Abomination Vaults.name: 憎恨魔窟 Abomination Vaults
Abomination Vaults.description:
进入超级地下城！邪恶在憎恨魔窟的深处蠢动，这是一座庞大的地城；数百年前，邪恶的术士贝科拉·哈鲁维克斯曾试图在此召集一支怪物大军。勇敢的英雄必须深入这座布满野兽与陷阱的地城，阻止一名怀恨在心的反派再次崛起。《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径是一套由三部分组成、每月推出的连续冒险系列，这些相互衔接的冒险共同构成一场完整的《Pathfinder》战役。

内容警告：《憎恨魔窟》虽然包含典型的《Pathfinder》动作与冒险内容，但也呈现自杀、歧视残障者、肉体恐怖与人体实验等主题。在开始之前，请理解玩家（包括游戏主持人）的同意对于让每个人都拥有安全且愉快的游玩体验至关重要。你应在开始冒险前与玩家交流，并视情况调整描述或情境。

Enter the megadungeon! Evil stirs in the depths of the Abomination Vaults, a sprawling dungeon where the evil sorcerer Belcorra Haruvex attempted to raise an army of monsters hundreds of years ago. Brave heroes must venture into a dungeon full of beasts and traps to prevent a spiteful villain from rising again. The Abomination Vaults Adventure Path is a three-part, monthly series of connected adventures that comprise a complete Pathfinder campaign.

Content Warning: While Abomination Vaults contains typical Pathfinder action and adventure, it also presents themes of suicide, ableism, body horror, and human experimentation. Before you begin, understand that player consent (including that of the Game Master) is vital to a safe and fun play experience for everyone. You should talk with your players before beginning the adventure and modify descriptions or scenarios as appropriate.
Abomination Vaults.caption:
当迷雾悄然蔓延，月亮低垂；当小镇沉睡，凄凉灯塔开始发光！
When the fog is creeping, and the moon is low; When the town is sleeping, Gauntlight starts to glow!

Pounce.name: 猛扑 Pounce
Pounce.description:
巨型避日蜘蛛蜥蜴虫疾行，并在该次移动结束时进行一次打击。若巨型避日蜘蛛蜥蜴虫在以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}状态开始此动作，则直到该能力的打击结束后才会失去隐匿。

The giant solifugid Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the giant solifugid began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

Bite Bite.publicNotes:
即使是最小的巨型日行蛛，也仍大到足以骚扰沙漠商队及其坐骑。

这些怪物害虫有六条腿和两条大型进食附肢，很容易被误认为是额外的一对腿。尽管它们既不是蜘蛛也不是蝎子，人们仍常称它们为骆驼蜘蛛、太阳蜘蛛或风蝎。

The smallest of giant solifugids are still large enough to harry desert traders and their mounts.

These monstrous vermin have six legs and two large feeding appendages easily mistaken for an additional pair of legs. They are often called camel spiders, sun spiders, or wind scorpions, despite the fact that they are neither spiders nor scorpions.

Speak with Animals (At Will) (Arthropods.name: 动物交谈（随意）（仅限节肢动物） Speak with Animals (At Will) (Arthropods Only)
Speak with Animals (At Will) (Arthropods.description:
你可以向动物提问、从它们那里得到回答，并对它们使用交涉（技能）。该法术不会让它们比平常更友善。狡猾的动物很可能言简意赅、闪烁其词，而不那么聪明的动物则常常会发表一些愚蠢的评论。

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你让敌人的心智充满疑虑。

区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要他们仍在该区域内，就在攻击掷骰上承受-1状态减值。

每回合一次，从你施放绝望术后的下个回合开始，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，将该散发的半径增加5英尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再尝试一次豁免。

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的指令。你可以在你维持法术的期间施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持法术时，你都可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹调 冷却、加热或调味 1 磅的非生物材料。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无主的、负载为轻或更低的物体抬离地面 1 尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体外观粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以以 10 轮的专注影响一个负载为 1 的物体；而对更大的物体，则每 1 负载需要 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述所注明者）仅会在你维持法术的期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

5 feet. A flickerwisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with pale yellow light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

Innocuous.name: 无害 Innocuous
Innocuous.description:
闪火的外表在陷入困惑（状态）的生物心智中会以一种奇异的方式呈现。具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}状态的生物永远不会以攻击将闪火作为目标，除非该生物在过去24小时内曾被闪火的电击能力所伤害。

A flickerwisp's appearance registers strangely in the minds of creatures who are confused. A creature with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition never targets a flickerwisp with attacks unless the creature has been damaged by the flickerwisp's shock ability within the last 24 hours.

它恢复 @Damage[1d4[治疗]] 生命值，且若该生物的困惑（状态）具有有限的持续时间，则其持续时间额外延长1轮。

Flicker.description:
闪火在相邻生物的头部周围的空气中翻腾并掠动，它的身体长度以一连串令人眼花缭乱、令人分心的脉冲闪烁与火花四溅。

该生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:18] 意志豁免中获得成功，否则将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 1轮（若为大失败则为2轮）。若为大成功，则该生物获得持续24小时的暂时免疫。

The flickerwisp churns and flits in the air around an adjacent creature's head, and its length flashes and sparkles in a bewildering array of distracting pulsations.

The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure). On a critical success, the creature is temporarily immune to for 24 hours.

Flickerwisp.publicNotes:
舞动、扭曲的闪火是一种力量更弱、但同样恶毒的鬼火。和更危险的同类一样，闪火偏好在荒僻的沼泽地或孤寂的河流、溪涧沿岸出没，尤其喜欢靠近岸边的地带，因为在那里它们可以把自己伪装成一小簇萤火虫。闪火的身体是一段长达3英尺、由发丝般纤维构成的长条；当这只生物在空中飞掠时，它会闪烁、搏动，绽出诡异黄色的光亮带状与光点。

闪火能品尝恐惧术，并觉得其滋味可口，但它并不以这种情绪为食。相反，闪火以困惑术与疑虑求生。旅人在林中迷失时散发出的那种不安感，是闪火最钟爱的佳肴。它们能从这种迷惘感中啜饮，而不暴露自身存在，也不伤害猎物。最终，闪火会饥饿到无法忍耐，被迫飞得更近，令猎物陷入困惑术，并大啖这些原始的情绪。闪火会尽力在死亡发生前俯冲离去；其中最娴熟的折磨者甚至能让选定的餐食存活数日，以少量多次的方式从困惑术中啜饮。

The dancing, twisting flickerwisp is a less powerful but no less malevolent type of will-o'-wisp. Like their more dangerous kin, flickerwisps prefer to haunt lonely swamps or stretches of lonely rivers or creeks, particularly near the shorelines where they can pass themselves off as nothing more than a small gathering of fireflies. A flickerwisp's body is a 3-foot-long length of hair-like fibers that flashes and pulses with ribbons and points of eerie yellow light as the creature flits through the air.

While a flickerwisp can taste fear, and finds the flavor delectable, it does not feed on this emotion. Instead, flickerwisps subsist on confusion and doubt. The sense of unease a traveler exudes when they become lost in the woods is flickerwisps' favorite repast. They can sip from this sense of disorientation without betraying their presence or harming their prey. Eventually, the flickerwisps grow too hungry and are compelled to flit closer, confuse their prey, and glut on the raw emotions. Flickerwisps do their best to swoop away before death occurs, and the most skilled of these tormentors can keep a chosen meal alive for days, sipping from confusion in small doses.

这只小马大小的巨蝇抽搐的肢体似乎从不停歇，它不停地清洁自己，并将任何可食之物舀进其口器。巨蝇主要以腐肉为食，但有时也会捕食牲畜或其他动作太慢、来不及逃走的动物。

Giant flies are pony-sized insects that have massive compound eyes and bodies bristling with short, stiff hairs. Their lairs are notorious for the rotting meat they stockpile to lay their eggs into. Their maggot-dens are also prime breeding grounds for virulent diseases.

Giant Scorpion.publicNotes:
这些巨大而可怖的蛛形类通常从头部到尾巴根部约有 8 英尺长。GIANT SCORPION 是多种沙漠栖居生物偏爱的驮兽与战兽，尤其是科洛斯。然而，它们最常见于野外；在那里，它们栖身于山坡洞穴中，或潜入浅薄的沙层之下，静候猎物靠近。

作为沙漠、森林、稀树草原与荒地中甲壳覆身的灾厄，蝎子是致命的蛛形类，拥有强力的螯钳与令人痛苦的毒刺。蝎子几乎遍布每一种气候，在那里它们以耐心的潜行与原始的力量相结合来猎捕猎物。大多数蝎子生活在地下洞穴中，或作为孤独的猎手，或作为更大群落的一部分。这些蛛形类如此令人畏惧且危险，以至于在许多文化中，它们被视为神祇，或被当作同时象征死亡与免于死亡之庇护的二元符号。

These massive, terrifying arachnids are typically 8 feet long from head to the base of the tail. Giant scorpions are the favored pack animals and war beasts of various desert-dwelling creatures, particularly kholos. They are most commonly encountered in the wild, however. There they lair in mountainside caves or burrow beneath shallow layers of sand where they lie in wait for prey to wander near.

Chitinous scourges of deserts, forests, savannas, and badlands, scorpions are deadly arachnids with powerful pincers and a painful sting. Scorpions can be found in nearly every climate, where they hunt their prey with a mixture of patient stealth and raw strength. Most scorpions live in underground burrows, either as lone hunters or part of a larger colony. These arachnids are so feared and dangerous that in many cultures, they are treated as deities or dualistic symbols of both death and protection from said death.

Mister Beak.name: 喙先生 Mister Beak

Occult Innate Spells.name: 神秘天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，使目标浮空，离地5尺。在法术的持续时间内，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作使目标上升或下降10尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个“交互”动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内无视该减值。若目标邻接于一个固定的物体或稳定性适当的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，例如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，例如天花板）沿着该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Light.name: 光亮术 Light
Light.description:
该物体发光，如同火把一般，在20尺半径内散发明亮光照（并在接下来的20尺内提供昏暗光照）。如果你再次对第二个物体施放该法术，则第一个物体上的光亮术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

升阶（4环） 该物体在60尺半径内散发明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺内提供昏暗光照）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

The object glows, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) like a torch. If you cast this spell again on a second object, the light spell on the first object ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The object sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单独的魔法手，它可以是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动最多20英尺。由于你是在使物体悬浮，你可以将其向任意方向移动。当你维持法术时，你可以额外移动该物体20英尺。若法术结束时物体仍在空中，物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以一件负载为1或更低的、无人持用的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件负载为1或更低的、无人持用的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件负载为2或更低的、无人持用的物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害和1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{随等级成长的持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听你差遣。你可以在你维持该法术期间施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 冷却、加热或调味1磅非生物材料。
  • 举起 缓慢将一件无人看管、负载为轻或更低的物体抬离地面1英尺。
  • 制作 创造一件临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——不能用作工具、武器或法术材料。
  • 整理 为一件负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以以10轮的专注影响一件1负载的物体；影响更大的物体则需要每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述内容者）仅在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Soul Gem.name: 灵魂宝石 Soul Gem
Soul Gem.description:
喙先生的灵魂焦点宝石位于他的背部，夹在他的双翼之间。

Mister Beak's soul focus gem is located on his back, nestled between his wings.

Personality Fragments.name: 人格碎片 Personality Fragments
Personality Fragments.description:
喙先生分享了其捐赠者——地精波波——灵魂的碎片，但没有波波的任何记忆。

Mister Beak shares fragments of the soul of its donor, the goblin Borbo, but none of Borbo's memories.

Mister Beak.publicNotes:
缚魂娃娃是令人不安的假人或玩具，被灌注了已故凡人灵魂的一小片碎片。这些小型构装体出于多种原因被制造——例如充当伙伴或仆役——但它们拥有自由意志，使其是否服从创造者绝非理所当然。法莱斯玛的追随者通常憎恶缚魂娃娃，认为它们是对灵魂自然循环的亵渎；而崇拜坟冢夫人的人则将摧毁缚魂娃娃（无论该构装体的阵营如何）视为对浩瀚众界的重要贡献。缚魂娃娃是一系列缚魂构装体中最简单的一种，这一系列还包括人类体型的缚魂假人、强大的缚魂外壳，以及哨兵缚魂陶俑武者。用不情愿的活体生物来制造它们属于邪恶行为；不情愿的奉献者可以通过一次成功的意志豁免来抵抗该过程（对抗创造者的制造 DC），若不能阻止奉献者死亡，也会使娃娃毁坏。非邪恶的娃娃只能由某人在死亡发生前已同意将其灵魂如此使用的情况下，以其灵魂来制作

冒险者遭遇的缚魂娃娃通常是某种守卫；尽管体型矮小，灵魂碎片的力量却使娃娃的拳头比随意观察者所预料的更加危险。此外，它还赋予娃娃一个法术，其力量远超其身形所应有。由于它们的自主性与非凡智能，缚魂娃娃偶尔会被其制作者雇用来担任更强大但无心智的构装体（如魔像）的管理者，使这些娃娃能够操控远超自身能力的防御。尽管缚魂娃娃包含一小片在某人死亡时或死亡后不久提取出的灵魂碎片，这并不会影响逝者的复活或其前往来世的进程。对原本仍然活着、可能作为灵魂奉献者的人而言，这种提取过程是致命的；不过也有传闻称存在更昂贵的工艺，能让人捐献活体灵魂的一小片而不产生不良后果。

灵魂碎片栖居于一颗灵魂聚焦宝石中，该宝石通常嵌在娃娃的颈部或胸口。灵魂碎片并非静止不变，娃娃会从其初始状态继续学习，这意味着它的性格与能力可能改变，可能更接近奉献者，也可能沿着自身的个体道路渐行渐远。即使娃娃被摧毁，缚魂娃娃的聚焦宝石仍会保留娃娃的记忆。被摧毁娃娃的完好灵魂聚焦宝石甚至可以由精通制造缚魂生物的人置入新的娃娃躯体中，从而有效地重组该缚魂娃娃。

Soulbound dolls are eerie mannequins or playthings that have been imbued with a small piece of a deceased mortal's soul. These little constructs are created for a variety of reasons-such as to serve as companions or servants-but their free will means their obedience to their creators is hardly a given. Followers of Pharasma generally abhor soulbound dolls, viewing them as a perversion of the natural cycle of souls, and those who worship the Lady of Graves see the destruction of a soulbound doll, regardless of the construct's alignment, as an important service to the Great Beyond. Soulbound dolls are the simplest in a series of soulbound constructs including human-sized soulbound mannequins, powerful soulbound shells, and sentinel soulbound terra-cotta warriors. Creating them from unwilling living creatures is evil, and an unwilling donor can resist the process with a successful Will save against the creator's Craft DC, ruining the doll if not preventing the donor's death. A non-evil doll can only be crafted from the soul of a person who has given consent to such use before their death occurred

Soulbound dolls encountered by adventurers are typically guardians of some sort; despite their diminutive size, the soul fragment's power makes the doll's flst more dangerous than a casual observer would expect. Further, it grants the doll a single spell of outsized power given its stature. Because of their autonomy and remarkable intelligence, soulbound dolls are occasionally employed by their crafters as administrators over much more powerful but mindless constructs such as golems, allowing such dolls to control defenses far beyond their own capabilities. Though soulbound dolls contain a small fragment of a soul extracted during or shortly after a person's death, this doesn't affect the deceased's resurrection or progress to the afterlife. This extraction process is lethal to otherwise-living prospective soul donors, though there are rumors of more expensive processes that allows someone to donate a fragment of a living soul without repercussions.

The soul fragment resides in a soul focus gem typically embedded in the doll's neck or chest. The soul fragment isn't static, and the doll continues to learn from its initial state, meaning its personality and abilities can change, possibly growing closer to the donor's or moving farther afield on its own individual path. The soulbound doll's focus gem retains the doll's memories even after the doll's destruction. The the intact soul focus gem of a destroyed doll can even be placed into a new doll body by someone knowledgeable in the creation of soulbound creatures, effectively reconstituting the soulbound doll.

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初先天法术 Primal Innate Spells

Speak with Animals (Arthropods Only, At.name: 与动物交谈（仅限节肢动物，随意） Speak with Animals (Arthropods Only, At Will)
Speak with Animals (Arthropods Only, At.description:
你可以向动物提问、从它们那里获得回答，并对动物使用交涉（技能）。该法术不会让它们比平常更友善。狡猾的动物很可能言辞简短且闪烁其词，而不那么聪明的动物则经常会做出愚蠢的评论。

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你让敌人的心智充满疑虑。区域内的敌人必须在意志豁免中成功，否则只要他们仍在该区域内，就在攻击掷骰上承受–1状态减值。在后续回合中，每轮一次，你可以维持该法术，将该散发的半径增加10英尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再尝试一次豁免。

绝望术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法听从你的命令。你可以在你维持该法术期间施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 使 1 磅非生物材料冷却、加热或调味。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无人持用、负载为轻或更低的物体抬离地面 1 英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙而不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法器，也不能作为法术的花费。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮的专注影响一个负载为 1 的物体，而更大的物体则每负载需 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述所注明的内容）仅在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.

Self-Loathing.name: 自我憎恶 Self-Loathing
Self-Loathing.description:
米特弗利特的自我厌恶使其很容易受到影响。它的意志DC对抗用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}的检定承受-4减值。

A mitflit's self-loathing makes it easy to influence. It takes a -4 penalty to its Will DC against checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}.

Vengeful Anger.name: 复仇之怒 Vengeful Anger
Vengeful Anger.description:
只要它没有处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}状态，米特弗利特对曾经伤害或折磨过它的生物进行的伤害掷骰获得+2状态加值。

As long as it isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, a mitflit gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against a creature that has previously damaged or tormented it.

Mitflit.publicNotes:
螨精自我厌弃、可怜又怯懦，很容易被其他生物——甚至只是稍微更强的螨精头目——欺凌并逼迫为其效劳。它们驯养昆虫、蜘蛛以及其他小型害虫，使其作为忠诚的盟友效力。螨精已失去了大部分祖传的魔法，这让它们感到自身残缺，充满怀疑与不安。螨精在世间其他卑微的生物身上寻找陪伴，并与害虫建立牢固的友谊纽带——那些似乎唯一愿意接纳它们的存在。某种社会结构，即便是它们被欺凌的结构，也能部分填补大多数螨精性格中的空洞；除非怒火突破临界点，否则它们很少反抗或坚持到底。

小魔怪是残忍的妖精诡术家与破坏者，它们已完全适应宇宙中的生活，为自己充满创意的毁灭性行为找到了明确的生态位。几乎所有小魔怪都以毁坏或弄坏事物为乐——无论是装置或载具之类的有形之物，还是同盟或关系之类的无形之物。小魔怪最大的快乐，是看着复杂造物崩塌，最好是在小魔怪进行一次轻微、精心针对的推动之后。小魔怪往往会贬低、欺凌，甚至屠杀它们较弱的同族，尤其是螨精；更强的小魔怪会轻蔑地称它们为“袋子”。

Mitflits are self-loathing and pitiful cowards, easily bullied into servitude by other creatures or even slightly more powerful mitflit leaders. They tame insects, spiders, and other small vermin to serve as faithful allies. Mitflits have lost most of their ancestral magic, leaving them to feel incomplete and full of doubt and insecurity. Mitflits find companionship in the other base creatures of the world, and forge strong bonds of friendship with vermin, the only other beings that seem willing to accept them. A social structure, even one in which they are bullied, partially fills the hole within most mitflits' personalities, and they rarely rebel or last out unless their rage hits a breaking point.

Gremlins are cruel fey tricksters and saboteurs who have fully acclimated to life in the Universe, finding distinct niches for their inventive destructiveness. Nearly all gremlins delight in ruining or breaking things, whether it's something physical like a device or vehicle or something intangible such as an alliance or relationship. A gremlin's greatest joy is watching the collapse of complex creations, preferably after the slightest, carefully targeted nudge from the gremlin. Gremlins tend to denigrate, bully, or even slaughter their lesser kin, particularly mitflits, whom stronger gremlins derisively call "baggies."

Tremorsense 30 feet.name: 震动感知 30 尺 Tremorsense 30 feet

Regurgitation.name: 反刍 Regurgitation
Regurgitation.description:
触发 巨型蛆虫受到伤害

效果 巨型蛆虫反刍出它那腐臭、令人作呕的一餐。所有位于 @Template[emanation|distance:5] 内的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:16] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}）。

巨型蛆虫在至少花费1小时以尸体为食之前，无法再次使用反刍。

Trigger The giant maggot takes damage

Effect The giant maggot regurgitates its rancid, foul meal. All creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

The giant maggot can't use Regurgitation again until it spends at least an hour feeding on a corpse.

Gnaw Flesh.name: 啃噬血肉 Gnaw Flesh
Gnaw Flesh.description:
需求 巨型蛆虫已对一名生物施加 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

效果 巨型蛆虫在咀嚼该生物的血肉时，对被擒抱的生物造成 @Damage[(1d8+2)[slashing]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] 豁免）。

Requirements The giant maggot has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} a creature

Effect The giant maggot deals @Damage[(1d8+2)[slashing]] damage to the grabbed creature as it chews the creature's flesh (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

Mudlicker Maggot.publicNotes:
巨蝇会把卵产在更大型怪物或牲畜的身体上。这些卵孵化时，会释放出扭动的蛆虫，体型如同人类孩童般大小；这些饥渴的幼体会贪婪地吞食近旁的任何血肉——通常从它们出生所依附的那具尸体开始。

巨蝇是体型如小马的昆虫，拥有巨大的复眼，身躯上密布短而硬的刚毛。它们的巢穴因囤积用来产卵的腐肉而臭名昭著。它们的蛆虫巢穴同样也是致命疾病的绝佳滋生温床。

Giant flies lay their eggs on the bodies of larger monsters or livestock. When they hatch, these eggs release squirming maggots the size of human children, ravenous young who voraciously consume any flesh in the immediate vicinity-typically starting with the body upon which they were born.

Giant flies are pony-sized insects that have massive compound eyes and bodies bristling with short, stiff hairs. Their lairs are notorious for the rotting meat they stockpile to lay their eggs into. Their maggot-dens are also prime breeding grounds for virulent diseases.

Slurk.name: 泥蛙 Slurk

+2 Status to Fortitude Saves vs. Grapple.name: 对抗擒抱、复位或推撞的强韧豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to Fortitude Saves vs. Grapple, Reposition, or Shove

Belly Grease.name: 肚子油腻术 Belly Grease
Belly Grease.description:
泥蛙从其腹侧腺体中挤出滑腻的油脂，覆盖其下方的地面以及以其为中心的 5 尺迸发范围，使受影响的区域在 10 分钟内变为不稳地面，之后会干燥成腐臭的硬壳。在黏液上方进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} 的 DC 为 18。

The slurk extrudes a slippery grease from its ventral glands to coat the floor under it and in a 5-foot emanation, turning the affected area into uneven ground for 10 minutes, after which it dries to a putrid crust. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} across the slime is 18.

Entangling Slime.name: 纠缠黏液 Entangling Slime
Entangling Slime.description:
被泥蛙的黏液喷射击中的生物会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}，并在1小时内或直到黏液被移除前，速度承受–5尺减值。

被缠住的生物或与该生物相邻的生物总共进行三次交互动作即可移除黏液。这些动作不需要连续进行，也不需要由同一个生物完成。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.jQmfZcPD6xVYx5nb]{Effect: Entangling Slime}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}

A creature struck by a slurk's slime squirt becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.jQmfZcPD6xVYx5nb]{Effect: Entangling Slime} and takes a –5-foot penalty to Speed for 1 hour or until the slime is removed.

The slime can be removed with a total of three Interact actions by the entangled creature or creatures adjacent to the creature. These actions don't need to be consecutive or made by the same creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}

Slurk.publicNotes:
泥蛙是一种黏稠、长着獠牙的蛙形野兽，出没于地下巢穴与洞窟。它有两根巨大的獠牙，用来刺穿猎物，也用来与敌对的泥蛙纠缠搏斗。凭借泥蛙天生攀爬墙壁、轻松附着天花板的能力，粗心的洞穴探险者很容易就会撞上这些可怕的象牙獠牙。

泥蛙苍白的白色皮肤会分泌两种截然不同、恶臭难闻的分泌物。泥蛙背部的大型脓疱会滴落一种黏稠、类似树脂的黏液，暴露在空气中后会迅速硬化。泥蛙能通过绷紧皮肤，将这些脓疱朝入侵者方向挤爆，使黏糊糊的胶质覆盖敌人，并严重限制他们抵御该怪物其他攻击的能力，其中就包括它另一种分泌物的效果。沿着泥蛙腹侧分布的腺体会分泌一种极其滑腻、又臭又腐的油腻术，这种油腻术能保护泥蛙免受自身背部黏液的束缚效果影响，同时也带来额外好处：让它极难被擒抱与捕获。要判断附近是否有泥蛙，最好的方法是寻找这种油腻术干硬后的结块——它们常在洞穴角落与岩石堆间堆积并干燥，那正是泥蛙在两餐之间休息的地方。

人们认为泥蛙是矮人一次失败尝试的后代：矮人原本想驯化并繁殖大型地下蛙类，作为食物与劳役动物。尽管这次尝试看似失败，其他生活在地下的族群却常常与泥蛙结为伙伴。这些黏糊糊的蛙形野兽对狗头人（第210页）而言极具吸引力，如今狗头人会驯养并训练泥蛙作为强力的坐骑与守卫。虽然其他生物，尤其是沼蜍人（特征），有时也会训练泥蛙充当守卫，但狗头人仍是最常使用这些生物的族群。骑乘泥蛙的狗头人常会躲藏在洞窟上方的岩架处，利用高度与突袭优势，以远程攻击骚扰敌人。狗头人骑手也会利用泥蛙的攀爬能力，从洞穴墙壁上向敌人发起冲锋。

The slurk is a sticky, tusked frog-beast found in underground lairs and caves. It has two massive tusks that it uses to gore prey and tangle with rival slurks. With the slurk's natural ability to climb walls and cling effortlessly to ceilings, it can be easy for unwary cave explorers to end up on the wrong end of these formidable ivory tusks.

Slurks exude two very different types of foul-smelling secretions from their pale white skin. Large pustules on the slurk's back drip a sticky resin-like slime that quickly hardens upon exposure to air. By flexing its skin, the slurk can burst these pustules in the direction of intruders, covering its foes in sticky goo and severely limiting their ability to withstand the monster's other attacks, including the effects of its other secretion. Glands along the slurk's ventral side excrete an incredibly slippery and fetid grease, which protects the slurk from the immobilizing effects of its own back slime but also has the added benefit of making it extremely difficult to grapple and capture. The best way to discover if a slurk is in the vicinity is to look for hard clumps of such grease, which accumulate and dry in cave corners and amid rock piles where slurks rest between meals.

Slurks are thought to be descendants of a failed dwarven attempt to domesticate and breed large subterranean frogs as food and labor animals. Despite this apparent failure, others who live underground often befriend slurks. The sticky frog-beasts have proven extremely desirable to kobolds (page 210), who now domesticate and train slurks as powerful mounts and guardians. While other creatures, particularly boggards, sometimes train slurks to serve as guardians, kobolds remain those who use these creatures the most. A kobold mounted on a slurk will often hide in the upper ledges of a cave, using the advantages of height and surprise to harry foes with ranged attacks. Kobold riders also take advantage of the slurk's ability to climb, and charge at their enemies from the walls of a cavern.
Slurk.allSaves: +12 to fortitude saves vs. Grapple, Reposition, or Shove

Tangletop.name: 鸡窝头 Tangletop

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初先天法术 Primal Innate Spells

Dimension Door (Self Only).name: 次元门（仅限自身） Dimension Door (Self Only)
Dimension Door (Self Only).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你所穿戴和持有的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你所能看见、位于射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会将另一名生物一并带上——即使你正把它装在一件异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对你的位置与距离即可。你获得持续1小时的暂时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光球，彼此间距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光球移动至多60英尺。每个光球必须保持在你120英尺范围内，且与其他所有光球保持在10英尺以内，否则就会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Mending.name: 修复术 Mending
Mending.description:
你修复目标物品。你每个法术阶位为目标恢复5点生命值，若此次修复使其超过该物品的破损阈值，则可能移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} 状态。你无法替换遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环）你可以以负载不超过1的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载不超过2的非魔法物体为目标，或以负载不超过1的魔法物体为目标。

You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的命令。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 冷却、加热或调味 1 磅的非生物材料。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无人持握的、负载为轻或更低的物体抬离地面 1 英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质构成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏它。你可以用 10 轮的专注影响一个负载为 1 的物体，而更大的物体则需要每点负载 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（除上述所述之外）仅在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Ventriloquism.name: 腹语术 Ventriloquism
Ventriloquism.description:
每当你说话或用声音发出任何其他声响时，你可以让你的发声看起来像是从60英尺内的其他位置传出，并且在你发声时可以自由改变该表观位置。任何听到该声音的生物都可以尝试识破你的幻觉。

强化（2环）该法术的持续时间增加至1小时，并且你还可以改变你的声音的音调、音色、质感以及其他性相。在生物能够尝试识破你的幻觉之前，它必须主动尝试一次察觉检定，或以其他方式使用动作来与该声音互动。

Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

Baffling Bluff.name: 令人困惑的虚张声势 Baffling Bluff
Baffling Bluff.description:
棕仙的滑稽把戏能使一名生物困惑并迷失方向。当棕仙使用“迷惑诡诈”时，它以30尺内的单一生物为目标；该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:17] 意志豁免。

该目标在1分钟内暂时免疫“迷惑诡诈”。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标短暂受骗，在棕仙下个回合结束前，针对棕仙对其进行的下一次近战打击时处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标困惑（状态）持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束困惑（状态）。

The brownie's antics can confuse and disorient a creature. When the brownie uses Baffling Bluff, it targets a single creature within 30 feet; that creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save.

The target is temporarily immune to Baffling Bluff for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is fooled momentarily and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next melee Strike the brownie makes against it before the end of the brownie's next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is confused for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confused condition.

Tangletop.publicNotes:
棕仙把家安在空心树的树干里、小而带泥土气息的地洞中，甚至在门廊下或农舍的爬行空间内。棕仙常穿着看起来由植物或树叶制成的衣服，系着一条缀满小袋与工具的腰带。无论他们选择用什么语言说话，往往都夹杂着古怪的发音与口语表达。他们的说话方式可能会引用早已过时几十年甚至几个世纪的措辞，例如；或者他们会以奇怪的方式把比喻混为一谈。几乎就像棕仙是故意采用这些古灵精怪的说话方式一样——当然，他们对纠正他们的闲聊反应并不友好。想惹恼一个棕仙，几乎没有比试图纠正它的语法更快的方法了。棕仙身高刚刚不到2英尺，体重约20磅。

面对危险时，棕仙很少投入战斗，而是更倾向于迷惑并扰乱袭击者，以争取足够的时间逃脱。棕仙满足于诚实的劳作与亲族的爱，保持着和平主义的天性；他们骚扰生物也仅仅是为了把对方赶走，或因受辱而施以惩戒。尽管如此，所有棕仙都携带一把刀刃。他们提起自己的剑时带着一丝厌恶，并戏称刀刃是他们的“最后把戏”，将其用途保留给最危急的情形。

棕仙诚实得近乎苛刻；他们会随意取用，但总会通过劳动偿还债务，或留下某物作为供品。他们可能会从农夫的果园里吃一个苹果，却以采收整棵树来作为回报。某个棕仙也许会吃掉窗台上放着的一整块派，但随后把厨房收拾得整整齐齐，或把碗碟洗干净。棕仙可以与一个家庭同住许多年而不被发现。知晓家中有棕仙存在的家庭通常会发现这是一种有益的关系，于是会留下牛奶、几块水果、小饰品，有时甚至还有葡萄酒作为赋礼。作为交换，常住的棕仙会保持家里整洁、缝补衣物、修理工具，并驱赶害虫与小型掠食者。吹嘘家里有棕仙，是失去它的最佳方式。棕仙不信任狐狸，惧怕狼，并且会避开有狗的农场。

Brownies make their homes in the trunks of hollow trees, small earthy burrows, and even under porches or within the crawl spaces of farmhouses. Often attired in clothes that appear to be made of plants or leaves, brownies wear belts lined with pouches and tools. Whatever language they choose to speak is often is riddled with odd pronunciations and colloquialisms. Their manner of speaking might call upon turns of phrase that are decades or even centuries out of vogue, for example, or they might mix up their metaphors in strange ways. It almost seems as if brownies adopt these quirky ways of speaking intentionally-certainly they do not react favorably to corrections to their chatter. There's often no swifter way to annoy a brownie than to try to correct its grammar. Brownies stand barely 2 feet tall and weigh about 20 pounds.

When facing danger, brownies rarely engage in combat, preferring instead to confound and confuse their attackers in order to buy enough time for escape. Content with honest toil and the love of their kin, brownies maintain a pacifist nature, harassing creatures only to run them off or punish them for an insult. Despite this nature, all brownies carry a blade. They refer to their swords with a hint of disgust, and jokingly call their blades their "final trick," reserving their use for the direst of circumstances.

Honest to a fault, brownies take freely but always repay their debt through work or leave something behind as an offering. They may eat an apple from a farmer's orchard but harvest the entire tree as repayment. A brownie might eat an entire pie left on a windowsill, only to straighten up the kitchen or wash the dishes. A brownie can share a home with a family for years and years while avoiding detection. A family that is aware of a brownie in their midst usually finds this a beneficial relationship and leaves dishes of milk, pieces of fruit, trinkets, and sometimes even wine as gifts. In exchange, the resident brownie keeps the home clean, mends clothes, repairs tools, and shoos away vermin and small predators. Bragging about having a brownie in the house is the best way to lose one. Brownies distrust foxes and fear wolves, and they avoid farms with dogs.

Vampiric Mist.name: 吸血魔雾 Vampiric Mist

Misty Form.name: 迷雾形态 Misty Form
Misty Form.description:
吸血魔雾的身体由半固体的红色雾气组成，其稠度类似浓厚的泡沫。这使得吸血魔雾能够穿过直径窄至1英寸的空间，且其速度不会降低。然而，吸血魔雾无法穿戴或与物体互动。它也无法进入水或其他液体，并且在风如何影响它这一目的下，被视为超小型。

A vampiric mist's body is composed of a semisolid red mist similar in consistency to thick foam. This enables a vampiric mist to move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch in diameter with no reduction to its Speed. However, a vampiric mist can't wear or interact with objects. It also can't enter water or other fluids, and it's treated as Tiny for the purpose of how wind affects it.

Sense Blood (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 感知血液（不精确）60英尺 Sense Blood (Imprecise) 60 feet
Sense Blood (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
吸血魔雾可以感知60尺内具有血液的生物。它可以在1英里内感知暴露的血液。

A vampiric mist can sense creatures that have blood within 60 feet. It can sense exposed blood within a mile.

Blood Siphon.name: 鲜血虹吸 Blood Siphon
Blood Siphon.description:
当吸血魔雾以雾状触须打击对生物造成伤害时，该生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。若该打击为大成功或大失败，则该生物的豁免结果比原本的豁免结果差一级。吸血魔雾从汲血获得的任何临时生命值在 1 小时后淡化。

成功 该生物不受影响。

Vampiric Mist.publicNotes:
尽管它们常常被误认为处于气化形体的吸血鬼（特征）或某种不寻常的气元素，吸血魔雾实际上是怪异的畸变生命体。它们的无定形躯体由液体与空气共同构成，在沼泽或潮湿的地下地区栖居，使其对热量的脆弱性不那么令人担忧。即便如此，它们仍偏好在此类区域的边缘附近筑巢，因为吸血魔雾需要持续供应的新鲜血液以维生。尽管从动物身上汲取的血液与其他任何来源同样滋养，这些残忍的怪物却极为偏爱来自有思想生物的血液风味。与鬼火一样，吸血魔雾发现恐惧术会为血液增添滋味，不过它们并不会因啜饮受惊者的血而获得任何特别优势。

尽管具备一定智能，吸血魔雾并不形成社会。它们有时会结成小团伙，但即使如此也对协作兴趣寥寥。吸血魔雾将大部分时间用于寻找猎物——这一追猎它们以极富创造力的方式进行。迷雾倾向于呈现出自己所饮之血的生物那种模糊、骨骼化的形态，这进一步增添了其神秘感，并助长了它们与亡灵有关的传言。确实，许多吸血魔雾乐于利用这种普遍的误解为己所用，引诱敌人采用愚蠢的战术——例如欺骗施法者试图对它们使用活力能量，就好像它们是亡灵怪物一般。

Though they're often mistaken for vampires in gaseous form or an unusual type of air elemental, vampiric mists are in fact strange aberrant life-forms. With an amorphous body that consists as much of fluid as it does of air, these creatures dwell in swamps or moist underground regions where their vulnerability to heat isn't as much of a concern. Still, they prefer to lair near the fringes of such areas, as a vampiric mist needs a constant supply of fresh blood for sustenance. While blood drawn from animals is just as nutritious as blood from anything else, these sadistic monsters vastly prefer the flavor of blood drawn from thinking creatures. Like will-o'-wisps, vampiric mists find that fear flavors the blood, though they gain no particular advantage by feeding on the frightened.

Although somewhat intelligent, vampiric mists do not form societies. They sometimes group into small gangs, but even then they show little interest in working together. Vampiric mists spend most of their time seeking prey-a pursuit they approach with great creativity. The mists' propensity for taking on vague, skeletal forms of the creatures whose blood they drink further adds to their mystique and fuels rumors that they have connections to the undead. Indeed, many vampiric mists enjoy using this common misconception to their advantage, leading foes to apply foolish tactics-such as tricking spellcasters into attempting to use vitality energy against them as if they were undead monsters.

触发 一名活体生物在夜晚于A11区域结束其回合

效果 一幅骇人的贝科拉影像从地板上的血迹中升起，仿佛由新鲜血液构成，并像灯塔一样在原地旋转。冰冷的蓝色光束从贝科拉的双眼与张开的口中射出，令水疱与衰败在血肉上蔓延。位于以A11区域中心为中心的 @Template[burst|distance:30] 内的活体生物必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:damaging-effect] 豁免。

随后，此怨灵进行先攻掷骰。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到 @Damage[1d8[void]] 伤害。

失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(1d8+6)[void]] 伤害，并在1轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}。

大成功或大失败 该生物受到 @Damage[(2d8+6)[void]] 伤害，并在1轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，随后在1轮内目眩。

Trigger A living creature ends its turn in area A11 at night

Effect A ghastly image of Belcorra, seemingly composed of fresh blood, rises from the bloodstain on the floor and rotates in place like a lighthouse. Beams of cold blue light shine from Belcorra's eyes and open mouth, causing blisters and decay to spread across flesh. Living creatures within a @Template[burst|distance:30] from the center of area A11 must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:damaging-effect] save.

The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d8[void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(1d8+6)[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(2d8+6)[void]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round then dazzled for 1 round.

@Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Wipe Away Blood] (trained) to wipe away enough of the bloodstain to disrupt the haunt's necromantic energies, or @Check[religion|dc:20|name:Excorcise Haunt] (trained) to exorcise the haunt

A bloody image of Belcorra arises, emits a soul‑draining light, then inhales blood from living creatures in the room.

如果闹鬼通过被禁用或因受到伤害而被摧毁，贝科拉的血腥魅影向上螺旋喷射，浸透通往A25区域的活板门，然后通过钥匙孔向上流走，这会将用于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} 的盗窃DC降至 @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Pick Trap Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock,skill,manipulate]。

在下一次日出时，血液会流回这间房间，闹鬼重置。一旦拉斯达·范克维尔从D9区域获救，该闹鬼将被永久摧毁。

If the haunt is disabled or destroyed through damage, the bloody phantom of Belcorra sprays upward in a spiral, dousing the trap door leading to area A25 before draining upward through the keyhole, which reduces the Thievery DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} to @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Pick Trap Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock,skill,manipulate].

At the next sunrise, the blood drains back down to this room and the haunt resets. The haunt is destroyed permanently once Lasda Venkervale is rescued from area D9.

Confusing Confrontation.description:
触发 一名生物进入房间中央一处被瓦砾完全或部分填满的方格

效果 六只幽魂般的狗头人伴随着诡异的嚎叫从瓦砾中涌出。区域 A7 内的每个生物都必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:18] 意志豁免，结果如下。随后，此怨灵掷骰先攻。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响，对“迷乱对峙”在24小时内暂时免疫，并意识到以威吓性的强势姿态展示支配力或许能平息幽魂狗头人的袭击。

大成功或大失败 该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 持续2轮，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}。

Effect Six ghostly kobolds surge out of the rubble with eerie yowls. Each creature in area A7 must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save with the following results. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, is temporarily immune to Confusing Confrontation for 24 hours, and realizes that a display of intimidating dominance might quell the ghostly kobolds' assault.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 2 rounds and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Comprehension Elixir (Lesser).description:
这剂苦涩的饮剂将你的心智开启至文字的潜能。在饮用该炼金药剂后的所列持续时间内，只要这些文字是用通用语言书写的，你就能理解你读到的任何词语。该炼金药剂并不会自动让你理解密码或极其晦涩的段落——你仍需要尝试一次技能检定来进行文书解读。持续时间为1分钟。

This bitter draught opens your mind to the potential of the written word. For the listed duration after drinking this elixir, you can understand any words you read, so long as they are written in a common language. This elixir doesn't automatically allow you to understand codes or extremely esoteric passages-you still need to attempt a skill check to Decipher Writing. The duration is 1 minute.

Skeptic's Elixir (Lesser).name: 怀疑者灵药（次级） Skeptic's Elixir (Lesser)
Skeptic's Elixir (Lesser).description:
持续时间 1分钟

启动 1 交互

这剂怀疑者灵药会使你的心智更加敏锐，并让你看穿说谎、虚假陈述与魔法诡计。你在用于察觉虚假之事的察觉检定与察觉DC上获得+1物品加值，无论那是口头的说谎还是书面的欺诈。你在意志豁免上也获得相同的物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.5Gof60StUppR2Xn9]{Effect: Skeptic's Elixir (Lesser)}

Duration 1 minute

Activate 1 Interact

This elixir sharpens your mind and allows you to see through lies, falsehoods, and magical trickery. You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks and Perception DCs to notice falsehoods, whether they're spoken lies or written deceit. You gain this same item bonus to Will saves.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.5Gof60StUppR2Xn9]{Effect: Skeptic's Elixir (Lesser)}

Caltrop Snare.description:

If the caltrops scatter into the same square as a creature, that creature must attempt the Acrobatics check immediately.

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.

To Cast a Spell from a scroll, the spell must appear on your spell list. Because you're the one Casting the Spell, use your spell attack roll and spell DC. The spell also gains the appropriate trait for your tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Any physical material components and costs are provided when a scroll is created, so you don't need to provide them when Casting a Spell from a scroll. You must replace any required material component for that spell with a somatic component. If the spell requires a focus, you must have that focus to Cast the Spell from a scroll.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Dream Spider.publicNotes:
梦蜘蛛的蛛网术带有虹彩般的色泽，并注入了与该生物毒素相同的致幻化合物。梦蜘蛛最初是热带丛林的居民，如今已很好地适应了温带环境，尤其在城市的屋顶间繁盛生长，在那里，阴暗的炼金术士利用它们的毒液制造一种名为战栗的药物。

Originally denizens of tropical jungles, dream spiders have adapted well to temperate environments, particularly thriving among the rooftops of cities where shady alchemists use their venom to produce the drug known as shiver.

Spiders range dramatically in size, yet all are to some extent venomous.

Freznelkesh.publicNotes:
尽管这些河流龙兽闪亮的鳞片与光滑的鳍状翅膀令它们看起来让人联想到河鱼，但它们实际上是统治海洋的巨龙的远亲。河流龙兽比大多数龙兽更小，却完全有能力祸害河上旅人，并且同样适应水面之上与水面之下的生活。这种灵活性使它们能够捕食种类繁多的猎物，从鱼类与沼蜍人（特征）到鹿，甚至偶尔还会袭击渡船乘客。

贪婪、兽性、受本能驱使，龙兽是类龙怪物，继承了与其共享进化渊源的原初巨龙那骇人伟力的一小部分。尽管它们比巨龙更弱、更慢，也更不倾向于理性思考，龙兽仍然是周遭生物与聚居地的威胁。它们尤其倾向于组成劫掠队——这种小型社会群体被贴切地称为“暴乱团”——使它们更加危险；一支河流龙兽的暴乱团就能迅速夷平河岸村落，而游荡的沙漠龙兽暴乱团则是商队行旅的灾祸。

尽管栖息地与能力差异极大，龙兽仍共享若干将它们统一为同一物种的生理特征。例如，龙兽没有前臂，这使它们在近战中只能依靠可怕的啃咬与厚鳞的尾巴。多数龙兽其实更愿意避免这种方式，而偏好在头顶飞行、从舒适的距离以其魔法吐息在大范围内制造浩劫。最后，所有龙兽都拥有一小部分祖传的类龙力量储备，能够汲取其力以施展令人难以置信的极速专长。

不同种类的龙兽很少发生冲突。原因部分在于它们迥异的栖息地，但龙兽也愿意在暴乱团之间协商简单的协议。不过，这种礼遇并不适用于雏龙；龙兽会愉快地将其当作猎物。被驯化且独自行动的龙兽也不在此类协议之列；若其驯养者不够强大、无法保护它们，它们同样会被视作任人猎取的目标。

龙兽蛋

虽然龙兽的皮并不比相似体型的生物更有价值，但龙兽蛋却是备受追捧的珍贵商品。它们既可作为强大法术的材料，也会被不同文化食用；然而，龙兽蛋最常见的用途是孵化并饲育龙兽，使其作为坐骑与守卫。

一只典型的龙兽每5年会产下一窝2d4枚蛋。蛋会在3到6周内孵化；在此期间必须置于符合其自然环境的条件下，也许这是龙兽饲养中最困难的性相。一般而言，繁育者很容易孵化沙漠或丛林龙兽的蛋（它们需要略微温暖的温度才能孵化）或河流龙兽的蛋（它们必须浸没在流动的水中）；但烈焰与霜寒龙兽的蛋需要极端温度才能孵化，而这类环境往往难以安全复现。

一枚龙兽蛋是一个物体，具有硬度3、5 HP，且没有损坏阈值。龙兽蛋的颜色在不同种类之间仅有细微差异。生物必须在一次 @Check[nature|dc:20] 检定中成功，或在相关的DC 20学识检定中成功，才能辨认某一枚蛋所属的龙兽种类。

龙兽一旦孵化，会对它所见到的第一个生物产生印刻。以这种方式被印刻的生物可以使用自然来训练并向该龙兽施放命令术。龙兽蛋的市场价格会随龙兽类型与具体法律情况而变化。由于龙兽是危险且聪慧的生物，许多社会并不认可龙兽蛋的交易，并将从事此事者定为犯罪。

龙兽幼体需要2年才能长到完全体型。受过良好训练的龙兽能成为可怕的坐骑或守卫，但许多粗心大意、自以为能训练龙兽的人都会被自己照看的龙兽吞噬。

Although the glistening scales and sleek, fin-like wings on these drakes give them an appearance reminiscent of river fish, they are actually distant relatives of the dragons that rule the oceans. While smaller than most drakes, river drakes are more than capable of plaguing river travelers and are equally at home above and below the water's surface. This flexibility allows them to catch a wide variety of prey, from fish and boggards to deer and the occasional ferry passenger.

Ravenous, bestial, and driven by instinct, drakes are draconic monsters who bear a fraction of the terrifying might of the primal dragons they share evolutionary roots with. While they're weaker, slower, and less inclined toward reason than dragons, drakes are nonetheless a menace to creatures and settlements around them. Their propensity for forming raiding parties—small social groups fittingly called "rampages"—makes them all the more dangerous; a single rampage of river drakes can quickly lay waste to a waterside village, and roving rampages of desert drakes are a plague to caravan traders.

Drakes share a number of physical characteristics that unite them as one species despite their wide variety of habitats and abilities. For example, drakes lack forearms, leaving them with their formidable jaws and thickscaled tails to use in close combat. Most drakes would rather avoid this, however, preferring to use their magical breath to wreak havoc in wide swaths from comfortable distances while flying overhead. Finally, all drakes have small reservoirs of their ancestral draconic power that they can tap into to perform incredible feats of speed.

Different species of drakes rarely come into conflict. Part of this is their distinct habitats, but drakes are open to negotiating simple agreements between rampages. This courtesy does not extend to dragonets, which drakes happily take as prey. Solitary tamed drakes are also excluded from such agreements and considered free game if their tamer isn't strong enough to protect them.

Drake Eggs

While drake hides aren't any more valuable than those of similarly sized creatures, drake eggs are prized commodities. They are used as components in powerful spells as well as eaten by various cultures, but the most common use for drake eggs is hatching and rearing drakes to serve as mounts and guardians.

A typical drake lays a clutch of 2d4 eggs every 5 years. Eggs hatch within 3 to 6 weeks, during which time they must be kept in conditions appropriate to their natural environment, perhaps the most difficult aspect of drake husbandry. While it is generally easy for breeders to incubate the eggs of desert or jungle drakes (which require mildly warm temperatures to hatch) or river drakes (which must be submerged in running water), the eggs of flame and frost drakes require extreme temperatures in order to hatch, which can be difficult to replicate safely.

A drake egg is an object with Hardness 3, 5 HP, and no Broken Threshold. The coloration of drake eggs varies only slightly from one species to the next. A creature must succeed at a @Check[nature|dc:20] check, or a relevant DC 20 Lore check, to identify the drake species of a specific egg.

Once a drake hatches, they imprint on the first creature that they see. A creature imprinted on in this way can use Nature to Train and Command that drake. The market price of a drake egg varies depending on the type of drake and the exact legal situation. Because drakes are dangerous and intelligent creatures, many societies do not condone the trade of drake eggs and criminalize those who engage in it.

It takes 2 years for a drake hatchling to grow to full size. A well-trained drake can make a fearsome mount or guardian, but many careless would-be drake trainers are devoured by their charges.

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象在你的空间中盘旋，可能导致那些攻击你的人改为命中其中一个幻象而非你本人。任何本应命中你的攻击都有一定的随机几率改为命中你的某个幻象而非你。若三个幻象都仍在，则命中你的几率为 1/4（[[/r 1d4]] 掷出 1）。若剩余两个幻象，则命中你的几率为 1/3（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1-2）。若只剩一个幻象，则几率为 1/2（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1-3）。

一旦某个幻象被命中，它就会被摧毁。若一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的 AC 但没有大成功或大失败，它会摧毁一个幻象，但没有额外效果（即使该攻击通常会在失败时产生效果）。若一次攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败且会命中某个幻象，则摧毁一个幻象，并且该次攻击掷骰改为对你成功。所有幻象都被摧毁后，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

[[/r 1d4]]

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d6]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

[[/r 1d4]]

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一股念动力的奔涌，你移动一个敌人或他们携带的某件物品。你可以尝试对目标进行缴械、推撞或绊摔，使用法术攻击掷骰代替运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你以疑惧充斥敌人的心智。

区域内的敌人必须在意志豁免中成功，否则只要他们仍在该区域内，其攻击掷骰就会承受 -1 状态减值。

每回合一次，自你施放绝望术后的下个回合开始，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，使该发散的半径增加 5 英尺，并迫使区域内尚未受影响的敌人再次尝试一次豁免。

绝望术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你扰乱目标的心智，并用一次精神冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，则它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个由简单声音组成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人类的喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗术的触须从你的指尖卷出，穿过空气疾驰而去。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。线内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半的虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受全额伤害。

大成功或大失败 该生物承受双倍虚空伤害与双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻象般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4点精神伤害和1d4点持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

高度强化（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{随等级缩放的持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道汲取敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物将尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，则使用其豁免结果往差一档的一个成功等级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法的力场护盾术。这视为使用【举起护盾术】动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，持续到你下个回合开始，但它不需要一只手来使用。

在该法术生效期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术的硬度为5。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。不同于正常的 Shield Block，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环） 护盾术的硬度为10。

升阶（5环） 护盾术的硬度为15。

升阶（7环） 护盾术的硬度为20。

升阶（9环） 护盾术的硬度为25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散的、无人持用的物体掷向目标；该物体必须在射程内且负载为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则根据你所投掷的物体，造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被投掷物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败：成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全部伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Disease and P.name: 对抗疾病和毒素的所有豁免获得 +2 状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Disease and Poison

Occult Attack.name: 异能攻击 Occult Attack
Occult Attack.description:
摩洛克邪教徒疾步至其速度的一半，忽略由天然洞窟特征（如碎石或石笋）造成的困难地形。

在其移动期间的任何时刻，摩洛克邪教徒可以施放通常需要两个动作或更少动作来施放的法术。

The morlock cultist Strides up to half its speed, ignoring difficult terrain caused by natural cavern features like rubble or stalagmites.

At any point during its movement, the morlock cultist can Cast a Spell that normally takes two actions or fewer to cast.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
摩洛克对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6点精准伤害。

The morlock deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Graulgust.publicNotes:
在各自的密会中担任祭司的摩洛克通常会涉猎诡异的神秘学魔法。

摩洛克起源于早已与地表世界失联的人类。他们对机械、拾荒以及怪异的神秘学行为具有亲和力。

Morlocks who serve as priests in their conclaves usually dabble in eerie occult magic.

Morlocks originate from humans long lost to the surface world. They have an affinity for machinery, scavenging, and strange occult behaviors.
Graulgust.allSaves: +2 status to all saves vs. disease and poison

Grothlut.name: 胶化人 Grothlut

Disgusting Demise.name: 恶心的终结 Disgusting Demise
Disgusting Demise.description:
当胶化人降至0生命值时，它的消化器官会破裂，将炼金酸液与毒素释放到所有位于@Template[emanation|distance:30]内的生物身上。区域内的每个生物必须在@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免中成功，否则将受到@Damage[2d6[acid]]伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（大成功或大失败时伤害加倍并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}）。

When the grothlut is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its digestive organs rupture, unleashing alchemical acid and poison upon all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or take @Damage[2d6[acid]] damage and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (double damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

Piteous Moan.name: 悲惨哀鸣 Piteous Moan
Piteous Moan.description:
60英尺。

每个进入该区域或在该区域内开始其回合的非胶化人生物都必须成功通过一次 @Check[will|dc:17] 豁免检定，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（大成功或大失败中的大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}）。随后，该生物在1分钟内获得暂时免疫。

胶化人可以解除该光环。

胶化人通常直到其感官到非胶化人生物的存在才会开始呻吟，而一旦它不再感官到任何此类生物，通常就会停止。

60 feet.

Each nongrothlut creature that enters or starts its turn within the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:17] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The creature then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

The grothlut can Dismiss this aura.

A grothlut usually does not begin moaning until it senses the presence of a non-grothlut creature, and it usually stops once it doesn't sense any more such creatures.

Grothlut.publicNotes:
如蛞蝓般的憎邪，胶化人是塑肉仪式过程中怪诞的残渣。它们的头与躯干隐约呈人形，但手臂如橡胶般柔软，笨拙地垂在身体两侧并摇摆。作为可怜的生物，当附近有其他生物时，它们会凄厉地呻吟，或许是其心智最后的残余在哀求从这可怖的扭曲形态中解脱。

许多塑肉者认为胶化人是造物的失败，因为这种转化几乎抹去了意识。也有人不同意，认为扭曲生物的心智反而更有用，因为它会变得顺从且易于驱赶。哈艮地的邪教徒通常将胶化人用作守卫，让它们缓慢巡逻其据点的边缘。一旦就位，胶化人还能被当作粗劣的突击兵使用，被放出去削弱敌军，随后更有价值的武者再冲上前，斩杀那些被胶化人爆裂的器官与血肉所致恶心不适的敌人。

魔法事故、神祇诅咒与未经测试的技术都足以对身体造成剧烈的转化，而这些在格拉利昂乃至更远之地都十分猖獗。经历了如此剧烈的变化、以至于不再能被视为与先前相同族裔的生物，被称为塑肉裔。此类存在相当罕见，其令人不安的外貌往往会引起他人的惊恐反应。

有些生物沉溺于通过塑肉仪式将被击败的敌人彻底贬损。尽管这项技艺最初由恶魔领主哈艮地传授给凡人，但凡人已耗费无数纪元对其加以改造并臻于完善。塑肉匠将敌人折磨于翻涌的魔法试剂之缸中，重塑其血肉与心灵，把它们一并扭造成骇人而怪物般的东西。

Sluglike abominations, grothluts are grotesque dregs of the fleshwarping process. While their head and torso are vaguely humanoid, their arms are rubbery and move awkwardly at their sides. Wretched creatures, they moan piteously when other creatures are near, perhaps as the last remnants of their mind pleads to be free from their horrid warped form.

Many fleshwarpers consider the grothlut to be a failure of a creation, as the transformation all but stamps out consciousness. Others disagree, arguing that warping the creature's mind makes it all the more useful, since it becomes pliable and easy to herd. Cultists of Haagenti typically use grothluts as guardians that slowly patrol the edges of their enclaves. Once in position, grothluts can be used as crude shock troops, unleashed to soften enemy forces before more valuable warriors wade in and cut down the enemies who have been nauseated by the grothluts' exploded organs and flesh.

Magical mishaps, divine curses, and untested technology are all capable of wreaking drastic transformations on the body, and are all rampant on the world of Golarion and beyond. Creatures that have undergone changes so drastic they no longer can be considered the same ancestry as they were before are known as fleshwarps. These beings are rare, and their unsettling appearance often provokes horrified responses from other people.

Some creatures revel in the total degradation of their defeated foes through fleshwarping. Though the technique was originally taught to mortals by the demon lord Haagenti, mortals have spent eons modifying and perfecting the method. Fleshcrafters torture their enemies in vats of churning magical reagents, reshaping their flesh and psyche alike into horrid and monstrous things.

Majordomo.name: 总管 Majordomo

Light Vulnerability.name: 光亮术弱点 Light Vulnerability
Light Vulnerability.description:
对幽影的攻击若由处于魔法光亮术中的生物发起，或使用处于魔法光亮术中的物体发起（例如来自 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} 法术），则视为魔法攻击。

Attacks against the shadow are treated as magical if made by a creature who is in magical light or with an object that is in magical light (such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} spell).

Shadow Spawn.name: 幽影衍生物 Shadow Spawn
Shadow Spawn.description:
当生物的幽影被“偷窃幽影”拉离时，它会成为由创造它的幽影所命令的幽影衍生物。这个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} 没有“偷窃幽影”，并且永久且无法治愈地处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}。

如果被拉出幽影衍生物的那名生物死亡，幽影衍生物会成为一个完全成熟、具有自主性的幽影。如果该生物从其衰弱中恢复，它的幽影会返回到它身上，而幽影衍生物会被熄灭。

When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a shadow spawn under the command of the shadow that created it. This @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.clzHAfegb9Rn6DOe]{Shadow Spawn} doesn't have Steal Shadow and is perpetually and incurably @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its enfeeblement, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.

Slink in Shadows.name: 潜入幽影中 Slink in Shadows
Slink in Shadows.description:
幽影可以在生物或物体的幽影中@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}或结束其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}。

The shadow can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or end its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in a creature's or object's shadow.

Steal Shadow.name: 窃取幽影 Steal Shadow
Steal Shadow.description:
需求 幽影在其上一动作中用幽影之手打击命中了一个活着的生物

效果 幽影拉扯目标的幽影，使该生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。这会与来自幽影的其他力竭（状态）叠加，最高至 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}。如果这使一个生物的力竭（状态）值提高到3或更高，目标的幽影会从其身体分离（见幽影孽种）。来自偷取幽影的力竭（状态）值每小时降低1。

Requirements The shadow hit a living creature with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action

Effect The shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body (see shadow spawn). The enfeebled value from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.

Majordomo.publicNotes:
被称为幽影的神秘不死生物潜伏在黑暗之处，吞噬那些离光亮术太远的迷途之人。

The mysterious undead known as shadows lurk in dark places and feed on those who stray too far from the light.

Morlock.publicNotes:
摩洛克源自早已从光亮术世界消失的人类，是栖居在幽暗地域上层错综复杂隧道中的残暴怪物。它们瘦长的身躯掩盖了四肢的力量与迅捷的反应动作（），而它们的手臂之长，足以让它们为追求速度或隐匿而伏低身体，以四肢进行一种诡异的疾行。它们已不再记得祖先在地表过着怎样的生活，尽管仍有许多摩洛克栖身于其远古家园的破碎废墟之中。有些摩洛克把这些逝去年代的人类雕像当作神祇来崇拜；但也有些则转而崇拜拉玛什图、罗伐古格或其他暴虐的神祇。

摩洛克幼体永不满足，会为哪怕最微小的一口食物而喧嚷；若没有其他食物出现，它们甚至会吞食自己的同胞兄弟姐妹。大多数摩洛克都会鼓励这种行为，以确保整个祖裔族群整体变得更强。

一名典型的摩洛克身高略高于5英尺，体重约150磅。

Originating from humans long lost from the world of light, morlocks are brutal monsters that dwell in the tangled tunnels of the upper reaches of the Darklands. Their wiry frames mask the strength of their limbs and their swift reactions, and their arms are long enough that they can drop into an uncanny, four-limbed shuffle for speed or stealth. They no longer remember the lives their ancestors led on the surface, although many morlocks still dwell in the shattered ruins of their ancient homes. Some morlocks worship the statues of humans from these bygone eras as gods, but others now worship Lamashtu, Rovagug, or other violent deities.

Morlock young are insatiable and clamor for even the slightest morsel of food, even consuming their siblings if no other meal presents itself. Most morlocks encourage the practice to ensure their ancestral group as a whole grows stronger.

A typical morlock stands just over 5 feet tall and weighs roughly 150 pounds.
