Mark Quarry.name: 马克·采石场 Mark Quarry
Mark Quarry.description:
可将一只爬行之手指定一名猎物：用目标猎物的一滴血涂抹于手上即可。若这只手在任何时候没有猎物，它会自动将下一个被其造成伤害的生物作为猎物。当这只手使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks}其猎物时，其察觉检定获得+1环境加值；当它使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks}追踪其猎物时，其生存检定获得+1环境加值；当它打击其猎物时，其伤害掷骰获得+1环境加值。

A crawling hand can be assigned a quarry by anointing the hand with a drop of the intended quarry's blood. If the hand ever has no quarry, it automatically gains the next creature it damages as its quarry. The hand gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks} its quarry, to Survival checks when it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks} its quarry, and damage rolls when it Strikes its quarry.

Throat Grab.name: 喉咙擒拿 Throat Grab
Throat Grab.description:
此能力的运作方式如同擒抱，但爬行手会抓住一个中型或更小生物的喉咙。以此方式处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}状态的生物难以说话，并且必须额外花费1个动作才能执行任何需要说话的动作，包括施放法术。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Grab]

This ability functions as Grab, but the crawling hand grips the throat of a Medium or smaller creature. A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} this way has difficulty speaking and must spend an extra action to perform any action that requires speaking, including casting spells.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Grab]

Crawling Hand.publicNotes:
通常，爬行手是由被切断的肢体在邪恶的死灵能量灌注下获得粗浅知觉而形成，这些能量会将它们变成不知疲倦的杀手。然而，爬行手也可能自发出现，通常发生在生物在死灵能量充盈之地，或与负能量位面相连之处失去肢体时。

由中型生物的肢体形成的爬行手迅捷而灵活，在幽影中疾窜，直到它能出击袭击其猎物。

Typically, crawling hands are formed when severed appendages are endowed with a crude sentience by evil necromantic energies that turn them into tireless killers. Yet crawling hands can also arise spontaneously, usually when a creature loses an appendage in a place rife with necromantic energy or with a connection to the Negative Energy Plane.

A crawling hand formed from the appendage of a Medium creature is quick and agile, skittering in the shadows until it can strike its prey.

Jaul Mezmin.name: 杰尔·梅兹勄 Jaul Mezmin

Primal Prepared Spells.name: 原初备制法术 Primal Prepared Spells

Animal Order Spells.name: 动物目法术 Animal Order Spells

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一道闪电箭从你的手中向外射出，造成 4d12 电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d12。

A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Wall of Thorns.name: 棘墙术 Wall of Thorns
Wall of Thorns.description:
在一分钟的过程中，你使一堵厚实、布满尖刺的荆棘灌木墙从地面生长出来。你创造一堵厚5尺、直线形的荆棘与棘刺之墙，最长60尺，高10尺。你必须在一段连续不断的开放空间中创造这堵墙，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术将失效。墙体竖直矗立。若你愿意，墙的长度或高度可以更短。墙两侧的所有事物，都能从另一侧的生物那里获得掩蔽，且墙的空间为困难地形。每当一名生物使用一个移动动作进入至少一个墙的空间时，该生物受到3d4穿刺伤害。

墙的每个10尺×10尺区段具有AC 10、硬度10以及20生命值。它免疫大成功或大失败命中与精准伤害。被摧毁的区段可以被自由穿过。

升阶（+1） 墙的每个区段的生命值增加5点，且穿刺伤害增加1d4。

Over the course of a minute, you cause a thick wall of thorny brambles to grow from the ground. You create a 5-foot-thick wall of brambles and thorns in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall stands vertically. If you wish, the wall can be of a shorter length or height. Everything on each side of the wall has cover from creatures on the opposite side, and the wall's spaces are difficult terrain. For every move action a creature uses to enter at least one of the wall's spaces, that creature takes 3d4 piercing damage.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 10, and 20 Hit Points. It's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section can be moved through freely.

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 5, and the piercing damage increases by 1d4.

Water Breathing.name: 水下呼吸 Water Breathing
Water Breathing.description:
目标可以在水下呼吸。

升阶（3环） 持续时间增加至8小时。

升阶（4环） 持续时间增加至直到你的下次每日准备。

The targets can breathe underwater.

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to until your next daily preparations.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你掷出一团酸液，使其溅射到你的目标及附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6点酸蚀伤害外加1点溅射酸蚀伤害。在大成功或大失败时，目标还会受到@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至2d6，持续伤害提高至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至3d6，持续伤害提高至3，且溅射伤害提高至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至4d6，持续伤害提高至4，且溅射伤害提高至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至5d6，持续伤害提高至5，且溅射伤害提高至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，用以确认魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。不过，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如一瓶隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的、等级最高的效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环）同3环等级，但你也能定位最高等级魔法的源头。如同模糊感官，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将源头缩小到一个5英尺立方体内（若其大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Feather Fall.name: 羽落术 Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落减缓至每轮60英尺，且在法术持续时间内发生的坠落部分，在计算坠落伤害时不计入。若目标在法术效果仍在持续时触地，它不会因这次坠落而受到伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Grease.name: 油腻术 Grease
Grease.description:
你召唤油腻术，其效果取决于你选择区域或目标。

  • 区域 [4个相连的5尺方格] 区域内所有坚实地面都被油脂覆盖。每个站在油腻表面上的生物必须成功通过一次反射豁免或一次特技检定来对抗你的法术DC，否则就会倒下并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。在法术持续时间内，使用一个动作移动到油腻表面上的生物必须尝试进行一次反射豁免或一次特技检定以保持平衡。进行快步或匍匐的生物不必尝试进行检定或豁免。
  • 目标 [1件负载1或更少的物体] 若你将此法术施放于一件无人持用的物体上，任何试图拾起该物体的人都必须成功通过一次特技检定或反射豁免来对抗你的法术DC才能做到。若你以一件有人持用的物体为目标，持有该物体的生物必须尝试进行一次特技检定或反射豁免。失败时，持有者或使用者在所有涉及使用该物品的检定中承受-2环境减值；大失败时，持有者或使用者会放开该物品。该物体落在GM选择的相邻方格中。若你将此法术施放在一件穿戴的物体上，穿戴者在对抗试图擒抱他们的强韧豁免中获得+2环境加值。

You conjure grease, with effects based on choosing area or target.

  • Area [4 contiguous 5-foot squares] All solid ground in the area is covered with grease. Each creature standing on the greasy surface must succeed at a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Creatures using an action to move onto the greasy surface during the spell's duration must attempt either a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check to Balance. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save.
  • Target [1 object of Bulk 1 or less] If you cast the spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to do so. If you target an attended object, the creature that has the object must attempt an Acrobatics check or Reflex save. On a failure, the holder or wielder takes a -2 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; on a critical failure, the holder or wielder releases the item. The object lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice. If you cast this spell on a worn object, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against attempts to grapple them.

Heal.name: 治疗术 Heal
Heal.description:
你引导生命力能量来为活物治疗或伤害亡灵。若目标为自愿的活物生物，你恢复1d8点生命值。若目标为亡灵，你对其造成等量的生命力伤害，且其进行一次基础强韧豁免。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30英尺。若你正在为一个活物生物治疗，使恢复的生命值增加8点

3 (材料, 姿势, 言语) 你在30英尺的放射中散布生命力能量。这会以爆发为目标涵盖其中所有活物与亡灵生物。

升阶（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值增加1d8点，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8点。

You channel vitality energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8

3 (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse vitality energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Heal Animal.name: 治疗术动物 Heal Animal
Heal Animal.description:
你治疗动物的伤口，使目标恢复 1d8 生命值。施放该法术所花费的动作数决定其效果。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (姿势, 言语) 该法术的射程为30尺，并使目标额外恢复 8 生命值。

升阶（+1） 治疗量增加 1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加 8。

You heal an animal's wounds, restoring 1d8 Hit Points to the target. The number of actions spent Casting this Spell determines its effect.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (somatic, verbal) The spell has a range of 30 feet and restores an additional 8 Hit Points to the target.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8, and the additional healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Magic Fang.name: 魔牙术 Magic Fang
Magic Fang.description:
选择一个目标的徒手攻击。你使该徒手攻击以原初能量闪耀。该徒手攻击变为一把+1强击徒手攻击，获得对攻击掷骰的+1物品加值，若其原本只有1个伤害骰，则将伤害骰数量增加至2个。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MqZ6FScbfGtXB8tt]{Spell Effect: Runic Body}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MqZ6FScbfGtXB8tt]{Spell Effect: Runic Body}

Choose one of the target's unarmed attacks. You cause that unarmed attack to shine with primal energy. The unarmed attack becomes a +1 striking unarmed attack, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of damage dice to two if it had only one.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MqZ6FScbfGtXB8tt]{Spell Effect: Runic Body}

Produce Flame.name: 燃火术 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一小团火焰出现在你手心里，你用它鞭打而出，可以进行近战或远程攻击。对你的目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及范围内的生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成2d4火焰伤害。大成功时，目标受到双倍伤害，并受到@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4，并且大成功时的持续伤害增加1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Summon Animal.name: 召唤动物 Summon Animal
Summon Animal.description:
你召唤一只动物为你作战。你召唤一只具有动物（特征）且等级为 -1 的普通生物，例如《开拓者怪物图鉴》各卷中所收录的那些。升阶该法术会提高你能够召唤的生物的最高等级。

升阶（2环） 等级 1

升阶（3环） 等级 2

升阶（4环） 等级 3

升阶（5环） 等级 5

升阶（6环） 等级 7

升阶（7环） 等级 9

升阶（8环） 等级 11

升阶（9环） 等级 13

升阶（10环） 等级 15

You conjure an animal to fight for you. You summon a common creature that has the animal trait and whose level is -1, such as those found in Pathfinder Bestiary volumes. Heightening the spell increases the maximum level of creature you can summon.

Heightened (2nd) Level 1

Heightened (3rd) Level 2

Heightened (4th) Level 3

Heightened (5th) Level 5

Heightened (6th) Level 7

Heightened (7th) Level 9

Heightened (8th) Level 11

Heightened (9th) Level 13

Heightened (10th) Level 15

Tanglefoot.name: 绊足术 Tanglefoot
Tanglefoot.description:
一根覆盖着黏稠树液的藤蔓凭空出现，从你手中甩出并缠向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。

大成功或大失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}，并在1轮内其速度受到-10尺的环境减值。它可以针对你的法术DC尝试逃脱以移除该减值和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}。

成功 目标在1轮内其速度受到-10尺的环境减值。它可以针对你的法术DC尝试逃脱以移除该减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine}

失败 目标不受影响。

升阶（2环） 效果持续2轮。

升阶（4环） 效果持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}

A vine covered in sticky sap appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack against the target.

Critical Success The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition and takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.TwtUIEyenrtAbeiX]{Spell Effect: Tangle Vine} condition.

Success The target takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

Bejeweled Necklace featuring a Porpoise.name: 饰有鼠海豚的宝石项链 Bejeweled Necklace featuring a Porpoise

Wolf Empathy.name: 狼类认同 Wolf Empathy
Wolf Empathy.description:
Jaul可以与犬科动物交流。

Jaul can communicate with lupines.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Poison.name: 对抗毒素时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Poison

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
• 人类
    • 近战 拳 [[/r 1d20+16 #Fist]]{+16}/[[/r 1d20+12 #Fist]]{+12}/[[/r 1d20+8 #Fist]]{+8}（灵巧，非致命），伤害 @Damage[(1d6+7)[bludgeoning]] 伤害
  • 狼
    • 速度 40英尺
    • 近战 啃咬[[/r 1d20+16 #Jaws]]{+16}/[[/r 1d20+11 #Jaws]]{+11}/[[/r 1d20+6 #Jaws]]{+6}，伤害 @Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]] 伤害加上 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}

    • 该兽化生物变为其类人、混合或动物形态。每种形态都有特定且持续的外观。真正的兽化生物的自然形态是其混合形态。

    在类人形态下，该兽化生物使用其原本的类人体型，失去其啃咬与爪击打击，并获得一次近战拳打击，其造成的钝击伤害等同于其爪击所造成的挥砍伤害。

    在动物形态下，其速度与体型变为该动物的数值，获得该动物的任何其原本没有的特殊打击效果（例如擒抱），并失去其武器打击。

    @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

    • Human
      • Melee fist [[/r 1d20+16 #Fist]]{+16}/[[/r 1d20+12 #Fist]]{+12}/[[/r 1d20+8 #Fist]]{+8} (agile, nonlethal), Damage @Damage[(1d6+7)[bludgeoning]] damage
    • Wolf
      • Speed 40 feet
      • Melee jaws[[/r 1d20+16 #Jaws]]{+16}/[[/r 1d20+11 #Jaws]]{+11}/[[/r 1d20+6 #Jaws]]{+6}, Damage @Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]] damage plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.BCLvAx4Pz4MLa2pu]{Knockdown}

    The werecreature changes into its humanoid, hybrid, or animal shape. Each shape has a specific, persistent appearance. A true werecreature's natural form is its hybrid shape.

    In humanoid shape, the werecreature uses its original humanoid size, loses its jaws and claws Strikes, and gains a melee fist Strike that deals bludgeoning damage equal to the slashing damage dealt by its claw.

    In animal shape, its Speed and size change to that of the animal, it gains any special Strike effects of the animal that it didn't already have (such as Grab), and it loses its weapon Strikes.

    @Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Curse of the Werewolf.name: 狼化人诅咒 Curse of the Werewolf
Curse of the Werewolf.description:
该诅咒仅影响类人生物。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

在每个满月，被诅咒的生物必须再次成功进行一次强韧豁免，否则将变成狼化人直到黎明。

该生物受GM控制，并在半个夜晚里横冲直撞，随后在黎明时坠落至昏迷状态。

This curse affects only humanoids.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

On each full moon, the cursed creature must succeed at another Fortitude save or turn into a werewolf until dawn.

The creature is under the GM's control and goes on a rampage for half the night before falling unconscious at dawn.

Moon Frenzy.name: 满月狂乱 Moon Frenzy
Moon Frenzy.description:
当满月出现在夜空中时，Jaul必须进入他的混合形态，此后无法再进行变形，体型变为大型，触及增加5尺，且其啃咬的伤害增加2。

当月亮落下或太阳升起时，Jaul恢复为类人生物形态，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}状态，持续[[/br 2d4 #Fatigued duration]]{2d4小时}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}

When a full moon appears in the night sky, Jaul must enter his hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes Large, increases his reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of his jaws by 2.

When the moon sets or the sun rises, Jaul returns to humanoid form and is [[/br 2d4 #Fatigued duration]] for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}{2d4 hours}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}

Wolf Coordination.name: 狼之协攻 Wolf Coordination
Wolf Coordination.description:
Jaul的打击对处于他的狼的触及范围内的生物造成额外1d6点伤害。

Jaul's Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures within his wolf's reach.

Jaul Mezmin.blurb:
男性人类狼化人追踪者
Male human werewolf stalker

Jaul Coordination.name: 杰尓协攻 Jaul Coordination
Jaul Coordination.description:
狼对处于Jaul触及范围内的生物造成额外1d6伤害。

The wolf deals 1d6 extra damage to creatures within Jaul's reach.

Otari Ilvashti.name: 奥塔里·伊瓦什提 Otari Ilvashti
Otari Ilvashti.tokenName: 奥塔里·伊瓦什提 Otari Ilvashti

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
区域 D18

典型的幽灵（特征）只能偏离其被杀之处或其萦绕之地的短距离。典型的限制是120英尺。有些幽灵（特征）则不是被束缚于某个地点，而是被束缚于对其特别的房间、建筑、物品或生物。

Area D18

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
寻回玫瑰团的四件遗珍并将其放置在D13区域的祭坛上，可以让奥塔里前往来世。

当一个幽灵（特征）被摧毁时，它会在其被束缚的地点于[[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4天}后重新成形，并完全恢复。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止灵魂休息的事物，幽灵（特征）才能被永久摧毁。

Securing the four icons of the Roseguard and placing them on the altar in area D13 allows Otari to move on to the afterlife.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Filth Fever.name: 腐热症 Filth Fever
Filth Fever.description:
由腐热症导致的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} 状态不会自行改善，直到该疾病被治愈为止。

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

阶段 1 携带者，无任何不良效果（[[/gmr 1d4 #Incubation]]{1d4 小时}）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（1 天）

阶段 3 恶心 1，且只要受影响的生物仍处于恶心状态，就会同时具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（1 天）

阶段 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}（1 天）

阶段 5 死亡

The @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} conditions from filth fever don't improve on their own until the disease is cured.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect ([[/gmr 1d4 #Incubation]]{1d4 hours})

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 Sickened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as the affected creature remains sickened (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

Infested Shadow.name: 鬼影 Infested Shadow
Infested Shadow.description:
奥塔里淡化，短暂地从30英尺内另一名生物的幽影中现身，并对该生物触及范围内的一个目标进行一次幽灵之手打击（但不能以他寄生其幽影的那名生物为目标）。

打击成功时，目标还会处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态，直到奥塔里下个回合开始。随后奥塔里在其起始位置重新出现。

奥塔里寄生其幽影的那名生物会暴露于腐热症。

Otari fades away, momentarily emerges from the shadow of another creature within 30 feet, and makes a ghostly hand Strike against a single target within reach of this creature (but not against the creature whose shadow he infests).

On a successful Strike, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of Otari's next turn. Otari then reappears at his starting point.

The creature whose shadow Otari infests is exposed to filth fever.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
奥塔里对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物造成2d6额外精准伤害。

Otari deals 2d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Otari Ilvashti.blurb:
男性幽灵冒险者
Male ghost adventurer
Otari Ilvashti.prototypeToken: 奥塔里·伊瓦什提 Otari Ilvashti

Poltergeist.name: 骚灵 Poltergeist

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).name: 念动战技（随意） Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will)
Telekinetic Maneuver (At Will).description:
随着一股念动力量的冲击，你移动一个敌人或他们携带的某个东西。你可以尝试对目标进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}，并使用法术攻击掷骰而非运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法手，它要么是隐形的，要么呈幽灵般的形态，它抓住目标物体，并缓慢地将其以任意方向浮空术至多20英尺。当你维持法术时，你可以将该物体额外移动20英尺。如果法术结束时该物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Invisible.name: 隐形 Invisible
Invisible.description:
你无法被看见。你对所有人都是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。生物可以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 来侦测你；如果某个生物在其察觉检定对抗你的潜行 DC 时成功，你对该生物变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}，直到你 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} 以再次变为未被侦测为止。如果你在某人已经能看见你时变为隐形，你起初对其为隐藏（而非未被侦测），直到你成功潜行。你在隐形状态下不能变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed}，除非通过特殊能力或魔法。

You can't be seen. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to everyone. Creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} to detect you; if a creature succeeds at its Perception check against your Stealth DC, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to that creature until you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} to become undetected again. If you become invisible while someone can already see you, you start out hidden to them (instead of undetected) until you successfully Sneak. You can't become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.1wQY3JYyhMYeeV2G]{Observed} while invisible except via special abilities or magic.

Telekinetic Object.name: 念动力物体 Telekinetic Object
Telekinetic Object.description:
伤害类型取决于被投掷的物体

Damage type depends on object thrown

Site Bound.name: 束缚之地 Site Bound
Site Bound.description:
骚灵与某个地点相连，无法旅行到距离其被创造或形成之处超过120英尺的地方。有些骚灵则被束缚在特定的房间、建筑或类似的区域

A poltergeist is tied to a location and can't travel more than 120 feet from the place where it was created or formed. Some poltergeists are instead bound to a specific room, building, or similar area

Natural Invisibility.name: 天生隐形术 Natural Invisibility
Natural Invisibility.description:
骚灵天生处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}状态。它只有在使用“惊吓”时才会变为可见。

A poltergeist is naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It becomes visible only when it uses Frighten.

Rejuvenation.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
Rejuvenation.description:
当一个骚灵被摧毁时，它会在[[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4天}后于其被摧毁之处重新成形，并完全痊愈。只有当有人查明其存在的原因，并纠正任何阻止该灵魂休息之事时，骚灵才能被永久摧毁。

When a poltergeist is destroyed, it reforms, fully healed, where it was destroyed after [[/br 2d4 #Rejuvenation]]{2d4 days}. A poltergeist can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

Telekinetic Defense.name: 念力防御 Telekinetic Defense
Telekinetic Defense.description:
触发 一名生物接近到距离骚灵10英尺内

效果 骚灵对触发的生物进行一次念动力物体打击。

Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the poltergeist

Effect The poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the triggering creature.

Frighten.name: 恐惧 Frighten
Frighten.description:
需求 骚灵必须处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

效果 骚灵变得可见，显现为一个骷髅般、幽灵般的人形生物。30尺内的每个生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免，失败则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。大失败时，它还会在恐惧持续期间处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。成功时，该生物在1分钟内暂时免疫。

在其下一回合开始时，骚灵再次变为隐形。

Requirements The poltergeist must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Effect The poltergeist becomes visible, appearing as a skeletal, ghostlike humanoid. Each creature within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a failure. On a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

At the start of its next turn, the poltergeist becomes invisible again.

Telekinetic Storm.name: 念动力风暴 Telekinetic Storm
Telekinetic Storm.description:
骚灵以念动力投掷大量小型物体，例如数十件银质餐具或书本，可以将它们分散攻击多个敌人，或将它们集中指向一个目标。

  • 当此效果分散攻击多个敌人时，骚灵对 @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} 内的每个生物以-2减值进行一次念动力物体打击。这些攻击对骚灵的多重攻击减值而言计为一次攻击，并且在所有攻击完成之前，该减值不会增加。
  • 当此效果只有一个目标时，骚灵对该目标进行一次念动力物体打击，并且伤害提高至3d12。失败时造成 @Damage[1d12[untyped]] 伤害，大成功或大失败中的大失败时不造成伤害。

The poltergeist telekinetically throws numerous small objects, such as dozens of pieces of silverware or books, either spreading them out among multiple foes or directing them at one target.

  • When this effect is spread out among multiple foes, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike at a -2 penalty against each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet}. These count as one attack for the poltergeist's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
  • When this effect has only one target, the poltergeist makes a telekinetic object Strike against the target, and the damage increases to 3d12. It deals @Damage[1d12[untyped]] damage on a failure, and no damage on a critical failure.

Poltergeist.publicNotes:
当一名生物死亡，并且由于某种原因其灵魂无法或不愿离开其死亡地点时，该灵魂可能会显现为骚灵：一种躁动不安的、隐形的灵体，仍然能够操纵物理物体。许多骚灵的死亡方式源于或导致了极端的情感创伤。

When a creature dies, and for whatever reason its spirit is unable or unwilling to leave the site of its death, that spirit may manifest as a poltergeist: a restless, invisible spirit that is still able to manipulate physical objects. Many poltergeists perished in a way that resulted from or led to extreme emotional trauma.

Vaulgrist.name: 瓦格丽斯特 Vaulgrist

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Painsight.name: 痛觉洞察 Painsight
Painsight.description:
链魔会自动知晓它所见的生物是否具有任何@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded}状态，以及这些状态的数值

A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions, as well as the value of those conditions

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or.name: 再生 10（被神圣或银制品停用） Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Unnerving Gaze.name: 骇人凝视 Unnerving Gaze
Unnerving Gaze.description:
30尺。当一名生物在灵光中结束其回合时，它会看到一张已故挚爱之人的面孔取代传道者的面孔。该生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免中成功，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}（大失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}）。

30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it sees the face of a departed loved one in place of the evangelist's face. The creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure).

Animate Chains.name: 活化锁链 Animate Chains
Animate Chains.description:
布道者附近的铁链长出倒刺并带着威胁性地扭动。除了在布道者铁链打击触及范围内的生物之外，布道者还可以对任何与20尺内一条无人看管的铁链相邻的生物进行铁链打击。

Chains in the evangelist's vicinity sprout barbs and writhe menacingly. The evangelist can make chain Strikes against any creature that is adjacent to an unattended chain within 20 feet, in addition to those within the reach of the evangelist's chain Strike.

Focus Gaze.name: 专注凝视 Focus Gaze
Focus Gaze.description:
福音传道者凝视其在30英尺内可见的一名生物。目标必须立刻尝试进行一次对抗“慑人凝视”的@Check[will|dc:21]意志豁免。此外，若该生物已处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}状态，则在豁免失败时，只要该生物仍然处于恐惧状态，福音传道者便会对该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

在尝试此豁免后，该生物随后会暂时免疫，直到福音传道者下个回合开始。

The evangelist stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save against Unnerving gaze. In addition, if the creature was already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, on a failed save, the evangelist is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from the creature for as long as the creature remains frightened.

After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the evangelist's next turn.

Impaling Chain.name: 穿刺铁链 Impaling Chain
Impaling Chain.description:
当福音使者以铁链进行打击并造成重击时，目标会被刺穿并固定在原地，被铁链施加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}。该生物无法从持续流血伤害中恢复，直到其挣脱（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 25）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.gjo8LR6uOhDM5W7L]{Effect: Impaling Chain}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

When the evangelist critically hits with a chain Strike, the target is impaled and anchored in place, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} by the chain. The creature is unable to recover from persistent bleed damage until it gets free (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.gjo8LR6uOhDM5W7L]{Effect: Impaling Chain} DC 25).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Vaulgrist.publicNotes:
福音使，链魔的非官方大使，游历位面最遥远的疆域，传播其族类那种“以痛苦求完美”的可憎信条。因此，他们是在材料位面最常被遭遇到的链魔，率领享乐主义的凡人血肉雕塑师集会，或担任骇人地城的卫士。在由炼狱势力统治的地区，福音使可能作为副官或顾问效力，以凡人的灵魂或上等凡人血肉为交换，低声指点通往力量的秘密途径。福音使的体型与人类相同，不过由于沉重的铁链总是披挂在其身形之上，他们常常重达350磅或更多。

通过自残寻求终极感官刺激，是那些栖居于幽影的邪魔——链魔——令人毛骨悚然的执念。他们唯有在对受害者施加痛苦与恐惧、试验新的酷刑形式，或将那折磨人的手段反施于自身时，才会超越其冷漠的超然。链魔自视为开悟的存在，超越道德或凡俗禁忌等限制，但他们的受害者只知道他们是毫无情感的施虐者，施加残忍的痛苦折磨。这些邪魔声称在思想、形态与行为上追求完美，然而他们不承认任何不需要以痛楚切除血肉或灵魂的“精炼”。

链魔源自最极端的受虐或施虐凡人的灵魂；这些灵魂在受审后被送往幽影位面。他们会呈现出契合其卑劣嗜好的形态，从低阶的占兆者，到被称为“隐修者”的痛苦与肢解大师，跨度极大。转化过程一步步扭曲灵魂，其他链魔会引领新成员穿越幽影位面黑暗深处那难以计数的痛苦密室。

Evangelists, the velstracs' unofficial ambassadors, roam the farthest reaches of the planes to spread the word of their kind's abhorrent belief in perfection through pain. They are therefore the most frequently encountered velstracs on the Material Plane, leading covens of hedonistic mortal flesh-sculptors or serving as wardens of horrific dungeons. In regions ruled by infernal powers, evangelists may serve as lieutenants or advisors, whispering secret paths to power in exchange for mortal's souls or choice mortal flesh. Evangelists are the same size as humans, although with the heavy chains that always drape their forms, they often weigh 350 pounds or more.

The search for ultimate sensation through self-mutilation is the horrifying preoccupation of the shadow-dwelling fiends known as velstracs. They transcend their stoic detachment only when inflicting pain and terror upon their victims, practicing new forms of torture, or when turning their agonizing practices back on themselves. Velstracs consider themselves enlightened beings, transcending such limitations as morality or mortal taboos, but their victims know them as emotionless tormentors who inflict sadistic suffering. These fiends claim to seek perfection in thought, form, and action, although they don't recognize any refinement that doesn't require the painful excision of the flesh or spirit.

Velstracs manifest from the souls of the most extreme masochistic or sadistic mortals who are judged and sent on to the Shadow Plane. They take on forms that suit their vile predilections, ranging from the low-ranking augurs to the maestros of suffering and mutilation called eremites. The process of transformation warps the soul step by step, with other velstracs conveying their new members through untold chambers of pain among the dark reaches of the Shadow Plane.
Vaulgrist.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Voidglutton.name: 虚空暴食者 Voidglutton

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异术天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一团黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮穿透或在该区域内发散。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在该区域内都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你的黑暗术的环阶或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使是具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Glow.name: 发光 Glow
Glow.description:
30英尺。虚空暴食者的指尖及其七只眼睛发光，在区域内投射明亮光照，并使其在若处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态时变得可见。

30 feet. The tips of a voidglutton's fingers and its seven eyes glow, casting bright light in the area and making it visible if it was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}.

Consume Light.name: 吞噬光亮 Consume Light
Consume Light.description:
触发 虚空暴食者施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}

效果 虚空暴食者在施放法术时熄灭其发光。只要它仍处于黑暗术的区域内，它就会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。如果虚空暴食者使用敌对动作，其隐形术会在该敌对动作完成后立刻结束。

Trigger The voidglutton casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}

Effect The voidglutton extinguishes its Glow as part of Casting the Spell. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} as long as it remains in the area of darkness. If the voidglutton uses a hostile action, its invisibility ends as soon as the hostile action is completed.

Ectoplasmic Web Trap.name: 灵质网捕 Ectoplasmic Web Trap
Ectoplasmic Web Trap.description:
被虚空暴食者的灵质网捕击中的生物会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}，并黏附在最近的表面上，直到其成功通过DC 26检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}。灵质网捕也能定身虚体生物。

A creature hit by the voidglutton's ectoplasmic web trap is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it succeeds at a DC 26 check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}. Ectoplasmic Web Trap can immobilize incorporeal creatures.

Fearful Strike.name: 骇人打击 Fearful Strike
Fearful Strike.description:
当虚空暴食者用其爪击打击对生物造成伤害时，该生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:26] 意志豁免中成功，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}（大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}）。

When the voidglutton damages a creature with its claw Strike, the creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Feed on Fear.name: 吞食恐惧 Feed on Fear
Feed on Fear.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 一名敌人受到恐惧术效果影响，或具有恐惧或濒死（状态）状态，且位于虚空暴食者25尺内

效果 虚空暴食者以该生物的恐惧为食。它恢复 @Damage[3d4[healing]] 生命值，且若其发光曾被熄灭，则会重新点燃。

它无法再次使用吞噬光亮，持续 [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Consume Light]]{1d4轮}，因为它被恐惧撑得太饱，无法压制其发光。

Frequency once per round

Requirement An enemy is affected by a fear effect or has the frightened or dying condition, and is within 25 feet of the voidglutton

Effect The voidglutton feeds on the creature's terror. It regains @Damage[3d4[healing]] Hit Points and its Glow reignites if it had been extinguished.

It cannot use Consume Light again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Consume Light]]{1d4 rounds}, as it is too glutted on fear to suppress its Glow.

Magic Immunity.name: 魔法免疫 Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description:
虚空暴食者免疫除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}以及带有光亮（特征）的法术以外的所有法术。

A voidglutton is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, and spells with the light trait.

Voidglutton.publicNotes:
虚空暴食者是一种强大的鬼火，会在苦难盘踞之处出没——例如墓地、战俘营或近期的战场。虚空暴食者呈现为一团翻涌的发光眼球之球体，环绕着一个直径4英尺的空洞黑色漩涡。在这漩涡之中伸出长长的半透明触须，末端是长着七根手指、布满针刺的手。

A voidglutton is a powerful type of will-o'-wisp that haunts a site where misery dwells-such as a graveyard, prison camp, or recent battlefield. A voidglutton appears as a seething sphere of glowing eyes swirling around an empty black vortex 4 feet wide. From within this vortex extend long, semi-transparent tendrils that end in seven-fingered, needled hands.

Volluk Azrinae.name: 沃鲁克·阿兹里尼 Volluk Azrinae
Volluk Azrinae.tokenName: 沃鲁克·阿兹里尼 Volluk Azrinae

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 奥术自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立即将自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、位于射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会把另一名生物一并带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你过去去过那里，并且知道它相对你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语的话语令生物难以抗拒。你向目标施加一个行动方案的暗示术；该暗示术必须以一种对目标而言看似合乎逻辑的方式措辞，且不能是自我毁灭的或明显违背目标自身利益的。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是正常地在和它说话，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得自我毁灭，或出现其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Bind Undead.name: 束缚死灵 Bind Undead
Bind Undead.description:
你用一句充满力量的言语夺取对目标的控制。它获得仆从（特征）特征。如果你或一名盟友对目标使用任何敌对动作，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

With a word of power, you seize control of the target. It gains the minion trait. If you or an ally uses any hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.rVkUzqS4rpZp9LS3]{Spell Effect: Bind Undead}

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的心智。它必须进行一次意志豁免。随后目标在1小时内暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功或大失败 成功 当你施放法术时，目标从你那里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断了目标的运动神经冲动，使其无法从头脑中传出，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标陷入麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，将剩余持续时间减少1轮；若大成功或大失败：成功，则完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Animate Object.name: 活化物体 Animate Object
Animate Object.description:
你将目标变形为一个活化物体，其等级最高不超过表7-1所允许者，并且类型与该物体相对应（因此一把扫帚会变成一把活化扫帚）。

表7-1：生物创造仪式

生物等级 所需法术阶位 花费
-1或0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

大成功或大失败 目标变为适当类型的活化物体。若其等级至少比你低4级，你可以使其成为仆从。这会赋予其仆从（特征），意味着当你对其施以命令术时它可以使用2个动作，而对其施以命令术是一个带有听觉与专注（特征）的单动作。你最多可以控制四个仆从。若它没有成为仆从，你可以给予它一个简单命令。它会一心一意地追求该目标，无视你之后的任何命令。

成功 同大成功或大失败，但未成为你仆从的活化物体会留在原地，并攻击任何攻击它或试图偷走或移动它的人，而不是遵从你的命令。

失败 你未能创造该活化物体。

大成功或大失败 你创造了该活化物体，但它会陷入狂暴并试图摧毁你。

You transform the target into an animated object with a level up to that allowed by Table 7-1 and of a type corresponding to the object (so a broom would become an animated broom).

Table 7-1: Creatures Creation Rituals

Creature Level Spell Rank Required Cost
-1 or 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

Critical Success The target becomes an animated object of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an animated object that doesn't become your minion stays in place and attacks anyone that attacks it or tries to steal or move it, rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the animated object.

Critical Failure You create the animated object, but it goes berserk and attempts to destroy you.

Comprehend Language.name: 通晓语言 Comprehend Language
Comprehend Language.description:
当你施放法术时，目标可以理解其正在听到或阅读的一种语言的含义。这不会让其理解暗号、以隐喻方式表达的语言等类似内容（由GM酌情决定）。如果目标能听到多种语言并且知道这一点，它可以选择要理解的语言；否则，随机选择一种语言。

升阶（3环） 目标也可以说该语言。

升阶（4环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标，且目标也可以说该语言。

The target can understand the meaning of a single language it is hearing or reading when you cast the spell. This doesn't let it understand codes, language couched in metaphor, and the like (subject to GM discretion). If the target can hear multiple languages and knows that, it can choose which language to understand; otherwise, choose one of the languages randomly.

Heightened (3rd) The target can also speak the language.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures, and targets can also speak the language.

Create Undead.name: 唤起死灵 Create Undead
Create Undead.description:
你将目标转化为一个不死生物，其等级最高不超过表7-1所允许的等级。此仪式有许多版本，每个版本都对应一种特定类型的不死生物（例如一个版本适用于所有丧尸（特征），一个适用于骷髅（特征），一个适用于食尸鬼（特征），等等），而能创造稀有不死生物的仪式同样也很稀有。某些形态的不死生物，如巫妖，会以其自身独特的方法形成，无法用任何版本的唤起死灵来创造。

表7-1：生物创造仪式

生物等级 所需法术阶位 成本
-1或0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

大成功 目标成为相应类型的不死生物。若其等级至少比你低4级，你可以使其成为仆从。这会使其获得仆从（特征），意味着当你对其施放命令术时，它可以使用2个动作；而对其施放命令术是一个具有听觉与专注（特征）的单动作。你最多可以同时控制四个仆从。若其具有智能且未成为仆从，该不死生物会因你将其唤醒而对你有所帮助，尽管它仍是可憎而邪恶的生物。若其不具智能且未成为仆从，你可以给予它一个简单的命令。它会一心一意追求该目标，无视你之后的任何命令。

成功 同大成功，但未成为你仆从的有智能不死生物仅对你友善；未成为你仆从的无智能不死生物会放过你，除非你攻击它。它会在本地区域横行，而不是遵从你的命令。

失败 你未能创造不死生物。

大失败 你创造了不死生物，但它的灵魂被你污秽的死灵法术折磨，对你只剩下仇恨。它会试图摧毁你。

You transform the target into an undead creature with a level up to that allowed in Table 7-1. There are many versions of this ritual, each specific to a particular type of undead (one ritual for all zombies, one for skeletons, one for ghouls, and so on), and the rituals that create rare undead are also rare. Some forms of undead, such as liches, form using their own unique methods and can't be created with a version of create undead.

Table 7-1: Creatures Creation Rituals

Creature Level Spell Rank Required Cost
-1 or 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
3 3 180 gp
4 4 300 gp
5 4 480 gp
6 5 750 gp
7 5 1,080 gp
8 6 1,500 gp
9 6 2,100 gp
10 7 3,000 gp
11 7 4,200 gp
12 8 6,000 gp
13 8 9,000 gp
14 9 13,500 gp
15 9 19,500 gp
16 10 30,000 gp
17 10 45,000 gp

Critical Success The target becomes an undead creature of the appropriate type. If it's at least 4 levels lower than you, you can make it a minion. This gives it the minion trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you command it, and commanding it is a single action that has the auditory and concentrate traits. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control. If it's intelligent and doesn't become a minion, the undead is helpful to you for awakening it, though it's still a horrid and evil creature. If it's unintelligent and doesn't become a minion, you can give it one simple command. It pursues that goal single-mindedly, ignoring any of your subsequent commands.

Success As critical success, except an intelligent undead that doesn't become your minion is only friendly to you, and an unintelligent undead that doesn't become your minion leaves you alone unless you attack it. It marauds the local area rather than following your command.

Failure You fail to create the undead.

Critical Failure You create the undead, but its soul, tortured by your foul necromancy, is full of nothing but hatred for you. It attempts to destroy you.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术法术等级相同或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你所选择颜色的、绚丽且无热的火焰勾勒。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。如果这些生物是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的，则在受妖火术影响期间，它们为隐蔽，而不是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象在你的空间中盘旋，可能导致那些攻击你的人击中其中一个幻象而非你。任何本会命中你的攻击都有一定的随机几率改为命中你的一个幻象而非你。若三个幻象都还在，有 1/4 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d4]] 掷出 1）。若还剩两个幻象，有 1/3 的几率命中你（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–2）。若只剩一个幻象，几率为 1/2（[[/r 1d6]] 掷出 1–3）。

一旦一个幻象被命中，它就会被摧毁。若一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的 AC 但没有大失败，它会摧毁一个幻象但没有额外效果（即使该攻击通常在失败时也会产生效果）。若一次攻击掷骰为大成功且本会命中其中一个幻象，则摧毁一个幻象，并且该次攻击掷骰改为对你成功。所有幻象都被摧毁后，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

[[/r 1d4]]

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d6]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

[[/r 1d4]]

Vomit Swarm.name: 喷吐虫群 Vomit Swarm
Vomit Swarm.description:
你打出一阵充满魔力的害虫群。你从自身的想象中唤起并塑形这些生物，使你能够改变这些生物的外观（通常是蜈蚣、蟑螂、黄蜂与蠕虫的混合），但这不会改变该法术的效果。害虫在区域内爬满任何人，它们的啃咬与蜇刺造成 @Damage[2d8[piercing]] 伤害（基础反射豁免）。豁免失败的生物还会变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。一旦该法术结束，虫群便会消失。

强化（+1） 将伤害提高 @Damage[1d8[piercing]]。

You belch forth a swarm of magical vermin. You evoke and shape the creatures from your own imagination, allowing you to change the appearance of the creatures (typically a mix of centipedes, roaches, wasps, and worms), but this doesn't change the effect of the spell. The vermin swarm over anyone in the area, their bites and stings dealing @Damage[2d8[piercing]] damage (basic Reflex save). A creature that fails its saving throw also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Once the spell ends, the swarm disappears.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by @Damage[1d8[piercing]].

Worm's Repast.name: 蠕虫盛宴 Worm's Repast
Worm's Repast.description:
啃噬蠕虫在目标生物的血肉中实体化，造成4d6穿刺伤害与@Damage[floor(@item.level/2)d6[persistent,piercing]]伤害。若目标为非骷髅的有形不死生物，你额外造成@Damage[floor((@item.level/2)+1)d6[persistent,piercing]]伤害。目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 蠕虫无害地扭动着离去，目标不受任何伤害。

成功 目标受到全部初始伤害但不受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标受到全部初始伤害与持续伤害，并因疼痛在承受持续伤害期间处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}状态。

大失败 同失败，但目标受到双倍初始伤害，并因疼痛在承受持续伤害期间还会处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}状态。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害与持续伤害分别增加2d6与1d6

Gnawing worms materialize within the flesh of the target creature, dealing 4d6 piercing damage and @Damage[floor(@item.level/2)d6[persistent,piercing]] damage. If the target is a non-skeletal corporeal undead creature, you deal an extra @Damage[floor((@item.level/2)+1)d6[persistent,piercing]] damage. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The worms writhe away harmlessly and the target takes no damage.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} due to the pain for as long as it takes persistent damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double the initial damage and is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} by the pain for as long as it takes persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial and persistent damage increase by 2d6 and 1d6, respectively

Alarm.name: 魔法警报 Alarm
Alarm.description:
你为一片区域设下结界，当生物在未经你许可的情况下进入时警示你。当你施放魔法警报时，选择一个口令。每当一只小型或更大、具有实体的生物在未说出该口令的情况下进入该法术的区域，魔法警报会发送你所选择的心灵警示（此时该法术获得心灵（特征））或带有手铃音色与音量的可听见警报（此时该法术获得听觉（特征））。任一选项都会自动唤醒你，而铃声会让区域内的每个生物都可以尝试一次DC 15的察觉检定以醒来。知晓魔法警报存在的生物在移动进入该区域时，必须进行一次对抗该法术DC的隐匿检定并成功，否则会触发该法术。

升阶（3环） 你可以指定哪些生物会触发魔法警报法术——例如，兽人或戴面具的人。

You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a DC 15 Perception check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify criteria for which creatures sound the alarm spell-for instance, orcs or masked people.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造最多四个漂浮的光亮术，彼此之间任意两个相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮术移动最多60英尺。每个光亮术必须保持在你120英尺内并且与所有其他光亮术保持在10英尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你迷乱目标的心智，并用一次精神冲击使其陷入眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的卷须从你的指尖卷起并在空气中疾驰。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。线内的每个活体生物都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物承受一半的虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败该生物承受全部伤害。

大成功或大失败：失败该生物承受双倍虚空伤害以及双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1）虚空伤害增加2d4点，且持续流血伤害增加1点。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一道幻象，使你看起来像另一种体型相同、且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）都与自己大致相近的生物。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，比如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而你移除的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为欺骗的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 用途建立伪装；它会无视你因将自己伪装成不相似的生物而可能承受的任何环境减值，它会给予你+4状态加值至欺骗检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装，并且即使你未受训也会将你的等级加入其中。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环）该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环）你可以看起来像任意同体型的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过某个个体才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Light.name: 光亮术 Light
Light.description:
该物体发光，像火把一样在20英尺半径内投射明亮光照（并在接下来的20英尺内投射昏暗光照）。如果你再次将此法术施放在第二个物体上，则第一个物体上的光亮术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

强化（4环）该物体在60英尺半径内投射明亮光照（并在接下来的60英尺内投射昏暗光照）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

The object glows, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) like a torch. If you cast this spell again on a second object, the light spell on the first object ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The object sheds bright light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单独的魔法之手，可以是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动至多20英尺。因为你在使物体悬浮，你可以让它朝任何方向移动。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20英尺。如果该法术结束时物体仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Mindlink.name: 讯息传递 Mindlink
Mindlink.description:
你将自己的心智与目标的心智连接，并在瞬间向该目标心灵传递本可在10分钟内沟通的信息量。

You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻痛折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害和1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害与持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。如果目标从恶心中恢复，持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大成功或大失败失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{随等级成长的持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心扉以感知魔法灵光。施放完成后，你知道该物品是否为魔法物品；若是，你还会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，你只有在该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时才会侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环）你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环）你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在直到你下个回合开始前获得AC+1环境加值，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

在该法术生效期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术具有硬度5。你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

强化该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

强化（3环） 护盾术具有硬度10。

强化（5环） 护盾术具有硬度15。

强化（7环） 护盾术具有硬度20。

强化（9环） 护盾术具有硬度25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Unseen Servant.name: 隐形仆役 Unseen Servant
Unseen Servant.description:
你召唤一个隐形仆役，你可以在维持法术时将其作为其中一部分来施以命令术。它为你服务，直到其生命值降至 0（此时法术结束），或直到你停止维持法术。该隐形仆役获得被召唤（特征）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.j7NNPfZwD19BwSEZ]{Unseen Servant}（无阵营）

You summon an unseen servant, which you can command as part of Sustaining the Spell. It serves you until its Hit Points are reduced to 0, at which point the spell ends, or until you stop Sustaining the Spell. The unseen servant gains the summoned trait.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.j7NNPfZwD19BwSEZ]{Unseen Servant} (No Alignment)

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Discorporate.name: 解体 Discorporate
Discorporate.description:
行动缓慢的水蛭会让英雄们有2轮而非1轮的时间，在这些逃窜的害虫逃脱前将其解决。

当蠕虫行者降至0 HP时，它会解体，组成其身体的构成蠕虫会向四面八方散开。若哪怕只有一条蠕虫逃脱，蠕虫行者最终也会重新聚合成形；这一过程通常需要[[/gmr 1d10 #Re-Form]]{1d10天}。

尽管具体情况与周遭环境会决定蠕虫行者的敌人在这些逃窜蠕虫逃脱前有多久时间将其解决，但通常其敌人只有一轮时间。

通常，这需要在1轮内，于蠕虫行者倒下的空间施加一个区域效果或溅射武器。在对该空间造成任意数量的区域或溅射伤害后，造成伤害的角色必须尝试一次@Check[flat|dc:15]纯骰检定。此后对该区域施加的每一次区域或溅射伤害效果，都会使该纯骰检定的DC降低2，最低降至DC 5。若这些纯骰检定中的任意一次成功，则没有蠕虫能逃脱，蠕虫行者将被永久摧毁。

由GM酌情决定，若以巧妙手段困住或以其他方式扣留这些害虫，可以延长允许终结蠕虫行者的时间。

Slow-moving leeches give the heroes 2 rounds, rather than 1 round, to dispatch the fleeing vermin before they escape.

When the worm that walks is reduced to 0 HP, it discorporates and the component worms that make up its body disperse in every direction. If even a single worm escapes, the worm that walks will eventually re-form using a process that typically takes [[/gmr 1d10 #Re-Form]]{1d10 days}.

While the exact circumstances and surroundings determine how long the worm that walks's foes have to dispatch the fleeing worms before they escape, usually its foes have only a single round.

Typically, this requires the application of an area effect or splash weapon within 1 round to the space where the worm that walks collapsed. After any amount of area or splash damage is dealt to that space, the character dealing the damage must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15] check. Each subsequent area or splash damage effect performed on the area reduces the DC of this flat check by 2, to a minimum of DC 5. If any of these flat checks succeed, none of the worms escape, and the worm that walks is destroyed permanently.

At the GM's discretion, clever means of trapping or otherwise detaining the vermin may extend the time allowed to finish off the worm that walks.

Hateful Memories.name: 可憎的回忆 Hateful Memories
Hateful Memories.description:
如果沃鲁克在其回合开始时能看到一幅准确描绘其作为活着的卓尔时旧日外貌的图像，他必须进行一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 意志豁免，否则将被自我憎恶填满，并在 1 轮内变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

If Volluk can see an accurate depiction of his former appearance as a living drow at the start of his turn, he must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save or become filled with self-loathing and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Squirming Embrace.name: 蠕虫之拥 Squirming Embrace
Squirming Embrace.description:
Volluk 大步移动，结束其移动时与一个生物共享同一空间，并对该生物造成 @Damage[3d8[piercing]] 伤害。该生物可以尝试进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] 豁免。

Volluk Strides, ending his movement sharing a space with a creature, and deals @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage to the creature. The creature can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:23|basic] save.

Swarm Shape.name: 虫群形态 Swarm Shape
Swarm Shape.description:
沃鲁克坍塌成一群无定形的水蛭群。他会掉落所有手持、穿戴与携带的物品。在解体状态下，他不能使用攻击动作，也不能施放法术，但他可以穿过足以容纳其单只水蛭通过的小型区域，而无需 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}。他可以用同一个动作重新凝聚回正常形态。

Volluk collapses into a shapeless swarm of leeches. He drops all held, worn, and carried items. While discorporated, he can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but he can move through areas small enough for his individual leeches to fit without having to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}. He can use the same action to coalesce back into his normal form.

Volluk Azrinae.blurb:
男性蠕虫行者邪教徒
Male worm that walks occultist
Volluk Azrinae.prototypeToken: 沃鲁克·阿兹里尼 Volluk Azrinae

Will-o'-Wisp.name: 鬼火 Will-o'-Wisp

Glow.name: 发光 Glow
Glow.description:
20尺。

鬼火本身天生为隐形，但会以彩色的光亮术发光，在光环内投射明亮光照并使其可见。

20 feet.

A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally invisible, but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.

Magic Immunity.name: 魔法免疫 Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description:
鬼火免疫所有法术，唯独不免疫 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}。

A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}.

Feed on Fear.name: 吞食恐惧 Feed on Fear
Feed on Fear.description:
频率 每轮一次

需求 15尺内的一名敌人处于恐惧术效果影响下或濒死

效果 鬼火以生物的恐惧为食。它恢复 @Damage[2d4[healing]]{2d4 生命值}，且若它已陷入熄光，其发光将重新点燃。

Frequency once per round

Requirements An enemy within 15 feet is under a fear effect or dying

Effect The will-o'-wisp feeds on the creature's terror. It regains @Damage[2d4[healing]]{2d4 Hit Points}, and if it has Gone Dark, its glow reignites.

Go Dark.name: 变暗 Go Dark
Go Dark.description:
鬼火熄灭其发光，成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。它可以再次使用该动作来结束此效果。若它在隐形状态下使用其电击攻击，电弧会让任何观察者得以判断其位置，使鬼火对所有观察者仅为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}，直到它移动为止。

The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to all observers until it moves.

Will-o'-Wisp.publicNotes:
充满恶意的彩色光球，鬼火出没于荒凉的沼泽与森林，在那里它们把毫无防备的旅人引入险境。鬼火能够改变自身散发的颜色与照度，并乐于模仿摇曳的提灯或远处的火光，把迷路或迷惘的旅人从安全的道路上引开。它们还能将自身的照明彻底熄灭，从而变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}，而且它们尤其喜欢在受害者彻底迷失、并意识到远处那团摇曳的光其实并不会带他们走向安全之后这么做。不过，即便在隐形状态下，鬼火也很少离开其目标太远，因为它以受害者所感受到的惊慌与恐惧为食。

在其发光之下，鬼火的身体是一团海绵质的球体，直径约1尺，重量不足5磅。尽管大多数鬼火不过是半透明、毫无特征的球形体，只在其制造的变幻照明中才显出轮廓，但也有少数带有深色斑驳，近看时宛如一颗头骨。鬼火不需要任何世俗的营养；事实上，它们缺乏摄取任何物质的能力——它们所需的一切养分都来自附近生物的恐惧。因此，它们喜欢与能够令受害者产生恐惧的亡灵并肩行动。鬼火寿命悠长，甚至几近不朽，而且记忆力极佳。一个被震慑或被击败的鬼火可以成为不错的传说与情报来源，尽管要从这样一个阴险的怪物那里获得合作绝非易事的专长。

鬼火栖息在荒芜的沼泽与森林中，通常在暮色时分与入夜后活动。因此，它们不太愿意把受害者引向立刻致命的区域，比如落穴陷阱，而更偏好那些能让受害者长时间受苦的危害，例如陈腐或有毒空气的气穴、流沙地带，以及更大型怪物的巢穴。按鬼火的说法，不同类型的恐惧在“风味”上有着细微差别：当人们逐渐意识到自己迷失时，那种潜伏在胃底、不断啃噬的阴郁惧意，会产生一种与直面高耸怪物、迫在眉睫的死亡所带来的骤然而赤裸的惊惧截然不同的滋味。正因如此，鬼火会尽量变换引发猎物恐惧的方式，以确保自己不会对某些恐惧的风味感到厌倦。

Malevolent balls of colored light, will-o'-wisps haunt lonely marshes and forests, where they lure unsuspecting travelers into danger. Will-o'-wisps can vary the color and illumination they shed, and delight in mimicking bobbing lanterns or distant fires to draw lost or disoriented travelers off of safe trails. They can extinguish their illumination entirely to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, and they enjoy doing so once their victims are wholly lost and have realized that the bobbing light in the distance isn't, in fact, leading them to safety. Even invisible, however, a will-o'-wisp rarely ventures far from its target, as it feasts upon the panic and dread felt by its victims.

Beneath its glow, a will-o'-wisp's body is a spongy ball approximately 1 foot in diameter and weighing less than 5 pounds. Although most will-o'-wisps are merely translucent, featureless orbs, gaining definition only in the shifting illumination they create, a few have dark mottling that makes them resemble a skull when viewed closely. Will-o'-wisps have no need for mundane nourishment, and in fact, lack the ability to consume matter of any kind; they find all the sustenance they need in the terror of nearby creatures. For this reason, they like to work alongside undead that produce terror in their victims. Will-o'-wisps are long-lived, if not effectively immortal, and they have good memories. A cowed or defeated will-o'-wisp can be a good source of lore and information, though acquiring such cooperation from such a sinister monster is no easy feat.

Will-o'-wisps inhabit desolate swamps and forests and are generally active at twilight and after dark. They are therefore reluctant to lead victims into immediately fatal areas such as deadfalls, but instead prefer hazards where their victims suffer over a long time, such as pockets of stale or poisonous air, patches of quicksand, and dens of bigger monsters. According to will-o'-wisps, different types of fear have subtle differences in flavor. The lurking dread in the pit of the stomach that gnaws at those who slowly become aware of the fact that they're lost produces a much different taste than the sudden, stark terror of imminent death in the face of a towering monster. Because of this, will-o'-wisps try to vary the ways in which they induce terror in their prey, to ensure they don't tire of certain flavors of fear.

Viper Arrow.name: 蝰蛇箭 Viper Arrow
Viper Arrow.description:
启动 A 命令术

这支箭的箭杆覆着细密的绿色鳞片，铁质箭头分叉成两点，几乎像一对毒牙。

一支已启动的蝰蛇箭命中一个目标后，箭矢会变形为一条@Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.lFlXmieuHTBIonhj]{Viper}。目标受到蝰蛇的毒素影响，如同被其咬伤一般。随后，蝰蛇落在紧邻目标的一个开阔空间内。

蝰蛇具有被召唤（特征），并在你回合结束时行动，即使你没有使用维持一个法术动作。它由GM控制，但通常会攻击被箭矢击中的生物。蝰蛇会在1分钟后或被杀死时消失。

制作需求 提供一次@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}的施放

Activate A Command

The shaft of this arrow is covered in fine green scales, and its iron head comes to a pair of points almost like fangs.

After an activated viper arrow hits a target, the arrow transforms into a @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.lFlXmieuHTBIonhj]{Viper}. The target is affected by the viper's poison, as if it had been bitten. The viper then lands in an open space adjacent to the target.

The viper has the summoned trait and acts at the end of your turn, even though you didn't use the Sustain a Spell action. It is under the GM's control, but it generally attacks the creature the arrow struck. The viper vanishes after 1 minute or when slain.

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}

Bracelet of Dashing.name: 冲刺手镯 Bracelet of Dashing
Bracelet of Dashing.description:
这只叮当作响的银色手镯让你脚步更轻，给予你特技检定+1物品加值。

启动 A 命令术

频率 每日一次

效果 你获得+10英尺速度状态加值，持续1分钟。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.lLP56tbG689TNKW5]{Effect: Bracelet of Dashing}

自动应用的效果：

  • 特技检定+1物品加值。

This jangling, silvery bracelet makes you lighter on your feet, giving you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate A command

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed for 1 minute.

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.lLP56tbG689TNKW5]{Effect: Bracelet of Dashing}

Automatically applied effects:

  • +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Lounge Desk.tokenName: 休息室服务台 Lounge Desk

Scroll of Comprehend Language (Level 2).name: 通晓语言卷轴（等级 2） Scroll of Comprehend Language (Level 2)
Scroll of Comprehend Language (Level 2).description:
从卷轴施法需要用一只手持握卷轴，并以施法（行动）来启动它，使用该法术正常所需的动作数。

要从卷轴施法，该法术必须出现在你的法术列表上。由于是你在施法，使用你的法术攻击掷骰与法术DC。该法术也会获得与你的根源相应的特征（奥术、神术、异能或原初）。

卷轴在被制作时已提供任何实体的材料成分与花费，因此你在从卷轴施法时不需要再提供它们。你必须将该法术所需的任何材料成分替换为姿势成分。若该法术需要法器，你必须持有该法器才能从卷轴施法。

注：要创建某个特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品Actor的物品栏中。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY]

Casting a Spell from a scroll requires holding the scroll in one hand and activating it with a Cast a Spell activity using the normal number of actions for that spell.
