Steel Shield.description:
如同木制盾牌，钢盾也有各种形状和体型。虽然比木制盾牌更昂贵，但它们要耐用得多。

硬度HPBT
52010

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

HardnessHPBT
52010

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加上小型金属板，在保留皮护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Glashdrumdur.publicNotes:
影幽侏儒武者会迅速冲入战斗，但在有选择时，比起更具侵略性的战术，他们更专注于保卫他们的亲族与家园。

侏儒以富有创造力与好奇心而闻名。他们身高约3英尺，鲜明的个性与其天生鲜艳的发色与瞳色相得益彰。侏儒与其祖先的家园——第一世界——有着天生的联系。他们渴求冒险与新体验，以对抗一种被称为“褪色”的、影响整个族裔的苦难。无法继续做梦与创新的侏儒会开始缓慢失去色彩，并陷入深度抑郁。

侏儒中有一个著名的分支被称为影幽侏儒，他们通常拥有灰色或棕色、带有石质纹理的皮肤，以及稀薄的浅色头发或光秃的头顶。影幽侏儒在幽暗地域数量最多，在那里他们被称为drathnelar。影幽侏儒往往将这些生理变化归因于一位被视为其族类之初的侏儒神祇——尼维·罗姆博达兹尔。尼维原本是一名地表侏儒，她深入幽暗地域旅行，并在与矮人神祇托拉格交换某颗特定宝石后，最终得到了半神之位作为奖赏。尼维对褪色免疫，而影幽侏儒往往也对其免疫或具有抗性。

Umbral gnome warriors are quick to charge into battle but focus on defending their kin and their homes over more aggressive tactics when a choice is available.

Gnomes are known for being creative and curious. They stand at around 3 feet tall, and their vivid personalities match their naturally vivid hair and eye color. Gnomes possess a natural connection to their ancestral home, the First World. They crave adventure and new experiences to fight off an ancestry-wide affliction known as the Bleaching. Gnomes who fail to dream and innovate begin to slowly lose their color and fall into a deep depression.

A notable subgroup of gnomes called umbral gnomes typically have gray or brown skin with a stony texture, and thin, pale hair or bald pates. Umbral gnomes are most numerous in the Darklands, where they go by the name drathnelar. Umbral gnomes often attribute these physical changes to the gnome deity regarded as the first of their kind, Nivi Rhombodazzle. Nivi was a surface gnome who traveled deep into the Darklands and was ultimately rewarded with demigodhood when she exchanged a particular gemstone with the dwarven deity, Torag. Nivi is immune to the Bleaching, and umbral gnomes are often immune or resistant to it as well.
Glashdrumdur.prototypeToken: 格拉什德拉姆杜尔 Glashdrumdur

Gulzash.name: 古尔扎什 Gulzash

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
这种护甲由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合制成，在提供一定防护的同时具备最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Stench.name: 恶臭 Stench
Stench.description:
30尺。进入该区域的生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:20]豁免。失败时，该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（状态）；大失败时，该生物还会在1轮内其速度承受-5尺状态减值。在该灵光范围内时，该生物为从恶心（状态）中恢复的豁免承受-2环境减值。豁免成功的生物会在1分钟内对所有地蜥人（特征）的恶臭暂时免疫。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uB3CVn3momZO9h0L]{Effect: Xulgath Stench}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}

30 feet. A creature that enters the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uB3CVn3momZO9h0L]{Effect: Xulgath Stench}, and on a critical failure, the creature also takes a -5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all xulgaths' stenches for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}

Stench Suppression.name: 抑制恶臭 Stench Suppression
Stench Suppression.description:
古尔扎什可以以自由动作（）压制或恢复他的恶臭。

Gulzash can suppress or resume his stench as a free action.

Mosh.name: 劲舞 Mosh
Mosh.description:
古尔扎什跳跃至一个与一名生物相邻的方格，然后 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoves}该生物。若古尔扎什在推撞上掷骰获得成功，则他改为获得大成功或大失败中的大成功。

Gulzash Leaps to a square adjacent to a creature, then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoves} that creature. If Gulzash rolls a success on the Shove, he gets a critical success instead.

Gulzash.blurb:
男性地蜥人（特征）鲁特琴手
Male xulgath lutenist

Hydra.name: 九头蛇 Hydra

Effect: Hydra Heads.name: 效果：九头蛇头颅 Effect: Hydra Heads
Effect: Hydra Heads.description:
九头蛇当前拥有的头颅数量。

The number of heads the hydra currently has.

Hydra Regeneration.name: 九头蛇再生 Hydra Regeneration
Hydra Regeneration.description:
九头蛇拥有等于其头颅数量 3 倍的再生。如果九头蛇的身体缺少任何头颅，且剩余的断颈未被灼烧处理，则在其因再生而恢复生命值后，九头蛇会进行一次 @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:25] 豁免。在成功时，一个未被灼烧处理的断颈会再长出两个头颅；在大成功时，两个未被灼烧处理的断颈各自再长出两个头颅。九头蛇长出的头颅数量永远不会超过其通常头颅数量的两倍。九头蛇的再生只有在其所有头颅都被斩断且所有断颈都被灼烧处理时才会完全停用，此时它会死亡。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]

The hydra has regeneration equal to 3 x the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:25] save after it regains Hit Points from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneration]

Head Regrowth.name: 头部再生 Head Regrowth
Head Regrowth.description:
九头蛇通常有五个头。一名生物可以尝试切断九头蛇的一个头，方法是特意将其作为目标并造成等于该头生命值的伤害。未被完全切断的头会在任意生物的回合结束时恢复至满生命值。

九头蛇可以使用九头蛇再生重新长出被切断的头。一名生物可以通过对断颈造成酸或火焰伤害来阻止这种再生，使其被烧灼。单一目标的酸或火焰效果必须以某个特定的断颈为目标，但造成溅射伤害或影响覆盖九头蛇整个空间的区域的效果，只要造成酸或火焰伤害，就会烧灼所有断颈。若切断头颅的攻击造成了任何酸或火焰伤害，则断颈会立即被烧灼。若五个头都被烧灼，九头蛇死亡。

九头蛇头颅

  • 生命值 15
  • 免疫 区域伤害
  • 弱点 挥砍 5

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Effect: Hydra Heads}

A hydra ordinarily has five heads. A creature can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing damage equal to the head's Hit Points. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Hit Points at the end of any creature's turn.

A hydra can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A creature can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or fire damage to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal splash damage or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or fire damage. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or fire damage, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

Hydra Head

  • Hit Points 15
  • Immunities Area Damage
  • Weaknesses Slashing 5

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Effect: Hydra Heads}

Reactive Heads.name: 反应性头颅 Reactive Heads
Reactive Heads.description:
九头蛇每超过第一个头颅多出一个头颅，便在每轮获得一个额外的反应动作（），但只能用于进行反应打击。即使某个生物在其触及范围内离开多个方格，九头蛇也不能对同一次触发动作使用超过1个反应动作（），且九头蛇每次进行反应打击时都必须使用不同的头颅。每当九头蛇的一个头颅被斩断时，九头蛇每轮失去1个额外的反应动作（）。

A hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Strike it makes. Whenever one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

Reactive Strike (See Reactive Heads).name: 反应打击（见反应头颅） Reactive Strike (See Reactive Heads)

Focused Assault.name: 专注突击 Focused Assault
Focused Assault.description:
九头蛇用它的多个头对单一目标发动攻击，以多次攻击压制其敌人，几乎不给对方任何闪避空间。九头蛇用其獠牙进行打击。在一次成功的攻击中，九头蛇对目标造成其獠牙打击的伤害，此外其拥有的每一个超过第一个的头都会额外造成 [[/r 1d6]] 伤害。在一次失败（但不是大成功或大失败）时，九头蛇对目标生物造成一次獠牙打击的伤害。此次打击在计算九头蛇的多重攻击减值时，算作等同于九头蛇头数的攻击次数。

The hydra attacks a single target with its heads, overwhelming its foe with multiple attacks and leaving almost nowhere to dodge. The hydra Strikes with its fangs. On a successful attack, the hydra deals damage from its fangs Strike to the target, plus an additional [[/r 1d6]] damage for every head it has beyond the first. On a failure (but not a critical failure), the hydra deals the damage from one fangs Strike to the target creature. This Strike counts as a number of attacks equal to the number of heads the hydra has toward the hydra's multiple attack penalty.

Storm of Jaws.name: 啃咬风暴 Storm of Jaws
Storm of Jaws.description:
九头蛇进行最多等同于其头颅数量的若干次打击，每次分别针对不同的目标。这些攻击计入九头蛇的多重攻击减值，但多重攻击减值直到九头蛇完成所有攻击后才会增加。

The hydra makes a number of Strikes up to its number of heads, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the hydra's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the hydra makes all its attacks.

Hydra.publicNotes:
多头蛇是多头、脾气暴躁的蛇形野兽，食欲贪婪，因其再生能力而广受畏惧。

Hydras are multiheaded, foul-tempered serpentine beasts with voracious appetites, widely feared for their regeneration abilities.

Jafaki.name: 贾法基 Jafaki

Occult Innate Spells.name: 秘传先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇怪的冲动使你的目标困惑，导致其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次地胡言乱语，并且陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1分钟。其可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束困惑术。

大成功或大失败 目标陷入Confused，持续1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

强化（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一个对目标而言最可怕的生物的幻影形象。只有该法术的目标能看见这个杀手，不过当它疾驰向前发动攻击时，你也能看见这幻象的模糊轮廓。杀手的效果取决于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6精神伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6精神伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标恐惧到可能会死。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；若目标失败，则它死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到12d6精神伤害，在其下个回合结束前获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 在失败时伤害增加2d6，在大失败时伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Hypercognition.name: 极化认知 Hypercognition
Hypercognition.description:
你迅速编目并整理与你当前处境相关的信息。作为施放该法术的一部分，你可以立刻使用最多 6 个回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，当你回忆知识时触发的任何特殊能力、反应动作（）或自由动作（）都不能使用。

You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，使目标浮到离地 5 尺处。你可以维持法术，使目标上升或下降 10 尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受 –2 环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内抵消此减值。若目标邻接于一个固定的物体或具有足够稳定性的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿该表面移动。GM 决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. You can Sustain the spell to move the target up or down 10 feet. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
你用一次粗浅的精神接触，尝试进行读心术以读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后目标在1小时内暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功或大失败：成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你那里感知到模糊的表层思想。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思想，并且你得知其智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思想。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，用一次精神震击使其眩晕。该震击造成1d6精神伤害，进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲以感知魔法的存在。除了是否存在魔法之外，你不会获得任何其他信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。你只有在该幻术魔法的效果位阶低于你的侦测魔法法术位阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你得知该法术侦测到的最强大魔法效果的位阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）同3环，但你还会锁定最高位阶魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若来源大于该范围，则为其最近的一个5尺立方体）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法手，它要么是隐形的，要么是幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并以缓慢的速度将其向任意方向浮空术般移动最多20英尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以额外移动该物体20英尺。如果该法术结束时该物体在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为2或更低的物体为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个在射程内且未被持用的松散物体（负载为1或更少）掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你投掷的物体。被投掷物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Infused Acid Flask (Moderate).name: 灌注酸液瓶（中等） Infused Acid Flask (Moderate)
Infused Acid Flask (Moderate).description:
启动 A 打击

这只装满腐蚀性强酸的烧瓶造成1点强酸伤害、2d6点持续强酸伤害，以及2点酸液飞溅伤害。你获得+1物品加值至攻击掷骰。

Activate A Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 2d6 persistent acid damage, and 2 acid splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

Infused Bottled Lightning (Moderate).name: 灌注瓶装闪电（中等） Infused Bottled Lightning (Moderate)
Infused Bottled Lightning (Moderate).description:
启动 A 打击

瓶装闪电装有不稳定的试剂，当它们暴露在空气中时会产生一阵电爆。瓶装闪电造成 2d6 电击伤害以及 2 点电击飞溅伤害。命中时，目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}，直到你下个回合开始。你获得 +1 物品加值于攻击掷骰。

Activate A Strike

Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they are exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals 2d6 electricity damage and 2 electricity splash damage. On a hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

Alchemist's Lab (Expanded).name: 炼金术实验室（扩展） Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)
Alchemist's Lab (Expanded).description:
你需要一间炼金术士的实验室，才能在休整模式中制作炼金物品。

一间扩展型炼金术士的实验室给予你在进行工艺检定以制造炼金物品时+1物品加值。

You need an alchemist's lab to Craft alchemical items during downtime.

An expanded alchemist's lab gives a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to create alchemical items.

Jafaki's Round Key.name: 贾法基的轮钥匙 Jafaki's Round Key
Jafaki's Round Key.description:
这把不同寻常的钥匙有一个圆形的钥匙柄，末端有几枚长短不一的钥齿。

This unusual key has a round shaft tipped with several teeth of varying length.

Jafaki's Four-pronged Key.name: 贾法基的四叉钥匙 Jafaki's Four-pronged Key
Jafaki's Four-pronged Key.description:
这把精致的钥匙采用四叉式设计。

This elaborate key has a four-pronged design.

Wand of Peaceful Rest (Rank 2).name: 安宁休息魔杖（2环） Wand of Peaceful Rest (Rank 2)
Wand of Peaceful Rest (Rank 2).description:
这根短杖约一英尺长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，另加过载

效果 你以标示的环阶施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次以所列环阶施放该法术。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏中。

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Wand of Force Barrage (Rank 1).name: 力场弹幕魔杖（1环） Wand of Force Barrage (Rank 1)
Wand of Force Barrage (Rank 1).description:
这根短杖约一英尺长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，另加过载

效果 你以标示的环阶施放该法术。

制造需求 提供以所列环阶施放该法术。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料集或资料集浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏。

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Infused Wyvern Poison.name: 灌注双足飞龙毒素 Infused Wyvern Poison
Infused Wyvern Poison.description:
经过妥善采集与保存，双足飞龙尾刺的毒素效果直接而有效。

启动 2 交互（伤害）

豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[5d6[poison]] 伤害（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] 伤害（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] 伤害（1 轮）

Properly harvested and preserved, the poison from a wyvern's sting is effective and direct.

Activate 2 Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage (1 round)

Infused Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate).name: 灌注认知诱变剂（中等） Infused Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate)
Infused Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

你的心智变得澄明，认知自由流动，但肉体之事似乎变得虚幻缥缈。

增益 你在奥术、制作、学识、通灵、社交检定，以及所有用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}的检定上获得+2物品加值。你在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}检定上的大成功或大失败中的大失败改为失败。

缺陷 你在武器与徒手攻击掷骰、运动检定与特技检定上承受-2减值。在陷入负载过重前，你可携带的负载比正常少2；你可携带的最大负载减少4。

持续时间 10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ztxW3lBPRcesF7wK]{Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate)}

Activate A Interact

Your mind becomes clear and cognition flows freely, but physical matters seem ephemeral.

Benefit You gain a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}. Your critical failures on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} checks become failures instead.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, Athletics checks, and acrobatics checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered, and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

Duration 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.ztxW3lBPRcesF7wK]{Effect: Cognitive Mutagen (Moderate)}

Infused Elixir of Life (Lesser).name: 注入生命灵药（次级） Infused Elixir of Life (Lesser)
Infused Elixir of Life (Lesser).description:
启动 A 交互

生命灵药会加速活体生物的自然治疗过程与免疫系统。饮用该灵药后，你恢复 @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] 生命值，并在10分钟内对抗疾病与毒素的豁免检定获得+1物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life}

Activate A Interact

Elixirs of life accelerate a living creatures natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.lPRuIRbu0rHBkoKY]{Effect: Elixir of Life}

Infused Mistform Elixir (Moderate).name: 灌注雾形灵药（中等） Infused Mistform Elixir (Moderate)
Infused Mistform Elixir (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

一层淡淡的薄雾从你的皮肤中散发出来，使你在 1 分钟内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。

如常，当你的所在位置仍然显而易见时处于隐蔽状态，你不能利用这种隐蔽来 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}。

Activate A Interact

A faint mist emanates from your skin, making you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for 1 minute.

As usual being concealed when your position is still obvious, you can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感知觉（不精确）30英尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Infused Items.name: 灌注物品 Infused Items
Infused Items.description:
贾法基携带这些灌注物品：2个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SgtqZxt26BdjUmEB]{Moderate Acid Flasks}，2个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.97QyNEOAyYLdGaYc]{Moderate Bottled Lightnings}，2个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qpzL9UnTi4cDhy6J]{Moderate Cognitive Mutagens}，2个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TZUskLT7yvP7N2co]{Lesser Elixirs of Life}，2个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ax8XcBd0rRd1Z7hN]{Moderate Mistform Elixirs}，以及2剂 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]{Wyvern Poison}（其中一剂他们已涂抹在他们的+1 细剑上）。这些物品持续24小时，或直到贾法基下一次进行每日准备为止。

Jafaki carries these infused items: 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SgtqZxt26BdjUmEB]{Moderate Acid Flasks}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.97QyNEOAyYLdGaYc]{Moderate Bottled Lightnings}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qpzL9UnTi4cDhy6J]{Moderate Cognitive Mutagens}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TZUskLT7yvP7N2co]{Lesser Elixirs of Life}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Ax8XcBd0rRd1Z7hN]{Moderate Mistform Elixirs}, and 2 doses of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WL4O32qFifxnMj0H]{Wyvern Poison} (one of which they have already applied to their rapier). These items last for 24 hours, or until the next time Jafaki makes their daily preparations.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Command Confusion.name: 命令困惑 Command Confusion
Command Confusion.description:
触发 一名生物在对抗贾法基的迷心灵光时豁免失败

效果 贾法基决定该@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}生物在该轮攻击谁，而不是由GM随机决定目标。

如果被选定的目标是该困惑生物的盟友，该生物可以立即尝试一次@Check[will|dc:21]意志豁免；若成功，则其目标照常随机决定；若大成功或大失败，则其目标不再处于困惑状态。

Trigger A creature fails its save against Jafaki's mindfog aura

Effect Jafaki determines who the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} creature attacks for that round, instead of the target being randomly determined by the GM.

If the chosen target is the confused creature's ally, the creature can immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save; on a success, its target is determined randomly as normal, and on a critical success the target is no longer confused.

Mindfog Aura.name: 迷心灵光 Mindfog Aura
Mindfog Aura.description:
20尺。任何在该灵光内开始其回合的生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:23] 意志 豁免中成功，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 1轮；若成功，该生物获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。

贾法基可以以带有专注（特征）的单动作压制或启动此灵光。

20 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round; on a success, that creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Jafaki can suppress or activate this aura as a single action with the concentrate trait.

Envenom Weapon.name: 武器涂毒 Envenom Weapon
Envenom Weapon.description:
贾法基将其天生的双尾虫怪毒涂抹在其所持的一把武器上。

Jafaki applies their innate seugathi venom to one weapon they wield.

Magic Item Mastery.name: 精通魔法物品 Magic Item Mastery
Magic Item Mastery.description:
贾法基即使该法术不在其法术列表上，也可以从魔法物品中施法。所有此类法术都是秘法法术，并使用贾法基的天生法术DC和攻击调整值。

Jafaki can Cast a Spell from magic items even if the spell isn't on their spell list. All such spells are occult spells and use Jafaki's innate spell DC and attack modifier.

Quick Consumption.name: 快速喝药 Quick Consumption
Quick Consumption.description:
贾法基交互以抽出一瓶药剂或突变剂，然后将其饮用。

Jafaki Interacts to draw an elixir or mutagen, then drinks it.

Seugathi Venom.name: 双尾虫怪毒 Seugathi Venom
Seugathi Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:24]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Jafaki.blurb:
双尾虫怪塑肉师
Seugathi fleshwarper
Jafaki.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Jedzeli.name: 耶泽利 Jedzeli

Camouflaged Step.name: 伪装步伐 Camouflaged Step
Camouflaged Step.description:
潜伏客在森林和地下设定中进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} 动作时获得其益处，且无需以一半速度移动。

The skulk gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} action in forests and subterranean settings without moving at half Speed.

Chameleon Skin.name: 变色皮肤 Chameleon Skin
Chameleon Skin.description:
潜伏客的皮肤会移动变化以匹配周围环境。只要其大部分身体未被衣物或护甲覆盖，潜伏客在进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}的隐秘检定时获得+2环境加值。

The skulk's skin shifts and changes to match the surroundings. As long as most of their body is not covered by clothing or armor, the skulk gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
潜伏客的打击会对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。

A skulk's Strikes deal an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Jedzeli.publicNotes:
怯懦而懒惰的潜伏客生活在有组织社会的边缘地带，偷盗他人毫不犹豫。即便是谋杀也不过是另一种必要之举；他们对潜入一户人家、杀掉住户并夺走所需之物这类行径毫不在意。

他们那种如变色龙般融入环境的能力使潜伏客难以被察觉，因此在大型聚居地周边常年存在的族群几乎不可能被永久清除。他们通常以不超过16名个体的小队形式行动，因为更大的队伍往往会演变成彼此之间的暴力冲突。尽管潜伏客自认为共享着被驱逐与被憎恨的共同历史，但这种纽带不足以让大量生物长期为了共同目的而团结在一起。

城市的出入口，尤其是下水道之类较少守卫的许可通道附近，是潜伏客最偏爱的活动地点。这些地点让他们既能近距离观察谁进出城市，也能在当局察觉其存在时获得迅速逃脱的选择。偶尔，一名纪律严明的潜伏客会在当地盗贼公会中崭露头角，并因棘手工作而受到追捧。然而，他们令人作呕的性格与压倒性的自私通常意味着他们无法获得长久的领导职位。

典型的潜伏客身高6英尺，体型结构与瘦长的人类相近。潜伏客成熟得很快，寿命可达50年，尽管大多数早在那之前就以暴死告终。少数设法逃离其充满暴力与怯懦刻薄之社会的潜伏客可以是任何阵营，但那些仍被其根源所束缚的潜伏客，始终将这些自我放逐者视为最恶劣的叛徒；放逐者也常常会成为被优先灭绝的目标，甚至不惜放过其他所有受害者。曾不止一支潜伏客帮派因鲁莽行事而亲手酿成覆灭：为了追猎这类放逐者，他们在一次计划拙劣却充满暴烈激情的行动中暴露了自身存在，使当局得以将其一网打尽。

The cowardly and lazy skulks live on the fringes of organized societies and steal from others without a second thought. Even murder is merely another necessity, and they think nothing of creeping into a house, dispatching the residents, and taking what they want.

Their chameleon-like ability to blend into their surroundings makes skulks difficult to detect, so their ever-present populations around the periphery of large settlements are nearly impossible to dislodge permanently. They typically travel in small groups of no more than 16 individuals, since groups larger than that tend to break into violence directed at one other. While skulks see themselves as sharing a common history of being cast out and hated, this is not a strong enough bond to hold large groups of the creatures together with a shared purpose for very long.

Entrances and exits from cities, especially less-guarded access ways around sewers and the like, are skulks' favorite stomping grounds. These sites allow them to closely observe who comes and goes from the city while also affording them swift escape options, should the authorities uncover their presence. On rare occasions, a well-disciplined skulk can rise to prominence within the local thieves' guild and become sought after for difficult jobs. Their repugnant personalities and overwhelming selfishness, however, usually means they are unable to secure long-lasting leadership roles.

A typical skulk is 6 feet tall with similar body structure to a gangly human. Skulks mature quickly and can live up to 50 years, although most meet a violent end long before then. The rare skulk who manages to escape their society of violence and craven bitterness can be of any alignment, but those skulks who remain bound by their traditions always see these self-imposed exiles as the worst kind of traitors, and the exiles are often targeted for eradication to the exclusion of all other victims. More than one band of skulks has accidentally engineered its own doom after throwing caution to the wind and exposing its existence to the authorities in an ill-planned but violently passionate attempt to track down such an exile.

Kragala.name: 克拉加拉 Kragala

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 秘传自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Occult Innate Spells.name: 秘法先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一个濒临死亡的生物的生命掐灭。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若此举杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内获得对攻击与伤害掷骰的+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Enlarge (Self Only).name: 变巨术（仅自身） Enlarge (Self Only)
Enlarge (Self Only).description:
在魔法力量的强化下，目标变为大型体型。其装备也随之变大，但若被移除则恢复为自然体型。该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}。其触及增加5尺（若其起始为超小型则增加10尺），并获得+2近战伤害状态加值。此法术对大型或更大体型的生物无效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sPCWrhUHqlbGhYSD]{Spell Effect: Enlarge}

升阶（4环） 该生物改为变为超大型体型。近战伤害的状态加值为+4，且该生物的触及增加10尺（若该生物起始为超小型则增加15尺）。此法术对超大型或更大体型的生物无效果。

升阶（6环） 选择该法术的2环或4环版本之一，并将其效果施加于至多10个自愿的生物。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}

Bolstered by magical power, the target grows to size Large. Its equipment grows with it but returns to natural size if removed. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sPCWrhUHqlbGhYSD]{Spell Effect: Enlarge}. Its reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if it started out Tiny), and it gains a +2 status bonus to melee damage. This spell has no effect on a Large or larger creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}

Heightened (4th) The creature instead grows to size Huge. The status bonus to melee damage is +4 and the creature's reach increases by 10 feet (or 15 feet if the creature started out Tiny). The spell has no effect on a Huge or larger creature.

Heightened (6th) Choose either the 2nd-rank or 4th-rank version of this spell and apply its effects to up to 10 willing creatures.

Invisibility (Self Only).name: 隐形术（仅自身） Invisibility (Self Only)
Invisibility (Self Only).description:
披覆于幻象之中，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} 状态。若目标使用一次敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Sound Burst.name: 音鸣爆 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
一阵刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成2d10点音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受全额伤害，并在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，在1分钟内处于耳聋，并且处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一阵心灵传动的力量迸发，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试对目标进行缴械、推撞或绊摔，使用法术攻击掷骰而非运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Bless.name: 祝福术 Bless
Bless.description:
来自彼岸的祝福帮助你的伙伴精准打击。你与盟友在此散发范围内进行攻击掷骰时获得+1状态加值。从你施放祝福术后的下一回合开始，每回合一次，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，将散发的半径增加5尺。

祝福术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}

Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bless, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标心智蒙蔽，并以一次精神冲击将其震慑。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化（+2） 伤害提高1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60英尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120英尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Guidance.name: 指引 Guidance
Guidance.description:
你祈求神圣指引，使目标在持续时间结束前进行的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免检定或技能检定获得+1状态加值。目标必须在掷骰前选择要将该加值用于哪次掷骰。若目标使用了该加值，则该法术结束。无论如何，目标随后在1小时内暂时免疫。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

You ask for divine guidance, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飞弹 Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
你发射一枚力场飞矢，疾驰向你能看见的一名生物。它自动命中并造成1d4+1点力场伤害。你在施放法术时每额外使用1个动作，发射的飞弹数量便增加1枚；以3个动作施放时最多可发射3枚飞弹。你分别为每枚飞弹选择目标。若你将多枚飞弹射向同一目标，在应用任何伤害加值或减值、抗力、弱点等之前，先将伤害合并。

升阶（+2） 你每花费1个动作，便额外发射1枚飞弹。

You send a dart of force streaking toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of missiles you shoot by one, to a maximum of three missiles for 3 actions. You choose the target for each missile individually. If you shoot more than one missile at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You shoot one additional missile with each action you spend.

Mending.name: 修复术 Mending
Mending.description:
你修复目标物品。你每法术环阶为目标恢复5点生命值，若将其修复至超过该物品的破损阈值，则可能移除@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}状态。你无法替换遗失的部件，也无法修复已被完全摧毁的物体。

增幅（2环） 你可以将目标设为负载1或更少的非魔法物体。

增幅（3环） 你可以将目标设为负载2或更少的非魔法物体，或负载1或更少的魔法物体。

You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Protection.name: 防护 Protection
Protection.description:
你守护一名生物，使其免受特定阵营影响。施放此法术时，选择混乱、邪恶、善良或守序。目标在对抗所选阵营的生物与效果时，其护甲等级与豁免检定获得+1状态加值。此加值在对抗来自此类生物、会直接控制目标的效果，以及对抗由所选阵营的召唤生物进行的攻击时，提高至+3。

此法术获得与所选阵营相对立的特征——若你选择混乱，此法术获得守序特征，反之亦然；若你选择邪恶，此法术获得善良特征，反之亦然。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

You ward a creature against a specified alignment. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful when you cast this spell. The target gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against creatures and effects of the chosen alignment. This bonus increases to +3 against effects from such creatures that would directly control the target and against attacks made by summoned creatures of the chosen alignment.

This spell gains the trait that opposes the alignment you chose-if you choose chaos, this spell gains the lawful trait, and vice versa; if you choose evil, this spell gains the good trait, and vice versa.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RawLEPwyT5CtCZ4D]{Spell Effect: Protection}

Sanctuary.name: 圣域术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你用防护能量守护一名生物，使其能够阻止敌人的攻击。生物每次试图攻击目标时都必须进行一次意志豁免。如果目标使用了敌对动作，该法术结束。

大成功或大失败 圣域术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试进行其攻击，以及在本回合中对目标进行的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标并浪费该动作。它在本回合中不能再尝试对目标进行进一步的攻击。

大成功或大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在圣域术的剩余持续时间内不能尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters enemy attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散、无人持用且在射程内、负载为1或更低的物体掷向目标。进行一次法术攻击掷骰，对抗该目标。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你所掷出的物体——其数值等于1d6加上你的施法关键能力调整值。所掷出物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响这次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Folding Drums.name: 折叠鼓 Folding Drums
Folding Drums.description:
你可以将这个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yw1kPxsdCoDUzOaE]{virtuoso percussion instrument}展开为手鼓（1 负载）、带有肩带与背部支架的行进鼓套装（3 负载），或带有内置凳子的巨大立式鼓套装（16 负载）。改变折叠鼓的体型是一个3行动的交互行动，并且这些鼓必须有足够的开阔空间来容纳其新的体型。

启动 1 交互（专注）

频率 每小时一次

效果 你在鼓上敲出强劲的节奏。如果你接下来的下一个行动是施放一个具有放射的作曲戏法，则将该放射的区域增加30尺。

You can unfold this @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.yw1kPxsdCoDUzOaE]{virtuoso percussion instrument} into a hand drum (1 Bulk), a marching drum set with a shoulder harness and back brace (3 Bulk), or a large standing drum set with a built-in stool (16 Bulk). Changing the folding drum's size is a 3-action Interact activity, and the drums must have sufficient open space to accommodate their new size.

Activate 1 Interact (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You play a pounding rhythm on the drum. If the next action you use is to cast a composition cantrip that has an emanation, increase the area of the emanation by 30 feet.

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Knock It Away.name: 把它敲飞 Knock It Away
Knock It Away.description:
触发 Kragala正握持一根鼓槌，并且被她能看见的攻击者以远程武器攻击作为目标

效果 Kragala在对抗触发的攻击时，AC获得+2环境加值。

Trigger Kragala is holding a drumstick and is targeted with a ranged weapon attack by an attacker she can see

Effect Kragala gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Guiding Rhythm.name: 引导节奏 Guiding Rhythm
Guiding Rhythm.description:
当克拉加拉在使用打击乐器时施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance}，她的目标不会对她的引导暂时免疫。

When Kragala casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} while using a percussive instrument, her targets don't become temporarily immune to her guidance.

Percussive Reverberation.name: 冲击混响 Percussive Reverberation
Percussive Reverberation.description:
Kragala使用锤子（包括鼓槌）造成额外1d6伤害（已包含在打击的伤害中）。

Kragala deals an additional 1d6 damage with hammers, including drumsticks (already included in the Strikes' damage).

Kragala.blurb:
灰矮人女鼓手
Female duergar drummer
Kragala.allSaves: +2 status to all saves vs. magic

Lallizanx.name: 拉利赞克斯 Lallizanx

Arcane Prepared Spells.name: 奥术备法法术 Arcane Prepared Spells

Arcane Innate Spells.name: 奥术天生法术 Arcane Innate Spells

Clairvoyance.name: 鹰眼术 Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程内的某个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的漂浮眼睛（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。这只眼睛无法移动，但你可以从该点向所有方向观察，如同使用你正常的视觉感官。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语的话语令生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一项行动方针的暗示术，其措辞必须让目标觉得这是一条合乎逻辑的行动路线，且不能是自我毁灭的，或明显违背目标自身利益的。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是在正常地与其交谈，而不是对其施放法术。

失败 目标立即遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得自我毁灭，或产生其他明显的负面效果。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Clairaudience.name: 锐耳术 Clairaudience
Clairaudience.description:
你在射程内的一处位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的漂浮耳朵（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。它无法移动，但你可以通过这只耳朵听见，仿佛使用你正常的听觉感官。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

Fireball.name: 火球术 Fireball
Fireball.description:
一阵咆哮的火焰爆裂出现在你指定的一个斑点，造成6d6火焰伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A roaring blast of fire appears at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，使目标浮空术离地5尺。为法术的持续时间内，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作使目标上升或下降10尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物在攻击掷骰上承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内抵消该减值。若目标邻接一个固定物体或具有足够稳定性的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Acid Arrow.name: 酸液箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤一支酸箭，命中后仍会持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8点酸性伤害，外加 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] 点伤害。大成功时，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，且持续酸性伤害增加1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造一片黑暗术帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或发散。光亮术不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发出任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外。这也会压制你黑暗术法术的环位或更低的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗术的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗术。他们将透过黑暗术看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试对目标进行一次反制检定。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是神器或类似物品，你会自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热的火焰勾勒。可见的生物在受到妖火术影响时不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。如果这些生物是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}，它们在受到妖火术影响时为 Concealed，而不是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆于幻术之中，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使目标对它们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} 状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但不会因目标使用敌对动作而结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，任意两个之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样散发光照。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60英尺。每个光源必须保持在你120英尺以内，且与所有其他光源保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，登记魔法的存在。除魔法存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 如同3环等级，但你也能锁定最高等级魔法的来源。就像模糊感官一样，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5英尺立方体内（若其大于此范围，则为最接近的区域）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造出一种简单声音的听觉幻觉，其最大音量等同于四名普通人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60英尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120英尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造出一只单独的魔法之手，可能是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动至多20英尺。由于你是在使物体悬浮，你可以将其向任意方向移动。当你维持法术时，你可以将该物体额外移动20英尺。若法术结束时物体仍在空中，物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为1或更低的物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以以一件无人持用且负载为2或更低的物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飞弹 Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
你射出一枚力场飞镖，朝向一名你能看见的生物疾驰而去。它自动命中并造成1d4+1点力场伤害。你在施放法术时每额外使用1个动作，就使你射出的飞弹数量增加1枚，最多在使用3个动作时射出3枚飞弹。你分别为每枚飞弹选择目标。若你向同一目标射出多于1枚飞弹，在应用伤害的加值或减值、抗力、弱点等等之前，先将伤害合并。

升阶（+2） 你每花费1个动作就多射出1枚额外飞弹。

You send a dart of force streaking toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of missiles you shoot by one, to a maximum of three missiles for 3 actions. You choose the target for each missile individually. If you shoot more than one missile at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You shoot one additional missile with each action you spend.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击检定。如果你成功，该生物将尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。如果你的攻击掷骰是大成功，则使用其豁免结果的低一级成功等级对应的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost

你发射一道冰冷的射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成 2d4 点寒冷伤害。

大成功或大失败 目标承受双倍伤害，并在 1 轮内其速度受到 -10 英尺的状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的羽翎保持稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Drider Venom.description:

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被蛛化精灵的蛛网术攻击命中的生物将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}并粘在最近的表面上（逃脱 DC 21）。

A creature hit by a drider's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface (Escape DC 21).

Lallizanx.publicNotes:
卓尔最先掌握的塑肉仪式流程，至今仍是他们最成功也最臭名昭著的一项：蛛化精灵。将卓尔的身体与巨型蜘蛛的身体融合，蛛化精灵是一种具明显两性异形的塑肉体——也是已知唯一能够繁衍后代的塑肉体。雌性蛛化精灵拥有优雅的卓尔女性上半身，口中长有锐利且带毒的獠牙；雄性蛛化精灵则有丑陋、突变的面容，进一步将类人生物的形态与蜘蛛的形态糅合在一起；这种外貌差异或许反映了卓尔社会的母系特质。在战斗中，所有蛛化精灵同样危险。

尽管塑肉仪式流程最初意在惩罚那些失势的卓尔，但这场骇人蜕变所带来的显著力量与强韧也吸引了部分卓尔，越来越多卓尔城市中地位较低的市民自愿接受这项痛苦的手术。作为交换，这些自愿的蛛化精灵在强制服役一段时代、担任守卫、士兵或其他公职人员之后，便会被允许过自己的生活，通常居住在靠近城市边缘的洞窟中。残酷的真相是，对大多数蛛化精灵而言，他们活不到获得这份奖赏的那一天；因为卓尔嗜好将他们塑肉仪式出的奴隶驱使至死，或将其投入致命的战争任务之中，而在那种任务里生还只是极其渺茫的可能。

大多数蛛化精灵使用奥术魔法，但使用神术魔法的蛛化精灵也广为人知；而极少数则使用秘术或原初魔法。无论魔法根源为何，蛛化精灵的天生法术都保持不变；但若其将不同类型的魔法作为预备法术使用，那么他们所预备的法术可能会与下方所示的蛛化精灵完全不同。

一些生物，尤其是卓尔，并不满足于仅仅杀死敌人。他们沉溺于以名为塑肉仪式的骇人变形技巧，令对手在彻底的堕落与羞辱中崩解。尽管塑肉仪式流程并非由卓尔创造，但许多人相信他们将其臻于完善。卓尔把敌人投入翻涌的魔法试剂大缸中加以折磨，将其血肉与心智一并重塑成可憎而怪诞之物。血肉的重构带来了无数种塑肉体的变体，而以下只是这些恐怖造物的几个例子。

The first fleshwarping process mastered by the drow remains both their most successful and most infamous: the drider. Fusing the body of a drow with that of a giant spider, driders are a sexually dimorphic fleshwarp-the only fleshwarp known to be able to produce young. While female driders have the upper torsos of elegant drow women with mouths featuring sharp poisoned fangs, male driders have hideous, mutated countenances that further blend the humanoid form with that of a spider; the difference in appearance is perhaps a reflection on the matriarchal nature of drow society. In combat, all driders are equally dangerous.

Although the fleshwarping process was originally intended to be a punishment for drow who fell from grace, the significant powers and strengths gained from the horrifying transformation are attractive to some drow, and an increasing number of lower-ranking citizens in drow cities volunteer themselves for the painful procedure. In return for mandatory time serving as a guardian, soldier, or other public servant, such volunteer driders are later allowed to lead their own lives, typically in caverns located in a city's periphery. The painful truth is that for most driders, they do not live long enough to see this reward, for the drow have a penchant for working their fleshwarped slaves to death or deploying them in deadly war missions in which survival is a only a remote possibility.

Most driders use arcane magic, but driders who use divine magic are well known, while a rare few use occult or primal magic. A drider's innate spells remain the same regardless of the magical tradition, but those who use different types of magic as prepared spells may well have entirely different spells prepared than the drider presented below.

Some creatures, notably drow, are not happy with merely killing their enemies. They revel in the total degradation of their foes through the horrifying transformative technique known as fleshwarping. Though the fleshwarping process was not created by the drow, many believe they perfected it. The drow torture their enemies in vats of churning magical reagents, reshaping their flesh and psyche alike into horrid and monstrous things. The reconstitution of flesh results in countless variations of fleshwarps, and the following are just a couple of examples of these horrors.

Living Landslide.name: 活体山崩 Living Landslide

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 震颤感知（不精确）60英尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Earthbound.name: 地缚 Earthbound
Earthbound.description:
当未接触坚实地面时，活体山崩处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态，并且不能使用反应动作。

When not touching solid ground, the living landslide is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Crumble.name: 崩解 Crumble
Crumble.description:
触发 活体山崩在岩石或土之上时受到来自敌对来源的伤害

效果 活体山崩崩解并沉入地面，掘地向下10英尺。此次掘地不会触发反应动作（）。

活体山崩在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Crumble]]{1d4轮}内无法再次崩解。

Trigger The living landslide takes damage from a hostile source while atop rock or earth

Effect The living landslide crumbles into the ground, Burrowing down 10 feet. This Burrowing does not trigger reactions.

The living landslide can't Crumble again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Crumble]]{1d4 rounds}.

Earth Glide.name: 土遁 Earth Glide
Earth Glide.description:
活体山崩可以在任何土质物质中掘行，包括岩石。当它这么做时，活体山崩以其完整的掘行速度移动，不会留下任何隧道或其经过的痕迹。

The living landslide can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the living landslide moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

Sliding Earth.name: 滑动的土 Sliding Earth
Sliding Earth.description:
活体山崩沿直线至多以其正常速度的两倍进行 Stride，然后尝试对其触及范围内的一名生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}。如果一名生物因该 Trip 而倒地为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，则每当活体山崩移动 10 英尺，该生物便受到 @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

The living landslide Strides up to twice its normal Speed in a straight line, then attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} a creature in its reach. If a creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} from this Trip, it takes @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] damage for every 10 feet the living landslide moved.

Living Landslide.publicNotes:
活体山崩看起来像由土和砂砾构成的人形。它们发现穿行于凡人宇宙的诸多地表，奇妙地令人感到解脱。

土元素是爱冒险的洞穴探险者的绝佳保镖，也是金库与宝库等重要地下地点的理想守护者。

Living landslides resemble humanoids made of earth and gravel. They find moving across the many surfaces of the mortal Universe strangely liberating.

Earth elementals make excellent bodyguards for adventuresome spelunkers and are ideal protectors of important subterranean locations such as vaults and treasuries.

Murschen.name: 穆尔申 Murschen

+1 Striking Handwraps of Mighty Blows.name: +1 强袭强力打击裹手 +1 Striking Handwraps of Mighty Blows
+1 Striking Handwraps of Mighty Blows.description:
当你灌注这些绣花布条时，你必须冥想并缓慢地将它们缠绕在你的双手上。这些手裹上刻有武器符文，以使你的徒手攻击获得这些符文的益处，让你的徒手攻击如同魔法武器一般运作。例如，+1 强击强力重击手裹会使你使用徒手攻击进行攻击掷骰时获得+1 物品加值，并将你的徒手攻击的伤害从一个武器骰增加到两个（通常为2d4而非1d4，但如果你的拳头使用不同的武器伤害骰，或你拥有其他徒手攻击，则改为使用该体型的骰子两个）。

你可以如同对武器那样升级、添加并在手裹之间转移符文，也可以将护符附挂在手裹上。为这些目的，将手裹视为擒抱组、具有光亮术负载的近战武器。属性符文仅在其对你正在使用的徒手攻击适用时才生效。例如，必须施加于挥砍武器上的属性，在你用拳头攻击时不会运作，但若你以爪击或其他挥砍的徒手攻击进行攻击，你将获得其益处。

As you invest these embroidered strips of cloth, you must meditate and slowly wrap them around your hands. These handwraps have weapon runes etched into them to give your unarmed attacks the benefits of those runes, making your unarmed attacks work like magic weapons. For example, +1 striking handwraps of mighty blows would give you a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with your unarmed attacks and increase the damage of your unarmed attacks from one weapon die to two (normally 2d4 instead of 1d4, but if your fists have a different weapon damage die or you have other unarmed attacks, use two of that die size instead).

You can upgrade, add, and transfer runes to and from the handwraps just as you would for a weapon, and you can attach talismans to the handwraps. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons of the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes. Property runes apply only when they would be applicable to the unarmed attack you're using. For example, a property that must be applied to a slashing weapon wouldn't function when you attacked with a fist, but you would gain its benefits if you attacked with a claw or some other slashing unarmed attack.

Camouflaged Step.name: 伪装步伐 Camouflaged Step

Murschen gains the benefit of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks} action in forests and subterranean settings without moving at half Speed.

Murschen's skin shifts and changes to match the surroundings. As long as most of his body isn't covered by clothing or armor, he gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}.

Flurry of Blows.name: 疾风连击 Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description:
频率 每回合一次

效果 穆尔申进行两次徒手打击。若两次都命中同一生物，为了抗力与弱点的计算目的，将它们的伤害合并。穆尔申的多重攻击减值照常适用于这些打击。

Frequency once per turn

Red Ruin Stance.name: 红毁姿态 Red Ruin Stance
Red Ruin Stance.description:
需求 穆尔申未穿戴护甲

效果 穆尔申摆出红色废墟架势，其设计旨在像凶猛野兽般撕扯下大块血肉。穆尔申可以进行红爪徒手攻击。这些攻击造成 @Damage[1d10[slashing]] 伤害；属于斗殴组；并具有灵巧、横扫和徒手特征。

处于此架势时，当穆尔申将其 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} 的状态值降低 1 时，他改为将其降低至 0。

Requirement Murschen is unarmored

While in this stance, when Murschen would reduce his @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition value by 1, he reduces it to 0.

Sneak Attack.description:
穆尔申的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。

Murschen's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Murschen.publicNotes:
懦弱又懒惰的潜伏客生活在有组织社会的边缘，毫不犹豫地从他人那里偷窃。即便是谋杀也不过是另一种必要之举；他们丝毫不觉得潜入一所房子、解决住户并拿走自己想要的东西有什么不妥。

他们那种如变色龙般融入周遭环境的能力使潜伏客难以被发现，因此在大型聚居地外围几乎随处可见的族群，几乎不可能被永久驱逐。他们通常以不超过16个个体的小团体行动，因为更大的团体往往会分裂成彼此相向的暴力冲突。尽管潜伏客认为自己共享着被放逐与被憎恨的共同历史，但这种联系不足以让大量生物以共同目标长期聚在一起。

城市的出入口，尤其是围绕下水道之类、守卫较少的许可通道，是潜伏客最喜欢出没的地盘。这些地点既能让他们近距离观察谁进谁出，也能在当局发现他们的存在时，为他们提供迅速的逃脱选择。极少数情况下，一名纪律严明的潜伏客能在当地盗贼公会中崭露头角，并因棘手的工作而备受追捧。然而，他们令人作呕的性格与压倒性的自私，通常意味着他们无法获得持久的领导地位。

典型的潜伏客身高6英尺，体型结构与瘦长的人类相似。潜伏客成熟很快，最多可活到50岁，尽管大多数早在那之前就以暴力方式丧命。极少数成功逃离其暴力与怯懦苦毒社会的潜伏客可以属于任何阵营，但那些仍受其根源所束缚的潜伏客，总是将这些自我放逐者视为最恶劣的叛徒；为了将其根绝，放逐者常常会被当作唯一目标，甚至不惜放过所有其他受害者。不止一支潜伏客团伙曾在一次计划拙劣却充满暴烈激情的追捕行动中，因鲁莽行事而将自身存在暴露给当局，从而意外地促成了自己的毁灭。

The cowardly and lazy skulks live on the fringes of organized societies and steal from others without a second thought. Even murder is merely another necessity, and they think nothing of creeping into a house, dispatching the residents, and taking what they want.

Their chameleon-like ability to blend into their surroundings makes skulks difficult to detect, so their ever-present populations around the periphery of large settlements are nearly impossible to dislodge permanently. They typically travel in small groups of no more than 16 individuals, since groups larger than that tend to break into violence directed at one other. While skulks see themselves as sharing a common history of being cast out and hated, this is not a strong enough bond to hold large groups of the creatures together with a shared purpose for very long.

Entrances and exits from cities, especially less-guarded access ways around sewers and the like, are skulks' favorite stomping grounds. These sites allow them to closely observe who comes and goes from the city while also affording them swift escape options, should the authorities uncover their presence. On rare occasions, a well-disciplined skulk can rise to prominence within the local thieves' guild and become sought after for difficult jobs. Their repugnant personalities and overwhelming selfishness, however, usually means they are unable to secure longlasting leadership roles.

A typical skulk is 6 feet tall with similar body structure to a gangly human. Skulks mature quickly and can live up to 50 years, although most meet a violent end long before then. The rare skulk who manages to escape their society of violence and craven bitterness can be of any alignment, but those skulks who remain bound by their traditions always see these self-imposed exiles as the worst kind of traitors, and the exiles are often targeted for eradication to the exclusion of all other victims. More than one band of skulks has accidentally engineered its own doom after throwing caution to the wind and exposing its existence to the authorities in an ill-planned but violently passionate attempt to track down such an exile.
