Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗的帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或向外散发。光亮术无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内都不会散发任何光，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。这也会压制你黑暗术的阶位或更低阶位的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看到外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Sound Burst (At Will).name: 音鸣爆（随意） Sound Burst (At Will)
Sound Burst (At Will).description:
一阵刺耳的噪音爆发而出，造成2d10音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}。

大成功或大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，在1分钟内耳聋，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲以侦测魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

强化（3环）你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若多个效果同等强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

强化（4环）同3环，但你还会定位最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官相同，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若来源大于该范围，则缩小到最近的等效区域）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他精细复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Leather Armor.name: 皮革护甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
由柔韧与定型的煮沸皮革混合制成，此类护甲在提供一定防护的同时具备最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Musical Instrument (Virtuoso handheld) (.name: 乐器（大师手持）（长颈鲁特琴） Musical Instrument (Virtuoso handheld) (theorbo)
Musical Instrument (Virtuoso handheld) (.description:
手持乐器包括风笛、小型钟琴、小鼓、提琴与维奥尔琴、长笛与竖笛、小型竖琴、鲁特琴、小号，以及尺寸相近的乐器。GM可能会裁定某些特别大的手持乐器（例如大号）具有更高的负载。大型鼓、一整套钟琴以及键盘乐器等笨重乐器便携性较差，通常需要在演奏时保持固定不动。

名匠乐器制作更为精良，并在使用该乐器进行表演检定时给予+1物品加值。

Handheld instruments include bagpipes, a small set of chimes, small drums, fiddles and viols, flutes and recorders, small harps, lutes, trumpets, and similarly sized instruments. The GM might rule that an especially large handheld instrument (like a tuba) has greater Bulk. Heavy instruments such as large drums, a full set of chimes, and keyboard instruments are less portable and generally need to be stationary while played.

A virtuoso instrument is more finely made and gives a +1 item bonus to Performance checks using that instrument.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Death Flame.name: 死之白焰 Death Flame
Death Flame.description:
当诺克斯死亡时，其尸体会在一阵白热火焰中爆燃，对@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物造成@Damage[5d6[fire]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] 豁免）。诺克斯的道具和宝藏不受火焰影响，并会留在其死亡处的一堆物品中。

When Nox dies, their body combusts in a flash of white-hot flame that deals @Damage[5d6[fire]] damage to creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). Nox's gear and treasure are unaffected by the flames and are left in a pile where they died.

Intense Performer.name: 热情演奏者 Intense Performer
Intense Performer.description:
当诺克斯手持乐器时，他们可以使用表演来[[/act feint statistic=performance]]{虚招}或[[/act demoralize statistic=performance]]{挫败士气}。

When Nox has a musical instrument in hand, they can use Performance to [[/act feint statistic=performance]]{Feint} or [[/act demoralize statistic=performance]]{Demoralize}.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
诺克斯对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物造成额外1d6点精准伤害。

Nox deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Nox.blurb:
非二元卡琳吉鲁特琴师
Nonbinary caligni lutenist
Nox.senses: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Ochre Jelly.name: 赭色凝胶怪 Ochre Jelly

Motion Sense 60 feet.name: 动态感知 60 尺 Motion Sense 60 feet
Motion Sense 60 feet.description:
赭色软泥怪可以通过振动和气流感知附近的移动。

A ochre jelly can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

Split.name: 分裂 Split
Split.description:
每当一只赭色果冻怪被会造成挥砍、穿刺或电击伤害的攻击或效果命中，且该赭色果冻怪至少拥有10 HP时，该果冻怪会分裂成两只完全相同的果冻怪，每只拥有原本HP的一半。

其中一只果冻怪位于原本所在的同一空间中，另一只则出现在相邻的未被占据的空间中。若没有任何相邻空间处于未被占据的状态，它会自动将生物与物体推开以填入一个空间（GM决定某个物体或生物是否过大或过稳固而无法被推动）。

Whenever an ochre jelly is hit by an attack or effect that would deal slashing, piercing, or electricity damage and the ochre jelly has at least 10 HP, the jelly splits into two identical jellies with half the original's HP.

One jelly is in the same space as the original, and the other appears in an adjacent unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, it automatically pushes creatures and objects out of the way to fill a space (the GM decides if an object or creature is too big or sturdy to push).

Constrict.name: 紧勒 Constrict
Constrict.description:
@Damage[(1d8+3)[bludgeoning],2d4[acid]]{1d8+3 钝击伤害加上2d4 强酸伤害}, @Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] 豁免

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

@Damage[(1d8+3)[bludgeoning],2d4[acid]]{1d8+3 bludgeoning damage plus 2d4 acid damage}, @Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

Ochre Acid.name: 赭黄酸液 Ochre Acid
Ochre Acid.description:
赭色果冻怪的酸液只会对血肉造成伤害——不会对骨骼、石头、木材或其他材料造成伤害。

An ochre jelly's acid damages only flesh-not bone, stone, wood, or other materials.

Ochre Jelly.publicNotes:
赭冻怪是由原生质构成的活动团块，呈现出令人作呕的黄、橙与褐色混合色调。它们的酸性躯体会溶解血肉，但会让其他材料（包括受害者的道具与骨骼）保持完好。一些古老文化会将尸体与赭冻怪一同封入石棺之中，让泥怪分解血肉，并清洁与抛光骨骼。

史莱姆、霉菌以及其他泥怪可见于阴湿的地城与幽暗的森林之中。它们未必邪恶，但有些会长到极其巨大的体型，并拥有永不满足的食欲。

Ochre jellies are animate masses of protoplasm with a sickly combination of yellow, orange, and brown hues. Their acidic bodies dissolve flesh but leave other materials, including a victim's gear and bones, intact. Some ancient cultures would entomb bodies in stone sarcophaguses with ochre jellies to allow the ooze to break down the flesh and clean and polish the bones.

Slimes, molds, and other oozes can be found in dank dungeons and shadowed forests. While not necessarily evil, some grow to enormous sizes and have insatiable appetites.

Ryta.name: 丽塔 Ryta

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 奥秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Deafness.name: 耳聋 Deafness
Deafness.description:
目标失去听觉；它必须尝试一次强韧豁免。随后该目标在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 状态，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 Deafened 状态，持续10分钟。

大失败 目标永久获得 Deafened 状态。

The target loses hearing; it must attempt a Fortitude save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Failure The target is Deafened for 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The target is Deafened permanently.

Shatter.name: 粉碎 Shatter
Shatter.description:
一次高频率的音波攻击击碎附近的一个物体。你对该物体造成2d10音波伤害，若该物体的硬度为4或更低，则无视该物体的硬度。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10，且该法术所无视的硬度增加2。

A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语甜如蜜糖，你的面容仿佛笼罩在梦幻的薄雾中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；若你或你的盟友最近威胁过它或对它使用过敌对动作，则该豁免获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。若你对目标使用敌对动作，则该法术结束。当法术结束时，目标未必会意识到自己曾被魅惑术影响，除非它对你的友谊或你说服它采取的动作与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你可能可以通过世俗手段说服目标继续做你的朋友。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图对其施展魅惑术。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非魅惑术，除非它辨识出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly}。若它原本为友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}。它无法对你使用敌对动作。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，并且它无法对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延长至你下次进行每日准备为止。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延长至你下次进行每日准备为止，且你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大喊出一道难以忽视的命令术。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同其具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 状态）、放开其正持握之物、卧倒 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或原地站定。在其服从你的命令之前，它不能延迟或进行任何反应动作（）。这些效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下一回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来照你命令行事。

大失败 目标必须在其下一回合使用其全部动作来服从你的命令术。

升阶（5环） 你可以以至多10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，它们彼此之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火炬一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60英尺。每个光源必须保持在你120英尺范围内，并且与所有其他光源保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的思维变得混沌，用一道精神冲击使其目眩。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个由简单声音构成的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时大喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可辨识的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

强化（3环） 射程增加至60英尺。

强化（5环） 射程增加至120英尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你召唤出一面魔法力场护盾。这视为使用“举起护盾”动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，持续至你下一回合开始，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

在该法术的效果持续期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾的硬度为5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环）护盾的硬度为10。

升阶（5环）护盾的硬度为15。

升阶（7环）护盾的硬度为20。

升阶（9环）护盾的硬度为25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Soothe.name: 安抚 Soothe
Soothe.description:
你安抚目标的心智，强化其心灵防御并治疗其伤势。当你施放法术时，目标恢复 1d10+4 点生命值，并在持续时间内对抗心灵效果的豁免获得 +2 状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

升阶（+1） 治疗量增加 1d10+4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散的、无人看管的物体掷向目标；该物体必须在射程内，且负载为1或更低。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你掷出的物体——数值等于1d6加上你的施法关键属性调整值。被掷出的物品不具备任何会影响该攻击或伤害的特定特征或魔法属性。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Ventriloquism.name: 腹语术 Ventriloquism
Ventriloquism.description:
每当你说话或以发声方式制造任何其他声音时，你可以让自己的发声看似来自60英尺内的其他位置，并且在你发声时可以自由改变该表观位置。任何听到该声音的生物都可以尝试不相信你的幻觉。

升阶（2环） 该法术的持续时间增加至1小时，并且你也可以改变你声音的音调、音色与其他性相。在生物能够尝试不相信你的幻觉之前，它必须主动尝试一次察觉检定或以其他方式使用动作与该声音互动。

Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮革护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加上小块金属板，在保留皮革护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Dance Moves.name: 舞步 Dance Moves
Dance Moves.description:
触发 莱塔被她能看见的攻击者以一次近战或远程攻击作为目标。

效果 莱塔快步并在对抗触发该攻击的AC上获得+2环境加值。

Trigger Ryta is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker she can see.

Effect Ryta Steps and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Cheek Pouches.name: 颊囊 Cheek Pouches
Cheek Pouches.description:
莱塔拥有可伸缩的颊囊，可存放至多 1 立方英尺的物体（但不超过四个轻型物品）。她可以使用【交互】动作取出或存入一件物品。只要她的颊囊中至少有一件物体，她的言语就会明显难以理解。

Ryta has stretchy cheek pouches that can store up to 1 cubic foot of objects (though no more than four light items). She can remove or store an item using the Interact action. As long as she has at least one object in her cheek pouches, her speech is noticeably difficult to understand.

Swarming.name: 群聚 Swarming
Swarming.description:
瑞塔可以在拥有此能力的盟友所在的同一格结束她的移动。只有两名这样的生物可以共享同一空间。

Ryta can end her movement in the same square as an ally that also has this ability. Only two such creatures can share the same space.

Vocal Warm-Up.name: 发音热身 Vocal Warm-Up
Vocal Warm-Up.description:
里塔布置起毁灭性的振动，在她的喉咙和她的颊囊中回响。直到她下个回合开始前，她的獠牙打击会额外造成 @Damage[2d8[sonic]] 伤害。

如果里塔的颊囊中有物体，她就无法使用发音热身。

Ryta sets up devastating vibrations that echo in her throat and her cheek pouches. Until the start of her next turn, her fangs Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d8[sonic]] damage.

Ryta can't use Vocal Warm-up if she has an object in her cheek pouches.

Ryta.blurb:
女性鼠人鲁特琴演奏者
Female ratfolk lutenist

Sarglagon.name: 溺亡魔 Sarglagon

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Control Water.name: 操控水位 Control Water
Control Water.description:
通过将你的意志强加于水，你可以使所选区域内的水位升高或降低10英尺。当你施放法术时，处于该区域内且具有水（特征）的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免，其效果如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow}法术。

区域 50英尺长，50英尺宽

By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Creatures that have the water trait and that are in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Fortitude save, with the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow} spell.

Area 50 feet long by 50 feet wide

Hydraulic Torrent.name: 水力奔涌 Hydraulic Torrent
Hydraulic Torrent.description:
一股旋转的水流激流沿着一条直线显现，冲击其路径上的生物和无人看管的物体，并可能将它们从你身边推开。激流造成8d6钝击伤害。区域内的每个生物必须进行一次基础强韧豁免；无人看管的物体自动失败。失败的生物和物体还会被击退5英尺（大失败时为10英尺）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A swirling torrent of water manifests along a straight line, battering creatures and unattended objects in its path and possibly pushing them away from you. The torrent deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Fortitude save; unattended objects automatically fail. Creatures and objects that fail are also knocked back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Translocate.name: 传送 Translocate
Translocate.description:
你会立刻将你自己以及你穿戴和持用的所有物品，从你当前的空间传送到射程内一个你能看见的未被占据的空间。如果这会让另一名生物与你一同前往——即使你正用异次元容器携带它——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。随后你会暂时免疫1小时。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Translocate (At Will).name: 传送（意志） Translocate (At Will)
Translocate (At Will).description:
你立刻将你自己以及你穿戴和持有的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处未被占据的空间。如果这会将另一名生物一同带来——即使你正将其装在一个异次元容器中携带——该法术失效。

强化（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道其相对你的位置与距离即可。随后你会在1小时内暂时免疫。

You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Unfettered Movement.name: 无拘移动 Unfettered Movement
Unfettered Movement.description:
你排斥会妨碍生物或减缓其移动的效果。处于此法术效果下时，目标无视会使其速度受到环境减值的效果。当其尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}使其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}的效果时，除非该效果是魔法的且其阶位高于不受束缚的移动法术，否则其自动成功。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

See the Unseen (Constant).name: 洞悉隐匿（恒定） See the Unseen (Constant)
See the Unseen (Constant).description:
你的凝视穿透幻觉，并找出@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的生物与灵体。你可以看见隐形生物，如同它们并未隐形一般，尽管其特征模糊，使其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态且难以辨认。你也可以看见无实体生物，例如幽灵，它们从距离某个物体表面10英尺内的位置穿过该物体时，会以透过这些物体所见的模糊形状呈现。更细微的线索还会使你在进行识破幻觉的检定时获得+2状态加值。

升阶（5环）该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Diabolic Pact.name: 恶魔契约 Diabolic Pact
Diabolic Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，请他们将其部分下属约束为你服务。若你成功，该魔鬼会派来由其选择的以下之一：一名等级2或更低的魔鬼、两名等级0或更低的魔鬼，或三名等级–1或更低的魔鬼。

大成功或大失败 这些魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 这些魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 你的提出请求不仅被拒绝，而且那位强大的魔鬼会将其不悦之意传达给你的主人。

升阶（+1） 对每个选项，将派来的魔鬼的等级提高1。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking them to bind some of their subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you their choice of one devil of level 2 or lower, two devils of level 0 or lower, or three devils of level –1 or lower.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/gmr 1d4 #Days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Heightened (+1) Increase the level of devil sent to you by 1 for each option.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Heavy Aura.name: 沉重灵光 Heavy Aura
Heavy Aura.description:
10英尺。

进入强烈灵光的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:23] 意志豁免。之后它在10分钟内获得暂时免疫。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 只要该生物仍在该区域内，它便处于负重状态。如果该生物已处于负重状态，则只要它仍在灵光范围内，它便处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} 状态。

大失败 同失败，但该效果在离开灵光后仍持续3轮。

10 feet.

A creature that enters the heavy aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:23] save. It is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is encumbered while it remains in the area. If the creature is already encumbered, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} while it remains within the aura.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect persists for 3 rounds after leaving the aura.

Stygian Guardian.name: 冥影守卫 Stygian Guardian
Stygian Guardian.description:
触发 溺亡魔触及内的一个生物或物体成为一次攻击的目标

效果 溺亡魔介入其中，为该生物或物体提供针对该次攻击的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Standard Cover}（AC+2环境加值），或者如果溺亡魔已在给予其低等掩蔽，则提供@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Greater Cover}（AC+4环境加值）。

Trigger A creature or object within the sarglagon's reach is targeted by an attack

Effect The sarglagon interposes themself, giving the creature or object @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Standard Cover} against the attack (+2 circumstance bonus to AC), or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.other-effects.Item.I9lfZUiCwMiGogVi]{Greater Cover} (+4 circumstance bonus to AC) if the sarglagon was already granting it lesser cover.

Drown.name: 溺水 Drown
Drown.description:
溺亡魔召唤浑浊的水灌入30尺内无法在水中呼吸的生物的肺部。目标必须尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标咳出水并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

失败 目标屏住呼吸。其唯一能采取的动作是尝试一次对抗溺亡的强韧豁免以排出水，该动作是单动作。

大成功或大失败 目标倒下并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，并开始窒息。若目标在窒息时其强韧豁免成功，它会咳出水并能再次呼吸。

The sarglagon conjures murky water to fill the lungs of a creature within 30 feet of it that can't breathe water. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target coughs up water and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The target is holding its breath. The only action it can take is to attempt a Fortitude save against Drown to expel the water, which is a single action.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and begins suffocating. If the target succeeds at its Fortitude save while suffocating, it coughs up the water and can breathe again.

Sarglagon Venom.name: 溺亡魔之毒 Sarglagon Venom
Sarglagon Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1@Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2@Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1@Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2@Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Sarglagon.publicNotes:
溺亡魔栖居在地狱无数的水道、湖泊与海洋之中。它们担任“说谎学院”的守卫——那是冥河地狱（Stygia），地狱第五层中秘密的宝库。溺亡魔呼吸水与空气同样轻松，并能以诡异的迅捷穿行于水中、陆地，甚至空中。很少有恶魔在多元宇宙的水路上旅行，但凡有河流横跨位面，溺亡魔多半曾沿其旅行，以推进它们的地狱阴谋。它们唯一回避的水域是冥河（Styx），因为这些恶魔至今尚未发展出任何防御该水道夺取记忆特性的手段。凡人施法者有时会束缚溺亡魔，令其作为珍贵秘密或宝藏的守卫，尤其是在水栖（特征）区域。最为怪异的是，溺亡魔有时会充当令人不安的看护者，守护那些根本不知道自己做了什么才招致这些不受欢迎的保护者注意的凡人。这些魔鬼持续不断、未经邀请的警戒，常令它们的受护者感到不安与窒息。

作为腐化的大师与征服的构筑者，魔鬼既追求诱惑凡人的生命加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也追求将暴政扩散至诸世界。它们给予凡人的诱惑多种多样：从签署一份地狱契约而获得的伟力，到对一位魔鬼庇护者的低声誓约后得到的扭曲恩惠，或是无数更加隐秘的交换。屈服于这些诱惑的人，会在死后被发配至地狱深坑，迎来无尽折磨的来世；而在其中唯一的逃脱希望，便是有机会被擢升，成为地狱序列中的一名魔鬼。

每个魔鬼在那台名为地狱、冷酷无情的官僚机器的运转中，都有其特定职责：从士兵与学者，到审判官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的奥特（ort）为更强大且更专业化的魔鬼从事卑下劳动，例如步兵魔鬼与契约魔鬼；而最伟大的奈萨里斯（nessaris）则能命令整支地狱军团。

阿斯莫德斯立于其所建立结构的顶点，但在他之下的层级却被持续不断的争位所标记。大多数魔鬼的谋划，归根结底都是为了提升谋划者在等级体系中的位置。

Sarglagons dwell in Hell's myriad waterways, lakes, and oceans. They serve as guardians of the Academy of Lies—the repository of secrets in Stygia, the fifth layer of Hell. Sarglagons breathe water and air with equal ease, and can move through water, land, and even air with uncanny swiftness. Few fiends travel the waterways of the multiverse, but where a river crosses the planes, odds are sarglagons have traveled it to further their infernal machinations. The only body of water they avoid is the River Styx, as the fiends have yet to develop any defense against that waterway's memory-sapping qualities. Mortal spellcasters sometimes bind sarglagons as guardians of precious secrets or treasures, particularly in aquatic areas. Most strangely, sarglagons sometimes act as unnerving caretakers to mortals who have no idea what they did to earn their unwanted protectors' attention. The constant uninvited vigilance of these devils is often disturbing and stifling to their wards.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks.

Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly orts perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as infantry and contract devils, while the greatest nessaris command entire infernal armies.

Asmodeus stands at the apex of the structure he created, but the layers below him are marked by a constant jockeying for position. Most diabolic plans ultimately serve to improve the schemer's place in the hierarchy.

Magic Item Mastery.name: 精通魔法物品 Magic Item Mastery
Magic Item Mastery.description:
双尾虫怪即使该法术不在其法术列表上，也可以通过魔法物品施法。所有此类法术都是异能法术，并使用双尾虫怪的天生法术DC和攻击调整值。

A seugathi can Cast a Spell from a magic item even if the spell isn't on their spell list. All such spells are occult spells and use the seugathi's innate spell DC and attack modifier.

Hypercognition.name: 极化认知 Hypercognition
Hypercognition.description:
你迅速编目并整理与你当前情况相关的信息。你可以在施放该法术时立即使用至多6次回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，你不能使用任何在你进行回忆知识时触发的特殊能力、反应动作（）或自由动作（）。

You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，使目标浮空术离地5尺。你可以维持该法术来使目标上升或下降10尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物在攻击掷骰上承受–2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内无视此减值。若目标与一个固定的物体或具有足够稳定性的地形相邻，则它可以通过攀爬（若该表面为垂直，例如墙壁）或匍匐（若该表面为水平，例如天花板）沿着该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. You can Sustain the spell to move the target up or down 10 feet. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你试图读取目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，目标会在1小时内对你的读心术暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败：成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你得知其智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，用一道精神冲击使其陷入眩晕术。冲击造成1d6点精神伤害，并进行一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，能登记周围是否存在魔法。除了魔法的存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知悉的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。你只有在该幻术魔法的效果位阶低于你的侦测魔法法术位阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（第3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强大魔法效果的位阶或等级，由GM判定。

升阶（第4环） 同第3环，但你也能锁定最高位阶魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体范围内（若目标大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法之手，或为隐形或为幽灵般可见，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢以任意方向浮空术移动至多20尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以将该物体额外移动20尺。若该物体在法术结束时仍在空中，则该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60尺，且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个松散、无人持用且在射程内、负载为1或更低的物体投向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你投掷的物体。被投掷的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响该次攻击或伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Wand of See Invisibility (Level 2).name: 识破隐形魔杖（等级2） Wand of See Invisibility (Level 2)
Wand of See Invisibility (Level 2).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}

这根短杖大约一英尺长，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以指定的等级施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次以所列等级施放该法术。

注：要制作特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从合集或合集浏览器拖入一名PC、NPC或战利品演员的物品栏中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated level.

Craft Requirements Supply a listed-level casting of the spell.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得 +1 状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Command Confusion.name: 命令困惑 Command Confusion
Command Confusion.description:
触发 一名生物未能通过双尾虫怪的迷心灵光的豁免

效果 双尾虫怪决定该 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 生物在该轮攻击谁，而不是由GM随机决定目标。

如果所选目标是该困惑术生物的盟友，该生物可以立即尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免；若成功，其目标如困惑术通常规则那样随机决定；若大成功或大失败，则其目标不再处于困惑术状态。

Trigger A creature fails its save against the seugathi's mindfog aura

Effect The seugathi determines who the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} creature attacks for that round, instead of the target being randomly determined by the GM.

If the chosen target is the confused creature's ally, the creature can immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save; on a success, its target is determined randomly as normal for confusion, and on a critical success the target is no longer confused.

Mindfog Aura.name: 迷心灵光 Mindfog Aura
Mindfog Aura.description:
20尺。任何在该光环内开始其回合的生物必须成功通过一次@Check[will|dc:21]意志豁免，否则将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1轮；若成功，则该生物获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。双尾虫怪可用带有专注（特征）的单动作来压制或启动该光环。

20 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round; on a success, that creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute. A seugathi can suppress or activate this aura as a single action with the concentrate trait.

Envenom Weapon.name: 武器涂毒 Envenom Weapon
Envenom Weapon.description:
双尾虫怪将其双尾虫怪毒涂抹在其所持用的一把武器上。

The seugathi applies their seugathi venom to one weapon they wield.

Seugathi Venom.name: 双尾虫怪毒 Seugathi Venom
Seugathi Venom.description:
豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Seugathi Guard.publicNotes:
夺心巨虫所繁衍的最常见的双尾虫怪是双尾虫怪仆从。它们的主人会为它们配备在任务中有用的工具（通常是一根魔杖和一把武器），而除了完成其被烙印的使命所需之外，它们很少看重其他材料事物。

邪恶而异界的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids} 通过仪式性的魔法使自身受孕，以产生被称为双尾虫怪的蠕虫状侍役生物。这些生物出生时便带有强烈的心灵驱动力，要为夺心巨虫影响深远的计划完成某项任务。这些指令多种多样、怪异，并且通常对类人生物的生命极其残酷。

The most common seugathis spawned by neothelids are seugathi servants. Their masters equip them with tools useful in their tasks (often a wand and a weapon), and they rarely value other material things beyond their usefulness in completing their imprinted mission.

The wicked, alien @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids} impregnate themselves through ritualistic magic to produce wormlike servitor creatures called seugathis. These creatures spawn with a strong psychic drive to complete some task on behalf of the neothelids' far-reaching plans. These directives are diverse, strange, and usually cruel toward humanoid life.

Seugathi servant

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法之手，可以是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其以缓慢的速度用浮空术向任意方向移动最多20英尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20英尺。如果该法术结束时物体仍在空中，物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人看管物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人看管物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人看管物体为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一件在射程内、散落且无人看管、负载为1或更低的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你掷出的物体。被掷出的物品不具有任何会影响该攻击或伤害的特定特征或魔法属性。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害提高1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Wand of Status (Level 2).name: 关照术魔杖（等级 2） Wand of Status (Level 2)
Wand of Status (Level 2).description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTou8cG05yuSkesj]{Status}

这根警棍长约一英尺，内含一个法术。其外观通常与其中的法术相关。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以标示的等级施放该法术。

制作需求 提供一次以所列等级施放该法术。

注：要创建特定法术的卷轴或魔杖，将该法术从资料库或资料库浏览器拖入PC、NPC或战利品角色的物品栏中。

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Command Confusion.name: 命令困惑 Command Confusion
Command Confusion.description:
触发 一名生物对双尾虫怪的迷心灵光进行豁免并失败

效果 双尾虫怪决定该 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 生物在该轮攻击谁，而不是由GM随机决定目标。

如果所选目标是困惑术生物的盟友，则该生物可以立刻尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志豁免；成功时，其目标如同困惑术正常规则一样改为随机决定；大成功时，该目标不再处于困惑术状态。

Trigger A creature fails its save against the seugathi's mindfog aura

Effect The seugathi determines who the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} creature attacks for that round, instead of the target being randomly determined by the GM.

If the chosen target is the confused creature's ally, the creature can immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save; on a success, its target is determined randomly as normal for confusion, and on a critical success the target is no longer confused.

Mindfog Aura.name: 迷心灵光 Mindfog Aura
Mindfog Aura.description:
20尺。任何在该灵光中开始其回合的生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 意志 豁免中获得成功，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 1轮；若成功，该生物将获得1分钟的暂时免疫。双尾虫怪可以用带有专注（特征）的单动作来压制或启动该灵光。

20 feet. A creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round; on a success, that creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute. A seugathi can suppress or activate this aura as a single action with the concentrate trait.

Envenom Weapon.description:
双尾虫怪将他们的双尾虫怪毒涂抹在他们挥舞的一把武器上。

The seugathi applies their seugathi venom to one weapon they wield.

A seugathi can Cast a Spell from a magic item even if the spell isn't on their spell list. All such spells are occult spells and use the seugathi's innate spell DC and attack modifier.

Seugathi Researcher.publicNotes:
最常见的由夺心巨虫产下的双尾虫怪是双尾虫怪仆从。它们的主人会为其配备在任务中有用的工具（通常是一根魔杖和一把武器），而除了在完成其被烙印的使命时所具备的用途之外，它们很少重视其他材料事物。

邪恶而异质的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids}通过仪式性的魔法使自己受孕，以产生被称为双尾虫怪的蠕虫状仆役生物。这些生物诞生时就带有强烈的心灵驱动力，以代表夺心巨虫那影响深远的计划完成某项任务。这些指令多种多样、怪异，且通常对类人生物的生命极其残酷。

The most common seugathis spawned by neothelids are seugathi servants. Their masters equip them with tools useful in their tasks (often a wand and a weapon), and they rarely value other material things beyond their usefulness in completing their imprinted mission.

The wicked, alien @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids} impregnate themselves through ritualistic magic to produce wormlike servitor creatures called seugathis. These creatures spawn with a strong psychic drive to complete some task on behalf of the neothelids' far-reaching plans. These directives are diverse, strange, and usually cruel toward humanoid life.

Hypercognition.name: 极化认知 Hypercognition
Hypercognition.description:
你迅速编目并整理与你当前情况相关的信息。作为施放此法术的一部分，你可以立刻使用至多 6 个回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，当你进行回忆知识时触发的任何特殊能力、反应动作（）或自由动作（）都不能使用。

You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违抗重力，并让目标在离地5尺处漂浮。你可以维持法术，使目标向上或向下移动10尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物在攻击掷骰上承受–2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合的剩余时间内抵消此减值。若目标邻接于一个固定的物体或具有足够稳定性的地形，它可以通过攀爬（如果表面是垂直的，如墙壁）或匍匐（如果表面是水平的，如天花板）沿该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. You can Sustain the spell to move the target up or down 10 feet. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Mind Reading.name: 读心术 Mind Reading
Mind Reading.description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读心术目标的思想。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。之后目标对你的读心术暂时免疫1小时。

大成功或大失败 成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你会得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你会得知它的智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败 如同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你侵入目标的心智，用一次精神冲击令其陷入眩晕术。该冲击造成1d6点精神伤害，并允许进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，它还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，用以登记周围是否存在魔法。除魔法的存在与否外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。你仅在该魔法的效果位阶低于你的侦测魔法法术位阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术所侦测到的最强魔法效果的位阶或等级，由GM裁定。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高位阶魔法的来源。类似于模糊感官，你不会得知精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若目标大于该范围，则缩小到最接近的等效范围）。

However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Seugathi Servant.publicNotes:
最常见的由夺心巨虫孵化的双尾虫怪是双尾虫怪仆从。它们的主人会为其配备执行任务所需的工具（通常是一根魔杖和一把武器），并且除了能用于完成其被烙印的使命之外，它们很少看重其他材料事物。

邪恶而异界的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids} 通过仪式性的魔法使自身受孕，以制造出被称为双尾虫怪的蠕虫状仆役生物。这些生物在孵化时便带有强烈的心灵驱动力，去代表夺心巨虫深远计划中的一环完成某项任务。这些指令多样、怪异，并且通常对类人生物的生命极其残酷。

The most common seugathis spawned by neothelids are seugathi servants. Their masters equip them with tools useful in their tasks (often a wand and a weapon), and they rarely value other material things beyond their usefulness in completing their imprinted mission.

The wicked, alien @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary-2.Actor.wxBQsGLdti2xcGVT]{Neothelids} impregnate themselves through ritualistic magic to produce wormlike servitor creatures called seugathis. These creatures spawn with a strong psychic drive to complete some task on behalf of the neothelids' far-reaching plans. These directives are diverse, strange, and usually cruel toward humanoid life.
Seugathi Servant.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic
Seugathi Servant.prototypeToken: 双尾虫怪仆从 Seugathi Servant

Shanrigol Behemoth.name: 塑肉残渣巨兽 Shanrigol Behemoth
Shanrigol Behemoth.tokenName: 塑肉残渣巨兽 Shanrigol Behemoth

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震动感知（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当塑肉残渣巨兽死亡时，它的血肉腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的@Template[emanation|distance:5]。这股气体对该区域内的生物造成@Damage[9d6[void]]伤害，因为它们的血肉也会凝固并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic]豁免）。

When the shanrigol behemoth dies, its flesh rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body. This gas deals @Damage[9d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic] save).

Sapping Squeeze.name: 压榨 Sapping Squeeze
Sapping Squeeze.description:
需求 该塑肉残渣擒抱了一名生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

效果 该塑肉残渣从其目标身上挤压出生命精华，造成 @Damage[(1d10+11)[bludgeoning],1d6[bleed]]{1d10+11 钝击伤害和 1d6 持续流血伤害}（@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] 豁免）。

该塑肉残渣获得等同于单一目标所受钝击伤害一半的临时生命值；这些临时生命值持续 1 分钟。

Requirements The shanrigol has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The shanrigol squeezes the life essence from its target, dealing @Damage[(1d10+11)[bludgeoning],1d6[bleed]]{1d10+11 bludgeoning and 1d6 persistent bleed damage} (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save).

The shanrigol regains temporary Hit Points equal to half the amount of bludgeoning damage a single target takes; these temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

Shred Flesh.name: 撕肉 Shred Flesh
Shred Flesh.description:
塑肉残渣巨兽的攻击会残忍地撕裂其敌人。被塑肉残渣的血肉拍击打击重击命中的生物会额外承受 @Damage[2d6[bleed]]，并在其流血期间陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

A shanrigol behemoth's attacks brutally rend its foes. Creatures critically hit by the shanrigol's fleshy slap Strike take an additional @Damage[2d6[bleed]] and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for as long as they are bleeding.

Undulating Step.name: 波状蠕行 Undulating Step
Undulating Step.description:
塑肉残渣将其血肉与骨骼分离，以便穿过狭小空间。它移动，无视困难地形，并且能像超小型生物一样穿过狭窄空间。

在它占据一个足以容纳其正常形态的区域之前，除了波状蠕行之外，它不能使用任何其他动作。

The shanrigol separates its flesh from its bones to fit through small spaces. It Strides, ignoring difficult terrain and fitting through tight spaces as though it were a Tiny creature.

It can't use any actions other than Undulating Step until it occupies an area large enough for its normal form.

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被塑肉残渣巨兽的蛛网术攻击命中的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}状态，并粘在最近的表面上，直到它能够逃脱（DC 25）。

A creature hit by the shanrigol behemoth's web attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it can Escape (DC 25).

Shanrigol Behemoth.publicNotes:
随着许多活体受害者的增添而不断生长的塑肉残渣，其体型可变得真正巨大，并在其不断扩张的狩猎领地中构成更大的威胁。地下社群曾坍塌整条隧道，以防止这些生物抵达他们的聚居地。

许多塑肉残渣巨兽会吸收足够的脑组织以形成粗陋的智能，并呈现蛇形或类人形态。它们的能力比塑肉残渣堆更为多样，因为它们往往会从构成它们的生物身上获得能力。下文所示的塑肉残渣巨兽含有蛛化精灵与透肌魔人的血肉，使其拥有蛛网术攻击与暗蚀溃烂能力。并非所有塑肉残渣巨兽都具备这两项能力，但应以其他能力替换它们。

塑肉者无论其起源或训练如何，都会制造出惊人数量的废弃物。当畸变血肉被丢弃的残余物堆叠在一起，并意外混入炼金化合物或可憎能量时，这团物质可能会迅速活化并重获生命。在没有塑肉者引导的情况下，这些畸变的身体部件会聚合成一团塑肉残渣——一堆由骨、肌肉与筋腱纠缠而成的乱团。

Shanrigols that grow with the additions of many living victims can become truly enormous in size and pose a greater danger in their expanding hunting territories. Subterranean communities have collapsed entire tunnels to prevent the creatures from reaching their settlements.

Many shanrigol behemoths absorb enough brain matter to form crude intelligences and take a serpentine or humanoid shape. They're more varied in their abilities than shanrigol heaps, as they often gain abilities from their constituent creatures. The shanrigol behemoth presented below contains flesh from driders and urdefhans, giving it a web attack and necrotic decay ability. Not all shanrigol behemoths have these two abilities, but should have other abilities to replace them.

Fleshwarpers, regardless of their origin or training, create a shocking amount of waste. When the discarded remnants of aberrant flesh are heaped together with an accidental mixture of alchemical compounds or odious energy, the mass can quicken and regain life. Without the guidance of a fleshwarper, these aberrant body parts form into a shanrigol, a mess of bone, muscle, and sinew.
Shanrigol Behemoth.prototypeToken: 塑肉残渣巨兽 Shanrigol Behemoth

Sod Hound.name: 烂泥猎犬 Sod Hound

Crystal Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 水晶感知（模糊）60尺 Crystal Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet
Crystal Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
泥猎犬可以在60英尺内感知到水晶或宝石，如同使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.rqfnQ5VHT5hxm25r]{Scent}能力

A sod hound can sense crystals or gems within 60 feet as if using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.rqfnQ5VHT5hxm25r]{Scent} ability

Earth Glide.name: 土遁行 Earth Glide
Earth Glide.description:
草犬可以在任何土质物质中掘地穿行，包括岩石。当它如此行动时，草犬以其完整的掘地速度移动，不会留下任何隧道或经过的痕迹。

The sod hound can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the sod hound moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

Sod Hound.publicNotes:
苔犬是覆满苔藓的异界犬类，由压实的土和卵石构成。在它们的原生位面上，它们常被指派守卫较不安全的地点并寻找矿藏。另一些则作为野猪人的宠物，过着相对奢华的生活。

土元素是富于冒险精神的洞穴探险者的出色保镖，也是金库和财宝库等重要地下地点的理想守护者。

Sod hounds are mossy extraplanar canines formed of packed dirt and pebbles. On their native plane, they are often tasked with guarding less secure sites and finding mineral deposits. Others live in the comparative lap of luxury as pets to jabalis.

Earth elementals make excellent bodyguards for adventuresome spelunkers and are ideal protectors of important subterranean locations such as vaults and treasuries.

Vischari.name: 维斯查芮 Vischari

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮术无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内都不会散发任何光亮术，即使其光照半径原本会延伸到黑暗术之外亦然。这也会压制你施放的黑暗术之环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗术的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有暗视（但不包括高等暗视）的生物也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗术。他们将通过黑暗术看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一个濒死的生物的生命掐灭。该目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若这使其死亡，你获得10点临时HP，以及对攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值，持续10分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你对目标施放恐惧术；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败：大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身制止坠落。目标的坠落减缓至每轮60英尺，并且在法术持续时间内的那段坠落在计算坠落伤害时不计入其中。若目标在法术效果持续期间到达地面，它不会因该次坠落而受到伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰是大成功或大失败中的大成功，则使用比其豁免结果差一级的成功等级对应的结果。

大成功或大失败中的大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败中的大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当维斯查芮死亡时，她的隐形血肉会腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满以她的尸体为中心的 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。当该区域内生物的血肉凝结腐烂时，这股气体对其造成 @Damage[7d6[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] 豁免）。

When Vischari dies, her invisible flesh rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around her body. This gas deals @Damage[7d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Immobilizing Blow.name: 定身打击 Immobilizing Blow
Immobilizing Blow.description:
维斯查芮进行一次拳击打击，使其目标的运动控制失效。目标必须进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:25] 豁免。如果该打击为大成功或大失败命中，将目标的豁免结果视为下降一个等级。随后目标在1小时内暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败失败 目标麻痹1分钟。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的强韧豁免，将剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功或大失败成功时完全结束该效果。

Vischari makes a fist Strike that shuts down her target's motor control. The target must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save. If the Strike was a critical hit, treat the target's save result as one degree worse. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is paralyzed for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Fortitude save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round or end it entirely on a critical success.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 维斯查芮在她上一个动作中用一次啃咬打击对一个生物造成了伤害

效果 维斯查芮保持接触，使生物的血肉在受伤处周围变得半透明。维斯查芮从两个选项中选择一个，每个选项都需要目标尝试一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:25] 豁免。若她的啃咬打击是大成功或大失败命中，则该生物同时承受两个效果，且两个效果使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 维斯查芮饮下该生物的一部分鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 且维斯查芮恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP（大成功或大失败失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 且维斯查芮恢复 @Damage[20[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 维斯查芮抽出该生物的一部分生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 持续 1 小时（大成功或大失败失败时为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} 持续 1 小时）。

Requirements Vischari damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on her last action

Effect Vischari maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. Vischari chooses one of two options, each of which requires the target to attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save. If her jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood Vischari drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and Vischari regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP (on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and Vischari regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality Vischari draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Vischari.blurb:
女性透肌魔人拳斗家
Female urdefhan pugilist
Vischari.senses: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Zebub.name: 斥控魔 Zebub

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会瞬间将你自己以及你身上穿戴和手持的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。如果这会带上另一名生物——即使你正将其装在一个异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将你自己以及你穿戴和持有的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、在射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一个生物一同带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器中携带——该法术会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提高至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的方位与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).name: 隐形术（意志）（仅自身） Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).description:
目标披覆幻象，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对它们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} 状态。若目标使用一次敌对动作，该法术会在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，要求它将其部分下属束缚到你的服役之中。如果你成功，魔鬼会派遣它所选择的以下之一：一名魔鬼，其等级不超过炼狱契约环阶的两倍；两名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 成功 这些魔鬼会被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 这些魔鬼会被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 失败 你的提出请求不仅被拒绝，这位强大的魔鬼还会将其不满传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动唇，但这些话语并不会从你口中发出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话语，效果并不比你正常动唇更清楚；但目标听到你的话语时，就仿佛他们正站在你身旁。

目标可以以反应动作（）做出简短回应，或若他们愿意，也可以在其下一回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且在射程内才能这样做。若他们回应，其回应会像最初的传讯术一样，直接送入你的耳中。

增幅（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only).name: 召唤动物（仅限虫群生物） Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only)
Summon Animal (Swarm creatures only).description:
你召唤一只动物为你作战。你召唤一个普通生物，该生物具有动物（特征）且其等级为 -1，例如那些出现在《Pathfinder Bestiary》各卷中的生物。升阶该法术会提高你能召唤的生物的最高等级。

升阶（2环） 等级 1

升阶（3环） 等级 2

升阶（4环） 等级 3

升阶（5环） 等级 5

升阶（6环） 等级 7

升阶（7环） 等级 9

升阶（8环） 等级 11

升阶（9环） 等级 13

升阶（10环） 等级 15

You conjure an animal to fight for you. You summon a common creature that has the animal trait and whose level is -1, such as those found in Pathfinder Bestiary volumes. Heightening the spell increases the maximum level of creature you can summon.

Heightened (2nd) Level 1

Heightened (3rd) Level 2

Heightened (4th) Level 3

Heightened (5th) Level 5

Heightened (6th) Level 7

Heightened (7th) Level 9

Heightened (8th) Level 11

Heightened (9th) Level 13

Heightened (10th) Level 15

Infernal Eye.name: 炼狱之眼 Infernal Eye
Infernal Eye.description:
斥控魔会记录他们所见的一切，尽管他们不会记住所有观察，但他们可以将这些内容传递给另一名生物。

斥控魔向一名被触碰且自愿的生物重放其目击事件的10分钟，该生物会在信息闪现中接收这些记忆。通过保持接触，斥控魔可以花费额外的3动作活动来重放更多信息。

在将他们的幻象转述给另一个之后，斥控魔将再也无法回忆起那些事件。

The zebub records everything they see, and though they don't remember all observations, they can pass them along to another creature.

The zebub replays 10 minutes of witnessed events to a touched willing creature, which receives the memories in a flash of information. By remaining in contact, the zebub can spend additional 3-action activities to replay more information.

After relaying their visions to another, the zebub can't ever recall those events again.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
斥控魔的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物造成额外1d6精准伤害。

The zebub's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Zebub.publicNotes:
斥控魔充当地狱的信使与间谍。它们将所见之事与其他生物分享的能力使其格外有用——不仅对其他魔鬼如此，对凡人的召唤师亦然。一些炼狱领主会将它们以庞大而可怖的虫群释放到毫无戒备的土地上，在收集炼狱军势日后可能加以利用的秘密的同时，也一并玷污血肉与大地。斥控魔会利用任何机会操纵意志薄弱或容易受诱惑的凡人，让其侍奉斥控魔的心血来潮。斥控魔虽傲慢而狡诈，却缺乏大多数魔鬼的机敏与自信，因此它们的阴谋往往聚焦于满足自利或自毁的野心。斥控魔由幼稚而怯懦的凡人灵魂形成，在地狱第七层——柯西 图斯——那冰冷、肮脏的荒原中，被大魔鬼巴尔泽布尔重塑而成。

每一种魔鬼都在地狱的官僚体系与等级结构中扮演特定角色，不过有些魔鬼的职能远比其他魔鬼更为专门化。

Zebubs serve as Hell's messengers and spies. Their ability to share what they've seen with other creatures makes them especially useful-not only to other devils, but also to mortal conjurers. Some infernal lords unleash them in enormous, horrid swarms upon unsuspecting lands to debase flesh and land alike while collecting secrets the infernal host might later put to use. Zebubs use any opportunity to manipulate weak-willed or easily tempted mortals into serving the zebubs' whims. While arrogant and deceitful, zebubs lack the cunning and confidence of most devils, and thus their schemes often focus on satisfying self-serving or self-destructive ambitions. Zebubs form from the souls of childish and craven mortals, reshaped by the archdevil Baalzebul in the frozen, filthy wastes of Hell's seventh layer, Cocytus.

Each type of devil plays a particular role in Hell's bureaucracies and hierarchies, though some have far more specialized functions than others.
Zebub.senses: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Zebub.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Yellow Mold.name: 黄霉菌 Yellow Mold

Spore Explosion.name: 孢子爆炸 Spore Explosion
Spore Explosion.description:
触发 一名生物移动进入霉菌的空间或对霉菌造成伤害。如果霉菌处于直射阳光下，或伤害为火焰伤害，则霉菌无法使用此反应动作（）。

效果 触发生物以及所有位于 @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet} 内的生物都会暴露于黄霉孢子之下。

Trigger A creature moves into the mold's space or damages the mold. The mold can't use this reaction if it's in direct sunlight or if the damage was fire damage.

Effect The triggering creature and all creatures within @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet} are exposed to yellow mold spores.

Yellow Mold Spores.name: 黄霉孢子 Yellow Mold Spores
Yellow Mold Spores.description:
孢子造成的任何流失（状态）会在毒素的持续时间结束后仍然持续。

豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

最长持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}（1 轮）

Any drained condition from the spores persists after the poison's duration ends.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)
