@Check[survival|dc:26|name:Remove the Mold] (expert) to remove the mold without triggering the spores
Yellow Mold.hazarddescription:
有毒霉菌孢子袭击附近的生物。

Poisonous mold spores assault nearby creatures.

Dissection Chamber Detritus.name: 解剖室残骸 Dissection Chamber Detritus

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为链甲衫，这是一件用与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Steel Shield.name: 钢盾 Steel Shield
Steel Shield.description:
如同木制盾牌，钢盾也有多种形状和体型。尽管比木制盾牌更昂贵，它们要耐用得多。

硬度 HP BT
5 20 10

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

Dagger.name: 匕首 Dagger
Dagger.description:
这把小型刃器武器可单手持用，并用于在近身战斗中刺击一名生物。它也可以被投掷。

This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

Pick.name: 镐 Pick
Pick.description:
一把专为战斗设计的镐拥有坚固的木柄和沉重的尖头，能够造成毁灭性的打击。

A pick designed solely for combat has a sturdy wooden shaft and a heavy, pointed head to deliver devastating blows.

Caltrops.name: 铁蒺藜 Caltrops
Caltrops.description:
这些四叉金属尖钉会对生物的脚造成伤害。你可以用一个交互动作将铁蒺藜散布在你相邻的一个空方格中。第一个进入该方格移动的生物必须在DC 14的体操检定中成功，否则受到1d4点穿刺伤害以及[[/r 1[persistent,bleed]]]伤害。因铁蒺藜而承受持续流血伤害的生物，其速度受到-5英尺减值。花费一个交互动作将铁蒺藜拔出会降低止血的DC。一旦某个生物因铁蒺藜受到伤害，就会有足够多的铁蒺藜被毁，使得其他进入该方格的生物是安全的。若没有任何生物因已布置的铁蒺藜受到伤害，则可回收并重复使用。否则，将有足够多的铁蒺藜被毁，无法回收。

These four‑pronged metal spikes can cause damage to a creature's feet. You can scatter caltrops in an empty square adjacent to you with an Interact action. The first creature that moves into that square must succeed at a DC 14 Acrobatics check or take 1d4 piercing damage and [[/r 1[persistent,bleed]]] damage. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from caltrops takes a -5‑foot penalty to its Speed. Spending an Interact action to pluck the caltrops free reduces the DC to stop the bleeding. Once a creature takes damage from caltrops, enough caltrops are ruined that other creatures moving into the square are safe. Deployed caltrops can be salvaged and reused if no creatures took damage from them. Otherwise, enough caltrops are ruined that they can't be salvaged.

Fishing Tackle (Professional).name: 钓具（专业） Fishing Tackle (Professional)
Fishing Tackle (Professional).description:
这套工具包括一根可折叠鱼竿、鱼钩、鱼线、鱼饵和一张捞鱼网。专家级渔具给予钓鱼检定+1物品加值。

This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net. Professional fishing tackle grants a +1 item bonus to checks to fish.

Spyglass.name: 望远镜 Spyglass
Spyglass.description:
一支典型的望远镜让你能看得比平常远八倍。

A typical spyglass lets you see eight times farther than normal.

Piton.name: 岩钉 Piton
Piton.description:
这些小尖钉可以用作锚点，让攀爬更容易。要固定岩钉，你必须用一只手握住它，并用另一只手用锤子将其敲入。你可以把绳子系在敲入的岩钉上，这样在攀爬时遭遇大成功或大失败就不会一路跌落到地面。

These small spikes can be used as anchors to make climbing easier. To affix a piton, you must hold it in one hand and use a hammer to drive it in with your other hand. You can attach a rope to the hammered piton so that you don't fall all the way to the ground on a critical failure while Climbing.

Jafaki's Laboratory.name: 贾法基的实验室 Jafaki's Laboratory
Jafaki's Laboratory.tokenName: 贾法基的实验室 Jafaki's Laboratory

Repair Kit (Superb).name: 修理工具包（卓越） Repair Kit (Superb)
Repair Kit (Superb).description:
修理工具包允许你在旅行时进行简单的修理。它包含便携式铁砧、钳子、木工工具、磨刀石，以及用于保养皮革和木材的油。你可以使用修理工具包来用手艺（技能）技能修理物品。专家级修理工具包使你在检定中获得+1物品加值。

A repair kit allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. It contains a portable anvil, tongs, woodworking tools, a whetstone, and oils for conditioning leather and wood. You can use a repair kit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. A superb repair kit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check.

Alchemist's Lab (Expanded).name: 炼金术师实验室（扩展） Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)
Alchemist's Lab (Expanded).description:
你在休整模式中制造炼金物品时需要一间炼金术师实验室。

一间扩展的炼金术师实验室在制造炼金物品时，为制造检定提供+1物品加值。

You need an alchemist's lab to Craft alchemical items during downtime.

An expanded alchemist's lab gives a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to create alchemical items.

Healer's Tools (Expanded).name: 医疗工具（扩展） Healer's Tools (Expanded)
Healer's Tools (Expanded).description:
这套由绷带、草药和缝合工具组成的工具包，是进行医疗检定以实施急救、治疗疾病、治疗毒素或治疗伤口所必需的。专家级医疗工具为此类检定提供+1物品加值。当你将这些工具随身携带并四处移动时，你会把其中许多组件随手放在身上，例如放在口袋或弹药带中。

This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to Administer First Aid, Treat Disease, Treat Poison, or Treat Wounds. Expanded healer's tools provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. When you carry the tools from place to place, you keep many of the components handy on your person, in pockets or bandoliers.

Crafter's Eyepiece.name: 工匠护目镜 Crafter's Eyepiece
Crafter's Eyepiece.description:
这副坚固的金属目镜蚀刻着方形图案，设计为覆盖单只眼睛佩戴。旋转镜片会显现出你计划制造或修理的物品的淡淡三维轮廓，并在其组件部位标注有实用的标签。

佩戴期间，这副目镜给予你进行工艺检定时+1物品加值。当你修理一件物品时，每熟练度阶位恢复的生命值提高为15而非10。

This rugged metal eyepiece etched with square patterns is designed to be worn over a single eye. Twisting the lens reveals a faint three-dimensional outline of an item you plan to build or repair, with helpful labels on the component parts.

While worn, this eyepiece gives you a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks. When you Repair an item, increase the Hit Points restored by 15 per proficiency rank instead of 10.

Antiplague (Moderate).name: 抗疫剂（中等） Antiplague (Moderate)
Antiplague (Moderate).description:
启动 A 交互

抗疫剂能够强化身体对抗疾病的防御。饮用抗疫剂后，你在24小时内对抗疾病的强韧豁免检定获得+3物品加值；这同样适用于你每日用以对抗疾病进展的豁免。

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-effects.HeRHBo2NaKy5IxhU]{Effect: Antiplague (Moderate)}

Activate A Interact

Antiplague can fortify the body's defenses against diseases. Upon drinking an antiplague, you gain a +3 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against diseases for 24 hours; this applies to your daily save against a disease's progression.

Eerie Flexibility.description:

Furious Claws.description:

The gug makes up to four claw Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks all count toward the gug's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gug makes all its attacks.

Aulr.publicNotes:
古格巨人最骇人的特征是它那桶状的头颅——头颅会纵向裂开，露出数排尖锐发黄的牙齿与敞开的喉咙。位于头颚两侧的眼睛虽小却敏锐。骨质嵴脊保护它的双眼，免受猎物惊慌乱舞的肢体拍打；与真菌和霉菌相比，它更偏爱生食且仍在扭动的肉。它用强壮的手臂抓住猎物，手臂在肘部裂分成一对前臂，使其拥有四只带爪的兽足。这些怪物般的蛮力野兽全身覆着蓬乱的黑色毛发，常常结着血与肉泥。

尽管古格巨人看似野兽，它们却拥有敏锐而邪恶的才智。古格巨人栖居在地下极深处，但有时会在黑暗的夜晚来到地表狩猎，或独自行动，或结成小群。由于它们食欲贪婪，大多数古格巨人会吞食自己捕获的生物，但也有一些会改为绑架受害者并撤回地底，只留下经久不散的恶臭与古怪的、带爪的足印。受害者会被带往腐臭的巢穴，那里刻着奇异的符文，并被献祭给古格巨人那邪恶的血之、黑暗与梦魇术之神祇。可怕的流言称，在地下极深处存在由巨型石块建成、毫无光亮的古格巨人城市，其中强大的古格巨人首领向嚎叫的古格巨人暴民宣讲它们卑劣的教义。

古格巨人与食尸鬼之间有着奇特的关系，这似乎可追溯至它们共同起源于某个遥远的地下世界。尽管体型远高于食尸鬼，古格巨人却生活在对食尸鬼的恐惧术之中；然而，这种诡异的恐惧并不适用于尸妖，古格巨人吞食尸妖的贪婪程度与吞食其他生物无异。

古格巨人身高16英尺，体重2,000磅；尽管体型巨大，它们的步态却带着诡异的优雅，令人难以与其庞大体型联系起来。它们轻盈的步伐与挤入空间穿过极狭小裂隙的能力，使古格巨人在怪异失踪或血腥屠杀的传说中常被当作噩梦般的怪谈主角。

某些尤为嗜血的古格巨人会从其神秘而不可名状的庇护者那里获得可怖的力量作为赋礼。这些怪物被称为“贤者”，其力量从不低于第12等级，并获得若干奥术先天法术。尽管每位贤者的法术具体组合各不相同，但通常这些法术会赋予隐形术、提供操控并改变岩石的力量，或对活体血肉引发可怖且具毁灭性的能量。

A gug's most horrid feature is its barrel-shaped head, which splits vertically to reveal numerous rows of sharp, yellow teeth and an open throat. Its eyes on either side of its head-jaw are small but keen. Bony ridges protect its eyes from the frantic flailing of its prey, as it prefers meals of raw and writhing meat over fungi and molds. It grips said prey with powerful arms that split at the elbow into a pair of forearms, giving it four clawed paws. These monstrous brutes are covered with shaggy black fur, often crusted with blood and gore.

Although gugs may seem bestial, they have keen and wicked intellects. Gugs lair far underground, but they sometimes come to the surface to hunt during dark nights, either alone or in small groups. As they possess voracious appetites, most gugs consume the creatures they catch, but some instead kidnap their victims and retreat below the surface, leaving only a lingering stench and odd, clawed paw-prints. Victims are taken to rancid lairs marked with strange runes and sacrificed to the gugs' wicked gods of blood, darkness, and nightmares. Dire rumors tell of lightless gug cities made of titanic blocks of stone far underground, where powerful gug leaders preach their vile doctrines to mobs of howling gugs.

Gugs have a strange relationship with ghouls, which seems to date from their shared origin in a distant subterranean world. Gugs live in fear of ghouls, despite towering over them; however, this strange fear doesn't apply to ghasts, whom gugs consume as voraciously as they do other creatures.

Gugs stand 16 feet tall and weigh 2,000 pounds, although they have an eerie, graceful gait that belies their immense size. Their light step and ability to squeeze through very small crannies makes gugs common bogeymen in tales of strange disappearances or bloody massacres.

Some particularly bloodthirsty gugs gain awful powers as gifts from their eldritch patrons. These monsters are known as savants, are never less than 12th level in power, and gain several occult innate spells. Though each savant's precise mix of spells varies, normally, these spells grant invisibility, offer power to manipulate and change rock, or invoke awful and destructive energies upon living flesh.

升阶（5环） 射程提升至 1 英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你曾在过去到过那里，并且知道其相对于你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫 1 小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Infernal Pact.name: 地狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一名强大的魔鬼提出请求，恳求它将部分下属束缚于你的役使之下。若你成功，魔鬼会派遣它所选择的以下之一：一名等级不超过地狱契约阶位两倍的魔鬼；两名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效力[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效力[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 你的提出请求不仅被拒绝，这名强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦之意传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Message.description:

目标可以用一个简短的答复作为一个反应动作（）给出，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在他们下一个回合以一个自由动作（）给出，但他们必须能够看见你并且在射程内才能这么做。若他们作出回应，他们的回应会像最初的传讯术一样，直接传入你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Infernal Eye.name: 炼狱之眼 Infernal Eye
Infernal Eye.description:
斥控魔会记录他们所见的一切，尽管他们不会记住所有观察，但他们可以将其传递给另一名生物。

斥控魔向触碰到的自愿生物重播其所目击事件的10分钟内容，该生物在信息洪流般的一瞬间接收这些记忆。只要保持接触，斥控魔便可花费额外的3动作活动来重播更多信息。

在将他们的幻象转述给他者之后，斥控魔将再也无法回忆起那些事件。

The zebub records everything they see, and though they don't remember all observations, they can pass them along to another creature.

The zebub replays 10 minutes of witnessed events to a touched willing creature, which receives the memories in a flash of information. By remaining in contact, the zebub can spend additional 3-action activities to replay more information.

After relaying their visions to another, the zebub can't ever recall those events again.

The zebub's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Azvalvigander.publicNotes:
斥控魔是地狱的信使与间谍。它们能够将所见所闻与其他生物分享的能力，使其格外有用——不仅对其他魔鬼如此，对凡人的召唤师亦然。一些炼狱领主会将它们以庞大而骇人的虫群释放到毫无防备的土地上，既败坏血肉也玷污大地，同时收集炼狱军势日后可能派上用场的秘密。斥控魔会利用一切机会，操纵意志薄弱或容易受诱惑的凡人去满足斥控魔的一己之欲。尽管傲慢而狡诈，斥控魔却缺乏大多数魔鬼所具备的狡黠与自信，因此它们的阴谋往往专注于满足自利或自毁的野心。斥控魔由幼稚而怯懦的凡人灵魂形成，在地狱第七层、柯西 图斯那冰封而污秽的荒原中，被大魔鬼巴尔泽布重塑而成。

每一种魔鬼在地狱的官僚体系与等级结构中都扮演着特定角色，不过有些魔鬼的职能比其他魔鬼要更为专门。

Zebubs serve as Hell's messengers and spies. Their ability to share what they've seen with other creatures makes them especially useful-not only to other devils, but also to mortal conjurers. Some infernal lords unleash them in enormous, horrid swarms upon unsuspecting lands to debase flesh and land alike while collecting secrets the infernal host might later put to use. Zebubs use any opportunity to manipulate weak-willed or easily tempted mortals into serving the zebubs' whims. While arrogant and deceitful, zebubs lack the cunning and confidence of most devils, and thus their schemes often focus on satisfying self-serving or self-destructive ambitions. Zebubs form from the souls of childish and craven mortals, reshaped by the archdevil Baalzebul in the frozen, filthy wastes of Hell's seventh layer, Cocytus.

Each type of devil plays a particular role in Hell's bureaucracies and hierarchies, though some have far more specialized functions than others.

Barbazu.publicNotes:
胡须魔，也被称为长须魔鬼或步兵魔鬼，是嗜杀的邪魔，它们通过充当地狱军团的步兵来满足自己对毁灭的渴望，常常率领由小魔鬼与莱墨瑞等低等魔鬼组成的乌合之众投入战斗。长须魔鬼挥舞带锯齿的关刀，造成参差裂伤，使其难以被治疗魔法愈合，从而导致惊人的失血。当敌人靠得太近时，长须魔鬼便用其蠕动胡须上的尖刺猛击，传播一种名为“阿弗纳斯热”的可憎疫病，并以目睹受害者的力量从体内被缓慢吞噬为乐。

在地狱的各个层面，都能见到胡须魔残忍地放纵来自邪恶炼狱领主的任性命令；它们肆意散播谋杀、悲惨与痛苦，并为此欢欣鼓舞。

作为腐化的大师与征服的设计者，魔鬼既试图引诱凡俗生命加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也试图将暴政散播到诸世界。它们向凡人提供的诱惑多种多样：从签署炼狱契约而获赐的强大力量，到对某位恶魔化主君耳语誓言后换来的扭曲恩惠，乃至更多更为隐晦的交换。那些屈从于这些诱惑的人，会发现自己被发配到地狱深坑中无尽折磨的来世；在那里，唯一的逃脱希望在于有机会被擢升，成为炼狱序列中的一名魔鬼。每一名魔鬼在这台名为地狱的冷酷官僚机器中都有其特定职能，从士兵与学者，到审判官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的莱墨瑞与小魔鬼为更强大、更专业的魔鬼从事卑下劳役，例如契约魔鬼与埃里倪厄斯；而最强大的深坑魔鬼则命令术整支炼狱大军。

Barbazus, known also as bearded devils or infantry devils, are murderous fiends who satiate their lust for annihilation by serving as the foot soldiers of Hell's armies, often leading hordes of lesser devils such as imps and lemures into battle. Bearded devils wield serrated glaives to inflict jagged gashes that resist healing magic, resulting in tremendous blood loss. When enemies come too close, bearded devils strike with the spines of their wriggling beards to deliver a wretched contagion called Avernal fever, savoring the sight of their victim's strength being slowly devoured from within.

Barbazus can be found savagely indulging the whims of evil infernal lords from all layers of Hell, rejoicing as they disseminate murder, misery, and anguish as they see fit.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.

Barbazus can be found savagely indulging the whims of evil infernal lords from all layers of Hell, rejoicing as they disseminate murder, misery, and anguish as they see fit.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.
Barbazu Drill Sergeant.senses: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Barbazu Drill Sergeant.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic
Barbazu Drill Sergeant.prototypeToken: 胡须魔操练军士 Barbazu Drill Sergeant

Barcumbuk.name: 巴坎布克 Barcumbuk

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

True Seeing (Constant).name: 真视术（恒定） True Seeing (Constant)
True Seeing (Constant).description:
你能如其实际般看见60尺内的事物。GM会针对区域内的任何幻术或变化系效果进行一次秘密的反制检定掷骰，但仅用于确定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功反制一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
开启一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会把另一名生物一同带去——即使你正将其装在异次元容器中携带——该法术失效。

高度强化（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要看见目的地，只要你过去去过那里并知晓其相对位置以及与你之间的距离即可。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持有的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、在射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会将另一个生物一同带过去——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里——该法术失效。

增幅（5环） 射程增加到1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你曾去过那里，并且知道其相对于你的位置与距离即可。你获得持续1小时的暂时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你引导神力的狂怒对抗你的敌人。你对区域内的敌人造成4d10灵魂伤害，具体取决于其强韧豁免结果。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大成功或大失败 该生物承受全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}；当它处于恶心状态时，它也会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Retributive Pain.name: 惩戒之痛 Retributive Pain
Retributive Pain.description:
触发 射程内的一名生物对你造成伤害。

你满怀复仇之意，将痛苦反射给折磨你的人。目标受到精神伤害，数值等于其在触发该法术时对你造成伤害的一半。

Trigger A creature in range damages you.

You vengefully reflect your pain upon your tormentor. The target takes mental damage equal to half the amount it dealt to you when it triggered the spell.

Fear (At Will).name: 恐惧术（意志） Fear (At Will)
Fear (At Will).description:
你对目标施加恐惧术；其必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: 幻象伪装（随意） Illusory Disguise (At Will)
Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
你创造一个幻术，使你看起来像另一只体型相同的生物，且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）与你大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件裙子。手持物品不受影响，而你取下的任何穿戴物品会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 用途进行伪装设置；它无视你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你 +4 状态加值，用于进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装；并且即使你未受训，也要将你的等级加到该检定中。你可以解消此法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能呈现其外貌。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Illusory Object.name: 幻象物品 Illusory Object
Illusory Object.description:
你创造出一个静止物体的虚假视觉影像。整个影像必须能容纳于该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然地活动，但它不会发出声音或产生气味。例如，水看起来会从一条虚假的瀑布中倾泻而下，但会是无声的。

任何接触该影像或使用搜寻动作来检查它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻术。

升阶（2环） 你的影像会发出恰当的声音，产生正常的气味，并且接触起来的感觉也正确。该法术获得听觉（特征）。持续时间增加至1小时。

升阶（5环） 如2环版本，但持续时间为无限。

You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory trait. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.

Infernal Pact.name: 地狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，要求它将其部分下属束缚为你效力。如果你成功，魔鬼会派遣它所挑选的：一名魔鬼，其等级不高于地狱契约阶级的两倍；或两名魔鬼，其等级各自都至少比该法术阶级两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，其等级各自都至少比该法术阶级两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效力[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效力[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，这位强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦之意传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Light Hammer.name: 光亮术锤子 Light Hammer
Light Hammer.description:
这种较小版本的+1 战锤拥有木制或金属制的柄杆，末端是一颗金属锤头。与更重的同类不同，它足够轻，可以投掷。

This smaller version of the warhammer has a wooden or metal shaft ending in a metal head. Unlike its heavier cousin, it is light enough to throw.

Warhammer.name: +1 战锤 Warhammer
Warhammer.description:
这把武器有一根木制握柄，末端连接着一个巨大而沉重的金属锤头。锤头可能是单面或双面的，但总能施加强力的钝击。

This weapon has a wooden shaft ending in a large, heavy metal head. The head of the hammer might be single-sided or double-sided, but it's always capable of delivering powerful bludgeoning blows.

Breastplate.name: 胸甲 Breastplate
Breastplate.description:
尽管被称为胸甲，这种护甲由数块板甲或半身板甲护甲组成，可保护躯干、胸部、颈部，有时还包括髋部和小腿。它在策略性地提供部分板甲防护的同时，允许更高的灵活性和速度。

Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

100 feet of Erinys-Hair Rope.name: 100尺狂怒魔发绳 100 feet of Erinys-Hair Rope

Fragment of Urevian's Pendant.name: 乌瑞维安的坠饰碎片 Fragment of Urevian's Pendant

Flaming Warhammer.name: 炽焰 +1 战锤 Flaming Warhammer

Flaming Light Hammer.name: 炽焰光亮术战锤 Flaming Light Hammer

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Flames of Fury.name: 火焰之怒 Flames of Fury
Flames of Fury.description:
狂怒魔持握的任何武器在其持握期间获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming}符文的效果。

Any weapon an erinys holds gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming} rune while they hold it.

Furious Fusillade.name: 狂怒齐射 Furious Fusillade
Furious Fusillade.description:
如果狂怒魔正在飞行，则其悬停在原地，并向@Template[cone|distance:30]内任意数量的生物各射出一支箭。每次攻击分别掷骰。就狂怒魔的多重攻击减值而言，这算作一次攻击。

The erinys hovers in place if they are flying and fires one arrow at any number of creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Each attack is rolled separately. This counts as one attack for the purpose of the erinys's multiple attack penalty.

Rope Snare.name: 绳索套索 Rope Snare
Rope Snare.description:
一只狂怒魔携带着一卷用其头发编织的绳索（使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}的数据），这绳索在其手中会自行活动。

当一个生物被狂怒魔的绳索击中时，绳索的一段会撕裂脱落并缠绕在该生物身上，使其速度承受10尺的环境减值。脱落的那段对中型或更小体型的生物而言为10尺长，且体型每比中型大一级，其长度便翻倍。

当一个生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}该效果（DC 26）时，已脱离的那段绳索会枯萎并化为无用的黑色淤泥。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.o0zqsH5kYopRanav]{Effect: Rope Snare}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}

An erinys carries a coil of rope woven of their hair (use the statistics for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}) that animates in their hands.

When a creature is hit by the erinys's rope, a segment of the rope tears loose and wraps itself around the creature, imposing a 10-foot circumstance penalty to Speed. The piece that tears off is 10 feet long for a Medium or smaller creature, and doubles in length for each size larger than Medium.

When a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.o0zqsH5kYopRanav]{Effect: Rope Snare} the effect (DC 26), the detached segment of rope withers away into useless black sludge.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}

Barcumbuk.publicNotes:
狂怒魔会对生物的罪行施以精确的复仇与血腥的正义，在允许他们以死亡作为逃脱之前，以讽刺的方式折磨并惩罚其受害者。尽管狂怒魔看起来像堕落天使，而最初的狂怒魔也确实源于此，现今的狂怒魔却以多种方式诞生：有的由较低等的魔鬼擢升而来，有的则由由拷问者与迫害者之魂铸成的蛆魔本身塑造而成。狂怒魔的起源与艾塞丝紧密交织——她同样是堕落天使，也是地狱最强大的半神之一。最初的狂怒魔都被视为艾塞丝的隐喻之女，但自那一时代以来形成的狂怒魔已不再局限于单一性别。

作为腐化的大师与征服的设计者，魔鬼既追求诱使凡俗生命加入他们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也追求将暴政散播到所有世界。他们向凡人提供的诱惑多种多样，从签署地狱契约而被赐予的强大力量，到对某位魔鬼庇护者的低语誓言之后所换来的扭曲恩惠，乃至更多更为微妙的交换。屈服于这些诱惑之人，将发现自己被判入地狱深坑，在无尽折磨的来世中受苦；其中唯一的逃脱希望，便是有机会被擢升，成为地狱序列中的一名魔鬼。每个魔鬼在那名为地狱的冷酷官僚机器的维系中都有其特定职责，从士兵与学者，到审问官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的蛆魔与小魔鬼为更强大、更专业的魔鬼从事服役劳动，例如契约魔鬼与狂怒魔；而最强大的深渊魔则能命令整支地狱军团。

Erinyes exact vengeance and bloody justice for a creature's crimes, torturing and punishing their victims in ironic fashion before allowing them the escape of death. While an erinys appears as a fallen angel and the first erinyes shared that origin, erinyes now originate in myriad ways, some promoted from lesser devils and others shaped from lemures themselves forged from the souls of torturers and persecutors. The erinyes' origin is entwined with Eiseth, herself a fallen angel and one of Hell's most powerful demigods. The first erinyes were all considered to be Eiseth's metaphorical daughters, but erinyes formed since that time are no longer limited to a single gender.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.
Barcumbuk.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Cynemi.name: 西涅米 Cynemi

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这种皮革护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加上小型金属板，在保留皮革护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Manacles (Simple).name: 镣铐（简易） Manacles (Simple)
Manacles (Simple).description:
你可以将镣铐铐在愿意配合的人身上，或是以其他方式将其置于任你摆布的境地；这是一项探索行动，耗时10—30秒，取决于生物的体型以及你施加了多少副镣铐。一只双足生物若其腿被束缚，其速度承受-15英尺的环境减值；一只双手生物若其手腕被束缚，则每当它使用一个操作行动时都必须在一次@Check[flat|dc:5]中成功，否则该行动失败。根据镣铐对双手的束缚有多紧，此DC可能更高。被束缚在固定物体上的生物处于定身状态。对于肢体更多或更少的生物，GM决定镣铐是否会产生任何效果，以及会产生何种效果。将生物从简易镣铐中解救出来需要三次成功的@Check[thievery|dc:22|traits:action:pick-a-lock]检定。

You can manacle someone who is willing or otherwise at your mercy as an exploration activity taking 10-30 seconds depending on the creature's size and how many manacles you apply. A two-legged creature with its legs bound takes a -15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds, and a two-handed creature with its wrists bound has to succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] any time it uses a manipulate action or else that action fails. This DC may be higher depending on how tightly the manacles constrain the hands. A creature bound to a stationary object is immobilized. For creatures with more or fewer limbs, the GM determines what effect manacles have, if any. Freeing a creature from simple manacles requires three successful @Check[thievery|dc:22|traits:action:pick-a-lock] checks.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Hunt Prey.name: 猎杀目标 Hunt Prey
Hunt Prey.description:
赏金猎人指定一个他们能看见且听见的生物，或一个他们正在追踪的生物，作为他们的猎物。赏金猎人获得+2环境加值用于进行察觉检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}该猎物，以及用于进行生存检定以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track}该猎物。此效果持续到赏金猎人再次使用猎杀目标为止。

The bounty hunter designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The bounty hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} the prey and to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} the prey. This effect lasts until the bounty hunter uses Hunt Prey again.

Precision Edge.name: 精准优势 Precision Edge
Precision Edge.description:
每轮中，赏金猎人第一次命中其被猎捕的猎物时，会额外造成 1d8 精确伤害。

The first time the bounty hunter hits their hunted prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage.

Running Reload.name: 移动装填 Running Reload
Running Reload.description:
赏金猎人跨步、快步或潜行，然后交互以装填。

The bounty hunter Strides, Steps, or Sneaks, and then Interacts to reload.

Cynemi.publicNotes:
赏金猎人总是在路上奔波，无论是在城墙之内还是在荒野之中，都在追踪他们逃亡的猎物以将其抓捕……或是处置。赏金猎人往往同样依赖潜行或欺诈与武艺，并运用种类繁多的才干来达成他们的目标，更别提在事后收取那笔丰厚的酬金。

一个涵盖广泛的类别，包括那些挥舞武器、施展法术，甚至运用诡计与狡黠的人，雇佣兵将他们自身与其专长出卖给付得起钱的人。

Bounty hunters are constantly on the move, whether within city walls or the wilderness, trailing their fugitive quarries for capture... or disposal. Often relying on stealth or deception as much as martial skill, bounty hunters employ a vast array of talents to accomplish their goals, not to mention to collect the hefty payout that follows.

A broad category that includes those wielding arms, spells, or even guile and cunning, mercenaries hire themselves and their expertise to those with the gold to pay for it.

Erinys.name: 狂怒魔 Erinys

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

True Seeing (Constant).name: 真视术（恒定） True Seeing (Constant)
True Seeing (Constant).description:
你能看见60英尺内的事物如其真实所是。GM会针对区域内的任何幻术或变化效果暗中进行一次反制检定，但仅用于决定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功反制了一个变形法术，你可以看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你所穿戴和持有的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一名生物一并带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术会失效。

强化（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立即将你自己以及你穿戴和持握的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且在射程内的一处空旷空间。若这会让另一名生物与你一同前往——即使你正将其携带在一个异次元容器中——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的方位与距离即可。你在1小时内暂时免疫。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你引导神性的狂怒对抗你的敌人。你对区域内的敌人造成4d10点灵魂伤害，取决于它们的强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大成功或大失败该生物受到全部伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}；在它恶心期间，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Retributive Pain.name: 报应之痛 Retributive Pain
Retributive Pain.description:
触发 射程内的一名生物对你造成伤害。

你怀着复仇之心，将痛苦反射给折磨你的人。目标受到等同于其在触发该法术时对你造成伤害的一半的精神伤害。

Trigger A creature in range damages you.

You vengefully reflect your pain upon your tormentor. The target takes mental damage equal to half the amount it dealt to you when it triggered the spell.

Fear (At Will).name: 恐惧术（意志） Fear (At Will)
Fear (At Will).description:
你对目标施放恐惧术；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你可以以最多五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: 幻象伪装（随意） Illusory Disguise (At Will)
Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
你制造一个幻觉，使你看起来像是另一种体型相同的生物，并且与你的身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而你移除的任何穿戴物品会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 用法进行伪装准备；它会忽略你因将自己伪装成不相似的生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值，用于进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装，并且即使你未受训也要加上你的等级。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环）该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）。

升阶（3环）你可以看起来像是任意同体型的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能呈现其外貌。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Illusory Object.name: 幻象物品 Illusory Object
Illusory Object.description:
你创造一个静止物体的虚假视觉影像。整个影像必须完全容纳在该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然地活动，但它不会发出声音或产生气味。例如，水看起来会沿着一条虚幻的瀑布倾泻而下，但会是无声的。

任何接触该影像的生物，或使用搜寻动作来检查它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻觉。

升阶（2环） 你的影像会发出恰当的声音，产生正常的气味，并且接触起来感觉正确。该法术获得听觉（特征）。持续时间增加为1小时。

升阶（5环） 同2环版本，但持续时间为无限。

You create an illusory visual image of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, water would appear to pour down an illusory waterfall, but it would be silent.

Any creature that touches the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your image makes appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory trait. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼发出恳求，请它将其部分下属束缚为你服务。若你成功，魔鬼会派出它所选择的：1个魔鬼，其等级不超过地狱契约阶位的两倍；或2个魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比该法术阶位的两倍低2；或3个魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比该法术阶位的两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 你的提出请求不仅被拒绝，这位强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦之情传达给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Composite Longbow.name: 复合长弓 Composite Longbow
Composite Longbow.description:
这种投射武器由角、木材和筋腱层压制成，以增强其拉力的威力和投射物的冲击力。与所有长弓一样，其巨大的体型也提高了弓的射程和威力。你必须用双手才能发射它，并且在骑乘时无法使用。任何明确限定为仅适用于长弓的能力（例如埃拉斯蒂尔的偏好武器），除非另有说明，也同样适用于复合长弓。

This projectile weapon is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Like all longbows, its great size also increases the bow's range and power. You must use two hands to fire it, and it cannot be used while mounted. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a longbow, such as Erastil's favored weapon, it also applies to composite longbows unless otherwise stated.

Longsword.name: 长剑 Longsword
Longsword.description:
长剑可以是单刃或双刃的剑。它们的剑刃很重，长度在3到4英尺之间。

Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

Breastplate.name: 胸甲 Breastplate
Breastplate.description:
虽然被称为胸甲，这种护甲由数块板甲或半身板甲组成，可保护躯干、胸部、颈部，有时也保护髋部和小腿。它在策略上提供了部分板甲的防护，同时允许更高的灵活性与速度。

Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

100 feet of Erinys-Hair Rope.name: 100英尺狂怒魔毛发绳 100 feet of Erinys-Hair Rope

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭矢的杆身由木头制成。它在飞行时由一端的箭羽稳定，并在另一端带有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Flaming Composite Longbow.name: 烈焰复合长弓 Flaming Composite Longbow

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Flames of Fury.name: 火焰之怒 Flames of Fury
Flames of Fury.description:
狂怒魔持有的任何武器在其持有期间获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming}符文的效果。

Any weapon an erinys holds gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming} rune while they hold it.

Furious Fusillade.name: 狂怒齐射 Furious Fusillade
Furious Fusillade.description:
狂怒魔若在飞行则悬停于原地，并向位于 @Template[cone|distance:30] 内的任意数量的生物各射出一支箭。每次攻击分别进行投掷。就狂怒魔的多重攻击减值而言，这视为一次攻击。

The erinys hovers in place if they are flying and fires one arrow at any number of creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Each attack is rolled separately. This counts as one attack for the purpose of the erinys's multiple attack penalty.

Rope Snare.name: 绳索套索陷阱 Rope Snare
Rope Snare.description:
狂怒魔携带一圈用其头发编织的绳索（使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}的统计数据），在其手中会自行活动。

当一个生物被狂怒魔的绳索击中时，绳索的一段会撕裂脱落并缠绕在该生物身上，使其速度受到10英尺的环境减值。对中型或更小的生物而言，撕裂下来的部分长10英尺；每比中型大一个体型，其长度就翻倍。

当一个生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}该效果（DC 26）时，脱落的那段绳索会枯萎成无用的黑色污泥。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.o0zqsH5kYopRanav]{Effect: Rope Snare}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}

An erinys carries a coil of rope woven of their hair (use the statistics for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escapes}) that animates in their hands.

When a creature is hit by the erinys's rope, a segment of the rope tears loose and wraps itself around the creature, imposing a 10-foot circumstance penalty to Speed. The piece that tears off is 10 feet long for a Medium or smaller creature, and doubles in length for each size larger than Medium.

When a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.o0zqsH5kYopRanav]{Effect: Rope Snare} the effect (DC 26), the detached segment of rope withers away into useless black sludge.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fyYnQf1NAx9fWFaS]{Rope}

Erinys.publicNotes:
狂怒魔会为生物的罪行施以精确的复仇与血腥的正义，在允许其以死亡来逃脱之前，以讽刺的方式折磨并惩罚其受害者。尽管狂怒魔看起来像堕落天使，而最初的狂怒魔也确实源于此，但如今狂怒魔的起源多种多样：有些由低等魔鬼晋升而来，有些则由泥魔——这些泥魔本身是由拷问者与迫害者的灵魂锻造而成——塑造而出。狂怒魔的起源与艾瑟丝纠缠在一起；她同样是堕落天使，也是地狱中最强大的半神之一。最初的狂怒魔都被视为艾瑟丝隐喻性的女儿，但自那时以来形成的狂怒魔已不再局限于单一性别。

作为腐化的大师与征服的设计者，魔鬼既试图诱使凡人生命加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也试图将暴政散播至所有世界。它们向凡人提供的诱惑从签署地狱契约而获得的强大力量，到对某位魔鬼庇护者的低语誓言之后所换来的扭曲恩惠，或无数更加微妙的交换。屈服于这些诱惑者，会发现自己被判入地狱深坑中无尽折磨的来世；在那里，唯一的逃脱希望在于获得晋升机会，成为地狱序列中的一名魔鬼。每一名魔鬼在这台名为地狱、冷酷无情的官僚机器的运转维护中都扮演着特定角色：从士兵与学者，到审判官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑微的泥魔与小魔鬼为更强大且更专业的魔鬼执行卑下劳役，例如契约魔鬼与狂怒魔；而最强大的深渊魔则以命令术统率整支地狱军团。

Erinyes exact vengeance and bloody justice for a creature's crimes, torturing and punishing their victims in ironic fashion before allowing them the escape of death. While an erinys appears as a fallen angel and the first erinyes shared that origin, erinyes now originate in myriad ways, some promoted from lesser devils and others shaped from lemures themselves forged from the souls of torturers and persecutors. The erinyes' origin is entwined with Eiseth, herself a fallen angel and one of Hell's most powerful demigods. The first erinyes were all considered to be Eiseth's metaphorical daughters, but erinyes formed since that time are no longer limited to a single gender.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.
Erinys.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Pus Burst.name: 脓液爆发 Pus Burst
Pus Burst.description:
触发 伏行巨手受到穿刺或挥砍伤害

效果 与伏行巨手相邻的一名随机生物被喷溅上恶臭脓液，受到 @Damage[4d6[void]] 伤害。受影响的生物必须尝试一次 @Check[reflex|dc:21] 豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受伤害。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

大成功或大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，并变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}。

Trigger The giant crawling hand takes piercing or slashing damage

Effect A random creature adjacent to the giant crawling hand is sprayed with vile pus that deals @Damage[4d6[void]] damage. The affected creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3}.

Mark Quarry.name: 马克·夸里 Mark Quarry
Mark Quarry.description:
你可以通过用预定猎物的一滴血为爬行之手涂抹，从而为其指定一个猎物。如果这只手在任何时候没有猎物，它会自动将其下一次造成伤害的生物作为其猎物。当这只手对其猎物执行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks}时，它的察觉检定获得+1环境加值；当它对其猎物执行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks}时，它的生存检定获得+1环境加值；当它打击其猎物时，它的伤害掷骰获得+1环境加值。

A crawling hand can be assigned a quarry by anointing the hand with a drop of the intended quarry's blood. If the hand ever has no quarry, it automatically gains the next creature it damages as its quarry. The hand gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seeks} its quarry, to Survival checks when it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Tracks} its quarry, and damage rolls when it Strikes its quarry.

Giant Crawling Hand.publicNotes:
伏行巨手是一种极其巨大的生物的肢体，例如巨人。

通常，伏行巨手是在被切断的肢体被邪恶的死灵能量赋予粗浅的感知后形成的，这些能量会将它们变成不知疲倦的杀手。然而，伏行巨手也可能自发出现，通常发生在生物在死灵能量充斥之地，或在与虚空有联系的地方失去肢体时。

A giant crawling hand is the appendage of a very large creature, such as a giant.

Typically, crawling hands are formed when severed appendages are endowed with a crude sentience by evil necromantic energies that turn them into tireless killers. Yet crawling hands can also arise spontaneously, usually when a creature loses an appendage in a place rife with necromantic energy or with a connection to the Void.
Giant Crawling Hand.prototypeToken: 伏行巨手 Giant Crawling Hand

Gibtanius.name: 狂跳跳 Gibtanius

Powerful Stench.name: 强烈恶臭 Powerful Stench
Powerful Stench.description:
20英尺。进入该灵光的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免。若失败，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}；若大失败，该生物还会在其恶心期间获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

豁免成功的生物获得1分钟的暂时免疫。

20 feet. A creature that enters the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; on a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for as long as it is sickened.

A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Bouncing Crush.name: 弹跳猛冲 Bouncing Crush
Bouncing Crush.description:
狂跳跳跳跃，并且可以在结束这次跳跃时占据与其他生物相同的空间。

它对其跳跃到的空间内每个生物造成 @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] 豁免），然后对每个生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoves}。如果它未能将任何生物推撞出其空间，它会弹跳到其选择的最近的可用空间，该空间不包含任何生物。

弹跳猛冲在决定狂跳跳的多重攻击减值时算作一次攻击。

The gibtanius Leaps and can end this Leap occupying the same space as other creatures.

It deals @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage to each creature in the space it Leaps to (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save), then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoves} each of those creatures. If it fails to Shove any creature out of its space, it bounces to the closest available space of its choosing that does not contain any creatures.

Bouncing Crush counts as one attack when determining the gibtanius's multiple attack penalty.

Breath Weapon.name: 吐息 Breath Weapon
Breath Weapon.description:
狂跳跳呕吐出一股酸液洪流，对@Template[line|distance:60]内的所有生物造成@Damage[9d6[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

它在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4轮}内无法再次使用吐息。

The gibtanius vomits a stream of acid that deals @Damage[9d6[acid]] damage to all creatures in a @Template[line|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save).

It can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

Gibtanius.publicNotes:
当一只跳跳规律进食，却始终得不到足以繁衍的食物时，它会成长为强大的狂跳跳。它们会变得乖戾、失控的掠食者，抛弃与之缔结羁绊的主人，以满足其永无止境的饥饿。

这种橡胶般的球形食腐生物几乎全是一张滴落酸液的巨口，长着五只鼓胀的黑色眼睛和两条强壮、细长的腿。跳跳常与单一的另一只生物——通常是更强大的畸变生物——缔结羁绊，并以忠诚却不时失控的方式侍奉该主人。把跳跳当作宠物或守卫饲养的生物很快就会学会：要让它远离任何他们不想被酸液溅得满是斑点的重要占据术。

When a gibtas feeds regularly but never receives sufficient food to procreate, it grows into a mighty gibtanius. They become surly, uncontrolled predators, forsaking their bonded masters to satiate their unending hunger.

This rubbery, spheroid scavenger is nearly all acid-dripping mouth, with five bulbous black eyes and two powerful, gangly legs. A gibtas often forms a bond with a single other creature-usually, a more powerful aberration- and serves this master loyally, if erratically. Creatures who keep a gibtas as a pet or guard soon learn to keep it away from any important possessions they don't want spattered with acid.

Gug.name: 古格巨人 Gug

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Eerie Flexibility.name: 诡异弹性 Eerie Flexibility
Eerie Flexibility.description:
尽管体型庞大，古格巨人的多个关节使其能够像中型生物一样穿过狭窄空间。进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing} 时，它可以以其完整的速度移动。

Despite its size, the gug's multiple joints allow it to fit through tight spaces as if it were a Medium creature. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeezing}, it can move at its full Speed.

Furious Claws.name: 狂怒之爪 Furious Claws
Furious Claws.description:
古格巨人至多进行四次爪子打击，每次分别针对不同的目标。这些攻击都计入古格巨人的多重攻击减值，但在古格巨人完成所有攻击之前，该减值不会增加。

The gug makes up to four claw Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks all count toward the gug's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gug makes all its attacks.

Gug.publicNotes:
古格巨人最骇人的特征是它那桶状的头颅——头颅会纵向裂开，露出一排排锋利的黄色牙齿与敞开的喉咙。它的眼睛位于头颌两侧，虽小却敏锐。骨质脊棱保护着它的眼睛，使其不至于在猎物疯狂挣扎挥舞时受伤；相较于真菌与霉菌，它更偏好生食尚在蠕动的鲜肉。它用强健的手臂钳制猎物，而手臂在肘部会分裂成一对前臂，使其拥有四只带爪的兽足。这些怪物般的蛮横巨兽全身覆盖着蓬乱的黑色长毛，常常结着干涸的血污与碎肉。

尽管古格巨人看似野兽，它们却拥有敏锐而邪恶的智识。古格巨人栖身于深邃的地下，但有时会在黑暗的夜里上到地表狩猎，或单独行动，或结成小群。由于它们食欲极其旺盛，大多数古格巨人会吞食自己抓到的生物；但也有一些会绑走受害者并退回地底，只留下挥之不去的恶臭与古怪的爪足印。受害者会被带到腐臭的巢穴中——那里刻着诡异的符文——并被献祭给古格巨人那些嗜血、黑暗与梦魇术的邪恶神祇。可怕的流言称，在极深的地下有无光的古格巨人城市，由巨大的石块垒成；在那里，强大的古格巨人首领向嚎叫的古格巨人群众宣讲其卑劣教义。

古格巨人与食尸鬼之间有种奇特的关系，似乎可追溯至它们同源于某个遥远的地下世界。古格巨人畏惧食尸鬼，尽管它们的身形远远高于后者；然而，这种古怪的恐惧并不适用于食尸鬼妖，古格巨人会像吞食其他生物一样贪婪地吞食它们。

古格巨人高达16英尺，重达2,000磅；然而，它们的步态却诡异而优雅，与其庞大体型极不相称。它们轻盈的脚步以及挤入空间穿过极狭小缝隙的能力，使古格巨人成为许多离奇失踪或血腥屠杀传说中常见的“床下怪物”。

某些尤其嗜血的古格巨人会从其诡秘的庇护者那里获得可怖的力量作为赋礼。这些怪物被称为“贤者”，其力量从不低于第12等级，并会获得数个奥术天生法术。尽管每名贤者所拥有的法术组合各不相同，但通常而言，这些法术能授予隐形术、赋予其操纵并改变岩石的力量，或将可怖而具毁灭性的能量施加于活体血肉之上。

A gug's most horrid feature is its barrel-shaped head, which splits vertically to reveal numerous rows of sharp, yellow teeth and an open throat. Its eyes on either side of its head-jaw are small but keen. Bony ridges protect its eyes from the frantic flailing of its prey, as it prefers meals of raw and writhing meat over fungi and molds. It grips said prey with powerful arms that split at the elbow into a pair of forearms, giving it four clawed paws. These monstrous brutes are covered with shaggy black fur, often crusted with blood and gore.

Although gugs may seem bestial, they have keen and wicked intellects. Gugs lair far underground, but they sometimes come to the surface to hunt during dark nights, either alone or in small groups. As they possess voracious appetites, most gugs consume the creatures they catch, but some instead kidnap their victims and retreat below the surface, leaving only a lingering stench and odd, clawed paw-prints. Victims are taken to rancid lairs marked with strange runes and sacrificed to the gugs' wicked gods of blood, darkness, and nightmares. Dire rumors tell of lightless gug cities made of titanic blocks of stone far underground, where powerful gug leaders preach their vile doctrines to mobs of howling gugs.

Gugs have a strange relationship with ghouls, which seems to date from their shared origin in a distant subterranean world. Gugs live in fear of ghouls, despite towering over them; however, this strange fear doesn't apply to ghasts, whom gugs consume as voraciously as they do other creatures.

Gugs stand 16 feet tall and weigh 2,000 pounds, although they have an eerie, graceful gait that belies their immense size. Their light step and ability to squeeze through very small crannies makes gugs common bogeymen in tales of strange disappearances or bloody massacres.

Some particularly bloodthirsty gugs gain awful powers as gifts from their eldritch patrons. These monsters are known as savants, are never less than 12th level in power, and gain several occult innate spells. Though each savant's precise mix of spells varies, normally, these spells grant invisibility, offer power to manipulate and change rock, or invoke awful and destructive energies upon living flesh.

Hellforge Barbazu.name: 地狱熔炉 胡须魔 Hellforge Barbazu

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你所穿戴和持有的任何物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的射程内一处空旷的空间中。若这会将另一名生物一同带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术会失去。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见、位于射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一个生物也一并带上——即使你正把它装在异次元容器里携带——则该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去去过那里并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，请求它将其一些下属束缚为你效劳。若你成功，该魔鬼会派遣它所选择的以下之一：一名等级不高于地狱契约阶位两倍的魔鬼；两名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低3。

大成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，而且强大的魔鬼还会传话给你的主人，表达它的不悦。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

+1 Flaming Striking Hellforged Glaive.name: +1 炽焰 强力 炼狱锻造 长柄刀 +1 Flaming Striking Hellforged Glaive
+1 Flaming Striking Hellforged Glaive.description:
这件长柄武器由一根7英尺长的长杆末端安装的一把长的单刃刀身构成。它在远距离挥出致命斩击方面极为有效。

This polearm consists of a long, single-edged blade on the end of a 7-foot pole. It is extremely effective at delivering lethal cuts at a distance.

Flaming Hellforged Glaive.name: 炽焰狱铸长柄刀 Flaming Hellforged Glaive

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Avernal Fever.name: 炼狱热病 Avernal Fever
Avernal Fever.description:
豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:23]

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1 天）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}（1 天）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}（1 天）

Infernal Wound.name: 地狱创伤 Infernal Wound
Infernal Wound.description:
髯魔的长柄刀打击还会造成 @Damage[1d6[bleed]]，且该流血抗拒对其进行治疗的尝试。

停止流血的纯骰检定从 @Check[flat|dc:20] 开始。只有当流血的生物或一名盟友成功援助其恢复时，DC 才会降低至 @Check[flat|dc:15]。对具有地狱创伤的生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} 的 DC 增加 5。

试图对正遭受地狱创伤的生物使用治疗魔法的施法者或物品必须在 DC 21 的反制检定中成功，否则该魔法无法治疗该生物。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{Effect: Infernal Wound}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}

A bearded devil's glaive Strike also deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] that resists attempts to heal it.

The flat check to stop the bleeding starts at @Check[flat|dc:20]. The DC is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:15] only if the bleeding creature or an ally successfully assists with the recovery. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{Effect: Infernal Wound} to a creature with an infernal wound is increased by 5.

A spellcaster or item attempting to use healing magic on a creature suffering from an infernal wound must succeed at a DC 21 counteract check or the magic fails to heal the creature.

Reposition.name: 重新定位 Reposition
Reposition.description:
触发 恶魔用长柄刀打击命中一个生物。

效果 恶魔将该生物向任意方向移动5尺。目的方格必须在恶魔的长柄刀触及范围内。

此移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Trigger The devil hits a creature with a glaive Strike.

Effect The devil moves the creature 5 feet in any direction. The destination square must be within reach of the devil's glaive.

This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Wriggling Beard.name: 蠕动胡须 Wriggling Beard
Wriggling Beard.description:
频率 每轮一次。

效果 胡须魔进行一次胡须打击。此次打击无视其多重攻击减值，且不计入该减值。

Frequency once per round.

Effect The barbazu makes a beard Strike. This Strike ignores their multiple attack penalty and doesn't count toward that penalty.

Hellforge Barbazu.publicNotes:
胡须魔，也被称为有胡子的魔鬼或步兵魔鬼，是嗜杀的邪魔，它们通过作为地狱军队的步兵来满足自己对毁灭的渴望，常常率领成群更低等的魔鬼，如小魔鬼与勒缪尔，投入战斗。有胡子的魔鬼挥舞带锯齿的长柄刀，造成参差不齐的裂创，使其难以通过治疗魔法愈合，从而导致惊人的失血。当敌人靠得太近时，有胡子的魔鬼会用其蠕动胡须上的尖刺打击，传播一种名为阿弗纳尔热的可憎传染病，并陶醉于目睹受害者的力量从体内被缓慢吞噬的景象。

胡须魔可以被发现正残忍地放纵来自地狱各层的邪恶炼狱领主的任性，欢欣鼓舞地按其所愿散播谋杀、苦难与折磨。

作为腐化的大师与征服的缔造者，魔鬼既寻求诱惑凡人生命加入它们对一切亵渎之物的追逐，也寻求将暴政传播到所有世界。它们给予凡人的诱惑形式多样：从签署一份炼狱契约而被授予的巨大力量，到向某位恶魔般的庇护者低声许诺后得到的扭曲恩惠，或任何数量更为微妙的交换。那些屈服于这些诱惑的人，会发现自己被判往地狱深坑中无尽折磨的来世，在那里，唯一的逃脱希望在于有机会被擢升，成为炼狱序列中的一名魔鬼。每个魔鬼都在那台名为地狱、冷酷无情的官僚机器的运转中扮演特定角色——从士兵与学者，到审判官、律师、法官与刽子手。卑贱的勒缪尔与小魔鬼为更强大且更专业的魔鬼从事卑下劳役，例如契约魔鬼与艾琳耶，而最强大的深坑魔鬼则统率整支炼狱军团。

Barbazus, known also as bearded devils or infantry devils, are murderous fiends who satiate their lust for annihilation by serving as the foot soldiers of Hell's armies, often leading hordes of lesser devils such as imps and lemures into battle. Bearded devils wield serrated glaives to inflict jagged gashes that resist healing magic, resulting in tremendous blood loss. When enemies come too close, bearded devils strike with the spines of their wriggling beards to deliver a wretched contagion called Avernal fever, savoring the sight of their victim's strength being slowly devoured from within.

Barbazus can be found savagely indulging the whims of evil infernal lords from all layers of Hell, rejoicing as they disseminate murder, misery, and anguish as they see fit.

Masters of corruption and architects of conquest, devils seek both to tempt mortal life to join in their pursuit of all things profane and to spread tyranny throughout all worlds. The temptations they offer mortals range from great powers granted by the signing of an infernal contract to twisted favors following a whispered pledge to a diabolic patron, or any number of even subtler exchanges. Those who succumb to these temptations find themselves consigned to an afterlife of endless torment in the pits of Hell, wherein the only hope of escape lies in the chance of being promoted to become a devil in the infernal ranks. Every devil has a specific role to play in the upkeep of the remorseless bureaucratic machine that is Hell, from soldiers and scholars to inquisitors, lawyers, judges, and executioners. Lowly lemures and imps perform subservient labor to more powerful and specialized devils, such as contract devils and erinyes, while the greatest pit fiends command entire infernal armies.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将你自己以及你穿戴和持有的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间。若这会把另一名生物也一同带过去——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术失效。

升阶（5环） 射程提升至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
开启一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会瞬间将你自己以及你穿戴与持握的所有物品，从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且位于射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一名生物一同带来——即使你正将其装在一个异次元容器里——则该法术将失效。

强化（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道它相对于你的方位与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimensional Anchor.name: 次元锚定 Dimensional Anchor
Dimensional Anchor.description:
你干扰目标进行传送以及在次元之间旅行的能力。次元锚定会尝试反制任何传送效果，或任何会将目标移动到不同位面的效果。持续时间由目标的意志豁免决定。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 效果的持续时间为1分钟。

失败 效果的持续时间为10分钟。

大失败 效果的持续时间为1小时。

You interfere with the target's ability to teleport and travel between dimensions. Dimensional anchor attempts to counteract any teleportation effect, or any effect that would move the target to a different plane. The duration is determined by the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The effect's duration is 1 minute.

Failure The effect's duration is 10 minutes.

Critical Failure The effect's duration is 1 hour.

Discern Lies.name: 识破谎言 Discern Lies
Discern Lies.description:
谎言在你耳边如不协和的音符般回响。当有人说谎时，你的察觉检定获得+4状态加值。

Falsehoods ring in your ears like discordant notes. You gain a +4 status bonus to Perception checks when someone Lies.

Zone of Truth.name: 诚实领域 Zone of Truth
Zone of Truth.description:
你指定一片区域，其中的生物被迫只能讲真话。处于该区域内或进入该区域的生物会难以说谎。每个可能受影响的生物必须在法术施放时，或该生物第一次进入该区域时，尝试一次意志豁免。若它离开并再次进入该区域，则沿用这次初始豁免的结果。受影响的生物知晓此惑控系效果；因此，它们可以避免回答那些通常会以说谎作答的问题，或只要仍在真话的范围边界之内，就可以含糊其辞。

大成功或大失败：大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在欺瞒检定上承受-2状态减值。

失败 目标无法说出任何蓄意且有意识的谎言，并且在欺瞒检定上承受-2状态减值。

大成功或大失败：大失败 目标无法说出任何蓄意且有意识的谎言，并且在欺瞒检定上承受-4状态减值。

You designate an area in which creatures are compelled to speak only truth. Creatures within or entering the area have difficulty lying. Each potentially affected creature must attempt a Will save when the spell is cast or when the creature first enters the area. It uses the results of this initial save if it leaves and reenters the area. Affected creatures are aware of this enchantment; therefore, they can avoid answering questions to which they would normally respond with a lie, or they can be evasive as long as they remain within the boundaries of the truth.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks.

Failure The target can't speak any deliberate and intentional lies, and it takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks.

Critical Failure The target can't speak any deliberate and intentional lies and takes a -4 status penalty to Deception checks.

Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意）（仅自身） Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will) (Self Only).description:
披上幻术的遮蔽，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但不会因目标使用敌对动作而结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，恳求它将其部分下属束缚来为你效劳。若你成功，魔鬼会派出它所选择的：1名魔鬼，其等级不高于地狱契约阶位的2倍；或2名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比该法术阶位的2倍低2；或3名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比该法术阶位的2倍低3。

大成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4周}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你效劳[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4天}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大失败 不仅你的提出请求被拒绝，而且那位强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦之意传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害和1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。如果目标从恶心状态中恢复，持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{按等级的持续精神伤害}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Leveled Persistent Mental Damage}

Osyluth Venom.name: 骨魔之毒 Osyluth Venom
Osyluth Venom.description:
豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害以及虚弱 1（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}（1 轮）。一旦某个生物到达阶段 3，它在对抗试图 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} 它的意志豁免时承受 -4 状态减值，持续 1 小时（这是一个精神效果）

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round). Once a creature reaches stage 3, it takes a -4 status penalty to Will saves against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} it for 1 hour (this is a mental effect)

Quick Invisibility.name: 快速隐形术 Quick Invisibility
Quick Invisibility.description:
骨魔可以仅用1个动作施放先天@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}。

The osyluth can cast innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility} using only 1 action.

Sadistic Strike.name: 施虐打击 Sadistic Strike
Sadistic Strike.description:
骨魔在对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}状态的生物进行打击时，会额外造成2d6伤害。

An osyluth deals an extra 2d6 damage whenever they Strike an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} creature.

Stygian Inquisitor.name: 黄泉判官 Stygian Inquisitor
Stygian Inquisitor.description:
骨魔以心灵感应审问一个受 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth} 影响的生物。1 轮后，若该生物故意拒绝回答问题，则其受到 @Damage[2d6[mental]] 伤害。

The osyluth telepathically questions a creature affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aewxsale5xWEPKLk]{Ring of Truth}. After 1 round, if the creature intentionally refuses to answer the question, it takes @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage.

Tail Sweep.name: 尾扫 Tail Sweep
Tail Sweep.description:
骨魔横扫它的尾巴，形成一个 @Template[cone|distance:15]。锥形范围内的每个生物必须在一次 @Check[reflex|dc:26] 豁免中成功，否则会被击倒至 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。

The osyluth sweeps their tail in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. Each creature in the cone must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:26] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Iyagian.publicNotes:
骨魔是一种无与伦比的审讯官，沉溺于地狱所广为人知的施虐与酷刑。这些魔鬼的职责是搜寻异端，无论是在凡人之中，还是在其他邪魔之中——这条戒律他们以毫不动摇的狂热加以贯彻。它们诞生于地狱第五层——斯提吉亚——由冥河之水滋养的沼泽；在异端与异端者的灵魂停滞之处，骨魔终将崛起。在同一层地狱更偏远的角落里，它们建造巨大的、钙化的蜂巢，在其中进行卑劣的审讯，并在低阶魔鬼与祈求者身上不断磨练其酷刑技艺。

每一种魔鬼都在地狱的官僚体系与等级结构中扮演着特定角色，不过有些魔鬼的职能要比其他魔鬼专门得多

An osyluth is an unparalleled inquisitor that revels in the sadism and torture for which Hell is so well known. These devils' charge is to seek out heresies, both among mortals and among other fiends-a commandment they uphold with unwavering fervor. They spawn within the Styx-fed swamps of Hell's fifth layer, Stygia; where heresies and the souls of heretics stagnate, osyluths eventually rise. In the remote corners of that same layer of Hell, they build massive, calcified hives where they perform their vile interrogations and perfect their torturous arts upon lesser devils and petitioners alike.

Each type of devil plays a particular role in Hell's bureaucracies and hierarchies, though some have far more specialized functions than others
Iyagian.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Iyagian.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Steel Shield.name: 钢盾 Steel Shield
Steel Shield.description:
与木制盾牌类似，钢盾也有各种形状和体型。尽管比木制盾牌更昂贵，但它们要耐用得多。

硬度 HP BT
5 20 10

Like wooden shields, steel shields come in a variety of shapes and sizes. Though more expensive than wooden shields, they are much more durable.

Hardness HP BT
5 20 10

War Leader.name: 战争领袖 War Leader
War Leader.description:
钢皮魔人的热忱鼓舞其盟友。30英尺内能够看见或听见钢皮魔人的盟友，只要他们的动作不妨碍钢皮魔人被烙印的使命，就会在攻击掷骰与技能检定上获得+1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.64wrP9IbfHbj1mrA]{Effect: War Leader}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.64wrP9IbfHbj1mrA]{Effect: War Leader}

A mulventok's fervor inspires its allies. Allies within 30 feet that can see or hear the mulventok gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks as long as their actions don't impede the mulventok's imprinted purpose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.64wrP9IbfHbj1mrA]{Effect: War Leader}
