Explosive Decay.name: 腐朽爆炸 Explosive Decay
Explosive Decay.description:
当钢皮魔人死亡时，它镜面般的血肉会破裂并爆炸，形成一个@Template[burst|distance:20]{20英尺半径}的爆发。被爆炸波及的生物会被内脏覆盖，并受到@Damage[8d6[void]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic]豁免）。

When a mulventok dies, its mirrored flesh ruptures and explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-foot radius}. Creatures caught in the blast are covered with viscera and take @Damage[8d6[void]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

Stay in the Fight.name: 继续战斗 Stay in the Fight
Stay in the Fight.description:
触发 30尺内的一名盟友生物降至0 HP

效果 钢皮魔人传递自身的部分能量以让盟友继续战斗。目标生物获得@Damage[1[治疗]]生命值，而钢皮魔人承受@Damage[2d6[mental]]伤害。

Trigger An allied creature within 30 feet reaches 0 HP

Effect The mulventok imparts some of its own energy to keep the ally fighting. The target creature gains @Damage[1[healing]] Hit Point, and the mulventok takes @Damage[2d6[mental]] damage.

Fervent Command.name: 热情命令 Fervent Command
Fervent Command.description:
钢皮魔人向30尺内的一名盟友大声下达命令。该盟友立即执行一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield}或跨步动作。一名生物每轮只能从中受益一次。

The mulventok shouts an order to one of its allies within 30 feet. That ally immediately takes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} or Step action. A creature can benefit from only once per round.

Psychokinetic Honing.name: 精神折磨 Psychokinetic Honing
Psychokinetic Honing.description:
当钢皮魔人投掷一把投掷武器时，该武器获得一枚@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning}符文的效果。钢皮魔人使用的投掷武器造成额外的@Damage[1d6[mental]]伤害，无论用于近战还是投掷。

A thrown weapon gains the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning} rune when a mulventok throws it. Thrown weapons the mulventok uses deal an additional @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage, whether used in melee or thrown.

Mulventok.publicNotes:
阴险的塑肉者将被俘的透肌魔人重塑为这些战争巨兽。它们的透明皮肤被硬化成厚重、如镜面般的甲壳，形成令人胆寒的外骨骼。钢皮魔人的寿命不长；在数周——最多数月——之内，它们过度发达的肌肉会撑裂其强化的皮肤，继而在一阵血肉飞溅中爆裂而亡。钢皮魔人的创造者对其心智的塑造不亚于对其肉体的塑造，将其攻击性引导至单一目的，例如夷平一座要塞或谋杀某个特定个体。

将受害者扭曲成骇人形态是邪恶卓尔众所周知的消遣，但其他地下怪物也窃取了这些做法，或是独立发展出了它们。虫状的双尾虫怪有时会扭曲那些领地与其无光之地毗邻的其他生物；下述塑肉怪分别源自摩洛克与透肌魔人。

Sinister fleshwarpers reshape captive urdefhans into these juggernauts of war. Their clear skin is hardened into a thick, mirror-like carapace, creating an intimidating exoskeleton. Mulventoks don't live long; within weeks-or, at most, months-their hyperdeveloped muscles split open their toughened skin, and they erupt in a shower of gore. A mulventok's creator shapes its mind just as much as its body, directing its aggression toward a single purpose, such as to raze a fortress or murder a specific individual.

Although twisting victims into horrid shapes is a well-known pastime of evil drow, other subterranean monsters have stolen these practices or developed them independently. The worm-like seugathis sometimes warp other creatures whose territories abut their lightless lands; the fleshwarps below result from morlocks and urdefhans, respectively.

Sacuishu.name: 萨奎舒 Sacuishu

Divine Prepared Spells.name: 神圣预备法术 Divine Prepared Spells

Divine Wrath.name: 神圣狂怒 Divine Wrath
Divine Wrath.description:
你引导神性的狂怒对抗你的敌人。你对区域内的敌人造成 4d10 灵魂伤害，具体取决于它们的强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。

大成功或大失败 该生物承受全部伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}；在其恶心期间，它也获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d10。

You channel the fury of divinity against your foes. You deal 4d10 spirit damage to enemies in the area, depending on their Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}; while it's sickened, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Read Omens.name: 阅读机运 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在1周内从事的特定目标或行动，或一个你预计可能在1周内发生的事件。你会获知一条隐晦的线索或一段可能对所选事件有所帮助的忠告，通常以押韵诗句或征兆的形式出现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你致盲目标。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后该目标在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Chilling Darkness.name: 冻寒黑暗 Chilling Darkness
Chilling Darkness.description:
你射出一道极度寒冷的黑暗射线，带着一丝亵渎能量。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。你造成5d6寒冷伤害，若目标为天界生物，则额外造成5d6灵魂伤害。

如果射线穿过一片魔法光亮术区域，或以受魔法光亮术影响的生物为目标，冻寒黑暗会尝试反制该光亮术。若你需要判定射线是否穿过一片光亮术区域，在你与该法术的目标之间画一条线。

大成功或大失败 目标承受双倍伤害。

成功 目标承受全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 寒冷伤害增加2d6，且对天界生物的灵魂伤害增加2d6。

You shoot an utterly cold ray of darkness tinged with unholy energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. You deal 5d6 cold damage, plus 5d6 spirit damage if the target is a celestial.

If the ray passes through an area of magical light or targets a creature affected by magical light, chilling darkness attempts to counteract the light. If you need to determine whether the ray passes through an area of light, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against celestials increases by 2d6.

Crisis of Faith.name: 信念崩塌 Crisis of Faith
Crisis of Faith.description:
你攻击目标的信仰，用疑虑与精神动荡折磨该生物，造成6d6精神伤害；若其能施放神圣法术，则造成6d8精神伤害。其效果由其意志豁免决定。

对许多神祇而言，若无重大理由而对你自身神祇的信徒施放该法术，属于禁忌。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到一半伤害。

失败 目标受到全额伤害；若目标能施放神圣法术，则其获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标受到双倍伤害，获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}，持续1轮，并且在1轮内无法施放神圣法术。

强化（+1） 伤害增加2d6（若目标为神圣施法者，则改为增加2d8）。

You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

Augury.name: 卜筮术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放该法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测最多未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM在以下结果中所作的最佳推测：

  • 吉 结果会很好。
  • 凶 结果会很糟。
  • 吉与凶 结果会好坏参半。
  • 无事 不会出现特别好或特别坏的结果。

GM进行一次秘密的@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。若检定失败，结果恒为“无事”。这使得无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。若在额外施放卜筮术时有人询问与第一次施放相同的主题，GM使用第一次施放的秘密掷骰结果。不过，若情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你制造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在区域内穿透或发散。光亮术不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内也不会发出任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。它们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解开一个法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标尝试一次反制检定。如果你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是神器或类似物品，你会自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

See Invisibility.name: 识破隐形 See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description:
你可以看见@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}生物和物体。它们在你眼中呈现为半透明的轮廓，并且对你而言处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。

增幅（5环）该法术的持续时间为8小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你用疑惧填满敌人的心智。

区域内的敌人必须在意志豁免中成功，否则只要他们仍在该区域内，就会在攻击掷骰上承受-1状态减值。

每回合一次，从你施放绝望术后的下一回合开始，你可以使用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作，将该灵光的半径增加5尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再尝试一次豁免。

绝望术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并使不死生物迷乱，甚至可能迫使它们逃离。该效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但若大失败，则还会在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，则目标在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。若大失败，则除非其在一次意志豁免中成功，否则目标还会在1轮内@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并以精神冲击使其昏沉。该冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在该豁免中大失败，它还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Divine Lance.name: 圣枪术 Divine Lance
Divine Lance.description:
你释放一道神圣能量光束。对目标的 AC 进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到 2d4 灵魂伤害（大成功时伤害加倍）。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 1d4。

You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你对目标施加恐惧术；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} 且获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以选择五个生物作为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗术的触须从你的指尖卷出，并在空中疾驰。你对线状区域内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害以及@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。线状区域内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半的虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害。

大成功或大失败：失败 该生物承受双倍虚空伤害以及双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4点，且持续流血伤害增加1点。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的指挥。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从以下四个选项中选择一个。

  • 烹饪 使1磅的非生物材料变凉、变暖或调味。
  • 抬升 缓慢地将一个无人持用、负载为光亮术或更低的物体从地面抬起1尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体外观粗糙且人造，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为光亮术或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用10轮的专注影响一个1负载的物体，而更大的物体则每1负载需要1分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或施加不利状态。对物体的任何真实改变（超出上述注明者）仅在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪出。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败，则将其豁免结果视为比实际结果差一级的成功度来使用。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Sanctuary.name: 圣域术 Sanctuary
Sanctuary.description:
你以防护能量守护一名生物，使其足以阻止敌人的攻击。生物每次尝试攻击目标时都必须进行一次意志豁免。若目标使用敌对动作，则该法术结束。

大成功或大失败 圣域术结束。

成功 该生物可以尝试进行其攻击，以及本回合内对目标进行的任何其他攻击。

失败 该生物无法攻击目标并浪费该动作。它本回合内无法再尝试对目标进行攻击。

大成功或大失败 该生物浪费该动作，并且在圣域术的持续时间剩余期间都无法尝试攻击目标。

You ward a creature with protective energy that deters enemy attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

Sigil.name: 魔法印记 Sigil
Sigil.description:
你无害地将你独特的魔法印记（体型约为1平方英寸）置于目标生物或物体上。该标记可以是可见或隐形，你可以通过使用一个【交互】动作来接触目标，将其从一种状态切换到另一种状态。该标记可以通过5分钟的擦洗或刮除工作移除。如果它在生物身上，它会在一周的过程中自然淡化。标记淡化前的时间会根据你升阶后的等级而增加。

升阶（第3环） 该魔法印记改为在1个月后淡化。

升阶（第5环） 该魔法印记改为在1年后淡化。

升阶（第7环） 该魔法印记永不淡化。

You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened level.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.

Glow.name: 发光 Glow
Glow.description:
20英尺。萨奎舒天生处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}状态，但会以病态的绿色光亮术发光，在灵光中投射明亮光照并使她可见。

20 feet. Sacuishu is naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} but glows with a sickly green light, casting bright light in the aura and making her visible.

Magic Immunity.name: 魔法免疫 Magic Immunity
Magic Immunity.description:
萨奎舒免疫所有法术，除了 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}。

Sacuishu is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}.

Feed on Magic.name: 吞噬魔法 Feed on Magic
Feed on Magic.description:
需求 一名能够施法的生物在萨奎舒15尺范围内

效果 萨奎舒啃噬该生物的魔法。萨奎舒恢复 @Damage[2d8[healing]] 生命值，且目标必须尝试一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 意志豁免。随后，目标获得1小时的暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 在萨奎舒下个回合开始前，目标第一次施法时，该法术会被扰乱，除非目标在一次 @Check[flat|dc:15] 检定中成功。

失败 同成功，但该效果适用于接下来1分钟内目标第一次施法时。

大成功或大失败 同成功，但该效果适用于接下来1分钟内目标每次施法时。此外，萨奎舒将其恢复的生命值加倍

Requirement A creature who can cast spells is within 15 feet of Sacuishu

Effect Sacuishu feeds on the creature's magic. Sacuishu regains @Damage[2d8[healing]] Hit Points, and the target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The first time the target Casts a Spell before the start of the Sacuishu's next turn, the spell is disrupted unless the target succeeds at a @Check[flat|dc:15] check.

Failure As success, but the effect applies the first time the target Casts a Spell within the next minute.

Critical Failure As success, but the effect applies each time the target Casts a Spell within the next minute. In addition, Sacuishu doubles the Hit Points it regains

Go Dark.name: 变暗 Go Dark
Go Dark.description:
萨奎舒熄灭她的发光，成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。她可以再次使用此动作来结束此效果。若她在隐形期间使用她的震击攻击，电弧会让任何观察者确定她的位置，使萨奎舒对观察者仅在她移动之前处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。

Sacuishu extinguishes her glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. She can end this effect with another use of this action. If she uses her shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine her location, making Sacuishu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to observers only until she moves.

Sacuishu.blurb:
女性鬼火密探
Female will-o'-wisp spy

Szek.name: 泽克 Szek

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读机运 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在1周内投入的特定目标或行动，或一个你预计可能在1周内发生的事件。你会得知一条隐晦的线索或建议，可能会对所选事件有所帮助，通常以押韵诗句或预兆的形式出现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（随意施放，仅自身） Invisibility (At Will, Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻术扭曲目标周围的光线，使其变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语甜如蜜糖，你的容貌仿佛笼罩在朦胧的梦幻薄雾之中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友近期曾威胁它或对其使用敌对动作，则该豁免获得+4环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。当法术结束时，除非它对你的友谊或你说服它采取的动作与它的预期相冲突，否则目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑术影响，这意味着你有可能通过世俗手段说服目标继续当你的朋友。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图魅惑术它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害之物而非魅惑术，除非它识别出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly}。若它原本为友善，则变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}。它无法对你使用敌对动作。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，并且它无法对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间延续至你下一次进行每日准备。

升阶（8环） 持续时间延续至你下一次进行每日准备，且你最多可将10个生物作为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，记录周围是否存在魔法。除魔法的存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品与持续中的法术。你只有在该魔法的效果阶位低于你的侦测魔法法术的阶位时，才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你会得知该法术侦测到的最强魔法效果的阶位或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）同3环，但你还会锁定最高阶位魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源范围缩小到一个5尺立方体之内（若目标大于该范围，则为最近的一个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Change Shape.name: 变形 Change Shape
Change Shape.description:
小魔鬼呈现为一只中型或更小的动物外貌。变形期间，小魔鬼失去其正常的感官、天生法术与特殊动作，但在其他方面不改变其数据，且仍能说话并使用心灵感应。小魔鬼也获得该动物的任何特殊感官，以及该动物所拥有的任何速度。

这不会改变其打击的攻击与伤害调整值，但可能会改变其打击所造成的伤害类型（取决于该动物拥有哪些种类的攻击），并阻止其使生物暴露于小魔鬼毒液。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

The imp takes on the appearance of a Medium or smaller animal. While transformed, the imp loses their normal senses, innate spells, and special actions, but doesn't otherwise change their statistics and can still speak and use telepathy. The imp also gains any special senses of the animal and any Speeds the animal has.

This doesn't change the attack and damage modifiers of their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (depending on what kinds of attacks the animal has) and prevents them from exposing creatures to imp venom.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

Fiendish Healing.name: 邪魔治疗 Fiendish Healing
Fiendish Healing.description:
频率 每轮一次。

效果 小魔鬼恢复 @Damage[1d6[治疗]] 点生命值。

Frequency once per round.

Effect The imp regains @Damage[1d6[healing]] Hit Points.

Fiendish Temptation.name: 恶魔诱惑 Fiendish Temptation
Fiendish Temptation.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 小魔鬼向15英尺内的一个非邪魔生物提出交易；若该生物自愿接受，小魔鬼便给予其幸运的赐福。赐福在被接受后持续1小时。

在这1小时内一次，该生物可以将一次攻击掷骰或豁免掷骰掷两次，并使用较高的结果。若该生物在赐福生效期间死亡，则由小魔鬼决定该生物的灵魂前往何处旅行。这通常会使灵魂永远被束缚在小魔鬼的家乡位面，并且除非通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}仪式或类似魔法，否则该生物无法被复活或再生。

Frequency once per day

Effect The imp offers a nonfiend within 15 feet a bargain, granting a boon of good luck if the creature accepts voluntarily. The boon lasts for 1 hour once accepted.

Once during the hour, the creature can roll an attack roll or saving throw twice and use the higher result. If the creature dies while the boon is in place, the imp decides where the creature's soul travels. This typically makes the soul bound for eternity in the imp's home plane, and the creature unable to be raised or resurrected except by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similar magic.

Imp Venom.name: 小魔鬼毒液 Imp Venom
Imp Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害、笨拙 1，以及 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, clumsy 1, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Szek.publicNotes:
小魔鬼是邪魔般的渗透者与腐化者；尽管它们身材矮小，却完全有能力在时间推移中，悄然影响一个意志薄弱之人，使其逐步做出愈发邪恶的行为。小魔鬼往往会同意侍奉凡人，表现得温顺而忠诚，作为长期阴谋的一部分，最终让其主人丧命或让其灵魂堕入诅咒。小魔鬼直接诞生自外层位面本身，而非源自凡人的灵魂，因此它们不受任何邪魔阶序所辖，这也让它们有余地去追求自身的专长。尽管身高仅有2英尺，小魔鬼依然可能是凶狠的战斗者；当胜算对它们不利时，它们会飞到触及之外，并变为隐形以便逃脱。

Imps are fiendish infiltrators and corrupters who, despite their diminutive stature, are more than capable of subtly influencing a weak-willed individual into performing increasingly evil acts over time. An imp will often agree to serve a mortal and act docile and loyal in a long-term plot to eventually get their master killed or damn their soul. Imps are born directly from the Outer Planes themselves, rather than from mortal souls, and thus they serve outside any fiendish hierarchies, granting them leeway to pursue their specialties. Despite standing a mere 2 feet tall, imps can be vicious combatants, flying out of reach and turning invisible to escape should the odds turn against them.
Szek.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Urevian.name: 乌瑞维安 Urevian

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Scrying (At Will) (See Right of Inspecti.name: 探知（随意）（见监察权） Scrying (At Will) (See Right of Inspection)
Scrying (At Will) (See Right of Inspecti.description:
你以魔法监视一名由你选择的生物。探知术的运作方式如同 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}，但你所获得的影像更不精确，不足以用于传送及类似法术。你不会在500尺内的固定地点创造一只眼睛，而是创造一只显现在目标正上方的眼睛。你可以通过姓名选择一个目标，或通过触摸其一件物品或其身体的一部分来选择目标。若你从未亲自见过目标，则探知术的DC降低2；若你并不知晓目标的身份（例如你在犯罪现场发现了一只未知生物的尖牙），则DC改为降低10。探知术的效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

大成功 法术失败，且目标在1周内暂时免疫。目标也会瞥见你，并得知你与其之间的大致距离与方向。

成功 法术失败，且目标在1天内暂时免疫。

失败 法术成功。

大失败 法术成功，且若目标移动，眼睛会跟随目标移动，每轮最多移动60尺。

You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. If you haven't met the target in person, scrying's DC is 2 lower, and if you are unaware of the target's identity (perhaps because you found an unknown creature's fang at a crime scene), the DC is instead 10 lower. The effect of scrying depends on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 week. The target also gains a glimpse of you and learns its rough distance and direction from you.

Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Failure The spell succeeds.

Critical Failure The spell succeeds, and the eye follows the target if it moves, traveling up to 60 feet per round.

Wall of Force.name: 力场墙 Wall of Force
Wall of Force.description:
你形成一道由纯粹魔法力构成的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}墙，最长50尺，最高20尺。该墙没有可辨识的厚度。你必须在一段不中断的开阔空间中创造这道墙，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术将失效。该墙AC为10，硬度30，且有60点生命值，并且免疫大成功或大失败命中与精准伤害。该墙阻挡物理效果穿过它；由于它由力构成，也会阻挡非实体与以太生物。传送效果可以穿过该屏障，视觉效果也可以（因为该墙是隐形的）。力场墙免疫其等级或更低等级的反制效果，但会被任何等级的解离术法术自动摧毁，或在接触取消之杖或湮灭之球时自动摧毁。

升阶（+2） 该墙的生命值增加20点。

You form an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} wall of pure magical force up to 50 feet long and up to 20 feet high. The wall has no discernible thickness. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it, and because it's made of force, it blocks incorporeal and ethereal creatures as well. Teleportation effects can pass through the barrier, as can visual effects (since the wall is invisible). Wall of force is immune to counteracting effects of its level or lower, but the wall is automatically destroyed by a disintegrate spell of any level or by contact with a rod of cancellation or sphere of annihilation.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of the wall increases by 20.

Call Spirit.name: 召唤灵魂 Call Spirit
Call Spirit.description:
你撕开通往来世的隐匿之纱，并从其最终的休息之处召来一个灵体。你必须以名字呼唤该灵体，并且必须提供与该灵体的关联物，例如一件占有物、一件衣物或其尸体的一部分。不愿回应你呼唤的灵体可以尝试进行意志豁免来避免被召来；在大成功或大失败时，一个诡计多端的灵体会冒充你原本想召唤的灵体。若你生前未曾见过该灵体，则该意志豁免的DC降低2。无论如何，该灵体会以你原本想召唤的生物的缥缈形态出现。在持续时间的每一分钟，你都可以向灵体提出一个问题。它可以随意作答，甚至拒绝回答。若该灵体不在来世（例如它是一个不死生物），除大成功或大失败之外的所有结果都使用失败效果。

大成功或大失败 灵体格外配合，即使它有充分理由欺骗你，它在进行欺瞒检定时也承受-2环境减值。

成功 你召来该灵体。

失败 你未能召来灵体。

大成功或大失败 一个或多个邪恶灵体现身并进行攻击。

You tear the veil to the afterlife and call a spirit from its final resting place. You must call the spirit by name, and you must provide a connection to the spirit, such as a possession, a garment, or a piece of its corpse. A spirit unwilling to heed your call can attempt a Will save to avoid it; on a critical success, a trickster spirit impersonates the spirit you meant to call. The DC of the Will save is 2 lower if you haven't met the spirit in life. Either way, the spirit appears as a wispy form of the creature you meant to call. Each minute of the duration, you can ask the spirit a question. It can answer how it pleases or even refuse to answer. If the spirit isn't in the afterlife (such as if it's an undead), all results other than critical failures use the failure effect.

Critical Success The spirit is particularly cooperative, and even if it has strong reasons to deceive you, it takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its Deception checks.

Success You call the spirit.

Failure You fail to call a spirit.

Critical Failure One or more evil spirits appear and attack.

Flame Strike.name: 烈焰打击 Flame Strike
Flame Strike.description:
区域: 10英尺半径、40英尺高的圆柱

你召唤一场神圣之火的雨从上方倾泻而下，造成8d6点火焰伤害。由于火焰注入了神圣能量，区域内生物仅应用其通常火焰抗力的一半。对火焰免疫的生物不会获得通常的免疫收益，而是将其豁免检定结果视为成功程度提高一级。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

Area: 10-foot radius, 40-foot-tall cylinder

You call a rain of divine fire that plummets down from above, dealing 8d6 fire damage. Because the flame is infused with divine energy, creatures in the area apply only half their usual fire resistance. Creatures that are immune to fire, instead of gaining the usual benefit of immunity, treat the results of their saving throws as one degree of success better.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Mind Probe.name: 精神质询 Mind Probe
Mind Probe.description:
你将自己的思绪投射进一名生物的心智中，筛选信息。你可以进入目标的记忆与知识，除非其以一次意志豁免将你击退。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 在法术持续时间的每一轮中，你都可以维持该法术以提出一个不同的问题，并尝试揭示答案。对于每个问题，目标都可以尝试进行一次欺骗检定来对抗你的法术DC；若目标成功，你无法得知答案；若为大成功或大失败中的大成功，目标会给出一个你认为真实的虚假答案。一旦你向目标问过某个问题，即使以另一次精精神质询的独立施放再次询问，也会产生相同的结果。

大成功或大失败中的大失败 同失败，并且目标在对抗你的问题所进行的欺骗检定上承受-4环境减值。

You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the Spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a -4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Sending.name: 发送 Sending
Sending.description:
你向该生物发送一段不超过25个单词的精神传讯术，它可以立即用一段不超过25个单词的传讯术作出回应。

You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

Tongues (Constant).name: 巧言术（持续） Tongues (Constant)
Tongues (Constant).description:
目标可以理解所有词语而不受语言影响，也能说出其他生物的语言。当处于由多种生物组成的混合群体中时，每当目标说话时，它都可以选择一个生物，并用该生物能够理解的语言交谈，即使目标并不知道那是什么语言。

强化（7环） 持续时间为8小时。

The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
开启一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立即将自己以及你穿戴和持握的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一个生物一并带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能够看见目的地，只要你过去去过那里，并且知道其相对位置以及与你之间的距离即可。你将暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Dimension Door (At Will).name: 次元门（随意） Dimension Door (At Will)
Dimension Door (At Will).description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立即将你自己以及你所穿戴和持握的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见的、位于射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会将另一名生物一同带上——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器里携带——该法术将会失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见目的地，只要你过去曾到过那里，并且知道其相对方位以及与你之间的距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Private Sanctum.name: 私密圣所 Private Sanctum
Private Sanctum.description:
从外部看，该区域看起来像一团无法穿透的黑色浓雾。感官刺激（例如声音、气味和光亮术）无法从区域内部传递到区域外部。探知法术无法感知来自该区域的任何刺激，且读心术效果在该区域内不起作用。

From outside, the area looks like a bank of impenetrable black fog. Sensory stimuli (such as sounds, smells, and light) don't pass from inside the area to outside the area. Scrying spells can't perceive any stimuli from the area, and mind-reading effects don't work in the area.

Enthrall.name: 注目术 Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
你的言语令你的目标迷魂。你在整个施放与持续时间内不间断地说话或歌唱。注意到你说话或歌唱的目标可能会将注意力完全集中在你身上；每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。若目标信奉对立的宗教、属于对立的族裔或政治倾向，或由于其他原因不太可能同意你所说的话，GM可以给予一个环境加值（最高+4）。

每个进入射程内的生物在你维持法术时都必须尝试一次豁免。若你在说话，注目术获得语言（特征）。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并注意到你试图使用魔法。

成功 目标不必注意，但不会注意到你试图使用魔法（它可能注意到其他目标被迷魂）。

失败 目标对你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}。若它目睹其不同意的动作或言语，它可以再次尝试一次意志豁免。若它成功，它不再迷魂，并在1小时内暂时免疫。若目标遭受敌对行为，或若另一名生物对其进行一次交涉或威吓检定并成功，则迷魂立刻结束。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，但若它不同意你，它无法尝试豁免以结束迷魂。

Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer Fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Locate (At Will).name: 定位术（意志） Locate (At Will)
Locate (At Will).description:
你会知晓目标的方向（若你选择的是特定物体，例如“我母亲的剑”）或最近的目标（若你选择的是一种物体，例如“剑”）。若目标是特定物体，你必须曾用自己的感官直接观察过它。若目标是一种物体，你仍需要对该类物体有准确的心象。若你与目标之间有铅或流动的水相隔，此法术无法定位术该物体。这意味着如果最近的一件该类物体位于铅或流动的水之后，你可能会找到更远处的同类物体。

升阶（5环） 你可以将目标改为特定生物或族裔而非物体，但你必须曾与想要作为目标的该生物或族裔见过面或近距离见过。

You learn the direction to the target (if you picked a specific object, such as "my mother's sword") or the nearest target (if you picked a type of object, such as "swords"). If the target is a specific object, you must have observed it directly with your own senses. If it's a type of object, you still need to have an accurate mental image of the type of object. If there's lead or running water between you and the target, this spell can't locate the object. This means you might find a type of object farther away if the nearest one is behind lead or running water.

Heightened (5th) You can target a specific creature or ancestry instead of an object, but you must have met or seen up close the creature or ancestry you want to target.

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意） Mind Reading (At Will)
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你试图施展读心术读取目标的心智。它必须进行一次意志豁免。随后目标在1小时内对你的读心术获得暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 成功 你施放法术时，目标能从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 你施放法术时从目标处感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Inveigle.name: 迷心咒 Inveigle
Inveigle.description:
你赢得了目标的心智，使其将你视为亲密且值得信赖的朋友，并把你的一切暗示术都视为合理。目标对你是乐于助人的，因此它会不遗余力地帮助你。与任何其他乐于助人的生物一样，你能要求它做的事也有限度。如果你曾要求目标做某件完全违背其天性，或对目标或其利益而言毫无必要地有害之事，它不仅会拒绝，而且还可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以提前结束该效果。由于施法时间与射程的缘故，除非目标是自愿的（也许被说服该仪式会产生其他效果）或被束缚，否则通常很难施放此仪式。若该生物不愿接受该仪式，它可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以抵消该效果。

大成功或大失败 仪式成功，且目标在进行用于结束该效果的意志豁免时承受-4状态减值。

成功 仪式成功。

失败 仪式失败。

大成功或大失败 仪式失败，且目标反而憎恨你，在持续时间内对你变为敌对。

升阶（6环） 你可以在整个施法过程中，对至多1英里外的一名生物使用迷心咒，只要你有该生物的一缕头发、一滴血，或其身体的其他一部分，并将其混入成本中使用的油里。基础成本提高至100 gp。持续时间比正常更短，取决于你使用了该生物身体部分的大小。血、头发、鳞片等会使该仪式持续1周，而一只手或其他较大的身体部位会使该仪式持续1个月。

You win over the target's mind, causing it to see you as a close and trusted friend and look upon your every suggestion as reasonable. The target is helpful toward you, so it will go out of its way to help you. As with any other helpful creature, there are limits to what you can ask of it. If you ever ask the target to do something completely against its nature or needlessly harmful to the target or its interests, not only does it refuse, but it also can attempt a Will save to end the effect early. Because of the casting time and range, it's generally difficult to cast this ritual unless the target is willing (perhaps convinced the ritual will have some other effect) or restrained. If the creature is unwilling to accept the ritual, it can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

Critical Success The ritual succeeds and the target takes a -4 status penalty to Will saves to end the effect.

Success The ritual succeeds.

Failure The ritual fails.

Critical Failure The ritual fails and the target instead hates you, becoming hostile to you for the duration.

Heightened (6th) You can use inveigle on a creature up to 1 mile away throughout the casting, as long as you have a lock of hair, a drop of blood, or some other piece of the creature's body, which you mix into the oils used in the cost. The base cost increases to 100 gp. The duration is shorter than normal, based on how large a piece of the creature's body you use. Blood, hair, scales, and the like cause the ritual to last 1 week, while a hand or other substantial body part causes the ritual to last 1 month.

Silence.name: 沉默术 Silence
Silence.description:
目标不会发出任何声音，防止生物仅凭听觉注意到它。目标不能使用音波攻击，也不能使用带有听觉（特征）的动作。这会阻止它施放包含言语成分的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.mmJNE57hC7G3SPae]{Spell Effect: Silence}

升阶（4环） 该法术效果从被触碰的生物处散发，使10尺半径内的所有声音（位于其中或穿过其中的声音）都被消除，并阻止受影响区域内的任何听觉（特征）与音波效果。在该半径内，生物会受到与目标相同的效果影响。根据效果的位置，生物可能会注意到没有声音传到它那里（例如，阻断了来自队伍的噪音）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.mmJNE57hC7G3SPae]{Spell Effect: Silence}

The target makes no sound, preventing creatures from noticing it using hearing alone. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This prevents it from casting spells that include verbal components.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.mmJNE57hC7G3SPae]{Spell Effect: Silence}

Heightened (4th) The spell effect emanates from the touched creature, silencing all sound in or passing through a 10- foot radius and preventing any auditory and sonic effects in the affected area. While within the radius, creatures are subject to the same effects as the target. Depending upon the position of the effect, a creature might notice the lack of sound reaching it (blocking off the noise coming from a party, for example).

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，用以感知魔法的存在。你获得的信息仅限于是否存在魔法。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在该幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果的魔法学派。若有多个效果同等强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官相同，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5英尺立方体内（若其大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Infernal Pact.name: 炼狱契约 Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description:
你向一位强大的魔鬼提出请求，要求它将一些下属束缚来为你服务。如果你成功，该魔鬼会派出它所选择的以下之一：一名魔鬼，其等级不超过地狱契约阶位的两倍；两名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低2；或三名魔鬼，它们的等级各自至少比法术阶位两倍低3。

大成功或大失败 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}。

成功 魔鬼被派到你身边，并为你服务[[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}。

失败 你的提出请求被拒绝。

大成功或大失败 你的提出请求不仅被拒绝，而且那位强大的魔鬼还会将其不悦传话给你的主人。

You make an appeal to a powerful devil, asking it to bind some of its subordinates to your service. If you succeed, the devil sends you its choice of one devil whose level is no more than double infernal pact's rank, two devils whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three devils whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #weeks]]{1d4 weeks}.

Success The devils are sent to you and serve you for [[/r 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}.

Failure Your request is denied.

Critical Failure Not only is your request denied, but the powerful devil sends word of its displeasure to your master.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Distracting Declaration.name: 分心宣告 Distracting Declaration
Distracting Declaration.description:
乌瑞维安随时准备几句狡黠的话来分散敌人的注意力。他总是使用欺瞒来进行先攻。

Urevian keeps a few sly words at the ready to distract enemies. He always uses Deception for initiative.

Ward Contract.name: 守护契约 Ward Contract
Ward Contract.description:
乌瑞维安携带的任何已签署的契约（包括披挂在他角上的任何契约）免疫来自除乌瑞维安以外生物的伤害。此外，乌瑞维安免疫任何会使他更改、作废或摧毁契约的心灵效果。

Any signed contract Urevian carries (including any draped over his horns) is immune to damage from creatures other than Urevian. In addition, Urevian is immune to mental effects that would make him alter, nullify, or destroy a contract.

Draft Contract.name: 草拟契约 Draft Contract
Draft Contract.description:
乌瑞维安为单个活着的凡人拟定一份地狱契约。这份契约可以赋予极其广泛的能力与效果，近似于一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}法术的力量，但由乌瑞维安严格依照字面条款履行。要获得其中任何益处，该凡人必须自愿在契约上签下自己的真名。此时，凡人的灵魂将被束缚于乌瑞维安以及地狱。

在契约效果持续期间，该凡人除非通过许愿术或类似魔法，否则无法被复活。若该凡人通过这些手段被复活，乌瑞维安会知晓是哪位凡人重获生命，并可在1年内定位使该凡人复活的生物（或多个生物），获得一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate}法术的效果，且射程为无限。规避地狱契约条款极其困难，且往往危险。

Urevian produces an infernal contract for a single living mortal. This contract can grant a wide range of abilities and effects, akin to the power of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} spell but fulfilled to the letter by Urevian. To receive any of those benefits, the mortal must willingly sign its true name to the contract. At that point, the mortal's soul is bound to Urevian and to Hell.

While the contract is in effect, the mortal can't be restored to life except by wish or similar magic. If the mortal is restored to life by those means, Urevian knows which mortal came to life and can locate the creature or creatures who restored the mortal to life for 1 year, gaining the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LQzlKbYjZSMFQawP]{Locate} spell with unlimited range. Avoiding the terms of an infernal contract is difficult and often dangerous.

Infernal Wound.name: 地狱创伤 Infernal Wound
Infernal Wound.description:
乌瑞维安的打击还会造成 @Damage[2d6[bleed]]，该流血会抵抗试图治疗它的行为。

止住流血的纯骰检定起始为 @Check[flat|dc:20]。仅当流血的生物或盟友成功援助其恢复时，DC 才会降低至 @Check[flat|dc:15]。对带有地狱创伤的生物进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid} 的 DC 增加 5。

施法者或物品试图对正在遭受地狱创伤的生物使用治疗魔法时，必须在 DC 28 的反制检定中成功，否则魔法无法治疗该生物。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{Effect: Infernal Wound}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}

Urevian's Strikes also deal @Damage[2d6[bleed]] that resists attempts to heal them.

The flat check to stop the bleeding starts at @Check[flat|dc:20]. The DC is reduced to @Check[flat|dc:15] only if the bleeding creature or an ally successfully assists with the recovery. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.inLBsuLRE5xmVHdn]{Effect: Infernal Wound} to a creature with an infernal wound is increased by 5.

A spellcaster or item attempting to use healing magic on a creature suffering from an infernal wound must succeed at a DC 28 counteract check or the magic fails to heal the creature.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}

Right of Inspection.name: 监察权 Right of Inspection
Right of Inspection.description:
乌瑞维安可以随意施放他天生的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} 法术，但只能以与他有契约的生物、他所持有的某份契约中点名的特定生物，或上述任意生物的后代为目标。目标豁免检定的结果比其掷出的结果差一级。

Urevian can cast his innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r784cIz17eWujtQj]{Scrying} spell at will, but only to target a creature with which he has a contract, a specific creature named in a contract he has, or a descendant of any of those creatures. The outcome of the target's saving throw is one step worse than the result it rolled.

Urevian.blurb:
男性契约魔战场指挥官
Male phistophilus field commander
Urevian.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Urevian.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Witchfire Warden.name: 巫火守卫 Witchfire Warden

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异能先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Control Weather.name: 控制天气 Control Weather
Control Weather.description:
你改变天气，使其变得平静并符合当季的正常水平，或根据季节从下列效果中选择至多两项。

你无法具体控制其表现形式，例如龙卷风的确切路径或闪电打击的目标。

  • 秋季 寒冷天气、雾、温和炎热、雨夹雪
  • 春季 毛毛雨、炎热、飓风、雨夹雪、雷暴、龙卷风
  • 夏季 毛毛雨、暴雨、极端炎热、冰雹、炎热
  • 冬季 暴风雪、温和寒冷、极端寒冷、解冻

大成功 你如愿改变天气，并且可以影响更大的区域（至多半径5英里的圆形），或更长的持续时间（额外任意数量的d12小时，最多16d12）。

成功 你如愿改变天气。

失败 你未能如愿改变天气。

大失败 天气以出乎意料的方式改变，由GM决定，但通常会尽可能与你真正的意愿相矛盾（例如，当你希望好天气时却出现可怕的风暴）。

升阶（9环） 你可以创造非当季的天气以及相互矛盾的天气效果，例如极端寒冷与飓风。你可以让天气变得平静并符合另一季节的正常天气，或从任意季节的列表中选择天气效果。

You alter the weather, making it calm and normal for the season or choosing up to two effects based on the season.

You can't specifically control the manifestations, such as the exact path of a tornado or the targets of lightning strikes.

  • Autumn cold weather, fog, mild heat, sleet
  • Spring drizzle, heat, hurricane, sleet, thunderstorm, tornado
  • Summer drizzle, downpour, extreme heat, hail, heat
  • Winter blizzard, mild cold, extreme cold, thaw

Critical Success You change the weather as desired and can affect a larger area (up to a 5-mile-radius circle), or a longer duration (any number of additional d12 hours, up to 16d12).

Success You change the weather as desired.

Failure You fail to change the weather as desired.

Critical Failure The weather changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, a terrible storm emerges when you would prefer good weather).

Heightened (9th) You can create unseasonable weather and contradictory weather effects, such as extreme cold and a hurricane. You can make the weather calm and normal weather for a different season or choose weather effects from any season's list.

Baleful Polymorph.name: 邪恶变形术 Baleful Polymorph
Baleful Polymorph.description:
你将目标生物变形为一种与区域相称的无害动物，其效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的身体获得该无害动物的一些轻微特征。它的内脏在部分变形时翻搅，使其陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。当它从恶心（状态）中恢复时，这些特征恢复正常。

失败 目标变形持续1分钟，但保留其心智。若它在其回合将全部动作都用于专注于其原本形态，则它可以尝试一次意志豁免以立即结束该效果。

大失败 目标在身体与心智上都被变形为所选的无害动物，持续时间为无限。

You transform the target creature into a harmless animal appropriate to the area, with effects based on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's body gains minor features of the harmless animal. Its insides churn as they partially transform, causing it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. When it recovers from the Sickened condition, its features revert to normal.

Failure The target transforms for 1 minute but keeps its mind. If it spends all its actions on its turn concentrating on its original form, it can attempt a Will save to end the effect immediately.

Critical Failure The target is transformed into the chosen harmless animal, body and mind, for an unlimited duration.

Phantasmal Calamity.name: 魅影灾祸 Phantasmal Calamity
Phantasmal Calamity.description:
末日般的毁灭幻景充斥区域内每个生物的心智。该幻景造成11d6精神伤害（基础意志豁免）。在大失败时，该生物还必须在一次反射豁免中成功，否则会相信自己被困住了（卡在裂缝中、在海上漂流，或其他符合其幻景的命运）。若其第二次豁免失败，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}状态，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的意志豁免，并在成功时识破该幻觉并从震慑（状态）中恢复。

强化（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

A vision of apocalyptic destruction fills the mind of each creature in the area. The vision deals 11d6 mental damage (basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature must also succeed at a Reflex save or believe it's trapped (stuck in a fissure, adrift at sea, or some other fate in keeping with its vision). If it fails the second save, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Will save at the end of each of its turns, and on a success, it disbelieves the illusion and recovers from the Stunned condition.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望灵光。每个生物所受的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作（）并且必须在其回合开始时再尝试一次豁免；若失败，则其在该回合中因无法控制地抽泣而变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大成功或大失败 同失败，并且该生物在1分钟内自动变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

升阶（第7环） 区域增加为60尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Illusory Scene.name: 幻象场景 Illusory Scene
Illusory Scene.description:
你构筑一个想象中的幻象场景，其中包含至多10个彼此独立的生物或物体，体型各异，且都必须位于该法术的区域内。这些要素会产生恰当的声音与气味，并且接触时手感逼真。幻象场景的要素无法说话。不同于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} 法术，你场景中的生物不具备战斗能力与数据。你的场景不包含对其周围环境的改变，不过你可以将该场景置于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} 法术所创造的幻象环境之中。

当你创造该场景时，你可以选择让它保持静止，或按某个程序运作。静止场景虽然固定不动，但仍包含基本的自然移动。例如，风吹动一张幻象纸会让它沙沙作响。一个程序最长可达1分钟，并在结束后重复。例如，你可以创造两个兽人互相战斗的场景，并且每次重复时战斗都会以同样的方式进行。若你创造的是循环，这两名战士在场景开始时与结束时都会处于同一位置，但你可以将程序衔接得更顺畅，使人难以分辨循环何时结束、何时开始。任何观察该场景超过几分钟的人几乎总会注意到它在循环。你在创造幻术后无法改变该程序。

任何接触图像任意部分的生物，或使用搜寻动作对其进行检查的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻术。若他们与幻术的某一部分互动，他们只会识破那一部分。只有在大成功或大失败中的大成功时，他们才会识破整个场景。

强化（6环） 你场景中的生物或物体可以说话。在创建程序时，你必须为每个角色说出其特定台词。该法术会为每个角色伪装你的声音。

强化（8环） 同6环版本，并且持续时间为无限。

You form an imaginary scene that includes up to 10 discrete creatures or objects of various sizes, all of which must be within the spell's area. These elements generate appropriate sounds and smells, and they feel right to the touch. Elements of an illusory scene are incapable of speech. Unlike with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell, creatures in your scene lack combat abilities and statistics. Your scene doesn't include changes to the environment around it, though you can place your scene within the illusory environment of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage} spell.

When you create the scene, you can choose to have it be static or follow a program. Though a static scene is stationary, it includes basic natural movement. For example, wind blowing on an illusory piece of paper would rustle it. A program can be up to 1 minute long and repeats when finished. For instance, you could create a scene of two orcs fighting each other, and the fight would go the same way for each repetition. If you create a loop, the two fighters end up in the same place at the start of the scene and at the end of it, but you can smooth the program so it's hard to tell when the loop ends and begins. Anyone observing the scene for more than a few minutes almost always notices it looping. You're unable to alter the program after you create the illusion.

Any creature that touches any part of the image or uses the Seek action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion. If they interact with a portion of the illusion, they disbelieve only that portion. They disbelieve the entire scene only on a critical success.

Heightened (6th) Creatures or objects in your scene can speak. You must speak the specific lines for each actor when creating your program. The spell disguises your voice for each actor.

Heightened (8th) As the 6th-rank version, and the duration is unlimited.

Prying Eye.name: 窥探之眼 Prying Eye
Prying Eye.description:
你在你可见的500尺内某处创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}、漂浮的眼睛，直径1英寸。它以你正常的视觉感官向所有方向观看，并持续将它所见传递给你。每轮你第一次维持法术时，你可以选择将眼睛移动至多30尺（只能看见眼睛前方的事物），或将其移动至多10尺（能看见其周围所有方向的一切）。眼睛能离你移动多远没有限制，但如果你与眼睛不再处于同一存在位面，法术会立刻结束。若你想用它进行察觉检定，你可以通过眼睛尝试搜寻动作。任何对眼睛造成的伤害都会摧毁它并结束法术。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

Summon Entity.name: 召唤怪形 Summon Entity
Summon Entity.description:
你召唤一只异怪（特征）为你作战。这与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal} 的运作方式相同，但你改为召唤一只具有异怪（特征）且等级为5或更低的常见生物。

升阶（6环） 等级7

升阶（7环） 等级9

升阶（8环） 等级11

升阶（9环） 等级13

升阶（10环） 等级15

You conjure an aberration to fight for you. This works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}, except you summon a common creature that has the aberration trait and whose level is 5 or lower.

Heightened (6th) Level 7

Heightened (7th) Level 9

Heightened (8th) Level 11

Heightened (9th) Level 13

Heightened (10th) Level 15

Summon Entity (Will-o'-Wisp Only).name: 召唤怪形（仅限鬼火） Summon Entity (Will-o'-Wisp Only)
Summon Entity (Will-o'-Wisp Only).description:
你召唤一只异怪生物为你战斗。此法术的效果如同 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}，但你召唤的是一只具有异怪（特征）的常见生物，且其等级为5或更低。

强化（6环） 等级7

强化（7环） 等级9

强化（8环） 等级11

强化（9环） 等级13

强化（10环） 等级15

You conjure an aberration to fight for you. This works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4YnON9JHYqtLzccu]{Summon Animal}, except you summon a common creature that has the aberration trait and whose level is 5 or lower.

Heightened (6th) Level 7

Heightened (7th) Level 9

Heightened (8th) Level 11

Heightened (9th) Level 13

Heightened (10th) Level 15

Clairvoyance.name: 鹰眼术 Clairvoyance
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程内的一个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的漂浮眼睛（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。这只眼睛无法移动，但你可以从该点向所有方向视物，就如同使用你正常的视觉感官一样。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

Nightmare.name: 梦魇术 Nightmare
Nightmare.description:
你将令人不安的梦魇术送入你的目标。目标下一次入睡时，必须尝试一次意志豁免。若你仅通过名字知晓该目标且从未见过对方，则目标在意志豁免上获得+4环境加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不承受任何不利效果，并在1周内暂时免疫。

成功 目标经历梦魇术，但除不愉快的记忆外不承受其他不利效果。

失败 目标经历梦魇术，并在醒来时获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}。

大成功或大失败 目标经历梦魇术，醒来时获得疲乏，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，直到其不再疲乏为止。

You send disturbing nightmares to your target. The next time the target falls asleep, it must attempt a Will save. If you know the target only by name and have never met them, the target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to the Will save.

Critical Success The target suffers no adverse effects and is temporarily immune for 1 week.

Success The target experiences the nightmares but suffers no adverse effects other than unpleasant memories.

Failure The target experiences the nightmares and awakens @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure The target experiences the nightmares, awakens Fatigued, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until it is no longer Fatigued.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一幅在目标眼中最可怖的生物的幻影。只有该法术的目标能看见这名杀手，不过你能看到这道幻觉疾驰向前发动攻击时的模糊轮廓。杀手的效果基于目标进行意志豁免的结果。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6点精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标害怕到可能会死。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；若目标失败，它死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到12d6点精神伤害，直到其下一回合结束前获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 在失败时伤害增加2d6，在大成功或大失败：失败时伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Talking Corpse.name: 会说话的尸体 Talking Corpse
Talking Corpse.description:
你赋予目标尸体一丝生命的表象，使其用来回答你向它提出的三个问题。本法术唤起的是肉体的潜在记忆，而非将死者的灵魂召回，因此尸体必须基本完整，本法术才能生效。尸体所受的伤害越多，它的回答就越不准确或越零碎，而且它必须有喉咙和嘴才能开口说话。如果在过去一周内有人曾对该尸体施放过此法术，则本法术自动失败。尸体可以尝试进行一次意志豁免，以其死亡时代原本生物的数据来抵抗回答问题，并产生如下效果。

大成功或大失败 目标可以说谎或拒绝回答你的问题，并且目标的灵魂会纠缠你24小时，骚扰你并导致你在这段时间内无法获得任何休息。

成功 目标可以提供虚假信息或拒绝回答你的问题。

失败 目标必须如实作答，但它的回答可以简短、晦涩且重复。它仍然可以对你施展假象术，或试图拖延，使得在你问完所有问题之前法术的持续时间就耗尽。

大成功或大失败 如同失败，但目标的回答更直接且不那么重复，尽管仍然晦涩。它在进行欺瞒检定以欺骗或对你施展假象术时承受-2状态减值。

You grant the target corpse a semblance of life, which it uses to speak the answers to three questions posed to it. This spell calls on the physical body's latent memories rather than summoning back the deceased's spirit, so the corpse must be mostly intact for the spell to function. The more damage the corpse has taken, the more inaccurate or patchwork its answers are, and it must have a throat and mouth to speak at all. If anyone has previously cast this spell on the corpse in the last week, the spell automatically fails. The corpse can attempt a Will save to resist answering the questions using the statistics of the original creature at its time of death, with the following effects.

Critical Success The target can lie or refuse to answer your questions, and the target's spirit haunts you for 24 hours, bothering you and causing you to be unable to gain any rest for that time.

Success The target can provide false information or refuse to answer your questions.

Failure The target must answer truthfully, but its answers can be brief, cryptic, and repetitive. It can still mislead you or attempt to stall so that the spell's duration runs out before you can ask all your questions.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target's answers are more direct and less repetitive, though still cryptic. It takes a -2 status penalty to Deception checks to deceive or mislead you.

Clairaudience.name: 锐耳术 Clairaudience
Clairaudience.description:
你在射程内的一个位置创造一只@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的漂浮耳朵（即使该位置在你的视觉线或效果线之外）。它无法移动，但你可以通过这只耳朵听见，如同使用你正常的听觉感官一样。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating ear at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). It can't move, but you can hear through the ear as if using your normal auditory senses.

Dream Message.name: 梦境传讯术 Dream Message
Dream Message.description:
你将一段传讯术送入你目标的梦境。该传讯术为单向，最多可包含 1 分钟的言语（约 150 个词）。如果目标正在睡觉，他们会立刻收到传讯术。否则，他们会在下次入睡时收到。只要他们收到传讯术，法术便结束，而你会知道传讯术已送出。

升阶（4环） 你可以以最多 10 个你知道其姓名且曾当面见过的生物为目标。你必须向他们所有人发送相同的传讯术；法术会对每个生物分别结束。

You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually.

Augury.name: 卜筮术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放该法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可预测未来最多30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM在下列结果中作出的最佳猜测：

  • 顺遂 结果会很好。
  • 灾厄 结果会很糟。
  • 顺遂与灾厄 结果会好坏参半。
  • 无事 不会出现特别好或特别坏的结果。

GM进行一次秘密的 @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。若检定失败，结果总是“无事”。这使得无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。如果在后续额外施放卜筮术时，有人询问与第一次施放时相同的主题，GM使用第一次施放的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
披覆于幻术之中，目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则在该敌对动作完成后法术结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Charm.name: 魅惑术 Charm
Charm.description:
对目标而言，你的话语甜如蜜糖，你的容貌仿佛沐浴在梦幻的薄雾中。它必须尝试一次意志豁免；如果你或你的盟友最近威胁过它或对它使用过敌对动作，则该豁免获得 +4 环境加值。

你可以解消该法术。如果你对目标使用敌对动作，该法术结束。法术结束时，目标不一定会意识到自己曾被魅惑术影响，除非它对你的友谊或你说服它采取的动作与它的预期相冲突；这意味着你可能通过世俗手段说服目标继续做你的朋友。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图魅惑它。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害之物而非魅惑术，除非它辨识出该法术。

失败 目标对你的态度变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly}。如果它原本为友善，则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}。它不能对你使用敌对动作。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标对你的态度变为乐于助人，并且它不能对你使用敌对动作。

升阶（4环） 持续时间持续至你下次进行每日准备时为止。

升阶（8环） 持续时间持续至你下次进行每日准备时为止，并且你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造最多四个漂浮的光亮术，彼此间距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮术移动最多60英尺。每个光亮术必须保持在你120英尺内，并且与所有其他光亮术保持在10英尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你创造一个由简单声音构成的听觉幻觉，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时喊叫。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方格中发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一道幻象，使自己看起来像另一种与自己体型相同、身形相似的生物，并且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）也大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而你取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装会被视为为使用欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 而进行的伪装准备；它会忽略你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值，用于进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装，并且即使你未受训也要加上你的等级。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能变成其外貌。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: 幻象伪装（随意） Illusory Disguise (At Will)
Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
你创造一个幻觉，使你看起来像另一种与自己身体形态相同、且身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件裙子。手持物品不受影响，而你移除的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装等同于为使用欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 做好伪装准备；它会忽略你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值，使你在进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装时获得+4状态加值，并且即使你未受训也要将你的等级加入其中。你可以解消该法术。

强化（2环）该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

强化（3环）你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself.
