Constrict.name: 紧勒 Constrict
Constrict.description:
@Damage[(1d8+9)[bludgeoning]] 伤害，@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] 豁免（仅被爪子@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}）

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

@Damage[(1d8+9)[bludgeoning]] damage, @Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by claws only)

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

Mandibles.name: 颚爪 Mandibles
Mandibles.description:
需求 一名生物被甲伏怪的触手施加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}。

效果 该生物受到@Damage[3d6[piercing]]伤害。

Requirements A creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} by the chuul's tentacles.

Effect The creature takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] damage.

Paralytic Venom.name: 麻痹毒液 Paralytic Venom
Paralytic Venom.description:
豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 轮)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} (1 round)

Tentacle Transfer.name: 触手转移 Tentacle Transfer
Tentacle Transfer.description:
需求 甲伏怪有一名生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 状态。

效果 甲伏怪将被擒抱的生物从其爪子转移到其触手中，或反之。生物在被转移到触手中时会暴露于甲伏怪的麻痹毒液之下，且若其仍被触手擒抱，则在甲伏怪每个回合开始时也会暴露于该毒液。

Requirements The chuul has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

Effect The chuul transfers the grabbed creature from its claws to its tentacles, or vice versa. A creature is exposed to the chuul's paralytic venom when transferred into the tentacles and at the start of each of the chuul's turns if it remains grabbed by the tentacles.

Chuul.publicNotes:
这些大型、披覆护甲板的甲壳类掠食者也被称为chu'ulothis，它们潜伏在水潭、沼泽泥淖与池塘的水面之下，等待用巨大的螯钳攫住猎物，再用触手将其麻痹。到了那一步，它们便开始进食，把猎物活生生地吃掉。

甲伏怪能在淡水或咸水中生存，事实上在全世界的水栖环境中都能发现它们——甚至在幽暗地域的地下海洋与湖泊里也是如此。尽管甲伏怪很会游泳，它们却更偏好陆生猎物。它们最喜欢的狩猎方式是从水中猛扑而出，用覆有毒液的触手麻痹受害者，然后兴高采烈地把抽搐的食物拖入水中淹死——若不能就这样直接把这些小点心活吃了的话。栖居地表的甲伏怪偏爱以蜥蜴人为食，而在幽暗地域地下湖泊中游弋的甲伏怪几乎什么都吃，唯独不吃地蜥人（特征），因为它们觉得地蜥人的味道和臭气都令人作呕。

甲伏怪具备言语与推理能力，但这些生物很少与异种交流，除非是为了嘲弄它们的食物。在开始吞食猎物之前，甲伏怪常会用一种咕噜作响、几乎难以理解的方言说些话，内容多是它将如何享用生物的血肉。也许甲伏怪相信侮辱与贬低能让食物更嫩、更美味，但真相大概永远不会为人所知；几乎所有甲伏怪都固执地拒绝任何有意义的对话，即便被囚禁，也不为奖赏或痛苦所迫。

除了它们狂乱的交配季之外，是否存在甲伏怪社会仍属未知。甲伏怪的智力似乎只用于进食、给有感知的生物造成心理痛苦、用最喜欢的餐点与胜利的纪念品装饰巢穴，以及繁衍。

Also known as chu'ulothis, these large, armor-plated, crustacean predators lurk beneath the surface of pools, mires, and ponds, waiting to snatch up prey with their massive claws before paralyzing them with their tentacles. At that point, they begin to feed, eating their quarry alive.

Chuuls can live in fresh or saltwater, and indeed are found in aquatic environs the world over-even in the subterranean oceans and lakes of the Darklands. While chuuls are good swimmers, they prefer terrestrial prey. Their preferred method of hunting is by lunging out of the water, paralyzing their victims with their poison-coated tentacles, then gleefully dragging their twitching food into the water to drown if they cannot simply eat such morsels alive. Chuuls that dwell aboveground prefer to dine on lizardfolk, while those swimming the subterranean lakes of the Darklands readily eat anything but xulgaths, whose flavor and stink they find off-putting.

Chuuls are capable of speech and reason, but these creatures rarely speak with those outside their species except to taunt their food. Before it begins consuming its prey, a chuul often speaks in a gurgling, nearly incomprehensible dialect about how it will enjoy feasting on the creature's flesh. Perhaps chuuls believe that insults and degradation lead to more tender and tastier food, but the truth will likely never be known; almost all chuuls stubbornly refuse any meaningful conversation, even when imprisoned and compelled by treats or pain.

It is unknown if a chuul society exists beyond their frenzied mating season. Chuuls' intellects seem devoted only toward eating, causing psychological pain to sentient creatures, decorating their lairs with mementos of their favorite meals and victories, and breeding.

Dragon's Blood Puffball.name: 龙血马勃 Dragon's Blood Puffball
Dragon's Blood Puffball.tokenName: 龙血马勃 Dragon's Blood Puffball

Motion Sense 60 feet.name: 动态感知 60尺 Motion Sense 60 feet
Motion Sense 60 feet.description:
怪物通过振动和空气移动感知移动。

The monster senses motion through vibrations and air movement.

Spore Explosion.name: 孢子爆炸 Spore Explosion
Spore Explosion.description:
当龙血尘菇死亡时，它会爆炸，对每个处于@Template[emanation|distance:20]内的生物造成@Damage[7d8[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic]豁免）。

When the dragon's blood puffball dies, it explodes, dealing @Damage[7d8[poison]] damage to each creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic] save).

Dragon's Blood Puffball.publicNotes:
这种球状的深红色真菌看起来像一朵巨大而腐烂的玫瑰。

许多无害的马勃类真菌附着在幽暗地域洞窟中森林地表的腐屑上。这些真菌的巨型版本更为机动，也更危险。

This bulbous, deep red fungus looks like an enormous, decaying rose.

Many benign puffball fungi cling to the detritus of forest floors in Darklands caverns. These fungi's giant versions are more mobile and dangerous.
Dragon's Blood Puffball.prototypeToken: 龙血马勃 Dragon's Blood Puffball

Drakauthix.name: 盗袭瘤菌 Drakauthix

Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 孢子视野（不精确）60尺 Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet
Sporesight (Imprecise) 60 feet.description:
盗袭瘤菌散发出一团它用来视物的孢子云。这是一种模糊感官，只有在没有强风气流的区域内才能运作。孢子视觉在水下无法运作。

The drakauthix exudes a cloud of spores that it uses to see. This is an imprecise sense that functions only in areas without strong wind currents. Sporesight does not function underwater.

Obscuring Spores.name: 遮蔽孢子 Obscuring Spores
Obscuring Spores.description:
每当盗袭瘤菌受到至少10点挥砍伤害时，它会释放一团棕色孢子云，其效果等同于以盗袭瘤菌为中心的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} 法术，持续1分钟。这团孢子云不会随盗袭瘤菌移动，也不会因它的移动而被移开。

Whenever the drakauthix takes at least 10 slashing damage, it releases a cloud of brown spores that has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} for 1 minute, centered around the drakauthix. This cloud of spores does not move with the drakauthix, nor is it displaced by its movement.

Reel In.name: 收线 Reel In
Reel In.description:
盗袭瘤菌将其所@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}的所有生物拉向自身，使其靠近15英尺。

The drakauthix pulls all creatures it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 15 feet closer to itself.

Spore Tendrils.name: 孢子卷须 Spore Tendrils
Spore Tendrils.description:
覆盖盗袭瘤菌全身的触须伸出并侵染相邻生物，造成 @Damage[4d6[poison]] 伤害和 @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] 伤害。生物可以尝试进行一次 @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] 豁免以减少该伤害，但被盗袭瘤菌以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 抓住的生物在此次豁免上承受 -4 环境减值。

The tendrils that cover the drakauthix's body reach out and infest adjacent creatures, dealing @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] damage. A creature can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save to reduce this damage, but one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the drakauthix takes a -4 circumstance penalty to this save.

Whirlwind of Hooks.name: 钩刃旋风 Whirlwind of Hooks
Whirlwind of Hooks.description:
盗袭瘤菌旋转翻腾，将周围的生物甩动起来。盗袭瘤菌对其触及范围内的每个生物进行一次触手打击。

The drakauthix whirls, whipping creatures around it. The drakauthix makes a tentacle Strike against every creature within its reach.

Drakauthix.publicNotes:
盗袭瘤菌是一种巨大的真菌，漂浮在幽暗地域最大洞窟的高处，靠会喷出空气与孢子的气囊推进。盗袭瘤菌是一名贪婪但行动迟缓的猎手，偏好从上方伏击多肉的生物，用带钩的附肢将受害者向上拖拽以便进食。盗袭瘤菌的消化过程完全在体外进行——它会附着在受害者身上，布满孢子的表面缓慢地啃食血肉并在其中生长，随后将被孢子侵染的尸体丢弃。当被侵染的躯体砸向下方地面时，它会爆裂并释放一团孢子云，放出一群被称为“孢子幼体”的幼体，它们会立刻窜上洞壁，附着在洞窟天花板并继续生长。

盗袭瘤菌的智慧并不比大多数掠食动物更高，它常以一种共生式的食腐方式来获取猎物：利用它经常出没的大型洞穴系统中泥怪与害虫的狩猎手段。当某个相对无心智的生物杀死了受害者，盗袭瘤菌便会漂落下来，用触须钩住刚被杀死的尸体，将这顿食物卷走。那只刚被偷走食物的无心智泥怪或其他生物很少记仇，只会蜿蜒离开去寻找新的猎物，让盗袭瘤菌安静地消化尸体。当然，盗袭瘤菌也不介意享用更活跃的猎物，若有冒险者在探索一片神秘洞穴网络时疏于抬头警戒，它也可能发起攻击。

一些栖居于幽暗地域的生物，例如灰矮人，会捕猎盗袭瘤菌取其肉食用；其肉有独特风味，并带有胡椒般的回味。地下种族也会用盗袭瘤菌制墨：先焚烧其尸体，再将灰烬长时间研磨并压榨，直到一种银色物质凝结成形。

The drakauthix is a massive fungus that floats through the heights of the largest Darklands caverns, propelled by bladders that spray air and spores. A voracious but slow-moving hunter, the drakauthix prefers to ambush meaty creatures from above, using its hooked appendages to pull its victims upward to feed. The drakauthix's digestive process is entirely external-it clings to victims, and its spore-laden surface slowly feeds on and grows through the flesh before the spore-infested carcass is discarded. As the infested body strikes the ground below, it bursts and releases a cloud of spores, unleashing a host of young called sporelings that immediately scuttle up the cavern walls to cling to its ceiling and grow.

The drakauthix behaves no more intelligently than most predatory animals, and often uses a sort of symbiotic scavenger method to secure prey by capitalizing on the hunting methods of oozes and vermin found in the large cave systems it frequents. When a relatively mindless creature kills a victim, the drakauthix drifts down, hooks the freshly slain carcass with its tendrils, and reels in its meal. The mindless ooze or other creature that just had its food stolen rarely holds a grudge and simply slithers off to find a new quarry, letting the drakauthix digest the corpse in peace. Of course, the drakauthix isn't above feasting on more active prey as well, and might attack an adventurer who neglects to look upward for danger when exploring a network of mysterious caves.

Some Darklands-dwelling creatures, such as duergars, hunt drakauthixes for their flesh, which has a unique flavor with a peppery aftertaste. Subterranean races also make ink from drakauthixes by burning their carcasses, then grinding and pressing the ashes for a long time until a silvery substance congeals.

Dread Wraith.name: 惧栗缚灵 Dread Wraith

Lifesense 60 feet.name: 生命感知 60 尺 Lifesense 60 feet

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality.name: 对抗活力效果时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Vitality

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Draining Presence.name: 汲取灵光 Draining Presence
Draining Presence.description:
10英尺。进入该灵光的生物必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 豁免中成功，否则获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。在离开该灵光1分钟后恢复。此流失（状态）值与汲取生命导致的流失值累加，但不会与多个汲取气场灵光累加。

豁免成功的生物在24小时内暂时免疫汲取气场。

10 feet. A creature entering the aura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. It recovers after it has been out of the aura for 1 minute. This drained condition value is cumulative with the drained value caused by drain life, but not with multiple draining presence auras.

A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to draining presence for 24 hours.

Sunlight Powerlessness.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Powerlessness
Sunlight Powerlessness.description:
一只惧栗缚灵在阳光下会处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}。

A dread wraith caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

Absorb Wraith.name: 吸收缚灵 Absorb Wraith
Absorb Wraith.description:
惧栗缚灵将手伸向100尺内的另一个缚灵生物。目标缚灵溶解并沿直线疾驰向惧栗缚灵，对该直线上的每个生物造成 @Damage[6d10[void]] 伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] 豁免）。

惧栗缚灵吸收目标缚灵的精粹，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}，并在等同于被吸收的缚灵等级数量的轮内，其飞行速度获得+10尺状态加值。它只能将额外动作用于飞行或打击。

不愿意的目标可以尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:28] 豁免，以抗拒被吸收。

The dread wraith extends its hand toward another wraith creature within 100 feet. The target wraith dissolves and streaks toward the dread wraith in a straight line, dealing @Damage[6d10[void]] damage to each creature along the line (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

The dread wraith absorbs the essence of the target wraith, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and gaining a +10-foot status bonus to its fly Speed for a number of rounds equal to the level of the absorbed wraith. It can use its extra action only to Fly or Strike.

An unwilling target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save to resist being absorbed.

Drain Life.name: 汲取生命 Drain Life
Drain Life.description:
当惧栗缚灵以其幽体之手打击对一个活体生物造成伤害时，缚灵获得 [[/r 10 #Temporary Hit Points]]{10 临时生命值}，且目标必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免中成功，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。缚灵造成的后续伤害会在豁免失败时使流失（状态）值增加1，最高至流失（状态）4。

When the dread wraith damages a living creature with its spectral hand Strike, the wraith gains [[/r 10 #Temporary Hit Points]]{10 temporary Hit Points} and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Further damage dealt by the wraith increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

Wraith Spawn.name: 缚灵衍生体 Wraith Spawn
Wraith Spawn.description:
被缚灵的幽体之手打击杀死的活体人形生物会在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{Wraith Spawn}{1d4轮}后起身，成为一个[[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]。该缚灵衍体受杀死它的惧栗缚灵的命令术支配。它没有吸取生命或缚灵衍体。如果该缚灵衍体的创造者死亡，缚灵衍体会成为一个完全成熟、具有自主性的缚灵；它恢复自由意志，并获得吸取生命和缚灵衍体。

A living humanoid slain by a wraith's spectral hand Strike rises as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.Gu0cJHGwPd547OtC]{Wraith Spawn} after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wraith Spawn Transformation]]{1d4 rounds}. This wraith spawn is under the command of the dread wraith that killed it. It doesn't have drain life or wraith spawn. If the creator of the wraith spawn dies, the wraith spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous wraith; it regains its free will and gains drain life and wraith spawn.

Dread Wraith.publicNotes:
这些由邪恶军阀或嗜血将军残留下来的威胁性灵体残骸，是高耸的幽魂，由幽影与死亡构成。和其他缚灵一样，惧栗缚灵会在世界的幽暗之地徘徊，但惧栗缚灵更可能进行更远距离的旅行，以散播恐惧或积累影响力；当它们穿越洒满阳光的土地时，往往会选择黑暗的林间空地或阴森的废墟作为落脚点。惧栗缚灵往往傲慢，很少与同类结成群体，而更倾向于用支配术统御普通的缚灵群。然而，格外强大的死灵法师或许能强迫成群的惧栗缚灵为其效力；而某个尤其恶毒的目标——例如根除一处光亮与生命的堡垒——也可能将数个惧栗缚灵吸引到一起，共同追求同一目的。

These menacing spiritual remnants of wicked warlords or bloodthirsty generals are towering specters of shadow and death. Like other wraiths, dread wraiths haunt the shadowy places of the world, but dread wraiths are more likely to travel greater distances to sow terror or amass influence, often sticking to dark glades or sinister ruins when journeying across sun-dappled lands. Dread wraiths tends to be arrogant and rarely form a pack with others of their kind, preferring instead to dominate groups of ordinary wraiths. A particularly powerful necromancer might compel packs of dread wraiths into service, however, while a particularly malevolent goal-such as to eradicate a bastion of light and life-might draw several dread wraiths together in a common purpose.
Dread Wraith.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality

Drow Hunter.name: 卓尔猎手 Drow Hunter

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗的帷幕，阻止光亮术穿透或在区域内散发。光亮术不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内时不会散发任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外。这也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它表现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗术。他们将透过黑暗术看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热火焰所勾勒。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。若这些生物为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}，则在受妖火术影响期间它们处于Concealed状态，而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮术，其中任意两个之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮术移动至多60英尺。每个光亮术必须保持在你120英尺内，并且与所有其他光亮术保持在10英尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子甲长衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭的箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行时由一端的箭羽保持稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有对抗精神的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Deft Evasion.name: 灵巧反射 Deft Evasion
Deft Evasion.description:
当猎人在反射豁免上掷骰获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功或大失败。

When the hunter rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Hunter's Wound.name: 猎手之伤 Hunter's Wound
Hunter's Wound.description:
频率 每轮一次

先决条件 猎人正持用一把装填为0的远程武器

效果 猎人对其猎物进行两次远程打击。若两次都命中并造成伤害，则目标额外承受 @Damage[1d8[bleed]]。

Frequency once per round

Prerequisites The hunter is wielding a ranged weapon with a reload of 0

Effect The hunter makes two ranged Strikes against their prey. If both hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]].

Skirmish Strike.name: 快速战斗 Skirmish Strike
Skirmish Strike.description:
猎人可以先进行一步再发动打击，或先发动打击再进行一步。

The hunter can Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

Drow Hunter.publicNotes:
猎人搜寻猎物，以维持卓尔社区的供给与运转。

由于在他们的主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔因而背负邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在脱离恶魔领主的阴险影响之后。

Hunters seek out game to keep drow communities fed and functioning.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Drow Hunter.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Drow Warden.name: 卓尔卫士 Drow Warden

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮穿透或在区域内发出。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会放出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制与你的黑暗术法术位阶相同或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你所选择颜色的、绚丽且不带热量的火焰勾勒轮廓。受妖火术影响时，可见的生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。若这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态，则它们在受妖火术影响时为 Concealed，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光球，任意两个之间的距离不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光球移动至多60英尺。每个光球必须保持在你120英尺内，且与所有其他光球之间的距离都在10英尺内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Elven Curve Blade.name: 精灵弯刃剑 Elven Curve Blade

Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由数件护甲组成，这些护甲由相互连接的小金属环编织成防护网。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对护臂和一顶护头巾，共同保护身体的大部分。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Lethargy Poison.name: 昏睡毒 Lethargy Poison
Lethargy Poison.description:
昏睡毒通常被卓尔以及其他希望让受害者活着的人用于打了就跑的战术；伏击者会撤退，直到毒素发作并让受害者陷入昏迷。进一步接触昏睡毒不需要目标进行额外的豁免；只有在对一次持续暴露进行的豁免中失败，才会推进其阶段。

启动 2 交互（伤害）

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

最大持续时间 4小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 迟缓 1（1分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（[[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4小时}）。

Lethargy poison is commonly used in hit-and-run tactics by drow and others who want their victims alive; the ambusher retreats until the poison sets in and the victim falls unconscious. Further exposure to lethargy poison does not require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing an saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Activate 2 Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 slowed 1 (1 minute)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}).

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Hampering Slash.name: 妨碍劈砍 Hampering Slash
Hampering Slash.description:
被守望者近战打击伤害的一个目标必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:21] 豁免，否则直到守望者下个回合结束前将陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

A target damaged by the warden's melee Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the warden's next turn.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
守望者对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}生物造成额外1d6伤害。

A warden deals an extra 1d6 damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Drow Warden.publicNotes:
卫士守望着卓尔营地，并且经常以小队形式行动。

卓尔因为在其主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔而享有邪恶的名声。然而，像任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以具有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

Wardens watch over drow encampments and often work in small groups.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Drow Warden.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Dulac.name: 杜拉克 Dulac

Occult Innate Spells.name: 神秘天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读机运 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥见未来。选择一个你计划在1周内参与的特定目标或行动，或一个你预期可能在1周内发生的事件。你会得知一条隐晦的线索或一段可能对所选事件有所帮助的建议，通常以押韵短句或征兆的形式呈现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语，让生物难以抗拒。你对目标施加一个行动方针的暗示术；其措辞必须使其在目标看来像是合乎逻辑的行动方针，且不能具有自我毁灭性，也不能明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是像平常一样在和它说话，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 目标立即遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成了一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得具有自我毁灭性，或出现其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的能力。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}状态，并且每轮只能将额外的动作用于打击和迈步动作。

升阶（第7环） 你可以以最多6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断目标的运动冲动，使其在离开其心智之前就被截断，威胁将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败的成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标在 1 轮内 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}。

大成功或大失败的失败 目标在 4 轮内麻痹。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功或大失败的成功时完全结束该效果。

强化（7环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触会汲取目标的生命之血以强化自身。你对目标造成 6d6 虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1 分钟后，你失去所有剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加 2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在区域内穿透或发散。光亮术无法进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发出任何光亮术，即使它们的光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。此效果也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它就像一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将通过这片黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术穿透或从该区域内向外散发。光亮术不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在该区域内也不会散发任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你该黑暗术的环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Ghoulish Cravings.name: 食腐渴望 Ghoulish Cravings
Ghoulish Cravings.description:
你接触目标，使其感染食尸鬼热，用饥饿与逐渐减弱的生命力能量联结侵蚀它；目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在阶段 1 感染食尸鬼热。

失败 目标在阶段 2 感染食尸鬼热。

大失败 目标在阶段 3 感染食尸鬼热。

食尸鬼热（疾病）；等级 3

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1 天）

阶段 2 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物从所有治疗中回复的生命值减半（1 天）

阶段 3 如阶段 2（1 天）

阶段 4 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1 天）

阶段 5 如阶段 4（1 天）

阶段 6 该生物死亡，并在下一个午夜以食尸鬼（特征）的形态复起

You touch the target to afflict it with ghoul fever, infesting it with hunger and a steadily decreasing connection to vitality energy; the target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 1.

Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 2.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 3.

Ghoul Fever (disease); Level 3

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 3d8 void damage and the creature regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 3d8 void damage and the creature gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 the creature dies and rises as a ghoul at the next midnight

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你召唤出一团薄雾。薄雾内的所有生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}，而薄雾外的所有生物对薄雾内的生物而言也变为隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的思绪蒙昧，并以一道心灵冲击使其眩晕。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免大失败，它还会受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

强化 (+2) 伤害提高 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你发出一道脉冲，用以确认是否存在魔法。你不会获得除魔法存在与否之外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在该幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环）你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果的魔法学派。若有多个效果强度相同，由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环）同3环，但你还会定位最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到5尺立方体范围内（或若目标大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，持续到你下个回合开始，但不需要一只手来使用。

在法术生效期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾术具有硬度5。在你使用Shield Block后，法术结束，并且你在10分钟内不能再次施放它。不同于普通的Shield Block，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环） 该护盾术具有硬度10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾术具有硬度15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾术具有硬度20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾术具有硬度25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一个在射程内、且负载为1或更低的松散且无人持用的物体掷向目标。进行一次法术攻击掷骰，对抗目标。如果你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你掷出的物体——数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响这次攻击或伤害。

大成功或大失败：成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子甲长袍，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Greater Darkvision.name: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

At-Will Spells.name: 随意法术 At-Will Spells
At-Will Spells.description:
杜拉克可以以任意意志次数施放她的法术，而无需消耗法术位。

Dulac can cast her at-will spells any number of times without using up spell slots.

Death Shadows.name: 死亡幽影 Death Shadows
Death Shadows.description:
当杜拉克死亡时，她的身体在一阵刺骨的幽影爆发中被摧毁。所有在@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物受到@Damage[8d8[cold]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]豁免）。

杜拉克的道具和宝藏不受幽影影响，并会留在她死亡之处堆成一堆。

When Dulac dies, her body is destroyed in a burst of chilling shadows. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[8d8[cold]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic] save).

Dulac's gear and treasure are unaffected by the shadows and are left in a pile where she died.

Opportune Step.name: 适时快步 Opportune Step
Opportune Step.description:
触发 一名 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 的生物，或具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness} 的生物，在其移动结束时停在与杜拉克相邻的位置

效果 杜拉克快步。

Trigger A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} creature, or a creature with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness}, ends its move adjacent to Dulac

Effect Dulac Steps.

Warding Shove.name: 防护推撞 Warding Shove
Warding Shove.description:
触发 杜拉克触及范围内的一名盟友成为她能看见的攻击者以远程或近战攻击为目标

效果 该盟友在对抗触发的攻击时获得AC+2环境加值，且该盟友可以在攻击后进行跨步。

Trigger An ally within Dulac's reach is targeted with a ranged or melee attack by an attacker she can see

Effect The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack, and the ally can Step after the attack.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
杜拉克对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。

Dulac deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Dulac.blurb:
女性卡林吉邪教领袖
Female caligni cult leader
Dulac.senses: 高等黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Elder Child of Belcorra.name: 贝科拉的长子 Elder Child of Belcorra
Elder Child of Belcorra.tokenName: 贝科拉的长子 Elder Child of Belcorra

Primal Prepared Spells.name: 原初预备法术 Primal Prepared Spells

Primal Innate Spells.name: 原初先天法术 Primal Innate Spells

Air Walk.name: 空中行走 Air Walk
Air Walk.description:
目标可以像在坚实地面上一样在空气中行走。它可以用这种方式以最多45度角上升和下降。

The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.

Freedom of Movement.name: 行动自如 Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
你排斥那些会妨碍生物或使其移动变慢的效果。在此法术效果持续期间，目标忽略那些会使其速度受到环境减值的效果。当其尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}一个令其处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}状态的效果时，除非该效果具有魔法性质且阶级高于行动自如法术，否则其自动成功。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

Plant Growth.name: 植物生长 Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
你使区域内的植物更健康、更具果实。除了健康植物的其他益处外，这还会根据你的成功程度提高农田的作物产量。如果你在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight} 的区域内施放该法术，植物生长会尝试反制该枯萎病，而不是产生其通常的效果。

大成功或大失败 将区域内的作物产量翻倍，或将区域扩大至1英里半径。

成功 将区域内的作物产量提高三分之一。

失败 该仪式没有效果。

大成功或大失败 区域内的植物群以一种出乎意料的方式发生变化，由GM决定，但通常会尽可能与您的真实愿望相悖（例如，当你更希望让作物更肥沃时，却使作物枯萎）。

You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful. In addition to other benefits of healthy plants, this increases the crop yield for farms, depending on your success. If you cast it in the area of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, plant growth attempts to counteract the blight instead of producing its usual effect.

Critical Success Double the crop yield in the area, or increase the area to a 1-mile radius.

Success Increase the crop yield in the area by one-third.

Failure The ritual has no effect.

Critical Failure The flora in the area changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, blighting crops when you would prefer to enrich them).

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标失明。该效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后该目标获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 直至其下一回合开始。

失败 目标失明1分钟。

大失败 目标永久失明。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚进一个符号来制作陷阱。在你施法该法术的同时，你也会施放一个更低法术环阶的法术并将其储存在刻文中。被储存的法术必须施放所需不超过3个动作，具有敌对效果，并以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设置一个口令、一个触发，或两者皆有。任何移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域且未说出口令或符合触发条件的生物，都会激活刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦有法术被储存在刻文中，刻文获得该法术的所有特征。若被储存的法术以一个或多个生物为目标，它以触发刻文的生物为目标。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。该刻文视为一个魔法陷阱，使用你的法术DC来进行用于察觉以注意到它的察觉检定，以及用于解除以停用它的巧手检定；两项检定都要求尝试者受训才能成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间内能维持激活状态的守卫刻文的最大数量等于你的施法关键能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Meld into Stone.name: 融入石中 Meld into Stone
Meld into Stone.description:
你与一块相邻的石块融合，该石块的体积足以容纳你以及你所穿戴与持有的物品。你在施放该法术时必须接触该石块。你能听见但无法看见石块外发生的事情，并且你在石块内仍可施放法术，只要这些法术不需要穿过石块之外的效果线。

当你在石块内时，若石块受到显著的物理伤害，你会被排出，并受到10d6伤害。穿墙术会将你排出而不造成伤害，并结束与石同在。你可以解消该法术。

You merge with an adjacent block of stone with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions. You must touch the stone when you Cast the Spell. You can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone, and you can cast spells while in the stone as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone.

Significant physical damage to the stone while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. Passwall expels you without dealing damage and ends one with stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

Acid Arrow.name: 酸液箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤出一支酸箭，在命中后仍持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成3d8点酸性伤害外加@Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]]伤害。大成功时，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

强化（+2） 初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸性伤害增加1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Barkskin.name: 树肤术 Barkskin
Barkskin.description:
目标的皮肤被树皮覆盖。目标获得对钝击与穿刺伤害的抗力2，以及对火焰的弱点3。目标在受到火焰伤害后，可以将受到该伤害作为触发条件，以自由动作（Dismiss）解除该法术；如此做不会减少目标所受到的火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

升阶（+2） 抗力各提高2，弱点提高3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

The target's skin becomes covered in bark. The target gains resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage and weakness 3 to fire. After the target takes fire damage, it can Dismiss the spell as a free action triggered by taking the damage; doing so doesn't reduce the fire damage the target was dealt.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

Heightened (+2) The resistances increase by 2, and the weakness increases by 3.

Entangle.name: 纠缠 Entangle
Entangle.description:
区域 以20英尺爆发为范围内所有包含植物或真菌的方格

区域内的植物和真菌会缠绕生物。该区域视为困难地形。每一轮，当生物在该区域内开始其回合时，它必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，它的速度在离开该区域之前受到-10英尺的环境减值；大失败时，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}状态，持续1轮。生物可以以缠绕的DC尝试逃脱以移除这些效果。

Area all squares in a 20-foot burst that contain plants or fungi

Plants and fungi in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

Glitterdust.name: 闪光尘 Glitterdust
Glitterdust.description:
区域内的生物被闪烁的尘埃勾勒出轮廓。每个生物都必须尝试一次反射豁免。若某个生物的隐形术被此法术抵消，则它改为处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。无论该生物原本已处于隐形，还是在此法术造成的隐形术抵消效果结束前从新的隐形术效果中获益，均适用此规则。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的隐形术被抵消，持续2轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 1分钟，并且其隐形术被抵消1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 1轮，并目眩10分钟。其隐形术被抵消10分钟。

Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This applies both if the creature was already Invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and Dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你溅出一团酸液，飞溅在你的目标及其附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6点酸蚀伤害外加1点飞溅酸蚀伤害。若大成功或大失败，目标还会承受@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]点伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至2d6，且持续伤害提高至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至3d6，持续伤害提高至3，且飞溅伤害提高至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至4d6，持续伤害提高至4，且飞溅伤害提高至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至5d6，持续伤害提高至5，且飞溅伤害提高至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一阵脉冲，感知魔法的存在。除了魔法是否存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只有在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若存在多个同等强度的效果，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 如同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。如同模糊感官，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若目标大于该范围，则为最接近的等效范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一个幻象，使你看起来像另一只体型结构相同、且与自身身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近的生物。这种伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而任何你取下的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装等同于为使用欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 行动建立伪装；它无视你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值，用于防止他人看穿你的伪装的欺瞒检定；并且即使你未受训，你也会加上你的等级。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能变成其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的吩咐。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从以下四个选项中选择一项。

  • 烹饪 使 1 磅的非生物材料变凉、变暖或调味。
  • 提起 缓慢将一个无人持用、负载为轻或更低的物体抬离地面 1 英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时物体，其负载可忽略不计，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体看起来粗糙且不自然，并且极其脆弱——不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮的专注影响一个负载为 1 的物体，影响更大的物体则每点负载需要 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或引发不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述所注明者）只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Produce Flame.name: 燃火术 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一团小小的火焰球出现在你的手心里，你用它进行一次近战或远程挥击。对你的目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对你徒手触及范围内的一名生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成2d4火焰伤害。大成功时，目标受到双倍伤害并受到@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]]伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d4，且大成功时的持续伤害增加1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。施法完成后，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法；如果有，你还会得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环级时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震颤感知（不精确）30尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Breath of the Bog.name: 沼泽之息 Breath of the Bog
Breath of the Bog.description:
30英尺。一名在其回合开始时位于该区域内的生物会感觉自己的肺正在灌满水，且必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免，否则将无法说话或呼吸。该生物仍然可以屏住呼吸，并且可以在其回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免。一名成功的生物会获得24小时的暂时免疫。

30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be unable to speak or breathe. Empty Death Bodak.publicNotes:
当一个活着的、有感知的类人生物接触到某种超自然邪恶的极端显现时，这种经历可能会不可逆转地令受害者堕入永罚：它碾碎其心智、撕裂其灵魂，并在一种令人作呕的亵渎转化中，使其变成一种对生命而言是禁忌的生物——波达尸。

在这种彻底腐化中残存的些许肉体碎片，只会进一步强化这类类人生物那极度令人不安的外貌。波达尸的躯体可怖地扭曲，仿佛永远锁死在痛苦与恐惧的痉挛之中。它干瘪、无毛的皮肉带着一种异界的珠光光泽，紧绷地裹在畸形的骷髅（特征）之上，使它的步态退化为缓慢术般的蹒跚拖行。但最令人毛骨悚然的还是它的双眼：嵌在一张下垂、如融化般的面孔里，旧日面部结构所剩无几。这双眼虽深陷眼眶，却仍以亵渎的光亮术发光，带着不息的恶意凝视，并不断淌出有毒的蒸汽。

过往存在的破碎记忆，被对活人的复仇憎恨所过滤，驱使波达尸试图回到它曾经熟悉的地方。若它得逞，便会以其凶杀性的凝视与一阵夹杂卑劣诅咒、指控与威胁、令人无法理解的胡言乱语洪流，袭击昔日的朋友、熟人与挚爱之人——这种袭击往往会导致受害者也在死后化为新生的波达尸。

When a living, sentient humanoid is exposed to an extreme expression of supernatural evil, the experience can irrevocably damn the victim, crushing their mind and ripping out their soul in an appalling, unholy transformation that results in a creature that's anathema to life-the bodak.

The shreds of physicality that survive this absolute corruption serve only to enhance the humanoid's profoundly disturbing appearance. The bodak's body is horrifically twisted, as though it's locked in a convulsion of agony and terror. Its desiccated and hairless flesh bears an otherworldly, pearlescent sheen, strung taut across a malformed skeleton that reduces its gait to a slow shamble. But most disturbing of all are its eyes, set in a drooping, melted visage with scant remains of its former facial structure. These eyes, sunken deep into their sockets, nevertheless glow with an unholy light, stare with unremitting malevolence, and constantly weep noxious vapor.

Fragmented memories of a prior existence filtered through a vengeful hatred of the living lead the bodak to try to return to those places it once knew. If successful, it assaults former friends, acquaintances, and loved ones with its murderous gaze and an incomprehensible torrent of gibberish laced with vile curses, accusations, and threats-an assault that often leads to the victims rising as newly formed bodaks themselves.

Ghonhatine.publicNotes:
在改造地蜥人（特征）时，卓尔塑肉者并非想创造一种新的生物类型，而是试图重现一种被认为已从格拉利昂彻底消失的地蜥人（特征）祖先形态。地蜥兽便是其结果——魁梧的爬行动物巨兽，更喜欢四肢着地爬行，并以兽性的狂怒撕扯它们的敌人。

这些可怖的憎邪由卑劣的炼金魔法重塑而成，此处呈现的两种塑肉造物由卓尔所创造；他们将俘获的精灵或地蜥人（特征）改造为扭曲的怪物，然后释放出去制造混乱与恐惧。

In transforming xulgaths, drow fleshwarpers sought not to create a new type of creature but to recapture a form of xulgath predecessor believed entirely vanished from Golarion. Ghonhatines are the result-hulking reptilian beasts who prefer to crawl on all fours and tear at their foes with bestial fury.

Horrid abominations reshaped by vile alchemical magic, the two fleshwarps presented here were created by drow, who transform captured elves or xulgaths into twisted monstrosities that can then be loosed to cause havoc and terror.

The spider can have one creature tethered at a time. The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} the web is 30. The tether can be severed with a Strike (AC 20, Hardness 5, HP 20), but this doesn't free the restrained creature.

Goliath Spider.publicNotes:
巨硕蜘蛛栖息在最深邃的丛林中，它们在那里结起如神殿般巨大的蛛网术，并以大如河马的猎物为食。

鲜有日常害虫能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛那样令人胆寒。

Goliath spiders dwell in the deepest jungles, where they build webs as big as temples and feast on prey as large as hippopotami.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.
