Freedom of Movement.name: 行动自如 Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
你能排斥那些会妨碍生物或减缓其移动的效果。在此法术的效果持续期间，目标无视那些会使其速度获得环境减值的效果。当他们试图@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}一个使其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}的效果时，他们自动成功，除非该效果是魔法且位阶高于行动自如法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Freedom of Movement}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the freedom of movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

Plant Growth.name: 植物生长 Plant Growth
Plant Growth.description:
你使区域内的植物更加健康且更具成果。除了健康植物的其他益处外，这会根据你的成功程度提高农场的作物产量。若你在 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight} 的区域内施放此法术，植物生长将尝试反制该枯萎病，而非产生其通常效果。

大成功或大失败 使区域内作物产量翻倍，或将区域扩大为半径1英里。

成功 使区域内作物产量提高三分之一。

失败 该仪式没有效果。

大成功或大失败 区域内的植物群以出乎意料的方式发生改变，由GM决定，但通常会尽可能与你的真实愿望相矛盾（例如，当你希望使作物更肥沃时，却反而使其枯萎）。

You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful. In addition to other benefits of healthy plants, this increases the crop yield for farms, depending on your success. If you cast it in the area of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, plant growth attempts to counteract the blight instead of producing its usual effect.

Critical Success Double the crop yield in the area, or increase the area to a 1-mile radius.

Success Increase the crop yield in the area by one-third.

Failure The ritual has no effect.

Critical Failure The flora in the area changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, blighting crops when you would prefer to enrich them).

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。该效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，直到其下个回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚进一个符号来制造一个陷阱。在施放该法术时，你还要施放一个更低法术环阶的法术以储存在刻文中。被储存的法术必须能在3个动作或更少动作内施放，具有敌对效果，且以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设置一个口令、一个触发，或两者皆有。任何生物只要移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，而其未说出口令或其行为符合触发条件，便会启动刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦有法术被储存在刻文中，刻文获得该法术的所有特征。若被储存的法术以一个或多个生物为目标，它就以触发刻文的生物为目标。若该法术具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。该刻文视为一个魔法陷阱，使用你的法术DC用于察觉检定以注意到它，以及用于盗窃检定以解除它；两项检定都要求尝试者受训才能成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间最多能保持生效的守卫刻文数量等于你的施法关键能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Meld into Stone.name: 融入石中 Meld into Stone
Meld into Stone.description:
你与一块相邻的石块融合，该石块具有足够的体积来容纳你以及你所穿戴与持有的物品。你在施放该法术时必须接触该石块。你能听见，但无法看见石块外发生的事情；你在石块内仍可施放法术，只要这些法术不需要穿过石块之外的效果线。

当你在其中时，若该石块受到显著的物理伤害，会将你排出并对你造成10d6伤害。穿墙术会将你排出但不造成伤害，并终止与石合一。你可以解消该法术。

You merge with an adjacent block of stone with enough volume to fit you and your worn and held possessions. You must touch the stone when you Cast the Spell. You can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone, and you can cast spells while in the stone as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone.

Significant physical damage to the stone while you are inside it expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. Passwall expels you without dealing damage and ends one with stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

Acid Arrow.name: 强酸箭 Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description:
你召唤一支酸箭，在命中后会持续腐蚀目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击。命中时，你造成 3d8 酸性伤害外加 @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] 伤害。大成功或大失败时，将初始伤害翻倍，但不翻倍持续伤害。

强化（+2） 初始伤害增加 2d8，持续酸性伤害增加 1d6。

You conjure an arrow of acid that keeps corroding the target after it hits. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d6[persistent,acid]] damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

Barkskin.name: 树肤术 Barkskin
Barkskin.description:
目标的皮肤被树皮覆盖。目标获得对钝击与穿刺伤害的抗力2，以及对火焰的弱点3。在目标受到火焰伤害后，它可以以受到该伤害为触发条件，用自由动作（）解消该法术；这么做不会减少目标所受到的火焰伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

升阶（+2） 抗力提高2，弱点提高3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

The target's skin becomes covered in bark. The target gains resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage and weakness 3 to fire. After the target takes fire damage, it can Dismiss the spell as a free action triggered by taking the damage; doing so doesn't reduce the fire damage the target was dealt.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HoOujAdQWCN4E6sQ]{Spell Effect: Oaken Resilience}

Heightened (+2) The resistances increase by 2, and the weakness increases by 3.

Entangle.name: 纠缠 Entangle
Entangle.description:
区域 以20英尺爆发为范围内所有包含植物或真菌的方格

区域内的植物与真菌会缠住生物。该区域视为困难地形。每一轮当一个生物在该区域内开始其回合时，它必须尝试一次反射豁免。失败时，它的速度在离开该区域前承受-10英尺环境减值；大成功或大失败时，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}，持续1轮。生物可以尝试以纠缠的DC进行逃脱，以移除这些效果。

Area all squares in a 20-foot burst that contain plants or fungi

Plants and fungi in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

Glitterdust.name: 闪光尘 Glitterdust
Glitterdust.description:
区域内的生物被闪烁的尘埃勾勒出轮廓。每个生物必须尝试一次反射豁免。若某个生物的隐形术被此法术抵消，它将处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态。无论该生物原本已经隐形，还是在此法术抵消隐形术效果结束前从新的隐形术效果中获益，此规则均适用。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的隐形术被抵消2轮。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} 1分钟，且其隐形术被抵消1分钟。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 1轮并目眩10分钟。其隐形术被抵消10分钟。

Creatures in the area are outlined by glittering dust. Each creature must attempt a Reflex save. If a creature has its invisibility negated by this spell, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This applies both if the creature was already Invisible and if it benefits from new invisibility effects before the end of the invisibility negation effect from this spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's invisibility is negated for 2 rounds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute and its invisibility is negated for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and Dazzled for 10 minutes. Its invisibility is negated for 10 minutes.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你泼洒出一团酸液，飞溅在你的目标和附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6点酸液伤害外加1点飞溅酸液伤害。在大成功或大失败时，目标还会受到@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]点伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提升至2d6，且持续伤害提升至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提升至3d6，持续伤害提升至3，且飞溅伤害提升至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提升至4d6，持续伤害提升至4，且飞溅伤害提升至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提升至5d6，持续伤害提升至5，且飞溅伤害提升至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你放出一道脉冲，以感知魔法的存在。除了魔法存在与否之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你和你盟友的魔法物品以及正在持续的法术。

你只有在该幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。然而，带有幻术灵光但外观并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同样强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环等级，但你还会定位最高等级魔法的来源。与模糊感官类似，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体范围内（或若其大于该范围，则定位到最近的一个）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一个幻象，使你看起来像另一个体型相同的生物，并且与自身身高（相差不超过6英寸）和体重（相差不超过50磅）大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一条连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，而任何你脱下的穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为使用欺瞒进行的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 行动设置了伪装；它无视你因将自己伪装成不相似生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它使你在防止他人看穿你的伪装的欺瞒检定上获得+4状态加值，并且即使你未受训也要加上你的等级。你可以解除该法术。

升阶（2环） 该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

升阶（3环） 你可以看起来像任何体型相同的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体，才能呈现其外观。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）特征。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Prestidigitation.name: 魔法伎俩 Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
最简单的魔法会听从你的差遣。只要你维持该法术，你就能施展简单的魔法效果。每次你维持该法术时，你可以从四个选项中选择其一。

  • 烹煮 冷却、加热或为 1 磅的非生物材料调味。
  • 提起 缓慢地将一个无人持用、负载为轻或更低的物体从地面抬起 1 英尺。
  • 制造 创造一个临时的、负载可忽略不计的物体，由凝结的魔法物质制成。该物体看起来粗糙且人造，并且极其脆弱——它不能用作工具、武器或法术成分。
  • 整理 为一个负载为轻或更低的物体上色、清洁或弄脏。你可以用 10 轮的专注影响一个负载为 1 的物体，而更大的物体则需要每点负载 1 分钟。

魔法伎俩不能造成伤害或导致不利状态。对物体的任何实际改变（超出上述注明者）都只会在你维持该法术期间持续。

The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the Spell. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or spell component.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object a 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the Spell.

Produce Flame.name: 燃火术 Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
一团小火球出现在你手掌中，你可以用它进行近战或远程攻击。针对你目标的AC进行一次法术攻击掷骰。这通常是一次远程攻击，但你也可以对处于你徒手触及内的一名生物进行一次近战攻击。

成功时，你造成2d4火焰伤害。大成功或大失败时，目标承受双倍伤害并承受 @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] 伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d4，且在大成功或大失败的重击时造成的持续伤害增加1d4。

A small ball of flame appears in the palm of your hand, and you lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a spell attack roll against your target's AC. This is normally a ranged attack, but you can also make a melee attack against a creature in your unarmed reach.

On a success, you deal 2d4 fire damage. On a critical success, the target takes double damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] damage.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 1d4 and the persistent damage on a critical hit by 1d4.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开心灵以感知魔法灵光。当施放完成时，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法；若是，你将得知其魔法学派。

如果该物体是幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你阅读灵光法术的阶位时，你才会侦测到这一点。

增幅（3环） 你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

增幅（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet.name: 震感（不精确）30 尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 30 feet

Breath of the Bog.name: 沼泽吐息 Breath of the Bog
Breath of the Bog.description:
30英尺。回合开始时位于该区域内的生物会感觉仿佛肺部正在灌满水，并且必须在一次@Check[fortitude|dc:28]豁免中成功，否则将无法说话或呼吸。该生物仍然可以屏住呼吸，并且可以在其回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免。豁免成功的生物在24小时内暂时免疫。

30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new save at the end of its turn. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Rise Up.name: 崛起 Rise Up
Rise Up.description:
触发 一个生物走到埋在下方泥浆或泥炭中的沼泽木乃伊（特征）上方

需求 尚未掷出先攻

效果 沼泽木乃伊（特征）自动注意到该生物，并在掷先攻之前掘地。

Trigger A creature walks on top of a bog mummy that lies buried in the mud or peat below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

Effect The bog mummy automatically notices the creature and Burrows before rolling initiative.

Bog Rot.name: 沼腐症 Bog Rot
Bog Rot.description:
这种苦难无法被降低至低于阶段 1，在使用移除诅咒或类似效果成功治疗之前，其造成的伤害也无法被治愈；此后，该苦难便可如同疾病一般正常移除。被沼腐症杀死的生物会融化成有毒的烂泥，除非通过 7 环的起死回生仪式或类似魔法，否则无法起死回生

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

阶段 1 携带者且无不良效果（1 分钟）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] 伤害与 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}（1 天）

This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with remove curse or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease. A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank resurrect ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 day)

Gorsalthith.blurb:
变体 泥沼木乃伊（特征）
Variant bog mummy

Huglu.name: 胡格鲁 Huglu

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一名濒死的生物的生命熄灭。该目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若这将其杀死，你获得10点临时HP，以及在10分钟内对攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Feather Fall (Self only).name: 羽落术（仅自身） Feather Fall (Self only)
Feather Fall (Self only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你使空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落减缓至每轮60英尺，并且在法术持续时间内发生的那段坠落在计算坠落伤害时不计入其中。如果目标在法术效果生效期间到达地面，它不会因这次坠落而受到伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道具有削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你在你的攻击掷骰上大成功或大失败，则使用其豁免结果中低一个成功等级的结果。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray with the power to sap a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save in order to determine the spell's effect. If you critically succeed on your attack roll, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这件皮革护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还附有小型金属板，在保有皮革护甲大部分灵活性的同时提供更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭杆由木材制成。箭在一端有羽翎以在飞行中保持稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，其隐形的血肉会迅速腐烂并升华为恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这种气体会对该区域内的生物造成 @Damage[3d6[void]] 伤害，因为它们的血肉也会随之凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] 豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[3d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save).

Ravenous Attack.name: 贪婪攻击 Ravenous Attack
Ravenous Attack.description:
透肌魔人对单一生物进行一次双叉剑打击和一次啃咬打击。在完成两次攻击后，它的多重攻击减值才会增加。

The urdefhan makes one rhoka sword Strike and one jaws Strike against a single creature. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用啃咬打击对生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物的血肉在伤口部位周围变得半透明。透肌魔人从两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:20] 豁免。若该啃咬打击为大成功或大失败命中，则该生物同时承受两个效果，并对两个效果使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 透肌魔人饮下该生物的一些血液。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} 且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[5[healing]] HP（或在大成功或大失败失败时，该生物改为获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} 且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 透肌魔人抽取该生物的一些生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败失败时改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} 持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Huglu.publicNotes:
从他们出生的那一刻起，透肌魔人就为战争做好了准备。透肌魔人武者是你在他们那诡异的地下城市之外可能遭遇的最不强大的透肌魔人之一。

From the moment they are born, urdefhans are prepared for war. Urdefhan warriors are among the least powerful urdefhans one might encounter outside of their eerie underground cities.
Huglu.senses: 强化黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Hunting Spider.name: 猎蛛 Hunting Spider

Web Sense.name: 蛛网感知 Web Sense
Web Sense.description:
猎蛛拥有不精确的震动感知，用以侦测触碰其蛛网术的生物所产生的振动。

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

The hunting spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

Spring Upon Prey.name: 猛扑猎物 Spring Upon Prey
Spring Upon Prey.description:
需求 尚未掷先攻。

触发 当猎蛛在蛛网术上时，一名生物触碰了猎蛛的蛛网术。

效果 猎蛛在掷先攻前自动注意到该生物，并在蛛网术上自动进行疾走、攀爬或下降。

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled.

Trigger A creature touches the hunting spider's web while the spider is on it.

Effect The hunting spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.

Descend on a Web.name: 降落于蛛网术上 Descend on a Web
Descend on a Web.description:
猎蛛沿直线向下移动至多40尺，由一根蛛网术丝线悬吊。它可以悬挂在蛛网术上或脱离坠落。它在蛛网术上下降的距离不计入坠落伤害。

成功打击蛛网术（AC 20，硬度 3，5 HP）的生物会将其切断，导致蜘蛛坠落。

The hunting spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage.

A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 3, 5 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.

Hunting Spider Venom.name: 猎蛛毒 Hunting Spider Venom
Hunting Spider Venom.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] 伤害并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}，并措手不及（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] 伤害、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}，并措手不及（1 轮）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and off-guard (1 round)

Web Trap.name: 网捕 Web Trap
Web Trap.description:
被猎蛛的蛛网术打击命中的生物会陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} 状态，并被粘在最近的表面上，直到它 [[/act escape dc=17]]{逃脱（DC 17）}。

A creature hit by the hunting spider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=17]]{Escapes (DC 17)}.

Hunting Spider.publicNotes:
猎蛛是巨蛛中最常见的种类，尽管并非最大。

在日常害虫中，鲜有能像臭名昭著的蜘蛛那样引发如此强烈的恐惧。

Hunting spiders are the most common type of giant spider, though not the largest.

Few everyday vermin inspire as much dread as the infamous spider.

Iribo.name: 伊瑞铂 Iribo

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮术不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会散发任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本会延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你黑暗术的法术环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热的火焰勾勒轮廓。可见的生物在受到妖火术影响时不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。如果这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态，它们在受到妖火术影响时会处于 Concealed 状态，而不是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮，它们之间任意两者相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样散发光亮。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮移动最多60英尺。每个光亮必须保持在你120英尺范围内并且与所有其他光亮相距不超过10英尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Repeating Hand Crossbow.name: 连发手弩 Repeating Hand Crossbow
Repeating Hand Crossbow.description:
装填 2 用于弹匣装填（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier}）

Reload 2 for magazine reload (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier})

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮制护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还会加装小型金属板，在提供与皮制护甲相近的大部分灵活性的同时，提供更为坚实的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Shootist Bandolier.name: 射手弹带 Shootist Bandolier
Shootist Bandolier.description:
这条皮制射手弹带可在会因拇指快速一拨而弹开的皮革口袋中容纳最多三个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines}。你将从弹带取出连发手弩弹匣为连发手弩进行装填所需的时代减少 1，总计为 2 个动作。你一次只能穿戴一条射手弹带。

This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
启动 2 互动

迷梦毒是对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison} 的更强效蒸馏。对迷梦毒的进一步暴露不需要 目标 进行额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露的豁免投掷中失败，才会推进其 阶段。

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

最大持续时间 6 小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} 和 措手不及（1 轮）

Shootist's Luck.name: 射手的幸运 Shootist's Luck
Shootist's Luck.description:
触发 神射手豁免失败

频率 每日一次

效果 神射手重骰该豁免，并使用较好的结果。

Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

Distracting Shot.name: 干扰射击 Distracting Shot
Distracting Shot.description:
射手瞄准并进行一次远程打击。如果该攻击命中并造成伤害，则目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 直到射手的回合结束；若为大成功或大失败命中，则持续到射手下个回合结束。

The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 射手正持有一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 射手通过交互来装填连发手弩并用其进行打击。

Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 射手交互以抽出一把连发手弩并用其进行打击，或用其正持有的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后交互将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
射手对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外2d6精准伤害。

The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Iribo.publicNotes:
极少数专精于连发手弩命令术的卓尔，不仅因其技能而受人敬重，也因其好运与傲气而受人敬重。

由于在他们主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔以邪恶闻名。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

The rare few drow who specialize in the repeating hand crossbow command respect not only for their skills but for their luck and swagger.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Iribo.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Pain Frenzy.description:
每当克鲁斯因大成功重击而受到伤害时，它在其下个回合结束前获得+2状态加值于攻击和伤害掷骰。在此狂乱持续期间，它不能使用反应动作（）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.tJx9B2e3AET6PbJD]{Effect: Pain Frenzy}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.tJx9B2e3AET6PbJD]{Effect: Pain Frenzy}

Whenever the krooth is damaged by a critical hit, it gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of its next turn. It can't use reactions while this frenzy lasts.

Poison Tooth.name: 毒牙 Poison Tooth
Poison Tooth.description:
需求 该克鲁斯特在其本回合最近一次动作中用其啃咬对一个生物造成了伤害；

效果 该克鲁斯特将自己的一颗牙折断并留在它命中的生物体内。该生物受到 @Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6 persistent bleed damage} 并陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}。在牙齿仍留在体内期间，双方都无法被治疗。

安全地移除该牙齿需要进行一次成功的 @Check[medicine|dc:26|traits:action:administer-first-aid] 检定以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}。这不会终止流血或使其稳定，而是移除该牙齿与流失（状态），但它不会自动终止流血伤害。

Requirements The krooth damaged a creature with its jaws on its most recent action this turn;

Effect The krooth snaps off one of its teeth in the creature it hit. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[bleed]]{1d6 persistent bleed damage} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. Neither can be healed while the tooth remains.

Removing the tooth safely requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:26|traits:action:administer-first-aid] check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}. Instead of ending bleeding or stabilizing, this removes the tooth and the drained condition, but it doesn't automatically end the bleed damage.

Krooth.publicNotes:
克鲁斯，有时也被称为食鳄者，是沼泽与湿地中迅捷而凶残的猎手。尽管它们以猎食并吞吃鳄鱼、短吻鳄，以及几乎任何有血有肉的生物而闻名，但它们最偏爱的猎物是蜥蜴人、沼蜍人（特征）与恐龙。

克鲁斯既可能独自出没，也可能成群行动。雄性克鲁斯是独居且领地性强的生物——凶猛、大胆、嗜血。相对地，雌性克鲁斯更可能回避潜在的掠食者，但一旦它们的育雏群受到威胁，便会迅速变得暴烈。由于它们的幼体极其脆弱，雌性克鲁斯会聚集成群来抚育幼崽，派出较小的小队外出觅食，而其余族群则守护育雏群。克鲁斯每4或5年才交配一次，而其交配过程是一场离奇而血腥的景象。整群雌性会结队狩猎一只落单的雄性克鲁斯，在一场可能持续整整一日一夜的狂乱中夺取她们的“奖品”。交配结束后，雌性会杀死配偶并吞食其富含营养的血肉，尤其是其内脏。这些器官含有一种独特的化学化合物，对妊娠至关重要。许多博物学者会为新鲜的雄性克鲁斯遗骸支付高价，以便研究这种生物血液与器官的奇异性质。此外，克鲁斯拥有带毒的中空牙齿。当这些生物咬住猎物时，一枚牙齿会折断并留在伤口内，使受害者大量出血，因为血液会通过那枚中空的牙齿涌出。

无论雄性还是雌性，克鲁斯似乎都会被类地精的肉所排斥，尤其是熊地精（特征）的肉。这并不意味着克鲁斯不会杀死类地精，尤其是那些威胁其幼崽的个体；但它们通常只用爪与尾巴来完成杀戮，并且在这种击杀之后会格外小心地把自己彻底清理干净。

Krooths, sometimes called crocodile eaters, are fast and vicious hunters of bogs and wetlands. While they are known to hunt and eat crocodiles, alligators, and virtually any creature with flesh, their favorite prey are lizardfolk, boggards, and dinosaurs.

Krooths are found alone or in packs. Male krooths are solitary and territorial creatures—fierce, bold, and bloodthirsty. Female krooths, on the other hand, are more likely to shy away from potential predators but swiftly turn violent when their brood is threatened. Because their offspring are so vulnerable, female krooths gather in packs to raise their young, sending smaller groups to hunt for food while the rest of the pack watches the brood. Krooths mate only once every 4 or 5 years, and the mating process is a curiously gruesome spectacle. An entire pack of females will hunt as a group for a lone male krooth, claiming their prize in a frenzy that can last for an entire day and night. After the mating has finished, the females slay their mate and devour his nutrientrich flesh, and his organs in particular. These organs contain a unique chemical compound vital to gestation. Many naturalists will pay handsomely for the fresh remains of a male krooth so they can study the strange properties of the creature's blood and organs. In addition, krooths have poisonous, hollow teeth. When these creatures bite their prey, a tooth breaks off and causes the victim to bleed profusely as their blood pours through the hollow tooth.

Whether male or female, krooths seem to be repelled by goblinoid flesh, especially that of bugbears. This doesn't mean krooths won't kill goblinoids, especially those threatening their young, but they typically do so using only their claws and tails, and they take great care to clean themselves thoroughly after such a killing.
Krooth.allSaves: +4 status to all saves vs. fear

Occult Innate Spells.name: 异术天生法术 Occult Innate Spells

Hallucination.name: 镜花水月 Hallucination
Hallucination.description:
目标会持续将一件事物识别为另一件事物、无法侦测到实际存在的事物，或侦测到并不存在的事物，不过这不会改变其信念。你选择以上哪一种效果适用，并由你决定镜花水月的具体内容。例如，你可以让目标把所有精灵看成是人类、无法侦测到其兄弟的存在、即使护身上并没有也仍看见自己心爱的幸运护符，或看见城镇中心有一座高塔。

目标可以尝试一次初始意志豁免，效果如下。每当其进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 或直接与镜花水月互动时，也会获得一次意志豁免以不相信该镜花水月。例如，目标每次与精灵互动、意外撞到其兄弟、尝试查看其护符或研究那座高塔时，都可以尝试不相信该镜花水月。在由 GM 决定的情境下，目标尝试不相信时可以获得一个很大的环境加值，例如目标试图攀爬那座并不存在的高塔时。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到其不相信为止，但它知道镜花水月是什么。

失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到其不相信为止。

大失败 该生物会感知到你所选择的内容，直到其不相信为止，并且它信任自己虚假的感官，对不相信的豁免承受 -4 环境减值。

升阶（6环） 选择其一：将目标改为至多 10 个生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为直到你的下次每日准备。

升阶（8环） 选择其一：将目标改为任意数量的生物，或将该法术的持续时间改为无限。

The target consistently detects one thing as another, can't detect something that's there, or detects something that's not there, though it doesn't alter their beliefs. You choose which of these effects applies, and you determine the specifics of the hallucination. For example, you could make the target see all elves as humans, be unable to detect the presence of their brother, see their beloved good luck charm on their person even when it isn't, or see a tower in the center of town.

The target can attempt an initial Will save, with effects below. They also receive a Will save to disbelieve the hallucination every time they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or directly interact with the hallucination. For example, the target could attempt to disbelieve the hallucination each time they interacted with an elf, bumped into their brother accidentally, tried to check their charm, or studied the tower. The target can attempt to disbelieve with a large circumstance bonus in situations determined by the GM, such as if the target attempted to climb the nonexistent tower.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, but it knows what the hallucination is.

Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves.

Critical Failure The creature perceives what you chose until it disbelieves, and it trusts its false senses, taking a -4 circumstance penalty to saves to disbelieve.

Heightened (6th) Choose to either target up to 10 creatures or change the spell's duration to until your next daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) Choose to either target any number of creatures or change the spell's duration to unlimited.

Mind Probe.name: 精神质询 Mind Probe
Mind Probe.description:
你将思绪投向一名生物的心智，筛选其中的信息。你可以获取目标的记忆与知识，除非它以一次意志豁免将你挡开。

成功目标不受影响。

失败在法术持续时间的每一轮中，你都可以维持该法术来提出一个不同的问题，并尝试揭示答案。对于每个问题，目标都可以尝试一次欺瞒检定，对抗你的法术DC；若目标成功，你就无法得知答案；若为大成功或大失败中的大成功，目标会给出一个你认为是真实的虚假答案。一旦你向目标提出过某个特定问题，再次询问该问题，即使是通过另一次精神质询的单独施放，也会产生相同的结果。

大成功或大失败中的大失败同失败，并且目标在针对你的问题进行欺瞒检定时承受–4环境减值。

You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Wave of Despair.name: 绝望灵光之波 Wave of Despair
Wave of Despair.description:
你对区域内的生物施加绝望灵光。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功或大失败 成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作（），并且必须在其回合开始时再尝试一次豁免；若失败，则该回合中其获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，因为它无法控制地抽泣。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，且该生物在1分钟内自动处于slowed 1。

升阶（7环） 区域增加为一个60尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇异的冲动使你的目标陷入迷乱，使其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}，持续1分钟。它可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以终止该困惑术。

大成功或大失败 目标陷入困惑术，持续1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Flicker.name: 闪动 Flicker
Flicker.description:
你在当前位面与另一个位面之间快速闪动。你获得对所有伤害的抗力5，力场伤害除外。在你的每个回合结束时，你会自动向随机方向传送10英尺，方向由GM决定。你可以维持该法术以用这种方式传送。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

升阶（+2） 该抗力增加3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

Nightmare.name: 梦魇术 Nightmare
Nightmare.description:
你对你的目标施放令人不安的梦魇术。下次目标入睡时，它必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果你只知道目标的名字且从未见过它，目标在此次意志豁免上获得+4环境加值。

大成功 目标不受任何不利效果，并在1周内暂时免疫。

成功 目标经历梦魇术，但除不愉快的记忆外不承受任何不利效果。

失败 目标经历梦魇术，并醒来时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}。

大失败 目标经历梦魇术，醒来时处于Fatigued，并在其不再处于Fatigued之前处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}。

You send disturbing nightmares to your target. The next time the target falls asleep, it must attempt a Will save. If you know the target only by name and have never met them, the target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to the Will save.

Critical Success The target suffers no adverse effects and is temporarily immune for 1 week.

Success The target experiences the nightmares but suffers no adverse effects other than unpleasant memories.

Failure The target experiences the nightmares and awakens @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure The target experiences the nightmares, awakens Fatigued, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until it is no longer Fatigued.

Dream Message.name: 梦境传讯术 Dream Message
Dream Message.description:
你将一则传讯术送入你的目标的梦境。传讯术是单向的，最多可持续 1 分钟的讲话（约 150 个词）。如果目标正在睡觉，他们会立刻收到传讯术。如果不是，他们会在下次入睡时收到。一旦他们收到传讯术，法术即结束，而你知道传讯术已送达。

升阶（4环） 你可以以最多 10 个你知道其名字且曾亲自见过的生物为目标。你必须向他们所有人发送同一则传讯术；法术对每个生物分别结束

You send a message to your target's dream. The message is one-way, up to 1 minute of speech (roughly 150 words). If the target is asleep, they receive the message instantly. If not, they receive it the next time they sleep. As soon as they receive it, the spell ends, and you know the message was sent.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 creatures you know by name and have met in person. You must send the same message to all of them; the spell ends for each creature individually

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意） Mind Reading (At Will)
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的思维。它必须进行一次意志豁免。随后，目标在1小时内暂时免疫你的读心术。

大成功 当你施放法术时，目标从你这里感知到模糊的表层想法。

成功 你会得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你从目标那里感知到模糊的表层想法，并且你会得知其智力是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大失败 同失败，并且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层想法。目标不会再获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).name: 隐形术（意志，自身限定） Invisibility (At Will, Self Only)
Invisibility (At Will, Self Only).description:
幻术扭曲目标周围的光线，使其变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这会使其对所有生物而言都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对它们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} 状态。若目标使用敌对动作，则在该敌对动作完成后法术结束。

升阶（4环） 法术持续1分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声用嘴型说出话语，但这些话并不会从你的口中发出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听到你的话并不会比你平常做口型时更清楚，但目标听到你的话就像他们正站在你身旁一样。目标可以以反应动作（）做出简短回应，或者如果他们愿意，也可以在他们的下个回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且处于射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，他们的回应会像最初的传讯术一样直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加到500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你将注意力集中在目标物体上，敞开心扉感知魔法灵光。施放完成后，你会知道该物品是否具有魔法。你或任何你就该灵光给予建议的人，在该物品上进行 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} 时获得+2环境加值。如果该物体是幻觉，你只有在该效果的环位低于你的阅读灵光法术的环位时才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你可以以最多10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法的力场护盾术。这算作用了“举起护盾术”动作，使你在你的下一回合开始前获得 AC +1 环境加值，但它不需要占用一只手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术具有 硬度 5。你可以使用该法术的反应动作（）来减少来自任何法术或魔法效果的伤害，即使其不造成物理伤害也可以。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（+2） 护盾术的 硬度 增加 5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

Telekinetic Hand.name: 念动力之手 Telekinetic Hand
Telekinetic Hand.description:
你创造一只漂浮的魔法之手，可以是隐形的或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并用浮空术使其缓慢地向任意方向移动最多20英尺。当你维持该法术时，你可以使物体额外移动20英尺。如果法术结束时物体仍在空中，则物体坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以将负载为1或更少的无人持用物体作为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以将负载为1或更少的无人持用物体作为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，且你可以将负载为2或更少的无人持用物体作为目标。

You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Mind Crush.name: 精神粉碎 Mind Crush
Mind Crush.description:
需求 虐戾怪擒抱了一名生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

效果 虐戾怪将手探入被擒抱生物的心智，植入受害者最可怕的恐惧与梦魇术的支离破碎影像。被擒抱生物受到 @Damage[6d6[mental]] 伤害，并进行一次 @Check[will|dc:31|basic] 意志豁免。若为大失败，目标也会如同受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind} 的影响，并且必须针对该效果再进行一次第二次意志豁免。

Requirements The nilith has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The nilith reaches into the mind of the grabbed creature and implants disjointed images of the victim's worst fears and nightmares. The grabbed creature takes @Damage[6d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:31|basic] save. On a critical failure, the target is also affected as though by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5BbU1V6wGSGbrmRD]{Never Mind}, and it must attempt a second Will save against that effect.

Nilith.publicNotes:
光滑、深色的虐戾怪看起来像无毛、瘦骨嶙峋的树懒。这些生物极其危险而可怖，拥有发光的红眼、邪恶的利爪，以及长满针状牙齿的口器。虐戾怪以活物的情绪、恐惧术与血肉为食，民间传说认为，那些梦见这些生物、陷入梦魇术的人，注定终有一日会被它们吞噬。虐戾怪从折磨有智慧的生物中获得强烈的快感，常将捕食目标集中在虔诚者与正义之士身上，从他们身上引出最本能的恐惧与最阴暗的念头，并沉溺于受害者随后爆发的惊惧之中。更多时候，这些卑劣的操纵者希望将受害者逼入疯狂，甚至走向自杀。大多数虐戾怪缺乏耐心，无法花太多时间彻底摧毁某个人；当一只虐戾怪厌倦了眼前的玩物，对其特定的念头与恐惧感到无聊时，它便会在啃食其血肉之前先杀死猎物，然后转向下一名受害者。

虐戾怪实际上是栖居于梦境之外、某个遥远异维度中更致命生物的延伸——从某种意义上说，虐戾怪不过是与其相连的未知异界实体的远程进食机器。学者与跨维旅行者曾试图揭开这种神秘联系的确切机制，但至今仍未破译真相。确实，许多试图调查虐戾怪纽带本质的人，还没接近答案便已被逼疯。与异界存在的这种怪异连接或许能解释这些生物的长寿，因为人们相信虐戾怪可以存活数千年。

所幸对其他人而言，虐戾怪是独居的生物，憎恨同类的陪伴——很可能是因为这些梦魇术的预兆者并不希望品尝自己带给他人的恐怖。

The sleek, dark niliths resemble hairless, emaciated tree sloths. These creatures are intensely dangerous and fearsome, with glowing red eyes, wicked claws, and mouths full of needlelike teeth. Niliths feed off the emotions, fears, and flesh of the living, and folktales posit that those who have nightmares of these creatures are fated to one day be eaten by them. Niliths draw intense joy from tormenting sapient creatures, often focusing their predations on the pious and the just, from whom they draw forth their most basic fears and worst thoughts and revel in their victims' subsequent terror. More often than not, these despicable manipulators wish to drive their victims into madness and even to suicide. Most niliths lack the patience to spend too much time fully tearing down an individual, and when a nilith tires of its current plaything and becomes bored with its particular thoughts and fears, it murders the quarry before feeding on its flesh and moving onto the next victim.

Niliths are actually extensions of much deadlier creatures that dwell in a distant dimension beyond dreams—in a way, niliths are little more than remote feeding machines for the unknown alien entities to which they are connected. Scholars and dimensional travelers have attempted to uncover the exact mechanisms of this mysterious connection, but they have yet to decipher the truth. Indeed, many who investigate the nature of a nilith's bond are driven to madness before getting anywhere close. The odd connection to otherworldly beings might help explain the longevity of these creatures, as it is believed that niliths can live for thousands of years.

Thankfully for others, niliths are solitary creatures that hate the company of their own kind, likely because these harbingers of nightmares have no wish to taste the horrors they bring to others.

Owb.name: 幽暗之魂 Owb

Occult Innate Spells.name: 天赋秘法法术 Occult Innate Spells

Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The.name: 位面转移（仅自身）（仅往返幽影位面） Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The Shadow Plane Only)
Plane Shift (Self Only) (To Or From The.description:
你和你的盟友穿越存在诸位面之间的屏障。各个目标移动到另一个位面，例如火元素位面、冥界或外层裂隙。你必须对目的地位面具备特定知识，并使用一枚由该位面的材料制成的魔法调谐音叉，作为该法术的法器。尽管多数著名位面的调谐音叉都较为罕见，就像法术位面转移一样，但更为晦涩的位面与半位面往往拥有稀有的调谐音叉。该法术极不精确，你会出现在距离上一次某个目标（由你选择）最后一次旅行至该位面时所在位置1d20x25英里之处。若对所有目标而言都是第一次前往某个位面，你会出现在该位面的一个随机地点。位面转移并不提供返程旅行的手段，不过再次施放位面转移能让你返回先前的位面，除非存在特殊情况。

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must have specific knowledge of the destination plane and use a magic tuning fork created from material from that plane as a focus for the spell. While the tuning forks for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell plane shift, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare tuning forks. The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20x25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Plane shift doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting plane shift again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

Shadow Blast.name: 幽影爆破 Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
你将幽影位面的半真实物质塑造成一次爆发。选择酸蚀、钝击、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、穿刺、挥砍或音波伤害，并选择一个@Template[cone|distance:30]、一个位于120尺内的@Template[burst|distance:15]或一个@Template[line|distance:50]。爆发对区域内每个生物造成你所选类型的5d8伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You shape the quasi-real substance of the Shadow Plane into a blast. Choose acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, slashing, or sonic damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 5d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Shadow Walk.name: 幽影漫步 Shadow Walk
Shadow Walk.description:
你获得进入幽影位面的许可，利用其扭曲的本质来延展你的旅行。目标进入幽影位面的边缘地带，在那里它与材料位面接壤。目标在幽影位面时无法看见材料位面（尽管该位面的要素有时会是材料位面的朦胧倒影）。当处于幽影位面时，目标会暴露于与该位面居民发生潜在遭遇的风险。位面之间边界上的幽影会扭曲空间，使你相对于材料位面的移动加速。每当目标沿着这条边界旅行3分钟，他们移动的距离相当于在材料位面中1小时所能行进的距离。任何时候，目标都可以解消该法术的效果，不过这只影响该目标。幽影的扭曲并不精确，因此当法术结束时，目标会在材料位面上出现在距离其预定地点约1英里处（不过，那些一同旅行并在幽影位面的同一点解消法术的人会一起出现）。

You access the Shadow Plane, using its warped nature to spread your travels. The targets enter the edge of the Shadow Plane where it borders the Material Plane. Targets can't see the Material Plane while on the Shadow Plane (although elements of that plane can sometimes be a hazy reflection of the Material Plane). While on the Shadow Plane, the targets are exposed to potential encounters with that plane's denizens. The shadows on the border between the planes bend space, speeding up your movement with respect to the Material Plane. Every 3 minutes the targets travel along this border, they move as far as they would through the Material Plane in 1 hour. At any point, a target can Dismiss the spell's effects, although this affects only that target. The shadow bending is inexact, so when the spell ends, the targets appear roughly 1 mile from their intended location on the Material Plane (though those who are traveling together and Dismiss the spell at the same point on the Plane of Shadow appear together).

Mind Reading (At Will).name: 读心术（随意） Mind Reading (At Will)
Mind Reading (At Will).description:
通过一次粗略的精神接触，你尝试读取目标的心智。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。随后，该目标在1小时内对你的读心术获得暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 成功 当你施放法术时，目标会从你这里感知到模糊的表层思绪。

成功 你得知目标的智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

失败 当你施放法术时，你会从目标那里感知到模糊的表层思绪，并且你得知其智力调整值是高于、等于还是低于你的。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，且在法术的持续时间内，你可以维持该法术以再次侦测目标的表层思绪。目标不会获得任何额外的豁免。

With a cursory mental touch, you attempt to read the target's mind. It must attempt a Will save. The target then becomes temporarily immune to your mind reading for 1 hour.

Critical Success The target perceives vague surface thoughts from you when you Cast the Spell.

Success You find out whether the target's Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Failure You perceive vague surface thoughts from the target when you Cast the Spell, and you find out whether its Intelligence modifier is higher than, equal to, or lower than yours.

Critical Failure As failure, and for the duration of the spell, you can Sustain the Spell to detect the target's surface thoughts again. The target doesn't receive any additional saves.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或发出。光亮术不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发出任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外亦然。这也会压制你施放的黑暗术之环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗术的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使是具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗术。他们将透过黑暗术看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标笼罩在幻术之中，变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言均为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使其逃离。该效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活物生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标尝试一次基础强韧豁免，但若大失败，还会在1轮内成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。若大失败，除非其在一次意志豁免中成功，否则目标还会在1轮内成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。

升阶（+1） 对活物生物造成的虚空伤害提高1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混乱，并用一道精神冲击使其眩晕。冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标豁免大失败，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Read Aura.name: 阅读灵光 Read Aura
Read Aura.description:
你专注于目标物体，敞开你的心智以感知魔法灵光。当施法完成时，你知道该物品是否具有魔法；若是，你会得知其魔法学派。

若该物体为幻象，只有当该效果的等级低于你的阅读灵光法术的环阶时，你才能侦测到这一点。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以10个物体为目标。

升阶（6环） 你可以以任意数量的物体为目标。

You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, and if it is, you learn the school of magic.

If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's level is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你举起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在 AC 上获得 +1 环境加值，直到你下个回合开始，但使用它不需要空出一只手。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术具有 硬度 5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，并且你在 10 分钟内无法再次施放它。与通常的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

升阶（3环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾术具有 硬度 25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Telepathy 100 feet.name: 心灵感应 100 尺 Telepathy 100 feet

Curse of Darkness.name: 黑暗诅咒 Curse of Darkness
Curse of Darkness.description:
幽暗之魂对一个因其燃寒打击而承受持续寒冷伤害的生物施加诅咒，偷走受害者的鲜活气息。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|dc:23]豁免。

若失败，该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness}，其体色变为灰白褪色的色调，同时其所携带、持用或穿戴的所有装备也一并如此。这些效果的持续时间为无限。无论其豁免结果如何，该生物获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。

若幽暗之魂对卡利格尼使用该能力，除非施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}或类似的强大魔法，否则无法移除该诅咒。

The owb inflicts a curse on one creature taking persistent cold damage from their burning cold Strike, stealing the victim's vibrancy. The creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

On a failure, the creature gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.I0HYG0ctCLP5JRsW]{Light Blindness} and its coloration turns to washed out shades of gray, along with all equipment it carries, wields, or wears. These effects have an unlimited duration. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

If the owb uses this ability on a caligni, the curse can't be removed short of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} or similar powerful magic.

Owb.publicNotes:
通常被称为幽暗之魂，或被更强大的幽暗之魂先知称为次等幽暗之魂，这些神秘的生物大多专注于操纵卡利格尼文化。在卡利格尼之中，幽暗之魂会对他们认为地位在其之下的凡人进行躲藏——甚至包括他们所监护的卡利格尼。幽暗之魂更偏好挑选一名卡利格尼领袖，在幽影中对其加以控制，运用魅力与魔法操纵对方。通过胁迫这类代理人，幽暗之魂得以在社群政治中持续施加影响力：要么赐福并撕毁与其他生物的契约，要么作为卡利格尼与强大的外来实体之间的中间人和大使。

这些幽影位面的古老居民，看上去如覆着半透明幽影隐匿之纱的灰白人形上身。它们沉默而神秘，四处漂浮，没有双腿来支撑其悬空。它们从不大声说话，而是将触及伸入周遭生物的心智，低语并含混地呢喃诅咒、威胁，以及令人怅惘的怪异卜筮术片段。

这些令人不寒而栗的生物被卡利格尼尊为被遗忘者的代理——被遗忘者是一群形似祖灵的半神，许多卡利格尼崇拜它们。有些人甚至相信幽暗之魂就是被遗忘者的显现。

许多幽暗之魂会造访卡利格尼社群，甚至留下来提供建议；它们的性格如被遗忘者一般多样。所有幽暗之魂都共享对光亮术与色彩的憎恨，唯独例外是它们能作为武器投掷的燃烧寒冷魔法所发出的闪烁发光。居住在卡利格尼之中的幽暗之魂往往会禁止使用光亮术与色彩；必要时，它们会用其黑暗术诅咒来压制违令者。所有幽暗之魂唯一的另一共同点，是它们根深蒂固地渴望通过读心术与欺骗来操纵其监护对象，尽管这种操纵既可能隐晦，也可能公开。

Commonly called owbs, or lesser owbs by more powerful owb prophets, most of these mysterious creatures focus on manipulating caligni culture. Among calignis, an owb hides from mortals they deem beneath them-even including calignis in their charge. An owb prefers to select one caligni leader to control from the shadows, manipulating them using charisma and magic. Through coersion of such agents, owbs maintain a steady hand in the politics of the community, either blessing and breaking pacts with other creatures or acting as intermediaries and ambassadors between calignis and powerful external entities.

These ancient denizens of the Shadow Plane appear as grayish humanoid torsos covered in translucent funeral veils of shadow. Silent and mysterious, they float about, absent legs to hold them aloft. Never speaking a word aloud, they instead reach into the minds of creatures around them to whisper and mumble curses, threats, and strange bits of forlorn augury.

These haunting creatures are revered by calignis as proxies of the Forsaken-a strange array of ancestor-like demigods whom many calignis worship. Some even believe owbs are the Forsaken manifested.

A multitude of owbs visit and even remain to advise caligni communities, as varied in personality as the Forsaken. All owbs share a hatred of light and color, except for the flickering glow of the burning cold magic they can hurl as a weapon. Owbs who live among calignis tend to prohibit the use of light and color, using their curse of darkness to quench violators if necessary. The only other similarity across all owbs is their entrenched desire to manipulate their charges through mind-reading and deception, though such manipulation can be either subtle or overt.
Owb.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Padli.name: 帕德利 Padli

Occult Innate Spells.name: 神秘先天法术 Occult Innate Spells

Suggestion.name: 暗示术 Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
你甜言蜜语，让生物难以抗拒。你向目标提出一个行动方案的暗示术，其措辞必须让该行动方案对目标而言看起来合乎逻辑，且不能是自我毁灭的，或明显违背目标自身利益。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并且知道你试图控制它。

成功 目标不受影响，并认为你只是正常地在和它说话，而不是对它施放法术。

失败 目标立刻遵从你的暗示术。该法术的持续时间为1分钟，或直到目标完成一个有限的暗示术内容，或该暗示术变得自我毁灭，或产生其他明显的负面效果为止。

大成功或大失败：失败 如同失败，但基础持续时间为1小时。

升阶（8环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected and thinks you were talking to them normally, not casting a spell on them.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你致盲目标。该效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标获得暂时免疫1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Enthrall.name: 注目术 Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
你的言辞令你的目标陷入迷魂。你在整个施放与持续时间内不间断地说话或歌唱。注意到你说话或歌唱的目标可能会将全部注意力投向你；每个目标都必须尝试一次意志豁免。若目标信奉相对立的宗教、属于相对立的族裔、政治倾向相反，或以其他方式不太可能赞同你所说之事，则GM可能会给予环境加值（最高+4）。

每个进入射程的生物在你维持法术时都必须尝试一次豁免。若你正在说话，注目术获得语言（特征）。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响，并注意到你试图使用魔法。

成功 目标不必注意你，但不会注意到你试图使用魔法（它可能会注意到其他目标被迷魂）。

失败 目标对你处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}状态。若它目睹了其不赞同的动作或说话，它可以再尝试一次意志豁免。若它成功，则不再迷魂，并在1小时内暂时免疫。若目标遭受一次敌对行为，或若另一名生物对其进行一次交涉或威吓检定并成功，则迷魂立即结束。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，但若目标不同意你，它无法尝试豁免来结束迷魂。

Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the Spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer Fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断目标的运动冲动，使其无法从意识中传出，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} 1轮。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标麻痹4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功或大失败：成功时完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Darkness.name: 黑暗 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在区域内穿透或散发。光亮不会进入该区域，任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会散发任何光亮，即使它们的光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你施放的黑暗术之环级或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过这片黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造一层黑暗的帷幕，阻止光亮穿透或在该区域内发出。光亮不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（例如火把或提灯）在该区域内也不会发出任何光亮，即使它们的光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你黑暗术法术等级或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它像一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标笼罩在幻术之中，成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对它们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用一次敌对动作，则法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但如果目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（随意） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你召唤出一团迷雾。迷雾中的所有生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}，而迷雾外的所有生物对迷雾内的生物而言变为隐蔽。你可以解消该云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使其逃离。该效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但若大失败，还会在1轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。若大失败，目标还会在1轮内陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，除非其意志豁免成功。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
