Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any creature of the same size, even specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The spell also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。之后目标获得1分钟的暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 状态，直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Glyph of Warding.name: 守卫刻文 Glyph of Warding
Glyph of Warding.description:
你通过将一个敌对法术束缚到一个符文中来制作陷阱。施放该法术时，你还要施放一个更低法术环阶的法术，将其储存在刻文中。被储存的法术必须施放所需不超过3个动作，具有敌对效果，并以一个生物为目标或具有一个区域。你可以为刻文设置口令、触发，或两者皆有。任何生物只要移动、打开或触碰目标容器，或进入目标区域，且未说出口令或符合触发条件，就会启动刻文，释放其中的有害法术。

一旦有法术被储存在刻文中，刻文获得该法术的全部特征。若被储存的法术以一个或多个生物为目标，则其目标为触发刻文的生物。若其具有区域，则该区域以触发刻文的生物为中心。守卫刻文的持续时间在刻文被触发时结束。刻文视为一个魔法陷阱，使用你的法术DC来进行察觉检定以注意到它，以及进行巧手检定以解除它；两项检定都要求尝试的生物受训，才可能成功。

你可以解消守卫刻文。你在同一时间可维持的守卫刻文最大数量等同于你的施法能力调整值。

You craft a trap by binding a hostile spell into a symbol. While Casting this Spell, you also Cast a Spell of a lower spell rank to store in the glyph. The stored spell must take 3 actions or fewer to cast, have a hostile effect, and target one creature or have an area. You can set a password, a trigger, or both for the glyph. Any creature that moves, opens, or touches the target container or enters the target area that doesn't speak the password or that matches the trigger activates the glyph, releasing the harmful spell within.

Once a spell is stored in the glyph, the glyph gains all the traits of that spell. If the stored spell targets one or more creatures, it targets the creature that set off the glyph. If it has an area, that area is centered on the creature that set off the glyph. Glyph of warding's duration ends when the glyph is triggered. The glyph counts as a magical trap, using your spell DC for both the Perception check to notice it and the Thievery check to disable it; both checks require the creature attempting them to be trained in order to succeed.

You can Dismiss glyph of warding. The maximum number of glyphs of warding you can have active at a time is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Lightning Bolt.name: 闪电束 Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
一道闪电从你的手中向外劈出，造成4d12电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12。

A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Create Food.name: 造粮术 Create Food
Create Food.description:
你创造出足以供六个中型生物食用一天的食物。这些食物寡淡且不诱人，但很有营养。1天后，如果无人食用，这些食物会衰败并变得无法食用。大多数小型生物的食量是中型生物的四分之一（大多数超小型生物为十六分之一），而大多数大型生物的食量是其10倍（超大型生物为100倍，依此类推）。

升阶（4环） 你可以供养12个中型生物。

升阶（6环） 你可以供养50个中型生物。

升阶（8环） 你可以供养200个中型生物。

You create enough food to feed six Medium creatures for a day. This food is bland and unappealing, but it is nourishing. After 1 day, if no one has eaten the food, it decays and becomes inedible. Most Small creatures eat one-quarter as much as a Medium creature (one-sixteenth as much for most Tiny creatures), and most Large creatures eat 10 times as much (100 times as much for Huge creatures and so on).

Heightened (4th) You can feed 12 Medium creatures.

Heightened (6th) You can feed 50 Medium creatures.

Heightened (8th) You can feed 200 Medium creatures.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮术在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮术不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内时都不会散发任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外也一样。这也会压制你黑暗术法术等环阶或更低等环阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗术的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗术。它们将透过黑暗术看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光线在该区域内穿透或发散。光线无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也是如此。这同样会压制你黑暗术的环级或更低环级的魔法光亮。光无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Hideous Laughter.name: 狂笑术 Hideous Laughter
Hideous Laughter.description:
目标被无法控制的笑声所吞没。它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标被无法控制的笑声所折磨。它不能使用反应动作（）

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}且不能使用反应动作（）

大成功或大失败 目标倒地@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，并在1轮内不能使用动作或反应动作（）。随后它承受失败的效果。

The target is overtaken with uncontrollable laughter. It must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is plagued with uncontrollable laughter. It can't use reactions.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and can't use actions or reactions for 1 round. It then suffers the failure effects.

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标被幻术所笼罩，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，尽管这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} 状态。若目标使用一次敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但即使目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Obscuring Mist (At Will).name: 隐雾术（意志） Obscuring Mist (At Will)
Obscuring Mist (At Will).description:
你唤起一团薄雾云。薄雾中的所有生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态，且薄雾外的所有生物对其中的生物而言也为隐蔽。你可以解消这团云雾。

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

Telekinetic Maneuver.name: 念动战技 Telekinetic Maneuver
Telekinetic Maneuver.description:
随着一股念动力量的奔涌，你移动一个敌人或其携带的某件物品。你可以尝试对目标进行缴械、推撞或绊摔，使用法术攻击掷骰代替运动检定。

With a rush of telekinetic power, you move a foe or something they carry. You can attempt to Disarm, Shove, or Trip the target using a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check.

Acid Splash.name: 酸液飞溅 Acid Splash
Acid Splash.description:
你溅出一团酸液，使其飞溅到你的目标及附近的生物身上。进行一次法术攻击。若你命中，你造成1d6点酸性伤害外加1点飞溅酸性伤害。在大成功或大失败时，目标还会受到@Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]]点伤害。

升阶（3环） 初始伤害提高至2d6，且持续伤害提高至2。

升阶（5环） 初始伤害提高至3d6，持续伤害提高至3，且飞溅伤害提高至2。

升阶（7环） 初始伤害提高至4d6，持续伤害提高至4，且飞溅伤害提高至3。

升阶（9环） 初始伤害提高至5d6，持续伤害提高至5，且飞溅伤害提高至4。

You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures. Make a spell attack. If you hit, you deal 1d6 acid damage plus 1 splash acid damage. On a critical success, the target also takes @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (3rd) The initial damage increases to 2d6, and the persistent damage increases to 2.

Heightened (5th) The initial damage increases to 3d6, the persistent damage increases to 3, and the splash damage increases to 2.

Heightened (7th) The initial damage increases to 4d6, the persistent damage increases to 4, and the splash damage increases to 3.

Heightened (9th) The initial damage increases to 5d6, the persistent damage increases to 5, and the splash damage increases to 4.

Alarm.name: 魔法警报 Alarm
Alarm.description:
你在一个区域布下防护，以在生物未经你允许进入时向你发出警报。当你施放魔法警报时，选择一个口令。每当一名小型或更大体型的有形生物在未说出口令的情况下进入该法术的区域时，魔法警报会按你的选择发出一种心灵警报（此时该法术获得心灵（特征））或发出一种可听见的警报，其声音与音量如同手铃（此时该法术获得听觉（特征））。无论选择哪一种，都会自动唤醒你；而铃声会使区域内的每个生物都可以尝试一次DC 15 察觉检定以醒来。知晓该魔法警报存在的生物在移动进入该区域时，必须在对抗该法术DC的隐匿检定中成功，否则将触发该法术。

升阶（3环） 你可以指定哪些生物会令魔法警报法术响起的条件——例如，兽人或戴面具的人。

You ward an area to alert you when creatures enter without your permission. When you cast alarm, select a password. Whenever a Small or larger corporeal creature enters the spell's area without speaking the password, alarm sends your choice of a mental alert (in which case the spell gains the mental trait) or an audible alarm with the sound and volume of a hand bell (in which case the spell gains the auditory trait). Either option automatically awakens you, and the bell allows each creature in the area to attempt a DC 15 Perception check to wake up. A creature aware of the alarm must succeed at a Stealth check against the spell's DC or trigger the spell when moving into the area.

Heightened (3rd) You can specify criteria for which creatures sound the alarm spell-for instance, orcs or masked people.

Create Water.name: 造水术 Create Water
Create Water.description:
当你将双手拢成杯状时，水开始从中涌出。你创造2加仑的水。若无人饮用，它会在1天后蒸发。

As you cup your hands, water begins to flow forth from them. You create 2 gallons of water. If no one drinks it, it evaporates after 1 day.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你遮蔽目标的心智，并用精神冲击使其迟钝。这次冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标严重失败该豁免，它还会获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一股脉冲，登记周围是否存在魔法。除了魔法的存在或不存在之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。

你只有在该幻术魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术的环阶时，才能侦测到幻术魔法。不过，带有幻术灵光但外观上并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你会得知该法术在射程内侦测到的、最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若多个效果强度相同，由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。就像模糊感官一样，你不会得知精确位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5英尺立方体范围内（若目标大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动唇，但这些话语并不会从你的口中发出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听不见你的话语，效果不会比你正常动唇更好；但目标能听见你的话语，如同他们正站在你身旁一般。

目标可以用反应动作（）给出简短回应，或若其愿意，则在其下个回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能看见你且在射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，他们的回应会直接传到你的耳中，就像最初的传讯术一样。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程增加至500尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Ray of Frost.name: 霜冻射线 Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
你发射一道冰冷射线。进行一次法术攻击掷骰。该射线造成2d4寒冷伤害。

大成功或大失败 目标受到双倍伤害，并在1轮内其速度承受-10英尺状态减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

成功 目标受到正常伤害。

强化（+1） 伤害增加1d4。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

You blast an icy ray. Make a spell attack roll. The ray deals 2d4 cold damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.I4PsUAaYSUJ8pwKC]{Spell Effect: Ray of Frost}

Success The target takes normal damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在 AC 上获得 +1 环境加值，持续到你下一回合开始，但它不需要空出一只手来使用。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术具有 硬度 5。在你使用 Shield Block 后，该法术结束，并且你在 10 分钟内不能再次施放它。不同于普通的 Shield Block，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）对抗 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的 硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环）该护盾术具有 硬度 10。

升阶（5环）该护盾术具有 硬度 15。

升阶（7环）该护盾术具有 硬度 20。

升阶（9环）该护盾术具有 硬度 25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Wand of Continuation (4th-Rank Spell).name: 延续魔杖（4环法术） Wand of Continuation (4th-Rank Spell)
Wand of Continuation (4th-Rank Spell).description:
这根魔杖会增加一个法术的持续时间。黄色余烬在其表面盘旋，直到法术结束。

启动 施法；若该法术通常需要1来施放，则启动需要2；若该法术通常需要2来施放，则启动需要3

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施法，并且其持续时间增加一半。

制作需求 提供一次施放适当环阶法术。该法术的施放时代必须为1或2，且持续时间不短于10分钟、不长于1小时。

This wand increases a spell's duration. Yellow embers spiral over its surface until the spell ends.

Activate Cast a Spell; The activation takes 2 if the spell normally takes 1 to cast, or 3 if the spell normally takes 2

Frequency Once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell, and its duration is increased by half.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate rank. The spell must have a casting time of 1 or 2 and a duration no less than 10 minutes and no greater than 1 hour.

Death Motes.name: 死之微粒 Death Motes
Death Motes.description:
当加卢杜死亡时，她的身体爆炸成闪耀的魔法能量微粒。所有处于@Template[burst|distance:20]内的生物受到@Damage[12d6[force]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]豁免）。加卢杜的道具不受爆炸影响，并会留在她死亡之处堆成一堆。

When Galudu dies, her body explodes into brilliant motes of magical energy. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:20] take @Damage[12d6[force]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). Galudu's gear is unaffected by the explosion and is left in a pile where she died.

Opportune Step.name: 适时快步 Opportune Step
Opportune Step.description:
触发 一名目眩或目盲的生物，或一名具有强光致盲的生物，在结束其移动时停在与加鲁杜相邻的位置

效果 加鲁杜快步。

Trigger A dazzled or blinded creature, or a creature with light blindness, ends its move adjacent to Galudu

Effect Galudu Steps.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
加鲁杜对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外3d6点精准伤害。

Galudu deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Survivor's Nourishment.name: 幸存者的给养 Survivor's Nourishment
Survivor's Nourishment.description:
食用加鲁杜的造粮术所创造食物的生物恢复 @Damage[4d4[healing]] 生命值。一名生物每周只能从该治疗中受益一次。

A creature that eats food conjured by Galudu's create food spell regains @Damage[4d4[healing]] Hit Points. A creature can only benefit from this healing once per week.

Galudu.blurb:
女性卡利尼领袖
Female caligni leader
Galudu.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Gogiteth.name: 高基特斯 Gogiteth

Skittering Reposition.name: 疾行换位 Skittering Reposition
Skittering Reposition.description:
触发 一个在高基特斯触及之外开始其移动的生物移动进入其触及。

效果 高基特斯移动10英尺。这不会触发反应动作（）。

Trigger A creature that starts its move outside the gogiteth's reach moves into its reach.

Effect The gogiteth moves 10 feet. This does not trigger reactions.

Carry Off Prey.name: 叼走猎物 Carry Off Prey
Carry Off Prey.description:
高基特斯在啃咬中含着一名被其@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}的生物时，仍可用其全速度移动，并将被擒抱的生物一并带走。

The gogiteth can move at its full Speed while it has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in its jaws, bringing the grabbed creature along.

Skittering Assault.name: 疾掠强袭 Skittering Assault
Skittering Assault.description:
高基特斯移动三次。每次移动期间，它都可以在移动过程中的任意时点，尝试对其触及内的一个生物进行一次腿部打击；它必须将每次攻击对准不同的生物，但在完成所有打击之前，它不会应用其多重攻击减值。如果任意一次打击导致大成功或大失败中的失败，疾行突袭结束。

The gogiteth Strides three times. Once per Stride, it can attempt a leg Strike against a creature in its reach at any point during the Stride; it must make each attack against a different creature, but it doesn't apply its multiple attack penalty until after making all its Strikes. If any of the Strikes result in a critical failure, Skittering Assault ends.

Gogiteth.publicNotes:
高基特斯是一种流着涎的梦魇，由牙齿、眼睛与多毛的蜘蛛般长腿组成；任何目睹过它的人，都会将其外貌深深烙印在脑海中。这些疾窜怪物的巢群出没于幽暗地域最深处，为了食物与资源与洞穴蠕虫及其他地下恐怖之物竞争。高基特斯很少独自行动，因为它们已经明白，最好的生存之道就是与同类抱团。就连最坚韧的幽暗地域居民在发现高基特斯时也会寻找掩蔽，因为有一个出现，就必定会有一群紧随其后。

高基特斯在疾窜时会发出咔哒声。它们众多腿部的关节在每次移动时都会噼啪作响，不过它们也能自愿压制这些声音，悄无声息地狩猎而不惊动猎物。这些古怪的生物还会发出尖锐的口哨声，在它们栖居的洞窟中回荡。一些幽暗地域原住民报告称，高基特斯群体有时会聚在一起，唱出令人毛骨悚然、刺耳不协的歌声。

高基特斯的解剖结构引发了对其起源的无数猜测。有些人认为它们是某次塑肉仪式实验可怕失败的产物。也有人认为它们可能在某种程度上与“黑暗主宰”有关——或许是那些异界实体的远亲，或某些诡异的放逐者。依照这一神话体系，一旦它们来到格拉利昂，高基特斯便爬入土的深处，畏避上方炽烈的太阳。

高基特斯对幽暗地域的所有其他居民而言都是一大祸患。生活在塞卡米纳或奥尔弗受高基特斯侵扰地区的人们，常在发现高基特斯群时呼吁达成临时停战。由于即便一个普通的高基特斯巢群也能容纳多达二十四只这类恐怖之物，号召消灭它们无疑是危险至极的任务。

A gogiteth is a slavering nightmare of teeth, eyes, and hairy spiderlike legs, and its appearance is invariably seared into the minds of any who witness it. Hives of these skittering monsters haunt the lowest reaches of the Darklands, competing with cave worms and other subterranean horrors for food and resources. A gogiteth is rarely alone, as they learned that the best means of survival is sticking with others of their own kind. Even the hardiest Darklands residents seek cover when a gogiteth is spotted, for where there's one, a swarm is sure to follow.

Gogiteths make a clacking sound as they skitter. The joints in their many legs pop and crack with each movement, though they can suppress this voluntarily and hunt silently without alerting prey. The odd creatures can also make a high-pitched whistling sound that echoes throughout the caverns where they live. Some Darklands natives report that groups of gogiteths sometimes join together in eerie, discordant songs.

Gogiteth anatomy have inspired no shortage of speculation as to their origins. Some believe they are the result of a fleshwarping experiment gone horribly wrong. Others think they may be related in some way to the Dominion of the Black—possibly the distant cousins or some strange exiles of those alien entities. According to this mythos, once they made their way to Golarion, the gogiteths crawled into the depths of the earth, shying away from the blazing sun above.

Gogiteths are a menace to every other denizen of the Darklands. Those who live in gogiteth-infested regions of Sekamina or Orv frequently call for temporary truces when a gogiteth swarm has been spotted. Since even an average gogiteth hive can host up to two dozen of the horrors, calls to eradicate them are dangerous quests indeed.

Khurfel.name: 库尔费 Khurfel

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Read Omens.name: 阅读机运 Read Omens
Read Omens.description:
你窥视未来。选择一个你计划在1周内从事的特定目标或行动，或一个你预期可能在1周内发生的事件。你会得知一条隐晦的线索或建议，可能有助于所选事件，通常以押韵或征兆的形式呈现。

You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标失明。效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标获得暂时免疫1分钟。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}直到其下个回合开始。

失败 目标失明1分钟。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标永久失明。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动神经冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标获得麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，将剩余持续时间减少1轮；若大成功或大失败：成功，则完全结束该效果。

升阶（第7环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Augury.name: 卜筮术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放该法术期间，询问某一特定行动方案的结果。该法术可以预测未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM在以下结果中做出的最佳猜测：

  • 吉 结果会很好。
  • 凶 结果会很糟。
  • 吉与凶 结果会好坏参半。
  • 无 不会有特别好或特别坏的结果。

GM进行一次秘密的 @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。在一次失败时，结果总是“无”。这使得无法判断“无”的结果是否准确。如果在额外一次施放卜筮术时有人询问与第一次施放卜筮术相同的主题，GM使用第一次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，仍有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你熄灭一名濒死边缘生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若此举杀死它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内对攻击和伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}值提高1点。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一个生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落减缓至每轮60尺，并且在法术持续时间内的那段坠落在计算坠落伤害时不计入其中。若目标在法术效果持续期间触及地面，则不会因这次坠落而受到任何伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗不死生物。若目标是活的生物，你对其造成1d8虚空伤害，并且其进行一次基础强韧豁免。若目标是自愿的不死生物，你恢复等量的生命值。你在施放此法术时花费的动作数决定其目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗一个不死生物，将恢复的生命值提高8点。

3 (材料, 言语, 姿势) 你在30尺散发中扩散虚空能量。这会以区域内所有活的与不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或伤害的数值提高1d8，并且2动作版本的额外治疗提高8点。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道汲取敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击尝试。若你成功，则该生物尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则使用比其豁免结果差一级成功度的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

+1 Striking Rhoka Sword.name: +1 强击双叉剑 +1 Striking Rhoka Sword
+1 Striking Rhoka Sword.description:
双叉剑是透肌魔人士兵偏好的武器，不过所有透肌魔人都懂得如何挥舞这些战争器具。

The rhoka sword is the preferred weapon of urdefhan soldiers, though all urdefhans know how to wield these instruments of war.

Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由数件护甲组成，这些护甲由相互链接的小金属环编织成保护性的网状结构。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对臂甲和一顶头罩，共同保护身体的大部分。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Emerald Fulcrum Lens.name: 翡翠支点镜片 Emerald Fulcrum Lens
Emerald Fulcrum Lens.description:
这枚凹形的绿色镜片布满凹坑且瑕疵明显；其锯齿状边缘可能割伤未小心处理它的人。你将翡翠支点镜片注入后，你的肌肤看起来如蜡般苍白。你获得虚空治疗，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm}法术在对你恢复的生命值上获得+4状态加值。你也可以用以下方式启动该镜片。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.vlTiBE0h2kyw5J9o]{Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens}

启动 2 交互（治疗）

频率 每日一次

效果 你用一只手握住翡翠支点镜片，恢复@Damage[30[healing]]生命值，并在1轮内对抗魔法的豁免检定获得+2物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.rH6RHxy6sNTLusKX]{Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Throw)}

启动 2 交互（攻击，占据术）

当你握住镜片时，以调整值[[/r d20+20]]{+20}进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰。若命中，你迫使来自镜片中的宁布洛斯精髓碎片占据目标。你不再将该镜片注入，而目标获得如同其已将该镜片注入一般的益处，但无法启动镜片的其他能力。该效果为永久，但可被任何移除占据术效果的效果终止。在占据术效果结束前，镜片不具备任何魔法能力；当其结束时，精髓将返回镜片。

This concave green lens is pitted and flawed; its jagged edges can cut those who don't handle it with care. While you have the Emerald Fulcrum Lens invested, your flesh appears waxen and pallid. You gain void healing and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} spells gain a +4 status bonus to the Hit Points they restore to you. You can also activate the lens in the following ways.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.vlTiBE0h2kyw5J9o]{Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens}

Activate 2 Interact (healing)

Frequency once per day

Effect You grasp the Emerald Fulcrum Lens in one hand, regain @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points, and gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against magic for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.rH6RHxy6sNTLusKX]{Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Throw)}

Activate 2 Interact (attack, possession)

While grasping the lens, make a melee spell attack roll with a modifier of [[/r d20+20]]{+20}. On a hit, you force the splinter of Nhimbaloth's essence from the lens to possess the target. You're no longer invested in the lens, and the target gains the benefits as though it had invested the lens but can't activate the lens's other abilities. This effect is permanent, but it can be ended by any effect that removes a possession effect. The lens doesn't have any magical abilities until the possession effect ends; when it does, the essence returns to the lens.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩箭比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩所使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Thr.name: 效果：翡翠支点镜片（豁免检定） Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Throw)
Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Thr.description:
你在 1 轮内获得对攻击掷骰、豁免检定与 DC 的 +1 物品加值。

For 1 round you gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and DCs.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强等暗视 Greater Darkvision

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当库尔费死亡时，他的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华成一团恶臭气体，充满其尸体周围的@Template[emanation|distance:10]。该气体会对该区域内的生物造成@Damage[10d6[void]]伤害，因为它们的血肉也会凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic]豁免）。

When Khurfel dies, his invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around his body. The gas deals @Damage[10d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh too curdles and rots (@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save).

Frenzied Attack.name: 狂乱攻击 Frenzied Attack
Frenzied Attack.description:
库尔费进行一次双叉剑打击和两次啃咬打击，目标可以是一个或两个不同的生物（他可以按自己的意愿以任何方式分配这些攻击）。

他的多重攻击减值直到所有三次攻击之后才会增加。

Khurfel makes one rhoka sword Strike and two jaws Strikes against one or two different creatures (splitting up the attacks any way he wishes).

His multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all three attacks.

Insightful Swing.name: 洞察回旋 Insightful Swing
Insightful Swing.description:
库尔费进行一次近战武器打击。在这次打击中，他在攻击掷骰上获得+2环境加值，并无视目标拥有的任何隐蔽。

Khurfel makes a melee weapon Strike. On this Strike, he gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll and ignores any concealment the target has.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 库尔费在其上一动作中以一次啃咬打击对一名生物造成了伤害

效果 库尔费保持接触，使该生物伤口周围的血肉变得半透明。库尔费从两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要进行一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免。若该次啃咬打击为大成功或大失败，则该生物同时承受两个效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 库尔费饮用该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且库尔费恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP（或若为大成功或大失败，则其获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且库尔费恢复 @Damage[20[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力 库尔费抽取该生物的一些生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时（或若为大成功或大失败，则获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}，持续1小时）。

Requirements Khurfel damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on his last action

Effect Khurfel maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the injury. Khurfel chooses one of two options, each of which requires a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood Khurfel drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and Khurfel regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and Khurfel regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality Khurfel draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Khurfel.publicNotes:
库尔费率领着英雄们在憎恨魔窟中所面对的规模最大、最活跃的一群敌对者。他与英雄们命中注定的对决不可避免，因为他持有翡翠支点镜片，并且只要他还活着就拒绝交出它，因为这象征着他邪教的领导权。库尔费对在英雄手中坠落的幻视并未激起恐惧术——它激起的是狂怒，只要身体里还剩一口气，他就会与这些被预言的敌人战斗到底。

Khurfel leads the largest and most active group of adversaries the heroes face in the Abomination Vaults. His fated confrontation with the heroes is necessary because he holds the Emerald Fulcrum Lens and refuses to give it up as long as he lives, as it symbolizes the leadership of his cult. Khurfel's vision of falling at the heroes' hands doesn't inspire fear-it inspires fury, and he fights against his prophesized enemies as long as breath remains in his body.
Khurfel.blurb:
男性透肌魔人战争勇士
Male urdefhan war champion

Klathor.name: 克拉索尔 Klathor

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Commune.name: 通神术 Commune
Commune.description:
你呼唤一个未知的异界实体来回答问题；如果你拥有神祇并使用宗教，则该实体是你神祇的侍从。你最多可以提出七个能用“是”或“否”回答的问题。该实体很可能知晓与其职权相关的答案；@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.swwwP7eVmlNuWTb7]{Gozreh}的侍从很可能了解不自然的天气模式，而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna}的侍从很可能了解某人的旅行路线。该实体用“是”“否”“可能”和“未知”等单词作答，不过其答案总是反映它自身的意图，并可能具有欺骗性。

大成功或大失败 你联系到一个更强大的、与你的利益高度一致的实体，甚至可能是你的神祇。该实体不会试图欺骗你，尽管它仍可能不知道答案。当需要提供明确说明时，该实体会用不超过五个词回答你的问题，例如“如果你立刻离开”或“那曾经是真的”。

成功 你可以提出你的问题并获得答案。

失败 你未能联系到异界实体。

大成功或大失败 你暴露于宇宙的浩瀚之中，并在1周内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}（无法以任何方式移除）。

You call upon an unknown planar entity to answer questions; this is a servitor of your deity if you have one and use Religion. You can ask up to seven questions that could be answered with "Yes" or "No." The entity is likely to know answers related to its purview; a servitor of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.swwwP7eVmlNuWTb7]{Gozreh} would likely know about unnatural weather patterns and a servitor of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.JgqH3BhuEuA4Zyqs]{Desna} would likely know someone's travel route. The entity answers with one word answers such as "Yes," "No," "Likely," and "Unknown," though its answers always reflect its own agenda and could be deceptive.

Critical Success You contact a more powerful entity aligned strongly with your interests, possibly even your deity. The entity won't attempt to deceive you, though it still might not know the answers. When it's important to provide clarity, the entity will answer your questions with up to five words, such as "If you leave immediately" or "That was true once."

Success You can ask your questions and receive answers.

Failure You fail to contact a planar entity.

Critical Failure You are exposed to the enormity of the cosmos and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4} for 1 week (can't remove by any means).

Black Tentacles.name: 黑触手 Black Tentacles
Black Tentacles.description:
区域 20尺爆发，邻接一处平坦表面

油腻的黑触手升起并尝试捕捉区域内的生物。对区域内每个生物的强韧DC进行法术攻击掷骰。你成功对抗的任何生物将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} 并受到3d6钝击伤害。每当一个生物在区域内结束其回合时，若触手尚未尝试擒抱该生物，则触手尝试擒抱该生物；并且触手对任何已被擒抱的生物造成 @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] 伤害。

触手的逃脱DC等于你的法术DC。生物可以攻击一根触手以尝试使其松开。其AC等于你的法术DC，且若其受到12点或更多伤害则被摧毁。即使被摧毁，额外的触手仍会在区域内继续生长，直到持续时间结束。你可以解消该法术。

Area 20-foot burst adjacent to a flat surface

Oily black tentacles rise up and attempt to capture creatures in the area. Make spell attack rolls against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. Any creature you succeed against is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage. Whenever a creature ends its turn in the area, the tentacles attempt to grab that creature if they haven't already, and they deal @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage to any creature already Grabbed.

The tentacles' Escape DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a tentacle in an attempt to release its grip. Its AC is equal to your spell DC, and it is destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage. Even if destroyed, additional tentacles continue to grow in the area until the duration ends. You can Dismiss the spell.

Ectoplasmic Expulsion.name: 灵质驱散 Ectoplasmic Expulsion
Ectoplasmic Expulsion.description:
你召唤短暂的灵质触须穿过目标，带走一种有害的心灵苦难。你立刻尝试反制目标身上的单一效果，该效果必须具有情绪或占据（特征）特征，或是使目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} 状态的效果。若你反制该效果失败，你仍会建立一种共鸣，使目标能更好地自行逃脱该效果；在接下来1小时内，目标获得+2状态加值，用于进行意志豁免以摆脱你未能反制的效果（例如，为摆脱 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} 法术的控制而进行的意志豁免）。

You call upon tendrils of ephemeral ectoplasm to pass through the target and carry away a harmful psychic affliction. You immediately attempt to counteract a single effect on the target with the emotion or possession trait, or an effect giving the target the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} condition. If you fail to counteract the effect, you nevertheless set up a resonance that allows the target to more ably escape the effect on its own; for the next hour, the target gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves to shrug off the effect you failed to counteract (such as Will saves to shake off control by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wU6hNzK8Yfqdmc8m]{Possession} spell).

Prying Eye.name: 窥探之眼 Prying Eye
Prying Eye.description:
你在一个你能看见且距离你500英尺内的位置创造一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}的漂浮眼睛，直径1英寸。它以你正常的视觉感官向所有方向观察，并持续将它所见到的一切传递给你。每轮你首次维持该法术时，你可以选择将眼睛移动至多30英尺（此时只看见眼睛前方的事物），或将其移动至多10英尺（此时能看见其周围所有方向的一切）。眼睛能离你移动多远没有限制，但若你与眼睛在任何时候不再处于同一存在位面，该法术会立刻结束。若你想用它进行察觉检定，你可以通过眼睛尝试搜寻动作。对眼睛造成的任何伤害都会摧毁它并结束该法术。

You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, floating eye, 1 inch in diameter, at a location you can see within 500 feet. It sees in all directions with your normal visual senses and continuously transmits what it sees to you. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can either move the eye up to 30 feet, seeing only things in front of the eye, or move it up to 10 feet, seeing everything in all directions around it. There is no limit to how far from you the eye can move, but the spell ends immediately if you and the eye ever cease to be on the same plane of existence. You can attempt Seek actions through the eye if you want to attempt Perception checks with it. Any damage dealt to the eye destroys it and ends the spell.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持有的任何物品从你当前的空间传送到射程内你能看见的一处空旷空间中。

如果这会把另一个生物也带着一起过去——即使你正把它装在一个超维度容器中携带——该法术将失效。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不需要能看见你的目的地，只要你过去曾去过那里，并且知道它相对于你的位置与距离即可。你暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Globe of Invulnerability.name: 法术无效结界 Globe of Invulnerability
Globe of Invulnerability.description:
你在自身周围创造一个固定不动的球形结界，尝试反制来自球形结界外部的任何法术，只要该法术的区域或目标进入球形结界之内；如同该球形结界是一道比其实际法术阶位低1阶的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} 法术。

若反制尝试成功，它仅阻止原本会进入球形结界的那一部分法术效果（因此，如果该法术也有位于球形结界外的目标，或其区域的一部分在球形结界之外，则那些目标或那部分区域仍会正常受到影响）。

你必须在一处不间断的开阔空间内形成该球体，使其边缘不会穿过任何生物或物体，否则该法术将失效（但在法术施放后，生物可以进入球形结界）。

You create an immobile globe around yourself that attempts to counteract any spell from outside the globe whose area or targets enter into the globe, as if the globe were a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} spell 1 rank lower than its actual spell rank.

If the counteract attempt succeeds, it prevents only the portion of the spell that would have entered the globe (so if the spell also has targets outside the globe, or part of its area is beyond the globe, those targets or that area is affected normally).

You must form the sphere in an unbroken open space, so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost (though creatures can enter the globe after the spell is cast).

Outcast's Curse.name: 流放诅咒 Outcast's Curse
Outcast's Curse.description:
你用一个诅咒折磨目标，使其存在感令人厌烦且让人反感。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 持续10分钟，目标在尝试欺瞒、交涉、威吓或表演检定时必须掷骰两次并使用较差的结果，且他们在遭遇的生物对其的初始态度会变差一个快步（例如，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} 代替 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}）。

失败 同成功，但效果为永久。

大成功或大失败：失败 同失败，且目标在遭遇的生物对其的初始态度会变差两个快步。

You afflict the target with a curse that makes its presence abrasive and off-putting. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 10 minutes, the target must roll twice and use the worse result whenever attempting a Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance check, and creatures they encounter have an initial attitude toward them of one step worse (for instance, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fuG8dgthlDWfWjIA]{Indifferent}).

Failure As success, but the effect is permanent.

Critical Failure As failure, and creatures that the target encounters have an initial attitude toward them of two steps worse.

Blindness.name: 目盲术 Blindness
Blindness.description:
你使目标目盲。其效果由目标的强韧豁免决定。随后目标在1分钟内暂时免疫。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} 直到其下一回合开始。

失败 目标目盲1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标永久目盲。

You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

Geas.name: 指使术 Geas
Geas.description:
你对一个自愿的目标施加一条魔法规则，迫使其要么执行、要么避免执行某个特定行为。要求执行某行为的指使术通常是有条件的，比如：“总是向寻求住宿的陌生人提供款待。”无条件要求执行某个特定行为的指使术并不要求目标只能做那件事，不过它必须将该任务置于所有休闲消遣之上优先处理。最常见的要求避免执行某行为的指使术，是规定其不得违反一份契约。在这些情况下，次要施法者通常负责确保契约的措辞与仪式的魔法正确契合。由于目标是自愿的，指使术可以拥有持续时间，只要目标同意就能持续。如果目标无法履行指使术，它会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}，并且其恶心（状态）在其连续每一天都被阻止遵循指使术时增加1，最多至恶心（状态）4。当其再次遵循指使术时，恶心（状态）立刻结束；它无法以任何其他方式移除恶心（状态）。只有强大的魔法，例如@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}仪式，才能从自愿目标身上移除指使术的效果。

大成功或大失败 指使术成功，且目标在直接维系指使术的技能检定上获得+1状态加值（由GM酌情决定）。

成功 指使术成功。

失败 指使术失败。

大成功或大失败 指使术失败，而你反而会受到你原本试图施加在目标身上的指使术影响。你被视为非自愿目标，因此该指使术可以被@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}法术反制。

升阶（5环） 你可以将指使术用于一个非自愿生物；它可以尝试进行一次意志豁免以抵消效果。若目标在该意志豁免中失败，指使术最多持续1周。除强大魔法（例如许愿术仪式）外，净化苦难法术也可以反制施加在非自愿生物上的指使术。聪明的非自愿生物可以通过刻意制造使其无法遵从的情境来破坏指使术，但在这种情况下它会变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}（如上所述）。

升阶（7环） 同5环，但指使术在非自愿生物身上最多持续1年。

升阶（9环） 同5环，但指使术在非自愿生物身上持续你选择的持续时间（甚至无限）。

You enforce a magic rule on a willing target, forcing it to either perform or refrain from carrying out a certain act. A geas to perform an act is usually conditional, such as, "Always offer hospitality to strangers seeking a place to stay." An unconditional geas to perform a certain act doesn't require the target to perform that act exclusively, though it must prioritize the task above all leisurely pursuits. The most common geas to refrain from carrying out an act is a specification to avoid violating a contract. In those cases, the secondary caster usually takes charge of making sure the wording of the contract is attuned correctly with the ritual's magic. Because the target is willing, geas can have a duration that lasts for as long as the target agrees to. If the target is unable to fulfill the geas, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and the sickened condition increases by 1 for each consecutive day it is prevented from following the geas, to a maximum of sickened 4. The sickened condition ends immediately when it follows the geas again; it can't remove the sickened condition in any other way. Only powerful magic such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual can remove the effects of geas from a willing target.

Critical Success The geas succeeds, and the target receives a +1 status bonus to skill checks that directly uphold the geas (at the GM's discretion).

Success The geas succeeds.

Failure The geas fails.

Critical Failure The geas fails, and you are instead affected by the geas you were attempting to place on the target. You are considered an unwilling target, so the geas can be counteracted with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} spell.

Heightened (5th) You can use geas on an unwilling creature; it can attempt a Will save to negate the effect. If the target fails this Will save, the geas lasts up to 1 week. A cleanse affliction spell can counteract a geas on an unwilling creature, in addition to powerful magic such as a wish ritual. A clever unwilling creature can subvert the geas by contriving situations that prevent it from complying, but in that case it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} (as described above).

Heightened (7th) As 5th rank, but the geas lasts for up to 1 year on an unwilling creature.

Heightened (9th) As 5th rank, but the geas lasts for a duration you choose (even unlimited) on an unwilling creature.

Heroism.name: 英雄气概 Heroism
Heroism.description:
你唤起目标内心的英雄气概，给予其攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免检定与技能检定+1状态加值。

升阶（6环） 状态加值提升至+2。

升阶（9环） 状态加值提升至+3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

You tap into the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你扩张目标周围的时代流动，减缓其动作。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Wanderer's Guide.name: 旅者向导 Wanderer's Guide
Wanderer's Guide.description:
你祈求彼岸来指引你的路线。当你施放该法术时，选择一个目的地；你会获得一条通往该目的地的灵感路线，使你以及与你一同进行陆上旅行的盟友在持续时间内将因困难地形造成的移动减值减半，只要你们不偏离这条灵感路线。此效果不会对遭遇中的移动产生任何效果。如果你在持续时间结束前再次使用该能力，此效果结束，并被新路线的效果取代。

You call upon the beyond to guide your route. When you Cast this Spell, choose a destination; you receive an inspired route to that destination, allowing you and allies who travel overland with you to reduce the movement penalty from difficult terrain by half for the duration, as long as you don't deviate from the inspired route. This doesn't have any effect on movement during encounters. If you use this ability again before the duration is over, this effect ends and is replaced by that of the new route.

Augury.name: 卜筮术 Augury
Augury.description:
你获得对未来的模糊一瞥。在施放该法术期间，询问某个特定行动方案的结果。该法术能预测最多未来30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM在以下结果中作出的最佳推测：

  • 祸福 结果将会很好。
  • 灾祸 结果将会很糟。
  • 祸福与灾祸 结果将是好坏参半。
  • 无事 不会有特别好或特别坏的结果。

GM掷一次秘密的@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]检定。若检定失败，结果总是“无事”。这使得无法判断“无事”的结果是否准确。若有人在额外一次施放卜筮术时询问与第一次施放卜筮术相同的话题，GM使用第一次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，若情况发生变化，则有可能得到不同的结果。

You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你制造出一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮不会进入该区域，任何非魔法的光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内也不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外亦然。这同样会压制你施放的黑暗术法术位阶或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它如同一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括强效黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗术所见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时位于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择的一种颜色的五彩、无热火焰勾勒出轮廓。可见的生物在受妖火术影响期间不能处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}状态。如果这些生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}状态，则它们在受妖火术影响期间为Concealed，而非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

False Life.name: 虚假生命 False Life
False Life.description:
你用死灵系能量制造一股生命力的储备，获得等同于6加上你的施法能力调整值数量的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 临时生命值增加3点。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

You create a reservoir of vitality from necromantic energy, gaining a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标笼罩在幻术之中，变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言皆为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对他们而言改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但不会因目标使用敌对动作而结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Paranoia.name: 狂乱偏执 Paranoia
Paranoia.description:
你使目标将所有其他生物视为迫在眉睫的威胁。目标对周围所有生物产生强烈的狂乱偏执，必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标相信它看到的每个人都是潜在威胁。它对所有尚未对其敌对的生物变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly}，即使那些此前是盟友的生物也是如此。它不将任何人视为盟友。该法术在1轮后结束。

失败 如同成功，但该效果持续1分钟。

大成功或大失败 如同失败，但目标相信它看到的每个人都是不共戴天的死敌。由GM决定，它会对所有人使用其反应动作（）与自由动作（），无论对方此前是否为其盟友。除此之外，它仍会如平常般理性地行动，并且很可能更倾向于攻击那些正在攻击或妨碍它的生物，而不是那些任其自处的生物。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以5个生物为目标。

You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

Sound Burst.name: 音鸣爆 Sound Burst
Sound Burst.description:
刺耳的噪声轰然爆发，造成2d10音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并在1轮内处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}。

大成功或大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，在1分钟内耳聋，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d10。

A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is Deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Bless.name: 祝福术 Bless
Bless.description:
来自彼界的祝福帮助你的伙伴精准打击。你与盟友在该发散范围内时，攻击掷骰获得+1状态加值。每回合一次，从你施放祝福术后的下个回合开始，你可以使用一个具有专注（特征）的单动作，使该发散的半径增加5英尺。

祝福术可以反制 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}

Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bless, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.RfCEHpMoEAZvB9IZ]{Aura: Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入你体内，你的手散发出苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使它们逃跑。其效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会在1轮内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物 目标在强韧豁免失败时会在1轮内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。在大失败时，目标还会在1轮内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，除非它在一次意志豁免中成功。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物的虚空伤害提高1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大声喊出一道难以忽视的命令术。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同其具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}）、放开其正握持的物品、倒下成为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或原地不动。在其服从你的命令之前，它不能延迟或进行任何反应动作（）。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用单动作来照你的命令行事。

大成功或大失败 目标必须在其下个回合用尽全部动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造最多四个漂浮的光源，任意两个之间相距不超过10英尺。每个光源如同火把般照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60英尺。每个光源必须保持在你120英尺范围内，并且与所有其他光源之间保持在10英尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你扰乱目标的心智，并用一次精神冲击使其目眩。该冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须进行一次基础意志豁免。若目标在豁免中大失败，则其还会获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

高度化（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Detect Magic.name: 侦测魔法 Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
你释放出一道脉冲，用以识别魔法的存在。除了是否存在魔法之外，你不会获得任何信息。你可以选择忽略你已完全知晓的魔法，例如你和盟友的魔法物品以及持续中的法术。

你只能在该魔法的效果等级低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，才会侦测到幻术系魔法。然而，具有幻术灵光但外观上并不具欺骗性的物品（例如隐形术药水）通常仍会被正常侦测到。

升阶（3环） 你得知该法术在射程内所侦测到的最高等级效果所属的魔法学派。若有多个效果同等强大，则由GM决定你得知哪一个。

升阶（4环） 同3环，但你还会锁定最高等级魔法的来源。类似于模糊感官，你不会得知确切位置，但可以将来源缩小到一个5尺立方体内（若来源大于该范围，则为最接近的范围）。

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies.

You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower level than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the school of magic for the highest-level effect within range that the spell detects. If multiple effects are equally strong, the GM determines which you learn.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd level, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-level magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的触须从你的指尖卷出，在空中疾驰。你对直线内的活体生物造成2d4点虚空伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]点伤害。直线内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受全部伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4点，持续流血伤害增加1点。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Know Direction.name: 指北术 Know Direction
Know Direction.description:
在你的心眼中，你看见一条通向北方的路径。你会立刻知道哪个方向是北方（如果在你当前所在的位置存在北方的话）。

升阶（7环） 你可以改为得知通往一个熟悉地点的方向，例如之前的家或最喜欢的酒馆。

In your mind's eye, you see a path northward. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location).

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a previous home or a favorite tavern.

Mending.name: 修复术 Mending
Mending.description:
你修理目标物品。你每个法术环阶为目标恢复5点生命值，若这次修理使该物品的生命值超过其破损阈值，则可能移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} 状态。你无法替换丢失的部件，也无法修理已被完全摧毁的物体。

升阶（2环） 你可以以负载为1或更少的非魔法物体为目标。

升阶（3环） 你可以以负载为2或更少的非魔法物体为目标，或以负载为1或更少的魔法物体为目标。

You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一个魔法力场护盾术。这视为使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在你的下一个回合开始前获得AC+1环境加值，但不需要手来使用。

在该法术的效果持续期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾具有硬度5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环） 该护盾具有硬度10。

升阶（5环） 该护盾具有硬度15。

升阶（7环） 该护盾具有硬度20。

升阶（9环） 该护盾具有硬度25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spel.name: 连发飞弹魔杖（1环法术） Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spell)
Wand of Manifold Missiles (1st-Rank Spel.description:
这根魔杖顶部雕刻着龙首，中段镶嵌着一颗抛光的金属球。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你以1环施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}。

在你施放该法术后，在你每个回合开始时，魔杖都会额外发射一枚或多枚飞弹，如同你施放了魔法飞弹的1动作版本。每次都选择目标。此效应持续1分钟，直到你不再持用该魔杖，或直到你再次尝试启动该魔杖为止。

制造需求 提供一次施放适当环阶的魔法飞弹。

This wand features a carved dragon's head at its top and a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency Once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} at 1st rank.

After you cast the spell, an additional missile or missiles are released from the wand at the start of each of your turns, as though you cast the 1-action version of magic missile. Choose targets each time. This lasts for 1 minute, until you're no longer wielding the wand, or until you try to activate the wand again.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of magic missile of the appropriate rank.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有针对精神的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental

Stone Defense.name: 岩石防御 Stone Defense
Stone Defense.description:
触发 一名敌人即将以钝击伤害或以具有土（特征）的法术对洞窟先知造成伤害

效果 洞窟先知获得对触发的伤害的抗力10。

Trigger An enemy is about to damage the cavern seer with bludgeoning damage or with a spell that has the earth trait

Effect The cavern seer gains resistance 10 against the triggering damage.

Cavern Distortion.name: 洞穴扭曲 Cavern Distortion
Cavern Distortion.description:
频率 每天一次

需求 洞窟先知在地下

效果 碎石和尘土从岩石中升起以阻碍视线。洞窟先知及其60英尺内的盟友获得隐蔽状态，持续1分钟。

这种隐蔽不能用于躲藏或潜行。

Frequency once per day

Requirements The cavern seer is underground

Effect Pebbles and dust rise from the stone to impede vision. The cavern seer and their allies within 60 feet become concealed for 1 minute.

This concealment can't be used to Hide or Sneak.

Underground Stride.name: 地底阔步 Underground Stride
Underground Stride.description:
洞窟先知在地下时无视困难地形。

The cavern seer ignores difficult terrain while underground.

Klathor.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Lady's Whisper.name: 女士的耳语 Lady's Whisper

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 奥术自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

True Seeing (Constant).name: 真视术（恒定） True Seeing (Constant)
True Seeing (Constant).description:
你能看见60英尺内的事物真实的样子。GM对区域内的任何幻术或变化系效果进行一次秘密的反制检定，但仅用于确定你是否能看穿它（例如，若该检定成功反制一个变形法术，你能看见该生物的真实形态，但你不会终止该变形法术）。

You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion or transmutation in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

Crushing Despair.name: 极度绝望 Crushing Despair
Crushing Despair.description:
你在区域内对生物施加绝望灵光。每个生物的效果由其意志豁免决定。

大成功或大失败 成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 持续1轮，该生物不能使用反应动作（），并且必须在其回合开始时再进行一次豁免；若失败，则在该回合中由于无法控制地啜泣而获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

失败 同成功，但持续时间为1分钟。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，且该生物自动获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}，持续1分钟。

升阶（第7环） 区域增加为60尺锥形。

You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

Mind Probe.name: 精神质询 Mind Probe
Mind Probe.description:
你将思绪投射入一名生物的心智，筛选信息。你能接触目标的记忆与知识，除非它以一次意志豁免将你击退。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 在法术持续时间的每一轮，你都可以维持法术以提出一个不同的问题，并尝试揭示答案。针对每个问题，目标都可以尝试一次欺瞒检定对抗你的法术DC；若目标成功，你不会得知答案；而在大成功或大失败时，目标会给出一个你认为真实的虚假答案。一旦你向目标询问过某个特定问题，再次询问该问题，即使是以一次独立施放的精神质询，也会产生相同的结果。

大成功或大失败 同失败，且目标在针对你的问题进行的欺瞒检定上承受-4环境减值。

You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the Spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a -4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Shadow Blast.name: 幽影爆破 Shadow Blast
Shadow Blast.description:
你将幽影位面的半真实物质塑造成一次爆发。选择酸、钝击、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、穿刺、挥砍或音波伤害，并选择一个 @Template[cone|distance:30]、一个位于120尺内的 @Template[burst|distance:15]，或一个 @Template[line|distance:50]。该爆发对区域内的每个生物造成你所选择类型的5d8伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d8。

You shape the quasi-real substance of the Shadow Plane into a blast. Choose acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, slashing, or sonic damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 5d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Blink.name: 闪现术 Blink
Blink.description:
你在物质位面与以太位面之间快速闪烁。你获得对所有伤害的抗力5（除了力场）。你可以维持该法术来消失并在距离10尺远处、由GM决定的随机方向重新出现；该移动不会触发反应动作（）。在你回合结束时，你如上所述消失并重新出现。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Blink}

升阶（+2） 该抗力提高3。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Blink}

You blink quickly between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. You gain resistance 5 to all damage (except force). You can Sustain the Spell to vanish and reappear 10 feet away in a random direction determined by the GM; the movement doesn't trigger reactions. At the end of your turn, you vanish and reappear as above.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Blink}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

Gaseous Form.name: 气化形体 Gaseous Form
Gaseous Form.description:
目标变形为一种蒸汽状态。在此状态下，目标为无定形体。它失去任何对AC的物品加值，以及来自护甲的所有其他效果与加值，并使用其无甲防御的熟练度调整值。它获得对物理伤害的抗力8，并免疫精准伤害。它无法施放法术、启用物品，或使用带有攻击或操作（特征）的动作。它获得10英尺的飞行速度，并能滑过细小裂缝。目标可以解消该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{Spell Effect: Vapor Form}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{Spell Effect: Vapor Form}

The target transforms into a vaporous state. In this state, the target is amorphous. It loses any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and it uses its proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. It gains resistance 8 to physical damage and is immune to precision damage. It can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. It gains a fly Speed of 10 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. The target can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.sILRkGTwoBywy0BU]{Spell Effect: Vapor Form}

Modify Memory.name: 修改记忆 Modify Memory
Modify Memory.description:
你改变目标的记忆，可以抹除一段记忆、增强一段记忆的清晰度、改变一段记忆，或添加一段虚假记忆。目标可以尝试一次意志豁免以抵抗该法术。

大成功 目标不受影响，并意识到你试图改变它的记忆。

成功 目标不受影响，但会认为你的法术是某种无害的东西而非修改记忆，除非它识别出该法术。

失败 在该法术持续时间的最初5分钟内，你可以维持法术以每轮修改一次记忆。当你这么做时，你构想最多6秒的记忆进行修改，最多可达连续5分钟的记忆。

你所改变的任何记忆只要该法术仍然生效就会保持改变状态。若目标在这5分钟结束前移出射程，你就无法再改变任何进一步的记忆。

升阶（6环） 你可以对一个自愿的目标施放该法术，以压制其对某个特定主题的所有记忆；该主题需用不超过50个词详述。该效果为永久，并会以模糊不清的朦胧感来填补这些缺失。

You alter the target's memories, either erasing a memory, enhancing a memory's clarity, altering a memory, or adding a false memory. The target can attempt a Will save to resist the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of modify memory, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure During the first 5 minutes of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the Spell to modify a memory once each round. When you do, you imagine up to 6 seconds of memory to modify, to a maximum of 5 continuous minutes of memory.

Any memories you've altered remain changed as long as the spell is active. If the target moves out of range before the 5 minutes is up, you can't alter any further memories.

Heightened (6th) You can cast the spell on a willing target to suppress all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. The effect is permanent, and it patches these omissions with an indistinct haze.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你为目标创造出一个它所能想象到的最可怕的生物的幻影形象。只有该法术的目标能看见这个杀手，不过你能看见幻象那模糊的轮廓疾驰而出进行攻击。杀手的效果取决于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6精神伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6精神伤害，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标害怕到可能会死。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；如果目标失败，则它死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到12d6精神伤害，在其下个回合结束前获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，并获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 失败时的伤害增加2d6，大成功或大失败：失败时的伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Haste (Constant).name: 加速术（恒定） Haste (Constant)
Haste (Constant).description:
魔法使目标能够更快地行动。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}（状态），并且每轮只能将这额外的动作用于打击和疾走动作。

升阶（7环） 你可以以至多6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Hypercognition.name: 极化认知 Hypercognition
Hypercognition.description:
你迅速编目并整理与当前处境相关的信息。作为施放此法术的一部分，你可以立刻使用至多6个回忆知识动作。对于这些动作，你不能使用任何在你回忆知识时触发的特殊能力、反应动作（）或自由动作（）。

You rapidly catalog and collate information relevant to your current situation. You can instantly use up to 6 Recall Knowledge actions as part of Casting this Spell. For these actions, you can't use any special abilities, reactions, or free actions that trigger when you Recall Knowledge.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
