你违抗重力，使目标在离地5尺的高度漂浮。于法术的持续时间内，你可以用具有专注（特征）的单动作，使目标向上或向下移动10尺。通过浮空术漂浮在空中的生物在攻击掷骰上承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定伤势，并在其回合的剩余时间内抵消此减值。若目标邻接于一个固定的物体或具有足够稳定性的地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，如天花板）沿着该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐通过。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断了目标的运动冲动，使其尚未离开其心智之前就被截断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} 持续 1 轮。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标麻痹持续 4 轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，以将剩余持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功或大失败：成功时完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你使目标周围的时代流动变得迟缓，减慢其动作。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} 状态，持续 1 分钟。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触将生命精华从一个目标体内汲取出来以强化你自己。你对目标造成6d6虚空伤害。你获得等于目标受到的虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等之后）。1分钟后，你失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Calm Emotions.name: 安定心神 Calm Emotions
Calm Emotions.description:
你强行使区域内的生物安定心神，将它们抚慰至非暴力状态；每个生物必须尝试进行一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 该生物不受影响。

成功 安定冲动使该生物的攻击掷骰承受-1状态减值。

失败 任何会影响该生物的情绪效果都会被压制，且该生物不能使用敌对动作。若目标受到任何其他生物的敌对对待，则其不再受安定心神影响。

大成功或大失败 同失败，但敌对不会结束该效果。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm emotions.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一个濒死的生物的生命掐灭。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若这使其死亡，你获得10点临时HP，以及持续10分钟的对攻击与伤害掷骰的+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Mirror Image.name: 镜影术 Mirror Image
Mirror Image.description:
三个你的幻象在你的空间周围盘旋，可能会导致那些攻击你的人击中其中一个幻象而不是你。任何本会命中你的攻击，都有一个随机几率改为命中你的一个幻象而不是你。若三个幻象都仍在，则命中你的几率为 1/4（在[[/r 1d4]]上掷出1）。若剩余两个幻象，则命中你的几率为 1/3（在[[/r 1d6]]上掷出1-2）。若只剩一个幻象，则命中你的几率为 1/2（在[[/r 1d6]]上掷出1-3）。

一旦一个幻象被命中，它就会被摧毁。若一次攻击掷骰未能命中你的AC但没有大成功或大失败，则它会摧毁一个幻象，但没有额外效果（即使该攻击通常在失败时也会产生效果）。若一次攻击掷骰为大成功或大失败且本会命中其中一个幻象，则摧毁其中一个幻象，并使该次攻击掷骰改为对你造成成功。一旦所有幻象都被摧毁，该法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}

[[/r 1d4]]

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d6]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]{Spell Effect: Mirror Image}).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

[[/r 1d4]]

See Invisibility (Constant).name: 识破隐形（恒定） See Invisibility (Constant)
See Invisibility (Constant).description:
你可以看见 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 生物和物体。它们在你眼中呈现为半透明的形状，并且对你而言它们处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。

升阶（5环） 该法术的持续时间为 8 小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

You can see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creatures and objects. They appear to you as translucent shapes, and they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen} to you.

Heightened (5th) The spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}

Touch of Idiocy.name: 愚者之触 Touch of Idiocy
Touch of Idiocy.description:
你使目标的心智迟钝；目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}。

You dull the target's mind; the target must attempt a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Command.name: 命令术 Command
Command.description:
你大声喊出一道难以忽视的命令术。你可以命令目标接近你、逃离（如同其具有 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 状态）、放开其正持有之物、卧倒 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}，或原地不动。在其服从你的命令之前，它不能延迟或进行任何反应动作（）。其效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功 该生物不受影响。

失败 在其下个回合的第一个动作中，该生物必须使用一个单动作来照你所命令的去做。

大失败 目标必须在其下个回合使用其所有动作来服从你的命令。

升阶（5环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智变得混沌，并用一次精神冲击使其目眩。该冲击造成等同于你的施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标在该豁免中大失败，它还会受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你对目标施放恐惧术；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} 且在1轮内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Ghost Sound.name: 幻音术 Ghost Sound
Ghost Sound.description:
你制造一个简单声音的听觉幻象，其最大音量相当于四个正常人同时大喊。声音从你在射程内指定的一个方形区域发出。你无法创造可理解的词语或其他复杂的声音（例如音乐）。

升阶（3环） 射程增加至60尺。

升阶（5环） 射程增加至120尺。

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting. The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

Heightened (3rd) The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 120 feet.

Illusory Disguise.name: 幻象伪装 Illusory Disguise
Illusory Disguise.description:
你创造一个幻觉，使你看起来像另一种具有相同体型的生物，并且其身高（相差不超过6英寸）与体重（相差不超过50磅）都与你大致相近。该伪装通常足以隐藏你的身份，但不足以冒充某个特定个体。该法术不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。你可以改变你的衣物与穿戴物品的外观，例如让你的护甲看起来像一件连衣裙。手持物品不受影响，且你取下的任何穿戴物品都会恢复其真实外观。

施放幻象伪装视为为使用欺瞒的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate} 做好伪装准备；它无视你因把自己伪装成不相似的生物而可能承受的任何环境减值；它给予你+4状态加值，用于进行欺瞒检定以防止他人看穿你的伪装；并且即使你未受训，你也要加上你的等级。你可以解消该法术。

升阶（2环）该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）。

升阶（3环）你可以看起来像任何同体型的生物，甚至是某个特定个体。你必须见过该个体才能呈现其外貌。该法术也会伪装你的声音与气味，并获得听觉与嗅觉（特征）。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

You create an illusion that causes you to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds), as yourself. The disguise is typically good enough to hide your identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. You can change the appearance of your clothing and worn items, such as making your armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item you remove returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise, and you add your level even if you're untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (2nd) The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

Heightened (3rd) You can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to take on their appearance. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.action-macros.Macro.k5nW4jGyXD0Oq9LR]{Impersonate}

Mage Hand.name: 法师之手 Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
你创造一只单独的魔法之手，可以是隐形或幽灵般的，它抓住目标物体并将其缓慢移动最多20英尺。由于你在使该物体悬浮，你可以将其向任何方向移动。当你维持该法术时，你可以让该物体额外移动20英尺。如果该物体在法术结束时仍在空中，该物体会坠落。

升阶（3环）你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（5环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为1或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

升阶（7环）射程增加至60英尺，并且你可以以负载为2或更低的无人持用物体为目标。

You create a single magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and moves it slowly up to 20 feet. Because you're levitating the object, you can move it in any direction. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飞弹 Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
你发射一枚力场飞镖，朝你能看见的一名生物疾驰而去。它自动命中并造成1d4+1点力场伤害。你在施放法术时每额外使用1个动作，你发射的飞弹数量便增加1枚，最多在使用3个动作时发射3枚飞弹。你为每枚飞弹分别选择目标。如果你将多枚飞弹射向同一目标，在应用对伤害的加值或减值、抗力、弱点等之前，先将伤害合并。

升阶（+2） 你每花费1个动作就额外发射1枚飞弹。

You send a dart of force streaking toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of missiles you shoot by one, to a maximum of three missiles for 3 actions. You choose the target for each missile individually. If you shoot more than one missile at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You shoot one additional missile with each action you spend.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法的力场护盾术。这算作使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在下个回合开始前的AC获得+1环境加值，但不需要空出一只手来使用。

在该法术效果持续期间，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}反应动作（）。该护盾术的硬度为5。你使用Shield Block后，法术结束，并且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。不同于普通的Shield Block，你可以用该法术的反应动作（）来对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}法术。

升阶该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

升阶（3环）护盾术的硬度为10。

升阶（5环）护盾术的硬度为15。

升阶（7环）护盾术的硬度为20。

升阶（9环）护盾术的硬度为25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一件处于射程内、无人持用且负载为1或更低的松散物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。若你命中，则你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——以你掷出的物体为准——数值等于1d6加上你的施法能力调整值。被掷出的物品不具有任何会影响该攻击或伤害的特定特征或魔法属性。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成全额伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害提高1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Death's Grace.name: 死亡恩赐 Death's Grace
Death's Grace.description:
女士的耳语可以选择其在会以不同方式影响不死生物的效果中是否被视为不死生物。即使它不被视为不死生物，女士的耳语也永远不被视为活体生物。

Lady's Whisper can choose whether or not it counts as undead for effects that affect undead differently. Even if it does not count as undead, Lady's Whisper never counts as a living creature.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时，所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

Negative Recovery.name: 负能量治疗 Negative Recovery
Negative Recovery.description:
女士的耳语可以选择是否承受活力伤害。

Lady's Whisper can choose whether or not it takes vitality damage.

Sibilant Whispers.name: 窃窃耳语 Sibilant Whispers
Sibilant Whispers.description:
20英尺。每个在该光环内开始其回合且能听到不祥低语的生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:30] 意志豁免中成功，否则成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。若成功，该生物会获得持续1分钟的暂时免疫。

20 feet. Each creature that begins its turn within the aura and can hear the ominous whispers must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Gatekeeper's Will.name: 守门者的意志 Gatekeeper's Will
Gatekeeper's Will.description:
女士的耳语以心灵力量使宁布洛斯之门内（区域B60至B64以及区域C1至C18）的任何门或传送门开启或关闭。若女士的耳语令一扇门关闭，则必须通过破拆或将其砸开才能打开。

Lady's Whisper mentally causes any doors or portals within the Gate of Nhimbaloth (areas B60 to B64 and areas C1 through C18) to open or shut. If Lady's Whisper wills a door closed, it must be Forced Open or battered down.

Unwilling Teleportation.name: 强迫传送 Unwilling Teleportation
Unwilling Teleportation.description:
当女士的耳语以其爪击Strike命中并对一个生物造成伤害时，它可以选择将该生物传送到15英尺内任意一个开放的空间，即使女士的耳语看不见目的地。目标可以尝试进行一次 @Check[will|dc:30] 豁免掷骰以抵抗该效果。

When Lady's Whisper hits and damages a creature with its claw Strike, it can choose to teleport that creature to any open space within 15 feet, even if Lady's Whisper can't see the destination. The target can attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] saving throw to resist this effect.

Lady's Whisper.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

Ofalth.name: 奥法斯特 Ofalth

Refuse Pile.name: 拒绝堆积 Refuse Pile
Refuse Pile.description:
当它们不处于危险之中时，奥法尔斯可以花费 1 分钟安置进一个 10 尺高、看起来像一堆垃圾的堆积物中。直到下一次它采取动作之前，奥法尔斯获得 AC +2 环境加值。

进入该垃圾堆的区域或与其互动的生物必须尝试进行一次对抗奥法尔斯恶臭的豁免。

When they're not in danger, an ofalth can spend 1 minute settling into a 10-foot pile that looks like a heap of garbage. Until the next time it takes an action, the ofalth gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

A creature that enters the area of the garbage heap or interacts with it must attempt a save against the ofalth's stench.

Filth Wallow.name: 粪坑打滚 Filth Wallow
Filth Wallow.description:
当奥法尔斯处于碎屑或排泄物高度集中的区域时，例如垃圾堆或下水道，它获得快速治疗2。

An ofalth gains fast healing 2 when in an area with a high concentration of debris or excrement, such as a refuse heap or sewer.

Wretched Weeps.name: 卑劣悲泣 Wretched Weeps
Wretched Weeps.description:
豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

阶段 1 携带者且无不良效果（1 天）

阶段 2 每小时 @Damage[2d4[bleed]]{2d4 持续流血} 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}（1 天）；

阶段 3 每小时 @Damage[2d6[bleed]]{2d6 持续流血} 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}（1 天）

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:26]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d4[bleed]]{2d4 persistent bleed} every hour and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 day);

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[bleed]]{2d6 persistent bleed} every hour and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 day)

Ofalth.publicNotes:
完全成年的欧法尔斯会捕获受害者，并慢慢把他们活活吃掉。

欧法尔斯栖息于城堡粪堆、城市垃圾场与下水道中，是由潮湿残渣、污水与垃圾构成的活体混合体。它们携带一种名为“悲惨渗血”的疾病，会使受害者的血液从毛孔中渗出。

Fully grown ofalths capture victims and slowly eat them alive.

Found in castle dung heaps, city dumps, and sewers, ofalths are living amalgamations of wet detritus, sewage, and rubbish. They carry a disease called wretched weeps that causes the victim's blood to seep from its pores.

Quara Orshendiel.name: 库娅拉·奥申迪尔 Quara Orshendiel
Quara Orshendiel.tokenName: 库娅拉·奥申迪尔 Quara Orshendiel

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意施放） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一片黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在该区域内穿透或散发。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在该区域内都不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外也一样。这也会压制你黑暗术法术等级或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看到的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
当你施放该法术时，区域内的所有生物在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热火焰勾勒。可见的生物在受到妖火术影响时不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。如果这些生物为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}，则它们在受到妖火术影响时处于 Concealed 状态，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，任意两个之间相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样照明。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在你120尺以内并且与所有其他光源相距不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

+1 Striking Kukri.name: +1 强袭库克里 +1 Striking Kukri
+1 Striking Kukri.description:
这把一尺长的刀刃向内弯曲，刀柄处没有护手。

The blade of this foot-long knife curves inward and lacks a cross guard at the hilt.

Repeating Hand Crossbow.name: 连发手弩 Repeating Hand Crossbow

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。不过，它比链甲轻得多，只能保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Shootist Bandolier.name: 射手弹带 Shootist Bandolier
Shootist Bandolier.description:
这条皮革射手弹带在可用拇指快速一拨就弹开的皮革口袋中可容纳至多三个 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines}。你从射手弹带中取出连发手弩弹匣为连发手弩装填时，将装填所需动作减少 1，总计为 2 个动作。你一次只能穿戴一条射手弹带。

This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine.name: 连发手弩弹匣 Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
迷梦毒是对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison} 更为强效的蒸馏物。再次暴露于迷梦毒不需要 目标 进行额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露进行豁免投掷时失败，才会推进其 阶段。

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

最大持续时间 6 小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} 和 措手不及（1 轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，且无法通过 察觉 检定 醒来（1 轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过 察觉 检定 醒来（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 小时}）

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对所有对抗魔法的豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有针对精神的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental

Commanding Aura.name: 指挥灵光 Commanding Aura
Commanding Aura.description:
30英尺。夸拉周围的卓尔因她的存在而振奋。她在灵光中的卓尔盟友在攻击掷骰和技能检定上获得+1状态加值。

30 feet. Drow around Quara are heartened by her presence. Her drow allies in the aura gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks.

Deny Advantage.name: 否决优势 Deny Advantage
Deny Advantage.description:
夸拉不会对11级或更低等级的隐匿、未察觉或进行夹击的生物处于措手不及状态，也不会对11级或更低等级使用突然袭击的生物处于措手不及状态。

Quara isn't off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of 11th level or lower, or to creatures of 11th level or lower using Surprise Attack.

Evasion.name: 反射闪避 Evasion
Evasion.description:
当夸拉在反射豁免掷骰中掷出成功时，她改为获得大成功。

When Quara rolls a success on a Reflex saving throw, she gets a critical success instead.

Defensive Shooter.name: 防御式射手 Defensive Shooter
Defensive Shooter.description:
夸拉的远程攻击不会触发反应动作（）。

Quara's ranged attacks don't trigger reactions.

Poison Weapon.name: 涂毒武器 Poison Weapon
Poison Weapon.description:
需求 Quara 正持有一把穿刺或挥砍武器，并且有一只空手

效果 Quara 将毒药涂抹在该武器上。

Requirements Quara is holding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand

Effect Quara applies poison to the weapon.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 夸拉正持有一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 夸拉以【交互】来装填连发手弩并用其进行【打击】。

Requirements Quara is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect Quara Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 夸拉进行交互动作以拔出一把已装填的连发手弩并用其进行打击，或使用她持握的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后进行交互动作将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect Quara Interacts to draw a loaded repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow she's holding and then Interacts to stow it.

Skirmishing Dash.name: 战斗冲刺 Skirmishing Dash
Skirmishing Dash.description:
夸拉大步或快步，然后打击。此次打击额外造成3d6伤害。

Quara Strides or Steps, then Strikes. This Strike deals an additional 3d6 damage.

Quara Orshendiel.publicNotes:
夸拉很可能会成为英雄们的盟友，因为她一眼就能看出谁是有用的伙伴。她想为父亲和妹妹报仇，但她也明白，父亲追寻赭石支点镜片时所追求的目标，可能在将伊尔达里斯永远从贝科拉的控制中解放出来这件事上起到关键作用。她得知，这枚赭石镜片只是贝科拉在数个世纪前托付给该地区盟友的三枚镜片之一，于是她让英雄们踏上回收这些镜片并进一步查明真相的道路。夸拉为英雄们提供的最重要线索是：她的父亲正前往湖边边缘的一座古老地窖，因此英雄们可以在那个地点查到更多。

英雄们可能会将卓尔视为敌人并袭击伊尔达里斯。在这种情况下，夸拉会尽全力保护她的族人，依靠她敏捷手指中仍未消退的枪手训练。经历这样的侵略之后，她很可能不会再信任英雄们并向其提供任何情报，但他们或许能在她的住处找到一些线索。

Quara will likely become an ally of the heroes, as she knows useful partners when she sees them. She's interested in avenging her father and sister, but she knows that whatever goal her father was pursuing with the Ochre Fulcrum Lens could prove critical in freeing Yldaris from Belcorra's control forever. She has learned that the ochre lens was only one of three lenses that Belcorra entrusted to allies in the region centuries ago, and she sets the heroes on the trail of recovering them and finding out more. The most important lead Quara provides to the heroes is that her father was headed toward an ancient vault at the edge of the lake, so the heroes can find out more at that location.

The heroes might see drow as enemies and assault Yldaris. In this case, Quara does her best to protect her people, relying on the shootist training that still lingers in her quick fingers. She likely won't trust the heroes with any information after such aggressions, but they might find some clues in her quarters.

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在该区域内穿透或发散。光亮不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或灯笼）在区域内都不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本会延伸到黑暗之外亦是如此。这也会压制你该黑暗术同环阶或更低环阶的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看去，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即便是拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强透过这片黑暗看见。他们将透过这片黑暗看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

It can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

Corrupt Water.name: 腐化之水 Corrupt Water
Corrupt Water.description:
频率 每日一次

效果 巨龙永久玷污90尺内10立方尺的液体。该液体变得不可饮用，且无法支撑具有水下呼吸能力的生命。

若液体魔法或炼金物品的等级低于巨龙，则此效果会将其摧毁（生物可以尝试一次@Check[will|dc:28]意志豁免，以保护其占有中的液体）。此效果不会影响生物体内的液体。

Frequency Once per day

Effect The dragon permanently befouls 10 cubic feet of liquid within 90 feet. The liquid becomes undrinkable and unable to support water-breathing life.

This destroys liquid magic or alchemical items if they're of a lower level than the dragon (a creature can attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save to protect liquids in its possession). This doesn't affect liquids in a creature's body.

Draconic Frenzy.name: 龙族狂乱 Draconic Frenzy

巨龙以任意顺序进行两次爪击打击和一次角击打击。

The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horns Strike in any order.

Draconic Momentum.name: 龙之动量 Draconic Momentum

The dragon recharges its Breath Weapon whenever it scores a critical hit with a Strike

Ravirex.publicNotes:
作为沼泽、湿地、泥沼与泽地的嗜杀暴君，黑龙以炽烈的狂热恐吓其领域。它们欣然以虐待为乐，从深邃洞穴或沼泽中其他与世隔绝之处统治其腐臭的公国，手段兼具闪电般迅捷的突袭与阴谋诡计。它们对其他生物的憎恨如其吐息般酸蚀，且几乎不会容忍同类的其他龙——除非是为了交配，或为击倒共同的敌人而短暂合作。

黑龙为两栖——尽管它们以空气呼吸，鳃也使其能够在水中呼吸。它们的颈褶与鳍让它们成为出色的游泳者，十分适应其湿地环境与水下巢穴。它们对因其腐化水的魔法能力而产生的腐臭水体免疫。

黑龙的巢穴与其灵魂一样污秽。地面散落着腐烂的肉块，被掠夺来的宝藏沿着阴湿洞窟中的淤泥与黏液铺陈，周围缠绕着扭曲的根系与蔓生植物。此类地点往往爬满害虫、蛇与软泥怪。它们能占据天然洞窟时便会如此，但在不得已时，也会以沼泽中植被浓密、盘结扭曲的区域为巢。黑龙的宝藏堆主要由宝石与昂贵的玻璃工艺品构成，因为较为柔软的材质无法在龙那酸蚀性的存在中存留。

龙的种类繁多，从强大的位面龙到奇异的秘奥龙皆有其例，但很少有哪一类龙能像彩色龙那样广为人知、也同样理所当然地令人畏惧。它们以鳞片色泽区分；每一种颜色的龙都会释放出其独有的嗜杀残酷——无论是以利爪、尖牙，或吐息——而且不同于大多数生物，龙只会随着年代增长而变得更为强大。它们对宝藏、食物、杀戮与掌控的渴求堪称传奇。其肉体强悍，且自负与之相称；这些龙往往道德败坏，行事如犯罪首脑、凶残暴君，或贪婪的劫掠者。

Murderous tyrants of marshes, swamps, bogs, and fens, black dragons terrorize their domains with intense fervor. Gleefully sadistic, they rule their fetid principalities from a deep cave or otherwise isolated part of the swamp with a mix of lightning-quick raids and subterfuge. Their hatred for other creatures is as acidic as their breath weapons, and they rarely tolerate even other dragons of their kind-except perhaps to mate or temporarily collaborate to take down a mutual enemy.

Black dragons are amphibious-although they breathe air, their gills also allow them to breathe water. Their frills and fins make them accomplished swimmers, well suited to their wetland environments and submerged lairs. They're immune to the fetid water that comes as a result of their magical ability to corrupt water.

Black dragon lairs are as foul as their souls. The floors are littered with rotting meat, and plundered treasures line the muck and slime of their dank caves amid twisted roots and creepers. Such places are often crawling with pests, snakes, and slimes. Though they claim natural caverns when they can, they make do with areas of dense, twisted vegetation within a swamp. Black dragon treasure hoards primarily consist of gems and expensive glass work, as valuables of softer substance can't survive the dragon's acidic presence.

While there are many types of dragons, from the powerful planar dragons to the strange esoteric dragons, few dragon varieties are as well-known and as rightly feared as the chromatic dragons. Differentiated by the hue of their scales, each color of dragon unleashes its own flavor of murderous cruelty-be it by claw, tooth, or breath-and unlike most creatures, dragons only become more powerful as they age. Their lust for treasure, food, bloodshed, and control are legendary. Physically powerful with egos to match, these dragons are often morally depraved and act as criminal masterminds, vicious tyrants, or voracious raiders.

Creatures that fail their save are exposed to skull rot.

Paralysis.name: 麻痹 Paralysis
Paralysis.description:
被泡泡球的触须击中的生物必须成功通过一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:28] 豁免，否则将变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}。麻痹的生物可以在其每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免。

A creature hit by the puffball's tendril must succeed a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. The paralyzed creature can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns.

Spore Cloud.description:
马勃释放出一片@Template[cone|distance:30]的孢子，造成@Damage[4d8[poison]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic]豁免）给锥形范围内的生物。

Creatures that fail this save are also exposed to skull rot.

Reaper Skull Puffball.publicNotes:
许多无害的马勃真菌附着在幽暗地域洞窟的森林地面残骸上。这些真菌的巨型版本更为机动且更危险。

当这种真菌探测到猎物时，它的触须会扭动并分泌麻痹性毒素。

Many benign puffball fungi cling to the detritus of forest floors in Darklands caverns. These fungi's giant versions are more mobile and dangerous.

When this fungus detects prey, its tendrils writhe and exude a paralytic toxin.

Intimidating Display.name: 恐吓展示 Intimidating Display
Intimidating Display.description:
巨伞蜥移动。如果它在该次移动结束时与至少1个其他生物相邻，它会突然展示其色彩斑斓的颈部皮褶并发出令人恐惧的嘶声。每个相邻生物必须在一次 @Check[will|dc:21] 豁免中成功，否则变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}（大失败则为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}）。

随后，该生物在1分钟内对 Intimidating Display 暂时免疫。

The giant frilled lizard Strides. If it ends that Stride adjacent to at least one other creature, it suddenly displays its colorful neck frills and issues a frightening hiss. Each adjacent creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:21] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure).

The creature is then temporarily immune to Intimidating Display for 1 minute.

Riding Lizard.publicNotes:
栖息于温暖的热带森林与稀树草原之中，这些巨大的蜥蜴对毫无防备的旅人而言是致命威胁。当它们不在睡觉或潜行追踪猎物时，巨伞蜥会一次在阳光下晒上好几个小时。探险者有时会因其大型（体型）、精致的颈部褶边（在展示攻击性与支配地位时展开，会被误认为是翅膀）以及用来吓退那些大到无法吞食的生物的凶猛嘶嘶叫声，而误以为它们与龙类有关。

巨伞蜥的主要食物来源是体型夸张的节肢动物与其他无脊椎动物，但它也会毫不犹豫地用脊椎动物来补充食谱，包括其他蜥蜴、猴子，以及几乎任何它能塞进嘴里的东西——甚至类人生物。尽管它能够短暂爆发出惊人的速度，巨伞蜥在狩猎时通常会一动不动地趴着，期望伏击其猎物。

蜥蜴的外观与能力差异极大，但大多数都共享一种基本的爬行动物外形——长尾巴、宽阔且布满牙齿的嘴，以及四条腿。尽管少数物种能在短时间内用两条腿移动，但大多数都严格以四足行走。此处展示的三种蜥蜴，代表了大型物种中最常见也最广为人知的几类。

Found in warm and tropical forests and savannas, these immense lizards are a deadly threat to the unsuspecting traveler. When they aren't sleeping or stalking prey, giant frilled lizards bask in the sunlight for hours at a time. Explorers sometimes mistakenly think they are related to dragons due to their large size, elaborate neck frills (which, when displayed in a show of aggression and dominance, can be mistaken for wings), and ferocious hissing vocalizations used to frighten away creatures too large to eat.

A giant frilled lizard's primary food sources are oversized arthropods and other invertebrates, but it won't hesitate to augment its diet with vertebrates, including other lizards, monkeys, and just about anything it can fit into its mouth—even humanoids. Although capable of short bursts of speed, a giant frilled lizard normally lies perfectly still while hunting, hoping to ambush its prey.

Lizards have a wide range of appearances and abilities, but most share a basic reptilian shape—long tails, wide toothy mouths, and four legs. While a few species are capable of movement on two legs for short periods of time, most are strictly quadrupedal. The three species presented here represent the most common and well-known of the larger species.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你所选择颜色的缤纷、无热的火焰勾勒出轮廓。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。若这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态，则在受妖火术影响期间它们处于 Concealed 状态，而不是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光亮术，任意两个之间相距不超过10英尺。每个都像火把一样发光。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光亮术移动至多60英尺。每个光亮术必须保持在你120英尺范围内，并且与其他所有光亮术之间相距不超过10英尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也称为锁子甲袍，这是一件长衫，由与链甲相同的金属环构成。然而，它比链甲轻得多，只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Arrows.name: 箭矢 Arrows
Arrows.description:
这些投射物是弓的弹药。箭杆由木头制成。它在飞行中由一端的羽翎稳定，另一端则装有金属箭头。

These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Deft Evasion.name: 灵巧反射 Deft Evasion
Deft Evasion.description:
当猎人在一次反射豁免中掷骰获得成功时，他们改为获得大成功或大失败。

When the hunter rolls a success on a Reflex save, they get a critical success instead.

Hunter's Wound.name: 猎手之伤 Hunter's Wound
Hunter's Wound.description:
频率 每轮一次

先决条件 猎人正持用一把装填为0的远程武器

效果 猎人对其猎物进行两次远程打击。若两次都命中且造成伤害，则目标额外受到 @Damage[1d8[bleed]]。

Frequency once per round

Prerequisites The hunter is wielding a ranged weapon with a reload of 0

Effect The hunter makes two ranged Strikes against their prey. If both hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]].

Skirmish Strike.name: 快速战斗 Skirmish Strike
Skirmish Strike.description:
猎人可以先迈步后打击，或先打击后迈步。

The hunter can Step and then Strike, or Strike and then Step.

Rikizlia.publicNotes:
猎人会去寻找猎物，以维持卓尔社群的供给与运作。

卓尔因其主要聚居地中对恶魔的崇拜而有邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以具有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

Hunters seek out game to keep drow communities fed and functioning.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Rikizlia.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Salaisa Malthulas.name: 萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯 Salaisa Malthulas
Salaisa Malthulas.tokenName: 萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯 Salaisa Malthulas

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造一层黑暗术帷幕，阻止光亮术在区域内穿透或发散。光亮术不会进入该区域，且任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内都不会发出任何光亮术，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗术之外也是如此。这也会压制你的黑暗术法术位阶或更低位阶的魔法光亮术。光亮术无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，它表现为一颗纯粹黑暗术的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使拥有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗术。他们将透过黑暗术看到的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放该法术时处于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的绚丽、无热的火焰勾勒。可见的生物在受到妖火术影响时不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。若这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}，则在受到妖火术影响时它们处于隐蔽，而非 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，任意两个之间相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样照明。你维持法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在距你120尺以内，并且与所有其他光源之间保持在10尺以内，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

+1 Striking Corrosive Longsword.name: +1 猛击 腐蚀 长剑 +1 Striking Corrosive Longsword
+1 Striking Corrosive Longsword.description:
长剑可以是单刃剑或双刃剑。其剑刃沉重，长度在3到4英尺之间。

Longswords can be one-edged or two-edged swords. Their blades are heavy and they're between 3 and 4 feet in length.

Breastplate.name: 胸甲 Breastplate
Breastplate.description:
尽管被称为胸甲，这种护甲由几块板甲或半身板甲护甲组成，用于保护躯干、胸部、颈部，有时还包括臀部和小腿。它在策略上提供了板甲的部分防护，同时允许更大的灵活性和更高的速度。

Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

Salaisa's Key.name: 萨莱萨的钥匙 Salaisa's Key

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
迷梦毒是对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison} 更强效的蒸馏物。进一步暴露于迷梦毒不会要求目标进行额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露进行豁免投掷失败时，才会使其阶段推进。

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

最大持续时间 6小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}（1轮）

阶段 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} 且措手不及（1轮）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，且无法通过察觉检定唤醒（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定唤醒（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6小时}）

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20|traits:alchemical,incapacitation,injury,poison,sleep]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对所有对抗心灵效应的豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status To All Saves vs. Mental

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Attack Now!.name: 立即攻击！ Attack Now!
Attack Now!.description:
萨莱莎大喊，一名30英尺内能看见或听见萨莱莎的卓尔盟友可以用反应动作进行一次近战或远程打击。

Salaisa shouts, and a drow ally within 30 feet that can see or hear Salaisa makes a melee or ranged Strike as a reaction.

Storm of Blades.name: 剑刃风暴 Storm of Blades
Storm of Blades.description:
萨莱莎步行最多至她的速度。她可以在此次移动期间的任意时点进行至多三次长剑打击，每次都必须针对触及范围内的不同目标。这些攻击计入她的多重攻击减值，但多重攻击减值直到她完成所有攻击后才会增加。若她在剑刃风暴期间移动不超过她速度的一半，则该移动不会触发反应动作（）。

Salaisa Strides up to her Speed. She can make up to three longsword Strikes at any point during this movement, each against a different target within reach. These attacks count toward her multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after she makes all of her attacks. If she moves half her speed or less during Storm of Blades, that movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Salaisa Malthulas.blurb:
女性卓尔卫队长
Female drow head warden
Salaisa Malthulas.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental
Salaisa Malthulas.prototypeToken: 萨莱莎·马尔苏拉斯 Salaisa Malthulas

Shuln.name: 地鼠怪 Shuln

Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet.name: 震颤感知（不精确）60英尺 Tremorsense (Imprecise) 60 feet

Armor-Rending Strikes.name: 撕裂护甲打击 Armor-Rending Strikes
Armor-Rending Strikes.description:
每当地鼠怪以近战打击造成大成功时，它也会对目标的护甲造成等同的伤害，无视任何低于10的硬度，如精金。

Any time the shuln scores a critical hit with a melee Strike, it also deals the same amount of damage to the target's armor, bypassing any Hardness lower than 10, like adamantine.

Shuln Saliva.name: 地鼠怪唾液 Shuln Saliva
Shuln Saliva.description:
豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

最大持续时间 6 轮

阶段 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] 伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（1 轮）

阶段 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] 伤害，且迟缓 1（1 轮）

阶段 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]] 伤害且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续 [[/br 2d6 #Paralysis Duration]]{2d6 小时}。地鼠怪的唾液能够克服那不可抗拒的能力。

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage, and slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for [[/br 2d6 #Paralysis Duration]]{2d6 hours}. Shuln saliva overcomes the inexorable ability.

Unstoppable Burrow.name: 势不可挡的掘地 Unstoppable Burrow
Unstoppable Burrow.description:
地鼠怪可以像在泥土或松散的瓦砾中一样钻掘进入坚固的岩石以及任何硬度低于精金的金属，留下一个直径10英尺的隧道。

Shulns can burrow into solid rock and any metal with a hardness less than that of adamantine like it is soil or loose rubble, leaving a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.

Shuln.publicNotes:
作为上层幽暗地域的灾厄，这些巨大的类鼹怪物用粗壮的前臂与堪比精金般坚硬的利爪切割并钻掘坚实的岩石。地鼠怪可长到约20英尺，拥有四只极小、几乎难以察觉的眼睛；一条细长而苍白的口鼻；四条肌肉粗壮的腿，末端是修长带锯齿的利爪；以及一截短粗的粉色尾巴。当地鼠怪幼体成熟时，其独特的新陈代谢会产出精金，并逐渐渗入其整个骨骼系统。除使其利爪与獠牙几乎无法折断外，这一独特的生理特征还令地鼠怪成为无与伦比的掘地者，也因此备受怪物猎人追捧——他们希望从其尸体中采集这种珍贵材料。

地鼠怪食欲极其旺盛，几乎吃得下它们能抓到的任何东西，但其偏好食谱几乎完全由大型无脊椎动物构成，尤其是洞穴蠕虫。它们依靠覆盖口鼻的细小感知触须，无需视觉也能探知空气与地面中细微的移动。当它们察觉到合适的猎物时，地鼠怪会在第一时间咬住其目标，并将唾液中的强效麻痹毒素注入其中。这种毒药强到足以制服几乎不可阻挡的洞穴蠕虫，使地鼠怪成为任何深入幽暗地域蠕虫肆虐地区之人的宝贵（尽管危险）同伴。地鼠怪以臭名昭著的坏脾气，以及总爱把洞挖到地下聚落中本不该挖掘的区域而著称，这使它们成为难以长期留在身边的生物；但若另一种选择是遭遇一条巨大、饥饿、行踪莫测却致命的洞穴蠕虫来访，这些烦恼就完全值得忍受。

在土位面上与更为巨大的类地鼠怪实体的遭遇表明，这些生物可能起源于那里。更大的地鼠怪仍保有其元素特质，聪明得多，并拥有一整套以土为主题的先天原初法术——但即便如此，它们依旧钟爱洞穴蠕虫的味道。

Scourges of the upper Darklands, these enormous, mole-like monstrosities slice and burrow through solid stone with massive forearms and adamantine-strong claws. Shulns grow to about 20 feet long and have four tiny, nearly imperceptible eyes; a long, pale snout; four thick-muscled legs that end in long, serrated claws; and a stubby pink tail. As a young shuln matures, its unique metabolism produces adamantine that becomes infused throughout its skeletal system. In addition to making their claws and fangs nearly unbreakable, this unique physiological trait makes shulns unparalleled burrowers and highly sought by monster hunters who hope to harvest the precious material from their corpses.

Shulns have a ravenous appetite and eat nearly anything they can catch, but their preferred diet consists almost entirely of large invertebrates, especially cave worms. They rely on tiny sensory whiskers that cover their snouts and allow them to detect subtle movements in the air and ground without the use of vision. When they detect suitable prey, shulns bite their target at the first opportunity, injecting it with a potent paralytic toxin present in their saliva. So strong is this poison that it's capable of subduing even the near-unstoppable cave worm, making shulns a valuable (if dangerous) companion to anyone making excursions into worm-infested regions of the Darklands. Shulns' notoriously ill-tempered dispositions and their knack for digging into areas of an underground settlement where digging ought not to occur make them frustrating creatures to keep around, but when the alternative is an unpredictable but deadly visit from an enormous, hungry cave worm, the annoyances are well worth the trouble.

Encounters with much larger shuln-like entities on the Plane of Earth suggest that these creatures may have originated from there. The larger shulns still retain their elemental qualities, are quite a bit smarter, and have their own suite of earth-themed innate primal spells—but for all that, they still love the taste of cave worm.
