Chain Mail.name: 铁链甲 Chain Mail
Chain Mail.description:
一套锁子甲由数件护甲组成，这些护甲由相互连接的小金属环编织成保护性的网状结构。它通常包括一件链甲衫、护腿、一对护臂和一顶锁子头罩，共同保护身体的大部分部位。

A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

Bolts.name: 弩矢 Bolts
Bolts.description:
弩矢比传统箭矢更短，但结构相似，是弩使用的弹药。

Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.

Lethargy Poison.name: 昏睡毒 Lethargy Poison
Lethargy Poison.description:
昏睡毒常被卓尔和其他想让受害者活着的人用于打了就跑的战术；伏击者会撤退，直到毒素起效、受害者陷入昏迷为止。再次暴露于昏睡毒不需要目标尝试额外的豁免掷骰；只有在对持续暴露的豁免掷骰中失败，才会使其阶段推进。

启动 2 交互（伤害）

豁免掷骰 @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

最大持续时间 4小时

阶段 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}（1轮）

阶段 2 迟缓 1（1分钟）

阶段 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，且无法进行察觉检定来醒来（1轮）

阶段 4 昏迷，且无法进行察觉检定来醒来（[[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4小时}）。

Lethargy poison is commonly used in hit-and-run tactics by drow and others who want their victims alive; the ambusher retreats until the poison sets in and the victim falls unconscious. Further exposure to lethargy poison does not require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing an saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Activate 2 Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 slowed 1 (1 minute)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/gmr 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours}).

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法的所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Attack of Opportunity.name: 借机攻击 Attack of Opportunity

Hampering Slash.name: 妨碍劈砍 Hampering Slash
Hampering Slash.description:
一个被守卫者的近战打击伤害的目标必须在一次 @Check[fortitude|dc:21] 豁免中成功，否则将获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} 直到守卫者下个回合结束。

A target damaged by the warden's melee Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:21] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of the warden's next turn.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
守望者对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}的生物造成额外1d6伤害。

A warden deals an extra 1d6 damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Taklitur.publicNotes:
卫士守望着卓尔营地，并经常以小组形式行动。

由于在他们的主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔有着邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主的阴险影响时。

Wardens watch over drow encampments and often work in small groups.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Taklitur.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Tanieth.name: 塔尼思 Tanieth

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Darkness (At Will).name: 黑暗术（随意） Darkness (At Will)
Darkness (At Will).description:
你创造出一层黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮穿透或在区域内发出。光亮不会进入该区域，任何非魔法光源（如火把或提灯）在区域内也不会发出任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外。这也会压制你黑暗术等级或更低等级的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即使具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物也只能勉强透过黑暗看见。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Faerie Fire (At Will).name: 妖火术（随意） Faerie Fire (At Will)
Faerie Fire (At Will).description:
你施放法术时位于区域内的所有生物，在持续时间内都会被你选择颜色的缤纷、无热火焰勾勒出来。受妖火术影响的可见生物不能处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} 状态。如果这些生物处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} 状态，则在受妖火术影响时它们处于 Concealed 状态，而不是 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}。

All creatures in the area when you cast the spell are limned in colorful, heatless fire of a color of your choice for the duration. Visible creatures can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while affected by faerie fire. If the creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, they are Concealed while affected by faerie fire, rather than being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}.

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光术 Dancing Lights
Dancing Lights.description:
你创造至多四个漂浮的光源，其中任意两个彼此相距不超过10尺。每个都像火把一样散发光亮。当你维持该法术时，你可以将任意数量的光源移动至多60尺。每个光源必须保持在你120尺范围内，并且与所有其他光源相距不超过10尺，否则它会熄灭。

You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

Repeating Hand Crossbow.name: 连发手弩 Repeating Hand Crossbow
Repeating Hand Crossbow.description:
装填 2 用于弹匣装填（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier}）

Reload 2 for magazine reload (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.oJZe5rRitvioUgRh]{Shootist Bandolier})

Studded Leather Armor.name: 镶嵌皮甲 Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.description:
这套皮质护甲用金属铆钉加固，有时还配有小型金属板，在提供与皮质护甲几乎相同的灵活性的同时，提供更坚固的防护。

This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

Shootist Bandolier.name: 射手弹带 Shootist Bandolier
Shootist Bandolier.description:
这条皮革射手弹带在会用拇指迅速一拨就弹开的皮革口袋中，最多可容纳三具 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines}。你将从射手弹带中取用连发手弩弹匣的装填时代减少 1，降至总计 2 个动作。你同一时代只能穿戴一条射手弹带。

This leather bandolier holds up to three @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.xk9bw9ccupAIx7xT]{Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazines} in leather pockets that pop open with the quick flick of a thumb. You reduce the reload time for a repeating hand crossbow magazine from the bandolier by 1, to a total of 2 actions. You can wear only one shootist bandolier at a time.

Stupor Poison.name: 迷梦毒 Stupor Poison
Stupor Poison.description:
启动 2 交互

迷梦毒是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}的更强力蒸馏版本。再次暴露于迷梦毒不需要目标尝试额外的豁免投掷；只有在对持续暴露的豁免投掷中失败，才会使其中毒阶段推进。

豁免投掷 @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

最大持续时间 6小时

阶段1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}（1轮）

阶段2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}和措手不及（1轮）

阶段3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（1轮）

阶段4 昏迷，且无法通过察觉检定醒来（[[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6小时}）

Activate 2 Interact

Stupor poison is a more potent distillation of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zo0ophqfKunJFxZN]{Lethargy Poison}. Further exposure to stupor poison doesn't require the target to attempt additional saving throws; only failing a saving throw against an ongoing exposure can progress its stage.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Maximum Duration 6 hours

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} with no Perception check to wake up (1 round)

Stage 4 unconscious with no Perception check to wake up ([[/r 1d6 #hours]]{1d6 hours})

Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine.name: 连发手弩弹匣 Repeating Hand Crossbow Magazine

+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: 对抗魔法时所有豁免获得+1状态加值 +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

+2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental.name: 对抗精神效果的所有豁免获得+2状态加值 +2 Status to All Saves vs. Mental

Shootist's Luck.name: 射手的幸运 Shootist's Luck
Shootist's Luck.description:
触发 枪手豁免失败

频率 每天一次

效果 枪手重骰该豁免并使用较好的结果。

Trigger The shootist fails a save

Frequency once per day

Effect The shootist rerolls the save and uses the better result.

Distracting Shot.name: 干扰射击 Distracting Shot
Distracting Shot.description:
枪手瞄准并进行一次远程打击。若该攻击命中并造成伤害，则目标在枪手回合结束前处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 状态；若为大成功或大失败，则持续至枪手下一回合结束。

The shootist takes aim and makes a ranged Strike. If the attack hits and deals damage, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of the shootist's turn, or until the end of the shootist's next turn on a critical hit.

Reloading Trick.name: 装填诀窍 Reloading Trick
Reloading Trick.description:
需求 射手正持用一把未装填的连发手弩

效果 射手执行交互以装填该连发手弩并用其进行一次打击。

Requirements The shootist is holding an unloaded repeating hand crossbow

Effect The shootist Interacts to reload the repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it.

Shootist's Draw.name: 射手快拔 Shootist's Draw
Shootist's Draw.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 神枪手进行交互动作以抽出一把连发手弩并用其进行打击，或用他们正持用的一把已装填的连发手弩进行打击，然后进行交互动作将其收起。

Frequency once per round

Effect The shootist Interacts to draw a repeating hand crossbow and Strikes with it, or Strikes with a loaded repeating hand crossbow they're holding then Interacts to stow it.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
射手对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} 的生物造成额外 2d6 精确伤害。

The shootist deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Tanieth.publicNotes:
那些少数专精于连发手弩命令术的卓尔，不仅因其技能而受人敬重，也因其好运与张扬的派头而受人敬重。

由于在其主要聚居地中崇拜恶魔，卓尔有着邪恶的名声。然而，如同任何族裔的成员一样，卓尔可以拥有任何阵营，尤其是在远离恶魔领主阴险影响时。

The rare few drow who specialize in the repeating hand crossbow command respect not only for their skills but for their luck and swagger.

Drow have a reputation for evil due to demon worship in their major settlements. However, like members of any ancestry, drow can have any alignment, especially when removed from the demon lords' sinister influence.
Tanieth.allSaves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +2 status to all saves vs. mental

Urdefhan Blood Mage.name: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage
Urdefhan Blood Mage.tokenName: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage

Occult Spontaneous Spells.name: 神秘自发法术 Occult Spontaneous Spells

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Call The Blood.name: 唤血术 Call The Blood
Call The Blood.description:
随着一句咒语与一个手势，你使血流从目标的口中、鼻孔、耳朵或其他面部开口喷涌而出，并奔流进入你的口中。你对目标造成 8d4 虚空伤害。

若目标受到伤害，它的血会流入你的口中。若你是活体生物且没有虚空治疗，则你获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。若你是不死生物（或你是活体但拥有虚空治疗），你可以选择：要么获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后），并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} 1 轮；要么放弃这些临时生命值并获得加速 1 分钟。你只能使用这一额外动作来进行「步移」、「移动」或「打击」。1 分钟后，你会失去任何剩余的临时生命值。

强化（+1） 伤害增加 2d4。

With a word and gesture, you cause streams of blood to erupt from the target's mouth, nostrils, ears, or other facial openings and come rushing into your mouth. You deal 8d4 void damage to the target.

If the target takes damage, its blood flows into your mouth. If you're a living creature and don't have void healing, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}. If you're undead (or living but have void healing), you can choose to either gain temporary Hit Points equal to half of the void damage the target takes (after applying resistance and the like) and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round, or forgo the temporary Hit Points and become quickened for 1 minute. You can use this extra action only to Step, Stride, or Strike. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4.

Confusion.name: 困惑术 Confusion
Confusion.description:
你用奇异的冲动使你的目标困惑术，导致其随机行动。其效果由目标的意志豁免决定。你可以解消该法术。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标语无伦次并且 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} 1分钟。它可以在它每个回合结束时尝试一次新的豁免以结束困惑术。

大成功或大失败 目标困惑术 1分钟，且无法通过豁免提前结束。

升阶（8环） 你可以指定至多10个生物作为目标。

You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Dimension Door.name: 次元门 Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description:
打开一扇绕过正常空间的门，你会立刻将自己以及你穿戴和持有的所有物品从你当前的空间传送到你能看见且位于射程内的一处空旷空间中。若这会把另一只生物一同带走——即使你正把它装在一个异次元容器中携带——该法术将失效。

增幅（5环） 射程增加至1英里。你不必能够看见你的目的地，只要你过去到过那里，并且知道它相对你的位置与距离即可。你会暂时免疫1小时。

Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Phantasmal Killer.name: 魅影杀手 Phantasmal Killer
Phantasmal Killer.description:
你创造出一个对目标而言最可怕的生物的幻影。只有该法术的目标能看见这个杀手，不过你能看见这幻象模糊的轮廓疾驰向前发动攻击。杀手的效果取决于目标的意志豁免结果。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标受到4d6精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标受到8d6精神伤害，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大成功或大失败 失败 目标恐惧至极，可能会死。它必须尝试一次强韧豁免；如果目标失败，则它死亡。若强韧豁免成功，目标受到12d6精神伤害，获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} 直到其下个回合结束，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}。此效果具有失能（特征）。

升阶（+1） 失败时的伤害增加2d6，大成功或大失败 失败时的伤害增加3d6。

You create a phantasmal image of the most fearsome creature imaginable to the target. Only the spell's target can see the killer, though you can see the vague shape of the illusion as it races forth to attack. The effect of the killer is based on the outcome of the target's Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes 8d6 mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is so afraid it might die. It must attempt a Fortitude save; if the target fails, it dies. On a successful Fortitude save, the target takes 12d6 mental damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} until the end of its next turn, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}. This effect has the incapacitation trait.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 on a failure and by 3d6 on a critical failure.

Haste.name: 加速术 Haste
Haste.description:
魔法赋予目标更快行动的力量。它获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}（状态），并且每轮只能将额外的动作用于打击与疾行动作。

升阶（7环） 你可以以最多6个生物为目标。

Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

Levitate.name: 浮空术 Levitate
Levitate.description:
你违逆重力，使目标浮空离地5英尺。在法术持续时间内，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作使目标上升或下降10英尺。因浮空术而漂浮在空中的生物，其攻击掷骰承受-2环境减值。漂浮的生物可以花费一个交互动作来稳定自身，并在其回合剩余时间内抵消该减值。如果目标邻接于足够稳固的固定物体或地形，它可以通过攀爬（若表面为垂直，例如墙壁）或匍匐（若表面为水平，例如天花板）沿该表面移动。GM决定哪些表面可以被攀爬或匍匐穿越。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. For the duration of the spell, you can move the target up or down 10 feet with a single action, which has the concentrate trait. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其思维之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败 目标陷入麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功或大失败时完全结束该效果。

升阶（7环） 你可以以最多10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Slow.name: 缓慢术 Slow
Slow.description:
你使目标周围的时代流动膨胀，减缓其动作。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在1轮内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

失败 目标在1分钟内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}。

大成功或大失败 目标在1分钟内获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}。

升阶（6环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之触 Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description:
你的接触从一个目标身上汲取生命之血以强化自身。你对目标造成6d6虚空伤害。你获得等同于目标所受虚空伤害一半的临时生命值（在应用抗力等效果之后）。1分钟后，你失去所有剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你掐灭一名濒死生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这使其死亡，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内获得+1状态加值于攻击掷骰与伤害掷骰。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法 Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
你解构一个法术或效果背后的魔法。尝试一次反制检定对抗目标。若你成功反制一个魔法物品，该物品在10分钟内变为其类型的普通物品。这不会改变该物品的非魔法属性。若目标是一件神器或类似物品，你自动失败。

You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

Ghoulish Cravings.name: 食腐渴望 Ghoulish Cravings
Ghoulish Cravings.description:
你接触目标，使其感染食尸鬼热，让饥饿侵蚀其身，并使其与生命力能量的联系逐渐减弱；目标必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标在第1阶段感染食尸鬼热。

失败 目标在第2阶段感染食尸鬼热。

大失败 目标在第3阶段感染食尸鬼热。

食尸鬼热（疾病）；等级 3

阶段 1 携带者，无不良效果（1天）

阶段 2 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物从所有治疗中恢复的生命值减半（1天）

阶段 3 同阶段2（1天）

阶段 4 3d8 虚空伤害，且该生物无法从治疗中获得任何益处（1天）

阶段 5 同阶段4（1天）

阶段 6 该生物死亡，并在下一个午夜作为食尸鬼（特征）复起

You touch the target to afflict it with ghoul fever, infesting it with hunger and a steadily decreasing connection to vitality energy; the target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 1.

Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 2.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with ghoul fever at stage 3.

Ghoul Fever (disease); Level 3

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 3d8 void damage and the creature regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 3d8 void damage and the creature gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 the creature dies and rises as a ghoul at the next midnight

Invisibility.name: 隐形术 Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
目标被幻术笼罩，变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物都为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，从而使其对他们改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

强化（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但若目标使用敌对动作也不会结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Touch of Idiocy.name: 愚者之触 Touch of Idiocy
Touch of Idiocy.description:
你使目标的心智变得迟钝；目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}。

大成功或大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}。

You dull the target's mind; the target must attempt a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

Bane.name: 绝望术 Bane
Bane.description:
你用疑虑填满敌人的心智。

区域内的敌人必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则只要他们还在该区域内，其攻击掷骰就会承受-1状态减值。

每回合一次，从你施放绝望术后的下一回合开始，你可以用一个带有专注（特征）的单动作，将该散发的半径增加5尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再次尝试进行一次豁免。

绝望术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt.

Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a -1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area.

Once per turn, starting the turn after you cast bane, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}

Chill Touch.name: 恐吓之触 Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description:
将虚空能量虹吸入自身，你的手散发出一抹苍白的黑暗。你的接触会削弱活物并扰乱不死生物，甚至可能使其逃离。效果取决于目标是活物还是不死生物。

  • 活体生物 该法术造成等同于1d4加上你的施法调整值的虚空伤害。目标进行一次基础强韧豁免，但在大失败时还会在1轮内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。
  • 不死生物 若强韧豁免失败，目标在1轮内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}。在大失败时，除非其意志豁免成功，否则目标还会在1轮内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}。

升阶（+1） 对活体生物造成的虚空伤害增加1d4。

Siphoning void energy into yourself, your hand radiates a pale darkness. Your touch weakens the living and disorients undead, possibly even causing them to flee. The effect depends on whether the target is living or undead.

  • Living Creature The spell deals void damage equal to 1d4 plus your spellcasting modifier. The target attempts a basic Fortitude save, but is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 round on a critical failure.
  • Undead Creature The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save.

Heightened (+1) The void damage to living creatures increases by 1d4.

Daze.name: 眩晕术 Daze
Daze.description:
你使目标的心智陷入迷雾，并用精神冲击将其眩晕。冲击造成等同于你施法能力调整值的精神伤害；目标必须尝试一次基础意志豁免。若目标大失败该豁免，它还会受到 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You cloud the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals mental damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; the target must attempt a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Fear.name: 恐惧术 Fear
Fear.description:
你将恐惧术植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}，并获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing}，持续 1 轮。

升阶（3环） 你最多可以以五个生物为目标。

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一个生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落减缓为每轮60尺，并且在计算坠落伤害时，不将法术持续时间内的那段坠落计入其中。如果目标在法术效果生效期间到达地面，它不会因这次坠落而受到任何伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的触须从你的指尖卷出，穿过空气疾驰。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4虚空伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。线内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害，且不承受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

增幅（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Message.name: 传讯术 Message
Message.description:
你轻声动唇吐字，但这些话语并不会从你口中发出，而是直接传到目标的耳中。其他人听到你的话语并不会比你平常动唇不出声时更清楚，但目标听到你的话语就如同他们正站在你身旁一样。

目标可以以反应动作（）作出简短回应，若他们愿意，也可以在其下个回合以自由动作（）回应，但他们必须能够看见你且处于射程内才能这么做。若他们回应，其回应会像原本的传讯术一样，直接传到你的耳中。

升阶（3环） 该法术的射程提高至500英尺。

You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you.

The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

Phantom Pain.name: 幻痛术 Phantom Pain
Phantom Pain.description:
幻觉般的痛苦折磨着目标，造成2d4精神伤害和1d4持续精神伤害。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标承受全部初始伤害但不承受持续伤害，且该法术立即结束。

失败 目标承受全部初始伤害和持续伤害，且目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。若目标从恶心中恢复，则持续伤害结束且该法术结束。

大成功或大失败 失败 同失败，但目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d4，持续伤害增加1d4。

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and 1d4 persistent mental damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

@Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]]{Scaling Persistent Mental Damage}

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，则该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰是大成功，则使用其豁免结果中低一级成功度的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标成为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Shield.name: 护盾术 Shield
Shield.description:
你升起一道魔法力场护盾术。这算作使用“举起护盾术”动作，使你在AC上获得+1环境加值，直到你下个回合开始为止，但它不需要一只手来使用。

当该法术生效时，你可以用你的魔法护盾术使用 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} 反应动作（）。该护盾术的硬度为5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，该法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放它。与普通的盾牌格挡不同，你可以对 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} 法术使用该法术的反应动作（）。

强化该法术会提高护盾术的硬度。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

强化（3环） 护盾术的硬度为10。

强化（5环） 护盾术的硬度为15。

强化（7环） 护盾术的硬度为20。

强化（9环） 护盾术的硬度为25。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes. Unlike a normal Shield Block, you can use the spell's reaction against the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity} spell.

Heightening the spell increases the shield's Hardness.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 10.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 15.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 20.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 25.

Telekinetic Projectile.name: 念动射弹 Telekinetic Projectile
Telekinetic Projectile.description:
你将一件位于射程内、松散且无人看管、负载为1或更低的物体掷向目标。对目标进行一次法术攻击掷骰。如果你命中，你造成钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害——取决于你掷出的物体——数值等于1d6加上你的施法关键能力调整值。被掷出的物品的任何特定特征或魔法属性都不会影响该攻击或该伤害。

大成功或大失败 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d6。

You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage-as appropriate for the object you hurled-equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当透肌魔人死亡时，其隐形的肉体会迅速腐烂并升华为一股恶臭气体，充满尸体周围的@Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这股气体会对该区域内的生物造成@Damage[8d6[void]]伤害，因为它们的肉体也会凝固并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic]豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[8d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Blood Offering.name: 鲜血驱能 Blood Offering
Blood Offering.description:
频率 每轮一次

效果 血法师割伤自己并承受 @Damage[8[slashing]] 伤害。若血法师的下一个动作是施法，则该动作不能被打断；且若该法术具有射程，血法师可以将该法术的射程增加30英尺。

Frequency once per round

Effect The blood mage cuts themself and takes @Damage[8[slashing]] damage. If the blood mage's next action is to Cast a Spell, the action can't be disrupted, and if the spell has a range, the blood mage can increase that spell's range by 30 feet.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用一次啃咬打击对一名生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物在伤口部位周围的血肉变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要一次强韧豁免。若该次啃咬打击为大成功或大失败命中，则该生物同时承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 @Check[fortitude|dc:26] 透肌魔人饮下该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复@Damage[10[healing]] HP（若为大成功或大失败失败，则其获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复@Damage[20[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力（死灵法术）@Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:necromancy] 透肌魔人抽出该生物的一部分生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物在1小时内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}（若为大成功或大失败失败，则在1小时内变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood @Check[fortitude|dc:26] The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality (necromancy) @Check[fortitude|dc:26|traits:necromancy] The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Blood Mage.publicNotes:
作为秘法力量的坚韧大师，透肌魔人血法师以鲜血换取魔法威能。伤痕累累的血法师会受到同族透肌魔人的敬重，因为这表明他们在与诡异的秘法庇护者进行的诸多交易中幸存了下来。

透肌魔人是幽暗地域中皮肤半透明的灾厄使者，是无情的杀手，也是世界终结的步兵。

Hardened masters of occult power, urdefhan blood mages trade their blood for magical might. A heavily scarred blood mage is held in esteem by their fellow urdefhans, as it shows they have survived many bargains with eerie occult patrons.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
Urdefhan Blood Mage.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Urdefhan Blood Mage.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人血法师 Urdefhan Blood Mage

Urdefhan Death Scout.name: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout
Urdefhan Death Scout.tokenName: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你熄灭一个濒死的生物的生命。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。如果这杀死了它，你获得10点临时HP，以及在10分钟内对攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 数值增加1。

失败 目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Invisibility (Self Only).name: 隐形术（仅自身） Invisibility (Self Only)
Invisibility (Self Only).description:
目标披上幻术的伪装，获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}。这使其对所有生物而言都处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} 状态，不过这些生物可以尝试寻找目标，使其对它们而言改为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}。如果目标使用敌对动作，则该法术在该敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续 1 分钟，但不会因目标使用敌对动作而结束。

Cloaked in illusion, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你令空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60英尺，并且在计算坠落伤害时，法术持续时间内的那段坠落不计入其中。如果目标在法术效果持续期间到达地面，它不会因这次坠落受到任何伤害。目标一着地，法术立刻结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物进行一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则使用其豁免结果下调一个成功等级的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Necrotic Bomb (Moderate).name: 暗蚀炸弹（中等） Necrotic Bomb (Moderate)
Necrotic Bomb (Moderate).description:
启动 1 打击

暗蚀炸弹混合了大多数人认为充其量令人作呕、最糟则亵渎不洁的试剂，在接触空气时产生一种吸取生命的瘴气。暗蚀炸弹造成所列的虚空伤害与飞溅伤害，并在大成功或大失败命中时使主要目标陷入恶心状态。此伤害仅伤害活体生物。

你获得攻击掷骰+1物品加值。

该炸弹造成2d6虚空伤害与2点虚空飞溅伤害。若大成功或大失败命中，目标为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}。

Activate 1 Strike

Necrotic bombs combine reagents most people consider disgusting at best and unholy at worst, creating a life-sucking miasma upon contact with air. A necrotic bomb deals the listed void damage and splash damage, and it sickens the primary target on a critical hit. This damage harms only living creatures.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

The bomb deals 2d6 void damage and 2 void splash damage. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Leather Armor.name: 皮甲 Leather Armor
Leather Armor.description:
由柔韧与定型的煮制皮革混合而成，此类护甲在提供一定防护的同时具备最大的灵活性。

A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，它的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华成一股恶臭的气体，充满尸体周围的 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。

这股气体会对该区域内的生物造成 @Damage[6d6[void]] 伤害，因为它们的血肉也会凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] 豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[6d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save).

Shauth Bite.name: 牙刃之噬 Shauth Bite
Shauth Bite.description:
死亡侦察兵使用牙刃时会额外造成 @Damage[1d6[bleed]]，并且能够通过魔法绍斯武器打击使用其秽恶之啮。

The death scout deals an additional @Damage[1d6[bleed]] with shauth blades and can use their Wicked Bite through magical shauth weapon Strikes.

Sneak Attack.name: 偷袭 Sneak Attack
Sneak Attack.description:
死亡斥候对处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}状态的生物造成额外2d6点精准伤害。

The death scout deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一个动作中用啃咬打击对一名生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物伤口部位周围的肉体变得半透明。透肌魔人从以下两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要进行一次强韧豁免。若该啃咬打击为大成功或大失败命中，则该生物同时承受两个效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 @Check[fortitude|dc:24] 透肌魔人啜饮该生物的一些血液。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[5[治疗]] HP（或在大成功或大失败失败时，其为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[治疗]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力（死灵术）@Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:necromancy] 透肌魔人抽出该生物的一部分生命精粹。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}，持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败失败时获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}，持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood @Check[fortitude|dc:24] The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[5[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality (necromancy) @Check[fortitude|dc:24|traits:necromancy] The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Death Scout.publicNotes:
死亡斥候接受训练，作为其教团的间谍与刺客。其他透肌魔人蔑视他们隐秘的手段，但无人能质疑他们的成果。

作为幽暗地域中半透明皮肤的天谴者，透肌魔人是冷酷无情的杀手，也是世界终末的步兵。

Death scouts train as spies and assassins for their cult. Other urdefhans scorn their stealthy methods, but none can argue with their results.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
Urdefhan Death Scout.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Urdefhan Death Scout.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人死亡斥候 Urdefhan Death Scout

Urdefhan Lasher.name: 透肌魔人鞭笞者 Urdefhan Lasher
Urdefhan Lasher.tokenName: 透肌魔人鞭笞者 Urdefhan Lasher

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣天生法术 Divine Innate Spells

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你在目标的运动冲动离开其心智之前将其阻断，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败：成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}，持续1轮。

大成功或大失败：失败 目标麻痹，持续4轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少1轮，或在大成功或大失败：成功时将其完全结束。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以10个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你将一名濒死边缘的生物的生命掐灭。该目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若这使其死亡，你获得10点临时HP，以及在10分钟内对攻击与伤害掷骰获得+1状态加值。

大成功或大失败 该目标不受影响。

成功 该目标的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}数值增加1。

失败 该目标死亡。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

You snuff the life out of a creature on the brink of death. The target must attempt a Will save. If this kills it, you gain 10 temporary HP and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.98XT2QUk6wvXIqf7]{Spell Effect: Death Knell} value increases by 1.

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).name: 羽落术（随意）（仅限自身） Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only)
Feather Fall (At Will) (Self Only).description:
触发 射程内的一名生物正在坠落

你使空气本身阻止坠落。目标的坠落速度减缓至每轮60英尺，且在法术持续时间内的坠落部分在计算坠落伤害时不计入。若目标在法术生效期间到达地面，则不会因这次坠落而受到任何伤害。目标一落地，法术立即结束。

Trigger a creature within range is falling

You cause the air itself to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射线 Ray of Enfeeblement
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一道削弱敌人力量的射线从你手中闪现。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若你成功，该生物将尝试一次强韧豁免以决定该法术的效果。若你的攻击掷骰为大成功，则使用其豁免结果低一个成功等级的结果。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}。

失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}。

大失败 目标变为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}。

A ray that saps a foe's strength flashes from your hand. Attempt a ranged spell attack against the target. If you succeed, that creature attempts a Fortitude save to determine the spell's effect. If your attack roll is a critical success, use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1}.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}.

Critical Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3}.

Chain Shirt.name: 链甲衫 Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.description:
有时也被称为锁子甲长衫，这是一件由与链甲相同的金属环构成的长衫。然而，它比链甲轻得多，并且只保护穿戴者的躯干、上臂和大腿。

Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.

Greater Darkvision.name: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision

Necrotic Decay.name: 暗蚀溃烂 Necrotic Decay
Necrotic Decay.description:
当一名透肌魔人死亡时，它的隐形血肉会迅速腐烂并升华成恶臭气体，充满其尸体周围的一个 @Template[emanation|distance:5]。

该气体会对该区域内的生物造成 @Damage[7d6[void]] 伤害，因为它们的血肉也会凝结并腐烂（@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] 豁免）。

When an urdefhan dies, its invisible flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[emanation|distance:5] around the body.

This gas deals @Damage[7d6[void]] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots as well (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic] save).

Shauth Seize.name: 牙鞭缠绕 Shauth Seize
Shauth Seize.description:
鞭击者获得使用牙鞭的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab}能力，并且能够通过魔法牙鞭武器的打击使用其秽恶之啮。

The lasher gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Tkd8sH4pwFIPzqTr]{Grab} ability with a shauth lash and can use their Wicked Bite through magical shauth weapon Strikes.

Wicked Bite.name: 秽恶之啮 Wicked Bite
Wicked Bite.description:
需求 透肌魔人在其上一动作中用一次啃咬打击对一个生物造成了伤害

效果 透肌魔人保持接触，使该生物在伤口部位周围的血肉变得半透明。透肌魔人从两个选项中选择其一，每个选项都需要进行一次强韧豁免。若该次啃咬打击为大成功或大失败命中，则该生物承受两种效果，并对两者使用相同的豁免结果。

  • 啜饮鲜血 @Check[fortitude|dc:25] 透肌魔人饮下该生物的一些鲜血。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[10[healing]] HP（或在大成功或大失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}，且透肌魔人恢复 @Damage[20[healing]] HP）。
  • 啜饮活力（死灵系）@Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:necromancy] 透肌魔人抽取该生物的一部分生命精华。豁免失败时，该生物获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} 持续1小时（或在大成功或大失败时获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} 持续1小时）。

Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on its last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The urdefhan chooses one of two options, each of which requires a fortitude save. If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature suffers both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood @Check[fortitude|dc:25] The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains @Damage[20[healing]] HP).
  • Drain Vitality (necromancy) @Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:necromancy] The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Urdefhan Lasher.publicNotes:
透肌魔人鞭笞者从小就接受奇异而强大的沙乌斯鞭训练，宁死也不愿从战斗中撤退。

作为幽暗地域中皮肤半透明的鞭笞者，透肌魔人是冷酷无情的杀手，也是世界终结的步兵。

Trained from a young age with the strange and powerful shauth lashes, urdefhan lashers would rather die than retreat from combat.

Translucent-skinned scourges of the Darklands, urdefhans are remorseless killers and foot soldiers of the world's end.
Urdefhan Lasher.senses: 强效黑暗视觉 Greater Darkvision
Urdefhan Lasher.prototypeToken: 透肌魔人鞭笞者 Urdefhan Lasher

Urdefhan Tormentor.name: 透肌魔人折磨者 Urdefhan Tormentor
Urdefhan Tormentor.tokenName: 透肌魔人折磨者 Urdefhan Tormentor

Divine Innate Spells.name: 神圣先天法术 Divine Innate Spells

Paralyze.name: 麻痹术 Paralyze
Paralyze.description:
你阻断目标的运动冲动，使其无法离开其心智，威胁要将目标冻结在原地。目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功或大失败 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}。

失败 目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} 1 轮。

大成功或大失败 目标麻痹 4 轮。在其每个回合结束时，它可以尝试一次新的意志豁免，使剩余持续时间减少 1 轮，或在大成功或大失败时将其完全结束。

升阶（7环） 你最多可以以 10 个生物为目标。

You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Darkness.name: 黑暗术 Darkness
Darkness.description:
你制造一团黑暗帷幕，阻止光亮在该区域内穿透或发出。光亮无法进入该区域，且任何非魔法的光源，例如火把或提灯，在区域内都不会散发任何光亮，即使其光照半径本应延伸到黑暗之外亦然。这也会压制你黑暗术的环阶或更低的魔法光亮。光亮无法穿过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外面看，它呈现为一个纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环） 即便具有黑暗视觉（但不包括高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿黑暗。他们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}。

You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Death Knell.name: 死亡丧钟 Death Knell
Death Knell.description:
你掐灭一名濒死的生物的生命。该目标必须尝试一次意志豁免。若此法术杀死它，你获得10点临时HP，并在10分钟内获得+1状态加值于攻击和伤害掷骰。

大成功或大失败 该目标不受影响。

成功 该目标的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} 值增加1。

失败 该目标死亡。

Failure The target dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}

False Life.name: 虚假生命 False Life
False Life.description:
你用死灵法术能量创造一处活力储备，获得等于6加上你的施法能力调整值数量的临时生命值。

升阶（+1） 临时生命值增加3点。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

You create a reservoir of vitality from necromantic energy, gaining a number of temporary Hit Points equal to 6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Life}

Daemonic Pact.name: 邪魔契约 Daemonic Pact
Daemonic Pact.description:
你呼唤阿巴顿的力量，赐予你一名邪魔的协助。你可以呼唤一名生物等级不超过邪魔契约法术环阶两倍的邪魔；或呼唤两名邪魔，它们的等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低2；或呼唤三名邪魔，它们的等级各自至少比法术环阶两倍低3。

大成功 你召唤出该邪魔或这些邪魔，它们为你效劳且不要求任何回报。

成功 你召唤出该邪魔或这些邪魔，它们愿意为你效劳，但要求以流出的鲜血作为祭品（可以是另一名生物的，也可以是你自己的）。

失败 你未能召唤出任何邪魔。

大失败 你未能召唤出任何邪魔，并且执行该仪式所需的自我牺牲会使你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（若法术环阶为5或更高，则为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}）。

You call upon the powers of Abaddon to grant you the assistance of a daemon. You call upon a daemon whose level can be no more than double daemonic pact's spell rank, two daemons whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three daemons whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, and they require nothing in return for their service.

Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, who serve you willingly, but require a sacrifice in the form of spilled blood (either another creature's or your own).

Failure You don't conjure any daemons.

Critical Failure You don't conjure any daemons, and the self-sacrifice required to perform the ritual leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} if the spell rank is 5 or higher).

If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

Grim Tendrils.name: 邪影触须 Grim Tendrils
Grim Tendrils.description:
黑暗的卷须从你的指尖蜷曲伸出，穿过空气疾驰而去。你对线内的活体生物造成2d4虚空伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。线内的每个活体生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物受到一半的虚空伤害，且不受到持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物受到全部伤害。

大失败 该生物受到双倍虚空伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 虚空伤害增加2d4，且持续流血伤害增加1。

Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

Harm.name: 伤害术 Harm
Harm.description:
你引导虚空能量来伤害活物或治疗亡灵。若目标是一名活的生物，你对其造成1d8虚空伤害，且其必须进行一次基础强韧豁免。若目标是一名自愿的亡灵生物，你恢复等量生命值。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标、射程、区域以及其他参数。

1 (姿势) 该法术的射程为接触。

2 (言语, 姿势) 该法术的射程为30尺。若你在治疗一名亡灵生物，使恢复的生命值增加8。

3 (材料, 言语, 姿势) 你在30尺放射中扩散虚空能量。这会以区域内所有活的与亡灵生物为目标。

升阶 (+1) 治疗或伤害的数值增加1d8，且2动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, verbal, somatic) You disperse void energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
