这扇门原本有一把巨大的锁，但很久以前就被砸毁了。如今，卡利尼族从门内用门闩封住此门。它无法被破拆，但可以被摧毁（硬度 15，生命值 60）。它也受到下文所述刻文的保护。

守卫刻文

加卢杜在这扇门上设置了一道守卫刻文，会影响任何触碰此门的非卡利尼族。它储存了一道5级 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt}（[[/r 6d12[electric]]] 伤害，@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true]{基础反射} 豁免；察觉并解除该刻文的DC为26）。

This large stone structure is flanked on one side by the massive Gauntlight footprint to the north and on the other by the enormous iron ladder descending from the chasm in the Farm level. Belcorra built this lodge so those hunting in the wild caverns could relax in relative safety. In the earliest days, urdefhans, drow, and various mercenary hunters all used the lodge in a series of uneasy truces enforced by Belcorra and her Children. These fragile truces fell apart when Belcorra died, and the lodge has changed hands several times since then.

The calignis currently holed up within are insular and reclusive. They only rarely leave to hunt, as their leader Galudu takes care of most of their needs. The heroes’ best way to meet them peacefully is to speak with Dulac in the shrine (area @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.LyqYciAwy0l9vyed]{H08}). Otherwise, the calignis view anyone barging in here as a threat, and the heroes must be especially diplomatic to placate them.

The door had a massive lock, but it was smashed long ago. Now, the calignis bar the door from the inside. It can’t be Forced Open, but it can be destroyed (Hardness 15, Hit Points 60). It’s also protected by the glyph described below.

Glyph of Warding

Galudu placed a glyph of warding on this door that affects any non-caligni who touches it. It contains a 5th-level @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.9AAkVUCwF6WVNNY2]{Lightning Bolt} ([[/r 6d12[electric]]] damage, @Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save; DC 26 to notice and disarm the glyph).

I22. Great Hall.name: I22. 大会堂 I22. Great Hall
I22. Great Hall.text:
这座宽阔的大厅曾经宏伟而令人印象深刻。如今墙上的壁画已剥落并沾染污渍，地面覆满泥泞，少数几件家具看起来像是被匆忙地完全修复过很多次。房间中央有一个火坑。

这里曾是猎人们热闹的集会与宴会厅，如今该区域则作为一个前哨，供卡利尼难民谨慎监视入侵者。该区域的两扇较小的门都未上锁，但西侧的大型双开门从这一侧被横闩封住。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[OloMMRPtTQKF0x16]{卡利尼防御者（3）}

90 XP

三名卡利尼试图牵制入侵者，阻止他们更深入小屋。若条件允许，一名防御者会移动到较小的门旁并敲门，提醒其他卡利尼发生了攻击。这会引来位于区域 @UUID[.8iE1bRgAOvwLTzmw]{I23} 的卡利尼；两者合起来，构成一个针对9级角色的极端遭遇。若托管人杜拉克与英雄们同行，卡利尼会勉强为她指向区域 @UUID[.UisN4T7sPOV11IC0]{I25}，以便与加鲁杜交谈。

This large hall was once grand and impressive. Now the walls’ murals are chipped and stained, the floor is covered with mud, and the few pieces of furniture look like they’ve been hastily repaired many times. A fire pit sits at the center of the chamber.

Once a lively meeting place and banquet hall for hunters, the area now serves as an outpost where caligni refugees keep a careful watch for intruders. The two smaller doors of the area are unlocked, but the large double door to the west is barred from this side.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[OloMMRPtTQKF0x16]{Caligni Defenders (3)}

90 XP

Three calignis try to contain intruders and keep them from penetrating any deeper into the lodge. If possible, a defender moves to the smaller doors and knocks on them, alerting the other calignis to an attack. This brings the calignis in area @UUID[.8iE1bRgAOvwLTzmw]{I23}; together, this makes up a Extreme encounter for 9th-level characters. If Custodian Dulac accompanies the heroes, the calignis grudgingly point her toward area @UUID[.UisN4T7sPOV11IC0]{I25} to speak with Galudu.

I23. Caligni Bunks.name: I23. 卡利尼卧铺 I23. Caligni Bunks
I23. Caligni Bunks.text:
这个房间肮脏不堪，散发着陈腐的气味。破布、破烂的地毯和毯子散落在地上。

这间睡眠室光线昏暗，因为通往区域 @UUID[.iduGvMRKIN2B46hv]{I24} 的门缝周围在发光。

遭遇

低 9

@Actor[OloMMRPtTQKF0x16]{卡利尼防御者 (2)}

60 XP

在此处休息的两名卡利尼会对大会堂中的骚动做出反应。若发现寡不敌众，一名防御者会打开通往区域 @UUID[.iduGvMRKIN2B46hv]{I24} 的门，释放亡灵。

This room is filthy and smells stale. Rags and tattered rugs and blankets litter the floor.

This sleeping chamber is dimly lit, as the cracks around the door to area @UUID[.iduGvMRKIN2B46hv]{I24} glow.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[OloMMRPtTQKF0x16]{Caligni Defenders (2)}

60 XP

The two calignis resting here respond to commotion in the great hall. If outclassed, a defender opens the door to area @UUID[.iduGvMRKIN2B46hv]{I24} to set the undead free.

I24. Strange Dead.name: I24. 奇怪的死者 I24. Strange Dead
I24. Strange Dead.text:
如果英雄们检查门缝中的发光，它会发生变化，仿佛里面的光源正在移动。

一堆布满灰尘的瓮堆在这间小房间的东墙边。每个瓮上都刻着锯齿状的符文。

卡林吉人因这房间里奇怪的居住者而避开此处：一对罕见的不死卡林吉，被称为光明行者。只有加卢杜会定期来这里与他们交谈；其他卡林吉人只有在需要严重且紧急的援助时才会打开这扇门。

这些瓮是此地还是猎人小屋时留下的。总共有11个瓮，每个高3英尺。它们曾用于用魔法保存作为战利品取下的生物部位，但这些魔法早已失效。有四个瓮里装着干瘪的爪子或骨头。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[ChRgdkplhO1D81Lg]{光明行者 (2)}

80 XP

两名光明行者在这房间里焦躁地来回踱步，但加卢杜尽力让他们保持脚踏实地并冷静下来。当他们看到非卡林吉人时，会认为小屋正遭到攻击，并战斗至被摧毁，或直到加卢杜叫停他们。

If the heroes examine the glow in the door’s cracks, it shifts as if the light source within is moving around.

A stack of dusty urns is heaped against the east wall of this small room. Each is covered with jagged runes.

The caligni keep out of this room due to its strange occupants, a pair of rare undead calignis called bright walkers. Only Galudu regularly comes here to speak with them; the other calignis only open the door if they need serious and immediate aid.

The urns are left over from when this place was a lodge for hunters. There are 11 urns in total, each 3 feet tall. They were used to magically preserve creature parts taken as trophies, but their magic expired long ago. Four urns contain shriveled claws or bones.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[ChRgdkplhO1D81Lg]{Bright Walkers (2)}

80 XP

The two bright walkers pace restlessly in this room, but Galudu does her best to keep them grounded and calm. When they see non-calignis, they assume the lodge is under attack and fight until destroyed, or until Galudu calls them off.

I25. Old Rubbish.name: I25. 旧垃圾堆 I25. Old Rubbish
I25. Old Rubbish.text:
成堆的破家具、破布和其他垃圾散落在这间肮脏的房间里。

加卢杜有时会在这里与其他人会面，而不是在她南边的私人房间里。如果英雄们与托管人杜拉克同行，杜拉克会让他们在这里等候，同时她私下将他们的情况告知加卢杜。

Piles of broken furniture, rags, and other rubbish litter this dirty room.

Galudu sometimes meets with others here, rather than in her private chamber to the south. If the heroes are with Custodian Dulac, Dulac asks them to wait here while she privately informs Galudu about them.

I26. Galudu’s Room.name: I26. 加卢杜的房间 I26. Galudu’s Room
I26. Galudu’s Room.text:
一扇由透明石头制成的大型凸窗俯瞰着小屋外的荒野，但窗户被污垢覆盖得很严重，几乎无法清晰地看穿。房间中央附近搭起了一张临时桌子，旁边卷着一张睡垫。

加鲁杜大部分时间都待在这里。她不仅是卡利尼的领袖，还是他们的主要供给者：当猎人空手而归——或者根本没有回来——时，她会用召唤出来的食物和清水来喂养他们。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[3Ll0LCZcmQmb7aV3]{Galudu}

80 XP

如果英雄一路打进小屋，加鲁杜会用她的法术把他们逼退。无处可逃之下，她会战斗至死。

如果是托管人杜拉克带英雄来到这里，加鲁杜会既警惕又欢迎；如果英雄帮助了杜拉克和她那群愚蠢的邪教徒，他们或许也能帮助加鲁杜。她会听英雄说话，但很快就会引出她的支线任务话题。

支线任务

加鲁杜解释说，这里的卡利尼全都是难民，正逃离幽暗地域更深处的某场灾难，但她并未说明细节。在抵达这间小屋之前，有好几名卡利尼死去；如今只剩下最强壮的成员。她很快略过了导致杜拉克以乌塔古尔教团身份占据上层的分裂经过；加鲁杜认为杜拉克和她的邪教徒不过是一群抱着错位希望的蠢货，并不在乎他们的命运。她更关心的是为自己和她的卡利尼防御者找到一条安全的出口；只要不拖慢加鲁杜的脚步，邪教徒也欢迎跟来。

加鲁杜说明有两条离开的路，但都被强大的怪物堵住：南边有一只魔鬼（区域 @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{I31}），东边有一条巨龙（区域 @UUID[.cwYDvlHWV3sCAa1r]{I51}）。此外，透肌魔人的狩猎队伍一直在——并且确实已经——逐渐削减卡利尼的人数。如果英雄同意消灭其中任意一只怪物（或者更好的是，已经做到了），并护送卡利尼前往那里，加鲁杜就会把她的魔法魔杖作为报酬交给他们。加鲁杜并不知道区域 @UUID[.ZoNiqNOdXR8zD5pG]{I42} 也通向狩猎场之外，但如果英雄清理出道路，她也乐意走那条通道。英雄需要自行击败他们选择的生物，然后再回来护送卡利尼。由于区域 @UUID[.g1OFd8Mt0UAghDjX]{I22} 的防御者不会让他们从区域 @UUID[.VhKqePYVA3INg8gz]{I21} 进入，他们必须返回农场等级，并通过神龛向下进入，才能回到加鲁杜身边。

遭遇

严重 9

来自区域 @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35} 和 @UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36} 的透肌魔人

120 XP

透肌魔人袭击

如果英雄接受支线任务，旅程并不会一帆风顺。透肌魔人死亡斥候正等着卡利尼来到开阔地带。区域 @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35} 与 @UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36} 的居民会集结起来攻击队伍。这对9级角色而言是一次严重遭遇，但他们有卡利尼站在自己这一边。

A large bay window of transparent stone overlooks the wilderness outside the lodge, but it’s so covered in grime that it’s difficult to see through with any clarity. A makeshift table has been erected near the center of the room, and a sleeping mat is rolled up to one side of it.

Galudu spends most of her time here. She isn’t only the leader of the calignis but their chief provider, feeding them with conjured food and water when hunters return empty-handed—or not at all.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[3Ll0LCZcmQmb7aV3]{Galudu}

80 XP

If the heroes fought their way through the lodge, Galudu uses her spells to drive them off. With nowhere else to go, she fights to the death.

If Custodian Dulac led the heroes here, Galudu is wary but welcoming; if the heroes aided Dulac and her band of foolish cultists, they might be able to help her as well. She listens to the heroes but quickly introduces the topic of her side quest.

Side Quest

Galudu explains that the calignis here are all refugees, fleeing from some calamity deeper in the Darklands that she doesn’t explain. Several calignis died before they made it safely to this lodge; only the strongest now remain. She quickly glosses over the schism that led to Dulac occupying the upper levels as Cult of Urthagul; Galudu considers Dulac and her cult to be simpletons clinging at misplaced hope and doesn’t care about their fate. She’s more interested in finding a safe exit for herself and her caligni defenders; the cultists are welcome to come along if they don’t slow Galudu down.

Galudu explains that there are two ways to leave, but both are blocked by powerful monsters: a daemon to the south (area @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{I31}) and a dragon to the east (area @UUID[.cwYDvlHWV3sCAa1r]{I51}). Furthermore, hunting bands of urdefhans can—and have—whittled down the calignis’ numbers. If the heroes agree to eliminate either monster (or, better yet, have already done so) and escort the calignis there, Galudu gives them her magic wand as payment. Galudu doesn’t know that area @UUID[.ZoNiqNOdXR8zD5pG]{I42} also leads out of the Hunting Grounds, but she’s happy to take that passage if the heroes clear the way. The heroes are on their own to defeat the creature they choose and can come back to escort the calignis. As the defenders in area @UUID[.g1OFd8Mt0UAghDjX]{I22} don’t let them in through area @UUID[.VhKqePYVA3INg8gz]{I21}, they’ll have to return to the Farm level and descend through the shrine to return to Galudu.

Encounter

Severe 9

Urdefhan from areas @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35} and @UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36}

120 XP

Urdefhan Attack

If the heroes accept the side quest, the journey isn’t without incident. Urdefhan death scouts are waiting for the calignis to come into the open. The denizens of areas @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35} and @UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36} come together to assault the group. This is a Severe encounter for 9th-level characters, but they have the calignis on their side.

I27. Ladder Base.name: I27. 梯子的底座 I27. Ladder Base
I27. Ladder Base.text:
一架巨大的铁制梯子向上延伸进黑暗之中。它的铁链与杆条布满裂纹，锈蚀剥落。

这架梯子通往上方超过100尺的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.0DvO7vVIbYZAhm3R]{H34}。

遭遇

低 9

@Actor[NW1Ax1QGE9W4DmiN]{仆役邪魔（4）}

60 XP

四只仆役邪魔在梯子的底座周围的瓦砾与真菌间徘徊。它们对暴力的渴望如此强烈，以至于会与任何看到的人战斗至死。

A large, iron ladder stretches upward into the darkness. Its chains and rods are cracked and flaked with rust.

This ladder leads over 100 feet up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.0DvO7vVIbYZAhm3R]{H34}.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[NW1Ax1QGE9W4DmiN]{Ceustodaemons (4)}

60 XP

Four ceustodaemons prowl amid the rubble and fungus at the ladder’s base. They’re so eager for violence that they fight anyone they see to the death.

I28. Central Pit.name: I28. 中央坑洞 I28. Central Pit
I28. Central Pit.text:
一缕扭曲的光带从天花板上的一个圆孔延伸到地板上与之对应的圆孔。光带附近的石头看起来布满麻点，像是被感染了一般。弧形墙面上装饰着狰狞的石制头颅，属于可怖怪物的造型。

凄凉灯塔的内部无法从本层到达；唯一的许可来自上方100尺（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}）或下方100尺（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}）。

任何活着的生物若在直径5尺的光带内结束其回合，会受到[[/r 9d6[negative]]]伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:24|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免）。

这些石头头颅只是贝科拉喜欢的装饰；它们某种程度上构成了一份异怪的清单。其造型包括甲伏怪、肉体畸变体、古格巨人，以及其他英雄们很可能已经遭遇过的怪物。它们并非由与凄凉灯塔相同的无敌石材制成，因此可以正常移除或摧毁。

A ribbon of twisting light extends from a circular hole in the ceiling to a matching hole in the floor. The stone near the light looks pockmarked and infected. The rounded walls are decorated with snarling stone heads of fearsome monsters.

Gauntlight’s interior can’t be reached from this level; the only access is from 100 feet above (area @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}) or 100 feet below (area @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}).

A living creature that ends its turn within the 5-foot-diameter ribbon of light takes [[/r 9d6[negative]]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:24|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save).

The stone heads are simply decor that Belcorra liked; they constitute a checklist of sorts for aberrations. They include chuuls, fleshwarps, gugs, and other monsters the heroes have likely already encountered. They aren’t made of the same invulnerable stone as Gauntlight and thus can be removed or destroyed normally.

I29. Boathouse.name: I29. 船屋 I29. Boathouse
I29. Boathouse.text:
这座矮胖的石造建筑仅有8英尺高，紧贴着岸边。两座木码头从建筑中伸出，探入巨大的地下湖幽暗的湖水里。门上结满霉菌与地衣，仿佛多年未曾开启。

贝科拉之子曾像照看上方那座湖一样照料这座湖，但数百年前被透肌魔人击溃。在这次溃败中，透肌魔人将贝科拉之子中一位强大的秘法学者——贝卢斯——逼回这间船屋，并将他锁在里面。自那之后贝卢斯一直待在内部，如同其他许多不死侏儒一样陷入迟钝的昏沉。除了被霉菌糊住之外，这些门外侧还钉着临时木板加固。木板很容易撬开，但这么做动静很大，会惊动贝卢斯。屋内，一艘老旧但仍可用的划艇用短铁链吊在天花板上。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[3ry9WSvMMXHUe3kE]{Beluthus}

80 XP

当任何人撬开门或闯入船屋时，贝卢斯就会苏醒。他怒不可遏地猛然出击，渴望在漫长的昏沉之后夺回更多灵魂，并重新加入其他贝科拉之子。

宝藏

@Actor[JLD4vuTKjfWvoOff]{Old Rowboat}

划艇里有一只小海箱，内含一枚天鹅船羽符，一块符文石，刻有一枚+2 护甲潜能符文石，以及一把+2 强击匕首。

This squat stone building, only eight feet high, hugs the shore. Two wooden docks jut from the building into the dark waters of the massive underground lake. The doors are caked with mold and lichen, as if they haven’t been opened in years.

The Children of Belcorra once tended to this lake as they did the one above, but the urdefhans routed them centuries ago. During this rout, the urdefhans drove Beluthus, a powerful occultist among the Children of Belcorra, back to this boathouse and locked him in. Beluthus has remained inside ever since, succumbing to torpor like many of the other undead gnomes. In addition to being caked with mold, the doors have makeshift planks nailed across them on the outside. The planks are easy to pry off, but doing so is noisy and alerts Beluthus. Inside, an old but serviceable rowboat hangs from the ceiling on short chains.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[3ry9WSvMMXHUe3kE]{Beluthus}

80 XP

Beluthus wakes when anyone pries open the doors or intrudes into the boathouse. He lashes out with fury, eager to recover more souls after his long torpor and rejoin the other Children of Belcorra.

Treasure

@Actor[JLD4vuTKjfWvoOff]{Old Rowboat}

The rowboat contains a small sea chest with a swan boat feather token, a runestone with a +2 armor potency rune, and a +2 striking dagger.

I30. Lizard Run.name: I30. 蜥蜴跑场 I30. Lizard Run
I30. Lizard Run.text:
这个洞穴的天花板上布满了许多水晶生长物与钟乳石。这些构造物上滴落着如雨点般的细密水滴，而小径则蜿蜒穿过地面上茂密生长的厚重真菌。

伊尔达里斯的卓尔用一种厚实、快速生长的真菌培育了这片区域，这种真菌由远方社群中的卓尔真菌学家研发。这些蘑菇能遮蔽卓尔的移动，并为社群提供稳定的食物来源。

在这片区域中移动十分艰难，因为厚厚的蘑菇掩盖了地面上的石笋与水晶生长物。对熟悉地形的伊尔达里斯卓尔及其骑乘蜥蜴而言，地面为困难地形；对所有其他生物而言，则为高等困难地形。

遭遇

低 9

@Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{骑乘蜥蜴（4）}

40 XP

卓尔让他们的骑乘蜥蜴在这片区域自由奔跑。洞穴中的掠食者有时会抓住并杀死一只走失的蜥蜴，但卓尔并不在意这种损失，因为他们可以研究猎杀现场，从而了解更多在家园附近狩猎的生物信息。当前有四只骑乘蜥蜴栖居于此，均刚刚达到成熟期。由于它们的两只同胞近期被透肌魔人杀死，它们会对非卓尔类人表现出攻击性。任意一只蜥蜴的生命值降至少于25点时，便会逃离该区域。

宝藏

@Actor[eomAmy6pj0uYoMS1]{蛛网}

尽管巨伞蜥没有宝藏，但在一处蜘蛛蛛网残骸附近散落着87 gp与120 sp。蛛网中有一具死去的卓尔尸体，身穿高等医者手套并披着精灵披风。

The ceiling of this cavern sports many crystal growths and stalactites. A pattering drizzle drips from these formations, and paths wind though thick fungus growing on the ground.

The Yldaris drow cultivated this area with a thick, fast-growing fungus developed by drow mycologists in distant communities. These mushrooms hide drow movements and provide the community with a ready source of food.

Movement in this area is challenging, as the thick mushrooms conceal stalagmites and crystalline growths on the ground. For Yldaris drow and their riding lizards, who know the terrain, the ground is difficult terrain; for all other creatures, it’s greater difficult terrain.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[QRjjE4TJNfaDhhQC]{Riding Lizards (4)}

40 XP

The drow let their riding lizards run free in this area. The predators of the cavern sometimes catch and kill an errant lizard, but the drow don’t mind the loss, as they can study the site of the kill and learn more information about creatures hunting near their home. Four riding lizards currently reside here, all just reaching maturity. As two of their siblings were recently killed by urdefhans, they’re aggressive to non-drow humanoids. A lizard reduced to fewer than 25 Hit Points flees the area.

Treasure

@Actor[eomAmy6pj0uYoMS1]{Webbing}

While the giant frilled lizards have no treasure, 87 gp and 120 sp are scattered near the remains of a spider’s web. A dead drow in the web wears greater healer's gloves and a cloak of elvenkind.

I31. The Barrens.name: I31. 贫瘠之地 I31. The Barrens
I31. The Barrens.text:
这座洞窟中的菌类生长变得稀薄，让位于贫瘠的岩石与瓦砾。在暗淡的灰色石块之间，奇异的、浓厚的灰黑色雾云贴着地面翻涌。

伊尔达里斯卓尔经过此处时会沿着洞窟北侧边缘绕行，因为他们知道更深处潜伏着危险。卓尔将此地称作贫瘠之地；若英雄们已赢得他们的援助，他们会警告英雄此地的风险：雾气致命，而洞窟中还栖息着一只危险的怪物。

雾气使察觉检定承受–2环境减值。10尺以外的一切皆为隐蔽，且能见度在30尺处终止。

一条狭窄的通道通向南方，通往遥远而同样险恶、且不在本次冒险范围内的幽暗地域洞窟。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[oKogG9AwUZ9iBsm3]{异虫邪魔} @Actor[s8Ofcsub5QJJmgA5]{邪魔之雾}

132 XP

雾气的效果与邪魔的瘴气相连。当一个非邪魔、非透肌魔人生物冒险深入洞窟过半时，薄雾会凝结成汲取生命的巨口。若异虫邪魔被杀死，此危害会在数分钟内消失。

进入狩猎场

@Scene[Z5ExlCWEpqm0SMe1]{I - 狩猎场}

当我们为本层制作VTT就绪地图时，我们选择将其划分为三个部分。我们的目标是在不影响性能的前提下，提供与其他地图相同的分辨率。我们希望这能确保所有用户都获得尽可能好的体验。

如果你的玩家想要继续向北进入@UUID[.ZxWEWhGUw4kphhDf]{Southern Jumble}，你应当启用下一张场景，并将玩家的指示物放置在那里。

你可以在侧边栏的场景标签页中，于09: On The Hunt文件夹内找到狩猎场与透肌魔人营地的场景。

The fungus growth thins in this cavern, giving way to barren rock and rubble. Amid the dull gray stone, strange clouds of thick, grayish-black fog hug the ground.

The Yldaris drow skirt the north stretch of this cavern when they come this way, knowing of the dangers that lurk deeper in. The drow call this place the Barrens; if the heroes have earned their aid, they warn the heroes of its risks: the fog is deadly, and the cavern harbors a dangerous monster.

The fog imposes a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks. Everything beyond 10 feet is concealed, and visibility ends at 30 feet.

A narrow passage leads south to distant, equally treacherous Darklands caverns outside the scope of this adventure.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[oKogG9AwUZ9iBsm3]{Derghodaemon} @Actor[s8Ofcsub5QJJmgA5]{Daemonic Fog}

132 XP

The fog’s effects are tied to the daemon’s miasma. When a non-fiend, non-urdefhan creature ventures halfway into the cavern, the mist solidifies into life-draining mouths. If the derghodaemon is killed, this hazard disappears in minutes.

Into the Hunting Grounds

@Scene[Z5ExlCWEpqm0SMe1]{I - Hunting Grounds}

When we created the VTT-ready maps for this floor, we chose to divide it into three sections. Our goal was to provide the same resolution as the other maps without having any impact on performance. We hope this will ensure that all users would have the best possible experience.

If your players would like to continue to the north into the @UUID[.ZxWEWhGUw4kphhDf]{Southern Jumble}, you should activate the next scene and place down your players' tokens there.

You can find the scenes for the Hunting Grounds and Urdefhan Camp in the 09: On The Hunt folder of the scenes tab in your sidebar.

I32. Southern Jumble.name: I32. 南部荒野 I32. Southern Jumble
I32. Southern Jumble.text:
在这座巨大的洞窟中，真菌肆意生长且高大茂密，有时可长至三十英尺之高。当能透过真菌冠层看见时，洞窟天花板还要更高。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[czQFet5Qo63IXtHl]{割颅尘菌（2）}

80 XP

洞窟这片野生区域中的部分真菌很危险。英雄们第一次进入这片区域时，两株致死尘菌会朝他们飘来，从高处的蘑菇顶部向下漂降。它们会尽其所能追击敌人，并战斗直至被摧毁。

向南前进

@Scene[SkPDNmMoL4M4r1it]{I - 伊尔达里斯}

为本层制作可用于 VTT 的地图时，我们选择将其划分为三个部分。我们的目标是在不影响性能的前提下，提供与其他地图相同的分辨率。我们希望这能确保所有用户都能获得尽可能最佳的体验。

如果你的玩家想继续向南进入 @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{The Barrens}，你应当激活下一张场景并将你玩家的指示物放置在那里。

你可以在侧边栏的场景标签页中，09：狩猎之中文件夹里找到透肌魔人营地与伊尔达里斯前哨的场景。

Fungus grows wild and tall throughout this enormous cavern, sometimes reaching as high as thirty feet. The cavern ceiling, when visible through the fungal canopy, is higher still.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[czQFet5Qo63IXtHl]{Reaper Skull Puffballs (2)}

80 XP

Some fungus in this wild section of the cave is dangerous. Two deadly puffballs float toward the heroes when they first enter this area, descending from the mushroom tops high above. They pursue foes as best they can and fight until destroyed.

Heading South

@Scene[SkPDNmMoL4M4r1it]{I - Yldaris}

When we created the VTT-ready maps for this floor, we chose to divide it into three sections. Our goal was to provide the same resolution as the other maps without having any impact on performance. We hope this will ensure that all users would have the best possible experience.

If your players would like to continue to the south into @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{The Barrens}, you should activate the next scene and place down your players' tokens there.

You can find the scenes for the Urdefhan Camp and the Yldaris outpost in the 09: On The Hunt folder of the scenes tab in your sidebar.

I33. Ferocious Displays.name: I33. 残暴示威 I33. Ferocious Displays
I33. Ferocious Displays.text:
这处宽阔的洞窟入口令人作呕。墙壁上泼洒着赭黄与猩红的图像，杂乱无章地交织成一片充满暴力与淫秽的符号。入口周围的木桩上钉着头骨与一些奇异生物被肢解的残骸。

这是透肌魔人居住的洞窟群的主要入口。狩猎场中有智慧的生物都避开此地，因为它们知道透肌魔人会残酷地保护自己的领地。

遭遇

低 9

@Actor[tZCFmJonHkhGg1Vs]{透肌魔人死亡斥候 (2)} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{透肌魔人鞭笞者 (2)}

70 XP

两名透肌魔人鞭笞者站岗放哨，而两名透肌魔人死亡斥候则潜伏在由头骨与残肢组成的恐怖陈列之间。它们已被指示在面对强大或数量众多的敌人时高声发出魔法警报，但只要察觉到任何敌人，它们就会迫不及待地投入战斗。若任意三名透肌魔人被击败，幸存者会突然意识到自己本该更早呼救，于是逃往区域 @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34} 拉响魔法警报。

替换

如果这些守卫被击败，它们会先被区域 @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34} 的死亡斥候与鞭笞者替换，随后再由同一区域的一对紧张不安的透肌魔人武者替换。

进入营地

@Scene[kxMIly2TCSidrRf1]{I - 透肌魔人营地}

当我们为这一层制作 VTT 就绪地图时，我们选择将其划分为三个部分。我们的目标是在不影响性能的前提下，提供与其他地图相同的分辨率。我们希望这能确保所有用户都能获得尽可能最佳的体验。

当你的玩家在区域 I33 击败透肌魔人守卫后，如果他们想继续深入透肌魔人据点，你应当激活下一张场景，并将他们的指示物放置在入口附近。

你可以在侧边栏的场景标签页中，于场景的 09：追猎之中 文件夹里找到“透肌魔人营地”和“伊尔达里斯前哨”的场景。

This wide cavern entrance is a disgusting sight. The walls are splashed with ocher and scarlet images in a riot of violent and obscene symbols. Stakes around the entrance hold up skulls and dismembered parts of strange creatures.

This is the main entrance of the cavern complex where the urdefhans live. Intelligent creatures in the Hunting Grounds avoid this place, knowing the urdefhans ruthlessly protect their territory.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[tZCFmJonHkhGg1Vs]{Urdefhan Death Scouts (2)} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{Urdefhan Lashers (2)}

70 XP

Two urdefhan lashers stand guard, while two death scouts lurk amid the gruesome displays of skulls and body parts. They’ve been directed to shout an alarm in the face of powerful or numerous foes, but they jump eagerly into a fight as soon as they detect any enemies. If any three urdefhans are defeated, the survivor suddenly realizes they should’ve called for help sooner and flees to area @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34} to raise the alarm.

Replacements

If these guards are defeated, they’re first replaced with death scouts and lashers from area @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34}, then with a pair of nervous urdefhan warriors from the same area.

Moving into the Camp

@Scene[kxMIly2TCSidrRf1]{I - Urdefhan Camp}

When we created the VTT-ready maps for this floor, we chose to divide it into three sections. Our goal was to provide the same resolution as the other maps without having any impact on performance. We hope this will ensure that all users would have the best possible experience.

When your players have defeated the urdefhan guards in area I33, if they would like to continue deeper into the Urdefhan compound, you should activate the next scene and place down their tokens near the entrance.

You can find the scenes for the Urdefhan Camp and the Yldaris outpost in the 09: On The Hunt folder of the scenes tab in your sidebar.

I34. Urdefhan Horde.name: I34. 透肌魔人部落 I34. Urdefhan Horde
I34. Urdefhan Horde.text:
这座巨大的洞窟里杂乱地搭着一堆低矮的帐篷，由缝合在一起的毛皮与血迹斑斑的皮革制成。大多数帐篷围绕着一根天然的石柱，石柱上用棕色与红色颜料绘有奇异符号，周围还绑着或钉着许多头骨。各种生物的毛皮盖住了东南方向三处洞穴的入口，每处都有一扇狭窄的木门。

卓尔的支援

如果英雄们获得了伊尔达里斯的援助，并表示要与库尔费为敌，那么卓尔可能会在远处尾随，以便监视他们的动向。若英雄们陷入难以招架的局面，一支由两名卓尔猎手与两名卓尔射手组成的小队会前来援助。卓尔若能避免便不会进入近战，但他们很乐意在远处逐个击倒透肌魔人。若英雄们确实向伊尔达里斯展现了自己的价值，夸拉也可能同样前来支援。

憎恨魔窟中的大多数透肌魔人都居住在这座巨大的洞窟里。他们睡在狭小拥挤的帐篷中，但清醒时则把时间花在进食、切磋或摆弄他们的武器上。用于支援营地的其他物资，如食物储藏室与日常补给品，则存放在帐篷里。

穿越洞窟

穿越这座战营去面对库尔费十分困难。透肌魔人渴求毁灭，总是随时准备战斗。由于他们把大量时间都花在彼此之间的切磋与厮杀上，邻近洞穴的住民（区域 @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35}、@UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36} 和 @UUID[.ODRXDNm2Z9BgXmTM]{I37}）不会对这里的战斗声响作出反应。若英雄们使用潜行或诡计，或许能更轻松地绕过这些力量，但请记住，这里的邪魔始终维持着识破隐形。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[e5yE4RkwLQojRYHm]{武者 (12)} @Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{Tormentors (2)} @Actor[NW1Ax1QGE9W4DmiN]{仆役邪魔 (2)} @Actor[tZCFmJonHkhGg1Vs]{死亡斥候 (2)} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{鞭笞者 (2)}

这里几乎任何时候都能找到将近20名透肌魔人，另有两名仆役邪魔在一旁煽动他们的嗜血欲望。大约三分之一的透肌魔人正在睡觉，但只要其他透肌魔人发出叫喊，他们便会迅速抓起武器投入战斗。所有透肌魔人都以低吼的欢呼声作战，并沉醉于战斗之中，即使他们正处于劣势。若英雄们击败了这里除透肌魔人武者之外的所有敌人，透肌魔人武者便会一起溃散逃离。

若英雄们从这场战斗中撤退，大多数透肌魔人会放他们离开；[[/r 1d6]] 名透肌魔人武者会跟随其后，尖叫着要英雄们的血。

若透肌魔人击败了英雄们，他们不会杀死对方，而是将其活捉并移交给区域 @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35} 中的 tormentors，在那里他们或许能在被献祭之前获得一次逃脱的机会。

This massive cavern holds a jumble of low-lying tents made of stitched-together pelts and blood-streaked leather. Most of the tents surround a natural stone pillar decorated with strange symbols in brown and red paint, amid skulls tied or spiked to the pillar. Hides of various creatures cover the entrances to three caves to the southeast, each with a narrow wooden door.

Drow to the Rescue

If the heroes have gained the aid of Yldaris and indicated they were going against Khurfel, the drow might have followed at a distance to keep an eye on them. If the heroes are in over their heads, a group of two drow hunters and two drow shootists come to their aid. The drow won’t enter melee if they can avoid it, but they’re happy to pick off urdefhans at a distance. If the heroes have truly shown their worth to Yldaris, Quara might come to their aid as well.

Most urdefhans in the Abomination Vaults dwell in this enormous cavern. They sleep in small, cramped tents but spend their time awake eating, sparring, or working with their weapons. Other accoutrements to support their camp, such as food storage and mundane supplies, are in the tents.

Crossing the Cavern

Traversing this war camp to face Khurfel is difficult. With their craving for destruction, the urdefhans are always ready for battle. As they spend so much time sparring and fighting among themselves, the denizens of the adjacent caves (areas @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35}, @UUID[.w0VMeGekcaakkCSk]{I36}, and @UUID[.ODRXDNm2Z9BgXmTM]{I37}) don’t respond to the sounds of combat here. The heroes might have an easier time bypassing these forces if they use stealth or trickery, but keep in mind the daemons here have a constant see invisibility.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[e5yE4RkwLQojRYHm]{Warriors (12)} @Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{Tormentors (2)} @Actor[NW1Ax1QGE9W4DmiN]{Ceustodaemons (2)} @Actor[tZCFmJonHkhGg1Vs]{Death Scouts (2)} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{Lashers (2)}

Nearly 20 urdefhans can be found here at almost all times, along with two ceustodaemons who stoke their bloodlust. About a third of the urdefhans are sleeping, but they’re quick to grab their weapons and join in a fight if other urdefhans raise a hue and cry. All the urdefhans fight with growling whoops and revel in the battle, even if they’re losing. If the heroes defeat all the foes here other than urdefhan warriors, the urdefhan warriors all break and flee together.

If the heroes retreat from this battle, most of the urdefhans let them go; [[/r 1d6]] urdefhan warriors follow, screaming for the heroes’ blood.

If the urdefhans defeat the heroes, they don’t kill them, but rather take them alive and hand them over to the tormentors in area @UUID[.6P5Lw4eeNrBQKv9O]{I35}, where they might have a chance to escape before being sacrificed.

I35. Summoning Cavern.name: I35. 召唤洞穴 I35. Summoning Cavern
I35. Summoning Cavern.text:
这个洞窟向上倾斜，通往一片平坦的区域。北墙边放着一个约三英尺见方的金属箱子，箱盖被顶在墙上以防止打开。地面上绘着一个血色圆圈，周围环绕着符文。

透肌魔人致力于将更多邪魔带入他们的族群之中，因此用这间房作为进行邪恶召唤仪式的场所。他们目前关着一名打算献祭的俘虏：一位名叫 @Actor[0hnnwyqLfYVIenzd]{Calinth Narogblom} 的深地侏儒岩卫。倒霉的卡林斯来到憎恨魔窟，搜索证据以确认他的族人有一支分支仍在此地生活。他甚至还没来得及与贝科拉之子会面——而贝科拉之子如今的状态会令他惊骇——就被一支透肌魔人劫掠队俘获。他们把卡林斯关在靠墙推紧的金属箱里，这样他就无法融入石头并逃脱。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{透肌魔人折磨者 (3)} @Actor[OTT7CCkonkfwhJ8Y]{透肌魔人血法师}

60 XP

三名透肌魔人折磨者吟唱并哀嚎，在一名满身疤痕且残忍的血法师协助下施展一场冗长的召唤仪式。折磨者希望强化他们的邪魔契约仪式，以召来更强大的邪魔；他们是否成功由你决定。四名透肌魔人会攻击任何打断其仪式的入侵者。他们战至死方休。

支线任务

卡林斯身上没有任何道具，但他仍想弄清楚生活在这里的深地侏儒的情况。若英雄向他展示贝科拉之子的证据——甚至是以往战斗中留下的尸体——卡林斯会感到悲伤，但他的好奇心也会得到满足。若英雄将他带到通往幽暗地域的某个出口，他就能回到族人身边。

一周后，卡林斯会寄来一份象征感谢的信物：一套黑玉与蛋白石完整套装的 @Item[OroUy85wiTjxpDb5]{黑暗追逐} 桌游，价值 120 gp。若英雄告诉卡林斯他们与伊尔达里斯卓尔关系友善，他会通过前哨站与洛扎丁之间的商队路线寄送。否则，他会亲自去找英雄，必要时甚至会冒险前往地表世界。

This cavern slopes upward to a flat area. A metal box about three feet across sits against the northern wall, its lid pressed against the wall to prevent it from opening. A bloody circle surrounded by runes is painted on the floor.

Dedicated to bringing more daemons into their midst, the urdefhans use this chamber for vile summoning rituals. They currently keep one prisoner they intend to sacrifice: a deep gnome rockwarden named @Actor[0hnnwyqLfYVIenzd]{Calinth Narogblom}. The unfortunate Calinth came to the Abomination Vaults searching for evidence that an offshoot of his people were still living here. He never even met up with the Children of Belcorra—whose current state would horrify him—before being captured by an urdefhan raiding party. They keep Calinth in the metal box pushed against the wall so he can’t meld into stone and escape.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{Urdefhan Tormentors (3)} @Actor[OTT7CCkonkfwhJ8Y]{Urdefhan Blood Mage}

60 XP

Three urdefhan tormentors chant and wail, casting a lengthy summoning ritual with the assistance of a scarred and cruel blood mage. The tormentors hope to empower their daemonic pact ritual to bring in a more powerful daemon; whether or not they succeed is up to you. All four urdefhans attack any intruders that interrupt their rite. They fight to the death.

Side Quest

Calinth carries no gear, but he nevertheless still wants to find out about the deep gnomes living here. If the heroes show him evidence of the Children of Belcorra—even their corpses from past fights—Calinth is sad but his curiosity is satisfied. If the heroes lead him to one of the exits to the Darklands, he can make it back to his people.

A week later, Calinth sends them a token of his appreciation: a jet and opal complete set of the @Item[OroUy85wiTjxpDb5]{Dark Chase} board game, worth 120 gp. If the heroes told Calinth that they’re friendly with the Yldaris drow, he sends it by the caravan route between the outpost and Lozardyn. Otherwise, he searches the heroes out himself, even braving the surface world if he must.

I36. The Blood Temple.name: I36. 鲜血神庙 I36. The Blood Temple
I36. The Blood Temple.text:
这座大致呈三角形的洞窟东侧有一处升起的平台，上面立着一座血淋淋的祭坛。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{透肌魔人折磨者（2）} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{透肌魔人鞭笞者（2）}

60 XP

这间室内持续进行着一场无休止的放血狂欢，这是诡异而血腥的透肌魔人宗教的一部分。若被打断，参与者会急切地想用新鲜血液覆盖他们的祭坛。

两名折磨者引导两名鞭笞者进行仪式。他们都会攻击干涉其骇人仪式的不信者，并战斗至死。

A raised platform with a bloody altar stands on the east side of this roughly triangular cavern.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{Urdefhan Tormentors (2)} @Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{Urdefhan Lashers (2)}

60 XP

A constant orgy of bloodletting goes on in this chamber, all part of the strange and gory urdefhan religion. If interrupted, the participants are anxious to cover their altar with fresh blood.

Two tormentors guide two lashers in the rites. All of them attack nonbelievers who interfere with their gruesome rituals and fight to the death.

I37. Khurfel’s Tent.name: I37. 库尔费的帐篷 I37. Khurfel’s Tent
I37. Khurfel’s Tent.text:
在这座洞窟的中心坐落着一间唯一的皮毛棚屋。通往棚屋的小径两侧立着顶着骷髅的长矛。

这是这个透肌魔人邪教的根源：战斗冠军独自居住，且其居所并不比其他透肌魔人的更精致。那些骷髅全都属于库尔费为夺取并维持战斗冠军之位而击败的对手。它们的牙齿已经被拔走，用来制作@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.jkYn89XREERA3V2e]{Shauth Blade}与@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.WiPcevdeD4YoTLRa]{Shauth Lash}武器。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{透肌魔人折磨者（2）} @Actor[Np787X9Z4aQxOdCg]{库尔费}

80 XP

一旦库尔费注意到英雄们，他便显得很满意，脸部扭曲成一个骇人的狞笑。他一边拔出双叉剑、一边大步向前，用地底通用语喊道：“我们在好日子相会，为了杀戮。”正如他的血之幻视所预示的那样，他不会回避与英雄的战斗，也既不提出也不接受饶命。他始终将@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.IS1P6er2hLyKXAss]{Emerald Fulcrum Lens}随身携带，绑在背上以免战斗时碍事。他已对该镜片进行灌注，因此对他施放的伤害术会额外恢复更多生命值。

两名折磨者为库尔费出谋划策，并会加入他参与的任何战斗。他们小心不妨碍自家战斗冠军，并用他们的伤害术让他得以继续战斗。若库尔费被击败，他们便会逃离。

XP 奖励

英雄们找回翡翠支点镜片时，奖励 30 XP。

进击的库尔费

如果英雄们袭击透肌魔人营地后撤退或逃脱，库尔费会积极展开报复。他不会等待英雄们回来；相反，他会带领一名鞭笞者、一名死亡斥候以及四名透肌魔人武者去搜寻他们。英雄们下一次遭遇的随机遭遇会是与库尔费的战团的遭遇。或者，你也可以让战团在英雄们于伊尔达里斯之外旅行时的任何时刻出现。

宝藏

@Actor[d7Os57bGrdmJDPzT]{透肌魔人贡品}

库尔费的棚屋内堆着成堆的贡品：180 gp、1,320 sp、五颗每颗价值 10 gp 的月长石，以及两颗每颗价值 20 gp 的金绿宝石。

At this cavern's center sits a single fur-and-skin hovel. A path to the hovel is flanked with skull-topped spears.

It’s the tradition of this urdefhan cult that the war champion dwells apart and lives in a home no more elaborate than that of other urdefhans. The skulls all belong to rivals that Khurfel defeated to obtain and maintain his position as war champion. Their teeth are gone, having been used for @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.jkYn89XREERA3V2e]{Shauth Blade} and @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.WiPcevdeD4YoTLRa]{Shauth Lash} weapons.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[FJr7Rc9MQEwxjAcz]{Urdefhan Tormentors (2)} @Actor[Np787X9Z4aQxOdCg]{Khurfel}

80 XP

Once Khurfel notices the heroes, he looks pleased, his face contorting in a terrifying grin. He calls out, “We meet on a good day to kill” in Undercommon as he draws his rhoka sword and strides forward. As his blood visions foretold his fight with the heroes, he doesn’t shy away from it, and he neither offers nor accepts quarter. He keeps the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.IS1P6er2hLyKXAss]{Emerald Fulcrum Lens} on his person at all times, strapped across his back so it doesn’t get in the way during a fight. He has invested the lens, so harm spells cast on him heal additional Hit Points.

Two tormentors advise Khurfel and join any battle with him. They’re careful not to get in their war champion’s way, and they use their harm spells to keep him in the fight. They flee if Khurfel is defeated.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for recovering the Emerald Fulcrum Lens.

Khurfel on the March

If the heroes assault the urdefhan camp and retreat or escape, Khurfel is active in his retribution. He doesn’t wait for the heroes to return. Instead, he leads a lasher, a death scout, and four urdefhan warriors in the search for them. The next random encounter the heroes have is an encounter with Khurfel’s war party. Alternatively, you can have the war party show up whenever the heroes are traveling outside of Yldaris.

Treasure

@Actor[d7Os57bGrdmJDPzT]{Urdefhan Tribute}

Inside Khurfel’s hovel are mounds of tribute: 180 gp, 1,320 sp, five moonstones worth 10 gp each, and two chrysoberyls worth 20 gp each.

I38. Guard Post.name: I38. 岗哨 I38. Guard Post
I38. Guard Post.text:
透肌魔人使用这条通道从湖岸来回出入。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{透肌魔人鞭笞者 (3)}

60 XP

被指派来守卫这个很少使用的入口的三名透肌魔人鞭笞者渴望战斗。

增援

如果守卫被击败，他们会由区域 @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34} 中的仆役邪魔替换。如果邪魔被击败，这个区域将保持无人守卫。

The urdefhans use this passageway to come and go from the lakeshore.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[Sbxt8YT0AOFfVCPX]{Urdefhan Lashers (3)}

60 XP

The three urdefhan lashers assigned to guard this little-used entrance are itching for a fight.

Reinforcements

If the guards are defeated, they’re replaced by the ceustodaemons in area @UUID[.rnPlOrzXgNElSkPN]{I34}. If the daemons are defeated, this area remains unguarded.

I39. Deadly Lake.name: I39. 夺命湖 I39. Deadly Lake
I39. Deadly Lake.text:
这座巨大湖泊的浑浊水体不祥地翻涌着。

尽管不像农场等级的大湖那样被令人作呕、令人不适的薄雾笼罩，这座湖在中心处却有数百英尺深，并栖息着奇异的水栖（特征）生物。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[78Vf1Lk9ph2RGDgL]{深水触鳍鱼怪（2）}

80 XP

这座湖里总共有六只深水触鳍鱼怪游弋。其中两只会迅速前来调查水中的任何扰动。这次攻击应当发生在英雄们第一次进入湖中时，但如果你愿意，也可以在之后的探入中让另一对触鳍鱼怪发动攻击。触鳍鱼怪会单独或成对攻击，且凶悍得惊人；它们会追逐上岸的敌人，并战斗至死。

The murky waters of this massive lake shift ominously.

Though not covered with a cloying, sickly mist like the large lake in the Farm level, this lake is hundreds of feet deep in its center and harbors strange aquatic life.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[78Vf1Lk9ph2RGDgL]{Deepwater Dhuthorexes (2)}

80 XP

A total of six deepwater dhuthorexes swim in this lake. Two quickly come to investigate any disturbance in the water. This attack should occur the first time the heroes venture into the lake, but you can have another pair of dhuthorexes attack during later excursions if you choose. The dhuthorexes attack singly or in pairs and are shockingly aggressive; they pursue foes on land and fight to the death.

I40. Crystal Shore.name: I40. 水晶湖岸 I40. Crystal Shore
I40. Crystal Shore.text:
此处岸边的岩石上长出大片淡绿色水晶结晶体。这些水晶从天花板垂下，沿墙面攀爬，并以长长的晶丝伸向水面。

尽管其中一些水晶很尖，但并不危险。然而，如果一只生物触碰到其中一块水晶，它就会开始振动，引发水晶之间共鸣的、叮当作响的连锁反应。声音很大，但并不刺耳。噪声引起了在区域 @UUID[.zRyrXydUmCGSSpzo]{I41} 筑巢的迷音鸟的注意，它会游过来进行调查。

The stone along the shore here sprouts large growths of pale-green crystals. The crystals hang from the ceiling, climb up the wall, and reach toward the water in long strands.

While some of these crystals are pointed, they aren’t hazardous. However, if a creature touches one of the crystals, it begins to vibrate, which starts a chain reaction of resonant, ringing sounds among the crystals. The sound is loud but not unpleasant. The noise piques the attention of the cauthooj nesting in area @UUID[.zRyrXydUmCGSSpzo]{I41}, which swims over to investigate.

I41. Island Nest.name: I41. 岛巢 I41. Island Nest
I41. Island Nest.text:
这座岛的主体由绿色水晶和灰色石头混杂构成。岩石上长着几片真菌，其中在岛屿东岸附近有一片格外厚密的菌丛。

这片厚密的菌丛是一处迷音鸟巢，里面有两枚蛋。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[FHfrIJCdKTzy2rrR]{迷音鸟}

120 XP

一只迷音鸟最近来到这座岛上产卵，并囤积尸体以喂养即将孵化的幼雏。当它侦测到英雄时，会立刻发动攻击以确保食物来源。若其生命值降至40点以下，它会逃离岛屿并弃下鸟蛋。它对陷阱十分警惕，不会追逐任何逃入狭窄通道的人，例如通往区域 @UUID[.nWev8MFPqA7hd0lz]{I38} 或 @UUID[.vnlVep65rXXsVyLP]{I43} 的通道。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

寻找支点镜片

夸拉的父亲在与库尔费战斗时，把@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.I2ul8Bzcth7sleow]{Ochre Fulcrum Lens}掉进了这座岛东岸附近的水里。像侦测魔法这样的法术能轻易将其定位出来；否则，一名在水中搜索的英雄可以在一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定后找到它。若英雄们此前尚未在区域 @UUID[.wHieR95y1h9tQrGc]{I39} 遭遇深水触鳍鱼怪，那么这些怪物可能会骚扰任何花大量时间在此区域搜索的人。

XP奖励

英雄们找回赭石支点镜片后，给予他们30 XP。

宝藏

@Item[1qGzZwhFICVJbNFK]{迷音鸟蛋}

这两枚蛋对合适的买家而言很有价值，但要找到买家可能很困难。沃里温在奥塔里外不远处经营石环池塘；她有人脉，愿意为这些鸟蛋出价400 gp，或以任意8级或更低的普通恒久魔法物品进行交换。

A mix of green crystals and grayish stone make up the mass of this island. A few patches of fungus grow across the rocks, with a particularly thick patch near the island’s eastern shore.

The thick patch is a cauthooj nest holding two eggs.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[FHfrIJCdKTzy2rrR]{Cauthooj}

120 XP

A cauthooj recently came to this island to lay its eggs and stockpile corpses to feed the hatchlings. When it detects the heroes, it attacks immediately to secure a source of food. If reduced to fewer than 40 Hit Points, it flees the island and abandons its eggs. It’s wary of a trap and doesn’t pursue anyone who flees into a narrow passage, such as to areas @UUID[.nWev8MFPqA7hd0lz]{I38} or @UUID[.vnlVep65rXXsVyLP]{I43}.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Finding the Fulcrum Lens

Quara's father dropped the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.I2ul8Bzcth7sleow]{Ochre Fulcrum Lens} in the water near the eastern shore of this island during his battle with Khurfel. Spells like detect magic locate it easily; otherwise, a hero Searching the water finds it with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. If the heroes haven’t already encountered deepwater dhuthorexes in area @UUID[.wHieR95y1h9tQrGc]{I39}, those monsters might harass anyone spending a lot of time searching this area.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for recovering the Ochre Fulcrum Lens.

Treasure

@Item[1qGzZwhFICVJbNFK]{Cauthooj Eggs}

The two eggs are valuable to the right buyer, but finding one can be difficult. Worliwynn, who runs the Stone Ring Pond just outside of Otari, has contacts who offer 400 gp or any common permanent magic item that’s 8th level or lower for the eggs.

I42. Steep Exit.name: I42. 陡坡出口 I42. Steep Exit
I42. Steep Exit.text:
这条充满瓦砾的通道陡峭向下倾斜。通道的天花板起伏不定，回荡的吱吱啁啾声充满空气。

通道通向幽暗地域更深处，但前进并不容易。这段陡峭而崎岖的下坡向下延伸80英尺，随后到达一处笔直的300英尺落差。几条废弃的天然通道从其底部向外放射，但这些通道可能通往何处已超出本次冒险的范围。

数百只微小的地下蝙蝠在此筑巢。即便它们数量惊人且倾向于成群围绕入侵者的头部，对高等级角色也不构成威胁。这些蝙蝠有时会在狩猎场，或在更深的幽暗地域洞窟中捕猎，但同样经常成为更大型生物的食物。

This rubble-filled passage slopes steeply downward. The passage’s ceiling undulates as an echoing chitter fills the air.

The passage leads deeper into the Darklands, but the going isn’t easy. The steep and rocky decline slopes downward for 80 feet before reaching a sheer, 300-foot drop. Several disused natural passages radiate outward from its base, but where these passages might lead is beyond the scope of this adventure.

Hundreds of tiny subterranean bats lair here. They don’t pose a threat to high-level characters, even with their staggering numbers and tendency to swarm around the heads of intruders. The bats sometimes hunt in the Hunting Grounds, or in deeper Darklands caverns, but are just as often food for larger creatures.

I43. Sanctuary.name: I43. 圣域术 I43. Sanctuary
I43. Sanctuary.text:
茂密的真菌丛堵住了这处狭窄的洞穴入口。

这种无害的真菌很容易被推到一旁。它掩盖着一处偏僻的洞窟，里面有一眼小小的淡水泉。这处洞窟是英雄们休息的绝佳地点，因为游荡的怪物会忽略这里。

A thick growth of fungus blocks this narrow cave entrance.

The harmless fungus can easily be pushed aside. It conceals an out-of-the-way cavern with a small spring of fresh water. This cavern makes a perfect place for the heroes to rest, as wandering monsters ignore it.

I44. Digger’s Cavern.name: I44. 挖掘者的洞穴 I44. Digger’s Cavern
I44. Digger’s Cavern.text:
一团乱糟糟的真菌生长在这处近似方形洞窟的中央。一具巨蜥的尸体 леж在真菌之中。

这只巨伞蜥在区域 @UUID[.rclYw8nugZgu0z5Q]{I45} 中勉强从绞索怪手下逃脱，但最终在这片无害的真菌丛中倒下并死去。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[fxYMucI5b2IUoBpw]{地鼠怪}

120 XP

当英雄检查巨蜥或真菌时，整座洞窟开始震动，一只地鼠怪咬穿北侧墙壁钻了进来。这只体型巨大的啮齿类地鼠怪嗅到了死去的巨蜥气味，原本是来吃尸体的，但它对活着的猎物更兴奋。它饥肠辘辘，会战斗到被杀死为止。它会追击逃跑的敌人，但它不喜欢水，因此会放弃追逐任何逃进湖里的人。

A jumble of fungus grows in the center of this roughly square cave. A large lizard’s corpse lies amid the fungus.

The giant frilled lizard barely escaped the roper in area @UUID[.rclYw8nugZgu0z5Q]{I45} but collapsed and died in this harmless fungus patch.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[fxYMucI5b2IUoBpw]{Shuln}

120 XP

When the heroes examine the lizard or the fungus, the entire cavern starts to shake as a shuln chews its way through the north wall. The enormous, rodent-like shuln scented the dead lizard and was coming to eat it, but it’s more excited for living prey. It’s hungry and fights until slain. It pursues foes that run away but doesn’t like the water, so it gives up chasing anyone that flees into the lake.

I45. Dead Roper.name: I45. 死亡的树绳怪 I45. Dead Roper
I45. Dead Roper.text:
这间房间南端的岩石洼地里，有一根粗大的石笋倒在一滩黑色脓液中。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

仔细检查后会发现，这根石笋其实是一只死亡的树绳怪。区域 @UUID[.nhkChhX6MdhDuLQo]{I44} 中的地鼠怪从它下方掘出，咬掉了它下三分之一的身体，但随即觉得味道极其难吃，便把剩余的躯体丢在原地。成功通过一次 @Check[type:nature|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{自然} 或相关的学识检定的英雄会意识到：有一只巨型的掘地野兽从树绳怪下方钻出并咬了它，但那只掘地生物身后的地道已经塌陷，如今无法通行。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A rocky depression at the south end of this chamber contains a thick stalagmite toppled over in a pool of dark ichor.

Exploration

@UUID[.nhkChhX6MdhDuLQo]{I44}

Upon closer inspection, the stalagmite is a dead roper. The shuln in area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate} burrowed up from beneath it and bit off its lower third before deciding its taste was wholly unpleasant and leaving the rest of the body behind. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:nature|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} or relevant Lore check realizes that a Huge burrowing beast came up beneath the roper and bit it, but the burrowing creature’s tunnel has collapsed behind it and is now impassable.

I46. Pudding Wallow.name: I46. 布丁坑 I46. Pudding Wallow
I46. Pudding Wallow.text:
一滩浓稠的黑色黏液覆盖了这座洞穴地面上的一大片区域。

一只黑布丁在被另一名捕食者击败之前，把这个房间里的大部分真菌都剥离得一干二净。它黏稠的残骸在一个浅坑里休息。

A pool of thick black goo coats a large patch of the floor in this cave.

A black pudding stripped most of the fungus in this room clear before it was defeated by another predator. Its gooey remains rest in a shallow pit.

I47. Corrupted Garden.name: I47. 堕落花园 I47. Corrupted Garden
I47. Corrupted Garden.text:
一座古老而摇摇欲坠的石桥横跨水面，通向一座长满恶臭真菌的岛屿。

这座老石桥仍足够稳固，可以安全通过，但桥面覆满黏滑的软泥与潮湿的地衣，使其成为困难地形。岛屿过去曾是一座精心打理的花园，但如今因密集且湿滑的真菌而成为高等困难地形。真菌上滋生的黏泥散发出可怕的气味，但仍被岛上住民的恶臭所掩盖。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[jP8CO6z7bNIhOuqQ]{Ofalth}

60 XP

一只ofalth栖居在岛上。真菌以及其生长其上的污秽层为该生物的粪坑打滚能力提供燃料。它将覆满黏泥的真菌视为困难地形，而非高等困难地形。

An ancient and crumbling stone bridge stretches across the water to an island teeming with reeking fungus.

The old stone bridge is still stable enough to traverse safely, though it’s slick with slime and moist lichen that make it difficult terrain. The island used to be a tended garden, but it’s now greater difficult terrain thanks to the dense, slick fungus. The slime growing on the fungus emits a terrible smell, but one overwhelmed by the stench of the island’s denizen.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[jP8CO6z7bNIhOuqQ]{Ofalth}

60 XP

An ofalth dwells on the island. The fungus and the layer of filth it grows from fuels the creature’s Filth Wallow ability. It treats the slime-covered fungus as difficult terrain rather than greater difficult terrain.

I48. Horrid Carnage.name: I48. 骇人杀戮 I48. Horrid Carnage
I48. Horrid Carnage.text:
骨头与被丢弃的内脏散落在这座洞窟中，仿佛不久前这里刚发生过一场骇人的战斗。一条由这些可怖残骸构成的痕迹蜿蜒向东北方，沿着一条狭窄的隧道向上延伸。

这场屠戮是高基特斯进食的结果。这只啮咬不休、如噩梦般的异怪栖居在区域 @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49}，但它有时会潜伏在通道中伏击猎物。当英雄们接近该区域时，进行一次秘密 @Check[type:flat|dc:15]{Flat} 纯骰检定。成功时，它正从通道里注视着，并已准备好发动袭击。

Bones and discarded viscera are strewn across this cavern as if some horrifying battle recently occurred here. A trail of the gruesome remains winds to the northeast, up a narrow tunnel.

The carnage is the result of gogiteth feeding. The gnashing, nightmarish aberration lairs in area @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49}, but it sometimes lurks in the passageway to ambush prey. When the heroes approach this area, make a secret @Check[type:flat|dc:15]{Flat} check. On a success, it’s watching from the passageway and is prepared to strike.

I49. Gogiteth Cave.name: I49. 高基特斯洞穴 I49. Gogiteth Cave
I49. Gogiteth Cave.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

如果英雄们还没击败在此栖身的高基特斯，当他们靠近时，会听到它移动时腿部发出的咔哒与爆裂声。任何成功通过一次 @Check[type:occultism|dc:30|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} 检定的英雄，都能认出这声音属于一只高基特斯。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[IXen98RbUlbxDWBD]{Gogiteth}

120 XP

如果高基特斯在这里，它正撕扯一具透肌魔人尸体。它会“啪嗒”一声令人作呕地丢下死去的透肌魔人，疾窜向前，扑食英雄。它不会追逐猎物离开 @UUID[.ih4G2q4q9sJ699qR]{I48} 和 @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49} 这些区域。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

If the heroes haven’t already defeated the gogiteth lairing here, as they approach, they hear its clacking and popping legs as it moves about. Any hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:occultism|dc:30|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check recognizes the sound as that of a gogiteth.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[IXen98RbUlbxDWBD]{Gogiteth}

120 XP

If the gogiteth is here, it’s tearing up an urdefhan corpse. It drops the dead urdefhan with a sickening plop to skitter forward and feast upon the heroes. It doesn’t pursue prey out of areas @UUID[.ih4G2q4q9sJ699qR]{I48} and @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49}.

I50. Coins and Slime.name: I50. 钱币与黏液 I50. Coins and Slime
I50. Coins and Slime.text:
成串垂下的霉菌条从这里的天花板上摇曳而下。北侧的一层石架上，有几枚钱币从石头里凸出来。

很久以前，一名旅人把这些钱币塞进墙里，希望能确保它们安全，然而他们再也没有回来。一片绿史莱姆从霉菌条中滋生出来，尤其覆盖在钱币上方——它可以落到贪婪的宝藏寻觅者身上，将其溶解，然后再滑回天花板上，等待下一名受害者。

危害

@Actor[LLPsEKLoVmoPleJS]{绿史莱姆}

8 XP

绿史莱姆藏在垂挂的霉菌之间，很难斑点。它会滴落在任何试图把钱币从石头里拔出来的人身上。

宝藏

地面里只卡着15 sp，而想要撬出每一枚钱币都需要花上几分钟凿刻，或使用塑石术或类似的魔法（这也是这些钱币最初会卡进石头里的原因）。

Hanging streamers of mold dangle from the ceiling here. Several coins protrude from a shelf of stone to the north.

A traveler left the coins in the wall here long ago, hoping to keep them safe, though they never returned. A patch of green slime grew from the streams of mold, particularly over the coins, where it could fall upon greedy treasure-seekers, dissolve them, and slither up the ceiling to await a new victim.

Hazard

@Actor[LLPsEKLoVmoPleJS]{Green Slime}

8 XP

The green slime is hard to spot amid the hanging mold. It drips upon anyone who tries to pull the coins free.

Treasure

There are only 15 sp stuck in the floor, and breaking out each coin requires a few minutes’ chiseling or shape stone or similar magic (which is how the coins got stuck in the stone in the first place).

I51. Ravirex’s Fen.name: I51. 拉维雷克斯的沼泽 I51. Ravirex’s Fen
I51. Ravirex’s Fen.text:
这座巨大的洞窟地面是一片泥沼，长满厚实的真菌与缠绕的藤蔓。几块巨石从泥中突起。

不久前，一条名为拉维雷克斯的黑龙搬进了狩猎场边缘这座沼泽洞窟，把这里当作巢穴。他起初想要用支配术掌控这片区域，但很快就与强大的生物发生冲突，例如区域 @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{I31} 的异虫邪魔、区域 @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49} 的高基特斯，以及那些已被证明难以擒获的卓尔猎手。拉维雷克斯很快意识到在狩猎场里需要更加谨慎；这些日子里，他主要忙于把宽阔洞窟中的生长物塑造成自己喜欢的样子。他傲慢得不屑于考虑防御，自以为狩猎场里其他危险的生物也知道不该去攻击一条龙。

贝科拉前不久现身于拉维雷克斯面前，开启谈判，商议协助对某座地表城市发起攻击——那座城市拉维雷克斯并不知晓；这条龙正等待她下次来访以了解更多。她提到过要把一枚带颜色的魔法透镜托付给拉维雷克斯，因此他一直留意着这些东西，希望借此讨好贝科拉。

有两条通道从此区域通往西侧狂野的幽暗地域区域。南侧通道完全被沼泽水淹没，而北侧通道没有积水，但非常狭窄。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[irrXrWxJ0LYSUCQB]{拉维雷克斯}

80 XP

当拉维雷克斯不在巢穴里塑造真菌，或外出狩猎时，他便在北侧壁龛的宝藏堆上休息。他会凶猛地保卫巢穴，并竭力驱逐入侵者，以维持自己的私密空间。若他得知英雄们持有任何他认为贝科拉想要的魔法透镜，他会把携带者当作目标，并试图夺走它们。

宝藏

@Actor[sgQCxACQTgxm8C1N]{拉维雷克斯的宝藏}

这条龙的宝藏包括260 gp、1,412 sp、4,303 cp、一只价值200 gp的金酒杯、一把+2 强袭硬头锤、一枚铁奖章、一张灵魂冲击卷轴以及一只木乃伊蝙蝠。

A morass of mud sprouting thick fungus and clinging vines makes up the floor of this large cavern. A few boulders protrude from the mud.

Not long ago, a black dragon named Ravirex moved into the swampy cavern at the edge of the Hunting Grounds to make his lair. He initially thought to dominate the area but soon ran afoul of powerful creatures like the derghodaemon in area @UUID[.sJbJvBLnTcfcPRLs]{I31}, the gogiteth in area @UUID[.PUv8ghWFABFTz3ej]{I49}, and the drow hunters who have proven impossible to pin down. Ravirex quickly realized the need to be much more circumspect in the Hunting Grounds, and these days he primarily works on sculpting the growth in his wide cavern to his liking. He’s too arrogant to consider defense, assuming that even the other dangerous creatures of the Hunting Grounds know better than to attack a dragon.

Belcorra appeared to Ravirex a short time ago to open negotiations about aiding an attack on a surface city that Ravirex doesn’t know, and the dragon awaits her next visit to learn more. She mentioned something about entrusting a colored magical lens to Ravirex, so he’s keeping an eye out for those in the hopes of currying favor with Belcorra.

Two passages lead out of this area to wild Darklands areas to the west. Swamp water floods the southern passage entirely, while the northern passage is clear but very narrow.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[irrXrWxJ0LYSUCQB]{Ravirex}

80 XP

While not working to sculpt the fungus in its lair or out hunting, Ravirex rests upon his hoard in the alcove to the north. He defends his lair ferociously and works hard to drive intruders away so he can preserve his privacy. If he learns that the heroes have any of the magic lenses he believes Belcorra wants, he targets the heroes who carry them and tries to take them.

Treasure

@Actor[sgQCxACQTgxm8C1N]{Ravirex's Hoard}

The dragon's hoard consists of 260 gp, 1,412 sp, 4,303 cp, a golden goblet worth 200 gp, a +2 striking mace, an iron medallion, a scroll of spirit blast, and a mummified bat.

I52. Vault Ledge.name: I52. 地窖壁架 I52. Vault Ledge
I52. Vault Ledge.text:
湖水慵懒地拍打着环绕在一处嵌入洞窟墙壁的建筑周围的宽阔石台。石台上长满地衣，宽度几乎仅够站立。仅有一扇铁制、如金库般的门，带有金属把手与钥匙孔，通向这座建筑内部。

贝科拉建造了这座坚固的金库，用来收集她计划用以资助对艾巴萨罗姆进攻的宝藏。在繁茂地衣的遮掩下，石台上还有数个系船钉，用于固定船只。

金库门看起来坚不可摧，但令人惊讶的是并未上锁。金库里唯一拥有智慧的居住者——一名名为卡利多的死墓骑士——最近前往憎恨魔窟的第三等级取回贝科拉想要的几本书，而他返回时疏忽了锁门。

危害

@Actor[neNlIrZOs6zOODoe]{爆炸门闩}

12 XP

金库门并未上锁，但设有陷阱。

The lake’s water laps lazily on a wide stone ledge surrounding a structure built into the cavern wall. The ledge is thick with lichen and barely wide enough to stand on. A single iron, vault-like door with a metal handle and a keyhole leads into the structure.

Belcorra built this secure vault as a place to gather the treasures she planned to use to fund her assault on Absalom. Beneath the profusion of lichen, the ledge holds several cleats for securing boats.

The vault door looks formidable but is, surprisingly, unlocked. The vault’s only intelligent occupant, a graveknight named Caliddo, recently traveled to the third level of the Abomination Vaults to recover some books Belcorra wanted, and he neglected to lock the door when he returned.

Hazard

@Actor[neNlIrZOs6zOODoe]{Blast Tumbler}

12 XP

The vault door isn’t locked but is trapped.

I53. Vault Antechamber.name: I53. 地窖前厅 I53. Vault Antechamber
I53. Vault Antechamber.text:
这个房间里的尘土很厚，只有通往并离开三扇铁门中最南边那扇的脚印除外；那扇门看起来与金库入口相似。

房间南侧有一尊经硬化处理的黏土雕像，被塑造成贝科拉的模样。

每扇门都通向另一处金库。通往区域 @UUID[.uyABiql2hjVpN6UO]{I54} 和 @UUID[.jEIagL8TU2V9x3ST]{I55} 的门都上了锁，而死墓骑士卡利多持有钥匙。锁需要进行六次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:40|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定来以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}打开，并且它们无法被破拆。通往区域 @UUID[.iV9RReXcTyfDbDRq]{I56} 的门未上锁；卡利多去了那里。

遭遇

低威胁 9

@Actor[skz8n8N9GEQY2c90]{黏土魔像}

60 XP

这尊雕像是一具被灌注了使命的黏土魔像，会攻击除贝科拉或卡利多之外的任何生物。它会战斗直到被摧毁，在攻击时其陈旧的黏土发出碾磨声。声音很快会把卡利多也引来参战。他们合在一起，对9级角色来说是一场严重遭遇。

The dust is thick in this room, save for footprints that lead to and from the southernmost of three iron doors, which look similar to the vault’s entrance.

On the south side of the chamber is a hardened clay statue sculpted to resemble Belcorra.

Each door leads to another vault. The doors to areas @UUID[.uyABiql2hjVpN6UO]{I54} and @UUID[.jEIagL8TU2V9x3ST]{I55} are both locked, and Caliddo the graveknight has the keys. The locks require six successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:40|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} to open, and they can’t be Forced Open. The door to area @UUID[.iV9RReXcTyfDbDRq]{I56} is unlocked; this is where Caliddo went.

Encounter

Low 9

@Actor[skz8n8N9GEQY2c90]{Clay Golem}

60 XP

The statue is a clay golem charged with attacking any creature other than Belcorra or Caliddo. It fights until destroyed, its old clay grinding as it attacks. The sound quickly brings Caliddo to fight as well. Together, they’re a Severe encounter for 9th-level characters.

I54. Coin Vault.name: I54. 硬币金库 I54. Coin Vault
I54. Coin Vault.text:
三只铁箱，体型各不相同，沿着这间房间的北墙一字排开。

这些箱子里装着贝科拉生前为援助她对艾巴萨罗姆的进攻而积攒的大量宝藏。

宝藏

@Actor[G5qIaqPrLKK0gwz4]{钱币地窖}

最大的箱子里有8,000 sp，次大的一只装着500 gp。最小的一只里有100 pp。所有这些钱币都是几个世纪前铸造的。

@Actor[G5qIaqPrLKK0gwz4]{Coin Vault}

Three iron chests, all in different sizes, are lined up against the north wall of this room.

The boxes hold a mass of treasure that Belcorra accumulated in life to aid in her assault on Absalom.

Treasure

@Actor[G5qIaqPrLKK0gwz4]{Coin Vault}

The largest box contains 8,000 sp, and the next largest holds 500 gp. The smallest has 100 pp. All these coins were minted centuries ago.

I55. Alchemical Vault.name: I55. 炼金宝库 I55. Alchemical Vault
I55. Alchemical Vault.text:
这扇门即使在解锁后也很难打开，因为内部被一次爆炸扭曲变形。金库内是一团纠缠的古老木料，以及破碎的玻璃与陶器。焦痕在石墙上留下累累伤疤。

贝科拉曾在这座金库中存放了多种炼金炸弹。随着世纪流逝，承放其中一部分炸弹的木制架子坍塌，引发了爆炸的连锁反应，使房间与金库门变成了如今这副模样。这里已不剩任何有价值的东西。

This door is difficult to open, even once unlocked, because the inside has been warped by an explosion. Inside the vault is a tangle of ancient wood and shattered glass and pottery. Scorch marks scar the stone walls.

Belcorra stored a variety of alchemical bombs in this vault. As the centuries passed, the wooden shelves that held some of them collapsed, creating a chain reaction of explosions and leaving the room and its vault door in its current state. Nothing of value remains.

I56. Caliddo’s Vigil.name: I56. 卡利多的警戒 I56. Caliddo’s Vigil
I56. Caliddo’s Vigil.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

这间狭小而空荡的房间里有更多的库门，就像在区域 @UUID[.vV1UI5ww3NEtLe0o]{I53} 中一样；卡利多·哈鲁维克斯也带着这两把钥匙。这里还有一扇隐藏得极其巧妙的秘密门；一名正在搜索此房间的英雄在一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定后，会发现开启它的隐藏开关。

遭遇

低 9

@UUID[Actor.oXnpdJVN6NIE58W3]{Caliddo Haruvex}

60 XP

一名身着古旧护甲的战士站在房间里，紧握着一把巨剑。这便是卡利多·哈鲁维克斯，一名技艺娴熟的佣兵；当他听闻自己那位远房亲戚的力量已变得多么强大时，便前来为贝科拉效力。贝科拉接受了卡利多的援助提议，随即将他杀死，并将他复生为一名永远受束缚、为她效命的死墓骑士。卡利多多次向贝科拉证明了自己的价值与忠诚，因此她委任他守卫她的宝库。他在此沉默守望了数个世纪。

当贝科拉归来时，她派卡利多去取回几本书，不让它们落入可能用来对付她的他人之手。数个世纪以来第一次，卡利多离开了宝库。他从地下城的上层取回了这些文献，并将其锁在区域 @UUID[.ydFyUm2uTgteYviW]{I58} 中。

卡利多仍留守在自己的岗位上，袭击任何进入者。若英雄们没有在区域 @UUID[.vV1UI5ww3NEtLe0o]{I53} 与魔像一同面对他，就会在这里遭遇他。卡利多会战斗直到被摧毁，但除非贝科拉明确命令，他不会离开自己在宝库中的岗位。

卡利多的归来

想要彻底消灭卡利多非常困难，因为他的护甲会将他重建。若英雄们洗劫了宝库后他复生，他会追击他们，试图夺回这些物品。不过，他与这些宝藏并无特殊联系，因此他可能得四处搜寻很久，才能查明英雄们去了哪里。卡利多不太可能谈判，但他最感兴趣的是取回自己的钥匙，并将那些书送回宝库（因为那是贝科拉最后明确表示特别在意的东西，而他也认为那对她来说最有价值）。若英雄们交出钥匙与书籍，或许能避免卡利多的报复，并保住其他宝藏。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

This small, bare room contains more vault doors, just as in area @UUID[.vV1UI5ww3NEtLe0o]{I53}; Caliddo Haruvex carries these two keys as well. There’s also a remarkably well-hidden secret door here; a hero Searching this room discovers the hidden switch to open it with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{Perception} check.

Encounter

Low 9

@UUID[Actor.oXnpdJVN6NIE58W3]{Caliddo Haruvex}

60 XP

A warrior in archaic armor stands in this room, clutching a greatsword. This is Caliddo Haruvex, a skilled mercenary who came to serve Belcorra when he heard how powerful his distant relative had become. Belcorra accepted Caliddo’s offer of aid and promptly killed him, raising him as a graveknight eternally bound to serve her. Caliddo proved his worth and loyalty to Belcorra many times, so she entrusted him with guarding her vault. He kept a silent vigil here for centuries.

When Belcorra returned, she put Caliddo to work fetching several books she wanted out of the hands of others who might use them against her. For the first time in centuries, Caliddo left the vault. He recovered the texts from an upper level of the dungeon and locked them in area @UUID[.ydFyUm2uTgteYviW]{I58}.

Caliddo remains at his post and assaults anyone who enters. If the heroes don’t face him with the golem in area @UUID[.vV1UI5ww3NEtLe0o]{I53}, he’s encountered here. Caliddo fights until destroyed, but he doesn’t leave his post in the vault unless Belcorra expressly orders him to.

Caliddo’s Return

Destroying Caliddo for good proves difficult because his armor rebuilds him. If he rejuvenates after the heroes have plundered the vault, he pursues them in an attempt to recover the items. He doesn’t have any special connection to the treasures, though, so he might have to search around a lot to find out where the heroes went. Caliddo isn’t likely to negotiate, but he’s most interested in reclaiming his keys and returning the books to the vault (as those were the last things Belcorra expressed particular interest in and, he assumes, the most valuable to her). Heroes who turn over the keys and books might avert Caliddo’s retribution and keep the other treasures.

I57. Derelict Armory.name: I57. 废弃军械库 I57. Derelict Armory
I57. Derelict Armory.text:
古老的武器架随着时代推移而倒塌，许多剑、矛与斧头杂乱地堆在地上。

贝科拉在这个房间里为她的战役囤积了数十件武器，打算武装那些在她的攻击中与异怪怪物并肩作战的人形武者。虽然其中大多数武器只是制作精良，但仍有不少确实更为卓越。

宝藏

@Actor[3R2NgS7KzooSqidC]{Derelict Armory}

在这些武器之中有一把标准纯度精金战锤以及一把 +2 强击战斧。一具倒下的护甲架与曾展示其上的 +2 强韧 链甲衫 纠缠在一起。

Ancient weapon racks have collapsed over time, leaving many swords, spears, and axes jumbled on the floor.

Belcorra hoarded dozens of weapons for her campaign in this room, intending to arm the humanoid warriors who fought alongside the aberrant monsters in her attack. While most of the weapons are merely well-made, a number of them are genuinely superior.

Treasure

@Actor[3R2NgS7KzooSqidC]{Derelict Armory}

Amid the weapons are a standard-grade adamantine warhammer and a +2 striking battle axe. A fallen armor stand is tangled up with the +2 resilient chain shirt that was once displayed on it.

I58. Vault of Secrets.name: I58. 秘密宝库 I58. Vault of Secrets
I58. Vault of Secrets.text:
这间房间的书架上摆着几本旧书和各式各样的零碎物件。房间中央有一台布满尘土的铜银机械装置。它缺少镜片，但除此之外看起来像一盏灯笼的骨架，本应安装在灯塔顶端。房间里的尘土最近被扰动过。

这里是贝科拉防护最严密的密库，存放着她的宝藏与关于她过去的秘密。最近被摆上书架的书——从尘土中的痕迹可以看出——是贝科拉生前亲笔写下的研究日志。它们已有数百年之久，但在精心的魔法保存之下并未坠落成碎片。这些日志描述了四枚支点镜片（猩红、乌木、翠绿与赭黄），它们能将宁布洛斯熄灭灵魂的凝视跨越空间与时代聚焦投射。

贝科拉的日志详细记载了她如何建造凄凉灯塔，并创造出一种名为支点晶格的特殊框架，用以安装四枚镜片并驾驭其力量。支点晶格的示意图清楚表明，这件装置正是此处所放置的那一台。贝科拉对使用支点镜片抱有几分忧惧；每一枚都含有一丝宁布洛斯的本质，而将它们彼此靠近可能会很危险。更具体地说，这些镜片会把宁布洛斯的本质灌注进使用者或被其触碰者体内。若同时被灌注四种本质，必将招来宁布洛斯可怖的注视。贝科拉在她袭击艾巴萨罗姆的前夕，让她才华横溢的学徒沃鲁克·阿兹里尼制作了普通镜片，使凄凉灯塔能以削弱的效能运作，直到支点晶格与支点镜片得以安装为止。支点晶格还能让四枚巨大而沉重的镜片被轻松携带。

贝科拉的日志解释道，她只在凄凉灯塔基座的空无之窟中使用了乌木支点镜片，认为单一支点镜片中所含的本质风险最小。她把其余镜片交给下层密库中她信任的团体：将翠绿镜片交给透肌魔人，将赭黄镜片交给卓尔，而把猩红镜片藏在她的不死侏儒爪牙能够保护的地方。她确信这些团体不会彼此合作，更别提了解到：若将这些镜片汇聚，使一名生物被灌注宁布洛斯本质的四枚碎片，将会带来彻底湮灭。

XP 奖励

英雄们揭开支点镜片的传说并得知如何摧毁贝科拉后，奖励他们 80 XP。

其他书籍

其他书籍都是装满异能知识的古旧巨著；它们在哈鲁维克斯家族中传承了数代。书中蕴含关于幽灵（特征）、宁布洛斯以及哈鲁维克斯家族的大量异能传闻。一名英雄若至少花 1 小时翻阅这些巨著，在此处使用调查（探索行动）时，对这些主题进行回忆知识检定获得 +2 物品加值。

宝藏

@Actor[xEJHglwTvuHoI9vG]{秘密宝库}

贝科拉在此保存了许多贵重物品，包括一把骷髅造型的钥匙（价值 30 gp），可开启宁布洛斯之门（区域 @UUID[.0UMcuMR7KSoCWHkz]{I60}）的门扉；以及两枚印戒，每一枚都刻着“触手缠绕骷髅、口中塞满苔藓”的符号。其中一枚是谎言戒指，另一枚则具有高等异能吊坠的功能。

支点晶格也在此处，而且以其体型而言轻得出奇。若英雄们至今已找到任何支点镜片，它们都能严丝合缝地嵌入晶格之中，而晶格也不会因其重量而变得更重。

The shelves of this room contain several old books and various odds and ends. In the center of the room is a dusty mechanism of copper and silver. It’s missing its lenses but otherwise looks like the framework of a lantern that belongs in the top of a lighthouse. The dust in this room has been recently disturbed.

This is Belcorra’s most protected vault, holding her treasures and secrets of her past. The books that have been most recently shelved here—as evidenced by the trails in the dust—are research journals Belcorra penned when she was alive. They’re centuries old, but careful magical preservation has kept them from falling apart. These journals describe four fulcrum lenses (in crimson, ebon, emerald, and ochre) that focus Nhimbaloth’s soul-extinguishing gaze across space and time.

Belcorra’s journal details how she built Gauntlight and created a special framework called the Fulcrum Lattice to fit the four lenses and harness their power. A diagram of the Fulcrum Lattice makes it clear that the device is the very one sitting here. Belcorra expresses some trepidation at using the fulcrum lenses; they each contain a sliver of Nhimbaloth’s essence, and bringing them in close proximity can be dangerous. More specifically, the lenses impart Nhimbaloth’s essence into those who use or are touched by them. Having all four essences imbued at once is sure to bring Nhimbaloth’s dreadful scrutiny. Belcorra had her talented apprentice, Volluk Azrinae, fashion mundane lenses that would allow Gauntlight to function at a diminished capacity until the Fulcrum Lattice and the fulcrum lenses could be installed, on the eve of Belcorra’s assault on Absalom. The Fulcrum Lattice allows all four of the large, heavy lenses to be carried with ease.

Belcorra’s journals explain that she used only the Ebon Fulcrum Lens in the Empty Vault at Gauntlight’s base, deeming the essence within one fulcrum lens a minimal risk. She gave the other lenses to trusted groups in the lower vaults: the emerald lens to the urdefhans, the ochre lens to the drow, and the crimson lens hidden where her undead gnome minions could protect it. She trusts that the groups won’t work together, much less learn that bringing the lenses together to imbue a single creature with all four splinters of Nhimbaloth’s essence would impart total annihilation.

XP Award

Award the heroes 80 XP for uncovering the lore of the fulcrum lenses and learning how to destroy Belcorra.

Other Books

The other books are aging tomes full of occult knowledge; they’ve been in the Haruvex family for generations. They hold a wealth of occult lore about ghosts, Nhimbaloth, and the Haruvexes. A hero who peruses these tomes for at least an hour gains a +2 item bonus on checks to Recall Knowledge on these subjects when using the Investigate exploration activity here.

Treasure

@Actor[xEJHglwTvuHoI9vG]{Vault of Secrets}

Belcorra keeps many valuables here, including a skull-shaped key worth 30 gp that unlocks the doors to the Gate of Nhimbaloth (area @UUID[.0UMcuMR7KSoCWHkz]{I60}) and two signet rings that each bear the symbol of a tentacle wrapped around a skull with a moss-filled mouth. One is a ring of lies, and the other functions as a greater pendant of the occult.

The Fulcrum Lattice is also here, and it’s surprisingly lightweight for its size. If the heroes have discovered any fulcrum lenses so far, they fit neatly into the lattice, and the lattice grows no heavier for their weight.

I59. Level 9 Portal Chamber.name: I59. 等级 9 传送门房间 I59. Level 9 Portal Chamber
I59. Level 9 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的部分 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} 构成了一个更大型网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，有人可以将任意一间这类房间中的所有人传送至憎恨魔窟内另外九间传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地中的传送法阵都已通过 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal}仪式唤醒（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九间房间分别为区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}，以及 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

布满银色的螺旋符文覆盖着这间房室的弧形墙壁。同样的银色金属也覆盖着地面与天花板。

此处还有另一座未激活的传送法阵，英雄们可以借助唤醒传送门仪式将其与憎恨魔窟中的其他传送法阵连接起来。

XP 奖励

若英雄们使用唤醒传送门仪式重新激活此处的传送法阵，奖励他们 30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

Spiraling runes filled with silver cover this chamber’s curved walls. The same silvery metal covers the floor and ceiling.

This room contains another inactive teleportation circle that the heroes might connect to others in the Abomination Vaults with the Awaken Portal ritual.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for using the awaken portal ritual to reactivate the teleportation circle here.

I60. Ebon Doors.name: I60. 乌木之门 I60. Ebon Doors
I60. Ebon Doors.text:
这扇巨大的双开门由黑色和绿色的石头制成。一个氧化的青铜锁带有钥匙孔，但没有把手。

这扇门通往一处名为宁布洛斯之门的建筑——一座古老的神殿，由黑石砌成，其上布满带着令人作呕的绿意的条纹。贝科拉并未建造此地；她发现了它，并将其纳入自己不断扩张的地城之中。宁布洛斯之门究竟一直存在于地下，还是曾从地表被打落至此，仍是个谜；曾经居住于此的邪教徒亦同样成谜。无论如何，它的入口如今已与憎恨魔窟的石体无缝衔接。宁布洛斯之门不仅包括其后的房间，也包括大部分下层等级。

这扇门的古老锁具极其复杂。要@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}需要进行六次成功的@Check[type:thievery|dc:40|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定，而且这扇门完全无法被破拆。位于区域@UUID[.ydFyUm2uTgteYviW]{I58}的骷髅形钥匙可以打开这扇门。当门被打开时，钥匙上的雕刻会发生变化，显示出苔藓从骷髅的口中萌生。

These massive double doors are made of black and green stone. An oxidized bronze lock has a keyhole but no handles.

This door leads to a structure called the Gate of Nhimbaloth, an ancient temple made of black stone streaked with a greenish, nauseating hue. Belcorra didn’t build this place; she found it and incorporated it into her ever-expanding dungeon. Whether the Gate of Nhimbaloth always existed underground or was once cast down from the surface is a mystery, as are the cultists who once inhabited it. In any case, its entry is now seamless with the stone of the Abomination Vaults. The Gate of Nhimbaloth includes not only the rooms beyond it, but most of the lower level as well.

The door’s ancient lock is incredibly complex. Six successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:40|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks are required to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}, and the door can’t be Forced Open at all. The skull-shaped key located in area @UUID[.ydFyUm2uTgteYviW]{I58} opens this door. When it does, the key’s carving changes to show moss sprouting from the skull’s mouth.

I61. Hall of Priests.name: I61. 祭司大厅 I61. Hall of Priests
I61. Hall of Priests.text:
这间巨大的厅室由与北面那两扇威严的乌黑大门相同的黑色石材建成。东、西两侧墙壁各有四个壁龛，共八个。每个壁龛里都残留着玉色雕像的遗骸。所有雕像都被亵渎：没有一尊还留着头，大多数缺了手，其中一尊只剩下一双赤裸的脚立在基座上。与黑门相对的圆顶厅室里，矗立着一座由沉重石块凿刻而成的巨大石王座。

早在贝科拉的时代之前，这里曾是宁布洛斯某个教团的半公开礼拜区域。寻求复仇、敌人的湮灭，或希望失去的挚爱能以幽灵（特征）之身归来的祈求者，会在王座以及坐在其上的生物周围留下供品与祭品——那名生物被称为女士的耳语——而那生物至今仍坐在那里。追随者希望那具披覆阴影的骷髅（特征）会起身，带领他们穿过三道门之一，接受考验以成为教团的新入会者。女士的耳语有时会静止数年不动，也有时会连续数日不断引领新的教徒。尽管即使是资深教徒也从未理解女士的耳语与宁布洛斯之间的联系，但无人质疑这具骷髅（特征）作为通往教团成员资格之门径的职责。

然而，教徒们确实知道：只有那些被女士的耳语引领进入东方之门的人，才会加入教团。西侧的门通向可怖的命运，那是为那些连接受入团测试都不配的人所预留的结局。

女士的耳语是一种独特的不死生物，与为 @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.pkNWilK2pHZ5TDsd]{Lesser Deaths}效力的 @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.mGr4e6fH3w8ewcSX]{Grim Reaper}有着遥远的亲缘关系。由于久远到已不可考的原因，这个骷髅（特征）生物与宁布洛斯牢不可破地绑定在一起。它知道英雄们来此是为了面对贝科拉，且并不适合加入如今已不存在的教团，但它仍决定让他们接受入会试炼，期望借此削弱并杀死他们。女士的耳语能够命令宁布洛斯之门内众多恐怖鬼火的效忠，但当英雄们初来此处时，这里并没有恐怖鬼火为它防卫，因此它会谨慎地应对英雄。

女士的耳语起身，双手平举，做出求和的手势。随后它指向东方之门，并以低语逐一说出每位英雄的名字。它迈步走向东方之门，示意英雄跟随。

遭遇

中等 9

@Actor[dWOK0nzGWyc5NkNz]{女士的耳语}

80 XP

如果英雄攻击，女士的耳语会用利爪猛然反击，将英雄传送离开，最好传送进相邻的厅室，那些地方有危险的恐怖鬼火与陷阱。若它受到超过50点伤害便会逃离，但在撤退时会试图把英雄引诱得更深入宁布洛斯之门。

This large chamber is made of the same black stone as the imposing ebon doors to the north. Eight alcoves, four on each side, line the east and west walls. Each alcove contains the remains of jade-colored statues. All of the figures have been defiled; none have any heads remaining, most are missing hands, and one is just a pair of bare feet upon a pedestal. An enormous stone throne carved out of heavy blocks stands in a domed chamber opposite the black doors.

Well before Belcorra’s time, this served as a semipublic area of worship for a cult of Nhimbaloth. Those seeking vengeance, an enemy’s obliteration, or assurance that a lost loved one would return as a ghost left offerings and sacrifices around the throne and the creature sitting on it, who was called Lady’s Whisper—the creature that sits there still. Aspirants hoped the shrouded skeleton would rise and lead them through one of the three doorways to take the tests to become an initiate in the cult. Lady’s Whisper sometimes remained still for years, or ushered in new cultists for days on end. Although even the senior cultists never understood the connection between Lady’s Whisper and Nhimbaloth, none questioned the skeleton’s role as gateway to cult membership.

The cultists did know, however, that only those Lady’s Whisper ushered into the eastern door would join the cult. The western doors lead to grim fates reserved for those unworthy to even be tested for admittance to the cult.

Lady’s Whisper is a unique undead creature distantly related to the @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.pkNWilK2pHZ5TDsd]{Lesser Deaths} that serve the @Compendium[pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.mGr4e6fH3w8ewcSX]{Grim Reaper}. For reasons long lost, the skeletal creature is irrevocably tied to Nhimbaloth. It knows that the heroes are here to face Belcorra and are ill-suited to join the now-nonexistent cult, but it decides to put them through the initiation trials anyway in the hopes of weakening and killing them. Lady’s Whisper commands the allegiance of the many dread wisps within the Gate of Nhimbaloth, but there are none here to defend it when the heroes first arrive, so it deals with the heroes cautiously.

Lady’s Whisper rises and holds forth both hands, gesturing for peace. It then points to the eastern door and whispers the names of each hero, one by one. It steps toward the eastern door, gesturing for the heroes to follow.

Encounter

Moderate 9

@Actor[dWOK0nzGWyc5NkNz]{Lady's Whisper}

80 XP

If the heroes attack, Lady’s Whisper lashes out with its claws to teleport heroes away, preferably into the adjacent chambers with dangerous wisps and traps. It flees if it takes more than 50 points of damage but tries to lure the heroes deeper into the Gate of Nhimbaloth as it does.

I62. Oblivion Fall.name: I62. 遗忘坠落 I62. Oblivion Fall
I62. Oblivion Fall.text:
由与神殿其余部分相同的暗色石材构成，这条通道通向一间长方形厅室。

危害

@Actor[xkqjwu1ox0pQLOnb]{无底深坑}

8 XP

走廊尽头的厅室没有地板。那里是一个无底深坑，与《核心规则书》中的危害不同，它没有活板门；尽管如此，由于它嵌在反光的黑色石材之中，仍然很难注意到。女士的耳语会把它判定为对宁布洛斯事业无用的候选者引到这个深坑里——必要时会强行将其推入。

Made of the same dark stone as the rest of the temple, this passage opens into a rectangular chamber.

Hazard

@Actor[xkqjwu1ox0pQLOnb]{Bottomless Pit}

8 XP

The chamber at the end of the hall has no floor. It’s a bottomless pit that, unlike the hazard in the Core Rulebook, has no trapdoor; nevertheless, because it’s set into reflective black stone, it’s still difficult to notice. Lady’s Whisper led aspirants whom it judged to be useless to Nhimbaloth’s cause into this pit—forcefully, when necessary.

I63. Garden of Failures.name: I63. 失败之园 I63. Garden of Failures
I63. Garden of Failures.text:
一条黑石通道通向这间八角形的厅室。房间里长满了散发恶臭的沼泽杂草。

那些进入宁布洛斯之门，却在内心深处因恐惧而不敢接受下方入会考验的生物，都会被带到这里。通常，女士的耳语会用安慰的话语告诉他们，他们只要简单地休息一下便可安然离去，但这只是说谎——生物被带到这里是为了被杀死，他们的鲜血与精粹将被用来滋养洞窟那座无日之园。

遭遇

微不足道 9

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{恐怖鬼火}

一只恐怖鬼火漂浮在这间房间里，渴望在许许多多年后第一次进食。

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{Dread Wisp}

A black-stoned passage opens into this octagonal chamber. The room is a riot of foul-smelling swamp weeds.

Creatures who made it into the Gate of Nhimbaloth but were, in their hearts, too afraid to undertake the initiation tests below were brought here. Often, Lady’s Whisper gave them comforting words about how they could simply rest and depart in peace, but this was a lie—creatures were brought here to be killed, their blood and essence used to fuel the cavern’s sunless garden.

Encounter

Trivial 9

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{Dread Wisp}

A single dread wisp floats in this room, desperate to feed for the first time in many, many years.

I64. Initiates’ Chamber.name: I64. 入会者之厅 I64. Initiates’ Chamber
I64. Initiates’ Chamber.text:
这间房间的墙壁由黑色石头雕凿而成，并设有四个大型壁龛，东侧两个，西侧两个。其中三个壁龛里有装满芦苇、苔藓和其他沼泽植物的大型石盆。第四个壁龛里的石盆是空的。楼梯向北通向下方。

楼梯通向下方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01}。

遭遇

严重 9

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{恐怖鬼火（3）}

120 XP

三只恐怖鬼火悬浮在此处三只石盆的上方（第四只曾驻守于此的恐怖鬼火很久以前就被杀死了，而它的石盆如今只剩干枯的土壤）。如果英雄们有女士的耳语陪同，两只恐怖鬼火会在远处跟随它和英雄们，随时准备在英雄们变得暴力时介入。若英雄们没有与女士的耳语同行，恐怖鬼火就会攻击。

The walls of this room are carved from black stone and feature four large alcoves, two to the east and two to the west. Three contain large stone basins filled with reeds, moss, and other swamp plants. The basin in the fourth alcove is empty. Stairs lead downward to the north.

The stairs lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.GZNjyAZgRDgPx68z]{J01}.

Encounter

Severe 9

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{Dread Wisps (3)}

120 XP

Three dread wisps hover here over three of the stone basins (the fourth dread wisp once stationed here was slain long ago, and its basin now contains only desiccated soil). If the heroes are accompanied by Lady’s Whisper, two of the dread wisps follow it and the heroes at a distance, ready to intervene if the heroes become violent. If the heroes aren’t with Lady’s Whisper, the dread wisps attack.

Chapter 9: On The Hunt.name: 第9章：狩猎中 Chapter 9: On The Hunt
Chapter 9: On The Hunt.text:
章节概要

狩猎场里有好斗的透肌魔人、排外的卓尔，以及本《冒险路径》中英雄们将面对的一些最强大的怪物。对英雄们而言，了解支点镜片至关重要，例如可从卓尔夸拉处得知。

狩猎场

任何幽暗地域的探险者都能告诉你：你下潜得越深，事物就越狂野、越怪诞。随着贝科拉将憎恨魔窟向更深处挖掘，她发现了一套规模庞大的洞窟系统。与自成一体的农场等级不同，这些洞窟真正野性未驯。起初，她与凶猛的住民作战，并试图封闭通往更深处的通道，但这项任务终归徒劳。她将此地命名为狩猎场，并基本放任不管，只在此地的各个社群之间建立同盟。贝科拉仅在该区域建立了少数据点，包括一座小屋、一处地窖，以及宁布洛斯之门的入口——那座地下神殿容纳着空无之窟，也是凄凉灯塔力量的源头。

环境线索：

霉菌、回荡的咆哮、片状湿滑黏液、粗糙的石壁、奇怪的足迹。

特征

狩猎场内众多相互连通的洞窟一片昏暗，但发光真菌照亮了足够多的区域，使人能感受到洞窟的巨大规模。天花板高度差异很大：大型洞窟高40英尺，小型洞窟高20英尺，而经由改造以供类人生物居住的区域——例如伊尔达里斯、卡利尼人的小屋以及宁布洛斯之门——高12英尺。大多数区域的门由石头或坚固的菌木制成。有人居住的区域入口通常更厚，或以其他方式加固以用于防御。

Chapter Synopsis

The Hunting Grounds contains aggressive urdefhans, insular drow, and some of the most powerful monsters the heroes face in this Adventure Path. It’s key for the heroes to learn about the fulcrum lenses, such as from the drow Quara.

The Hunting Grounds

As any explorer of the Darklands can tell you, the farther you descend, the wilder and stranger things become. As Belcorra dug the Abomination Vaults deeper, she found an extensive system of caverns. Unlike the self-contained Farm level, these caverns were truly wild. At first, she fought against the fierce denizens and tried to close off the passages to deeper places, but the task was futile. She dubbed the place the Hunting Grounds and left it mostly alone, save for building alliances with the communities there. Belcorra established only a few strongholds in the area, including a lodge, a vault, and the entrance to the Gate of Nhimbaloth, the subterranean temple holding the Empty Vault and the source of Gauntlight’s power.

Environmental Cues:

Mold, echoing roars, patches of slick slime, rough stone walls, strange tracks.

Features

The numerous interconnecting caverns in the Hunting Grounds are dark, but glowing fungus illuminates enough areas to provide a sense of the caverns’ great size. Ceiling height varies widely: large caverns are 40 feet high, smaller caverns are 20 feet high, and areas worked for humanoid habitation—such as Yldaris, the calignis’ lodge, and the Gate of Nhimbaloth—are 12 feet high. Doors in most areas are made of stone or sturdy fungal wood. Entrances to inhabited areas are often thicker or otherwise reinforced for defense.

Belcorra's Return.name: 贝科拉的归来 Belcorra's Return
Belcorra's Return.text:
堕落之前

狩猎场的两个派系曾在贝科拉权势巅峰时为她效力。自她归来后，她已采取措施来重申他们对她的效忠——但她最初又是如何赢得他们的效忠的呢？

透肌魔人邪教

透肌魔人是类吸血鬼的人形生物，基本上追求暴力与屠杀的人生。作为残忍的杀手，他们痴迷于终结生命与存在本身；那些经常从洞穴中现身、突袭狩猎场洞窟与湖泊的透肌魔人，正是贝科拉在她的战役中所需要的那种士兵。她发动了一次精心策划、势不可挡的攻击来震慑透肌魔人；当那名术士要求会谈时，透肌魔人的战争勇士听取了她的意见。贝科拉宣誓透肌魔人将成为她最终对地表发动攻击时的先锋，并将翡翠支点镜片交给战争勇士，作为在那之前她恩宠的信物。数代过去，战争勇士们将这枚支点镜片代代相传，作为他们领导地位的象征。

卓尔的效忠

在深地侏儒被她震慑、透肌魔人为她的力量所折服之后，贝科拉接着将目光转向狩猎场的卓尔。卓尔从伊尔达里斯那座坚固的堡垒出发，像致命的幻影般游弋于洞窟之中，并在面对重大危险时撤退。贝科拉知道自己必须将卓尔逼入同盟，于是她捕获并囚禁了越来越多的卓尔猎人，直到伊尔达里斯的领袖同意与她会面。她用俘虏交换卓尔的承诺：卓尔将妥善保管赭石支点镜片，并在她对地表的攻击中提供援助。

誓约重申

当贝科拉以幽灵（特征）之身复起时，她首先造访了狩猎场。她检查了自己的宝藏宝库，以确保其中最重要的内容仍然安全无虞，随后派遣宝库的 @UUID[Actor.oXnpdJVN6NIE58W3]{Graveknight} 守卫去取回她留在更高等级上的珍贵书籍。接着她造访透肌魔人；他们仍在讲述关于那位近乎神话般的术士的模糊传说。他们的新战争勇士 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5s8hYZ6UPLJW5dtd]{Khurfel} 携带着翡翠支点镜片，并同意追随他们的幽灵女王去焚毁地表世界。此后，透肌魔人加紧了召唤天罚魔盟友的行动，为迫在眉睫的进攻做准备。

贝科拉对伊尔达里斯的卓尔的造访则不那么顺利。@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.PMfMv2GzieXiY1Oo]{Quara Orshendiel}——当年贝科拉从其祖父那里榨取出效力承诺的那位领袖的孙女——几乎不知道贝科拉是谁。尽管如此，贝科拉仍然接受了库娅拉仓促给出的（且并非完全真诚的）对其祖父誓约的重申。

Before the Fall

Two of the factions of the Hunting Grounds once served Belcorra at the height of her power. Since her return, she has taken measures to renew their allegiance to her- but how did she earn it to begin with?

The Urdefhan Cult

Urdefhans are vampire-like humanoids who largely pursue lives of violence and slaughter. As brutal killers obsessed with ending life and existence itself, the urdefhans who regularly emerged from their caves to raid the caverns and lake of the Hunting Grounds were precisely the kind of soldiers Belcorra needed for her campaign.
