She made a calculated, overwhelming attack to awe the urdefhans, and when the sorcerer called for a parley, the urdefhan war champion listened. Belcorra swore the urdefhans would be the vanguard of her eventual assault on the surface and gave the Emerald Fulcrum Lens to the war champion as a token of her favor until then. Generations passed, and the war champions passed down the fulcrum lens as their symbol of leadership.

Drow Allegiance

With the deep gnomes cowed and the urdefhans awed by her power, Belcorra next turned to the drow of the Hunting Grounds. From their secure stronghold of Yldaris, the drow ranged through the caverns like deadly apparitions, retreating in the face of significant danger. Belcorra knew that she must trap the drow into an alliance, so she captured and imprisoned more and more of their hunters until Yldaris’s leader agreed to meet with her. She traded the captives for a promise that the drow would keep the Ochre Fulcrum Lens safe and provide aid in her attack on the surface.

Oaths Renewed

When Belcorra arose as a ghost, she visited the Hunting Grounds first. She checked her treasure vault to ensure its most important contents remained secure and then sent the vault’s @UUID[Actor.oXnpdJVN6NIE58W3]{Graveknight} guardian to retrieve the valuable books she’d left on an upper level. She next visited the urdefhans, who still told vague legends of the quasi-mythical sorcerer. Their new war champion, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5s8hYZ6UPLJW5dtd]{Khurfel}, carried the Emerald Fulcrum Lens and agreed to follow their Ghost Queen to raze the surface world. The urdefhans have since stepped up their summoning of daemon allies, preparing for the pending assault.

Belcorra’s visit to the drow of Yldaris went less well. @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.PMfMv2GzieXiY1Oo]{Quara Orshendiel}, the granddaughter of the leader from whom Belcorra extracted a promise to serve, had little idea who Belcorra was. Still, Belcorra nevertheless accepted Quara’s hastily-given (and not entirely genuine) renewal of her grandfather’s promise.

A Cavern Vast.name: 广袤洞窟 A Cavern Vast
A Cavern Vast.text:
狩猎场的大部分是由岩层构造、水晶生长、矿物温泉以及大片高耸真菌构成的荒野。其居住者并不总是在各自的遭遇区域中出现。每当英雄们花费15分钟穿越洞窟时，进行一次秘密的 @Check[type:flat|dc:5]{纯骰检定}。若成功，他们将面对以下随机遭遇之一。

H01. Overgrown Stairs.name: H01. 杂草丛生的楼梯 H01. Overgrown Stairs
H01. Overgrown Stairs.text:
腐烂与霉变的气味弥漫在这段封闭的楼梯间里。在底部，一层潮湿的真菌、黏液与霉菌地毯厚厚地长在墙上。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

通道的西侧墙壁上有一扇暗门，通向凄凉灯塔的轮廓（区域 @UUID[.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}）。这扇门被魔法上锁，无法被破坏打开。英雄以一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定发现门那淡淡的轮廓。门上有一个凹陷的凹槽，只有用支点透镜触碰时才会打开。

The smell of rot and mildew pervades the air of this enclosed staircase. At the base, a moist carpet of fungus, slime, and mold grows thickly on the walls.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

The western wall of the passage contains a secret door leading into Gauntlight’s footprint (area @UUID[.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}) that’s magically locked and can’t be broken open. A hero spots the door’s faint outline with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. It has a concave indentation, and it only opens when touched with a fulcrum lens.

H02. Hall of Eyes.name: H02. 眼之厅 H02. Hall of Eyes
H02. Hall of Eyes.text:
六个壁龛沿着墙壁排列，北边三个、南边三个。最东侧的四个壁龛中各有一个大型石制种植盆，里面装满散发着阴郁沼泽般恶臭的泥水。东门附近地面上有两处焦痕，围着几堆黑色破布。其中一堆破布下露出一把刀刃的剑柄。

这些水盆被魔法连接到下方很深处的神殿楼层的沼泽（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15}）。它们始终装满沼泽之水，而这里的鬼火可以利用它们向贝科拉传送影像。

这些焦痕和破布是两名卡利格尼在与本房间的住民冲突后留下的残骸。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{鬼火（4）}

80 XP

每个水盆上方都悬浮着一只鬼火，尽管起初它们看起来不过是装饰性的灯光。它们会以心灵感应汇报英雄的动作，直到它们受到攻击，或直到英雄试图离开这间房室。到那时，鬼火便会立刻行动起来，并战斗至被摧毁为止。

当微灵被揭示为生物后，只需运行 @Macro[C3op8ZzoCDxheaO0]{H02 - Wisp Reveal} 宏即可让它们可见，同时隐藏场景的环境光源。

贝科拉应在这场遭遇后不久的某个时刻攻击英雄（见第148页旁栏）。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.w5ZX1R3dPvuLcuRx]{Gloom Blade}

其中一堆破布里有一把幽暗之刃。

Six alcoves line the walls, three to the north and three to the south. The four easternmost alcoves each contain a large stone planter filled with muddy water that reeks like a dismal swamp. Two scorch marks on the ground near the eastern door surround piles of dark rags. The pommel of a blade peeks out from underneath one of the rag piles.

The basins are magically connected to the swamp in the Temple level far below (area @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.1Ov1191GpaTDBaAE]{J15}). They remain filled with the swamp’s waters, and the will-o’-wisps here can use them to transmit images to Belcorra.

The scorch marks and rags are the remains of two calignis who ran afoul of this room’s denizens.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[wRQ7TZdd0n5UIIao]{Will-o'-Wisps (4)}

80 XP

A will-o’-wisp hovers over each basin, although they appear at first to be merely decorative lights. They telepathically report on the heroes’ actions until they’re attacked or until the heroes try to leave this chamber. At that point, the will-o’-wisps spring into action and fight until destroyed.

Once the wisps are revealed to be creatures, simply run the @Macro[C3op8ZzoCDxheaO0]{H02 - Wisp Reveal} macro to make them visible, while hiding the scene's ambient lights.

Belcorra should attack the heroes (see the sidebar on page 148) sometime shortly after this encounter.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.w5ZX1R3dPvuLcuRx]{Gloom Blade}

One rag pile has a gloom blade in it.

H03. Hazy Shrine.name: H03. 朦胧神殿 H03. Hazy Shrine
H03. Hazy Shrine.text:
任何靠近这间房间任一扇门的人，都能闻到一种不寻常的气味，仿佛燃烧的真菌。

一团带着刺鼻却并非完全令人不快的气味的烟雾，从东方高台上、一张炭床之上的巨大铜锅中袅袅升起。盆口上方的金属架上放着数枚棕色与紫色的卵，每枚约有人类头颅大小，正在烟雾中熏煮。墙壁上绘着大幅的线条与旋涡状花纹。

数个世纪前，贝科拉打造了这些房间，既作为宁布洛斯的圣所，也作为研究岛上洞窟（区域 @UUID[.f02YPQGkiBbZ0Ijt]{H12}）奇异幻视效果的基地。乌塔古尔教团的夜爪族如今将此处用于祈祷与冥想，并烹煮他们从湖中采集来的甲伏怪卵。眼下正在烹煮的这些，是教团目前卵储备的最后一批。

遭遇

低 8

@Actor[gWxpeqOQ54Jd4HTG]{夜爪族潜行者（6）}

60 XP

六名夜爪族在此冥想，若被打扰便会攻击。他们相信自己的死之白焰能强化乌塔古尔，因此会顽强战斗至死。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

通往下层小屋的暗门隐藏在西墙所绘的抽象图案之中。夜爪族知晓这扇暗门，但不愿透露。成功进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定后，在此房间进行搜索的英雄便能找到这扇门及用于开启它的隐藏把手。门的另一侧有明显的闩锁机构，并未隐藏。

An unusual scent, as of burning fungus, is apparent to anyone approaching any of the doors to this chamber.

A haze of smoke with a pungent but not entirely unpleasant scent emanates from a large copper cauldron atop a bed of coals on a dais to the east. A metal rack over the basin holds several brown and purple eggs, each about the size of a human head, cooking in the smoke. The walls are painted with sweeping lines and whorls.

Belcorra crafted these chambers centuries ago as both a shrine to Nhimbaloth and as a base to study the strange visionary effects of the island caves (area @UUID[.f02YPQGkiBbZ0Ijt]{H12}). Calignis of the Cult of Urthagul now use this room for prayer and meditation and to cook the chuul eggs they harvest from the lake. The ones being cooked now are the last of the cult’s current store of eggs.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[gWxpeqOQ54Jd4HTG]{Caligni Stalkers (6)}

60 XP

Six calignis meditate here and attack if disturbed. They believes their death flames empower Urthagul, so they fight tenaciously to the death.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A secret door to the lodge on the lower level is hidden amid the abstract patterns painted on the west wall. The calignis know about the secret door but are reluctant to reveal it. A hero Searching this room finds the door and the hidden knob to open it with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. The door’s other side has an obvious latch mechanism that isn’t hidden.

H04. Storage.name: H04. 储藏室 H04. Storage
H04. Storage.text:
这个方形房间里堆满了杂乱的敞开箱子、木桶、火把捆，以及微微发光的植物。

这个储藏室之所以如此混乱，是因为黑暗侏儒多年来随手把补给扔在这里。植物是生物发光的芦苇，被采收后仍能保持发光数周，并在此处提供昏暗光照。大多数木桶里装着黑暗侏儒偏爱的肉质干蘑菇，不过它们粗糙的口感让其他生物几乎无法下咽。

宝藏

@Item[GHomhFNgseTb75OX]{美丽的紫水晶（3）}

一名英雄在这个房间内进行搜索时，会发现三颗紫水晶，每颗价值20 gp。

@Item[GHomhFNgseTb75OX]{Beautiful Amethysts (3)}

This square chamber is filled with a jumble of open boxes, casks, bundles of torches, and faintly glowing plants.

This storage chamber is a mess because calignis have haphazardly thrown supplies in here over the years. The plants are bioluminescent reeds that retain their glow for weeks after being harvested, and they provide dim light here. Most casks contain the meaty, dried mushrooms calignis favor, although their gritty taste makes them practically inedible to other creatures.

Treasure

@Item[GHomhFNgseTb75OX]{Beautiful Amethysts (3)}

A hero Searching through this room uncovers three amethyst worth 20 gp each.

H05. Cult Barracks.name: H05. 教团兵营 H05. Cult Barracks
H05. Cult Barracks.text:
这间灰暗的房间里有几卷铺盖和一只箱子，箱子上放着几个陶土马克杯。一张书桌上堆着成摞的纸张。

乌塔古尔教团的普通成员都睡在这里的八卷铺盖上。这些铺盖里没有任何值得注意的东西。

卡利格尼地图

一些教团成员正在绘制憎恨魔窟的地图，希望能找到一条绕过微灵、再次抵达乌塔古尔的捷径。他们的地图放在书桌上。他们已经绘出了区域 @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} 到 @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14}，并在区域 @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13} 与 @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14} 之间的水域里画了几个类似龙虾的形状来代表甲伏怪。区域 @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} 和 @UUID[.tXdibKRkxLO9wGnz]{H10} 中几个愤怒的球状图形代表新的微灵。他们还绘出了区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.g1OFd8Mt0UAghDjX]{I22} 到 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.eR8zzQKxdR0jU0zH]{I26} 以及连接其间的楼梯。区域 @UUID[.LyqYciAwy0l9vyed]{H08} 的暗门没有标注在上面。

This drab chamber contains a few bedrolls and a box with several earthen mugs atop it. A desk holds stacks of paper.

Rank-and-file members of the Cult of Urthagul all sleep in the eight bedrolls here. The bedrolls contain nothing of interest.

Caligni Map

Some cult members are mapping the Abomination Vaults, in the hopes of finding an easy way around the wisps to reach Urthagul again. Their map is on the desk. They’ve mapped out areas @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} to @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14} and drawn several lobster-like shapes in the water between areas @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13} and @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14} to represent the chuuls. Several angry ball-like shapes in areas @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} and @UUID[.tXdibKRkxLO9wGnz]{H10} represent the new wisps. They’ve also mapped out areas @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.g1OFd8Mt0UAghDjX]{I22} to @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.eR8zzQKxdR0jU0zH]{I26} and the connecting staircase. The secret door in area @UUID[.LyqYciAwy0l9vyed]{H08} isn’t noted.

H06. Padli’s Chamber.name: H06. 帕德莉的房间 H06. Padli’s Chamber
H06. Padli’s Chamber.text:
这间房间里堆满了枕头、毛皮、毯子和地毯，杂乱无章。地上散落着几个空罐子。

杜拉克勤勉而专注；而她的副手帕德利则是个自私、好交际的享乐主义者。他偏爱蘑菇酒，这个房间周围的罐子曾装着那种带着泥土气息、令人陶醉的饮料。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[qw2pk1zjvgxbeGBO]{Padli} @Actor[gWxpeqOQ54Jd4HTG]{Caligni Stalkers (2)}

80 XP

尽管沉溺享乐，帕德利的虔诚并不亚于杜拉克；他将任何闯入都视为对信徒的攻击。帕德利让他的伙伴承受近战攻击的主要压力，而自己则留在后方施放法术。这里的卡利格尼对谈判或留活口毫无兴趣。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.t4X6GDybqLmt7UkN]{Greater Cheetah's Elixir}

在这房间的诸多舒适用品之中，有一个小袋子，内有 25 gp、10 sp，以及一瓶更强猎豹药剂。

This room is a jumble of pillows, furs, blankets, and rugs. Several empty jugs litter the floor.

While Dulac is studious and intense, her second-in-command, Padli, is a selfish, gregarious hedonist. He favors mushroom wine, and the jugs around this room once held the earthy, intoxicating beverage.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[qw2pk1zjvgxbeGBO]{Padli} @Actor[gWxpeqOQ54Jd4HTG]{Caligni Stalkers (2)}

80 XP

For all his hedonism, Padli is no less devout than Dulac, and he sees any intrusion here as an assault on the faithful. Padli lets his companions take the brunt of melee attacks and hangs back to cast spells. The calignis here have no interest in parley or quarter.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.t4X6GDybqLmt7UkN]{Greater Cheetah's Elixir}

Amid the comforts of the room is a small pouch with 25 gp, 10 sp, and a greater cheetah's elixir.

H07. Prison.name: H07. 牢房 H07. Prison
H07. Prison.text:
这个房间从外侧上锁；帕德利拥有唯一的钥匙。一位英雄可以通过进行四次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}，或进行一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:29|traits:action:force-open]{运动} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}。

里面有一名囚犯在等待：一名名叫胡格鲁的透肌魔人战士，最近被卡利格尼俘获。卡利格尼拒绝给胡格鲁食物和饮水以从他口中套出情报，但这名顽固的战士宁愿死也不愿对俘虏者透露任何信息。他目前正假装死亡以打对手个措手不及，但由于他的欺瞒 DC 只有 12，英雄们很可能看穿他的诡计。

几乎不可能从胡格鲁口中得到任何信息，因为这名邪恶战士唯一的愿望就是在归于虚无之前尽可能多地制造死亡与破坏。尝试用交涉来改善胡格鲁的敌对态度不会奏效，不过英雄们也许可以通过进行欺瞒检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}，或进行威吓检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}他服从，从而得到信息。这些检定的 DC 为 19，这既是他的意志 DC，也是他的察觉 DC。

成功时，胡格鲁会说出他的名字，说明他是在区域 @UUID[.SXr3Fbi3jae09RT1]{H09} 的门附近被抓的，他效忠于一位名叫库尔费的伟大战争勇士，并且他的族人控制着附近一道裂谷底部的领地（区域 @UUID[.0DvO7vVIbYZAhm3R]{H34}）。胡格鲁会在这些信息中夹杂对英雄的威胁，并寄望城喝光英雄与卡利格尼的鲜血（不过，大成功时，胡格鲁会省略这些威胁）。

如果英雄们释放胡格鲁，只要他认为自己能在被杀之前先杀掉其中一人，他就会立刻反过来攻击他们。

XP 奖励

英雄们从胡格鲁处获得关于透肌魔人的信息时，给予英雄们 30 XP。

This room is locked on the outside; Padli has the only key. A hero can open it with four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} or a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:29|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}.

A single prisoner waits inside: an urdefhan warrior named Huglu whom the calignis recently captured. The calignis have denied Huglu food and water to get information out of him, but the stubborn warrior would rather die than tell his captors anything. He’s currently pretending to be dead to catch his abductors off-guard, but as his Deception DC is only 12, the heroes likely see through his ruse.

Getting any information out of Huglu is virtually impossible, as the evil warrior’s only desire is to inflict as much death and destruction as he can before oblivion. Diplomacy attempts to improve Huglu’s hostile attitude don’t work, though the heroes might get information out of him with Deception checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} or Intimidation checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce} compliance. The DC for these checks is 19, which is both his Will DC and his Perception DC.

On a success, Huglu relays his name, that he was caught near the door in area @UUID[.SXr3Fbi3jae09RT1]{H09}, that he serves a great war champion named Khurfel, and that his people control the territory at the bottom of a nearby chasm (area @UUID[.0DvO7vVIbYZAhm3R]{H34}). Huglu sprinkles this information with threats against the heroes and promises to drink the heroes’ and the calignis’ blood (on a critical success, however, Huglu omits these threats).

If the heroes free Huglu, he turns on them as soon as he thinks he can kill one of them before being killed himself.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for getting information about the urdefhans from Huglu.

H08. Dulac’s Chambers.name: H08. 迪拉克的厅室 H08. Dulac’s Chambers
H08. Dulac’s Chambers.text:
这间陈设简陋的房间里，只有房间远角的一张垫子；南墙边有一张小桌，桌下放着一个铁制保险箱。桌上唯一的物品是一碗灰色的稀粥和一把勺子。

这间房间是名叫杜拉克的严重卡利尼女性的住处，她是乌塔古尔教团的首领。她为了展示自己对乌塔古尔的谦卑服从，自封“托管人”这一头衔。她曾是一位非常积极而充满活力的领袖，却引起了幽暗之魂的注意——幽暗之魂是卡利尼社群中恶意操纵者之一。幽暗之魂把他的时间花在这房间外的密室里，扭曲杜拉克的信仰。

当贝科拉在教徒领地周围部署了鬼火后，杜拉克的掌控力与自信遭受了严重打击。与乌塔古尔那怪异的胡言乱语和奇异洞见隔绝后，杜拉克不确定接下来该做什么。幽暗之魂给出含糊的保证，但他暗地里喜欢看到教团崩塌，并不希望与乌塔古尔的联系恢复。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[h0Ztbh36be4rpJCz]{杜拉克} @Actor[JkJRKxuIGJ3DOD9L]{幽暗之魂}

80 XP

托管人杜拉克与幽暗之魂正在此处近距离交谈。他们会与入侵者战斗，但如果英雄表现出任何愿意交谈的迹象，杜拉克就会停止敌对行动来听他们说。然而，幽暗之魂会继续发动攻击，以施放沉默术般让英雄闭嘴。

如果幽暗之魂被击败，且杜拉克被削减至少于30点生命值，她便会投降。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

一名英雄若对该房间进行搜查并成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便会发现东墙上的密门，以及必须拉出并旋转才能打开它的隐藏门闩。密室里空无一物——幽暗之魂不需要任何舒适之物，只需要独处。

支线任务

如果英雄与杜拉克进行谈判，她会提出一项交易：若英雄收集更多甲伏怪卵，并消灭教团领地边缘的微灵，杜拉克就会正式让他们成为教团盟友。作为盟友，他们可以随时在神龛中休息。此外，她还能让他们在会所内穿越卡利尼领地时获得安全通行。她警告说，下层的卡利尼防御者很可能不会在没有杜拉克美言的情况下与英雄交谈。

XP奖励

以英雄通过交谈解决杜拉克的方式，给予他们如同在战斗中击败她一样的XP。

宝藏

@Actor[4oiB7prL9wIerPY8]{铁制保险箱}

铁制保险箱里有一个小袋子，装着13 gp与50 sp；另一个袋子里有30枚缟玛瑙，每枚价值2 gp；四瓶中等治疗药水，以及一瓶树肤药水。

This sparsely appointed chamber contains a single mat in the far corner of the room and a small desk on the south wall with an iron strongbox sitting under it. A bowl with some gray gruel and a spoon are the only items on the desk.

This chamber serves as quarters for a severe caligni woman named Dulac, the head of the Cult of Urthagul. She has granted herself the title of “custodian” to demonstrate her humble subservience to Urthagul. Once a very active and vital leader, she drew the attention of an owb, one of the malevolent manipulators of caligni communities. The owb spends his time in the secret chamber off of this room, twisting Dulac’s faith.

Dulac’s control and self-confidence took a severe blow when Belcorra stationed the will-o’-wisps around the cultists’ domain. Cut off from Urthagul’s bizarre babblings and strange insights, Dulac isn’t sure what to do next. The owb offers vague assurances, but he secretly likes seeing the cult crumble and doesn’t want contact with Urthagul restored.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[h0Ztbh36be4rpJCz]{Dulac} @Actor[JkJRKxuIGJ3DOD9L]{Owb}

80 XP

Custodian Dulac and the owb are in here in close conversation. They fight intruders, but if the heroes give any indication that they’re willing to talk, Dulac ceases hostilities to hear them out. However, the owb presses the attack to silence the heroes.

If the owb is defeated and Dulac is reduced to fewer than 30 Hit Points, she surrenders.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

A hero who Searches this room and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check discovers the secret door in the east wall as well as the hidden latch that must be pulled and turned to open it. The room is empty—the owb needs no comforts, only solitude.

Side Quest

If the heroes parley with Dulac, she proposes a deal. If the heroes gather more chuul eggs and eliminate the wisps on the fringes of the cult’s territory, Dulac will make them formal allies of the cult. As allies, they can rest in the shrine whenever they’d like. Further, she can grant them safe passage through caligni territory in the lodge. She warns that the caligni defenders on the lower level aren’t likely to speak with the heroes without Dulac’s good word.

XP Award

Award the heroes XP for talking with Dulac as though they'd defeated her in combat.

Treasure

@Actor[4oiB7prL9wIerPY8]{Iron Strongbox}

The iron strongbox holds one small pouch containing 13 gp and 50 sp, another with 30 pieces of onyx worth 2 gp each, four moderate healing potions, and a barkskin potion.

H09. Barricaded Door.name: H09. 设有路障的门 H09. Barricaded Door
H09. Barricaded Door.text:
这扇厚实、包铁的门向北开启。它过去是从北侧用门闩封住的，但在胡格鲁潜入后，卡利格尼斯人用瓦砾堵住了南侧以增加安全性。移动瓦砾以打开门很耗时代，但并不困难。

This stout, iron-bound door swings open to the north. It used to be barred from the north, but after Huglu sneaked in, the calignis blocked the southern side with rubble for additional security. Moving the rubble to open the door is time-consuming but not difficult.

H10. Stairs of Urthagul.name: H10. 乌塔古尔的楼梯 H10. Stairs of Urthagul
H10. Stairs of Urthagul.text:
这间狭长的厅室里有粗略凿成的台阶通向上方。两侧点缀着壁龛，其中两个壁龛里有装满泥水的石盆。

这些石盆与@UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{Hall of Eyes}中的相似，并发挥相同的作用。

当贝科拉得知卡利格尼正与乌塔古尔会面时，她派了一对恐怖鬼火来此阻止卡利格尼通行。她不希望猩红支点镜片落入卡利格尼之手，因为在她看来，卡利格尼作为守护者远不如古格巨人可靠。

遭遇

严重 8

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{恐怖鬼火（2）}

120 XP

这对恐怖鬼火会攻击任何试图通过的、除贝科拉以及任何贝科拉之子之外的生物。击败恐怖鬼火会触发@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.em5wJ44hCXP8mGGG]{Belcorra Attacks!}事件。

This long chamber features roughly carved stairs leading upward. Its sides are dotted with nooks, two of which contain stone basins filled with muddy water.

The basins are similar to and serve the same purpose as those in the @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{Hall of Eyes}.

When Belcorra learned that calignis were meeting with Urthagul, she sent a pair of dread wisps here to prevent the calignis’ passage. She doesn’t want the Crimson Fulcrum Lens to fall into caligni hands, as she sees them as less reliable guardians than the gug.

Encounter

Severe 8

@Actor[2TOXR7nKS6xPng2Y]{Dread Wisps (2)}

120 XP

The pair of dread wisps attack any creatures other than Belcorra and any Children of Belcorra who attempt to pass. The defeat of the dread wisps triggers the @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.em5wJ44hCXP8mGGG]{Belcorra Attacks!} event.

H11. Carrion Ambush.name: H11. 腐肉伏击 H11. Carrion Ambush
H11. Carrion Ambush.text:
甚至在英雄进入这个房间之前，他们就能闻到一股腐肉与衰败的恶臭。

这个又大又臭的洞窟通向一处峭壁，峭壁下方约二十英尺处是一大片浑浊的水域。峭壁边缘堆着一堆散发臭气、正在腐烂分解的腐肉。一股水流自北方流来，经过腐肉堆后沿着峭壁形成一道狭窄的瀑布倾泻而下。

这堆腐肉曾是一只巨型水栖（特征）爬行动物，它为了躲避掠食性的甲伏怪而攀上峭壁，却死在了这里。它腐烂的尸块躲藏着一群贝科拉之子，他们在下面等待，以获取关于——并希望能捕获——乌塔古尔的情报。他们计划：如果古格巨人从这里经过（他们并不知道古格巨人从来不会走这条路），就跟踪乌塔古尔；或者捕获并审问卡利格尼（他们并不知道贝科拉已经阻止了这一点）。

遭遇

低威胁 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{贝科拉之子（4）}

60 XP

四名贝科拉之子躲藏在腐肉堆中，该腐肉堆在木乃伊的能力中视为一片沼泽。他们会攻击任何靠近的人，并战斗至被摧毁为止。

Even before the heroes enter this chamber, they can smell a putrid stench of carrion and decay.

This large, smelly cave opens onto a cliff with a large body of murky water about twenty feet below. At the edge of the cliff sits a heap of reeking, decomposing carrion. A stream of water flows from the north, past the heap and over the cliff in a narrow waterfall.

The pile of carrion was once a Huge aquatic reptile that scaled the cliff to escape the predatory chuuls but died here. Its rotting mass hides a group of Children of Belcorra who wait underneath to gain information about—and hopefully capture—Urthagul. They plan to either follow Urthagul if the gug passes this way (which they don’t realize the gug never does) or capture and interrogate calignis (which they don’t realize Belcorra has prevented).

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{Children of Belcorra (4)}

60 XP

Four Children of Belcorra are hiding in the carrion heap, which counts as a bog for the mummies’ abilities. They attack anyone who comes near and fight until destroyed.

H12. Island Cavern.name: H12。岛屿洞窟 H12. Island Cavern
H12. Island Cavern.text:
四条细小的溪流穿过这间洞室，水源来自西墙边的一处黑暗池塘。溪流将洞室分割成数座小岛，每座都覆满地衣、霉斑与蘑菇。生物荧光真菌与奇异的光点以阴森的光照洗遍此地，光影在水面上跳动，于洞壁上投出怪异的形状，宛如人形幻影滑过空中。沿着岛屿边缘流淌的水声以诡异的方式在洞壁间回响，像刺耳的低语。
“哈鲁维克斯已然崛起。你无能为力。”重叠的回声说道。那声音令人着迷，且出奇地令人平静。

早已消逝的邪教徒曾将此洞窟用作冥想室，以平复他们的情绪并澄清心智，但如今这里回荡着宁布洛斯异界意志的微妙低语。这些低语既可能令人发狂，也可能带来启迪，但通常完全无法理解。

这座洞窟的西北端形成一道10英尺高的岩壁，通向一座天然桥梁；桥梁位于湖面上方30英尺处，并连到一座旧牢笼（区域 @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13}）。乌塔古尔过去每隔一两周就会从这里离开，到湖中猎食，但在卡利格尼为他带来供品时，他就懒得这么做了。

分心低语

洞窟中的生物免疫情绪效果，但在低语中度过的时间会影响心智。每过1分钟，洞内生物必须尝试一次 @Check[type:will|dc:24]{意志} 豁免，否则将在24小时内成为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}（大失败则为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}）。此状态可叠加，最高至 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}。

每当某个生物在此处的呆滞（状态）加深时，低语都会诉说不同的真相，如下所示。

• 呆滞（状态） 1：“镜片。她知晓镜片的秘密。三枚在触及之内，一枚近在咫尺。另一枚被伊尔达里斯遗失。还有一枚被嗜血者持有。”

• 呆滞（状态） 2：“她将它们分离，只为施行她那卑微的复仇，但诸般精粹终将合一。”

• 呆滞（状态） 3：“找到镜片，并将它们的精粹一同置入宿主之中。”

• 呆滞（状态） 4：“将精粹在哈鲁维克斯体内合一，她便能再度坠落。这是空无之死的寄望，是空无之死的寄望。”

此洞窟对异怪与具有异怪血统的术士会产生不同影响；他们不会获得呆滞（状态），但在洞窟内会陷入迷魂。此迷魂会在他们离开时立刻结束。若这类生物在此停留过久，他们会不由自主地喋喋不休，说出在低语中回响的怪诞真相——乌塔古尔正是因此在卡利格尼之间获得了神秘主义者的名声。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[0jvmec4yJH1ASfRy]{乌塔古尔}

80 XP

在最北端的小岛上，在一窝发光的蟾菇之间，潜伏着古格巨人乌塔古尔。他佝偻而坐，发出呼噜声，用四只手中的一只抚摸着 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{Crimson Fulcrum Lens}。乌塔古尔已在此待了数十年，或许更久。尽管他是一名强大的生物，但他对低语与猩红支点镜片的迷恋已令他付出代价。他很少进食，而在卡利格尼邪教徒不再拜访他之后，他吃得更少了。他那发光的宝藏几乎占据了他全部的注意力。

当英雄们进入时，乌塔古尔除了朝他们的方向瞥上一眼外，几乎毫不在意。英雄们甚至可以探索或穿过洞窟而不惊动乌塔古尔；若他们与他交谈，他也不会回应，只会把自己的宝藏挪到离任何可能想夺走它的人最远的那只手里。

如果英雄们对乌塔古尔动用武力，或试图夺走猩红支点镜片，他便会以无情的残暴发动攻击。在战斗中，他偏好使用啃咬，并以镜片的力量加以辅助。当乌塔古尔使用他的“狂怒利爪”能力时，他只能进行三次攻击而非四次，因为他不会放开镜片。乌塔古尔会为保护自己的宝藏战至死，但他不会离开这座洞窟。

XP 奖励

英雄们取回猩红支点镜片时，给予他们30 XP。

Four small streams flow through this chamber, fed by a dark pond against the west wall. The streams divide the chamber into islands, each covered with lichen, mildew, and mushrooms. Bioluminescent fungi and strange motes of light bathe the place in eerie illumination, playing off the water to form odd shapes on the cavern's walls, like humanoid apparitions gliding through the air. Water flowing along the sides of the islands echoes off the walls in weird ways, like harsh whispers.
"Haruvex has risen. There is nothing you can do," the overlapping echoes say. The sound is hypnotizing, and strangely calming.

Long-gone cultists used this cavern as a meditation chamber to calm their emotions and clear their minds, but it now echoes with subtle whispers of Nhimbaloth's alien will. These whispers can be maddening or enlightening but are usually wholly unintelligible.

The northwestern end of this cavern forms a rock wall 10 feet high that leads to a natural bridge 30 feet above the lake to an old cage (area @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13}). Urthagul used to leave this way every week or two to hunt for food in the lake but hadn’t bothered to do so while the calignis were bringing him offerings.

Distracting Whispers

Creatures in the cavern are immune to emotion effects, but spending time amid the whispers affects the mind. Every minute, creatures in the cave must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:24]{Will} save or become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure) for 24 hours. This condition is cumulative, up to @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}.

The whispers speak a different truth each time a creature here increases its stupefied condition, as follows.

• Stupefied 1: “The lenses. She knows the secrets of the lenses. Three are within reach, one very close. The other lost by Yldaris. One held by the blood eaters.”

• Stupefied 2: “She keeps them apart while she works her petty vengeance, but the essences shall become one.”

• Stupefied 3: “Find the lenses and place their essences together within a host.”

• Stupefied 4: “Join the essences within Haruvex, and she can fall again. This is a promise of the Empty Death, a promise of empty death.”

The cavern affects aberrations and sorcerers with the aberrant bloodline differently; they don’t gain the stupefied condition but are fascinated while within the cavern. This fascination ends as soon as they leave. If such creatures stay here too long, they involuntarily babble strange truths that echo in the whispers, which is how Urthagul obtained his reputation as a mystic among the calignis.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[0jvmec4yJH1ASfRy]{Urthagal}

80 XP

On the northernmost island, amid a nest of glowing toadstools, lurks the gug Urthagul. He sits hunched, purring and stroking the @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.yAqGhT0GuZrkvWZl]{Crimson Fulcrum Lens} in one of his four hands. Urthagul has been here for decades, or perhaps longer. While a formidable creature, his fascination with the whispers and the Crimson Fulcrum Lens have taken a toll. He rarely eats, and does so even less now that the caligni cultists don’t visit him. His glowing treasure commands nearly all of his attention.

When the heroes enter, Urthagul takes no more notice other than a glance in their direction. The heroes can even explore or pass through the cave without rousing Urthagul; if they speak to him, he doesn’t respond other than to shift his treasure to the hand farthest from anyone who might try to take it.

If the heroes use force against Urthagul or try to take the Crimson Fulcrum Lens, he attacks with relentless brutality. In combat, he prefers to use his jaws, supplemented with the powers of the lens. When Urthagul uses his Furious Claws ability, he can only make three attacks instead of four, as he doesn’t let go of the lens. Urthagul fights to the death to protect his treasure, but he doesn’t leave this cavern.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for recovering the Crimson Fulcrum Lens.

H13. Isolated Cage.name: H13. 孤立牢笼 H13. Isolated Cage
H13. Isolated Cage.text:
这个巨大的金属笼子矗立在一根天然石柱的顶端，石柱高出水面三十英尺。铁栏已被撕裂并扭曲，笼底散落着骨头。

贝科拉之子曾将生物囚禁在这个笼子里。在乌塔古尔两次袭击并吃掉笼内的生物后，深侏儒意识到这个笼子不值得费事，便将其遗弃了。

This large metal cage stands atop a natural pillar rising thirty feet above the water. The bars have been ripped and bent, and bones lie scattered about the cage’s bottom.

The Children of Belcorra once imprisoned creatures in this cage. After Urthagul attacked and ate the creatures within, twice, the deep gnomes realized the cage wasn’t worth the bother and abandoned it.

H14. Rickety Dock.name: H14. 摇摇欲坠的码头 H14. Rickety Dock
H14. Rickety Dock.text:
一座孤零零的码头从岩石平台上伸出，腐朽而摇摇欲坠。它看起来已经很久没人使用了，也没有任何船只系在它的系泊桩上。

由于贝科拉之子撤离并放弃职责，这座码头多年未曾使用。它仍可使用，只是偶尔会发生木板塌陷的小意外。乌塔古尔邪教曾从这里潜水打捞甲伏怪卵，但自从因与乌塔古尔断绝联系的创伤而遭受重创后，他们就再也没这么做过。

遭遇

低级 8

@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{甲伏怪（2）}

60 XP

一对甲伏怪在此区域狩猎，有时协同作战，有时为食物相互竞争。它们更喜欢潜行接近猎物，攀上靠近岸边的码头，让猎物无处可逃，只能跳入水中。任何一只甲伏怪的生命值降至 20 点以下时都会逃离，并且不会返回。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[mEfaPB3TTjkUD16h]{甲伏怪巢穴}

虽然甲伏怪身上没有任何值钱物品，但在水下进行 Search 的英雄会在水面下约 15 英尺处发现它们隐藏的筑巢凹洞。那里藏着 6 枚甲伏怪卵、9 gp、42 sp，以及一把 +1 striking 长剑。

A lone dock, rotten and rickety, juts out from a shelf of rock. It looks long unused, and no vessel is tethered to its moorings.

This dock went unused for many years as the Children of Belcorra withdrew from their duties. It’s still usable, with only the occasional mishap of a collapsing board. The Cult of Urthagul used to dive for chuul eggs from it, but they haven’t done so since being wracked by the trauma of being cut off from Urthagul.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{Chuuls (2)}

60 XP

A pair of chuuls hunt in this area, sometimes working together, other times competing for food. They prefer to sneak up on their prey, clambering onto the dock close to the shore so their prey has nowhere to run except into the water. A chuul reduced to fewer than 20 Hit Points flees and doesn’t return.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[mEfaPB3TTjkUD16h]{Chuul Nest}

While the chuuls carry nothing of value, heroes who Search under the water find their hidden nesting nook some 15 feet below the surface. It holds a cache of 6 chuul eggs, 9 gp, 42 sp, and a +1 striking longsword.

H15. Fetid Lake.name: H15. 腐臭湖泊 H15. Fetid Lake
H15. Fetid Lake.text:
这些水又咸又浑，夹带着淤泥。恶臭空气的暗色云团与肮脏的薄雾贴着水面盘旋。水拍打岸边之处，会留下闪着湿光的泥浆痕迹。

这座湖的湖水曾经可饮、清新，并且充满了由贝科拉之子放养的地下鱼类。贝科拉陨落后，侏儒们放任、甚至培育了湖中的奇异异怪与其他水栖（特征）怪物。尽管湖面平静，水面高度的能见度却很差；薄雾使察觉检定承受–2环境减值，30英尺以外的一切皆为隐蔽，而能见度在约90英尺处终止。从更高处（例如区域 @UUID[.mXZ6lvqCGglrVRyc]{H11} 的峭壁、区域 @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13} 的石柱，或区域 @UUID[.16A6qnAoRtG9rIH1]{H22} 的洞穴）观察则毫无遮挡，并能更好地俯瞰湖穴。

污染的湖水

饮用湖水可能有害，但不会致命。任何饮用湖水者都有1/6的概率暴露于下水道痴呆症。

湖中野生生物

湖里仍有鱼类存活：一些失明、丑陋、满是棘刺的家伙，对大多数生物而言都有毒。食用这些鱼——即便彻底煮熟——也会令人黏腻反胃，并且同样会传播下水道痴呆症。

栖居湖中的其他污秽生物已对其中带病的湖水与鱼类产生了耐受。

下水道痴呆症

疾病 7

  • 疾病
  • 剧毒

许多医师与炼金术师怀疑下水道痴呆症具有超自然起源，因为它与特别强大的食腐巨怪有关联。

豁免掷骰： @Check[type:fort|dc:23]{Fortitude}

潜伏期： 2天

  • 阶段 1: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}（1天）
  • 阶段 2: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}和 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}（1天）
  • 阶段 3: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}和 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3}（1天）

随机遭遇：

英雄们每花15分钟穿越湖面，就进行一次秘密 @Check[type:flat|dc:5]{Flat} 纯骰检定。成功时，英雄们会遇到下列遭遇之一。

遭遇

遭遇预算

1只甲伏怪，来自区域 @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14}

30 XP

4名贝科拉之子乘坐小艇，来自区域 @UUID[.4gMUpcEFebuDe1Tf]{H17}

60 XP

1只克鲁斯

40 XP

2群孵巢水蛭虫群

20 XP

1只迷失的深水触鳍鱼怪，来自区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.wHieR95y1h9tQrGc]{I39}

60 XP

来自区域 @UUID[.m8Nz1hyJ9XZxjPAx]{H27} 的沼喉怪；它只会战斗1轮便撤退

 

掷骰表

@RollTable[68Ly2Z5mTPeVJaLS]{Fetid Lake Encounters}

你可以从上方列表中选择一个遭遇，或使用所包含的掷骰表随机决定结果。若结果是英雄们已经面对过的生物，将其视作没有遭遇。

如果你希望隐藏掷骰结果，请先在聊天框上方的下拉菜单中更改你的掷骰模式！

These waters are brackish and silty. Dark clouds of fetid air and grimy mists cling to the surface. Where it laps on the shore, the water leaves trails of glistening muck.

The lake’s water was once potable, fresh, and teaming with subterranean fish stocked by the Children of Belcorra. After Belcorra’s fall, the gnomes allowed and even fostered strange aberrations and other aquatic monsters in the lake. Despite the lake’s calm, the visibility at the water level is poor; the mist imposes a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks, everything beyond 30 feet is concealed, and visibility ends at about 90 feet. Visibility from a higher point (such as the cliff in area @UUID[.mXZ6lvqCGglrVRyc]{H11}, the pillar in area @UUID[.cm5dvw5Lw46nAhBe]{H13}, or the caves in area @UUID[.16A6qnAoRtG9rIH1]{H22}) is unobstructed and gives a better view of the lake cavern.

Tainted Water

Drinking the water can be hazardous but not fatal. There's a 1 in 6 chance that anyone drinking the water is exposed to sewer haze.

Lake Wildlife

Fish still live in the lake: blind, ugly, spinous things that are poisonous to most creatures. Eating these fish- even when well cooked- is a slimy and sickening affair and also spreads sewer haze.

The other foul creatures living in the lake have built a tolerance to its diseased water and fish.

Sewer Haze

Disease 7

  • Disease
  • Virulent

Many healers and alchemists suspect that sewer haze has a supernatural origin, given its association with particularly strong otyughs.

Saving Throw: @Check[type:fort|dc:23]{Fortitude}

Onset: 2 Days

  • Stage 1: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 day)
  • Stage 2: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 day)
  • Stage 3: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} (1 day)

Random Encounters:

Every 15 minutes that the heroes spend traversing the lake, make a secret @Check[type:flat|dc:5]{Flat} check. On a success, the heroes come across one of the following encounters.

Encounter

Encounter Budget

One Chuul, from area @UUID[.FAKz5eIbbUUifBrV]{H14}

30 XP

Four Children of Belcorra on a skiff, from area @UUID[.4gMUpcEFebuDe1Tf]{H17}

60 XP

One Krooth

40 XP

Two Brood Leech Swarms

20 XP

One lost Deepwater Dhuthorex, from area @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.wHieR95y1h9tQrGc]{I39}

60 XP

The Froghemoth from area @UUID[.m8Nz1hyJ9XZxjPAx]{H27}, which only fights for one round before retreating

 

Roll Tables

@RollTable[68Ly2Z5mTPeVJaLS]{Fetid Lake Encounters}

You can choose one of the encounters from the list above, or you can determine the outcome randomly using the included rolltable. If the result is a creature the heroes have already faced, treat it as no encounter.

If you'd like the roll's result to be hidden, make sure to change your roll mode first in the dropdown menu above your chat box!

H16. Monster Cages.name: H16. 怪物笼子 H16. Monster Cages
H16. Monster Cages.text:
七个由金属与奇异的纤维状木材构成的笼子沿着这片海滩排开，每个都部分浸没在恶臭的水中。

贝科拉之子用这些笼子来困住生活在湖中的强大怪物，这是贝科拉最近命令他们做的事。这项工作推进艰难且挫折不断，但贝科拉之子早已习惯花时间来完成目标。每个笼子都有一个简单的闩锁装置——一根弯曲的杆穿过金属环——打开或关闭需要三次 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} 动作。由于闩锁的位置，笼内的生物无法够到它。金属为笼子提供强度，而纤维状木材则提供足够的韧性，使其尤其难以被撞破。要对笼子进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Forcing Open} 需要一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:40|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定。笼子的栅栏间隙足够宽，中型生物可在一次成功的 @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:25|traits:action:squeeze]{特技}检定后通过栅栏 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}。小型或更小的生物不需要挤入空间，能够直接穿过栅栏，但将其视为高等困难地形。

遭遇

可变 8

@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{甲伏怪} @Actor[WNqPRMjKW0oCHZ8X]{Krooth} @Actor[lo4fR4jDVzLdwwkH]{骷髅巨怪（2）}

笼中的生物对被囚禁怒不可遏，若被释放，便会攻击附近的任何人；若其生命值降至一半，则会逃离。英雄们或许能与甲伏怪谈判，尽管它只会说阿克洛语与地下通用语。甲伏怪坚称若获释，它只会游走，不会再来找英雄们的麻烦；若英雄们似乎还需要更多诱因，甲伏怪会提出揭示数处甲伏怪卵的位置（区域 @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15}）。只有当英雄们看起来格外脆弱时，它才会背弃诺言。

@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{Chuul} @Actor[WNqPRMjKW0oCHZ8X]{Krooth} @Actor[lo4fR4jDVzLdwwkH]{Skeletal Hulks (2)}

Seven cages constructed of metal and strange fibrous wood line this beach, each partially submerged in the stinking waters.

The Children of Belcorra use the cages to trap powerful monsters living in the lake, as Belcorra recently commanded them to do. It is hard going and involves many setbacks, but the Children are used to taking their time to complete their goals. Each cage has a simple latching device—a curved bar leading through metal hoops—that takes three @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} actions to open or close. The latch can’t be reached by a creature inside the cage due to its position. The metal gives the cages strength, and the fibrous wood allows enough give that they’re particularly difficult to burst open. @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Forcing Open} a cage requires a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:40|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check. The cages have wide enough gaps that a Medium creature can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} through the bars with a successful @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:25|traits:action:squeeze]{Acrobatics} check. Small or smaller creatures don’t need to Squeeze and can simply move through the bars as greater difficult terrain.

Encounter

Variable 8

@Actor[aD76W2uEQhFFUrom]{Chuul} @Actor[WNqPRMjKW0oCHZ8X]{Krooth} @Actor[lo4fR4jDVzLdwwkH]{Skeletal Hulks (2)}

The creatures within the cages are furious at their imprisonment and, if freed, simply attack anyone nearby and flee if reduced to half their Hit Points. The heroes might be able to negotiate with the chuul, although it only speaks Aklo and Undercommon. The chuul insists it will simply swim away and not trouble the heroes again if freed; if the heroes seem to need further enticement, the chuul offers to reveal the location of several chuul eggs (area @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15}). It goes back on its word only if the heroes seem particularly vulnerable.

H17. Dock and Lift.name: H17. 码头与升降机 H17. Dock and Lift
H17. Dock and Lift.text:
这座巨大的 T 形码头上系着四艘老旧小艇。靠陆地一侧，码头通向一座大型木铁平台；平台每个角落都有一条铁链向上攀入黑暗。平台南端放着一台大型滑轮装置。它的铁链与机械结构，以及平台上的铁链，都覆着一层锈壳。

这里是贝科拉之子日渐稀少的湖上出行的下水点。

该平台是一部升降机，连接到上方 100 英尺处的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03}。这部大型升降机曾将食物与补给从农场等级运往魔窟的上层。尽管这套锈蚀的机械仍可勉强运转，但速度很慢且经常卡滞。它由平台上一处机构中的四根拉杆控制。控制方式并不直观；每根拉杆控制一个角落的链式滑轮，但每根拉杆的拉动速率各不相同。需要花费 [[/r 1d4]] 小时的摆弄才能弄清如何准确控制升降机，而这类反复试错可能会毁掉整套机构（进行一次 @Check[type:flat|dc:11]{Flat} 纯骰检定；失败时，该机构将被永久摧毁）。若一名英雄成功通过一次 @Check[type:crafting|dc:24|traits:action:repair]{Crafting} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} 该机构，则可将此纯骰检定的 DC 降至 5（大成功时降至 1）。

遭遇

低威胁 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{贝科拉之子（4）}

60 XP

四名贝科拉之子正在此处修理一艘小艇。当他们发现入侵者时，三名会冲上去战斗，而第四名会逃往区域 @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19} 寻求援助。尽管附近有数个装着笼子的生物，贝科拉之子也不会放出它们，因为当初抓住它们就费了很大周折。相反，如果真的陷入绝境，这些亡灵要么逃往区域 @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19}，要么放下一艘小艇前往区域 @UUID[.hD6CSfmfkrSopsaw]{H21} 获取援助。

This large, T-shaped dock has four old skiffs moored to it. On the land side, the docks open up to a large wood and iron platform; at each corner, an iron chain climbs upward into darkness. At the south end of this platform sits a large pulley device. Its chains and machinery, as well as the chains on the platform, are crusted with rust.

This is the launch point for the Children of Belcorra’s increasingly rare lake excursions.

The platform is a lift that connects to area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 100 feet above. The big lift once brought food and supplies from the Farm level to the upper levels of the Vaults. While the rusted machinery can still be coaxed to work, it’s slow and often stalls. It’s controlled by four levers situated in a mechanism on the platform. The controls are unintuitive; each lever controls a chain pulley on a corner, but each lever pulls at a different rate. It takes [[/r 1d4]] hours of tinkering to figure out exactly how to control the lift, and such trial and error might ruin the entire mechanism (roll a @Check[type:flat|dc:11]{Flat} check; on a failure, the mechanism is permanently destroyed). A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:crafting|dc:24|traits:action:repair]{Crafting} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repair} the mechanism reduces the DC of this flat check to 5 (or to 1 on a critical success). 

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{Children of Belcorra (4)}

60 XP

Four Children of Belcorra are repairing a skiff here. When they spot intruders, three rush to fight while the fourth flees to area @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19} for aid. Although there are several caged creatures nearby, the Children don’t release them because it was such trouble to capture them in the first place. Instead, if in genuinely desperate straits, the undead either flee to area @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19} or launch a skiff to get aid from area @UUID[.hD6CSfmfkrSopsaw]{H21}.

H18. Roper Pen.name: H18. 罗珀围栏 H18. Roper Pen
H18. Roper Pen.text:
这个洞穴的入口被一座用木料与铁箍临时拼凑的路障堵住。它的门从外侧被门闩拦住，而门闩上用侏儒语写着“危险！不要打开！”

贝科拉之子把他们最大、最危险的怪物关在这里。路障显然已经被破坏又重建过许多次，但它足够坚固，能把眼下的囚犯关在里面。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[ZXbr1ke1vF0ZFKY3]{Roper}

80 XP

洞穴里只有一只 roper。发现这只生物的贝科拉之子极为小心地将其捕获并转移到此处。他们不知道该如何控制这只异怪，但他们确信贝科拉会想把它纳入她的军队。roper 待在洞穴深处，伪装成一根不起眼的钟乳石。若有机会（例如英雄们打开门后又离开），它会悄悄爬出洞穴，以免再次被囚禁。否则，它会等待生物进一步走入洞内再发动袭击，并一直战斗到被摧毁为止。

The entrance to this cave is blocked by a makeshift barricade of wood and iron straps. Its door is barred from the outside, and the bar has the words, “Danger! Do not open!” written on it in Gnomish.

The Children of Belcorra keep their largest and most dangerous monsters here. The barricade has obviously been broken and rebuilt many times, but it’s sturdy enough to keep its current prisoner contained.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[ZXbr1ke1vF0ZFKY3]{Roper}

80 XP

The cave contains a single roper. The Children who discovered the creature took great care to capture it and move it here. They have no idea how to control the aberration, but they’re sure that Belcorra will want it for her army. The roper waits in the back of the cave, disguised as a nondescript stalactite. If given the chance (such as if the heroes open the door and then leave), it creeps out of the cave so it can’t be imprisoned again. Otherwise, it waits for creatures to step further inside before striking, and it fights until destroyed.

H19. Game Room.name: H19. 游戏室 H19. Game Room
H19. Game Room.text:
四张小型躺椅围着这间L形房间角落里的一张小桌子。桌上摆着一块细长的棋盘，被分成一排排方格。棋盘上放着各式棋子，桌面上还散落着金字塔形的骰子。

一些贝科拉之子在漫长岁月后从职责中退下，用他们的时代来赌博一种名为“黑暗追逐”的深地侏棋盘游戏。他们的套装缺了几枚棋子（不过六枚必需的四面骰都齐全），但这种不完整对贝科拉之子有着一种奇特的吸引力：缺失的棋子意味着没有终局，因此游戏永远不会结束。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{贝科拉之子 (2)} @Actor[00s3MhFQ4yOp2rTf]{年长的贝科拉之子}

80 XP

这里的三名贝科拉之子会与入侵者战斗，但他们会避免打扰正在进行的棋局。若有英雄对游戏造成了伤害（例如走过放着矮桌的方格，或用泼溅或区域效果伤害到该方格），木乃伊会将怒火集中到那名英雄身上。他们会战斗至被摧毁为止。

宝藏

@Item[m8oDybso1IIOaw7u]{简易铁钥匙} @Item[SbDSZpxf8NouBPtF]{棋盘}

棋盘周围下注用的都是彩色小卵石，漂亮但并不特别值钱。在这些卵石中有一把通往区域 @UUID[.K7CfSFezeDp8yJoj]{H20} 的钥匙。棋盘镶嵌着半宝石。即便不完整，这套棋具也价值80 gp。

Four small reclining couches circle a small table toward the corner of this L-shaped room. On the table is an elongated game board split into rows of squares. Various pieces sit in place on the board, and pyramid-shaped dice are scattered about the surface.

Some Children of Belcorra retreated from their duties after long years and spend their time gambling on a deep gnome board game called “The Dark Chase.” Their set is missing several pieces (although it has all six required four-sided dice), but the incompleteness holds a peculiar attraction to the Children: the missing pieces mean there’s no end state, so the game is never over.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{Children of Belcorra (2)} @Actor[00s3MhFQ4yOp2rTf]{Elder Child of Belcorra}

80 XP

The three Children here fight intruders, but they avoid disturbing the game in progress. If a hero damages the game (such as by moving across the square containing the low table or by damaging the square with a splash or area effect), the mummies focus their rage upon that hero. They fight until destroyed.

Treasure

@Item[m8oDybso1IIOaw7u]{Simple Iron Key} @Item[SbDSZpxf8NouBPtF]{Game Board}

The wagers around the board are all colored pebbles that are pretty but not particularly valuable. A key to area @UUID[.K7CfSFezeDp8yJoj]{H20} is among the pebbles. The game board is inlaid with semiprecious stones. Even incomplete, the set is worth 80 gp.

H20. Tomb of the Demilich.name: H20. 半巫妖之墓 H20. Tomb of the Demilich
H20. Tomb of the Demilich.text:
这间房间的门上了锁；钥匙在区域 @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19}。这把锁需要进行五次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} 才能打开，或进行一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:30|traits:action:force-open]{运动} 检定将其 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball}。

这扇门也受到魔法保护：一道守卫刻文，其中封存着一个 3 环 @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19}（@Check[type:reflex|dc:28|basic:true]{基础反射} 豁免；DC 28 用以察觉并解除刻文）。当一名非亡灵生物触碰这扇门时，刻文就会触发，即使是用钥匙开门也一样。

这间房间尘土飞扬而又干燥。在其西端有一块三英尺高的石板。上面躺着一具小小的尸体，裹着丧葬裹布。

戈尔萨尔希斯，最古老的贝科拉之子之一，计划成为半巫妖。其他贝科拉之子并不知道他从哪里得到了这个主意；他们中没人见过半巫妖，尽管他们都听过那些镶嵌宝石、拥有惊人施法力量的亡灵头骨的故事。但戈尔萨尔希斯坚称他知道方法：他将宝石嵌入眼中，用更小的宝石替换牙齿，并在头骨上钻孔以便将一顶水晶王冠嵌在那里。随后他把自己锁在这间屋里长眠静卧，耐心等待自己的身体化为尘土、蜕变最终完成。他在这里待了将近一个世纪，而他木乃伊般的形态毫无变化。

遭遇

低威胁 8

@Actor[6MLpOv7SzAff5xjf]{戈尔萨尔希斯}

60 XP

戈尔萨尔希斯执着于他那不切实际的目标。当英雄们进入时，他坚信自己必须击败他们才能推进进化。他在战斗中傲慢地谈论自己即将到来的转化。

宝藏

@Actor[CJJqBzrqruRCufeB]{宝石镶嵌头骨}

戈尔萨尔希斯仅有的宝藏就是嫁接在他头骨上的宝石。牙齿是各式各样的半宝石，共 24 颗，每颗价值 8 sp。他的每个眼眶里都有一颗透明黄玉，价值 50 gp，而他的王冠由九块石英组成，每块价值 3 gp。

The door to this chamber is locked; the key is in area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}. The lock requires five successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} to get open or a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:30|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to break it down.

The door is also magically protected with a glyph of warding containing a 3rd-level @UUID[.906FDGe5y8f6jJ5H]{H19} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:28|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save; DC 28 to notice and disarm the glyph). The glyph triggers when a non-undead creature touches the door, even to open it with the key.

This chamber is dusty and dry. At its west end sits a stone slab three feet high. Atop it lies a small body covered in funeral wrappings.

Gorsalthith, one of the oldest Children of Belcorra, plans to become a demilich. The other Children don’t know where he got this idea; none of them have even seen a demilich, although they’ve all heard stories of the gem-studded undead skulls with phenomenal spellcasting power. But Gorsalthith was adamant that he knew the method: he placed gemstones in his eyes, replaced his teeth with smaller gems, and drilled holes into his head to lodge a crown of crystals there. He then locked himself in this room to lay in repose, patiently waiting for his body to turn to dust and his transformation to take its final form. He has been here for nearly a century with no change in his mummified form.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[6MLpOv7SzAff5xjf]{Gorsalthith}

60 XP

Gorsalthith is determined in his unrealistic goal. When the heroes enter, he becomes convinced he must defeat them to advance his evolution. He arrogantly talks about his pending transformation as he fights.

Treasure

@Actor[CJJqBzrqruRCufeB]{Gemstone-studded Skull}

Gorsalthith’s only treasures are the gemstones grafted to his skull. The teeth are a variety of semiprecious stones, 24 in total, each worth 8 sp. His eye sockets each have a clear topaz worth 50 gp, and his crown is nine bits of quartz worth 3 gp each.

H21. Ancients’ Caves.name: H21. 远古者洞穴 H21. Ancients’ Caves
H21. Ancients’ Caves.text:
陡峭悬崖之上有四座洞穴，位于湖中漆黑水面上方十英尺处。

这些崖壁上有许多可供攀抓的着力点，需要成功通过一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb]{运动}检定才能 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} 到洞穴（或从一个洞穴攀到另一个洞穴）。

遭遇

严重 8

@Actor[jCJUvzs1FaL6PAkq]{空无之死 波达尸（3）}

120 XP

三名贝科拉之子对宁布洛斯的传说变得过于痴迷，并被外神那强大的惊鸿一瞥所轰击，进而被转化为波达尸。波达尸们压抑着痛苦与怨恨，退回到这些洞穴中。其他贝科拉之子承认波达尸的力量与知识，却很少接近它们。波达尸各自栖身于区域 H21a、H21b 与 H21d。当任意一只波达尸受到惊扰时，其余波达尸会攀爬过来援助，因此任何与其中一只波达尸交战的人很快就会与它们全部交战。

宝藏

@Actor[dczBOCUfY2fXGzf4]{波达尸宝藏}

两只波达尸没有宝藏，但栖身于区域 H21d 的那一只在其洞穴中散落着一些贵重物品。一个麻袋内有 80 gp、2 pp，以及雄鹰之眼。一根强效治疗法杖被丢弃在洞穴后方，而一把 +1 强袭短剑则卡在墙壁裂缝中。

Four caves atop steeps cliffs sit ten feet above the lake’s dark water.

These cliff walls have numerous handholds and require a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} to the caves (or across from one to the other).

Encounter

Severe 8

@Actor[jCJUvzs1FaL6PAkq]{Empty Death Bodaks (3)}

120 XP

Three Children of Belcorra became far too interested in the lore of Nhimbaloth and were blasted with a powerful glimpse of the Outer God, transforming them into bodaks. Nursing their pain and resentment, the bodaks retreated to these caves. The other Children acknowledge the bodaks’ power and knowledge but rarely approach them. The bodaks dwell individually in areas H21a, H21b, and H21d. When any bodak is disturbed, the others clamber over to help, so anyone fighting one of the bodaks soon fights them all.

Treasure

@Actor[dczBOCUfY2fXGzf4]{Bodak Treasure}

While two bodaks have no treasure, the one that dwells in area H21d has valuables scattered about its cave. A sack contains 80 gp, 2 pp, and eyes of the eagle. A greater staff of healing lies discarded at the back of the cave, and a +1 striking shortsword is wedged in a crack in the wall.

H22. Quiet Lake.name: H22。静谧湖 H22. Quiet Lake
H22. Quiet Lake.text:
大湖的西侧有污浊的水与隐雾术，如同东侧的湖（区域 @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15}）。

随机遭遇：

这一侧人口较少，主要是因为南方盘踞的沼喉怪食量惊人。英雄们在这里也可能遭遇随机遭遇，但进行遭遇的纯骰检定 DC 为10而非5。

掷骰表

@RollTable[Mzxa5Zg1ihyFyUt0]{寂静湖遭遇}

你可以从区域 @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15} 的列表中选择一个遭遇，或使用所附掷骰表随机决定结果。若结果为英雄们已经面对过的生物，则将其视为未发生遭遇。

若你希望掷骰结果隐藏，请先在聊天框上方的下拉菜单中更改你的掷骰模式！

@RollTable[Mzxa5Zg1ihyFyUt0]{Quiet Lake Encounters}

The western side of the large lake has foul water and obscuring mist like the lake to the east (area @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15}).

Random Encounters:

This side is less populated, predominantly due to the appetite of the froghemoth lairing to the south. The heroes might have random encounters here, too, but the DC of the flat check for an encounter is 10 rather than 5.

Roll Tables

@RollTable[Mzxa5Zg1ihyFyUt0]{Quiet Lake Encounters}

You can choose one of the encounters from the list in area @UUID[.EzERYV4NkVvzZeSR]{H15}, or you can determine the outcome randomly using the included rolltable. If the result is a creature the heroes have already faced, treat it as no encounter.

If you'd like the roll's result to be hidden, make sure to change your roll mode first in the dropdown menu above your chat box!

H23. Shadowed Dock.name: H23. 影幕码头 H23. Shadowed Dock
H23. Shadowed Dock.text:
这个T形码头最近已被完全修复，一艘小艇停泊在它的北侧。越过码头，一座砖石结构从洞窟壁上突出来，飘荡的薄雾在石砌墙面上投下怪异的幽影。其中央是一扇包铁的门。

在贝科拉的归来之前，这座码头与建筑已被废弃数十年。贝科拉最近任命为贝科拉之子首领的灵体娜迦维瑟里斯，如今将此处作为她的巢穴。建筑的门没有上锁。

遭遇

低威胁 8

@Actor[ZGEf08j9q4fIPDFd]{惧栗缚灵}

60 XP

在砖石上舞动的幽影不只是水面的把戏。一只惧栗缚灵在这片区域徘徊，充当哨兵。它一发现陌生人，便悄无声息地移动到内部建筑群去警告维瑟里斯。维瑟里斯不耐烦地打发惧栗缚灵，命令它“处理掉这个麻烦”。随后惧栗缚灵会追猎英雄们，渴望将他们变成缚灵衍体。

This T-shaped dock has been recently repaired, and a single skiff is moored on its north side. Beyond the dock, a masonry structure juts out from the cavern walls, the drifting mist creating strange shadows on the stonework. At its center is a single iron-bound door.

This dock and building were abandoned decades prior to Belcorra’s return. Vethris, the spirit naga Belcorra recently put in charge of the Children of Belcorra, now claims it as her lair. The door to the building is unlocked.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[ZGEf08j9q4fIPDFd]{Dread Wraith}

60 XP

The shadows playing on the masonry are more than just a trick of the water. A dread wraith haunts this area, acting as a lookout. When it spots strangers, it silently moves to the inner complex to warn Vethris. Vethris peevishly dismisses the dread wraith, commanding it to “take care of the problem.” The dread wraith then hunts down the heroes, eager to make wraith spawn out of them.

H24. Mud Room.name: H24. 泥房 H24. Mud Room
H24. Mud Room.text:
这间潮湿的房间地面下凹，里面填满了泥浆。

泥浆只比门槛低几英寸，但深达两英尺，并且属于困难地形。

遭遇

低威胁 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{贝科拉之子（4）}

60 XP

四名贝科拉之子潜伏在这间房间东侧的泥浆里，怨恨自己被懒惰的维瑟里斯在命令术之下派驻于此。只要有人惊扰这间房间，他们就会迅速发动攻击；但由于他们藏在泥浆下方，当惧栗缚灵从上方掠过、去警告那伞蜥入侵者时，他们并不会察觉，而且在英雄踏入泥浆之前，他们多半不会知道英雄已经在场。

This damp room has a recessed floor filled with mud.

The mud is only a few inches below the doors’ thresholds but is two feet deep and is difficult terrain.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[vHei0y2PKlXfxQ8Z]{Children of Belcorra (4)}

60 XP

Four Children of Belcorra lurk in the mud in the eastern part of this room, bitter at being stationed here under the command of the lazy Vethris. They’re quick to attack when anyone disturbs this room, but, being beneath the mud, they don’t notice when the dread wraith flits overhead to warn the naga of intruders and aren’t likely to know the heroes are present until the heroes enter the mud.

H25. Naga Lair.name: H25. 娜迦巢穴 H25. Naga Lair
H25. Naga Lair.text:
这个房间里堆满了地毯、挂毯与枕垫。大多数都被泥浆弄脏了。

这里是阴险的灵体那伽维瑟里斯的巢穴。维瑟里斯说服了贝科拉，相信她会把农场等级重新整理得井井有条，并让贝科拉之子守规矩，但她完全没有做到这些。维瑟里斯整日懒散地躺着，命令她的新爪牙为她带来食物和宝藏。尽管不死生物对她颇为不满，但它们忠于贝科拉，因此它们在不情不愿地听从那伽命令与设法无视她之间来回摇摆。

遭遇

低 8

@Actor[h4SZ3U9at7aT0ASv]{维瑟里斯}

60 XP

维瑟里斯很懒，但任何胆敢打扰她休憩的人都会让她立刻行动起来。她一边对敌人尖声咒骂，一边向他们施放法术。她偏好用黑触手把敌人阻在远处，随后尽可能频繁地接上麻痹术；这是她最喜欢的法术，而贝科拉之子对其免疫令她恼火，因此她无法用它来管教他们。若生命值降至40点以下，维瑟里斯会投降并试图蜿蜒溜走。

若英雄们设法在不惊动区域 @UUID[.0XtDnInFWYOLNUOX]{H24} 的泥浆的情况下到达这里，那里的木乃伊会苏醒并与那伽并肩作战。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

维瑟里斯带来了这些枕垫和其他装饰品，但良好卫生并不在这条那伽的优先事项之列。一幅挂毯描绘着风格化的、彼此纠缠的蛇巢，遮住了南墙上的暗门。任何人若移开挂毯或在房间里进行搜索，成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定即可定位术该暗门。按下东墙上正确的石块即可打开它。

This room is filled with rugs, tapestries, and pillows. Most are stained with mud.

This is the lair of the scheming spirit naga Vethris. Vethris convinced Belcorra she would do a good job of getting the Farm level back in good order and keep the Children in line, but she has done nothing of the sort. Vethris spends her days lounging about and ordering her new minions to bring her food and treasures. While the undead are dissatisfied with her, they’re loyal to Belcorra, so they alternate between grudgingly follow the naga’s orders and finding ways to ignore her.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[h4SZ3U9at7aT0ASv]{Vethris}

60 XP

Vethris is lazy, but she snaps into action against any who dare intrude on her relaxation. She screams curses at her foes while casting spells at them. She prefers to use black tentacles to keep her foes at a distance, but then she follows up with paralyze as often as possible; this is her favorite spell, and it frustrates her that the Children of Belcorra are immune to it, and thus she can’t use it to discipline them. Vethris surrenders if reduced to fewer than 40 Hit Points and tries to slither away.

If the heroes managed to get here without disturbing the mud in area @UUID[.0XtDnInFWYOLNUOX]{H24}, the mummies there rise up and fight alongside the naga.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Vethris brought the pillows and other trappings, but good hygiene isn’t one of the naga’s priorities. One tapestry, depicting a stylized nest of intertwining snakes, covers the secret door on the south wall. Anyone removing the tapestry or Searching the room locates the secret door with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. It’s opened by pressing the proper stone on the eastern wall.

H26. Secret Treasury.name: H26。秘密宝库 H26. Secret Treasury
H26. Secret Treasury.text:
一堆闪闪发光的宝藏堆放在这间小房间的南端。

这是维瑟里斯积攒的大部分宝藏，也是她交给不死生物去收集的那部分。

宝藏

@Actor[pxuKJ9IqbeBPYjN2]{秘密宝库}

房间里散落着130 gp、310 sp、高等飞弹偏斜护腕、一根火球术魔杖、三条谋杀者结、一瓶加速药水以及一支闪电标枪。一个小袋子里装着10颗咸水珍珠，每颗价值9 gp。

瓷茶壶上涂满了@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.KdeeRCrtsDCJLfgc]{Nettleweed Residue}。一旦把茶壶上的毒物洗掉，它就值40 gp。

@Actor[pxuKJ9IqbeBPYjN2]{Secret Treasury}

A glittering mass of treasure sits at the south end of this small room.

This is the bulk of the treasure Vethris had accumulated as well as that she tasked the undead to gather.

Treasure

@Actor[pxuKJ9IqbeBPYjN2]{Secret Treasury}

Scattered about the room are 130 gp, 310 sp, greater bracers of missile deflection, a wand of fireball, three murderer’s knots, a potion of quickness, and a javelin of lightning. A small sack contains 10 saltwater pearls worth 9 gp each.

The porcelain teapot is slathered with @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.KdeeRCrtsDCJLfgc]{Nettleweed Residue}. Once the poison is washed off the teapot, it's worth 40 gp.

H27. Shores of Death.name: H27. 死亡之滨 H27. Shores of Death
H27. Shores of Death.text:
在这片污秽地下湖泊的南端尽头，一座小木码头从一栋石砌与砖石结构的建筑旁伸出。码头已成废墟；其前端被巨力撕裂扯走，剩余部分倾斜着没入水中。建筑在码头尽头原本有一扇门，但它已被从铰链上扯下，一块门板半浸在水里，斜靠在洞窟墙上。结构以南，湖岸过渡为一片巨型真菌森林。码头附近的水面偶尔冒泡，仿佛有什么庞然大物栖息在水面之下的某处。

一只暴躁的沼喉怪曾在这处前哨站攻击贝科拉之子，破坏了码头并把沼泽木乃伊赶走。它就是水中气泡的来源。若一名英雄成功通过一次针对其隐匿DC的@Check[type:perception|dc:38|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，便能发现它的眼柄从恶臭的水面上探出窥视。

遭遇

极限 8

@Actor[RFCxaIS4OkacCpxD]{沼腐症沼喉怪}

180 XP

这只沼喉怪是如何来到湖中的仍是个谜，但在它待在此处的短暂时间里，它已经破坏了这栋建筑，并将南湖附近几乎所有的异怪与生物都驱赶走了。它有时会向北移动进行狩猎，但通常都潜伏在破碎码头旁的水下。

贝科拉之子对沼喉怪造成的伤害比他们意识到的更重；它感染了沼腐症，以奇异且令人衰弱的方式影响了它的异质生理结构。沼喉怪并非只是笨拙而已，它具有虚弱调整。

作为一名懒散的猎手，沼喉怪倾向于从水中发动攻击，且很少追击那些在真菌花园中找到庇护的人。然而，它在某种意义上十分记仇；若它失去至少一半生命值，便有一定几率（@Check[type:flat|dc:15]{纯骰}检定）陷入狂怒并跟随其攻击者登上干地。

At this southern terminus of the foul underground lake, a small wooden dock juts out from a stone and masonry building. The dock is in ruin; its front has been ripped away with massive force, leaving the rest of it sloping down into the water. The building had a door at the dock’s end, but it has been ripped off its hinges, with a chunk of the door partly submerged and leaning against the cavern wall. South of the structure, the lakeshore gives way to a forest of massive fungi. The water near the dock occasionally bubbles, as if something massive dwells somewhere below the surface.

A surly froghemoth attacked the Children of Belcorra in this outpost, damaging the dock and driving the bog mummies away. It’s the source of the bubbles in the water. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:38|traits:action:search]{Perception} check against its Stealth DC spots its eyestalk peeping above the fetid water.

Encounter

Extreme 8

@Actor[RFCxaIS4OkacCpxD]{Bog-Rotted Froghemoth}

180 XP

How the froghemoth came to the lake is a mystery, but in the short time, it has been here, it has damaged this building and driven nearly all the aberrations and creatures away from the southern lake. It sometimes makes its way north to hunt, but it’s usually lurking under the water by the shattered dock.

The Children of Belcorra injured the froghemoth more than they’ve realized; it’s afflicted with bog rot that has affected its alien physiology in strange and debilitating ways. Rather than simply being clumsy, the froghemoth has the weak adjustment.

A lazy hunter, the froghemoth tends to attack from the water and rarely pursues those who find shelter within the fungus garden. However, it’s vindictive in a way; if it loses at least half of its Hit Points, there’s a chance (@Check[type:flat|dc:15]{Flat} check) it becomes enraged and follow its attackers onto dry land.

H28. Ruined Outpost.name: H28. 废墟前哨站 H28. Ruined Outpost
H28. Ruined Outpost.text:
一张桌子和几把椅子的残骸散落在房间各处。西侧的门已被从合页上扯下，而南侧的门仍完好但敞开着。两具被撕裂、湿透的尸体瘫倒在门口。

这些尸体是贝科拉之子，在沼喉怪的横冲直撞中被毁灭。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

这间废弃的房间里没有任何值钱的东西，但东侧墙上有一扇暗门。一位正在搜索房间的英雄若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便会发现墙上的假石板，并能连同暗门的其余部分一起将其拉开。

门后是一条狭窄的通道，先向东延伸再转向北，通往另一扇设计相似的暗门。贝科拉之子使用这条通道，以获得对真菌花园北侧区域的快速许可。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The remains of a table and some chairs are scattered around the room. While the western door has been ripped off its hinges, the southern door is still intact but open. Two torn, soggy corpses are slumped in the doorway.

The corpses are Children of Belcorra who were destroyed in the froghemoth’s rampage.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

While there’s nothing of value in the abandoned room, there’s a secret door on the east wall. A hero Searching the room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spots the fake flagstone in the wall and can pull it aside with the rest of the secret door.

Beyond the door is a narrow passage heading east and then turning north, leading to another secret door of similar design. The Children of Belcorra used this passage to gain quick access to the northern reaches of the fungus garden.

H29. West Garden.name: H29. 西部花园 H29. West Garden
H29. West Garden.text:
尽管菌类森林仍在不断向高处生长，但也有迹象表明这片区域最近有人照料。岩石勾勒出一片片健康生长的区段，路径也被清理得很干净，只有零星的霉斑与菌类残留。生物发光的苔藓在整个区域提供了微弱而均匀的发光，仿佛为了这种效果而被刻意培育。向东，一座宽阔的石桥横跨一道巨大的裂谷。裂谷另一侧，一架巨大的铁梯如蛇般蜿蜒向下，深入裂谷的黑暗之中。越过桥与铁梯后，菌类森林变得更加过度蔓生。

贝科拉之子很久以前就将他们的照料范围从整个菌类花园缩减为仅限西端这一片。随着沼喉怪最近的到来，他们甚至连这里的照料也停止了。

这里的菌类无害；事实上，它们是营养丰富的食物、菌木木材以及发光苔藓的良好来源。

While the fungal forest continues to grow high, there are also signs that this area was recently tended. Rocks outline sections of healthy growth, and the paths are clear of all the but the occasional bits of mold and fungus. Bioluminescent moss provides a low, even glow throughout the area, as though intentionally cultivated for the effect. To the east, a wide stone bridge spans a massive chasm. A gigantic iron ladder snakes down into the darkness of the chasm from its other side. Beyond the bridge and the ladder, the fungal forest becomes even more overgrown.

The Children of Belcorra long ago limited their efforts from tending the entire fungus garden to only this western end. With the recent arrival of the froghemoth, they’ve even stopped their efforts here.

The fungi here are harmless; in fact, they’re good sources of nutritious food, fungus-wood lumber, and luminous moss.

H30. Lumber Shed.name: H30. 木材棚 H30. Lumber Shed
H30. Lumber Shed.text:
这座矮胖的石砌建筑看起来像一间储藏室。

作为菌类花园中三间储藏室之一，这栋建筑曾用来储存由坚韧的菌类纤维制成的木材。屋内仍堆着一堆菌木，旁边还有一捆斧头和锯子，用于采集菌类并将木板切割成形。

This squat stone building looks like a storage room.

One of three storage rooms in the fungal garden, this building was used to store wood formed from tough fungus fibers. Inside, a pile of fungus woods still sits, along with a bundle of axes and saws used to collect the fungus and cut the boards into shape.

H31. Tool Shed.name: H31. 工具棚 H31. Tool Shed
H31. Tool Shed.text:
这间棚屋上本应装锁的地方有个小洞，但洞周围只剩下锈迹的痕迹。

曾存放在这里的工具也落得和那把锁一样的下场，只剩下一堆堆锈渣，散落在斧柄、木制垫片以及其他非金属材料周围。房间中央躺着一具肥胖锈蚀怪干瘪的尸体；贝科拉之子多年前在它钻进他们的工具时就杀了它，而他们也从未费心把尸体移走。

This shed has a small hole where a lock would be, but traces of rust around the hole are all that remain there.

The tools once stored here have met the same fate as the lock and are nothing more than a piles of rust around axe handles, wooden shims, and other non-metallic materials. The shriveled corpse of a fat rust monster lies in the center of the room; the Children of Belcorra killed it years ago when it got into their tools, and they never bothered to remove it.

H32. Inhabited Shed.name: H32. 有人居住的棚 to=collate H32. Inhabited Shed
H32. Inhabited Shed.text:
这间简陋的储藏棚里堆满了细小的啃噬骨头、丢弃的鳞片，以及一股刺鼻的爬行动物恶臭。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

在此筑巢的地蜥兽异变体并不知道西侧墙壁上有一扇暗门。对房间进行搜查的英雄会发现那块用来开启暗门的伪装地砖会自动打开，因为那块地砖稍稍移位了。

宝藏

地蜥兽进食后留下的令人作呕的残渣中，藏有染血的 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.wI4Tj8bNwpZHequC]{Armbands of Athleticism}。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[xdIHvCBspeSXRL6A]{地蜥兽}

80 XP

在一段时间之前，地蜥兽从上方很远处的实验室楼层逃出，一路逃到了这里。它在周围的真菌花园中找到了绰绰有余的食物，因此从不走远，尽管它更偏好活体猎物。由于它学会了避开附近的湖泊（那里潜伏着沼喉怪），它已经有好几个月只吃到几只小蝙蝠或啮齿动物，如今渴望更大块的血肉。它会猛扑向打开这扇门的英雄，并以一往无前的狂怒发起攻击，直到被杀死为止。

This simple storage shed is filled with small, gnawed bones, discarded scales, and a pungent reptilian reek.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

The ghonhatine fleshwarp lairing here doesn’t know that there’s a secret door in the west wall. A hero who Searches the room discovers the false flagstone that opens it automatically, as the flagstone has shifted slightly out of place.

Treasure

The repulsive residue of the ghonhatine’s meals contain bloodstained @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.wI4Tj8bNwpZHequC]{Armbands of Athleticism}.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[xdIHvCBspeSXRL6A]{Ghonhatine}

80 XP

Some time ago, the ghonhatine escaped from the Laboratory level far above and fled all the way here. It has found more than enough to eat in the surrounding fungus garden, so it never ranges far, although it prefers living prey. As it has learned to avoid the nearby lake because of the lurking froghemoth, it hasn't had more than a few small bats or rodents in months, and it's eager for larger flesh. It rushes at the heroes who open this door and attacks with a single-minded fury until slain.

H33. Level 8 Portal Chamber.name: H33. 等级 8 传送门大厅 H33. Level 8 Portal Chamber
H33. Level 8 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的部分@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles}构成了更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，某人可以将这些房间中任意一间内的所有人传送至憎恨魔窟中另外九个传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地中的传送法阵都已通过@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal}仪式唤醒（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九个房间分别是区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}以及@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

这间房间的圆形墙壁上深深刻着流动的符文。符文中填充着银粉与尘埃。

这里是另一间传送门房间，内含一座未激活的传送法阵。英雄们可以使用唤醒传送门仪式，将其与憎恨魔窟其他等级中的传送法阵连接起来。

XP奖励

若英雄们使用唤醒传送门仪式重新启动此处的传送法阵，给予他们30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

The round walls of this chamber are deeply carved with flowing runes. The runes are filled with silver and dust.

This is another portal chamber containing an inactive teleportation circle. The heroes can connect it to those in other levels of the Abomination Vaults with the Awaken Portal ritual.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for using the awaken portal ritual to reactivate the teleportation circle here.

H34. Eastern Wilds.name: H34. 东方荒野 H34. Eastern Wilds
H34. Eastern Wilds.text:
跨过桥面，真菌长得更高——有些几乎长到洞窟的高顶，离地五十英尺。这里仍有旧小径的残迹，但大多被一簇簇较小的真菌或一片片苍白黏液覆盖。孢子在空气中飘散，真菌上巨大的红色花状体摆动，仿佛有风吹拂，尽管这里并没有风。一架巨大的铁制梯子垂入深邃的裂谷。支撑它的铁链每一环都大得几乎和人一样，但梯级间距设置得连小型生物也能轻松攀爬。

真菌花园的东侧已经很久没有得到适当培育，因而变得蔓生且危险。小径还算清晰，尽管杂草丛生；而洞窟其余部分若还能通行，则为高等困难地形。

这架巨大的铁制梯子向下延伸超过100英尺，通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.f4ruwhy1Yy1fliNH]{I27}。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[55SmPtsUXsridUjJ]{龙血尘菌 (2)}

80 XP

离桥最近的那片巨大真菌群落长出了两颗致命的红色龙血尘菌。这些龙血尘菌看起来像过度生长的花朵，但它们很快会脱落并漂向英雄，用其致命的花状体发动攻击。它们会追随逃跑的英雄，并一直战斗到被摧毁为止，最终在一次爆炸性喷发中消亡。

 

Across the bridge’s span, fungus grows to greater heights—some reaching nearly to the high ceiling of the cavern, fifty feet overhead. The remains of old paths remain here, but most are covered with clumps of smaller fungus or patches of pale slime. Spores drift through the air, and huge red blooms on the fungi shift as though in a wind, although there’s no wind here. An enormous iron ladder hangs down into the deep chasm. Each link of the chains that hold it up are about as large as a human, but the rungs are spaced to give even small creatures an easy climb.

The east side of the fungus garden has gone a long time without proper cultivation, which has made it overgrown and dangerous. The paths are somewhat clear, if overgrown, and the rest of the cavern is greater difficult terrain if it’s passable at all.

The gigantic iron ladder leads more than 100 feet down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.f4ruwhy1Yy1fliNH]{I27}.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[55SmPtsUXsridUjJ]{Dragon's Blood Puffballs (2)}

80 XP

The massive patch of fungus closest to the bridge has grown two deadly red puffballs. These dragon’s blood puffballs resemble overgrown flowers, but they soon detach and float toward the heroes to attack with their fatal blooms. They follow fleeing heroes and fight until destroyed in an explosive burst.

H35. Webbed Crossroads.name: H35. 蛛网交叉路 H35. Webbed Crossroads
H35. Webbed Crossroads.text:
这些杂草丛生的小径旁耸立着高大的菌类，缠满了厚重的蛛网术。蛛网术之中有几具类人生物的身影，但被蛛网术层层包裹，难以看清。

遭遇

严重 8

@Actor[T5CUuPsMPb17d6Qy]{巨硕蜘蛛}

120 XP

在此结网的饥饿巨硕蜘蛛并不在地面上，而是藏在头顶上方60英尺处天花板的一处裂隙中，并在那里获得高等掩蔽。这只蜘蛛以其“蛛网上降”能力发起突袭，让猎物措手不及。若其生命值降至40点以下，它会撤退到高处天花板裂隙的安全处。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.cKqZe5imzxqSnzwD]{Jade Bauble} Darkwood Shield @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.9XSOAzq3xp9g6qkF]{Dust of Disappearance}

被蛛网术裹住的尸体是一具干枯的透肌魔人，以及两具来自伊尔达里斯、死去时间更近的卓尔。清理每具尸体上的厚重蛛网术需要半小时。

透肌魔人携带着一枚翡翠小饰物以及一面标准纯度的暗木盾。其中一具卓尔尸体上有个小袋，里面装着消像尘。

The towering fungi around these overgrown paths are laced in thick webbing. Within are a few humanoid figures, too shrouded in webs to see clearly.

Encounter

Severe 8

@Actor[T5CUuPsMPb17d6Qy]{Goliath Spider}

120 XP

The hungry goliath spider that has made its web here isn’t on the ground, but hiding in a crevasse in the ceiling 60 feet above, where it has greater cover. The spider begins its assault with its Descend on a Web ability to catch its prey off guard. If reduced to fewer than 40 Hit Points, it retreats for the safety of its ceiling crevasse high above.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.cKqZe5imzxqSnzwD]{Jade Bauble} Darkwood Shield @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.9XSOAzq3xp9g6qkF]{Dust of Disappearance}

The webbed corpses are a desiccated urdefhan and two much-more-recently killed drow from Yldaris. It takes half an hour to clear the thick webbing from each corpse.

The urdefhan carries a jade bauble and a standard-grade darkwood shield. One of the drow corpses has a pouch containing dust of disappearance.

H36. Rounded Wall.name: H36. 圆形墙壁 H36. Rounded Wall
H36. Rounded Wall.text:
这片菌类比其余部分更低，尽管看不出任何栽培的迹象。其他真菌之间夹杂着球状的绿色增生物。洞穴后壁透过一团飘散的孢子云隐约可见；那不是天然岩石，而是一块苍白、弧形、无缝的石头。

这面墙是高处的凄凉灯塔占地的一部分，因此对伤害免疫。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

弧形墙上有一扇暗门，提供进入结构内部的许可（区域 @UUID[.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}）；与区域 @UUID[.L9JdFdozxxuly8RY]{H01} 的暗门一样，它很容易找到（@Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{察觉}），但只有将支点透镜放入其凹槽中才会开启。

遭遇

低 8

@Actor[SUpy8sleRwi2Egsq]{盗袭瘤菌}

60 XP

这些孢子与绿色增生物属于栖息在此的一只盗袭瘤菌。它会攻击任何靠近的活体生物，向上漂浮并露出带钩的触手。若其生命值降至 20 点以下，它会升至天花板并试图向南漂走。

如果英雄们尚未处理潜伏在区域 @UUID[.b0AhkI9gXf14Ns4p]{H35} 上方的巨硕蜘蛛，盗袭瘤菌会漂浮到它裂缝正下方。蜘蛛会突然飞镖般窜出，杀死盗袭瘤菌，然后退回它的藏身洞。这可能会提醒英雄们蜘蛛就在那里！

This patch of fungus sits lower than the rest, though it bears no signs of cultivation. Amid the other fungi are bulbous green growths. The back wall of the cavern is visible through a cloud of drifting spores; it isn’t natural rock, but a pale, curved, seamless stone.

The wall is part of the footprint of Gauntlight high above and is thus impervious to damage.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A secret door in the curved wall provides access to the structure’s interior (area @UUID[.rVwX8eSwEBHWEjcg]{H37}); like the secret door in area @UUID[.L9JdFdozxxuly8RY]{H01}, it’s easy to find (@Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{Perception}) but only opens when a fulcrum lens is placed into its indentation.

Encounter

Low 8

@Actor[SUpy8sleRwi2Egsq]{Drakauthix}

60 XP

The spores and green growths belong to a drakauthix lairing here. It attacks any living creatures that approach, floating upward to reveal its hooked tentacles. If reduced to fewer than 20 Hit Points, it ascends to the ceiling and tries to float away to the south.

If the heroes haven’t dealt with the goliath spider lurking above area @UUID[.b0AhkI9gXf14Ns4p]{H35}, the drakauthix floats right beneath its crevasse. The spider darts out, kills the drakauthix, and retreats into its bolt-hole. This might alert the heroes that the spider is there!

H37. Upper Pit.name: H37。上坑 H37. Upper Pit
H37. Upper Pit.text:
这个宽阔的圆形房间由苍白的石头砌成，覆满尘埃。房间中央立着一个带石质边沿的坑洞。一条蓝色的光带在空中盘旋扭动，从天花板延伸而下没入坑中。天花板的石头与坑壁在这诡异的光芒中起伏翻涌，仿佛石头本身正在受苦。

这处坑洞向下贯穿凄凉灯塔最底层的各个楼层。这条能量光带表明凄凉灯塔正在汲取更多力量，而英雄们可能曾在地城的更高楼层见过类似的光带。一个活体生物在直径5英尺的光带内结束其回合时，会受到[[/r 10d6[negative]]]伤害（@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免）；与在上层发现的光带不同，这股能量不会治疗不死生物。

坑洞向下延伸超过100英尺，通往狩猎场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.NaEg1IQHphXU25Nk]{I28}）上一处类似的房间，然后再向下100英尺通往空无之窟（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}），贝科拉通常栖居于此。

This large, circular room is made of pale stone and covered with dust. At its center stands a single, stone-lipped pit. A twisting ribbon of blue light coils and twists in the air, extending from the ceiling down into the pit. The stone of the ceiling and the walls of the pit undulate in the eerie light as though the stone itself were suffering.

This pit leads down through Gauntlight’s lowest levels. The ribbon of energy shows that Gauntlight is drawing even more power, and the heroes might have seen a ribbon like it in the dungeon’s higher levels. A living creature ending its turn within the 5-foot-diameter ribbon of light takes [[/r 10d6[negative]]] damage (@Check[type:reflex|dc:26|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save); unlike the ribbons discovered in the upper levels, this energy doesn’t heal undead creatures.

The pit leads down over 100 feet to a similar chamber on the Hunting Grounds (area @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.NaEg1IQHphXU25Nk]{I28}) and then another 100 feet to the Empty Vault (area @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.a9b40LjI7QwLgirk]{J20}), where Belcorra typically dwells.

H38. Strange Sentry.name: H38. 奇异哨兵 H38. Strange Sentry
H38. Strange Sentry.text:
沿着菌类小径接近尽头时，一座石砌结构从洞窟墙壁上突出来，中央有一扇门。

这座结构曾作为一处路标，让贝科拉之子能通过微灵与他们的幽灵女王交谈。他们离开东部菌类花园时便废弃了这栋建筑。

遭遇

微不足道 8

@Actor[mlifDVJJWwjFtUxv]{Murmur}

40 XP

一种阴森、类似树懒的怪物，称为虐戾怪，搬进了这座结构，但它在外面留下了一名守卫：一位被施加了弱智的美杜莎，它称其为“呢喃”。呢喃站在门前，兜帽拉起，喃喃自语着令人无法理解的词句。

对于8级角色而言，呢喃不太可能构成多大挑战，但她暗示着有些古怪的事情正在发生。若生物保持距离，她会用弓战斗——她几乎只剩下些许记得如何使用。若敌人逼近，她便丢下弓，逃进区域 @UUID[.kmyJE9Ayf9xywLVB]{H29} 与她的主人会合。

支线任务

恢复呢喃的心智是一项挑战，但并非不可能。若英雄们恢复了她，这位美杜莎会自我介绍为晨光，并提出在与他们并肩作战几天后再自行离去。她专横而残忍，所以英雄们可能并不想要她的援助；如果英雄们不希望她留在身边，她也完全乐意更早离开。

Toward the end of the fungal path, a masonry structure juts out from the cavern wall, a door at its center.

The structure served as a waypoint where the Children of Belcorra could converse with their Ghost Queen through the wisps. They abandoned this building when they left the eastern fungus garden.

Encounter

Trivial 8

@Actor[mlifDVJJWwjFtUxv]{Murmur}

40 XP

A sinister, sloth-like monster called a nilith moved into the structure, but it left a guardian outside: a feebleminded medusa it calls Murmur. Murmur stands in front of the door, her hood up, muttering unintelligible words to herself.

Murmur isn’t likely to pose much of a challenge for 8th-level characters, but she’s an indication that something strange is afoot. She fights with her bow, which she only barely remembers how to use, if creatures remain at a distance. If foes close in, she drops her bow and flees into area @UUID[.kmyJE9Ayf9xywLVB]{H29} to join her master.

Side Quest

Restoring Murmur’s mind is a challenge, but it isn’t impossible. If the heroes restore her, the medusa introduces herself as Moadenn and offers to fight alongside them for a few days before striking off on her own. She’s bossy and cruel, so the heroes might not want her aid; she’s perfectly happy to depart sooner if the heroes don’t want her around.

H39. Lair of the Dreamer.name: H39. 梦者之巢 H39. Lair of the Dreamer
H39. Lair of the Dreamer.text:
这个方形房间里的三个壁龛被细长的蘑菇菌柄与匍匐开花藤蔓的纠结丛覆盖。空气中弥漫着甜腻而浓烈的气味。

每个壁龛里都有石制盆槽，和区域 @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} 与 @UUID[.mXZ6lvqCGglrVRyc]{H11} 中的相似。它们曾用于与下方的沼泽相连，但在此筑巢的虐戾怪不想受到打扰。它把盆槽里的淤泥拉出，用真菌树脂涂覆其内部，并将其改作花盆，用来栽培能让它想起自己在梦境界故乡的植被。若英雄将其清理干净，盆槽会再次灌满恶臭的沼泽水，并且每个盆槽上方都会出现一只鬼火。它们的观察会触发贝科拉攻击！事件，如 @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.em5wJ44hCXP8mGGG]{Belcorra Attacks!} 中所述。

遭遇

中等 8

@Actor[PfcS6WzhMGzds5Wf]{虐戾怪}

80 XP

虐戾怪在房间里的藤蔓间攀爬，漫不经心地照料花朵。它已经对“咕哝”感到厌倦，正在寻找其他心智来扭曲，但如果英雄看起来愿意，它也乐意先交谈。它会谈起这些盆槽如何连接到下方深处某片恶毒的沼泽，并得意地展示它用树脂将其封住、以培育自己怪异花园的方法。它说话时会试图将英雄从最弱的心智到最强进行排序，以便知道该用精神攻击优先瞄准谁。它可能会提出谜题或谜语来弄清这一点，或询问英雄最近的梦境。

催眠花粉

空气中的花粉使房间内的活体生物（虐戾怪除外）在意志豁免上承受–1环境减值。这是嗅觉效果。

宝藏

@Actor[6OrsuoAvyTpqqtxe]{悬挂的宝藏}

藏在虐戾怪垂挂纠结的藤蔓深处的是它的宝藏，包括一个装有253 sp的袋子、三颗每颗价值60 gp的黄玉宝石、一枚雷鸣符文石，以及一份中等狂徒纯酿。

Three alcoves in this square chamber are overgrown with a tangle of thin mushroom stalks and creeping, flowering vines. The air smells sweet and heady.

The alcoves each contain stone basins, like those in areas @UUID[.0EtecMBSYJDok7n7]{H02} and @UUID[.mXZ6lvqCGglrVRyc]{H11}. They used to provide a connection to the swamps below, but the nilith lairing here didn’t want the interruption. It pulled the muck from the basins, coated their interiors with a fungal resin, and repurposed them as planters to grow vegetation that remind it of its former home in the Dreamlands. If the heroes clean them out, they refill with fetid swamp water once again, and a will-o’-wisp appears above each. Their observation triggers the Belcorra Attacks! event, as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.em5wJ44hCXP8mGGG]{Belcorra Attacks!}.

Encounter

Moderate 8

@Actor[PfcS6WzhMGzds5Wf]{Nilith}

80 XP

The nilith climbs around on the vines in this room, idly tending the flowers. It is bored with Murmur and is looking for other minds to twist, but it’s willing to engage in conversation first if the heroes seem amenable. It talks about how the basins connect to some malignant swamp far down, and it proudly shows off its means of sealing them with resin to grow its own strange garden. As it talks, it tries to rank the heroes from the weakest mind to the strongest, so it knows who to target best with its mental attacks. It might propose puzzles or riddles to find this out or ask the heroes about their recent dreams.

Soporific Pollen

The pollen in the air gives living creatures in the room (except the nilith) a –1 circumstance penalty on Will saves. This is an olfactory effect.

Treasure

@Actor[6OrsuoAvyTpqqtxe]{Hanging Treasure}

Hidden deep in the nilith's hanging tangles is its treasure, consisting of a bag with 253 sp, three topaz gemstones worth 60 gp each, a thundering runestone, and a moderate bravo's brew.

H40. Between a Rock and a Doorway.name: H40. 进退两难 H40. Between a Rock and a Doorway
H40. Between a Rock and a Doorway.text:
小径在一扇通向西方的门前结束。东方有一块覆盖着蛛网般雕刻的巨大巨石，堵住了洞穴入口。
