Before he succumbed to starvation, the erudite wizard cobbled together reagents to mummify himself with parchment paper, hoping to one day escape his bounds and inflict revenge on Jafaki, whom Chafkhem believed ordered him to be imprisoned in his room.

In his isolation, Chafkhem has attempted to devise a means of escape by creating a temporary portal through the wall. A simple mistake in his assumptions rendered all his calculations incorrect, and he has failed to get the spell to work—a point of great frustration for the vainglorious mummy.

The magic circle at the center of the room assists Chafkhem with maintaining magical energy. The circle gives him a +2 status bonus to skill checks when performing rituals. Additionally, he’s quickened while within the circle but can use the additional action only to Sustain a Spell.

Encounter

Severe 5

@Actor[x0NDgH3EMLTLh02r]{Chafkhem}

120 XP

When the heroes unseal his chamber, Chafkhem holds up his parchment-wrapped arms to show he means no harm. He’s genuinely thankful for his release and quite charming by nature. Unfortunately, he’s as bossy in undeath as he was in life, and he soon starts demanding, rather than requesting, information from the heroes about the current status of the seugathis and the Abomination Vaults. If the heroes don’t indulge Chafkhem, he decides to kill them and animate them as undead who don’t talk back nearly as much.

Side Quest

As long as the heroes obey Chafkhem’s demands and suffer his imperious demeanor, he can be a font of information. His initial attitude toward the heroes is indifferent, but they can improve it with a successful Diplomacy check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} (or another relevant skill, such as Deception to Lie or Arcana to Recall Knowledge that impresses him). The DC for this check is 27 (Chafkhem’s Will DC).

Chafkem's Information

If the heroes get on Chafkhem’s good side, he speaks with open contempt about the seugathis that Belcorra permitted to operate their fleshwarping laboratory on the next lower level, as they displaced arena functions Chafkhem controlled. He doesn’t know precisely how many seugathis remain, but he describes their leader as an alchemist and fleshwarper named Jafaki, whom he blames for locking him in this room to die several centuries ago. Chafkhem wants revenge against Jafaki, and he suggests that the heroes seek it on his behalf.

Chafkhem knows Belcorra is long dead, although he expresses concern if the heroes let him know that she also returned as an undead creature. Chafkhem makes plans to depart the Abomination Vaults and return to his native Osirion; whether the heroes want to let an evil mummy go free is up to them.

Killing Jafaki

Chafkhem takes 2d4 days to put his papers in order and carefully replicate the arcane patterns of his magic circle before he leaves. If the heroes return in that time with proof that they’ve slain Jafaki or that the imp Szek orchestrated Chafkhem’s imprisonment, the mummy expresses his gratitude and rewards them with information. He sketches out the entirety of the Arena level for them, including all its secret doors and passages, and provides the heroes with the magical passphrase to disable the trap in area E20. He doesn’t have any blank parchment, so he writes on his spellbook page containing freedom of movement; the heroes can later @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} from that page, in addition to having the useful map.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Chafkhem’s desk contains hundreds of pieces of parchment with writing covering every bit of space. For many years, Chafkhem only had access to this parchment, and he has made full use of it. These papers not only serve as Chafkhem’s spellbook, allowing heroes to Learn a Spell from them, but also contain the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} and @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} rituals. Any hero who spends time Investigating these papers discovers both rituals.

E18. Level 5 Portal Chamber.name: E18. 等级 5 传送门厅 E18. Level 5 Portal Chamber
E18. Level 5 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟中的一些@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles}构成了更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，某人可以将这些房间中的任意一间内的所有人传送到憎恨魔窟中另外九个传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地房间中的传送法阵都已通过@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal}仪式唤醒（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九个房间分别是区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}以及@UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

这间房间的门上了锁，而查夫肯姆持有唯一的钥匙。英雄可以通过一次成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}打开，或通过四次成功的@Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}。

石墙上刻满了旋转的符文，并以白银填充，覆盖了这间圆形房间的墙面。地面被打磨得光滑如镜，天花板也同样光滑，位于上方10英尺处。

英雄们可能已经发现了贝科拉在地城上层安装的、用于在憎恨魔窟中快速移动的永久性传送法阵的停用网络。如果他们发现了唤醒传送门仪式，甚至可能已开始修复这套网络（若他们未在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}找到该仪式，则可在区域@UUID[.5XJBjPHU2XkIZWtN]{E17}中查夫肯姆的笔记里找到）。这间房间还包含另一个未激活的传送法阵，英雄们可以将其与他们已重新唤醒的其他法阵连接起来。

XP奖励

若英雄使用唤醒传送门仪式重新激活此房间的魔法，奖励英雄30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

The door to this room is locked, and Chafkhem has the only key. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:25|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} Checks.

Swirling runes carved into the stone and filled with silver cover the walls of this circular chamber. The floor is polished smooth, as is the ceiling 10 feet above.

The heroes might have discovered the inactive network of permanent teleportation circles Belcorra installed to move quickly throughout the Abomination Vaults in the dungeon’s upper levels. The heroes could have even started restoring the network if they discovered the awaken portal ritual (if they didn’t find this ritual in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}, they can find it in Chafkhem’s notes in area @UUID[.5XJBjPHU2XkIZWtN]{E17}). This room contains yet another inactive teleportation circle that the heroes can connect to others they’ve already reawakened.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for using the awaken portal ritual to reactivate this room’s magic.

E19. Spying Chamber.name: E19. 窥探室 E19. Spying Chamber
E19. Spying Chamber.text:
一扇由单向透明石构成的窗户使任何身处此房间内的人都能观察恢弘长廊中的动静。从恢弘长廊一侧看去，这块石头是不透明的，而且这扇窗户无法被侦测到。从这一侧触摸透明石的任何人，都能通过一个恒定的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience}效果听到恢弘长廊中的一切声音。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

这间朴素房间最引人注目的特征，是通往@UUID[.DKiYbkAmfzGL3UgV]{Grand Concourse}的密门。从这一侧看，密门并不明显，因此角色必须在一次@Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定中成功，才能定位术它。一位知晓在恢弘长廊一侧开启此门的敲击顺序的英雄，也可以从这一侧打开密门，使门变得如幽灵般虚幻且无实体。

@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience}

A window of one-way transparent stone allows anyone from within this room to view events in the grand concourse. The stone appears opaque from the concourse side, and the window is undetectable. Anyone touching the transparent stone from this side can hear anything in the concourse through a permanent @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} effect.

Exploration

@UUID[.DKiYbkAmfzGL3UgV]{Grand Concourse}

This unadorned room’s most notable feature is the secret door that leads to the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience}. The secret door isn’t obvious from this side, so a character must succeed at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check to locate it. A hero who knows the series of knocks that opens the door in the grand concourse can also open the secret door from this side, making the door ghostly and incorporeal.

E20. Secret Hallway.name: E20. 秘密大厅 E20. Secret Hallway
E20. Secret Hallway.text:
骨骸与被肢解的断肢散落在这条不规则、分叉的走廊各处。

贝科拉与查夫肯姆曾从这条秘密走廊窥探角斗士，疑神疑鬼地担心叛乱。每当贝科拉与查夫肯姆都不在场时，他们就会启动一处致命陷阱，以保护走廊免受入侵者侵扰。这里的断肢曾属于双尾虫怪、潜伏客，以及数个血肉畸变的生物——它们在过去数年间尝试对抗该陷阱却都失败了。

这些参差不齐的走廊里有数块单向透明石块，可用来观察角斗士的住处。这些石块从房间内侧看起来是不透明的，且无法被侦测到。从走廊这一侧触摸透明石块的任何人，都能通过一个永久性的 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} 效果听到房间内的声音。

这条分叉走廊里的两扇暗门（通往区域 @UUID[.FwUjauqbfGI6Fu0b]{E14} 与 @UUID[.lOKp958Fy3lwvV66]{E24}）从这一侧看起来十分明显。

遭遇

严重 5

@Actor[VsRKgjKolLsJMd0I]{换位镰刃}

120 XP

这处镰刃陷阱最初旨在阻止入侵者进入这条秘密走廊，但它目前也妨碍了双尾虫怪探索此处的行动。分叉走廊相接处那片15尺×25尺的区域内布满了数十块压力板，只要有人在该区域内任何位置移动，就会触发陷阱。

三条狭窄走廊都没有压力板，尽管刀刃会穿过它们。陷阱会用刀刃猛击，随后收回刀刃并暗中重新移动位置，使得刀刃的下一次打击更难预测。

 

Bones and dismembered limbs lay scattered throughout this irregular, branching hallway.

Belcorra and Chafkhem spied on gladiators from this secret hall, paranoid about insurrection. When neither Belcorra nor Chafkhem was present, they activated a deadly trap to protect the hall from intruders. The severed limbs here once belonged to seugathis, skulks, and several fleshwarped creatures who tried and failed to contend with the trap over the past several years.

The jagged halls contain several blocks of one-way transparent stone offering a view into the gladiators’ quarters. The stone appears opaque from within the rooms and can’t be detected. Anyone touching a transparent stone from this side can hear in the room through a permanent @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.HXhWYJviWalN5tQ2]{Clairaudience} effect.

The two secret doors in this branching hall (leading to areas @UUID[.FwUjauqbfGI6Fu0b]{E14} and @UUID[.lOKp958Fy3lwvV66]{E24}) are obvious from this side.

Encounter

Severe 5

@Actor[VsRKgjKolLsJMd0I]{Shuffling Scythe Blades}

120 XP

Originally intended to keep intruders out of the secret hall, a scythe trap currently interferes with the seugathis’ efforts to explore this area. The 15-foot-by-25-foot area where the branching hallways connect contains dozens of pressure plates that trigger the trap when someone moves anywhere in the area.

None of the three narrow halls have any pressure plates, though the blades pass through them. The trap lashes out with its blades, then retracts them and moves them around secretly so the blades’ next Strikes are hard to predict.

E21. Staging Area.name: E21. 集结区 E21. Staging Area
E21. Staging Area.text:
这间奇形怪状的房间地面上，布满大片黑暗变色的干涸液体污渍。西侧墙边立着一张石制书桌，上面摆着工具、瓶子与罐子，装着各式各样的物质。

在这里，贝科拉的特工记录他们窥探到的角斗士情报。最近，贾法基的爪牙投入时间和资源，试图破坏北侧走廊里的镰刃陷阱，并在此处筹划他们的尝试。带有一排排刻痕的羊皮纸显示，当陷阱触发时，刀刃会如何在走廊中来回移动。双尾虫怪一直在试图从这种无序中找出规律，却始终无功而返。

通往东南的门洞通向一段狭窄而陡峭的楼梯，向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.fIH3LXVbvaKFJzOc]{F08} 的看台长廊。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.uhka9LHEP3wDKytG]{Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.evBPzM1VsuYcoenn]{Moderate Tanglefoot Bags (3)}

英雄们可以在桌上找到一套扩展炼金实验室和三个中等绊足包。

@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.fIH3LXVbvaKFJzOc]{F08} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.uhka9LHEP3wDKytG]{Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)}

Large, dark discolored patches of dried fluids adorn the floor of this oddly shaped chamber. A stone desk stands against the west wall and holds tools, bottles, and jars of a variety of substances.

Here, Belcorra’s agents kept notes about the gladiators they spied upon. Recently, Jafaki’s minions have spent time and resources trying to disable the scythe trap in the hallway to the north, and they stage their attempts here. Parchment marked with tick marks indicates how the blades shuffle around the hallway when triggered. The seugathis have sought a pattern in the randomness without any luck.

The doorway to the southeast opens to a cramped and steep staircase, which leads down to the observation gallery in area @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.evBPzM1VsuYcoenn]{Moderate Tanglefoot Bags (3)}.

Treasure

@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.fIH3LXVbvaKFJzOc]{F08} @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.uhka9LHEP3wDKytG]{Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)}

The heroes can find an expanded alchemist's lab and three moderate tanglefoot bags on the table.

E22. Sludge-Filled Room.name: E22. 满是污泥的房间 E22. Sludge-Filled Room
E22. Sludge-Filled Room.text:
数英尺厚的黑色浓泥充满了这个房间。这些浓泥是一只生物，但随意一看并不明显（例如通过区域 @UUID[.SeCEB4alINSAplfd]{E20} 的单向石观察房间）。几周前，贾法基发现乌瑞维安的一名魔鬼在四处探查，便将其引诱进这间房室，并放入一只经炼金改造的黑布丁怪。软泥杀死了那名魔鬼，并将其彻底溶解。

遭遇

中等 5

@Actor[5iuvJLceeLJPlR8O]{粘稠黑布丁怪}

80 XP

若受到惊扰，黑布丁怪会从昏沉中苏醒以进食，并无情地追击猎物。

为反映这一变化，你可以使用 @Macro[sgMuWDSwQymmOhIE]{E22 - Viscous Black Pudding} 宏，一次性切换地砖与指示物的可见性。

 

Several feet of thick, black sludge fill this room. The sludge is a creature, but that’s not obvious upon a casual look (such as viewing the room through the one-way stone in area @UUID[.SeCEB4alINSAplfd]{E20}). Several weeks ago, Jafaki caught one of Urevian’s devils poking around, lured them into this chamber, and sent in an alchemically modified black pudding. The ooze killed the devil and dissolved them completely.

Encounter

Moderate 5

@Actor[5iuvJLceeLJPlR8O]{Viscous Black Pudding}

80 XP

If disturbed, the black pudding rouses from its torpor to feed, pursuing prey relentlessly.

To reflect this change, you can use the @Macro[sgMuWDSwQymmOhIE]{E22 - Viscous Black Pudding} macro to toggle the visibility of the tile and token in one go.

E23. Empty Gladiators’ Quarters.name: E23. 空的角斗士单间 E23. Empty Gladiators’ Quarters
E23. Empty Gladiators’ Quarters.text:
这些房间里除了单人床、一个空的脚柜和一个金属夜壶外别无他物。任何有价值的东西早在很久以前就被剥夺一空，每个房间都留有被用作牢房的痕迹。

每扇门的内侧曾经都装有一根金属门闩以保证私密性，但在一段时间之前，这些门闩都被移到外侧，以便将生物困在里面。不过，这次重新安装也使门闩有些松动，因此，一名角色若成功通过一次 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20]{Thievery} 检定，便能从门内打开上闩的门。

These chambers include nothing more than a single bed, an empty footlocker, and a metal chamber pot. Anything of value was stripped long ago, and each room has signs of being used as a prison.

A metal bolt was once mounted on each door’s interior side for privacy, but some time ago, each of the bolts was relocated to the exterior to keep creatures trapped inside. This remounting has somewhat loosened the bolts, however, and a character who succeeds at a @Check[type:thievery|dc:20]{Thievery} check can open a bolted door from the inside.

E24. Hall of Heroes.name: E24. 英雄大厅 E24. Hall of Heroes
E24. Hall of Heroes.text:
一幅巨大的壁画环绕着整个房间；这幅壁画描绘了变异并经过血肉扭曲的武者，怪诞而强大，站在一道诡异的蓝色光束之中，身处一间圆形房间。蓝色光束源自一座高耸的凄凉灯塔，这些非人的勇士从光中跃出，屠杀人类、精灵以及其他居住在地表的生物。

壁画描绘了竞技场中最伟大的武者如何被凄凉灯塔的魔法送上战场。该展示旨在激励角斗士更狂热地战斗，从而可能让他们赢得以贝科拉之名在地表作战的权利。英雄们很可能还记得凄凉灯塔的这一作用：在第2章中，该遗珍最近一次试射唤醒了奥塔里的死者，并将一只油鳞蛛送入英雄们的身边。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

一位正在搜索这间房间的英雄在一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定后，会发现西墙上有一扇通往区域 @UUID[.SeCEB4alINSAplfd]{E20} 的秘密门。戳按壁画中一只强烈变异的食人魔双眼里的两个按钮，会使墙体的一部分向上滑入天花板。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

A giant mural wraps around this entire chamber; this mural depicts mutated and fleshwarped warriors, grotesque and powerful, standing in a round room within a beam of eerie blue light. The blue light originates from a tall lighthouse, and the inhuman champions spring forth from the light to slaughter humans, elves, and other surface-dwelling creatures.

The mural portrays how the arena’s greatest warriors would be sent into battle by Gauntlight’s magic. The display was intended to spur the gladiators to fight more fervently, which could have earned them the right to battle on the surface in Belcorra’s name. The heroes likely remember this function of Gauntlight from the artifact’s recent test firing that awakened Otari’s dead and sent a scalathrax into the heroes’ midst in Chapter 2.

Exploration

@UUID[.SeCEB4alINSAplfd]{E20} 

A hero Searching this room discovers a secret door in the west wall that leads to area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check. Poking two buttons in the eyes of a powerfully mutated ogre shown in the mural causes a section of the wall to slide upward into the ceiling.

E25. Gladiators’ Mead Hall.name: E25. 角斗士的宴会厅 E25. Gladiators’ Mead Hall
E25. Gladiators’ Mead Hall.text:
翻倒的桌子和长凳全都由石化木制成，散落在这间宽阔房间的边缘。苍白的骨头夹杂在这些家具之间。几颗保存完好的怪物头颅与银质铭牌装点着墙壁。东侧一处壁龛的地面上刻着一圈发光的符文。

贝科拉的角斗士们在这间房里消磨闲暇时光。那些保存完好的怪物头颅展示了为娱乐而杀死的生物，包括一只蜥蜴怪、一只奇美拉，以及三只蝎狮。铭牌用以纪念竞技场中的胜利；其中许多刻有日期，而所有胜利都发生在4235 ar至4244 ar的10年期间内。坚固的家具尽管被掀翻，却依然完好无损。

南面的门通往一段极为陡峭、向下延伸至测试场（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{F09}）的楼梯。很少有人走下这些台阶，但在下方战斗中落败者会沿此上行。

这圈符文标记着一道永久且仍在运作的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circle}，与其正下方测试场中的法阵相连。这道传送法阵可以双向运作，但不会与遍布憎恨魔窟的传送门房间网络相连接。踏入该传送法阵的生物，会在@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{Testing Grounds}中出现，伴随一阵淡蓝色火焰的爆发与响亮的金属撞击声（火焰主要用于戏剧效果，既不够明亮也不够炽热，无法造成伤害）。任何使用该传送法阵旅行至测试场的人，额头上都会出现一个魔法印记，用亚克罗语写着“挑战者”。任何使用该传送法阵返回此处的人，则会得到写着“胜利者”的魔法印记。一道由传送法阵施放的新的魔法印记，会替换任何旧的魔法印记。

遭遇

中等 5

@Actor[rketcmqDQJbFFYfq]{骸骨角斗士}

80 XP

散落的角斗士骸骨——在贝科拉陨落后不久于此被屠戮——仍牢牢抓住死亡与战斗的阴郁记忆。当有活物接近时，它们会咔啦作响并在房间里滑动，汇聚成一名由数个类人生物杂骨拼成的巨大角斗士。它会试图追击逃跑的敌人，但它无法挤过任何通往房间外的门，这使得其他人能相当轻松地逃脱它。它会战斗直到被摧毁为止。

当骷髅（特征）开始重新组装自身时，你可以使用此宏来同时切换骨堆与骷髅（特征）的可见性！

@Macro[QzesHWK5dtA7QbVH]{E25 - Bone Gladiator}

 

Overturned tables and benches, all made of petrified wood, lie scattered around the edges of this expansive chamber. Pale bones are interspersed with these furnishings. Several preserved monster heads and silver plaques adorn the walls. A glowing circle of runes is etched on the floor of an alcove to the east.

Belcorra’s gladiators spent their leisure time in this room. The preserved monster heads display creatures killed for sport, including a basilisk, a chimera, and three manticores. The plaques commemorate victories in the arena; many bear dates, and all occurred within a 10-year period from 4235 ar to 4244 ar. The sturdy furniture, though upended, remains intact.

The door to the south leads to a very steep staircase descending to the testing grounds (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{F09}). Rarely did anyone descend these stairs, though losers from the fights below ascended them.

The circle of runes marks a permanent, active @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circle} that connects to the circle in the testing grounds directly beneath it. This teleportation circle functions both ways but doesn’t connect to the portal chamber network throughout the Abomination Vaults. A creature stepping into the teleportation circle appears in the @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{Testing Grounds} amid a blast of pale blue fire and a loud clanging noise (the fire is principally for dramatic effect and isn’t bright or hot enough to cause damage). Anyone using the teleportation circle to travel to the testing grounds appears with a sigil on their forehead that reads “challenger” in Aklo. Anyone using the teleportation circle to return here receives a sigil that reads “victor” instead. A new casting of sigil by the teleportation circle replaces any old one.

Encounter

Moderate 5

@Actor[rketcmqDQJbFFYfq]{Bone Gladiator}

80 XP

The scattered bones of gladiators, slaughtered here shortly after Belcorra’s fall, still hold on to the grim memory of death and combat. When a living creature approaches, they rattle and slide across the room, forming a massive gladiator made from the assorted bones of several humanoids. It tries to pursue foes that flee, but it can’t fit through any of the doors leading out of this room, which allows others to escape it fairly easily. It fights until destroyed.

When the skeleton begins to reassemble itself, you can use this macro to toggle the visibility of the bones and the skeleton at the same time!

@Macro[QzesHWK5dtA7QbVH]{E25 - Bone Gladiator}

E26. Arena Balcony.name: E26. 竞技场看台 E26. Arena Balcony
E26. Arena Balcony.text:
本区仅代表一座巨大竞技场的上半部分。@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.pPa93mirtnlxQxlr]{Arena Floor}承载了此处大部分威胁。

沿着这间巨大的洞穴厅堂边缘，有一条宽阔的步道，可俯瞰下方三十尺处的石质竞技场地面。六座带内建座椅的阳台提供了最佳视野。每座阳台都伸出一支明亮的火把，照亮整座竞技场，同时让这层观景区笼罩在幽影之中。厅堂东端悬挂着一面巨大的金属锣，系在粗大的铁链上。两段陡峭的楼梯从竞技场地面北侧的中央阳台向下延伸。

贝科拉与她的宾客曾在此处奢华的座席上观看血腥竞技，在角斗士彼此对决或对抗可怖的怪物时为其喝彩。北侧中央阳台上有两根大型操纵杆与曲柄轮，用来控制楼梯底部通往竞技场地面的各道闸门。任何在此阳台进行探索的人，很可能会引起栖息在附近@UUID[.DKiYbkAmfzGL3UgV]{Grand Concourse}里的石化蜥蜴的注意。

英雄们从这里可以轻易看到竞技场地面上的巨型塑肉残渣巨兽。除非他们制造出荒谬程度的噪音或对塑肉残渣发动攻击，否则它会保持休眠（若英雄们仍只有5级，这大概是最好的情况）。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

西侧阳台上有一扇暗门，很难发现。一名角色若成功通过一次@Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，便会定位术到它，并且还能确定一套特殊的敲击顺序，可使门变得幽灵般且无形无质，让英雄们得以穿过。

宝藏

六座阳台上燃烧的六支火把均为@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torches}，拆卸它们几乎不费力气。

@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.pPa93mirtnlxQxlr]{Arena Floor}

This section represents only the top half of a massive arena. The @UUID[.DKiYbkAmfzGL3UgV]{Grand Concourse} holds the majority of the threat here.

A wide walkway around this cavernous chamber looks out over a stone arena floor thirty feet below. Six balconies with built-in seating provide the best view. Each balcony has a bright torch jutting from it, illuminating the entire arena while leaving this viewing level shrouded in shadows. An enormous metal gong on the eastern end of the chamber hangs on thick chains. Two steep staircases lead down from the central balcony on the north side of the arena floor.

Belcorra and her guests watched the blood sports from sumptuous seating here, cheering on the gladiators as they faced off against each other or against terrifying monsters. The north central balcony has two large levers and crank wheels to control each of the portcullises at the bottom of the stairs that lead to the arena floor. Anyone exploring this balcony likely draws the attention of the basilisks lairing nearby in the @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

The heroes can easily see the gargantuan shanrigol behemoth on the arena floor from here. Unless they make an absurd amount of noise or attack the shanrigol, it remains dormant (probably for the best if the heroes are still only 5th level).

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torches}

A secret door on the western balcony is difficult to spot. A character who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:25|traits:action:search]{Perception} check locates it, and they also determine the special series of knocks that turns the door ghostly and incorporeal, allowing the heroes to pass through.

Treasure

The six torches burning at the balconies are all @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.pPa93mirtnlxQxlr]{Arena Floor} and take a minimal amount of effort to remove.

Chapter 5: Into the Training Grounds.name: 第 5 章：进入训练场 Chapter 5: Into the Training Grounds
Chapter 5: Into the Training Grounds.text:
章节概述

本章以英雄们寻找进入憎恨魔窟中层等级所需的最后几件遗珍为开端，但近期发生的@UUID[.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{Theft}使这项任务变得复杂。英雄们在一处偏远的@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{remote cave}中与窃贼卡曼·拉贾尼对峙，他们必须决定该如何处置他——而他们尚未意识到，这个选择会在之后带来意义重大的后果。随后，他们可以探索憎恨魔窟的第五层，其中充斥着无主的恐怖之物与恶毒的灵体，并处理一桩与镇长的@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.7amkuLcaZC2gkHFm]{mystery}有关的谜团。

竞技场

一旦英雄们找回全部四件@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{Roseguard}，并将它们放置在区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13}内宁布洛斯的上层神殿的祭坛上，他们便能够进入憎恨魔窟的第五层。贝科拉曾用这一层来考验她的爪牙与囚徒的决心，并希望有朝一日建立一处一流的角斗士设施，从中为她的军势挑选最优秀的战士。如今，贾法基与其他双尾虫怪把这一层当作处理失败实验体的垃圾场。

环境线索：

带有奇怪足迹的尘土、墙壁上的刮痕、断裂的铁链链节、碎裂的家具、无法辨认的骨头、锈蚀的金属碎片、折断的爪子或甲壳残片。

特征

除非另有说明，本层天花板高度为15英尺。未被描述为有光亮术的区域完全黑暗。门由包铁木制成，几乎所有门上都带有过去狂暴野兽强行撞破时留下的凿痕或伤痕。若未用物品顶住，门在片刻后会因配重而自动摆回关闭状态。

Chapter Synopsis

The chapter begins with the heroes seeking the final icons needed to enter the Abomination Vault’s middle levels, but a recent @UUID[.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{Theft} complicates this task. The heroes confront the thief, Carman Rajani, in a @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{remote cave}, where they must decide what to do with him—a choice they don’t yet realize will have meaningful repercussions later. They can then explore the fifth level of the Abomination Vaults, which contains masterless horrors and malevolent spirits, and address a @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.7amkuLcaZC2gkHFm]{mystery} regarding the mayor’s daughter.

The Arena

Once the heroes recover all four of the icons of the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{Roseguard} and place them on the altar in the Upper Temple of Nhimbaloth in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.CGaM81kBLtYIxmqu]{D13}, they are able to enter the fifth level of the Abomination Vaults. Belcorra used this level to test the resolve of her minions and her prisoners, and hoped to someday establish a premier facility for gladiators, from which she would take the best combatants for her forces. Presently, Jafaki and the other seugathis use this level as a dumping ground for failed experiments.

Environmental Cues:

Dust with strange tracks in it, gouges along walls, broken links of chains, splintered furniture, unidentifiable bones, rusted scraps of metal, bits of broken claw or carapace.

Features

The ceilings on this level are 15 feet tall unless otherwise indicated. Areas not described as having light are completely dark. The doors are made of wood banded with iron, and virtually all of them bear gouges or scarring from violent beasts smashing their way through in the past. The doors are weighted to swing closed after a few moments if they aren’t propped open.

Investigating The Theft.name: 调查行动 盗窃事件 Investigating The Theft
Investigating The Theft.text:
卡曼的盗窃

当英雄们在憎恨魔窟时，卡曼潜入@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library}，并在书籍复原术室点燃了一场小火。当火势分散了职员们的注意力时，他砸开了合作之刃的展示柜，带着长剑逃之夭夭。

一个小时后，职员们扑灭了火势，没有出现任何严重伤情，只损失了几本书——侍祭们将此奇迹归功于莎伦莱的庇护。等到有人发现失窃时，卡曼已经在前往一处被称为@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge}的本地洞穴的路上了。镇卫队很快意识到失踪的卡曼·拉贾尼是头号嫌疑人。毕竟，他多年来一直因这把剑而纠缠镇长，而且有几位目击者看见一个与他特征相符的人从图书馆溜走，斗篷裹着一件长条形的物体。

万蒂的提出请求

晨花图书馆的首席女祭司万蒂·班得黛西在英雄们前来询问长剑时与他们会面。她几乎无法压抑怒火，尽管她似乎对盗窃比对火灾更为恼怒。她请求他们找到卡曼，并将他活着带回来接受审判与相称的惩罚。

寻找卡曼

寻找卡曼不该太困难，因为他行事仓促，没时间掩盖行踪或准备一套像样的掩蔽说辞。以下是他们可能想到去寻找的地点——他们获得的信息最终都应当引导他们前往@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge}。

奥塔里卫队

@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.St1SBR4xOInfNoPj]{Otari Garrison}帮不上多少忙；长鞍队长指出，由于卡曼既不在镇上，也不在道路沿线，卫兵们没有管辖权去追捕他。他哼了一声，又补充道：“那个惹事精走了更好。要是他识相，就会一直跑下去。”他不会提供任何支援来抓捕卡曼，但如果英雄们把这位铁匠带回镇里，他会很乐意将其收押。

伐木之刃

英雄们发现卡曼的铁匠铺@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5yYs7JNliPnSYLhp]{Blades for Glades}关着门；他们在这里找不到任何线索。如果英雄们此前已经获得伐木之刃的支援，他们会想起卡曼过去曾提到走私者避难所，因此那里很可能是他的藏身处。

搜寻全镇

如果英雄们在奥塔里打听卡曼的位置，几乎所有人都会建议他们去骗子之角。一名英雄若成功通过一次@Check[type:diplomacy|dc:20|traits:action:gather-information]{外交}检定以收集信息，便会从镇民口中听到走私者避难所，并回想起卡曼年轻时曾在那儿待过一段时间（奥塔里的许多人也都如此）。

骗子之角

在@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Crook’s Nook}四处打听会把老板伊娜斯梅拉招来交谈。她厚颜无耻地索要10 gp的“特别费用”作为餐饮花销；英雄们若付钱（或成功通过一次@Check[type:diplomacy|dc:20|traits:action:request]{外交}检定以提出请求获取信息），就能让她对卡曼敞开心扉。这位铁匠的大胆已经有些过头，不再能留在她的宠信之中，而这次盗窃则是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。她提到卡曼很可能已经躲到镇外的@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge}藏起来了。如果伊娜斯梅拉因英雄们之前的行动而对他们评价良好，她会免费提供这些信息。

Carman's Theft

While the heroes were off in the Abomination Vaults, Carman crept into the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library} and started a small fire in the book restoration room. While the fire distracted the staff, he broke the Cooperative Blade’s display case and fled with the sword.

After an hour, the staff had put out the fire without any serious injuries and only a few lost books—a miracle the acolytes attribute to Sarenrae’s protection. By the time anyone discovered the theft, Carman was already on his way to a local cave called @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge}. It didn’t take long for the town guard to realize that the missing Carman Rajani was the prime suspect. He had pestered the mayor about the sword for years, after all, and a few witnesses saw someone matching his description absconding from the library, clutching his cloak over some long object.

Vandy's Request

Vandy Banderdash, head priestess of the Dawnflower Library, meets with the heroes when they come to ask about the sword. She can barely contain her rage, although she seems more angry about the theft than the fire. She asks them to find Carman and bring him in alive to face trial and receive an appropriate punishment.

Finding Carman

Finding Carman shouldn’t be too hard, as he acted hastily and didn’t have time to cover his tracks or prepare a good cover story. Below are some of the locations they may think to look- the information they find should eventually lead them to @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge}.

Otari Guard

The @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.St1SBR4xOInfNoPj]{Otari Garrison} can’t provide much help; Captain Longsaddle points out that since Carman isn’t in town or along the roads, the guards don’t have jurisdiction to pursue him. He harrumphs and adds, “Good riddance to that troublemaker. He’ll keep running if he knows what’s good for him.” He doesn’t provide any aid to capture Carman but happily takes him into custody if the heroes bring the smith into town.

Blades for Glades

The heroes find Carman’s blacksmith shop, @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.5yYs7JNliPnSYLhp]{Blades for Glades}, closed; they won’t find any clues here. If the heroes already had the support of Blades for Glades, they recall that Carman mentioned Smuggler’s Refuge in the past, so it’s a likely hideout.

Combing the Town

If the heroes ask about Carman’s location in Otari, nearly everyone suggests they go to the Crook’s Nook. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:20|traits:action:gather-information]{Diplomacy} to Gather Information hears about the Smuggler’s Refuge from townsfolk and recalls that Carman spent time there in his youth (as did many people in Otari).

Crook's Nook

Asking around at the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Crook’s Nook} brings the owner, Yinyasmera, over to talk. She brazenly asks for a 10 gp “special fee” for food and drinks; heroes who pay up (or succeed at a @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:20|traits:action:request]{Diplomacy} to Request information) get her to open up about Carman. The blacksmith has been a little too bold to remain in her good graces, and this theft is the last straw. She mentions that Carman has likely gone into hiding at @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.DzqE7ZmPnygrbe34]{Smuggler's Refuge} outside of town. If Yinyasmera has a favorable opinion of the heroes from their previous actions, she gives this information for free.

Smuggler's Refuge.name: 走私者避难所 Smuggler's Refuge
Smuggler's Refuge.text:
环境线索：

滴水声、空气中矿物的涩味、破碎的箱子、发霉的铺盖、旧营火。

这个洞穴离镇子只有大约一小时路程，穿过森林走一小段路即可到达，位于一处废弃鱼营地以北。尽管这里离海岸太远，不便运输沉重货物，但过去走私者在搬运较轻的货品时经常利用此洞穴。他们把战利品藏在洞穴众多壁龛中的一处，打算日后再回来取走，或把这里当作与买家交易的投放点。

如今，随着近来走私活动的衰退，奥塔里的年轻人需要从伐木镇的生活中喘口气时，便会在洞穴里露营。

腐烂的箱子、被遗忘的衣物与其他杂物表明这座洞穴偶尔会被使用，但很少有人清理。洞穴中央有一处被木头围着的冰冷营火。静止的空气里隐约残留着霉味与烟味。

与许多先前来访者一样，卡曼起初也在这里生了火，但当他意识到没有合适的地方让烟排出去时，便把火熄灭了。几张旧行军床、成堆丢弃的衣物与空箱子显示这里偶尔有人居住。卡曼把最好的行军床和最新的衣物用作寝具。

遭遇

低 5

@Actor[tYzzLLUv9WBhHhQY]{卡曼·拉贾尼}

60 XP

如果卡曼尚未察觉英雄们的到来，他会坐在行军床上，嚼着风干鱼，一遍又一遍地把合作之刃在手中翻转把玩，陷入沉思。他在犹豫是否把剑归还，并祈祷自己只会被处以一笔严厉罚款，还是逃回他祖先的故土奈多。

如果卡曼知道英雄们的存在，他会躲藏在箱子后方，并使用隐秘来决定先攻。

卡曼早已听闻英雄们的名声。他认为他们来这里是要把他抓走，于是会奋力抵抗。在自卫时，他会对他们大喊：“你们休想活捉我！”以及“这是我的剑！我只拿回本就属于我的东西！”如果英雄们明显没有以同等的敌意回应，或当他的生命值降到30点以下时，他会投降。

XP 奖励

若英雄们活捉卡曼，除击败他所获得的 XP 外，再额外奖励英雄们 30 XP。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

卡曼的补给

除卡曼随身携带之物外，火堆旁他的冒险者背包里装有一周份的临时凑合的 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.L9ZV076913otGtiB]{Rations} 与两只 @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.VnPh324pKwd2ZB66]{Waterskins}。英雄在搜索洞穴时，若进行一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便能在一处覆满卵石的壁龛中找到一瓶被遗忘已久的 @Item[iHkRae4yiFiAiOSa]{旧法威士忌}。这瓶陈年酒价值 3 gp。

暗门

洞穴东侧墙壁上有一扇隐藏得异常巧妙的暗门，通向憎恨魔窟的第五等级。英雄搜索该区域时，必须在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功才能发现它。然而即便发现了，这扇暗门也无法从这一侧打开。门的机关会令沉重的石墙向内侧旋开，但由于门的另一侧紧挨着塌方，它无法如此转动。英雄们也许可以在之后从另一侧清理这处入口（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.BzlXstkevKBkM04H]{E07}）。

Environmental Cues:

Dripping water, mineral tang in the air, broken crates, moldy bedding, old campfires.

This cave is only about an hour outside of town, just a short walk through the forest, north of an abandoned fish camp. Though it's too far inland for transporting heavy cargo, this cave once saw a lot of use from smugglers moving lighter goods. They hid their loot in one of the cave's many niches, planning to come back for it at a later time, or used the site as a drop point for transactions with a buyer.

Today, with the recent decline in smuggling, Otari's young people camp in the cave when they need a break from the lumber town.

Rotted crates, forgotten clothes, and other debris suggest this cave is occasionally used but rarely cleaned. A cold campfire surrounded by logs sits at the cave's center. Faint smells of mildew and smoke hang in the still air.

Like many visitors before him, Carman initially built a fire here but put it out when he realized there isn't a good place for the smoke to vent. A few old cots, heaps of discarded clothes, and empty crates show that this cave is occasionally inhabited. Carman uses the best of the cots and the freshest clothes for bedding.

Encounter

Low 5

@Actor[tYzzLLUv9WBhHhQY]{Carman Rajani}

60 XP

If Carman isn't aware of the heroes, he sits on his cot, chewing on some dried fish and turning the Cooperative Blade over and over in his hands while he thinks. He wonders whether to return the sword and hope for nothing more than a stiff fine, or flee to his ancestral homeland of Nidal.

If Carman knows of the heroes' presence, he hides behind a crate and uses Stealth for initiative.

Carman knows the heroes by reputation. He assumes they've come here to take him prisoner, and he puts up a fight. While defending himself, he shouts to them, "You'll never take me alive!" and "This is my sword! I only took what's rightfully mine!" He surrenders if the heroes plainly don't reciprocate his aggression, or when he's reduced to fewer than 30 Hit Points.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for capturing Carman alive, in addition to the XP for defeating him.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Carman's Supplies

Apart from what Carman carries on him, his adventurer's pack near the fire contains a week of improvised @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.L9ZV076913otGtiB]{Rations} and two @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.VnPh324pKwd2ZB66]{Waterskins}. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching the cave finds a long-forgotten bottle of @Item[iHkRae4yiFiAiOSa]{Old Law Whiskey} hidden in a pebble-covered niche. The aged alcohol is worth 3 gp.

Secret Door

The east wall of the cave contains an exceptionally well-hidden secret door that leads into the fifth level of the Abomination Vaults. A hero Searching this area must succeed at a @Check[type:perception|dc:28|traits:action:search]{Perception} check to find it. Even if discovered, however, the secret door doesn't open from this side. The door's mechanism causes the heavy stone wall to swing inward, and it can't do so because of a cave-in just on the other side of it. The heroes might clear this entrance from the other side later (area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.BzlXstkevKBkM04H]{E07}).

Talking with Carman.name: 与卡曼交谈 Talking with Carman
Talking with Carman.text:
如果英雄们在把卡尔曼押送拘留之前给他一个解释的机会，他会试图为偷剑辩解。朗读或转述以下内容。

“那是我的，我跟你说！这把剑是我的！它本来就属于我，我怎么能算偷？它属于沃尔·拉贾尼，而我是她唯一还活着的后裔。那个一本正经的镇长说这把剑属于他们家，就因为一群狗头人曾经把它拿在手里一阵子，而他的祖先又从它们那里抢走了。他说传家宝就是传家宝，他说得没错——但那是我的传家宝！你看，我试过从他手里把它买下来，可每次我攒够钱币，他就把价格抬高——五十金币，然后一百，再然后两百。后来他又说不卖了！我别无选择，只能拿走它。它属于沃尔——属于拉贾尼家族。它属于我！”

卡尔曼恳求英雄们放他走，并坚称自己有权拿走这把剑。他会尽可能回答他们的问题。可能的提问和他的回答如下。

为什么这把剑对你这么重要？

“它属于我的家族，属于沃尔。她是玫瑰团中最出色的，也是拉贾尼家族中最出色的……而我想当镇长。我试了四次，但每次都输给奥瑟夫。要是我有这把剑——人们都说它能给镇子带来好运！如果我有它，他们就会希望我当镇长，这样我就能把好运带给他们。”

你为什么想当镇长？

“为了掌权！没道理一直让门海姆家来管这个地方。奥瑟夫说那是因为他们家是英雄的后代。哼，我也是，而且我能比那个老混蛋干得好得多。”

你为什么要在图书馆纵火？

“那火只是个障眼法。我不想伤害任何人，他们本来也该很快就把火扑灭。又不是我烧了什么重要东西，除了几张纸而已。”

就算这把剑确实理应属于你，你也犯了纵火罪。你不觉得你应该进监狱吗？

“纵火？呵。最多算破坏公物。我会为点火交罚款，但这把剑是我的。”

我们为什么要放你走？

“因为我会付钱给你们。五十金币——甚至一百。全给你们都行。但我得留下我的剑。”

你怎么弄到那么多金币的？

“攒的，也借了点。好吧，大部分是借的。听着，我就是必须拿到那把剑。”

如果我们放你走，你会做什么？

“我不知道。也许在这里待一阵子，想清楚再说。我想我现在确实没法回镇上了。也许我会去奈多。他们说沃尔来自那里——有人说她是王族，也许我能过上本该属于我的生活。”

如果我们放你走，我们能先借用这把剑吗？

“只要你们不是要拿走它，或者把我带回镇上，我就会跟你们一起去做你们需要做的事。”

If Carman has a chance to explain himself before the heroes take him into custody, he tries to justify stealing the sword. Read or paraphrase the following.

"It's mine, I tell you! The sword is mine! How can I steal something that already belongs to me? It belonged to Vol Rajani, and I'm her only surviving descendant. That uptight mayor says the sword belongs to his family just because a pack of kobolds had their hands on it for a while, and his ancestor snatched it from them. He says an heirloom is an heirloom, and he's right, but it's my heirloom! Look, I tried to buy it off him, but every time I saved enough coin, he raised the price- fifty gold, then one hundred, then two hundred. Then he said it wasn't for sale! I had no choice but to take it. It belongs to Vol- to the Rajani family. It belongs to me!"

Carman pleads for the heroes to let him go and steadfastly claims his right to take the sword. He answers their questions as best he can. Likely inquiries and his responses follow.

Why is the sword so important to you?

"It belonged to my family, to Vol. She was the best of the Roseguard and the best of the Rajanis... and I wanted to be mayor. I've tried four times but always lost to Oseph. If I had the sword, well- people say that it gives the town good luck! If I had it, they'd want me to be mayor so that I could give them luck."

Why do you want to be mayor?

"To be in charge! There's no reason a Menhemes should always run this place. Oseph says it's because his family is descended from heroes. Well, so am I, and I can do a much better job than that old bastard."

Why did you set the fire at the library?

"The fire was just a distraction. I didn't want to hurt anyone, and they should've put it out soon enough. It's not like I burned anything other than some paper."

Even if the sword is rightfully yours, you committed arson. Don't you think you deserve to go to jail?

"Arson? Heh. Vandalism maybe. I'll pay a fine for starting the fire, but the sword is mine."

Why should we let you go?

"Because I'll pay you. Fifty gold coins- a hundred, even. Take it all. But I get to keep my sword."

How did you get that much gold?

"Saved it, borrowed some. Okay, borrowed most of it. Look, I just had to get that sword."

If we let you go, what will you do?

"I don't know. Stay here a while, maybe, and think it out. I guess I can't really go back to town now. Maybe I'll head to Nidal. They say Vol was from there- some say she was royalty, and maybe I can get the life that's due to me."

If we let you go, can we borrow the sword first?

"As long as you're not taking it or me back to town, I'll go with you to do whatever you need to do."

Carman's Fate.name: 卡曼的命运 Carman's Fate
Carman's Fate.text:
英雄们决定如何处置卡尔曼。他很可能会顺从英雄们的任何要求，尤其是在英雄们已经证明自己能在战斗中打败他的情况下。

放他走

即使英雄们愿意放他走，他们仍需要合作之刃来突破憎恨魔窟中的屏障。为完成这项任务，卡尔曼会跟他们同行，因为他不想让这把剑离开自己的视线，但如果英雄们在憎恨魔窟中遇到麻烦，他不会参战。屏障解除后，卡尔曼会撤回洞穴考虑接下来该怎么做，并很可能在那里待上几天。

把他交出去

如果英雄们把他交给奥塔里卫队，长鞍队长会把他扔进牢房里，并开玩笑说要把钥匙丢掉。长鞍队长会让镇长知道英雄们拥有合作之刃；只要最终能把它归还到镇上，镇长不介意英雄们借用它。长鞍队长会把卡尔曼的钱收走，作为资金池用来偿还他罪行造成的任何开销，但会让英雄们保留卡尔曼的其他装备。

杀了他

如果英雄们在战斗中杀死卡尔曼，镇上的人明白在抓捕罪犯时这是一种风险。奥瑟夫会安排将卡尔曼安葬在奥塔里墓园，并让英雄们借用合作之刃。

The heroes decide what to do with Carman. He likely goes along with any of the heroes' demands, particularly if they already proved they can beat him in a fight.

Let Him Go

Even if the heroes are willing to let him go, they still need the Cooperative Blade to breach the barrier in the Abomination Vaults. Carman goes with them for this task since he doesn't want to let the sword out of his sight, but he doesn't fight in the Abomination Vaults if the heroes get into trouble. After the barrier goes down, Carman retreats to the cave to consider what to do and likely stays there for a few days.

Turn Him In

If the heroes turn him over to the Otari Garrison, Captain Longsaddle tosses him in a cell and jokes about throwing away the key. Longsaddle lets the mayor know that the heroes have the Cooperative Blade; the mayor is fine with the heroes borrowing it, as long as it ends up back with the town. Longsaddle takes Carman's money as a pool to repay any costs from his crimes but lets the heroes keep Carman's other equipment.

Kill Him

If the heroes kill Carman in combat, people in town understand that's a risk when apprehending a criminal. Oseph arranges for Carman's burial in the Otari Cemetery and lets the heroes borrow the Cooperative Blade.

The Spectral Seal.name: 幽灵封印 The Spectral Seal
The Spectral Seal.text:
世界状态

@Macro[pDzkFlraunFyBL5G]{D12 - 打破封印}

一道幽影屏障阻挡着从憎恨魔窟第四层通往第五层的唯一通道。正如英雄们在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} 从奥塔里·伊瓦什提的幽灵（特征）那里得知的那样，只有集齐玫瑰团四名成员的全部遗珍才能将其刺穿。收集这些遗物将成为接下来这段冒险的重点。

当你的玩家准备好刺穿屏障时，此宏将移除幽灵之路走廊中的墙体与照明效果，使他们得以通过。

收集情报

英雄们在镇上稍作打听，应该不难得知这些遗珍的情况；相关细节详见 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{The Roseguard} 日志。

了解玫瑰团的最佳地点是 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{Menhemes Manor}，也就是镇长及其家人的住所（他们皆为牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯的后裔）。庄园东翼设有一座面向公众的镇史博物馆。尽管这座博物馆内陈列着玫瑰团冒险道具的复制品，甚至还有一些冒险者曾经拥有的普通物品，但奥塔里·伊瓦什提的幽灵（特征）向英雄们描述的那些特定遗珍并不在此处。镇长欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯、在 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library} 的万蒂·班得黛西，或在 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jlb4fsKQC57ZjNQ7]{Wrin’s Wonders} 的瓦琳·希温尼斯，都能为英雄们指明正确方向。

取回遗珍

猎人胸针

牧师艾斯法娜·曼妮姆斯的胸针放在曼妮姆斯庄园音乐室里一只上锁的陈列盒中。若英雄们诚实且坦率地告诉欧瑟夫·曼妮姆斯他们为何需要它，他会允许他们想借多久就借多久。作为对他们坦诚相告的回报，他们将自动获得 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.7amkuLcaZC2gkHFm]{Malady}的支援：这使英雄们可以通过辅导曼妮姆斯家的孩子来赚取收入；而更切近眼下的是，这也让他们能够会见多莉安娜·曼妮姆斯并援助处理她的 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories}。如果英雄们此前已经获得曼妮姆斯的支援，欧瑟夫会以他们为他与小镇所做的一切作为交换，让他们把胸针留作己有。

真理的门槛

书商莫里宾特将扎马夫迪安的《真理的门槛》收藏在 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{Stolen} 的学术藏书中。若怪谈故事已经支援英雄们，莫里宾特会欣然允许他们借阅这本书。否则，在他把这本法术书借给他们之前，他们必须向莫里宾特承诺会对其格外小心。说服莫里宾特可能需要大量承诺、展示对古老典籍的正确养护方式，或两者兼具。无论如何，莫里宾特都希望得到一份关于他们如何使用它（以及任何相关魔法现象）的完整记录。

合作之刃

沃尔·拉贾尼的长剑“合作之刃”通常陈列在晨花图书馆入口处，但它在前一晚已被 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18}。

@Macro[pDzkFlraunFyBL5G]{D12 - Breaking the Seal}

World State

@Macro[pDzkFlraunFyBL5G]{D12 - Breaking the Seal}

A spectral barrier blocks the only passage from the fourth level of the Abomination Vaults to the fifth. As the heroes learned from the ghost of Otari Ilvashti in area @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.Gx2mnbeUctXU7XUN]{The Roseguard}, only icons of all four members of the Roseguard can pierce it. Gathering these artefacts will be the focus of the next stretch of the adventure.

When your players are ready to pierce the barrier, this macro will remove the wall and lighting effects from the corridor in the Ghostwalk, allowing them to pass.

Gathering Information

It shouldn’t take the heroes too much asking around in town to find out about the icons, which are detailed within the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{Menhemes Manor} journal.

The best place to learn about the Roseguard is @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.AztvvKcx7K7gOXhN]{Dawnflower Library}, the residence of the town’s mayor and his family (all descendants of Aesephna Menhemes). The manor’s eastern wing contains a public museum of the town’s history. Although this museum contains replicas of the Roseguard’s adventuring gear and even a few common items that the adventurers once owned, the specific icons Otari Ilvashti’s ghost described to the heroes aren’t here. Mayor Oseph Menhemes, Vandy Banderdash at the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.jlb4fsKQC57ZjNQ7]{Wrin’s Wonders}, or Wrin Sivinxi at @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.7amkuLcaZC2gkHFm]{Malady} can point the heroes in the right direction.

Retrieving the Icons

The Hunter's Brooch

Aesephna Menhemes’s brooch is in a locked shadowbox in the music room of Menhemes Manor. If the heroes honestly and openly tell Oseph Menhemes why they need it, he permits them to borrow the brooch for as long as they’d like. For being honest with him, they automatically earn the Menhemes's support, which allows the heroes to Earn Income by tutoring the Menhemes children and, more immediately pertinent, lets them meet Dorianna Menhemes and aid with her @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories}. If the heroes previously earned the Menhemes’s support, Oseph lets them keep the brooch in exchange for all they’ve done for him and the town.

Thresholds of Truth

The bookseller Morlibint keeps Zarmavdian’s Thresholds of Truth in his academic collection at @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.6EE3LBjSntNQeK8i]{Stolen}. If Odd Stories already supports the heroes, Morlibint gladly allows them to borrow the book. If not, they must promise Morlibint that they’ll take special care of the spellbook before he loans it to them. Convincing Morlibint might require extensive promises, a demonstration on the proper care of ancient tomes, or both. Either way, Morlibint wants to get a full account of what they do with it (and any related magical phenomena).

The Cooperative Blade

Vol Rajani’s longsword, the Cooperative Blade, is normally on display at the entrance to Dawnflower Library, but it was @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.J8ggyg2kxws3Sa1h]{D18} the previous night.

Dorianna's Dreams.name: 多莉安娜的梦境 Dorianna's Dreams
Dorianna's Dreams.text:
尽管英雄们能在憎恨魔窟中找到大量冒险，但奥塔里还有其他神秘事件正在发生。其中最重要的一件事围绕着@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Mayor Menhemes’s}的长女——十几岁的多瑞安娜·梅赫姆斯展开。多瑞安娜正处在发展灵能的边缘。虽然地表上无人知晓此事，但一位名为@UUID[Actor.8AVy2qIK6vh13sSj]{Ysondkhelir}的冷原居民（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}）已经察觉到了她的力量。随着通往更低楼层的屏障消失，他便能将她的梦扭曲成梦魇，并扮演她的救星。接下来数周里，他在幻梦境中与她进行一次次夜间冒险，推进这项长久计划。伊松德赫利意图最终将多瑞安娜的肉体推进幻梦境，以增进其他冷原居民的阴谋。

最初的梦

在英雄们打开通往憎恨魔窟下层的封印两夜之后，多瑞安娜·梅赫姆斯开始做起骇人的梦魇。她每晚会惊醒好几次，尖叫着醒来，死死抱住一只她多年未曾碰过的绒布狮鹫。被问及时，她除了自己的恐惧，以及一名裹在不相配布料中的男人会安慰她之外，记不起这些梦魇的具体内容。

若英雄们已获得@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{Menhemes Manor}的支援，他们就曾见过多瑞安娜，并会从其他孩子口中听说她的梦魇。否则，市长会去找那位最以治疗者或通灵学权威闻名的英雄。他会提到女儿的梦魇，以及梦中那位充当守护者与救星的“杂色男人”。他请求他们低调调查此事并帮助他的女儿。

询问瓦琳

梅赫姆斯市长认为瓦琳奇珍店的@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{Wrin Sivinxi}是个不可靠的怪人，因此没想到要让她介入自家的麻烦。然而她是通灵学专家；只要英雄们提出请求，她就会乐意随行协助多瑞安娜，前提是她不需要在室内与这位饱受折磨的女孩见面。若队伍里缺少受过通灵学训练、能够查明这些谜团根源的人，瓦琳的参与会是一个可行的解决方案。

检查多瑞安娜

即便是英雄们第一次检查多瑞安娜时，她也已显得憔悴苍白，仿佛感染了严重病症。一次成功的@Check[type:medicine|dc:15]{医疗}检定可证实她的身体状况其实良好。起初，英雄们找不到任何魔法或诅咒施加在她身上的证据。搜查多瑞安娜的房间会发现，她的一些童年玩具被重新拿出来供她玩耍。多瑞安娜含糊地表示她只是想念它们，想再玩一次。多瑞安娜的梦魇极其顽固；英雄们用来帮助她获得一夜好眠的任何魔法都会失败，除非法术施放者在一次秘密DC27反制检定中成功。

XP奖励

若英雄们花费精力与时间帮助多瑞安娜，即使他们暂时仍无法弄清问题所在，也给予他们30 XP。

多瑞安娜的衰退

多瑞安娜的状态会随时间恶化。她的梦魇强度有所减轻，但白天仍感到精疲力竭且焦虑。她开始把杂色男人当作想象中的朋友，即便清醒时也与之交谈，回避与其他任何人进行活动。她的性情变得反复无常且幼稚，并常常心不在焉地抓挠自己的右手。她的兄弟姐妹不想与她有任何瓜葛，甚至她的父母也觉得难以忍受。她受到了伊松德赫利施放的流放诅咒法术影响，英雄们可能按常规方式侦测或移除它；若他们这么做，伊松德赫利会在接下来的夜晚再次对她施放。

通过一次成功的@Check[type:diplomacy|dc:26]{交涉}检定，英雄们能获得多瑞安娜的信任，让她向他们敞开心扉。若他们得到曼妮姆斯庄园的支援，则该检定获得+4环境加值。每天只有一位英雄能尝试此检定一次（若大失败，则他们必须改为等待[[/r 1d4]]天）。成功时，多瑞安娜坚持杂色男人是真实存在的，并与他们讨论下列两个主题之一（在之后某天再次成功，或初次即大成功时，她会将两者都透露出来）。

赋礼

杂色男人会以她旧日童年玩具的形式赠予她赋礼，其中最棒的是那只绒布狮鹫。即便只是粗略检查，也能发现绒布玩具里缝进了什么坚硬物体；打开后可找到一颗巨大、无瑕的红宝石，价值30 gp。即便英雄们拿走这颗红宝石，下次多瑞安娜做梦时，它也会在另一件童年玩具中重新出现，无论它当时身在何处。它与多瑞安娜绑定，不会离开她太久。

腕部文字

多瑞安娜漫不经心地指给他们看自己右手腕上的几处瘀伤，她不记得这些瘀伤是怎么来的。一位受过通灵学训练、观察这些瘀伤的英雄，可以尝试一次@Check[type:occultism|dc:22|traits:action:decipher-writing]{通灵学}检定以进行文书解读。会说阿克洛语的英雄在该检定中获得+2环境加值。成功时，英雄注意到这些文字与某些梦境旅行仪式有关；大成功时，英雄会在这些瘀伤中注意到“冷原”一词。

这两条线索中的任意一条，都指向一种被称作冷原居民的恶意异界生物的介入。冷原是一个恐怖的异界地点，位于幻梦境之外不远处，居住着被称为冷原居民的残忍而阴险之人。一次成功的@Check[type:occultism|dc:24|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{通灵学}检定能让英雄意识到折磨多瑞安娜之生物的本质；若英雄们获得了两条线索，则任何受过通灵学训练的英雄无需检定便能意识到这一点。尽管英雄们可能找出多瑞安娜困境的源头，但他们目前仍无计可施，因为伊松德赫利从未在物理上接近过她。

XP奖励

若英雄们发现有冷原居民牵涉多瑞安娜的病症，给予他们80 XP。

Although the heroes can find plenty of adventure in the Abomination Vaults, other mysterious events are afoot in Otari. The most significant of these occurrences centers around @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.7WZr8QhFOSrHPTgU]{Mayor Menhemes’s} eldest daughter, the teenaged Dorianna Menhemes. Dorianna is on the cusp of developing psychic powers. While no one on the surface is aware of this, a denizen of Leng named @UUID[Actor.8AVy2qIK6vh13sSj]{Ysondkhelir} (area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.RiUE936phCZx8Hqe]{G18}) has become aware of her power. With the barrier to the lower levels down, he can twist her dreams into nightmares and take the role of her savior. He intensifies this long plan over weeks of nighttime adventures with her in the Dimension of Dreams. Ysondkhelir intends to eventually thrust Dorianna physically into the Dimension of Dreams to augment other denizens’ plots.

The First Dreams

Two nights after the heroes open the seal to the Abomination Vaults’ lower levels, Dorianna Menhemes begins having horrifying nightmares. She awakens several times each night, screaming and clutching a stuffed griffon she hasn’t touched in years. When asked, she doesn’t recall the specifics of these nightmares beyond her fear and the appearance of a man shrouded in mismatched fabric who comforts her.

If the heroes have earned the support of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.WirKAYn5ZGirmgjb]{Menhemes Manor}, they’ve met Dorianna, and they hear about her nightmares from the other children. Otherwise, the mayor seeks out whichever hero is best known as a healer or as an authority on Occultism. He mentions his daughter’s nightmares and the “motley man” who acts as a protector and savior within them. He asks them to discreetly look into the matter and help his daughter.

Asking Wrin

Mayor Menhemes views @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.raJDQ95RBqeXxV14]{Wrin Sivinxi} of Wrin’s Wonders as an unreliable eccentric, so he doesn’t think to involve her in his family’s troubles. However, she’s an expert in Occultism; she gladly accompanies the heroes to help Dorianna if they ask, so long as she doesn’t need to meet with the beleaguered girl indoors. If the party lacks someone with Occultism training to get to the bottom of these mysteries, Wrin’s involvement is a possible solution.

Examining Dorianna

Even the first time the heroes examine Dorianna, she already appears gaunt and pale as if she had caught a severe malady. A character who succeeds at a @Check[type:medicine|dc:15]{Medicine} check verifies that she’s nevertheless in good physical health. The heroes initially find no evidence of any magic or curse upon her. A search of Dorianna’s room discovers that several of her childhood toys have been brought back out for her to play with. Dorianna states vaguely that she just missed them and wanted to play with them again. Dorianna’s nightmares are tenacious; any magic the heroes use to help Dorianna get a good night’s sleep fail unless the caster succeeds at a secret DC27 Counteract check.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for taking the care and time to help Dorianna, even if they can’t figure out what’s wrong just yet.

Dorianna’s Decline

Dorianna’s condition worsens over time. Her nightmares lessen in intensity, but she feels exhausted and anxious during the day. She begins to talk with the Motley Man as an imaginary friend even when awake, eschewing activities with anyone else. Her disposition becomes erratic and childish, and she often scratches absently at her right hand. Her siblings don’t want anything to do with her, and even her parents find her hard to put up with. She’s been afflicted by Ysondkhelir’s outcast’s curse spell, which the heroes might detect or remove normally. If they do, Ysondkhelir casts it on her again the following night.

With a successful @Check[type:diplomacy|dc:26]{Diplomacy} check, the heroes gain Dorianna’s trust and get her to open up to them. If they have the support of Menhemes Manor, they have a +4 circumstance bonus to this check. Only one hero can attempt this check each day (on a critical failure, they must instead wait [[/r 1d4]] days). On a success, Dorianna insists that the Motley Man is real and discusses one of the following two subjects with them (on a subsequent day’s success or an initial critical success, she reveals both).

Gifts

The Motley Man gives her gifts in the form of her old childhood toys, and the best of them is the stuffed griffon. Even a cursory examination reveals that something hard is sewn inside the stuffed toy; characters who open it up find a large, flawless ruby worth 30 gp. Even if the heroes take this ruby, the next time Dorianna dreams, it reappears inside another childhood toy from wherever it is. It’s keyed to Dorianna and doesn’t leave her for long.

Wrist Writing

Dorianna absently points out several bruises on her right wrist that she can’t remember getting. A hero trained in Occultism who views the bruises can attempt a @Check[type:occultism|dc:22|traits:action:decipher-writing]{Occultism} check to Decipher Writing. A hero who speaks Aklo gains a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. On a success, the hero notes that the words are related to some dream-traveling rituals; on a critical success, the hero notes the word “Leng” among the bruises.

Either of these clues points to the involvement of a malevolent extraplanar creature called a denizen of Leng. Leng is a terrifying extraplanar location just past the Dimension of Dreams, where cruel and sinister people called denizens of Leng live. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:occultism|dc:24|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check realizes the nature of the creature plaguing Dorianna; if the heroes obtained both clues, then any hero trained in Occultism realizes this without a check. Though the heroes might identify the source of Dorianna’s trouble, there’s not much they can do for her yet, because Ysondkhelir doesn’t ever physically get anywhere near her.

XP Award

Award the heroes 80 XP if they discover a denizen of Leng is involved in Dorianna's malady.

06. Experiments in Flesh.name: 06. 血肉实验 06. Experiments in Flesh

F01. Central Shaft.name: F01. 竖井中段 F01. Central Shaft
F01. Central Shaft.text:
宽阔的螺旋楼梯继续向下，途中有一段变得平缓，足以经过一扇通往东侧的单门，以及一条通往西侧、尽头是双开门的走廊。两者之间的空间有一扇圆形、朦胧的窗户，俯瞰着天然洞窟中的一大片水池。远处下方散发出微弱的橙色发光，并随之传来一股硫磺般的恶臭。

螺旋楼梯向上通往第五等级（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.GtX8UuzhtARfLdsq]{E01}），向下通往第七等级（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}）。楼梯与连接它们的步道设有狭窄的铁制扶手，以防坠落40英尺至区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}。

窗户是魔法透明石材。由于它是凄凉灯塔的支援结构的一部分，因此也是遗物的一部分，无法被损坏。它也无法像地城其他地方的透明石材那样被操控，因为它缺少控制符文。

遭遇

低 6

@Actor[qOkxxiM4tNf96CHQ]{双尾虫怪守卫} @Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{胶化人}

60 XP

贾法基知道，控制这座主楼梯是阻止乌瑞维安的部队入侵他地盘的最佳方式；这也是捕获新研究对象的理想地点。一只双尾虫怪在此守卫，并有一只胶化人被铁链拴在扶手上。胶化人可以在房间北半部的步道上任意移动。

双尾虫怪会警惕来自下方的攻击，因此从上方下行的英雄可能会打它个措手不及（从上方平台传来的怪物呻吟与呓语并不罕见，不会惊动双尾虫怪）。如果双尾虫怪知道有人要来，它会从魔杖施放识破隐形，压制其迷心灵光，并假装友善，刚好足以让来者放松警惕。随后它会试图将入侵者俘虏；如有必要，它会为此战斗至死。

胶化人一旦侦测到任何入侵者就会呻吟着向前冲锋，但会忠诚地服从双尾虫怪的命令术。

增援

贾法基不会补充这些守卫。如果此平台无人守卫超过5天，乌瑞维安会从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} 或 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05} 派来一只谨慎的胡须魔，并从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04} 或 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15} 派来两只铁骨怪来确保其安全。

The wide spiral staircase continues downward, leveling out long enough to pass by a single door leading east and a hallway leading west to a double door. The space between them has a rounded, cloudy window overlooking a large pool in a natural cavern. A dim orange glow emanates from far below and, with it, a sulfurous stench.

The spiral stairs lead up to the fifth level (area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.GtX8UuzhtARfLdsq]{E01}) and down to the seventh level (area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}). The stairs and the walkway connecting them have a narrow iron handrail to prevent a fall 40 feet down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.2aDFWQZkq3nA7KPT]{G01}.

The window is magically transparent stone. As it’s part of Gauntlight’s support and thus part of the artifact, it can’t be damaged. It also can’t be manipulated like the transparent stone elsewhere in the dungeon, as it lacks control glyphs.

Encounter

Low 6

@Actor[qOkxxiM4tNf96CHQ]{Seugathi Guard} @Actor[K9Hw43co8fhwmKkM]{Grothlut}

60 XP

Jafaki knows that controlling this main staircase is the best way to keep Urevian’s troops from invading his territory; it’s also the ideal place to capture new research subjects. A seugathi is on guard here, along with a grothlut chained to the handrail. The grothlut can move anywhere along the walkway in the northern half of the room.

The seugathi watches for attacks from below, so heroes descending from above might catch them off guard (moaning and gibbering from monsters on the landing above aren’t unusual and don’t alert the seugathi). If the seugathi knows someone is coming, they cast see invisibility from their wand, suppress their mindfog aura, and feign friendliness just long enough to put the newcomers at ease. They then try to take the intruders prisoner, fighting to the death to do so if necessary.

The grothlut moans and charges forward when it detects intruders of any kind but loyally follows the seugathi’s commands.

Reinforcements

Jafaki doesn’t replace these guards. If this landing remains unguarded for more than 5 days, Urevian sends a cautious barbazu from area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JLM4Hwqvk9V8qvbp]{G03} or @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.AeQmFFVsCUF02tzd]{G05} and two dreshkans from area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.JCRGIRMAhYyjkSvF]{G04} or @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.wemHETiO7mks9Clo]{G15} to secure it.

F02. Grime Deposits.name: F02. 脏污房间 F02. Grime Deposits
F02. Grime Deposits.text:
锈迹和污垢充满了这间八边形房间。一条宽阔的走廊通向南方。

天花板上有一条圆形竖井，向上穿过石头25英尺，通向区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.oBe9I7ccu1SIxdsG]{E02}。

世界状态

@Macro[53JtRrpbTJ3IpCNC]{F02 - 生锈的格栅}

如果英雄们还没有触发那里的落坑陷阱，那么竖井顶部被生锈的格栅覆盖；该格栅在被移动时会坍塌。如果他们已经触发过，那么破碎的格栅残骸就 леж 在房间中央！

你可以点击上方的宏来切换场景中的图块。

@Macro[53JtRrpbTJ3IpCNC]{F02 - Rusty Grate}

Rust and grime fill this octagonal chamber. A wide hallway leads to the south.

A circular shaft in the ceiling leads up 25 feet through the stone to area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.oBe9I7ccu1SIxdsG]{E02}.

World State

@Macro[53JtRrpbTJ3IpCNC]{F02 - Rusty Grate}

If the heroes haven't triggered the pit trap there, the shaft's top is covered with the rusty grate that collapses when moved. If they have, then the broken wreckage of the grating lies in the centre of the room!

You can toggle the tile in the scene by clicking the above macro.

F03. Rocky Cave.name: F03. 岩石洞穴 F03. Rocky Cave
F03. Rocky Cave.text:
这座遍布卵石的洞窟墙面长满青苔，向上延伸至三十尺高的天花板。一扇宽阔的圆角窗位于地面上方十五尺处，俯瞰着这座洞窟。

东侧传来滴水回响。墙上的青苔可以食用，而且出乎意料地美味。

遭遇

中等 6

@Actor[xYlOudjXyTakF1m8]{活体山崩} @Actor[NVWaLagWOu5tCCZu]{苔犬（3）}

80 XP

贝科拉将数个土元素束缚在此，与其说是出于其他原因，不如说是为了阻止游荡的访客进入她的自然保护区（区域 @UUID[.f7dzsMJc3BAy82zr]{F04}）。任何生物进入此洞窟后[[/r 1d4]]轮，元素便会从墙壁与地面中突袭而出。它们四肢上可见以太镣铐，象征其受缚本质；镣铐阻止它们离开此洞穴，但它们可以潜伏在墙壁与地面之内。若某个元素被削减至少于5生命值，它会退回岩石之中，数日内不再出现。

支线任务

一名在奥秘学或秘法学方面为专家的英雄会意识到，这些元素的束缚很弱，可以解除。此逆转仪式必须在能看见束缚地点的位置施行；通往区域 @UUID[.YNHrEKfNsLjjoQhE]{F02} 的楼梯或区域 @UUID[.nywKGONakrYspO83]{F01} 的窗户都是进行仪式的好地点，因为元素无法在那里攻击任何人。

该仪式耗时4小时，消耗价值60 gp的宝石，并要求一名英雄在@Check[type:arcana|dc:25]{秘法学} 或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:25]{奥秘学} 检定中成功。尝试该检定的角色必须是所用技能的专家。至多另外四名角色可作为次级施法者。每名次级施法者都可以尝试一次 @Check[type:arcana|dc:23]{秘法学}、@Check[type:nature|dc:23]{自然}、 或 @Check[type:occultism|dc:23]{奥秘学} 次级检定，但必须在所用技能上受训。解除束缚可以使用少于四名次级施法者（也可以完全不包含）。

若仪式成功，元素将返回其家园位面。活体山崩会赐予一名参与解除束缚的英雄一项恩惠（最可能是主施法者）。该角色获得苔犬的 @Item[A3hDrMm29Lo7AzZf]{水晶感知} 能力，持续1周。

宝藏

苔犬埋藏了六颗 @Item[JiGXhVD9bvIBzbW2]{宝石}，每颗价值15 gp，作为其服务的报酬。英雄若搜索该区域并在一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，便能找到这些宝石；具有水晶感知能力的英雄会自动定位术到它们。

The mossy walls of this pebble-strewn cavern extend upward to a ceiling thirty feet high. A wide, rounded window fifteen feet above the floor overlooks this cavern.

Dripping water echoes from the east. The moss on the walls is edible and, in fact, surprisingly tasty.

Encounter

Moderate 6

@Actor[xYlOudjXyTakF1m8]{Living Landslide} @Actor[NVWaLagWOu5tCCZu]{Sod Hounds (3)}

80 XP

Belcorra bound several earth elementals here, more to keep wandering guests out of her nature preserve (area @UUID[.f7dzsMJc3BAy82zr]{F04}) than for any other reason. The elementals spring from the walls and floor [[/r 1d4]] rounds after any creature enters this cavern. They have ethereal shackles visible on their limbs, representing their bound nature; the shackles prevent them from leaving this cave, but they can lurk just within the walls and floor. An elemental reduced to fewer than 5 Hit Points retreats into the stone and doesn't return for several days.

Side Quest

A hero who's an expert in Arcana or Occultism realizes that the elementals’ binding is weak and can be undone. This reversal ritual must be performed in sight of the binding location; the stairs leading up to area @UUID[.YNHrEKfNsLjjoQhE]{F02} or the window in area @UUID[.nywKGONakrYspO83]{F01} make good locations for the ritual since the elementals can’t attack anyone there.

The ritual takes 4 hours, consumes 60 gp of gems, and requires a hero to succeed at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:25]{Arcana} or @Check[type:occultism|dc:25]{Occultism} check. The character attempting the check must be an expert in the skill being used. Up to four other characters can act as secondary casters. Each secondary caster can attempt an @Check[type:arcana|dc:23]{Arcana}, @Check[type:nature|dc:23]{Nature},  or @Check[type:occultism|dc:23]{Occultism} secondary check, but must be trained in the skill used. The unbinding can use fewer than four secondary casters (and need not include any).

If the ritual succeeds, the elementals return to their home plane. The living landslide grants a boon to one of the heroes who participated in the unbinding (most likely the primary caster). That character gains the @Item[A3hDrMm29Lo7AzZf]{Crystal Sense} ability of a sod hound for 1 week.

Treasure

The sod hounds buried six @Item[JiGXhVD9bvIBzbW2]{Gemstones} worth 15 gp each, given to them as payment for their service. Heroes who Search the area find the stones with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:27|traits:action:search]{Perception} check; the hero with the crystal sense ability locates them automatically.

F04. Deep Pool.name: F04. 深水池 F04. Deep Pool
F04. Deep Pool.text:
岩石海岸陡然落入数根钟乳石下方的一大片水池。石质天花板上有五个方形竖井向上延伸。南边，一道透明石质屏障保护着蜿蜒的高架岩脊，岩脊沿洞窟两侧延伸。一座短桥同样包裹在透明石中，跨过水池连接两道岩脊。

此区域曾作为贝科拉的地下自然保护区。她在此饲养了一对多头蛇，因为多头蛇之血在炼金术、魔法与塑肉仪式中有许多用途。水池平均深15英尺，细小的地下溪流不断为其补充水源。

贾法基出于与贝科拉相同的原因，维持着这片保护区与两条多头蛇（原来那一对的后代）。他让它们陷入化学性昏睡，以延长寿命、降低进食量，并减少它们造成的麻烦。当英雄们初到时，多头蛇正在睡觉，只有头部露出水面。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}

如果英雄们谨慎接近此房间，并且队伍中至少一半成员成功对多头蛇进行 Avoiding Notice，则这些生物仍会沉睡。任何明显扰动水面的动作——例如有人从上方坠落进入房间——都会惊醒它们。

遭遇

中等 6

@Actor[RiKjpztTt7tZbOeo]{Hydras (2)}

80 XP

由于被强制进行的炼金冬眠，每条多头蛇需要 [[/r 3d4]] 轮才能完全醒来；在此期间，它处于 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}。每当一条多头蛇受到伤害，将剩余轮数减少3。

多头蛇会战至死亡来保卫领地，但不会在洞窟范围之外追逐猎物。

A rocky shoreline drops steeply into a large pool beneath several stalactites. Five square shafts in the stony ceiling lead upward. To the south, a barrier of transparent stone protects winding raised ledges that run along each side of the cavern. A short bridge, similarly encased in transparent stone, crosses over the pool to connect the two ledges.

This area functioned as Belcorra’s underground nature preserve. She kept a pair of hydras here, as hydra blood has many applications in alchemy, magic, and fleshwarping. The pool averages 15 feet deep, and tiny subterranean streams refresh its waters.

Jafaki maintains the preserve and two hydras (descendants of the original pair) for the same reasons Belcorra did. He induced them into a chemical stupor to extend their lives, lower their food intake, and reduce the amount of trouble they cause. When the heroes first arrive, the hydras are sleeping with just their heads above the water’s surface.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoid Notice}

If the heroes approach this chamber carefully with at least half the party successfully Avoiding Notice from the hydras, the creatures remain asleep. Any actions that significantly disturb the water- such as someone falling into the room from above—rouse them.

Encounter

Moderate 6

@Actor[RiKjpztTt7tZbOeo]{Hydras (2)}

80 XP

Due to their forced alchemical hibernation, each hydra takes [[/r 3d4]] rounds to fully wake up; in the meantime, it’s @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}. Each time a hydra takes damage, reduce the number of rounds remaining by 3.

The hydras defend their territory to the death but don’t pursue prey beyond the confines of the cave.

F05. The Deep End.name: F05. 深水池尾端 F05. The Deep End
F05. The Deep End.text:
这座洞窟的南端完全被水淹没。一条嵌在透明石头中的步道沿着东侧墙壁延伸，位于水面上方十英尺处。

多头蛇曾在水池远端筑巢，那里水深下陷至25英尺。然而，它们害怕最近来到此处的东西，因此现在不再进入水池的这一部分。

水池最深处上方的岩棚被一口井穿透，井口由一张坚固的铁栅盖住。栅栏的螺栓似乎从下方被折断，因此只需稍用力就能将栅栏掀起。若成功通过一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:climb]{Athletics} 检定，水中的任何人都可以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} 上去进入区域 @UUID[.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{F09}。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

一名英雄若对步道进行搜查并成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，会在靠近地面的位置发现一块可疑的方形石砌结构。将其像按钮一样按下后，这扇通往区域 @UUID[.fIH3LXVbvaKFJzOc]{F08} 的暗门会旋转开启。

遭遇

中等 6

@Actor[340AwQpRXGblw1kF]{溺亡魔}

80 XP

乌瑞维安在数周前派出一只溺亡魔去监视贾法基及其阴谋。溺亡魔多疑且不愿承担可能明显暴露其存在的风险；因此，只要有任何生物前来打水，它就会花大部分时间玷污井下的水源。若英雄靠近，这只恶魔会认为自己已被贾法基的盟友发现，并绝望地发动攻击。它不愿向乌瑞维安承认失败，因此会战斗至死。它携带着乌瑞维安坠饰的五块 @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} 之一，用于开启通往契约恶魔领域的门（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}）。

宝藏

@Item[eN1XB2o9m4BPYXZo]{+1 Resilient Scale Mail}

水池最深处被遗弃的多头蛇巢穴中，存放着早已死去的角斗士们的装备与骸骨。唯一完好无损的装备是一件带有狮子纹饰的+1 Resilient Scale Mail。

The southern end of this cavern is entirely flooded. A walkway encased in transparent stone runs along the eastern wall, ten feet above the water’s surface.

The hydras once kept their nest at the far end of the pool, where the depth dips down to 25 feet. They’re afraid of the recent arrival here, however, and now don’t venture into this part of the pool.

An overhang above the deepest part of the pool is pierced by a well capped by a sturdy iron grate. The grate’s bolts appear to have been broken from underneath, so the grate lifts off with only a little effort. With a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:climb]{Athletics} check, anyone in the water can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} up into area @UUID[.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{F09}.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who Searches the walkway and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds a suspicious masonry square near floor level. When pushed like a button, this secret door to area @UUID[.fIH3LXVbvaKFJzOc]{F08} swings open.

Encounter

Moderate 6

@Actor[340AwQpRXGblw1kF]{Sarglagon}

80 XP

Urevian sent a sarglagon to spy on Jafaki and his plots several weeks ago. The sarglagon is paranoid and unwilling to take risks that might overtly expose their presence; therefore, they spend most of their time fouling the water under the well if any creatures come to fill the bucket. If the heroes approach, the devil believes they’ve been discovered by Jafaki’s allies and desperately attacks. Unwilling to admit defeat to Urevian, the sarglagon fights until slain. They carry one of five @UUID[Item.byrsQUlEoIiIgf9t]{Fragments} of Urevian’s pendant, used to open the door into the contract devil’s domain (area @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.YSOnwMgSJVzVm31U]{G10}).

Treasure

@Item[eN1XB2o9m4BPYXZo]{+1 Resilient Scale Mail}

The abandoned hydra nest at the deepest point of the pool contains the equipment and bones of long-dead gladiators. The only intact piece of equipment is a +1 Resilient Scale Mail with lion motifs.

F06. Dissection Chamber.name: F06. 解剖室 F06. Dissection Chamber
F06. Dissection Chamber.text:
金属架子和手术台暗示了这间房间最初的用途。干净的骨头和些许锈蚀的金属碎片在房间其余部分各处堆成小堆。

贾法基几十年来一直把垃圾倒在这间医务室里。天花板上有三条竖井通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.D2f9A4UpjzQmsdNF]{E04}。竖井顶部的盖子从竖井内部可以轻松打开。

遭遇

低威胁 6

@Actor[uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{赭冻怪（2）}

60 XP

两只赭冻怪懒洋洋地在这间解剖室里咕叽咕叽地蠕动，以此处被丢来的垃圾为食。它们会朝感知到的生物移动，期待得到食物；如果角色没有立刻提供某种食物，赭冻怪就会发动攻击，并战斗到被摧毁为止。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

一名正在搜索这些残渣的英雄，会在房间内各种破烂杂物之间发现一把设计精巧的大型@Item[WLO06eLC1Uo8XzBf]{四叉钥匙}。这把钥匙能打开底座房间（区域 @UUID[.4DSWkmCkIZ8iD20I]{F07}）中的一把锁。

宝藏

@Actor[SdhFlXxykBCiK3SU]{解剖室残渣}

在一堆被泥怪酸液冲刷得干干净净的物品之中，有一件链甲衫、一面钢盾、三把匕首、一把镐、数个铁蒺藜、专家级渔具、一具望远镜、14枚岩钉，以及30英尺长的铁链。

Metal shelves and operating tables hint at this room’s original purpose. Clean bones and bits of rusted metal lie in piles throughout the rest of the room.

Jafaki has dumped garbage in this medical bay for decades. Three shafts in the ceiling lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.D2f9A4UpjzQmsdNF]{E04}. The lids at the top open easily from within the shafts.

Encounter

Low 6

@Actor[uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jellies (2)}

60 XP

Two ochre jellies lazily squelch around this chamber, feeding on trash thrown here. They move to creatures they sense, expecting food; if the characters don't immediately offer some sort of food, the jellies attack, fighting until destroyed.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} 

A hero Searching through the detritus discovers a large @Item[WLO06eLC1Uo8XzBf]{Four-pronged key} with an elaborate design among the various bits of junk in this room. The key opens one of the locks in the plinth room (area @UUID[.4DSWkmCkIZ8iD20I]{F07}).

Treasure

@Actor[SdhFlXxykBCiK3SU]{Dissection Chamber Detritus}

Amid the jumble of items scoured clean by the oozes' acid is a chain shirt, a steel shield, three daggers, a pick, several caltrops, professional fishing tackle, a spyglass, 14 pitons, and 30 feet of chain.

F07. Plinth Room.name: F07. 底座房间 F07. Plinth Room
F07. Plinth Room.text:
这间房间的东墙与西墙各有一个棱角分明的壁龛，上面有石雕，但被毁得太严重，已无法辨认原本描绘的内容。这里立着两个倾斜的基座，一个在东侧壁龛内，另一个在西侧壁龛内。一扇门通向北方；与其相对的南墙上只有一扇门的轮廓，却没有把手或门闩。

这间大半被毁的房间曾经陈列着浮雕艺术，颂扬贝科拉与宁布洛斯的威严。如今只剩下两个基座，分处房间两侧，各自带有一把独特的锁。南边的门以及门后的那扇门都无法以正常方式打开；除非解锁，否则每一扇在功能上都等同于一堵厚2英尺的实心石墙。

东侧基座的锁有一个圆形钥匙孔；将正确的钥匙插入并转动，会伴随刺耳的碾磨声开启或关闭通往南方通道中最北端的那扇门（即本房间里可见轮廓的那扇）。西侧基座上有一块金属板，上面聚拢着四个孔；将正确的钥匙插入并转动，会同样伴随响亮的碾磨声开启或关闭两扇门中更南边的那扇。没有正确钥匙时，任何在盗贼技能上达到大师的角色，都可以通过进行五次成功的@Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗贼}检定来以@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}启动其中一把棘手的锁。

基座钥匙

如@UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV.JournalEntryPage.tPPxP1ysQky3lsv3]{Keys}讲义所述，每把钥匙各有三份副本，散落在本等级各处。

• @Item[XMNqir7oUGoFemFM]{圆孔钥匙}可在旧医疗补给室（区域@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.vygkTjkdSwK8uXzB]{E05}）的架子上找到，也可在囚犯审讯室（区域@UUID[.JhZf5mGUPNZqZSum]{F10}）找到。

• @Item[WLO06eLC1Uo8XzBf]{四叉钥匙}可在旧解剖室（区域@UUID[.sGI8w7LQqXuwWhHp]{F06}）的地板上找到，也可在维斯查芮的保险箱中（区域@UUID[.96tKiXroDGWLKvJk]{F16}）找到。

• 贾法基也携带着每把钥匙各一份副本。

This chamber’s east and west walls feature sharply angled alcoves bearing stone carvings too defaced to indicate what they originally depicted. Two angled plinths stand here, one in the alcove to the east and another in the alcove to the west. A single door leads north; the south wall opposite it bears the outline of a door but no handle or latch.

This mostly destroyed room once held relief art extolling the majesty of Belcorra and Nhimbaloth. All that remains are two plinths, one on both sides of the room, that each bear a unique lock. The door to the south and the one beyond it don’t open normally; each is functionally a solid stone wall 2 feet thick unless unlocked.

The eastern plinth features a lock with a round keyhole; turning the proper key in this lock opens or closes the northernmost door in the passage to the south (the outline visible in this room) with a grinding noise. The western plinth has four holes clustered together in a metal plate; turning the proper key in this lock opens or closes the southern of the two doors, also with a loud grinding noise. Without the proper keys, a character who’s a master in Thievery can activate one of these tricky locks with five successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:30|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}.

Plinth Keys

As described on the @UUID[JournalEntry.huN2s6RInuTublnV.JournalEntryPage.tPPxP1ysQky3lsv3]{Keys} handout, three copies of each key exist scattered around this level.

• The @Item[XMNqir7oUGoFemFM]{Round Key} can be found on a shelf in the old medical supply room (area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.vygkTjkdSwK8uXzB]{E05}) and in the prisoner processing chamber (area @UUID[.JhZf5mGUPNZqZSum]{F10}).

• The @Item[WLO06eLC1Uo8XzBf]{Four-pronged Key} can be found on the floor of the old dissection chamber (area @UUID[.sGI8w7LQqXuwWhHp]{F06}) and in Vischari’s safe (area @UUID[.96tKiXroDGWLKvJk]{F16}).

• Jafaki also carries a copy of each key.

F08. Observation Gallery.name: F08. 看台长廊 F08. Observation Gallery
F08. Observation Gallery.text:
这条长廊位于天花板下方15英尺处，环绕一个宽阔、血迹斑斑的房间，唯独东侧没有；下方房间的地面比长廊低5英尺。一扇由浑浊的透明石材制成的窗户，能将附近房间尽收眼底，同时阻断对其的直接进入。北侧有两处圆形的观察区俯瞰该房间；南侧的一间小室内有一张小桌、一把旧椅子，以及通往上方的楼梯。

贝科拉用这条步道来近距离观察她的一名勇士，她让其与各类对手对战，或通过仪式性的决斗来解决分歧。两处圆形观察前室内的魔法惑控系会将测试场内的声音传入此看台长廊，但反向不行。桌上放着几根粉笔和几块书写石板，双尾虫怪在观察测试场中的生物时会在上面做记录。

西南角附近的楼梯通往上方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.d7y3Wc10QZ6wZO5P]{E21}。

西北侧的门没有可见的门闩，但旁边的墙上有两个明显的钥匙孔：一个是圆形凹槽，另一个则是一块带有四个独立孔洞的圆形石片。它们的功能与区域 @UUID[.4DSWkmCkIZ8iD20I]{F07} 的钥匙孔完全相同。

看台长廊东端的墙壁上刻着微微发光的魔法符文。这些符文会同时影响环绕长廊的所有透明石材，并按区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.84aV9OCD0kfmzpC8]{E09} 所述的方式运作。

遭遇

微不足道 6

@Actor[cMpgGvq1fGxh8wI0]{双尾虫怪研究者}

60 XP

一名双尾虫怪研究者正在 @UUID[.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{Testing Grounds} 观察暗音盲怪，并在书写石板上记录。注意到入侵者后，双尾虫怪急切地想看看暗音盲怪在战斗中的表现；它会尽快撤退到长廊东端，将墙壁变为以太。一旦墙不再是实体石材，暗音盲怪的回声定位便能识别英雄的存在，并在双尾虫怪的指挥下加入战斗；两者合力将构成一次对6级角色而言的严重威胁遭遇。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

两扇暗门从此室通向北方（至区域 @UUID[.psfaf5Skhe3bMKsr]{F05}）与东南方（至区域 @UUID[.yBAZCPJ2rioIU3Fx]{F20}）。一名英雄在正确的区域进行搜索，若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便可定位它们。两扇暗门的运作方式相同：靠近地面的一块方形砖石会像按钮一样下陷，使暗门解锁并向外摆开。

Fifteen feet below the ceiling, this gallery traverses all but the east side of a large, bloodstained room with a floor five feet lower than the gallery. A window made of cloudy, transparent stone provides an excellent view of the nearby room while blocking direct access to it. Two rounded observation areas overlook the room from the north; a small room to the south has a small table, an old chair, and stairs leading up.

Belcorra used this walkway to observe one of her champions closely as she pitted them against various opponents or they settled disagreements through ritual combat. A magical enchantment in the two rounded observation vestibules transmit sound from the testing ground into this observation gallery, but not vice versa. The table features some pieces of chalk and a few writing slates, upon which the seugathis take notes when observing creatures in the testing grounds.

The stairs near the southwest corner lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.d7y3Wc10QZ6wZO5P]{E21}.

The northwest door has no visible latches, but the wall next to it features two distinct keyholes: one is a round indentation, and the other is a circular piece of stone with four separate holes. They function identically to the keyholes in area @UUID[.4DSWkmCkIZ8iD20I]{F07}.

The wall at the eastern end of the observation gallery bears faintly glowing magical glyphs. These glyphs simultaneously affect all the transparent stone ringing the gallery and operate as described in area @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.84aV9OCD0kfmzpC8]{E09}.

Encounter

Trivial 6

@Actor[cMpgGvq1fGxh8wI0]{Seugathi Researcher}

60 XP

A seugathi researcher observes the destrachan in the @UUID[.SEAO53LL3c9WdjdO]{Testing Grounds} and takes notes on a writing slate. Upon noticing the intruders, the seugathi becomes eager to see how the destrachan performs in combat; they retreat as soon as possible to the east end of the gallery to turn the wall ethereal. Once the wall is no longer solid stone, the destrachan’s echolocation allows it to recognize the heroes’ presence and join in combat as the seugathi directs, together presenting a severe-threat encounter for 6th-level characters.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}
