Korlok has nothing but scorn for the zebub, but he says that Urevian is shrewd but well-known for keeping his word.

C09. Prison.name: C09. 牢房 C09. Prison
C09. Prison.text:
一个翻倒的夜壶 леж在这间房间角落里一片长方形的真菌旁边，那片真菌可能曾经是一张床垫。真菌中隐约可见一具骷髅（特征）。

这具骷髅（特征）是贝科拉第一位厨师所剩下的全部——一个倒霉的男人，只因一餐菜肴调味过重而遭此不幸。或许是由于这位一丝不苟的厨师灵魂残留的某种效果，这里的真菌不仅可食用，而且相当美味。

An overturned chamber pot lies next to a rectangular patch of fungus that might have once been a mattress in the corner of this room. A skeleton is just visible within the fungus.

The skeleton is all that remains of Belcorra’s first chef, a hapless man who had the misfortune of over-spicing a meal. Perhaps due to some lingering effect of the fastidious chef’s spirit, the fungus here is not only edible but rather tasty.

C10. Twin Stairwells.name: C10. 两座楼梯 C10. Twin Stairwells
C10. Twin Stairwells.text:
这条走廊是两段楼梯的中途平台：一段向北通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{B02}，另一段向南通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32}。碎裂、腐烂的木料散落在大厅各处，是摩洛克从该等级逃离时留下的残骸。

This hallway is a landing for two staircases: one leading up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{B02} in the north and one leading up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8qZk6POeK6TgPon4]{B32} in the south. Splintered, rotten wood lies scattered around this hall, left over during the morlocks’ flight from this level.

C11. Main Library.name: C11. 主图书馆 C11. Main Library
C11. Main Library.text:
数百个石制书架被雕凿在这条十五英尺宽的走廊墙壁中。尽管藏书中有许多空缺，但仍保存着数量惊人的书籍、卷轴与对开本。走廊两侧的几扇门上方悬挂着标牌。南侧一块标牌下方，有一道微弱的蓝色发光在闪动。

这里保存的书籍涵盖范围极广，而溃烂教将书架整理得井井有条。一名英雄若有余裕花费 8 小时钻研这些典籍，便会了解图书馆的编排方式，并在此使用 调查（探索行动）时，对区域历史、奥术主题或灵异主题进行 回忆知识 的检定获得 +1 物品加值。

这里的标牌全都使用地底通用语。南侧区域 @UUID[.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15} 上方的标牌写着“阅览室”。较小的门上方标注如下：区域 @UUID[.TukfnGJXQkB3UYSH]{C12} 是“修理储藏室”，区域 @UUID[.Z3iUNrD6kbgazSIY]{C13} 是“工作间”，区域 @UUID[.jz7V8pdoBnKX4368]{C17} 是“安全室”并刻有跃动的火焰，区域 @UUID[.QaUQGVYx5WFwgQgV]{C18} 是“私人寝室”，区域 @UUID[.0tLGIjz5j6NrA4uC]{C19} 是“抄写员办公室”，区域 @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26} 是“贝科拉的办公室”，通往 C30 到 C32 的走廊标为“北翼”，而区域 @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33} 则是“保密藏书”。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（4）}

80 XP

四只食尸鬼都穿着长长的浅蓝色长袍，在此工作，既负责守卫，也负责为抄写员或教团领袖挑选或取回书籍，以便按需使用或修复。它们不会立刻攻击英雄，但会一边舔着嘴唇、一边打量英雄身上可口的肉块。某只食尸鬼会问队伍是否来“为溃烂献肉”，希望探出英雄是否愿意为区域 @UUID[.wAoRY1yKOiu1ocVU]{C34} 的工作献出身体部位。若有愚蠢到答应的英雄，就被期望当场砍下一截肢体（手指、脚趾或耳朵就够了）交给食尸鬼；它们会带着“捐献物”飞奔去区域 @UUID[.wAoRY1yKOiu1ocVU]{C34}。任何其他与食尸鬼互动的尝试都会很快让它们不耐烦并发动攻击。这些食尸鬼会战斗到被摧毁为止。

如果这里的战斗持续超过 4 轮，或动静异常巨大，@UUID[.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{Area C15} 的食尸鬼会前来调查。

支线任务

认识奥塔里怪谈故事 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories} 的莫里宾特的英雄（或任何在看见这些书时，成功进行一次 @Check[type:society|dc:14|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} 检定来 回忆知识 的英雄）会意识到：莫里宾特很可能会对这批藏书感兴趣。若有英雄把这里的图书馆告诉莫里宾特，这位法师会兴奋地提供一长串要在书架上寻找的具体书名、出版社与大致主题。

在本区域的 宝藏 小节中，以及附近其他满是书籍的房间中，可为莫里宾特回收并收集的书本数量以其 负载 等级标示。英雄在这些房间之一中搜索书籍时，可以尝试进行一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定来分拣书籍。

• 成功时，他们可定位术到该房间内书籍总 负载 中的 1 负载。

• 大成功或大失败时，他们最多可找出 2 负载的书籍。

如果你的玩家以这种方式获得了任何书籍，你可以用 @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books} 物品来代表一叠总计 1 负载的书，并且他们每取回 1 负载就额外获得一份。每份若卖给莫里宾特，价值 5 金币。

XP 奖励

若英雄将至少 12 负载的书交付给莫里宾特，他们就完成该支线任务。若他们之后找到更多书，仍然可以卖给他。

宝藏

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books（2）}

这里保存的书都是一般性知识，因此莫里宾特兴趣不大；这里只有 2 负载的书可为他收集。

Hundreds of stone shelves are carved into the walls of this fifteen-foot-wide hallway. While there are many gaps in the collection, a staggering number of books, scrolls, and folios remain. Signs hang above several doors off of this hall. A faint, blue glow flickers beneath a sign to the south.

The books kept here cover a wide range of subjects, and the Cult of the Canker keep the stacks organized. A hero with the luxury of pursuing these tomes for 8 hours learns the library’s organization and gains a +1 item bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge on regional history, arcane topics, or occult topics when using the Investigate exploration activity here.

The signs here are all in Undercommon. The one above area @UUID[.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{C15} to the south reads, “Reading Room.” The ones over the smaller doors are labeled as follows: area @UUID[.TukfnGJXQkB3UYSH]{C12} is “Repair Storage,” area @UUID[.Z3iUNrD6kbgazSIY]{C13} is “Workroom,” area @UUID[.jz7V8pdoBnKX4368]{C17} is “Safety” with a carving of leaping flames, area @UUID[.QaUQGVYx5WFwgQgV]{C18} is “Personal Quarters,” area @UUID[.0tLGIjz5j6NrA4uC]{C19} is “Scrivener’s Office,” area @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26} is “Belcorra’s Office,” the hallway leading to areas C30 to C32 is “North Wing,” and area @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33} is “Restricted Collection.”

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghouls (4)}

80 XP

Four ghouls all dressed in long, pale-blue robes work here, both to stand guard and to select or retrieve books for the scriveners or cult leaders to use or repair as needed. They don’t immediately attack the heroes but do lick their lips in anticipation as they size up their fleshy bits. One ghoul asks the party if they’re here to “donate flesh for the Canker,” hoping to find out if the heroes are willing to offer body parts to the work in area @UUID[.wAoRY1yKOiu1ocVU]{C34}. A hero foolish enough to agree is expected to lop off an appendage (a finger, toe, or ear suffices) for the ghouls, who scurry off to area @UUID[.wAoRY1yKOiu1ocVU]{C34} with the donation. Any other attempt to interact with the ghouls quickly makes them impatient and they attack. These ghouls fight until destroyed.

If a fight here last more than 4 rounds or is unusually loud, the ghouls in @UUID[.eOv6LI3wvIuKyyNJ]{Area C15} come to investigate.

Side Quest

A hero who knows Morlibint of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.0SO6cXvfRTtHZM6m]{Odd Stories} in Otari (or any hero who makes a successful @Check[type:society|dc:14|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check to Recall Knowledge when seeing these books) realizes that Morlibint would likely be interested in this collection. If a hero tells Morlibint about the library here, the wizard eagerly provides a long list of specific titles, publishers, and general themes to seek in the shelves.

In this area’s Treasure section, along with those of other book-filled rooms nearby, the number of books that can be salvaged and collected for Morlibint are denoted by their Bulk rating. A hero searching for books in one of these rooms can attempt a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check to sort through the books.

• On a success, they locate 1 Bulk of the total Bulk of books contained within the room.

• On a critical success, they can uncover up to 2 Bulk of books.

If your players secure any books in this way, you can use the @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books} item to represent a stack of books totalling one Bulk, and grant them an additional one for each Bulk they retrieve. Each of these is worth five gold if sold to Morlibint.

XP Award

If the heroes deliver at least 12 Bulk of books to Morlibint, they complete the side quest. They can still sell him more books, if they find any.

Treasure

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (2)}

The books kept here are of general knowledge and thus little interest to Morlibint; there are only 2 Bulk of books here to gather for him.

C12. Repair Materials.name: C12. 修复材料 C12. Repair Materials
C12. Repair Materials.text:
这里墙上的架子上摆着铁制分拣架、罐子，以及各种书籍装订工具。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[eVJazBubc7PIlaWc]{修复材料}

这房间里有用于维护书籍的修复材料。它们都太旧了，已经没有用处。一名英雄在此房间进行搜索时，会发现两张2级修复术卷轴以及一张极化认知卷轴。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[eVJazBubc7PIlaWc]{Repair Materials}

Shelves on the wall here contain iron sorting racks, jars, and all manner of bookbinding tools.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[eVJazBubc7PIlaWc]{Repair Materials}

This room contains repair materials for the upkeep of books. All are too old to be useful. A hero Searching this room discovers two 2nd-level scrolls of mending and a scroll of hypercognition.

C13. Librarian’s Workroom.name: C13. 图书管理员工作间 C13. Librarian’s Workroom
C13. Librarian’s Workroom.text:
从区域 C11 通往这间房间的门被上锁，而钥匙在房间内。一名英雄可以通过三次成功的 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃}检定，或通过一次成功的 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定来打开门，但一次失败的运动检定会惊动房间里的幽灵（特征）。

三张工作桌沿着这间房的墙壁排开，其中一张桌子旁放着一把凳子。凳子旁边有一具身穿浅蓝色图书管理员长袍的骷髅（特征）瘫成一堆。

这里有三张专用长凳，分别用于装订书籍、修复书页以及准备羊皮纸。这些桌子与工具都很陈旧且毫无用处。

图书管理员贾瑞尔·卡德瑞恩的幽灵（特征）仍在这间工作室里徘徊。贾瑞尔无法逃脱其他学者日益残忍的阴谋，于是她退入此室，锁上门，饮下了一罐砒霜（用于处理书籍装订），以免活生生被吃掉。她死得很快却极其痛苦，不久之后便以幽灵（特征）之身再度“起身”。贾瑞尔把自己的时间都花在以哑剧般的动作表演修书的过程上。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[hia81Ut7fEREbhkq]{贾瑞尔·卡德瑞恩}

80 XP

贾瑞尔对这些英雄抱有怀疑，但不会立刻敌对，除非他们表现出攻击性；不过如果他们诋毁贝科拉，她会勃然大怒并发动攻击。若英雄选择与她交谈而非战斗，他们会发现她似乎被自己的工具与装备所吸引，仿佛在某种强迫下重演她生前的工作。

XP 奖励

如果英雄在不与贾瑞尔战斗的情况下让她的灵魂得以休息，则给予他们如同在战斗中击败她一样的 XP。

宝藏

@Actor[7X6SlSnDyVvpCdSc]{贾瑞尔的遗骸}

搜查贾瑞尔的遗骸会找到通往区域 @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} 的门钥匙、一枚价值 10 gp 的金质镇纸，以及一副工匠护目镜。

The door to this room from area C11 is locked, and its key is inside the room. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with three successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:20|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check, but a failed Athletics check alerts the ghost in the room.

Three worktables line the walls of this room with a single stool near one of the tables. A skeleton wearing a light blue librarian's robe lies in a heap beside the stool.

Three specialized benches here are outfitted to bind books, repair pages, and prepare parchment, respectively. The tables and tools are old and useless.

The ghost of the librarian Jarelle Kaldrian still haunts this workroom. Jarelle couldn't escape the other scholars' increasingly gruesome schemes, so she retreated into this room, locked the door, and drank a jar of arsenic (used to work with book bindings) rather than be eaten alive. She died quickly and in agony, only to rise soon thereafter as a ghost. Jarelle spends her time pantomiming the act of repairing books.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[hia81Ut7fEREbhkq]{Jarelle Kaldrian}

80 XP

Jarelle is suspicious of the heroes but not immediately hostile unless they show aggression, though she becomes irate and attacks if they speak ill of Belcorra. If the heroes choose to talk to her rather than fight, they can see that she seems drawn to her tools and equipment, as if by a compulsion to reenact her life's work.

XP Award

If the heroes put Jarelle’s spirit to rest without fighting her, award them XP as if they'd defeated her in combat.

Treasure

@Actor[7X6SlSnDyVvpCdSc]{Jarelle's Remains}

A search of Jarelle's remains turns up the key to the door to area @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11}, a gold paperweight worth 10 gp, and a crafter's eyepiece.

C14. Librarian’s Bedroom.name: C14. 图书管理员的卧室 C14. Librarian’s Bedroom
C14. Librarian’s Bedroom.text:
一张狭小、局促的床别扭地塞在这间房里，因为墙边排着一圈下垂的书架。

贾蕾尔曾住在这里，直到她在@UUID[.Z3iUNrD6kbgazSIY]{Area C13}自尽。她保存在这里的书大多是图书馆其他地方所见书籍的重复本，但她把它们视作自己的私人藏书。

宝藏

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{贵重书籍（2）}

这里有2负载的书可供为莫里宾特收集。

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (2)}

A small, cramped bed is wedged awkwardly into this room, as the walls are lined with sagging bookshelves.

Jarelle once lived here before she took her life in @UUID[.Z3iUNrD6kbgazSIY]{Area C13}. The books she kept here were mostly duplicates of others found elsewhere in the library, but she viewed them as her private collection.

Treasure

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (2)}

There are 2 Bulk of books here to gather for Morlibint.

C15. Gauntlight Reading Room.name: C15. 灯塔阅览室 C15. Gauntlight Reading Room
C15. Gauntlight Reading Room.text:
这个房间光滑的石墙即使在空气干燥且略显闷热的情况下也因潮气而闪闪发亮。几张低矮的长沙发围成一圈摆放，其间穿插着矮桌，桌上堆着几本书和一些腐烂的腐肉残块。在房间中央裸露的地面与上方天花板之间，延伸着一条扭曲的淡蓝色光带；其接触点向外伸出如同感染组织般的蔓生物，以扭曲的螺旋形向外延展数尺。

如同在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35} 中一样，这条病态的光带是 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight} 日益增长力量的显现。此处曾是图书馆工作人员的阅览室，也是他们能直接评估凄凉灯塔能量的地方。这道诡异的光在房间中央形成一个直径5尺的爆发区域翻涌不息。任何活着的生物在其中结束其回合时，都会受到[[/r {4d6}[negative damage]]]{4d6 负能量伤害}（@Check[type:reflex|dc:18|basic:true]{基础反射}豁免）；而不死生物则恢复等量生命值。只要凄凉灯塔仍保持其低阶激活状态，这条光带便会持续翻涌；但若英雄们从区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09} 的囚禁中救出拉斯达·范克维尔，这条光带就会倏然熄灭。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{溃烂教徒} @Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（2）}

80 XP

今天，溃烂教的食尸鬼在此处拿着书与零嘴放松。成熟的摩洛克肉近来一直是它们饮食的主食，但当这些食尸鬼以及命令术它们的溃烂教徒发现英雄后，决定把冒险者的肉也加进菜单。战斗时，任何被打到低于一半生命值的食尸鬼都会移动进光带中以获得一些死灵治疗；如有必要，它会推撞挡路的同伴食尸鬼。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

英雄在搜索该房间时，若成功通过一次@Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，便会在西侧弧形墙壁上发现通往区域 @UUID[.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16} 的密门。

This chamber’s smooth stone walls glisten with moisture despite the air being dry and somewhat stuffy. Several low divans are arranged in a circle and interspersed with low tables stacked with a few books and rotting morsels of decayed flesh. A twisting ribbon of pale blue light stretches between the bare floor at the room’s center and the ceiling above, its points of contact sending creepers of what looks like infected tissue out in a distorted spiral for a few feet.

As in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.8pbhSFgv71lvCz9M]{B35}, the ribbon of sickly light is a manifestation of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}’s growing power. This room once served as a reading room for library staff, as well as a place where they could directly evaluate Gauntlight's energies. This eerie light churns in a 5-foot-diameter burst at the room's center. Any living creature ending its turn in it takes [[/r {4d6}[negative damage]]]{4d6 Negative Damage} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:18|basic:true]{Basic Reflex} save), and undead creatures regain the same amount in Hit Points. As long as Gauntlight remains at its low-level activation, the ribbon of light continues to churn, but if the heroes rescue Lasda Venkervale from his captivity in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RmFsEEQSD9Ulugwm]{D09}, the ribbon winks out.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{Canker Cultist} @Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghouls (2)}

80 XP

Today, Cult of the Canker ghouls relax here with books and snacks. Ripened morlock flesh has been a staple of their diets lately, but the ghouls and the cultist who commands them decide to add adventurer flesh to the menu once they spot the heroes. As they fight, any ghoul brought below half its Hit Points moves into the ribbon of light to gain some necromantic healing, Shoving a rival ghoul out of the way if necessary.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching this room spots the secret door to area @UUID[.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16} in the curved western wall.

C16. Level 3 Portal Chamber.name: C16。等级 3 传送门厅 C16. Level 3 Portal Chamber
C16. Level 3 Portal Chamber.text:
传送网络

憎恨魔窟内的一些 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} 构成了一个更大网络的一部分。通过描摹墙上符文的特定图案，某人可以将这些房间中任意一间内的所有人传送至憎恨魔窟内另外九间传送门房间之一——前提是出发房间与目的地的传送法阵都已通过 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal}仪式唤醒（区域 @UUID[.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}）。

这九间房间为以下区域：@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}、@UUID[.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}、@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}、@UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}、@UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}、@UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}、@UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}，以及 @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

这间圆形房间的墙壁上装饰着复杂、彼此交织的符文与形状，它们被深深雕刻进石头里，并填充了暗淡的银色金属。地板与天花板被打磨得光可鉴人。

这间房间内有一座惰性的传送法阵，与区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17} 中的那座相同。与那间房间一样，这座传送法阵必须先在区域 @UUID[.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35} 通过唤醒传送门仪式重新启动，才能使用。

XP 奖励

为启动这座传送门给予英雄们 30 XP。

Teleportation Network

Some of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} within the Abomination Vaults form a part of a larger network. By tracing specific patterns on the wall runes, someone could transport everyone in any one of these chambers to one of nine other portal chambers in the Abomination Vaults- so long as the teleportation circles in both the departure chamber and destination have been awakened by the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual (area @UUID[.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35}).

The nine chambers are areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}, @UUID[.vEiow4kU961XNOJp]{C16}, @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.RJf3BCpcVW6d68s7]{D05}, @UUID[JournalEntry.JT0zCcIwsSpKnbB5.JournalEntryPage.LJhOoRqYjj38YWl8]{E18}, @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.mDFVGUXY6YDuQWF3]{F13}, @UUID[JournalEntry.OyNcqrpRClyhr8BJ.JournalEntryPage.zTpatmyyb4JvgNCo]{G02}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FwWmtOBFHhvM2gtf.JournalEntryPage.Nak2hUmVOHXBkcR5]{H33}, @UUID[JournalEntry.1vlzl3NJsftNB9Dc.JournalEntryPage.DJKWR2KLTPUi3w6T]{I59}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.yn21bNM6kpV4xRol.JournalEntryPage.JinYTJeYVFBE1uky]{J05}

The walls of this circular chamber are decorated with intricate, intertwining runes and shapes carved into deep into the stone and filled with dull, silvery metal. The floor and ceiling are polished to a reflective sheen.

This room contains an inert teleportation circle like the one in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.537bzfVUpq6XbR9a]{B17}. Just as with that room, this teleportation circle must be reactivated with the awaken portal ritual in area @UUID[.8X4xF40k06MW0X7q]{C35} before it can be used.

XP Award

Award the heroes 30 XP for activating this portal.

C17. Firefighting Supplies.name: C17. 消防用品 C17. Firefighting Supplies
C17. Firefighting Supplies.text:
几桶沙子和若干个大桶挤满了这间狭窄的储藏室。门背后固定着一个简陋的木盒，盒盖紧闭。

这里存放的物资可用于灭火，而火灾在任何图书馆里都是重大威胁。这些桶曾经装过水，但如今只剩下霉污。

宝藏

@Item[lq62ogMGkC0lGTaw]{灭火术魔杖}

门上的木盒扣着插销，里面放着一根灭火术魔杖。

@Item[lq62ogMGkC0lGTaw]{Wand of Quench}

.

Several buckets of sand and a number of large barrels crowd this cramped storeroom. A simple wooden case with a closed lid is attached to the back of the door.

The supplies kept here are available to extinguish fires, a significant threat in any library. The barrels once held water but now contain only mildew.

Treasure

@Item[lq62ogMGkC0lGTaw]{Wand of Quench}

The case on the door is latched and holds a Wand of Quench.

C18. Temporary Bunks.name: C18. 临时餐厅 C18. Temporary Bunks
C18. Temporary Bunks.text:
三张朴素的床被别扭地堆叠在这间房间的西墙边上，腾出的空间只够放下一张矮桌，上面堆满散发恶臭的碎肉与骨块。

虽然大多数在图书馆劳作的仆从都住在地面上的住处，但有些人在长时间的研究期间需要休息。食尸鬼不需要床，就把它们简单地堆到一旁。

遭遇

低威胁 3

@Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（3）}

60 XP

这间房间现在充当三只食尸鬼的餐室，它们正大啖一名摩洛克的残骸。它们一见到英雄就会攻击，但第一个受伤的食尸鬼会尝试逃往区域 @UUID[.0tLGIjz5j6NrA4uC]{C19}，以招募阿勒·罗斯克的援助。

Three plain beds have been awkwardly stacked against the west wall of this room, leaving room for a single low table heaped with foul-smelling chunks of flesh and bone.

While most servants who toiled in the library kept quarters aboveground, some needed rest during long stretches of research. The ghouls don’t need the beds and simply stacked them out of the way.

Encounter

Low 3

@Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghouls (3)}

60 XP

This room now serves as a dining room for three ghouls who are feasting on the remains of a morlock. They attack the heroes on sight, but the first one injured tries to flee to area @UUID[.0tLGIjz5j6NrA4uC]{C19} to recruit Aller Rosk's aid.

C19. Scrivener’s Workshop.name: C19. 抄写员的工坊 C19. Scrivener’s Workshop
C19. Scrivener’s Workshop.text:
这间房间或许曾经是一间写作工作室，但如今它的状态几乎被几十片带纹身的剥皮肉片彻底抹除。根据房间中央桌上的工作台来看，这些纹身都是在死后才刺上去的；一片苍白的皮肤被拉伸铺在桌面上，上面是一幅尚未完成的邪恶女子画像。

阿勒·罗斯克生前是贝科拉的公证人与书记员，但在他死去并变成食尸鬼后，他的天性与兴趣发生了变化，哪怕只是些微。他对带纹身的肉产生了独特的嗜好：把某些东西写下来，然后再把它吃掉——这种想法对这扭曲的食尸鬼颇具吸引力。而当他不在准备一些不那么新鲜的摩洛克、分发给其他食尸鬼时，他就会在这里，用一片摩洛克的皮来制作他最新的作品。他当前的项目是对贝科拉的描绘。虽然他并不打算吃掉这一幅，但他内心的某个角落知道：这件艺术品一旦完成，其结局也不会与他这些年来创作的无数作品有任何不同。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[tOL4rWj2oYWZ4ow2]{阿勒·罗斯克}

80 XP

阿勒专注于他的工作，先攻检定承受-2减值。若被打断，他会怒火中烧并咒骂，在前2轮里每轮浪费1个动作来发泄不满，并告诉英雄们：等他打败他们之后，他会把亵渎的打油诗和羞辱性的颂歌刺在他们的尸体上。阿勒·罗斯克偏执得近乎单一，一旦战斗开始便会无情追击敌人，并战斗至被摧毁为止。

宝藏

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{贵重书籍（2）}

此房间内有2负载的书籍，内容涉及纹身技艺与莫里宾特感兴趣的历史纹身。

While this room might have once served as a writing studio, today its condition has been all but obliterated by dozens of tiny swatches of skinned flesh marked with tattoos. Judging by the workspace on the table in the middle of the room, these tattoos have been placed postmortem, with a swath of pale skin stretched over the desk sporting a half-completed image of a sinister woman.

Aller Rosk served as a notary and scribe for Belcorra when he lived, but after he died and became a ghoul, his nature and interests shifted, if only slightly. He’s developed a unique taste for tattooed flesh. The idea of writing something down and then eating it appeals to the twisted ghoul, and when he isn't preparing a less-than-fresh morlock for distribution to the other ghouls, he's here, preparing his latest work on a swath of morlock skin. His current project is a depiction of Belcorra. While he doesn't intend to eat this one, some part of him knows that this work of art, once complete, won't have a fate any different than the numerous others he's created over the years.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[tOL4rWj2oYWZ4ow2]{Aller Rosk}

80 XP

Aller is focused on his work and takes a -2 penalty to initiative checks. If interrupted, he seethes and curses, wasting an action each round for the first 2 rounds voicing his displeasure and informing the heroes about the blasphemous limericks and humiliating odes he’ll be tattooing onto their corpses once he’s defeated them. Single-minded to a fault, Aller Rosk pursues foes relentlessly once a fight begins and fights until he is destroyed.

Treasure

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (2)}

This room contains 2 Bulk of books about tattoo artistry and historical tattoos of interest to Morlibint.

C20. Scrivener’s Office.name: C20. 抄写员的办公室 C20. Scrivener’s Office
C20. Scrivener’s Office.text:
这间办公室里的书桌被重新改造成一张凌乱的屠宰台。一把闪亮的银短柄斧楔在书桌顶部，房间里散落着一些腐烂的苍白肉块。

阿勒尔把这间办公室改造成了一间临时肉铺。当然，把一具摩洛克的尸体处理成供食尸鬼食用的肉块几乎谈不上什么技艺，无非就是用短柄斧快速而残忍地劈砍几下。

宝藏

@Item[p8IEnP32OIwbaF4a]{+1 低纯度银质短柄斧}

这把短柄斧是一把+1 低纯度银质短柄斧。

@Item[p8IEnP32OIwbaF4a]{+1 Low-Grade Silver Hatchet}

.

The desk in this office has been repurposed into a messy butcher’s block. A shiny silver hatchet is wedged in the top of the desk, and bits of decaying pale flesh lie strewn about the room.

Aller has repurposed this office into a makeshift butcher’s shop. Of course, there’s little artistry that goes into the preparation of a morlock body for ghouls to eat, other than a few quick and brutal hacks with a hatchet.

Treasure

@Item[p8IEnP32OIwbaF4a]{+1 Low-Grade Silver Hatchet}

The hatchet is a +1 Low-Grade Silver Hatchet.

C21. Food Storage.name: C21. 食物储藏室 C21. Food Storage
C21. Food Storage.text:
这里悬挂并堆叠着一堆堆缓慢腐烂的尸体，揭示出这间昔日卧室如今被用作肉库。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

这里存放着五具摩洛克的尸体；在这间寒冷的房间里，它们的血肉正以相当缓慢的速度分解（对食尸鬼的味蕾而言，是“熟成”）。这里没有任何值得注意之物，但肮脏的环境会使任何搜查房间的英雄暴露于蓝疱疹——一种由罕见的食肉细菌引发的疾病。食尸鬼认为感染蓝疱疹的血肉格外鲜美。成功通过一次 @Check[type:medicine|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{医学} 或 @Check[type:nature|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{自然} 检定的英雄，会在搜查房间前意识到这些受感染尸体带来的危险。

蓝疱疹

疾病 3

  • 疾病
  • 剧毒

这种食肉疾病会在皮肤与牙龈上造成显著且疼痛的蓝色水疱。在你受蓝疱疹影响期间，你无法降低自己的恶心（状态）。

豁免： @Check[type:Fortitude|dc:20]{强韧}

潜伏期：1天

  • 阶段 1：@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}（1天）
  • 阶段 2：@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} 且 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}（1天）
  • 阶段 3：@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} 且 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} （1周）
  • 阶段 4：@Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} 且 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} （1周）

The heaps of slowly decaying bodies hung and stacked here reveal this former bedroom’s current use as a meat locker.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Five dead morlocks are stored here, their flesh decomposing (aging, to the ghoul palate) somewhat slowly in the chilly room. There's nothing of interest in here, but the filthy conditions expose any hero who Searches the room to blueblisters, a disease arising from an uncommon flesh-eating bacteria. Ghouls find flesh infected with blueblisters to be quite savory. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:medicine|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Medicine} or @Check[type:nature|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} check realizes the danger these infected bodies pose before Searching the room.

Blueblisters

Disease 3

  • Disease
  • Virulent

This flesh-eating disease causes prominent and painful blue blisters on the skin and gums. You can't reduce your sickened condition while afflicted with blueblisters.

Saving Throw: @Check[type:Fortitude|dc:20]{Fortitude}

Onset: One Day

  • Stage 1: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 day)
  • Stage 2: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)
  • Stage 3: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 week)
  • Stage 4: @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} and @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 week)

C22. Elevator Up.name: C22. 向上的升降机 C22. Elevator Up
C22. Elevator Up.text:
若上方区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34} 的魔法升降梯仍停在上层，本房间的门打开后将直接通向实心石壁。

这间朴素的圆形房间空无一物。东侧墙上装饰着一幅覆满苔藓的骷髅图像。

本房间的地板是一座魔法升降梯，与上方区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34} 相连。若一名生物触碰宁布洛斯的符号，地板会逐渐上升30英尺。（若英雄们尚未发现区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34} 的秘密门，他们可能不会意识到这条死路其实通往别处。）无法在升降梯井道中压碎任何东西；若有任何物体阻挡升降梯上升，例如有物品卡在北侧或南侧的门口，升降梯只会再次下降。

The doors to this room open onto solid stone if the magical elevator beyond is still up at area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34}.

This plain, circular room is empty. An image of a moss-caked skull adorns the eastern wall.

The floor of this room is a magical elevator that links to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34} above. If a creature touches Nhimbaloth’s symbol, the floor gradually ascends 30 feet. (If the heroes aren’t aware of the secret door in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.VotAVttLzRCeBWqT]{B34}, they might not realize this dead end leads anywhere.) It isn’t possible to crush anything in the elevator shaft; if anything gets in the way of the elevator’s ascent, such as an item stuck in the doorway to the north or south, the elevator simply descends again.

C23. Ghoul Garden.name: C23. 食尸鬼花园 C23. Ghoul Garden
C23. Ghoul Garden.text:
房间南半部堆着一大堆深灰色的泥土。

食尸鬼从地表搬来一堆堆沼泽泥土，把这间办公室改造成了花园。

遭遇

低威胁 3

@Actor[GsrqCDf0Dc9PisEt]{弱化紫菌（2）}

60 XP

食尸鬼在此培育了一对紫菌，既用于“快速熟成”血肉，也作为守卫。这些真菌尚未完全长成，但对非食尸鬼而言仍然危险（真菌已被训练到粗浅程度，不会攻击它们的不死园丁）。

A large mound of dark-gray soil lies heaped in the southern half of this room.

The ghouls have converted this office into a garden by hauling in mounds of swampy soil from the surface.

Encounter

Low 3

@Actor[GsrqCDf0Dc9PisEt]{Weak Violet Fungi (2)}

60 XP

The ghouls have cultivated a pair of violet fungi here, both as a method to "flash season" flesh and to serve as guardians. The fungi aren't yet fully grown but are still dangerous to non-ghouls (the fungi have been trained to a rudimentary degree, and they don't lash out at their undead gardeners).

C24. Canker Shrine.name: C24. 溃烂神龛 C24. Canker Shrine
C24. Canker Shrine.text:
无论这间房间最初用途为何，如今它被用作一处骇人的圣坛。一堆腐烂的血肉材料——看起来由等量的眼睛、嘴巴与皮肤组成——躺在房间中央的恶臭丘堆中，周围环绕着两打用小骨头与缠结打结的头发编成的微型类人生物塑像。

这座血肉丘堆是一只正在缓慢腐坏的呓语之喉——食尸鬼将其奉为“至纯之肉”的生物。围绕其摆放的塑像，代表教团中每一只食尸鬼。此房间的气味尤其恶臭。活体生物在房间内开始其回合时，必须成功通过一次 @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18]{Fortitude} 豁免，否则变为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}。若成功，该生物在24小时内对这里的气味获得暂时免疫。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{溃烂教徒（2）}

80 XP

两名溃烂教徒正在此处膜拜，若他们的敬拜被打断便会勃然大怒。英雄在任何一次成功的 @Check[type:religion|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定以辨识他们时，除获得其他信息外，还会识别出这些教徒对死去的呓语之喉的崇敬。任何针对死去的呓语之喉的攻击——无论出于故意还是意外——都会令教徒震惊，使其变为 @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} 1，持续1轮，但也会使他们将所有攻击集中在亵渎者身上。他们会战斗至被摧毁。

Whatever this room’s original use, today it serves as a horrific shrine. A rotting heap of fleshy material that seems to be composed of equal parts eyes, mouths, and skin lies in a stinking mound in the middle of the room, surrounded by two dozen tiny humanoid effigies crafted out of small bones and tangles of knotted hair.

The mound of flesh is a slowly decaying gibbering mouther- a creature the ghouls revere as "pure flesh." The effigies arranged around it are representations of each ghoul in the cult. The smell in this room is particularly foul. A living creature must succeed at a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:18]{Fortitude} save when it starts its turn in the room or become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune to the smell here for 24 hours.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{Canker Cultists (2)}

80 XP

Two cultists of the Canker are worshiping here, and they become irate if their venerations are interrupted. A hero identifies the cultists' reverence for the dead gibbering mouther on any successful @Check[type:religion|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to identify them, in addition to any other information gained. Any attack against the dead gibbering mouther- intentional or otherwise- shocks the cultists, causing them to become @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} 1 for 1 round, but it also causes them to focus all their attacks on the blasphemer. They fight until destroyed.

C25. Washroom.name: C25. 洗手间 C25. Washroom
C25. Washroom.text:
这间浴室的马桶和浴缸上都积满了灰尘。

食尸鬼们用不上这间房间，或许反倒是一种幸运。事实上，它们几乎从不往这里看，所以潜行的英雄也许可以在食尸鬼的地盘中央利用这里来躲藏。

This bathroom’s commode and tub are caked with dust.

It’s perhaps a blessing that the ghouls have no use for this room. In fact, they rarely ever look in here, so stealthy heroes might use it to hide out in the middle of the ghouls’ territory.

C26. Belcorra’s Office.name: C26. 贝科拉的办公室 C26. Belcorra’s Office
C26. Belcorra’s Office.text:
这间办公室被悬挂在书桌与椅子上方的枝形吊灯上的数盏发光光亮术照得十分明亮。北墙与南墙上各挂着一面镜子，但两面都严重破裂。

这间房内的光照对食尸鬼并没有特别的伤害，但溃烂教并不觉得这种照明令人愉快——此外，他们将此区域以及更深处的房间视为其守护者贝科拉的私人领地，出于对她在归来之日的尊敬，他们让这间房以及其后的房间都保持原样、未曾触动。然而，如果他们发现英雄进入了该区域，幸存的食尸鬼会带着义愤在此追击他们——只要有任何英雄在此，溃烂教的食尸鬼对其进行攻击掷骰时获得+1环境加值。

西侧的门上了锁，锁板上刻着一本风格化的打开的书。这一装饰与区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13} 中某把钥匙上的图案相同。钥匙孔大到可以向里窥视，但除了能辨认出房间同样被明亮光照照亮之外，什么也看不见。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torch}

枝形吊灯的明亮光照来自一支嵌在其中心的永燃火把。嵌入时，它的光会在许多漂亮（但毫无价值）的玻璃碎块间反射。

@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}

This office is brightly lit by several glowing lights in a chandelier hanging above a desk and chair. Mirrors hang on the north and south wall, although both of them are badly cracked.

The light in this chamber isn’t particularly harmful to ghouls, but the cult of the Canker doesn’t find the lighting pleasant—further, they view this area and the rooms beyond as the private domain of their patron, Belcorra, and out of respect for her on the day of her return, they’ve left this room and those beyond it untouched. If they discover the heroes have entered the area, though, the surviving ghouls pursue them in here with a righteous fury—as long as any heroes are in here, Cult of the Canker ghouls gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against them.

The western door is locked, and the lock plate is engraved with a stylized open book. This decoration matches the image on one of the keys in area @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torch}. The keyhole is large enough to look through, but it’s impossible to see anything in the room other than to identify that the room is also brightly lit.

Treasure

@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}

The chandelier’s bright light comes from an Everburning Torch socketed into its center. When socketed, it reflects through many pretty (but valueless) chunks of glass.

C27. Belcorra’s Reading Room.name: C27. 贝科拉的阅览室 C27. Belcorra’s Reading Room
C27. Belcorra’s Reading Room.text:
从区域 @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26} 通往此房间的门上着一把巨大的锁；其钥匙在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13} 的钥匙环上。英雄可以通过 3 次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:18|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}，或通过一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:22|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} 检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}，但一次失败的 Athletics 检定会提醒正在此处阅读的妖精，有入侵者存在。

这间房间看起来异常舒适：厚实的地毯、发光枝形吊灯提供的明亮光照，以及令人安神的熏香。两把松软的扶手椅面对着一张矮桌，桌上堆满书籍；更多书籍则摆在西侧的一排书架上。西北角有一座轻柔汩汩作响的喷泉，雕刻成覆满苔藓、渗水的骷髅形状。

这间房曾是贝科拉用来放松与阅读的私密舒适场所；这里有一些小型的魔法点缀：熏香的气味、喷泉的咕嘟声与明亮光照彼此配合，营造出愉悦的阅读体验。

这里的大多数书籍讨论献祭、无形的不死生物，以及熄灭活体的肉身与灵魂以制造强力魔法物品等主题。其他书则讲述内海地区各地著名闹鬼事件的故事（往往经过虚构改写）。这些书相当古老，但保存良好。它们可以像区域 @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} 的书一样，用于在这些主题上援助调查，提供 +1 物品加值。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[73qJxJK8ES4Tbp2k]{光中潜伏者}

80 XP

房间的舒适对当前的住客毫无意义：一名名为“微光笑颜”的光中潜伏者最近溜进了这间明亮的房间，以满足其好奇心。这名生物别扭地坐在房间里一把（对它而言）过大的椅子上，努力保持一本对它来说略显过大的书不至于滑落。它会不时因书中的内容而咯咯怪笑，同时用一支彩色羽毛笔在文字旁做批注。它被一本带插图的《蠕虫之路》中对仪式献祭的血腥描写所吸引，若被打扰便会愤怒地攻击。若其生命值降至 20 以下，这名妖精会使用次元门逃往区域 @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26}（不过若英雄已将该房间的照明熄灭，它便无法这么做），并迅速飞离。它会策划对英雄的报复，最可能的方式是与区域 @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33} 的食尸鬼结盟。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

搜索书架

英雄在翻阅这套藏书时，若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{察觉} 中成功，便会在一本关于幽灵的大部头里找到一本夹藏的纤薄书卷《不可言说的鬼故事》。这本薄册包含用于制造骚灵的 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} 仪式的配方；它还收录了对 @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AMEu5zzLN7uCX645]{Ghostly Weapon} 法术的详尽、学院派分析。能施放 3 环奥术或异能法术的角色，可借助这些笔记，将自己已知的一个 3 环法术在仅 1 天的休整模式中重训为幽灵武器。法师则可直接将该法术誊写进自己的法术书。此书价值 20 gp。

这些巨著之中包含足够的文本，可向莫里布因特提供 1 负载的 @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{贵重书籍}。

遗失的钥匙

英雄搜索此房间时，会在两张椅子坐垫之间发现一把铁钥匙，上面带有被刮损的奥罗登象征。该钥匙可打开通往区域 @UUID[.QyDogj0m5OoqMtUg]{C30} 的门。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torch}

如同区域 @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26}，这盏枝形吊灯中装有一支可拆卸的永燃火把。

The door to this room from area @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26} is locked with an oversized lock; its key is on the key ring in area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} with three successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:18|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} check or @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open} with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:22|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check, but a failed Athletics check alerts the fey reading here to the presence of intruders.

This room looks exceptionally comfortable with a thick carpet, bright light from a glowing chandelier, and soothing incense. Two overstuffed chairs sit opposite a low table stacked with books, while more books sit on a set of shelves to the west. A softly gurgling fountain carved to resemble a mossy skull leaking water sits in the northwest corner.

This room once served as a private and comfortable place for Belcorra to relax and read, with minor magical trappings like the scent of incense, the bubbling of the fountain, and the bright light working together to afford a pleasant reading experience.

Most of the books here concern topics of sacrifice, incorporeal undead, and extinguishing living bodies and souls to create powerful magic items. Other books are tales (often fictionalized) of famous hauntings throughout the Inner Sea region. The books are quite old but are well preserved. They can be used just like the books in area @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} to aid in Investigation on these topics, providing a +1 item bonus.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[73qJxJK8ES4Tbp2k]{Lurker In Light}

80 XP

The room's comforts are wasted on the current occupant, a lurker in light named Shimmergrin who recently slipped into the brightly lit room to satisfy their own curiosity. The creature sits awkwardly in one of the oversized (for them) chairs in the room as they focus on balancing a book a little bit too large for them to handle. They periodically cackle and titter over the book as they annotate its text with a colorful quill. They've become distracted by the grisly descriptions of ritual sacrifice in an illustrated copy of a text called Pathways of the Worm and angrily attack if interrupted. If brought below 20 Hit Points, the fey uses dimension door to flee to area @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26} (although they can't do so if the heroes have doused that room's illumination) and flit away. They plot revenge against the heroes, most likely by allying with the ghouls in area @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33}.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Searching the Bookshelves

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20]{Perception} while perusing this collection turns up a slender volume called Ineffable Hauntings tucked inside of a larger book about ghosts. This volume contains the formula for the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} ritual to create poltergeists. It also contains a detailed, academic analysis of the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AMEu5zzLN7uCX645]{Ghostly Weapon} spell. A character who can cast 3rd-level arcane or occult spells can use these notes to retrain a 3rd-level spell they know into ghostly weapon with only 1 day of downtime. A wizard can simply transcribe this spell into their spellbook. This book is worth 20 gp.

Among these tomes are enough texts to present 1 Bulk of @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books} to Morlibint.

Lost Key

Heroes Searching this room discover an iron key bearing a defaced symbol of Aroden between two chair cushions. The key unlocks the door to area @UUID[.QyDogj0m5OoqMtUg]{C30}.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everburning Torch}

As in area @UUID[.AheFAUwUtko3qnDA]{C26}, the chandelier incorporates a removable Everburning Torch.

C28. Private Washroom.name: C28. 私人卫生间 C28. Private Washroom
C28. Private Washroom.text:
这间房里的浴缸和便桶出奇地干净。

尽管用于保持这间房间清洁的微弱惑控系魔法仍在运作，这里也几乎没有什么值得注意的东西。

The bathtub and commode in this room are surprisingly clean.

Although a minor enchantment to keep this room clean still operates, there’s little of interest here.

C29. Abandoned Guard Post.name: C29. 废弃的警卫室 C29. Abandoned Guard Post
C29. Abandoned Guard Post.text:
这间如今空无一物的房间曾经是一个岗哨。除了一把破损的铁凳和一块使用频繁的磨刀石外，什么也没剩下。南侧门后的楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01}。

This now-empty room was once a guard post. Nothing remains other than a broken iron stool and a well-used whetstone. The stairs beyond the door to the south lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.owO8Ie1yNfI2amxK]{D01}.

C30. Siege Castle History.name: C30。围城历史博物馆 C30. Siege Castle History
C30. Siege Castle History.text:
这个房间上锁了。英雄们可以用来自区域 @UUID[.OJNJc6Fo510Heygw]{C27} 的钥匙打开，或进行四次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{盗窃} 检定来解锁。或者，他们也可以以一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:22|traits:action:force-open]{运动} 检定来破拆。

书架贴着墙壁摆放，而一座看起来部分完成——又或许部分毁坏——的宏大城市雕塑，置于一张直径五码的圆桌之上。

遭遇

严重 3

@Actor[7UBCht1tQfeba2Ih]{木魔像}

120 XP

一尊被雕刻成贝科拉模样的木魔像仍在这房间里守卫。只要有任何进入房间的人不像贝科拉，它就会立刻缓慢地行动起来。它不会追击离开房间的敌人，但除此之外会战斗到被摧毁为止。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

雕塑

这座雕塑刻画的是艾巴萨罗姆，且在数个区域呈现出严重的毁损。通过一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社交} 检定来回忆知识，英雄可以确认这些毁损大致符合传说中这座城市在数个世纪里抵御围城时所遭受的破坏，直到约500年前为止（其中不包含较近代的攻击，例如赤红围城、饥饿的拉贾围城或黑色舰队起义）。

参考材料

这些书大多聚焦于艾巴萨罗姆围城战的历史；尽管其中许多内容彼此矛盾，但把整套藏书合起来对照参阅，反而更容易推断出可能的错误。任何翻阅这些书的人都会发现它们全都被大量批注；将这些批注综合起来可以得知，先前的一名研究者正利用这些书编纂过往围城的失败，并分析城市对各类外部威胁的应对方式，目的在于确保一次新的围城能够成功。本房间的书可以像区域 @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} 的书一样使用，用于援助针对艾巴萨罗姆围城历史的调查，在相关技能检定上提供+1 物品加值。

宝藏

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{贵重书籍（4）}

此处可找到大量可能会让莫里宾特感兴趣的书籍——总计4 负载。

This room is locked. The heroes can unlock it with the key from area @UUID[.OJNJc6Fo510Heygw]{C27} or with four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks. Alternatively, they can Force it Open with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:22|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check.

Shelves line the walls, while what appears to be a partially completed—or perhaps partially ruined—sculpture of a sprawling city sits atop a five-foot-diameter circular table.

Encounter

Severe 3

@Actor[7UBCht1tQfeba2Ih]{Wood Golem}

120 XP

A wood golem carved to resemble Belcorra still stands guard in this room. It lumbers to action as soon as anyone enters the room who doesn't also resemble Belcorra. It doesn't pursue enemies out of the room but otherwise fights until destroyed.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Sculpture

The sculpture is of Absalom, depicted with heavy damage in several areas. With a successful @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check to Recall Knowledge, a hero can confirm that the damage roughly matches what the city was said to have suffered over the centuries from all of the siege attempts it repelled, up until about 500 years ago (it doesn’t include more recent attacks, such as the Red Siege, the Siege of the Ravenous Raja, or the Black Echelon Uprising).

Reference Materials

Most of these books focus on the history of Absalom's sieges, and while many of them contain contradictory information, the collection as a whole makes cross-referencing it to determine likely errors easier. Anyone perusing these books finds heavy annotations in all of them; taken together, they reveal that a previous researcher was using the books to catalogue the failures of prior sieges and analyze the city's response to various exterior threats, all in the interest of ensuring the success of a new siege. Books in this room can be used just like the books in area @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} to aid in Investigation on the history of sieges of Absalom, providing a +1 item bonus to relevant skill checks.

Treasure

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (4)}

A wealth of books of potential interest to Morlibint can be found here- 4 Bulk in all.

C31. Unfinished Library.name: C31. 未完成的图书馆 C31. Unfinished Library
C31. Unfinished Library.text:
这个房间的墙壁只完成了一部分，上面留有凿子和镐所留下的明显痕迹。被丢弃的石工作业工具靠在未完工的墙边。

贝科拉计划修建一处扩建翼楼，用来安置她的图书馆里在其他地方开始堆积起来的更多典籍，但在她死前工程从未完工，而食尸鬼们也尚未鼓起继续施工的先攻来恢复这项工作。

宝藏

@Item[Y1SrIVfcFFwwf6A9]{+1 强击鹤嘴锄}

这里剩下的大多数采矿工具都很普通，但其中一件是+1 强击鹤嘴锄。

@Item[Y1SrIVfcFFwwf6A9]{+1 Striking Pick}

.

The walls of this room are only partially completed and bear the telltale marks of chisels and picks. Discarded stone-working tools lie against the unfinished walls.

Belcorra planned an expansion wing to house additional tomes that had started to pile up elsewhere in her library, but the project was never completed before her death, and the ghouls haven’t yet gathered the initiative to resume the work.

Treasure

@Item[Y1SrIVfcFFwwf6A9]{+1 Striking Pick}

Most of the mining tools remaining here are mundane, but one of them is a +1 Striking Pick.

C32. Furnace room.name: C32. 焚烧间 C32. Furnace room
C32. Furnace room.text:
这间房间里的空气感觉灼热难耐，尽管热源并不明显。无论是装着几把铁铲的木桶，还是带有舱口式盖子的金属箱，都不像是热源。

这间房间曾用于焚烧地城中积累的垃圾——更多时候，是贝科拉通过占据术得到、却认为无用或危险的书籍。起初，垃圾会被装入金属箱；一旦舱口关闭，强大的火焰魔法便会将内容物焚烧殆尽，随后灰烬会被铲出并倾倒进沼泽。

怨灵

低危 3

@Actor[hnYckrT72oIKAuHJ]{复仇焚烧炉}

60 XP

在贝科拉死后不久，两名学者间的一场争执就在这间房里收场——他们试图把彼此活活烧死。机器发生故障，将两人都烧成了灰烬。如今，他们灵魂的回响在此间徘徊作祟。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.1r6StS0irdvi5JHY]{Ventriloquist's Ring}

焚烧炉内有一层灰烬。在灰烬中搜索，会找到唯一从其主人的焚身中幸存的物品——一枚刻着奇异符文的腹语师之戒。

 

The air in this room feels blisteringly hot, although the source of the heat isn’t apparent. Neither the wooden barrel containing a few iron scoops nor the metal bin with a hatch-like lid seems to be the source.

This room was used to burn refuse that accumulated in the dungeon—more often than not, books Belcorra came into possession of that she found to be useless or dangerous. Originally, the refuse would be loaded into the metal bin; once the hatch was closed, powerful fire magic incinerated the contents, and the ashes were then scooped out and dumped in the swamp.

Haunt

Low 3

@Actor[hnYckrT72oIKAuHJ]{Vengeful Furnace}

60 XP

In the aftermath of Belcorra’s death, a squabble between two scholars concluded in this room when they attempted to burn each other alive. The machine malfunctioned and burned both scholars to ashes. Today, echoes of their souls haunt the room.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.1r6StS0irdvi5JHY]{Ventriloquist's Ring}

The furnace contains a layer of ashes. Searching through the ashes turns up the only item to survive its owner’s immolation—a ventriloquist's ring carved with strange glyphs.

C33. Restricted Collection.name: C33. 保密藏书 C33. Restricted Collection
C33. Restricted Collection.text:
一排排书架沿着这间房间的长度延伸，但有些地方已经受损或倾倒。曾经摆放在毁坏书架上的书似乎已被转移到其他书架上。有几扇门从此处通往外面，但北边那扇双开门最为醒目：它由石头制成，上面雕刻着一个怪异的女性形体，从一座坟墓被掏空的墓园里、缠绕着幽灵的薄雾中升起。

贝科拉最珍贵的典籍大多保存在这里，这处藏书仅对少数关键学者与极具影响力的访客开放。房间里的许多破坏都相当新近：当幽灵女王的摩洛克从东侧楼梯进入此处时，他们与溃烂教爆发了激烈冲突。双方都遭受了损失，但食尸鬼赢得了战斗，迫使幸存的摩洛克向西逃窜，最终设法回到楼上的仆役宿舍楼层。

东门外的楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.2GyngLCPk5da2fMK]{D16}。

遭遇

严重 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{溃烂教徒} @Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{食尸鬼（4）}

120 XP

一名溃烂教徒和四名食尸鬼正尽其所能修复书架——但由于古老木材腐朽不堪，这项工作不断遭遇挫折。他们不会立刻攻击，而是围绕北门采取防御阵位。随后溃烂教徒会与英雄交谈，向他们提供觐见她的大祭司纳卡扎林的机会。当然，这是一场骗局——她希望把英雄带到大祭司面前再背叛他们；若她试图对英雄进行 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} 失败（考虑到她仅有+3的欺瞒调整值，这很可能发生），她会变得恼怒并下令发起攻击。这些食尸鬼会一直战斗到被摧毁为止。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

门上的雕刻

一名英雄若成功通过一次 @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定以进行回忆知识，便会认出北门上的场景：外神宁布洛斯正在吞食那些崇拜她之人的灵魂。

书架

这里的书涵盖的主题与区域 @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} 中的相同，但更为实用且整理得更好。关于相关主题的回忆知识检定在此改为获得+2物品加值。

宝藏

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{贵重书籍（6）}

这里有6负载的书可供收集并交给莫里宾特。

Rows of bookshelves run the length of this room, although in places they've been damaged or tipped over. The books that once sat on the ruined shelves appear to have been relocated to other shelves. Several doors lead out from this room, but the double door to the north is the most impressive: it's made of stone, carved with a strange feminine shape rising from the ghost-laced mists of a cemetery of emptied graves.

The bulk of Belcorra's most valuable tomes were kept here, in a collection that was available to only key scholars and very influential visitors. Much of the damage done to this room is relatively recent, for when the Ghost Queen morlocks emerged into this room from the stairs to the east, they clashed violently with the Cult of the Canker. Both sides suffered losses, but the ghouls won the fight and forced the surviving morlocks to flee west, eventually finding their way to the Servants' Quarters level upstairs.

The stairs beyond the east door descend to area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.2GyngLCPk5da2fMK]{D16}.

Encounter

Severe 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{Canker Cultist} @Actor[LHHgGSs0ELCR4CYK]{Ghouls (4)}

120 XP

A single Canker cultist and four ghouls are repairing the shelves as best they can—a task that keeps suffering setbacks due to the decayed quality of the ancient wood. They don’t immediately attack, but instead adopt a defensive position around the north door. The Canker cultist then addresses the heroes, offering them the chance to have an audience with her high priestess, Nhakazarin. Of course, this is a ruse—she hopes to lead the heroes to her high priestess only to betray them, and if her attempt to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to the heroes fails (a likely outcome, given her mere +3 Deception modifier), she grows frustrated and orders an attack. These ghouls all fight until destroyed.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Door Carving

A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge recognizes the scene on the north door as the Outer God Nhimbaloth feeding on the spirits of those who worship her.

Bookshelves

The books here cover all the same subject matter as those in area @UUID[.l9NjtV6c0sjeD50H]{C11} but are much more useful and better organized. Checks to Recall Knowledge about the relevant topics here have a +2 item bonus instead.

Treasure

@Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books (6)}

There are 6 Bulk of books here to gather for Morlibint.

C34. Temple of the Canker.name: C34. 溃烂神殿 C34. Temple of the Canker
C34. Temple of the Canker.text:
柔和的光亮术照亮了这间巨大房间里的数个陈列柜。陈列柜曾用于展示书籍，如今却被砸碎，空空如也。沿着北侧弧形墙壁，矗立着一具骇人、高耸的女性身影。其形体由数百块来自不同生物、缝合在一起的肉块拼成，并披着破烂肮脏的床单。雕像散发出的腐臭充满了这间大房间。

贝科拉曾在此展示她最重要、最珍贵的典籍。一位名为卡利多·哈鲁维克斯的死墓骑士——贝科拉的远亲之一，也是她位于更下方的宝藏金库的忠诚守卫——奉贝科拉之命取走这些书，并将其带回金库。曾照亮陈列柜的魔法光亮仍旧存在，使这间房间光线充足。

溃烂教的高阶女祭司是一名名为纳卡扎林的食尸鬼——她生前便残忍而施虐。她的灵魂天生带有不死的侵染，曾作为贝科拉众多死灵顾问之一效力。她死后，正是她激励了本等级的其他仆从，为贝科拉的复活做准备。

纳卡扎林把她的时间花在处理从摩洛克、怪物、甚至其他食尸鬼身上收集来的肉块。她正将这些肉缝到她的杰作上：一座15英尺高、由腐肉与染污骨骼制成的贝科拉雕像。这座巨大的腐烂构造物是一具未完成的外壳，类似血肉魔像。溃烂教打算在其完工后，让它成为贝科拉的新身体。腐烂的雕像看起来不祥，但它并非活物……至少现在还不是。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[w2N0foudBFcRCaHK]{Nhakazarin}

80 XP

纳卡扎林要求英雄们放弃他们的道具与性命，并许诺他们若愿接受食尸鬼热、随后被关进作者大厅（区域 @UUID[.usuxpNbIZj0J1B5j]{C38}）直到转化完成，便能在溃烂中获得荣耀。若英雄拒绝，纳卡扎林傲慢大笑并发动攻击，用威吓进行先攻。

战斗时，她承诺英雄们终将加入她的教团——自愿或不自愿皆然。一旦战斗开始，纳卡扎林更倾向于在与她的雕像相邻的方格中战斗，以便在需要时使用她的啃食杰作能力。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

西侧的密门隐藏得尤其巧妙；在此区域进行搜索的英雄必须在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功才能找到它。没有任何食尸鬼知道它在这里，英雄也很可能一开始找不到。不过请注意，在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08} 找到的蓝图揭示了这道密门（以及上方三个等级的所有其他密门）的存在。

雕像

记录英雄离开时雕像所处的状态；根据他们在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.1UGSUnBhEjOeJhkM]{F25} 的动作，它之后可能会动起来并给他们造成麻烦。

Soft light illuminates several display cases in this vast room. Once used to display books, the cases stand smashed and empty. Along the curved north wall stands a hideous, towering figure of a woman. The form is composed of hundreds of portions of stitched-together flesh from a variety of different creatures and draped in tattered, filthy sheets. The stench of rot from the statue fills even this large room.

Belcorra once displayed her most important and valuable tomes here. A graveknight named Caliddo Haruvex, one of Belcorra’s distant relatives and a loyal guardian of her treasure vault far below, retrieved the books and returned to the vault with them on Belcorra’s orders. The magical light that once illuminated their display cases remains, rendering this room well-lit.

The high priestess of the Cult of the Canker is a ghoul named Nhakazarin, a woman who was cruel and sadistic even in life. Born with an infestation of undeath in her soul, she served as one of Belcorra’s many necromantic advisers. After her death, she was the one who galvanized the other servants of this level to prepare for Belcorra’s resurrection.

Nhakazarin spends her time working with bits of flesh harvested from morlocks, monsters, and even other ghouls. She's stitching this flesh to her masterpiece, a 15-foot-tall statue of Belcorra made from decaying meat and stained bone. The immense rotten construction is an incomplete shell akin to a flesh golem. The Cult of the Canker intends it to serve as a new body for Belcorra once it’s finished. The rotting statue looks ominous but is inanimate... for now.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[w2N0foudBFcRCaHK]{Nhakazarin}

80 XP

Nhakazarin demands the heroes abandon their gear and their lives, promising glory with the Canker if they agree to accept ghoul fever and then be locked away in the Author’s Hall (area @UUID[.usuxpNbIZj0J1B5j]{C38}) until they transform. If the heroes refuse, Nhakazarin laughs imperiously and attacks, using Intimidation for initiative.

As she fights, she promises the heroes that they’ll join her cult, willingly or not. Once combat begins, Nhakazarin prefers to fight in a square adjacent to her statue so she can use her Consume Masterpiece ability if needed.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

The secret door to the west is particularly well hidden; heroes Searching this area must succeed at a @Check[type:perception|dc:30|traits:action:search]{Perception} check to find it. None of the ghouls know it’s here, and it's unlikely that the heroes will find it at first. Note, however, that the existence of this secret door (as well as all other secret doors on the upper three levels) is revealed in the blueprints found in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}.

The Statue

Note the condition the heroes leave the statue in, as it might animate and cause them problems later, based on their actions in area @UUID[JournalEntry.KI33EAGPVHP4zyFZ.JournalEntryPage.1UGSUnBhEjOeJhkM]{F25}.

C35. Secure Collection.name: C35. 绝密藏书 C35. Secure Collection
C35. Secure Collection.text:
这间小房间的墙壁上有内置的书架。北侧与南侧的书架上摆满了书籍，而西侧书架上则放着一叠散乱的纸张与卷轴。房间中央摆着一把椅子和一张小写字桌。

宝藏

@Actor[SVU5QArj8vuvPicl]{绝密藏书}

贝科拉将自己最珍贵、最重要的书籍保存在东侧的大房间里，但她把所有与自己在凄凉灯塔和憎恨魔窟上的研究有关的东西都存放在这里。由于食尸鬼不知道这间房间的存在，这些资料自她死亡以来一直留在此处。

贝科拉的日志

北侧书架上最大的一本书是一册大型日志，内容主要聚焦于贝科拉对艾巴萨罗姆的憎恨。它以阿克洛语写成；一位英雄花费8小时阅读后，将得知她的家族史：从被放逐而陷入贫困，到她最终返回该区域建造巢穴，企图向那座令她家族蒙羞并陷入贫困的城市复仇。日志最后几页记录了她建造憎恨魔窟的大量工作。尽管日志未提供太多具体细节，但提到了塑肉仪式实验室的建造、她为取乐而让敌人与怪物冠军相互厮杀的竞技场、牢房、拷问室、通往幽暗地域的连结，以及一座宏伟神殿——“空无之死本人曾在此拂过这脆弱的世界”。贝科拉的记录常以抽象方式谈论她的爪牙，仿佛在夸耀有多少人前来为她效力、共同打造这座复合设施，但她只提到过一位的名字：她那位“虚荣得可笑”的学徒，沃鲁克·阿兹里尼。最后几条记录之一描述这位学徒如何从“下方一个暴发而多管闲事的卓尔社群”前来投奔贝科拉。这些笔记并未提供关于该卓尔社群的更多信息。

凄凉灯塔蓝图

那叠散乱的纸张与卷轴包含大量关于@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}的信息。这些纸张以阿克洛语写成；整理并阅读它们需要8小时，之后读者可以如同已对该遗珍完成全面研究一般，了解凄凉灯塔的功能。

传送网络

北侧书架上数本关于传送的书之间夹着一册包含若干深奥图示的对开本。这册对开本详述了贝科拉一系列相互连结的@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles}，用于在憎恨魔窟中快速移动；并指出若因时代流逝或意外导致其力量耗尽，便必须使用@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal}仪式来启动它们。唤醒传送门仪式收录在这些页面之中。

《呓语芦苇》

房间里最大的一本书位于南侧书架上，是一本名为《呓语芦苇》的稀有典籍。这本魔法书描述了77次据称与外神宁布洛斯的遭遇，以及每一次遭遇如何留下肉体或精神上的创伤。本书有大量贝科拉手写批注，尤其集中在宁布洛斯作为“吞食幽灵者”的主题如何融入寓言与故事之处。

The walls of this small room have built-in shelves. Books line the shelves to the north and south, while a stack of loose scrolls sits on the shelf to the west. A single chair and a small writing desk sit in the middle of the room.

Treasure

@Actor[SVU5QArj8vuvPicl]{Secure Collection}

Belcorra kept her most valuable and significant books in the large chamber to the east, but she stored everything involving her work on Gauntlight and the Abomination Vaults here. These resources have remained here since her demise, since the ghouls don't know this room exists.

Belcorra's Journal

The largest book on the northern shelf is a large journal that focuses largely on Belcorra’s hatred of Absalom. It’s written in Aklo, and a hero who spends 8 hours reading it learns of her family history from their exile to poverty and her eventual return to the region to build a lair from which she hoped to exact revenge on the city that disgraced and impoverished her family. The last several pages of the journal document much of her work in building the Abomination Vaults. While the journal doesn’t offer many specific details, it mentions construction of fleshwarping laboratories, arenas where she pitted enemies against monstrous champions for her amusement, prisons, torture chambers, links to the Darklands, and a great temple where “once the Empty Death herself brushed against this fragile world.” Belcorra’s entries often speak of her minions in the abstract, as if bragging about how many have come to serve her in creating the complex, but she only ever mentions one by name: her “amusingly vain” apprentice, Volluk Azrinae. One of the last entries describes how this apprentice arrived from “a community of upstart and meddlesome drow below” to serve Belcorra. The notes don’t provide any further information about this drow community.

Gauntlight Blueprints

The stack of loose papers and scrolls contain a wealth of information about @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}. These papers are written in Aklo; sorting and then reading them takes 8 hours, after which the reader can learn about Gauntlight's functions as if they'd fully researched the artifact.

Teleportation Network

A folio containing several esoteric diagrams is sandwiched between several books on teleportation on the north shelf. The folio details Belcorra's series of linked @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circles} to quickly move around the Abomination Vaults, and it notes the importance of using the @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.AkF4yFcSCdhoULyZ]{Awaken Portal} ritual to activate them should time or mischance deplete them of power. The awaken portal ritual is included within the pages.

The Whispering Reeds

The largest book in the room, on the southern shelf, is a rare text called The Whispering Reeds. This magical book describes 77 supposed encounters with the Outer Goddess Nhimbaloth and how each encounter left physical or mental scars. The book is heavily annotated in Belcorra’s hand, particularly in areas where themes of Nhimbaloth as an “eater of ghosts” play into the parables and tales.

C36. Scriptorium.name: C36. 抄写间 C36. Scriptorium
C36. Scriptorium.text:
这间房间沿墙摆满了桌子，桌子被分隔成数个狭窄的隔间，旧木椅被推进桌边。桌上散落着成堆的旧纸张与破损的书籍，周围是干涸的墨水瓶和脆裂的羽毛笔。南边地上瘫着一具骷髅，身上穿着闪亮的链甲衫，骨手里紧紧攥着什么东西。

这间房间曾是抄写间，贝科拉的抄写员在此誊写与复制重要书籍。

一名英雄若在搜索东侧墙壁并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，会发现一个空隔间；该隔间可折叠起来以获得许可进入一扇通往区域 @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37} 的暗门。

南边的骸骨遗骸曾属于一名名叫尚德里·尹萨的卓尔女性，她是抄写间的主管。尚德里对贝科拉的学徒沃鲁克怀有几乎掩饰不住的爱慕；在贝科拉死后的几天里，尚德里试图说服他与自己一起逃走，离开憎恨魔窟，到远方某处开始新生活。沃鲁克拒绝了尚德里，坚持说：“贝科拉如今在死后比在生前更需要我；你也该同样想想！”尚德里带着绝望灵光回到这里，却被对她的霸凌心怀怨恨、急于摆脱她掌控的抄写员们谋杀；她临死时伸手抓住了沃鲁克的肖像。

遭遇

极难 3

@Actor[3H1rBpUQwTcNd6xZ]{尚德里·尹萨}

120 XP

如同许多在憎恨魔窟不幸死去的人一样，尚德里以幽灵（特征）之身再度起身。她如今终日漂浮在工作区之间，仿佛在抄写员身后巡查评估他们的工作，全然没有意识到自贝科拉死前那一小时以来已过去了任何时间。当英雄们进入房间时，幽灵将他们误认为新来的抄写员，先斥责他们迟到，随后命令他们开始誊写这里堆放的旧书。任何试图做出除服从尚德里的命令术之外的举动（包括仅仅离开房间）都会激起她的怒火并促使她发动攻击。

若英雄们各自坐在一个隔间里开始工作——哪怕只是装模作样地工作——只要他们不停下，尚德里便会感到满意。她也会对她的“抄写员”提出的简短问题与讨论作出回应；在合理范围内，她会回答英雄们的任何问题，只要这些问题不会让她意识到贝科拉已死或她自己是幽灵（特征）。每过10分钟，她会飘过暗门前往区域 @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37}；一名守夜并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:12]{察觉} 检定中成功的英雄会注意到，她的动作暗示这里有一扇隐藏的门（尽管她只是穿墙而过）。她从这些前往区域 @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37} 的短途行程中返回需要1d4轮。英雄们可以在这段时间内安全地逃脱房间；若他们之后返回，尚德里完全不记得他们。

若英雄们攻击尚德里，或迫使她面对自己是幽灵（特征）或贝科拉已死的真相，她会在绝望灵光中哭喊，随后发动攻击。

宝藏

@Actor[OTk9VX3iqpLGx8s0]{抄写间书籍} @Actor[6dYeLCCdOogucfQs]{尚德里的遗骸}

书籍

这里有1负载的书籍可供收集并交给莫里宾特。除这些书外，区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.LyGMJmON0ZPU7CmT]{B03} 的便笺中提到的三本（《如虫所晓》、《墓地之宴》与《颅骨之秘》）也在此处。莫里宾特对这三本有关死灵术的阴森论著毫无兴趣，但可以将它们各以8 gp 卖给莫里宾特以外的人（例如伊娜斯梅拉也许能设法找到买家）。

尚德里的遗骸

搜索尚德里的遗骸会发现，她的+1 链甲衫保存完好。她紧攥的物体是一幅装框的沃鲁克·阿兹里尼肖像。肖像既捕捉到了这名卓尔的俊美，也捕捉到了他那傲慢、自恋的得意坏笑——这两种特质正是尚德里所迷恋的。他的名字刻在肖像底座上一块小小的金牌上。这件艺术品经受住了时代流逝，价值10 gp，但对英雄们而言，它或许更能立刻派上用场：可用作在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08} 对抗沃鲁克的手段。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

除了显眼的护甲与肖像外，一名英雄在搜索尚德里的遗骸时若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，会发现其下方藏着一把 @Item[NJGaB7nHvuaHeec3]{微型铁钥匙}；这把钥匙可以打开 @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{Area C37} 中的柜子。

This room is lined with tables divided up into several narrow carrels with old wooden chairs pushed in against them. Upon them, old stacks of paper and tattered books sit amid dry inkwells and brittle writing quills. To the south, a skeleton dressed in shiny-looking chain shirt lies slumped on the floor, clutching something in its bony hands.

This room once served as a scriptorium where Belcorra’s scribes worked to transcribe and copy important books.

A hero who Searches the eastern wall and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds an empty carrel, which folds up to access a secret door leading to area @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37}.

The skeletal remains to the south were once a drow woman named Chandriu Invisar, director of the scriptorium. Chandriu harbored a poorly hidden adoration for Belcorra’s apprentice, Volluk, and in the days after Belcorra’s death, Chandriu tried to convince him to flee with her to start a new life together somewhere far from the Abomination Vaults. Volluk spurned Chandriu, insisting that “Belcorra needs me now in death even more than in life; you should consider the same!” Chandriu returned here in despair, only to be murdered by her disgruntled scribes eager to get out from under her bullying, and she grasped for Volluk’s portrait as she died.

Encounter

Severe 3

@Actor[3H1rBpUQwTcNd6xZ]{Chandriu Invisar}

120 XP

As with so many others who had the misfortune to perish in the Abomination Vaults, Chandriu arose as a ghost. She now spends her days floating among the work spaces, as if looking over the shoulders of scribes to appraise their work, not realizing that any time has passed at all since the hour preceding Belcorra's death. When the heroes enter the room, the ghost mistakes them for new scribes and chastises them for their tardiness before ordering them to begin transcribing the old books stacked here. Any attempt to do anything other than comply with Chandriu's commands (including simply leaving the room) arouses her anger and prompts her to attack.

If the heroes each sit at a carrel and begin to work- or even pantomime working- Chandriu is satisfied unless they stop. She entertains brief questions and discussion from her "scribes" though, and will answer any questions the heroes have, within reason, and that don't make her realize that Belcorra is dead or that she's a ghost. Every 10 minutes, she drifts through the secret door to area @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37}, and a hero who watches and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:12]{Perception} check notes that her actions suggest a hidden door (even though she simply passes through the wall). She returns from these short trips to area @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{C37} in 1d4 rounds. The heroes can safely escape the room during this window; if they later return, Chandriu doesn't remember them at all.

If the heroes attack Chandriu, or force her to confront the truth that she's a ghost or that Belcorra is dead, she cries out in despair, then attacks.

Treasure

@Actor[OTk9VX3iqpLGx8s0]{Scriptorium Books} @Actor[6dYeLCCdOogucfQs]{Chandriu's Remains}

Books

There are 1 Bulk of books here to gather for Morlibint. In addition to these books, the three mentioned in the note in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.LyGMJmON0ZPU7CmT]{B03} (What The Worm Knows, Grave Feasts, and Secrets of the Skull) are located here as well. Morlibint has no interest in these three grim treatises on necromancy, but they can be sold for 8 gp each to someone other than Morlibint (Yinyasmera, for example, might be able to procure a buyer).

Chandriu's Remains

A search of Chandriu's remains reveals that her +1 chain shirt is in good condition. The object she clutches is a framed portrait of Volluk Azrinae. The portrait captures the drow's beauty as well as his imperious, vain smirk, both qualities Chandriu adored. His name appears on a tiny gold plaque at the portrait's base. The work of art has endured the passage of time quite well and is worth 10 gp, but it might be more immediately valuable to the heroes as a way to fight against Volluk in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

In addition to the obvious armor and portrait, a hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:15|traits:action:search]{Perception} check while Searching Chandriu's remains spots a @Item[NJGaB7nHvuaHeec3]{Tiny Iron Key} concealed beneath them; this key unlocks the cabinet in @UUID[.E0TcXGYuA92wAB2y]{Area C37}.

C37. Secret Scriptorium.name: C37. 秘密抄写间 C37. Secret Scriptorium
C37. Secret Scriptorium.text:
一张堆满空白卷轴和纸张的工作桌靠着这间房间的东墙摆放。北边立着一只带有数个紧闭抽屉的柜子。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

柜子里有五个上锁的抽屉；每个抽屉都可以由一位英雄使用来自区域 @UUID[.KDcIKiVRxWGTfQhK]{C36} 的钥匙打开，或通过进行三次 @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} 检定以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}打开，或通过一次成功的 @Check[type:athletics|dc:16|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} 检定以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}打开。

贵重书籍

里面存放着几本书——由抄写员制作的文本副本，原本打算出售或作为赠礼送给贝科拉在他国的盟友，而那些盟友如今都已死去。其中包括给莫里宾特的 2 负载 @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books}。

炼狱契约

桌上的卷轴并非全是空白；其中一份夹在其他卷轴下方的是一份 @Item[A0akrLX7mp6OHty1]{Infernal Contract}。这份契约本应被存放在憎恨魔窟更深处，但它始终没能真正送到那里。能够阅读炼狱语的角色若花费 10 分钟审阅该契约，就会得知这是魔鬼科罗克的契约，将他束缚为一名守卫者。若阅读者成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{察觉} 或 @Check[type:society|dc:18]{Society} 检定，或受训于法律学识，则会注意到一个漏洞：只要将其告知魔鬼，就能释放他（区域 @UUID[.sVpphDD0gtGtIlFh]{C08}）。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A worktable covered with blank scrolls and papers sits against the eastern wall of this room. A cabinet with several closed drawers stands to the north.

Exploration

@UUID[.KDcIKiVRxWGTfQhK]{C36} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock}

There are five locked drawers in the cabinet; each can be opened by a hero using the key from area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}, succeeding at three @Check[type:thievery|dc:20|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} checks to @UUID[.sVpphDD0gtGtIlFh]{C08}, or with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:16|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

Valuable Books

Several books are stored within—copies of texts produced by scribes and once intended for sale or as gifts to Belcorra’s allies in other lands, all of whom are now dead. These include 2 Bulk of @Item[SSMdEvSAlggOWV0v]{Valuable Books} for Morlibint.

Infernal Contract

Not all of the scrolls on the desk are blank; one tucked beneath the others is an @Item[A0akrLX7mp6OHty1]{Infernal Contract}. This contract was meant to be stored deeper in the Abomination Vaults, but it never quite made it there. A character who can read Infernal and takes 10 minutes to look over the contract learns that this is the devil Korlok’s contract that binds him as a guardian. A reader who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18]{Perception} or @Check[type:society|dc:18]{Society} check, or who’s trained in Legal Lore, notes a loophole that can release the devil if it’s brought to his attention (area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}).

C38. Authors’ Hall.name: C38. 作者大厅 C38. Authors’ Hall
C38. Authors’ Hall.text:
这间房的四周（北侧除外）都排列着长长的书架，前面还拉着几把椅子。书架与地面上结着腐臭的陈旧血迹与衰败污渍。

贝科拉的书记曾在此誊写新作。溃烂教如今将这里用作存放食尸鬼热受害者的地方，直到他们死亡并起身成为食尸鬼。这里现在没有存放尸体，但英雄们可以找到大量曾在此发生痛苦与死亡的证据。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{溃烂教徒（2）}

80 XP

一对食尸鬼溃烂教徒正在激烈争论，被紫色真菌“催熟”的肉是否比自然腐烂的肉更美味。他们分心得很，甚至听不到区域 @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33} 的战斗声响，但会攻击任何他们注意到的入侵者。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

英雄若对南侧墙壁进行搜查，并在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，则会发现一段可向下翻折的书架，翻下后可获得通往区域 @UUID[.grfsjSzZmO95qpo7]{C39} 的秘密门的许可。

Long shelves with several chairs drawn up to them ring this room on all sides, save the north. Rancid stains of old blood and decay cake the shelves and floor.

Belcorra’s scribes once used this room to pen new works. The Cult of the Canker now use it as a place to store victims of ghoul fever until they die and arise as ghouls. There are no bodies stored here now, but the heroes can find ample evidence of the suffering and death that has occurred here.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[lMCEVxKkQ7XK6Nid]{Canker Cultists (2)}

80 XP

A pair of ghoul cultists are having a spirited debate on whether or not flesh “ripened” by violet fungi tastes better than naturally decayed meat. They’re distracted enough that they don’t overhear the sounds of combat in area @UUID[.tTVIrzNZtjKG1XVb]{C33}, but they attack any intruders they notice.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who Searches the south wall and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds a section of shelving that folds down to allow access to a secret door leading to area @UUID[.grfsjSzZmO95qpo7]{C39}.

C39. Guard Room.name: C39. 守卫室 C39. Guard Room
C39. Guard Room.text:
一个小壁龛坐落在这间空房间的东墙上，其地面装饰着一圈镶嵌符文构成的银色圆环。

这房间曾关押着一名被束缚的魔鬼，她曾作为贝科拉的守卫之一服役，但这名生物的契约早在很久以前就已到期，使她得以返回地狱。

A small alcove, its floor decorated with a silvery circle of inlaid runes, sits in the eastern wall of this empty room.

This room once housed a bound devil who served as one of Belcorra’s guardians, but this creature’s contract expired long ago, releasing her back to Hell.

C40. Pool.name: C40. 池 C40. Pool
C40. Pool.text:
水滴落与水花拍打的声音充满了这座巨大的洞窟大厅。空气冰冷而潮湿，东边有一座相当大的池塘。一股慵懒的溢流水流沿着向北倾斜的隧道涓涓流下，而在水池中央上方的天花板上，一个直径五英尺的洞口大张着。

这里的水池深5英尺，曾经是这些等级的饮用水来源；天花板上方15英尺处的洞口再向上25英尺通往区域@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.vKXFtG7SrIcibaif]{B23}的水井，而向北下倾的隧道通往区域@UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}。

遭遇

中等 3

@Actor[dEAneTvoPuQXZoLR]{呓语之喉}

80 XP

一只呓语之喉已在这座洞窟中栖居了数十年。它会周期性地沿着隧道爬到区域@UUID[.Xi06PfArAS2ZFqot]{C02}去猎捕蝙蝠和老鼠。它会立刻攻击入侵者，并尽其所能追击敌人。这只怪物不会区分英雄与其他住民，因此精明的小队或许能把呓语之喉引诱去与食尸鬼、摩洛克或其他生物战斗。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

英雄在搜索池塘时，会在水井洞口下方发现190 cp和64 sp。这些供品是迷信的仆人们在久远的年代前扔进这里的。

The dripping, sloshing sound of water fills this large cavern chamber. The air is cold and damp, and to the east sits a sizable pond. A lazy rivulet of overflow trickles to the north down a sloping tunnel, while a five-foot-diameter opening gapes in the ceiling above the center of the pool.

The pool here is 5 feet deep and was once used as a source of drinking water for these levels; the hole in the ceiling 15 feet above leads up 25 more feet to the well in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.vKXFtG7SrIcibaif]{B23}, while the downward sloping tunnel to the north leads to area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.PuMBjgCkm2ImMyCh]{D14}.

Encounter

Moderate 3

@Actor[dEAneTvoPuQXZoLR]{Gibbering Mouther}

80 XP

A gibbering mouther has dwelt in this cavern for decades. It periodically crawls along the tunnel to area @UUID[.Xi06PfArAS2ZFqot]{C02} to hunt bats and rats. It immediately attacks intruders and pursues foes as best it can. The monster doesn’t differentiate between the heroes and other denizens, so a canny group might lure the gibbering mouther into a fight against ghouls, morlocks, or other creatures.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Heroes Searching the pond discover 190 cp and 64 sp under the well opening. These offerings were tossed here by superstitious servants ages ago.

Chapter 3: Cult of the Canker.name: 第3章：溃烂教 Chapter 3: Cult of the Canker
Chapter 3: Cult of the Canker.text:
章节梗概

憎恨魔窟的第3等级曾经是贝科拉庞大的图书馆，包含与研究相关的房间。如今，它已从一座死灵学知识的储藏所转变为一个食尸鬼邪教的要塞，因为曾在此受雇的仆役与图书管理员已经变成了危险的不死生物。英雄们不仅能够消灭这个卑劣的邪教，还能揭露关于贝科拉兴趣与计划的重要信息。

图书馆

环境线索：

凌乱成堆的书本、灰尘、耸立的书架、霉臭的霉菌、损毁的工具与家具、翻页声、仿佛有什么东西在隐蔽角落腐烂的恶臭、闷热的空气。

贝科拉的图书馆未被照明，除非另有说明。走廊的天花板高8英尺，房间的天花板高10英尺，不过最大的房间与走廊有拱形天花板，高度升至12英尺。门由木材制成，许多门上标有标识（见区域C11的描述），以帮助学者找到路径。

Chapter Synopsis

The third level of the Abomination Vaults once served as Belcorra's sprawling library and contained rooms related to research. Today, it has been transformed from a store of necromantic knowledge into a stronghold for a cult of ghouls, as the servants and librarians once employed here have become dangerous undead creatures. The heroes can not only eliminate this vile cult but also uncover significant information about Belcorra's interests and plans.

The Library

Environmental Cues:

Books in untidy stacks, dust, looming shelves, musty mold, ruined tools and furniture, sounds of flipping pages, stink as of something rotting in a hidden corner, stuffy air.

Belcorra’s library is unlit except where otherwise noted. Ceilings are 8 feet high in halls and 10 feet high in rooms, although the largest rooms and halls have vaulted ceilings that rise to 12 feet high. Doors are made of wood, and many are marked with signs (described in area C11) to help scholars find their way.

Ghoulish Librarians.name: 食尸鬼图书管理员 Ghoulish Librarians
Ghoulish Librarians.text:
溃烂教是在图书馆中活动最广泛的派系。起初，这个团体由图书管理员、看护与抄写员组成；在贝科拉死后，这群忠诚的工作人员仍固执地继续工作，将研究重点放在寻找让他们的领袖复活的方法上。粮食储备日渐见底时，研究者们不愿冒险因可能公开地前往地表而惊动玫瑰团，便转而食人。毕竟在近在咫尺的仆役宿舍里，还有大量其他仆人可供食用。食尸鬼热的潜伏期迅速席卷了他们的队伍，但这些研究者沉迷其中，几乎没有察觉。如今，这些学者的研究带上了明显的食尸鬼色彩：他们致力于收集足够的“溃烂血肉”，以为贝科拉的完全复活提供燃料。食尸鬼的饥渴常常迫使他们吞食自己正试图收集的血肉，这无疑拖慢了进度，但丝毫没有削减他们的狂热。

The Cult of the Canker is the most widespread faction active in the library. Originally a collection of librarians, caretakers, and scribes, this loyal staff stubbornly kept working after Belcorra died, focusing their research on finding a way to restore their leader to life. When food stores ran low, rather than risk alerting the Roseguard by making potentially public forays to the surface, the researchers turned to cannibalism. There were plenty of other servants to eat, after all, in the conveniently nearby servants’ quarters. The onset of ghoul fever tore quickly through their ranks, but the researchers were so obsessed that they barely noticed. The scholars’ research now has a distinctly ghoulish bent: they work to gather enough “cankerous flesh” to fuel Belcorra’s full resurrection. The fact that the ghouls’ hunger often compels them to feed on the flesh they’re trying to collect has certainly slowed their progress, but it hasn’t slowed their zeal.

04. Long Dream the Dead.name: 04. 死者永眠 04. Long Dream the Dead

D01. Belcorra’s Dining Room.name: D01. 贝科拉的餐厅 D01. Belcorra’s Dining Room
D01. Belcorra’s Dining Room.text:
一对明亮发光的枝形吊灯照亮了一张长长的宴会桌，周围摆着豪华的高背椅。桌上仍然摆设得仿佛正准备一顿盛宴，但部分餐具摆设被打散、掀翻，几把椅子也东倒西歪。房间里散落着四具衣着褴褛的骷髅（特征），其中有些正掐着自己的脖子。

许多年前，当玫瑰团袭击凄凉灯塔要塞时，贝科拉正在此处与一群如今已灭绝的阿布萨罗姆盗贼公会代表共进晚餐；她正试图拉拢他们，作为对抗这座城市的潜在盟友。当消息传来——玫瑰团正轻而易举地突破要塞的防御——贝科拉不敢冒任何风险。她礼貌地告退，请客人继续用餐，并以魔法命令她的厨师在饭菜中下毒毒死所有客人、再谋杀其他仆役，最后自尽。

北门外的楼梯通往上方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.ct0oaB12kXiKf42Y]{C29}。

遭遇

中等 4

@Actor[HBRz8BVLVN9u9Odp]{尸火 (4)}

80 XP

客人们在极度痛苦中死去，随后他们的尸体成了寻觅宿主的尸火的栖身之所。当除沃卢克以外的活体生物进入此房间时，骷髅（特征）中的尸火开始发光，然后骷髅（特征）踉跄起身并发动攻击。每当一只尸火被迫进入鬼火形态时，它就会逃往相邻的某个房间（区域 @UUID[.5bfMemKThz7OVUOz]{D02}、@UUID[.pnwZz9VrIshgPSMZ]{D03}或@UUID[.Ez1TchVZQSMOMh9A]{D06}），占据另一具尸体作为宿主，再返回战斗。

宝藏

@Actor[e2P51BCKzDposq6L]{客人的遗骸}

搜查客人的遗骸可发现48 gp、一个冲刺手镯和一支蝰蛇箭。

A pair of brightly glowing chandeliers illuminates a long banquet table surrounded by luxurious, high-backed chairs. The table is still set as if for a grand meal, but some of the place settings are scattered and toppled, as are a few of the chairs. Four skeletons in tattered finery are scattered about the room, some of them clutching their own necks.

When the Roseguard assaulted Gauntlight Keep so many years ago, Belcorra was dining here with representatives of a now-extinct Absalomian thieves’ guild whom she was courting as potential allies against the city. When word came that the Roseguard was handily overcoming the keep’s defenses, Belcorra took no chances. She politely excused herself, bade her guests finish their meal, and magically commanded her chef to poison them all and murder the other servants before taking his own life.

Stairs beyond the north door lead up to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.ct0oaB12kXiKf42Y]{C29}.

Encounter

Moderate 4

@Actor[HBRz8BVLVN9u9Odp]{Corpselights (4)}

80 XP

The guests died in excruciating pain, then later became havens for corpselights seeking hosts. When a living creature other than Volluk enters this room, the corpselights within the skeletons begin to glow, and then the skeletons stagger to their feet and attack. Each time a corpselight is forced into wisp form, it flees to one of the adjoining rooms (areas @UUID[.5bfMemKThz7OVUOz]{D02}, @UUID[.pnwZz9VrIshgPSMZ]{D03}, or @UUID[.Ez1TchVZQSMOMh9A]{D06}) to claim another corpse host and return to the fight.

Treasure

@Actor[e2P51BCKzDposq6L]{Guests' Remains}

A search of the guests' remains reveals 48 gp, a bracelet of dashing, and a viper arrow.

D02. Kitchen.name: D02. 厨房 D02. Kitchen
D02. Kitchen.text:
房间西南角摆着一台奇怪、矮胖的铸铁炉灶，没有烟囱；而北边靠墙处有一张大橡木桌，上面摆满烹饪用具。西墙一排橱柜的底部蜷着一具骸骨。

炉灶能以魔法将从炉火中涌出的烟雾转化为洁净空气，但它被嵌在这间房的石头结构里，沉重得不值得费劲从地城里搬走。那具尸体曾是贝科拉的厨子，他在奉行贝科拉的魔法命令术、毒害宾客并杀死其他仆从后自尽身亡。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

一名英雄若对这房间进行搜查并在一次@Check[type:perception|dc:19|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定中成功，便会斑点到北边的一扇暗门。一些烹饪用具被固定在墙上；以正确顺序拨弄它们即可打开暗门。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A strange, squat cast-iron stove with no chimney sits in the southwest corner of this room, while to the north, a large oak table covered with cooking utensils sits against a wall. A skeletal body slumps at the base of the cupboards along the western wall.

The stove magically transmutes smoke welling up from its fire into clean air, but it’s built into the stone of this room and far too heavy to be worth the trouble of hauling away from the dungeon. The body was once Belcorra’s cook, who died by suicide after carrying out Belcorra’s magical commands to poison the guests and kill the other servants.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A hero who Searches this room and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:19|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spots a secret door to the north. Some cooking utensils are affixed to the wall; manipulating them in the correct order opens the secret door.

D03. Storage.name: D03. 储藏室 D03. Storage
D03. Storage.text:
这间房间的墙壁边排列着橱柜、架子和柜子。房间中央放着几个木桶。两具骷髅（特征）瘫倒在木桶旁。

这些骷髅（特征）是另外两名仆人，他们在被厨师谋杀前退到了这间储藏室。这里已没有任何值钱的东西。

The walls of this chamber are lined with cupboards, shelves, and cabinets. A few barrels sit in the middle of the room. Two skeletons lie slumped near the barrel.

The skeletons were two other servants who retreated to this storage room before being murdered by the chef. Nothing of value remains.

D04. Wine Cellar.name: D04. 酒窖 D04. Wine Cellar
D04. Wine Cellar.text:
一座高大的酒架靠着北墙而立，其上的酒瓶历经多年已蒙上厚厚的灰尘。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

几乎这里所有的酒都已经变质，但一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:18]{社交} 检定足以注意到三瓶 @Item[y7I4CGQOEDY08rTW]{贵重酒瓶}，每瓶价值 20 gp。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A tall wine rack, its bottles thick with dust after so many years, stands against the north wall.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}
