The mitflits keep a nasty-smelling chunk of giant maggot meat handy for a snack, but if forced to flee, one tosses the maggot steak onto the shore of the @UUID[.zhzpU6YS5G6wukpn]{Slurk Pond}, hoping to cover their retreating by luring the slurk living there onto shore to attack the heroes.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Ceiling

The Mudlicker mitflits have rigged a slipshod network of soggy ropes and planks in the space above the cobwebs to clamber around on; a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:12|traits:action:search]{Perception} check can spot this feature through the webbing, and a critical success also reveals a 3-foot-diameter hole in the roof in the northwest corner, which the gremlins use to come and go.

Strange Lumps

A successful @Check[type:nature|dc:15|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} identifies the deposits of gray material as mitflit dung. Apparently the mitflits use this room as a latrine as well as an advance guard station.

Treasure

Searching the room reveals a @Item[6vEnTu29Qy0jJABa]{Peridot Bead} (one of the mitflits thought it was candy) worth 2 gp, along with a chipped mitflit tooth in one of the little dung piles.

A02. Decrepit Drawbridge.name: A02. 破败吊桥 A02. Decrepit Drawbridge
A02. Decrepit Drawbridge.text:
一座木制吊桥横跨附属建筑与岛上蔓延的废墟之间二十英尺的缺口，桥梁的木料因年代久远与衰败而呈灰色。锈蚀的铁链从废墟北墙垂下，连接到吊桥南侧。这些铁链看起来随时会断裂，使吊桥的结构完整性更添一层可疑。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

正如外观所示，这座吊桥过桥并不安全，尤其是螨精以巧妙的掏空手法进一步削弱了其支撑结构。英雄们可以通过一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:5|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定发现这次破坏。

小型或更小的生物可以安全过桥，但中型生物必须一次只通过一名，否则吊桥会在一阵呻吟般的轰然崩塌中坍塌，把桥上的所有人都倾倒进4英尺深的水中。吊桥坍塌时靠近两端的生物可以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge}（@Check[type:reflex|dc:10]{Reflex} 豁免）以避免坠落入水。

世界状态

@Macro[IG9T1NXWfBf7YfcX]{A02 - Drawbridge Collapse}

如果英雄们使桥梁坍塌，点击上方宏以切换图块的状态——并在它在他们脚下碎裂时播放音效！

一旦桥梁坍塌，角色可以尝试一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:10|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} 检定，以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} 回到任一侧的区域 @UUID[.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01} 或区域 @UUID[.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{A04}。当然，一旦桥梁坍塌，区域 @UUID[.zhzpU6YS5G6wukpn]{A03} 中的泥蛙会迅速前来调查。

A wooden drawbridge, its timbers gray with age and decay, spans the twenty-foot gap between the outbuilding and sprawling ruin on the island. Rusty iron chains hang from the ruin’s northern wall to the drawbridge’s southern side. The chains look ready to fall apart, giving the drawbridge’s structural integrity an extra layer of dubiousness.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

True to appearances, the drawbridge isn’t safe to cross, especially now that the mitflits have further weakened the structure with some clever undercutting to its supports. The heroes can spot the sabotage with a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:5|traits:action:search]{Perception} check.

A Small or smaller creature can cross the bridge safely, but Medium creatures must cross one at a time or the bridge collapses with a groaning crash, which dumps everyone on the bridge into the 4-foot-deep water. A creature near the ends of the drawbridge when it collapses can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} (@Check[type:reflex|dc:10]{Reflex} save) to avoid falling in.

World State

@Macro[IG9T1NXWfBf7YfcX]{A02 - Drawbridge Collapse}

If the heroes collapse the bridge, click on the above macro to toggle the state of the tile- and play a sound effect as it splinters beneath them!

Once the bridge has collapsed, a character can attempt an @Check[type:athletics|dc:10|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} up to area @UUID[.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01} or area @UUID[.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{A04} on either side. Of course, once the bridge collapses, the slurk in area @UUID[.zhzpU6YS5G6wukpn]{A03} quickly comes to investigate.

A03. Slurk Pond.name: A03. 泥蛙池塘 A03. Slurk Pond
A03. Slurk Pond.text:
一丛丛芦苇在这座泥泞池塘的边缘茂密生长。水面因藻类而显得浑浊；一具身高三尺、覆有鳞片的人形生物的半腐烂尸体躺在水池北岸，半埋在淤泥与落叶之中。

这座池塘的水深只有4尺，但其下方还堆着额外数尺深的淤泥，使其涉水通过时属于高等困难地形。

遭遇

低威胁 1

@Actor[eHLDsL1LG3jQ1H6Y]{泥蛙}

60 XP

一只泥蛙——近期栖居在废墟中的石鳞狗头人的前任守卫者、也是唯一幸存的残存者——仍生活在这座池塘里。螨精们喜欢玩“躲喷射”：它们嘲弄泥蛙，诱使其朝它们吐出黏液，而它们则飞奔穿过藤蔓。白天时，泥蛙更喜欢在池塘中央睡觉，把鼻口露在水面上；到了夜里，它会翻扑上岸去狩猎。巨响（例如吊桥坍塌）、突然出现的免费食物气味（例如扔出的蛆虫牛排），或任何人在池边拍打溅水，都会把泥蛙从睡梦中惊醒。一旦醒来，这只怪物会急切地攻击附近的任何生物，但它不会离开能看见自己池塘的范围。该生物会战斗至死。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

藤蔓与攀缘植物点缀着废墟，但任何在此区域进行调查行动的英雄，若成功通过一次 @Check[type:nature|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{自然}检定来 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}，就会发现一条异常修长、显得格格不入的藤蔓。这条藤蔓从区域 @UUID[.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01} 的屋顶一直延伸到东北方 @UUID[.YWWlJBVLGkdNcjxf]{Walkway} 的北端。螨精把这条藤蔓架了起来，好让它们想避开地面时能走上面；它无法支撑体型大于小型的任何生物。

宝藏

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.3V2U720YhW2nyGVx]{Spike Snare}

一具死去的狗头人尸体 леж在池塘北岸。泥蛙因对最近被屠戮的部族仍存余忠而避免吞食这具尸体，而泥蛙的存在也让螨精不敢去洗劫它——不过它们仍在远处贪婪地盯着。狗头人尸体上的道具大多已经毁坏，只有一个腐烂腰包里还剩4 gp，以及一个牢牢捆在小背包里的尖刺圈套。

Tangles of reeds grow in thick clusters around the edge of this muddy pond. The water appears murky with algae, and the half-decayed body of a three-foot-tall scaly humanoid lies on the pool’s northern bank, half-buried in mud and leaves.

The water of this pond is only 4 feet deep, but an extra few feet of mud below make it greater difficult terrain to wade through.

Encounter

Low 1

@Actor[eHLDsL1LG3jQ1H6Y]{Slurk}

60 XP

A single slurk, the former guardian and only surviving remnant of the Stonescale kobolds who recently dwelt in the ruins, still lives in this pond. The mitflits enjoy playing “dodge the squirt”: they taunt the slurk into spitting slime at them while they dash across the vine. The slurk prefers to sleep in the center of the pond with its snout above the water during the day, then flops out at night to hunt. Loud noises (such as a collapsing drawbridge), the scent of sudden free food (such as a tossed maggot steak), or anyone splashing around on the pool’s edge will rouse the slurk from its slumber. Once woken, the monster eagerly attacks any creatures nearby, but it doesn’t leave sight of its pond. The creature fights to the death.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Vines and creepers festoon the ruins, but any hero Investigating this area who succeeds at a @Check[type:nature|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} identifies an unusually long vine that seems out of place. This vine stretches from the roof of area @UUID[.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01} to the north end of the @UUID[.YWWlJBVLGkdNcjxf]{Walkway} to the northeast. The mitflits strung up this vine so they could avoid the ground if they wanted to; it won’t support any creature larger than Small in size.

Treasure

@Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.3V2U720YhW2nyGVx]{Spike Snare}

The corpse of a dead kobold lies on the pond’s north bank. The slurk avoided eating the carcass out of lingering loyalty to the recently slaughtered tribe, and the slurk’s presence kept the mitflits from looting it—but not from eyeing it covetously from afar. The gear on the kobold’s body is mostly ruined with the exception of 4 gp in one rotten belt pouch and a spike snare bundled securely in a little backpack.

A04. Maggot Training Hall.name: A04. 蛆虫训练大厅 A04. Maggot Training Hall
A04. Maggot Training Hall.text:
成堆腐烂的木材与松散的石块在这间大型、L形大厅各处堆成小山。每一堆瓦砾上方的木质天花板都有缝隙，成团的苔藓与纠结的藤蔓从中垂落。数扇门通向四面八方，大多数都几乎只靠合页与门框勉强挂着。碎石完全堵死了一处木质楼梯井，那楼梯原本通往天花板上的一个大洞。石墙上零星可见火焰灼烧或远古战斗造成的伤痕与破损。

本房间的大多数门都很容易取得许可，但有几处例外。通往@UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Gauntlight Base}的门需要一次成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics}检定才能@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}，而通往@UUID[.IdPksxjraU1gfumW]{Scorpion Kennel}的门则几乎被瓦砾掩埋。角色可以尝试爬过瓦砾堆，从屋顶的破洞进入，再下到另一侧房间；成功进行一次@Check[type:athletics|dc:10|traits:action:climb]{Athletics}检定即可。

当螨精曾住在下方地城时，数量曾达数十；但在被摩洛克暴力驱逐、在“躲开喷射”游戏中不断损耗、以及错误地对害虫产生同理心之后，这个团体已经大为缩减。最初，所有舔泥佬都住在这间大房间里；如今这里只剩下三只螨精。

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{螨精（3）} @Actor[y9D2wh63pBzIyI7i]{舔泥佬蛆虫}

80 XP

三只螨精正在训练它们的第一条蛆虫，希望这只苍白的生物在成熟为巨型苍蝇后仍能保有训练成果。没有任何小魔怪知道一条蛆虫要多久才能长得又大又壮，但一发现英雄，它们立刻命令自己的“宠物”上前攻击。毕竟，巨型苍蝇战马得先养成吃人的口味，长大后才会又凶又恶。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

许多年前，玫瑰团在这间宽阔的房间里与贝科拉对峙。战斗从这里蔓延至区域@UUID[.g363pURldvDgwmoc]{08}的仆役休息室，并导致堡垒的一部分坍塌。一名正在进行调查行动的英雄若成功通过一次DC 15的回忆知识检定（使用任何与魔法相关联的技能），就能确认：数百年前的部分破坏是由强大且具毁灭性的法术造成的。

密室

一扇暗门通往西北方向一处小型隐藏壁龛；一名正在搜索本房间的英雄若成功进行一次@Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，就会发现石墙的一段可以滑开以取得许可进入。暗门后的壁龛内，石面上有数道沟槽，像是被人执意刮削所致。

这间密室过去曾包含一座通往区域@Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circle}的@UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05-A}，但在数百年前就被寻宝者发现并将魔法符文中的所有银料凿除。如此严重的破坏使魔法流失，并永久摧毁了该传送法阵。一名英雄若成功通过一次@Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana}或@Check[type:occultism|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism}检定来回忆知识，就会意识到此房间的原始用途以及所造成的永久性破坏。本房间也预示了在憎恨魔窟中还有许多其他传送法阵，英雄将能够将其重新激活并加以使用。

Piles of rotting timbers and loose stones lie in heaps throughout this large, L-shaped hall. Clumps of moss and tangled vines spill down from gaps in the wooden ceiling above each pile of rubble. Several doors lead out to all sides, most barely clinging to their hinges and frames. Debris completely blocks a wooden stairwell that leads up to a large hole in the ceiling. Here and there, the stone walls bear the scars of fire or damage from an ancient battle.

Most of the doors in this room are easy enough to access, with a couple exceptions. The door to the @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Gauntlight Base} requires a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}, and rubble has mostly buried the door to the @UUID[.IdPksxjraU1gfumW]{Scorpion Kennel}. Characters can try to clamber over the pile of rubble, through a hole in the roof, and down into the room beyond with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:10|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check.

When the mitflits dwelled in the dungeons below, they numbered in the dozens, but their violent eviction by the morlocks, attrition from games of “dodge the squirt,” and misjudged vermin empathy have diminished the group. Originally, all the Mudlickers lived in this large room; now, only three mitflits remain here.

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{Mitflits (3)} @Actor[y9D2wh63pBzIyI7i]{Mudlicker Maggot}

80 XP

Three mitflits are currently engaged in training their first maggot, hoping the pallid creature retains its training after it matures into a giant fly. None of the gremlins know how long it takes for a maggot to grow up big and strong, but upon sighting the heroes, they immediately order their “pet” forward to attack. After all, giant-fly war steeds need to develop a taste for people to grow up nice and mean.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Many years ago, the Roseguard confronted Belcorra in this vast room. The fight spilled from here into the servants’ lounge in area @UUID[.g363pURldvDgwmoc]{08}, and caused some of the keep’s collapse. A hero Investigating this room who succeeds at a DC 15 check to Recall Knowledge using any skill associated with magic confirms that powerful, destructive spells caused some of the damage centuries ago.

Secret Chamber

A secret door opens into a small hidden alcove to the northwest; a hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds a section of the stone wall that slides aside to access it. The alcove beyond the door has several grooves in the stone, caused by what looks like determined scraping.

This chamber used to contain a @Compendium[pf2e.spells-srd.5ZW1w9f4gWlSIuWA]{Teleportation Circle} to area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.VZPc5GsIN5eRKSVE]{C05-A}, but fortune hunters found this hidden alcove centuries ago and gouged out all the silver in the magic runes. The extensive damage drained away the magic and permanently destroyed the teleportation circle. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} or @Check[type:occultism|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Occultism} check to Recall Knowledge realizes the original purpose of this room and the permanent damage done. This room foreshadows the many other teleportation circles in the Abomination Vaults that the heroes will be able to reactivate and use.

A05. Maggot Stable.name: A05. 蛆虫马厩 A05. Maggot Stable
A05. Maggot Stable.text:
这间房间东北角有一座坍塌的木制楼梯，盘旋向上通往一个被苔藓遮蔽的洞口。西侧一段石墙完全坍塌，从那里能看到雾隐沼泽的广阔景象。一只死青蛙躺在这处坍塌处，体型如马般巨大，后腿在髋部被咬断。

这只巨蛙曾被弗雷兹内尔凯什攻击——她是一只栖居在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} 的河流龙兽。龙兽啃掉青蛙的腿后，决定对这青蛙恶臭的剧毒皮肤毫无兴趣。这具尸体躺在西侧墙边的瓦砾中。

遭遇

低 1

@Actor[y9D2wh63pBzIyI7i]{舔泥佬的蛆（2）}

60 XP

河流龙兽并不觉得青蛙的味道可口，但在区域 @UUID[.yyUsiyd1QIMwin1X]{A06} 的巨蝇把巨型蛆虫产进这具尸体里后，它们可没那么挑剔。若有任何生物接近到距离蛙尸 10 尺以内，两只巨型蛆虫会突然从尸体中爆出并发动攻击。它们会无情追逐新鲜食物，战至死方休。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

若一名英雄调查蛙尸，并在一次 @Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{奥秘} 或 @Check[type:nature|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{自然} 检定中成功以进行回忆知识，则能判断有某种龙类生物吃掉了青蛙的腿。若为大成功或大失败中的大成功，该英雄会认出咬痕周围的腐蚀性黏液属于河流龙兽。

A collapsed wooden staircase in the northeastern corner of this room winds up to a moss-shrouded hole. The expanse of the Fogfen is visible through a total collapse in a stone wall to the west. A dead frog the size of a horse lies sprawled in this collapse, its back legs bitten off at the hips.

This massive frog was attacked by Freznelkesh, the river drake who lairs in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19}. The drake decided she had no interest in the frog's foul toxic skin after gnawing off its legs. The carcass lies in the rubble on the western wall.

Encounter

Low 1

@Actor[y9D2wh63pBzIyI7i]{Mudlicker Maggots (2)}

60 XP

While the river drake didn’t find the frog’s flavor appetizing, the giant maggots deposited in the carcass by the giant fly in area @UUID[.yyUsiyd1QIMwin1X]{A06} aren't so discerning. If any creature approaches within 10 feet of the frog’s body, two giant maggots burst suddenly from the carcass to attack. They pursue fresh food relentlessly and fight to the death.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

A hero who Investigates the frog carcass and succeeds at a @Check[type:arcana|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Arcana} or @Check[type:nature|dc:18|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Nature} check to Recall Knowledge can tell that a draconic creature ate the frog's legs. On a critical success, the hero recognizes the caustic mucus around the bite as belonging to a river drake.

A06. Fly Pen.name: A06. 飞行围栏 A06. Fly Pen
A06. Fly Pen.text:
这座瞭望哨的内部仍保留着高高在上的木质天花板，但地面上堆着一大堆污秽与动物尸体，让这房间一点也不令人想靠近。

在斯夸老大命令下，螨精们捕获了他们统治奥塔里计划的基石——一只壮丽的绿蓝色苍蝇，体型如小马般大小，小魔怪们称它为“嗡嗡嗡”。他们把它关在这里，以为这只苍蝇无法从这房间逃脱；螨精们不知道活板门的存在，但他们的苍蝇囚犯立刻就发现了它。“嗡嗡嗡”随时都能离开，但这个区域里的食物让它满足于待在这里。

事实上，这个房间方便得有点过头了，因为另一只棕蓝色的巨蝇有时也会进来。这两只巨蝇彼此相处融洽，因为它们都有充足的食物。然而，螨精们从未同时在房间里见过两只，所以斯夸老大和他的追随者相信这里只有一只巨蝇。（他们不明白为什么“嗡嗡嗡”似乎会时不时变色。）

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[3DSqfobadad3pA6O]{巨蝇（2）}

80 XP

英雄们进入这房间时，首先遭遇的是那只绿蓝色的巨蝇。它会猛扑向英雄们，以为他们是更多的食物。一轮之后，那只棕蓝色的巨蝇会通过活板门飞镖般冲入房间，并加入攻击。任何同时看到两只苍蝇的螨精都会明显困惑，但当他们看见巨蝇们拼死搏斗时，这份惊讶会转为恐惧。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

这房间的天花板高 15 尺，并有一道活板门通向一处在庄园坍塌中幸存的小型女儿墙。成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定的英雄可以发现这道不易看见的活板门。由于梯子已经不见，角色必须成功通过一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb]{运动} 检定，才能攀爬到活板门处。

The interior of this watch post still has a wooden ceiling high above, but a thick mound of filth and animal carcasses heaped on the floor make the room anything but inviting.

Under Boss Skrawng’s orders, the mitflits captured the cornerstone of their plan to rule Otari—a magnificent, green-and-blue fly the size of a pony that the gremlins call Buzzybuzz. They keep it here believing that the fly can’t escape this room; the mitflits don’t know about the trapdoor, but their fly prisoner found it right away. Buzzybuzz can leave whenever it wants, but the food in this area keeps it satisfied here.

In fact, this room is slightly too convenient, as a second giant fly with brown and blue coloration sometimes comes in, too. The two giant flies get along with one another since they both have plenty of food. However, the mitflits have never seen both in the room at the same time, so Boss Skrawng and his followers believe there’s only one giant fly. (They don’t understand why Buzzybuzz seems to change color from time to time.)

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[3DSqfobadad3pA6O]{Giant Flies (2)}

80 XP

The heroes first encounter the green-and-blue giant fly when they enter this room. It lunges at the heroes, assuming they’re more food. One round later, the brown-and-blue giant fly darts into the room through the trapdoor and joins in the attack. Any mitflits who see both flies at the same time become visibly confused, but their surprise turns to horror when they see the giant flies fight to the death.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

This room’s ceiling is 15 feet high and has a trapdoor leading onto a small parapet that survived the manor’s collapse. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check can spot the trapdoor, which can’t easily be seen. With the ladder gone, a character must succeed at a @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check to Climb to the trapdoor.

A07. Dining Room.name: A07. 餐厅 A07. Dining Room
A07. Dining Room.text:
这间房屋中央坍塌的天花板在木制屋顶上留下了一个参差不齐的破洞。腐烂的挂毯垂在箭孔与破毁的边桌之间的墙上，布面图案已被霉菌完全遮蔽，只剩破烂的碎片。原本精致的餐桌残骸大多被坠落的天花板砸得粉碎。

游祟

中等 1

@Actor[8VXEF3cnjzcokCTL]{石鳞之魂}

80 XP

并非所有困扰凄凉灯塔的游祟都直接回响着贝科拉的遗产。这间房曾是石鳞狗头人使用的公共大厅，直到一场暴力政变将这群体撕裂。狗头人的灵魂至今仍徘徊于此。

当它们第一次现身时，使用 @Macro[tFWg6zQ2ZvSkRUcY]{A07 - Stonescale Spirits} 宏来同步揭示指示物与光亮术来源。

这可能是英雄们在《憎恨魔窟》冒险路径中面对的第一个游祟，因此你应尽力描述从瓦砾中升起的幽灵（特征）狗头人：它们不是以传统方式战斗的怪物，而是一种必须以其他方式应对的幽冥现象。你可以尝试引导英雄去使用最可能平息游祟的技能：用威吓吓退狗头人幽灵（特征），或用宗教让这些灵体重新得到休息。这是个让玩家进入“游祟往往更像需要解开的谜题而非必须击败的敌人”的思路的好机会，并让英雄们习惯去理解游祟为何会在此。理解游祟如何形成，是发现如何让它得到休息的最佳方式。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

安抚灵体

通过一次成功的 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，在此房间进行搜索的英雄会在瓦砾中发现许多细小的骨头。进行30分钟的工作可以挖出6具狗头人骷髅（特征）。摧毁这些骨头或将其全部从这间房移走，会永久解除该游祟。受训于宗教的英雄，或在一次成功的 @Check[type:religion|dc:15]{宗教} 检定后，会意识到这些骨头与游祟之间的联系，并明白必须摧毁这些骨头或将其全部从瓦砾堆中移走，才能确保这些幽冥狗头人再也不会复起。

@Actor[K5x037uBxKtreY4v]{狗头人骸骨}

如果英雄们发现了狗头人骸骨，他们也会找到几件杂乱的宝藏：3 gp、20 sp、一个装有铁蒺藜圈套组件的盒子、一枚狼牙，以及一瓶黑蝰毒，其上笨拙地写着“YUM”。

The collapsed ceiling at the middle of this room has left a ragged hole in the wooden roof. Rotten tapestries, their designs completely obscured by mold, hang in tatters on the walls between arrow slits and ruined side tables. The remains of a fancy dining table lie mostly pulverized by the fallen ceiling.

Haunt

Moderate 1

@Actor[8VXEF3cnjzcokCTL]{Stonescale Spirits}

80 XP

Not all the haunts plaguing Gauntlight are direct echoes of Belcorra’s legacy. This room served as the communal hall for the Stonescale kobolds before a violent coup tore the group apart. The kobold spirits linger here to this day.

When they rise for the first time, use the @Macro[tFWg6zQ2ZvSkRUcY]{A07 - Stonescale Spirits} macro to synchronise revealing the token and the light source at once.

This might be the first haunt the heroes face in the Abomination Vaults Adventure Path, so you should do your best to describe the ghostly kobolds that rise from the rubble not as monsters to be fought in a traditional manner, but as a spectral phenomenon that must be dealt with another way. You might try to lead the heroes into trying the skills most likely to quell the haunt: Intimidation to scare away the kobold ghosts or Religion to put the spirits back to rest. This is a good opportunity to get the players in the mindset that haunts are often more like a puzzle to be solved than a foe to be vanquished, and getting the heroes into the mindset of understanding why a haunt is here in the first place. Understanding how a haunt came to be is the best way to discover how to put it to rest.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Calming the Spirits

With a successful @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check, heroes Searching this room find many tiny bones scattered in the rubble. Thirty minutes of work can uncover six kobold skeletons. Destroying the bones or removing them all from this room permanently disables the haunt. A hero who’s trained in Religion or who succeeds at a @Check[type:religion|dc:15]{Religion} check realizes the connection between the bones and the haunt and understands that destroying the bones or removing them all from the rubble pile is necessary to ensure the spectral kobolds won’t ever rise again.

@Actor[K5x037uBxKtreY4v]{Kobold Bones}

If the heroes discover the kobold bones, they also find several jumbled treasures: 3 gp, 20 sp, a box with components for a caltrop snare, a wolf fang, and a vial of black adder venom with the word "YUM" clumsily written on it.

A08. Sinkhole.name: A08. 陷坑 A08. Sinkhole
A08. Sinkhole.text:
探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

在每位英雄进入这个房间之前，为其掷骰一次秘密的 @Check[type:perception|dc:10]{察觉}检定，以听见房间内传出的尖锐吱叫与尖啸声。任何在进入前特意倾听的英雄会自动听见这些声音。正在这个房间里胡闹的四只螨精就是噪音的来源。

这个房间几乎整个天花板都已坍塌；而在下方，地面碎裂成一个十英尺深的天坑，里面满是碎石、泥浆，以及闪亮的真菌斑块。古老的伤害痕迹——烧灼的疤痕与酸蚀的焦痕——点缀着墙壁与大量瓦砾。

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{螨精（4）}

80 XP

四只泥舔者螨精在天坑中的瓦砾间攀爬并快速穿梭。它们本该收集蘑菇与蛆虫，但此刻正扭打争抢谁能先吃一只特别明亮的蓝色蛆虫。由于分心，除非英雄在攻击前费心宣布自己的存在，否则螨精在为先攻而进行的察觉检定上承受 –2 减值。螨精会从下方向英雄投掷飞镖，但若某只螨精的飞镖用尽或受到任何伤害，它就会将注意力转为攀爬出坑，然后逃跑去警告 @UUID[.le4tidRkFqodABe4]{Mudlicker Throne Room}中的斯夸老大。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

调查

玫瑰团与贝科拉之间的古老战斗在此处以毁灭性的方式终结：贝科拉使用了孤注一掷的爆炸，试图击败这些冒险者。随之而来的坍塌吞没了队伍的游荡者奥塔里·伊瓦什提，并将他困在下方的地城中。此番孤注一掷失败后，贝科拉经由 @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Area A11}逃往灯塔。正如 @UUID[.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{Area A04}，一名在此房间进行调查行动并成功通过 DC 15 的回忆知识检定（使用任何与魔法相关联的技能）的英雄，会确认很久以前这里发生过一场毁灭性的魔法战斗。

搜查

角色必须尝试一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:12|traits:action:climb]{运动}检定以攀爬，从而在天坑陡峭的斜坡上行动。进行搜查的英雄若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定，会发现一段被埋的螺旋楼梯向下延伸。

世界状态

@Macro[GOmXbb8enFk5eicd]{A08 - 楼梯}

清理瓦砾可能需要许多天，但若英雄坚持不懈，他们就会打开通往下方 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08}区域的道路。

你可以使用上面的宏来切换地砖的可见性，以反映这一变化！也别忘了同时在 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08}区域中隐藏相应的地砖。

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout}

Roll a secret @Check[type:perception|dc:10]{Perception} check for each hero before they enter this room to hear the sound of high-pitched squeals and shrieks from within. Any hero who specifically listens before entering hears these sounds automatically. The four mitflits goofing off in this room are the source of the noise.

Almost the entire ceiling of this room has collapsed ,while below, the floor has crumbled into a ten-foot-deep sinkhole filled with rubble, mud, and glistening patches of fungus. Evidence of ancient damage—burn scars and acid scorch marks—decorate the walls and much of the rubble.

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{Mitflits (4)}

80 XP

Four Mudlicker mitflits clamber and scurry around amid the rubble in the sinkhole. They’re supposed to be gathering mushrooms and grubs but are currently wrestling over who gets to snack on a particularly bright blue grub. The mitflits take a –2 penalty to Perception checks rolled for initiative as a result of their distraction unless the heroes take pains to announce themselves before attacking. The mitflits hurl darts at the heroes from below, but a mitflit who runs out of darts or takes any damage focuses on Climbing out of the pit and then running away to warn Boss Skrawng in the @UUID[.le4tidRkFqodABe4]{Mudlicker Throne Room}.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Investigate

The ancient battle between the Roseguard and Belcorra came to its destructive end in this room when Belcorra used a last-ditch explosion to try to defeat the adventurers. The resulting collapse swallowed the group's rogue, Otari Ilvashti, and trapped him in the dungeon below. Belcorra fled to the lighthouse through @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Area A11} after this failed gambit. As in @UUID[.koVFvK0xxQMwKjaW]{Area A04}, a hero Investigating this room who succeeds at a DC 15 check to Recall Knowledge using any skill associated with magic confirms that a devastating magical battle occurred here long ago.

Search

A character must attempt a @Check[type:athletics|dc:12|traits:action:climb]{Athletics} check to Climb to navigate the sinkhole's steep slopes. A hero who Searches the rubble and succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check spies a buried spiral staircase leading downward.

World State

@Macro[GOmXbb8enFk5eicd]{A08 - Stairs}

Clearing the rubble away can take many days, but if the heroes persist, they open the way down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08} below.

You can use the above macro to toggle the visibility of the tile to reflect this change! Don't forget to hide the corresponding tile in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B08} as well.

A09. Walkway.name: A09. 步道 A09. Walkway
A09. Walkway.text:
一条十五尺长的石质步道跨过一段狭窄的沼泽水面，将破败的要塞与一座大型石质附属建筑连接起来。双开门封住步道两端。东南侧门前站着一具七尺高的骷髅（特征），它穿着由虬结的根须、骨头与锈蚀金属制成的护甲。骷髅（特征）用一只风化的手紧握着一把钉头锤，武器沉重、带刺的锤头搁在步道上，正位于骷髅（特征）脚边。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

搜索

这名骷髅（特征）“守卫”不过是一座由舔泥佬制作的雕像。它看起来吓人，但不构成威胁；任何检查雕像的人若在一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:12|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定中成功，便会注意到用来支撑它的木制支架与粗糙的捆扎。对骷髅（特征）造成的任何伤害都会让它哗啦一声散架，响亮地惊动 @UUID[.le4tidRkFqodABe4]{Mudlicker Throne Room} 内的住客。

宝藏

螨精找到了这把钉头锤，并对它把骷髅（特征）撑得稳稳当当感到很满意。他们不知道它其实是 @Item[c5oQP02ulBQ7nIVs]{+1 钉头锤}。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

A fifteen-foot stone walkway spans a narrow stretch of swamp water, connecting the ruined keep to a large stone outbuilding. Double doors block each end of the walkway. Standing before the southeast door is a seven-foot-tall skeleton dressed in armor made of gnarled roots, bones, and rusted metal. The skeleton clenches a morningstar in one weathered hand with the weapon’s heavy, spiked tip resting on the walkway at the skeleton’s feet.

Exploration

@UUID[.le4tidRkFqodABe4]{Mudlicker Throne Room}

Search

The skeletal “guard” is nothing more than a statue built by the Mudlickers. It looks frightening but poses no danger; anyone examining the statue who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:12|traits:action:search]{Perception} notices the wooden struts and crude lashings that keep it together. Any damage dealt to the skeleton causes it to clatter apart loudly, alerting the occupants of the @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

Treasure

The mitflits found the morningstar and are delighted with how well it keeps the skeleton propped up. They don’t know it's a @Item[c5oQP02ulBQ7nIVs]{+1 Morningstar}.

A10. Mudlicker Throne Room.name: A10. 泥舔者王座厅 A10. Mudlicker Throne Room
A10. Mudlicker Throne Room.text:
天花板和地板上断裂的框架暗示这座石质建筑内部曾被薄木墙分隔。那些墙被拆除后，如今只剩下一间单独的大房间。瓦砾、沼泽植被与泥巴成堆堆叠，像肮脏的巢穴；而更大一堆由瓦砾、树枝与骨头构成的堆砌物看上去几乎——但还不完全——像一座王座。王座前的地面上覆盖着一座被压平的沙丘，上面插着几十块木片与石块。

螨精为他们的指挥官——斯夸老大——选中了这座旧兵营作为王座厅。斯夸老大的脆弱王座需要持续维护；两名螨精在不睡在这里那些肮脏巢穴里的时候，就会负责这项工作。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

任何观察王座前沙丘的英雄都可以尝试一次 @Check[type:society|dc:10]{社会}检定，以意识到那代表着一幅粗糙的奥塔里地图。在大成功时，英雄会注意到几支箭头，标示出从雾隐沼泽方向发起攻击的计划。

斯夸老大总是在这里，在责骂听得见范围内的其他舔泥佬、和他的宠物巨型避日蛛“咬咬”玩耍、在王座上睡觉、或在他的沙堆上筹划对奥塔里的攻击之间分配时间。如果斯夸老大知道英雄就在附近，他会端坐在王座上保持警戒，让咬咬守在身旁，准备应对他们。

斯夸老大知道，来自奥塔里的英雄挑战他的地盘只是时间问题，但他似乎惊讶于这事竟在他还没真正对城镇做些什么之前就发生了。与其他螨精不同，斯夸老大会说通用语；他傲慢地要求英雄解释：为何在他攻击奥塔里之前就来打扰他。若他意识到英雄并不是来对付他的，他会可怜地改口，坚称自己没有攻击计划，而且无害又友善。他会用三叉戟把脚边的奥塔里地图扫散，以强调这一转变。精明的英雄若能对斯夸老大用 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie}掩饰他们来此的原因，就能与他周旋，或许能探出一些关于凄凉灯塔要塞的情报；但用不了多久，斯夸老大那可怜的英勇与更强的急躁就会驱使他开始对奥塔里的“进攻”——转而攻击英雄。

遭遇

严重 1

@Actor[xAfkUwJYq5JLmSrW]{斯夸老大} @Actor[C7LvY2Xxzm2xRL1M]{咬咬} @Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{螨精（2）}

120 XP

若战斗爆发，斯夸老大会命令爪牙投入近战，而他自己会留在后方，从王座的掩蔽后用吹箭攻击。在斯夸老大每个回合结束时，王座都会危险地摇晃颤动。除非有英雄对其造成伤害，否则它不会坍塌（王座 AC 10，硬度 2，且 3 HP）。如果王座坍塌，斯夸老大会变得惊慌失措。他立刻倒地，并且在接下来 3 个回合中，每个回合都必须至少花费 1 个动作，用地底通用语结结巴巴地咒骂。若斯夸老大被降至 5 或更少生命值，他会放弃并乞求饶命；但只要他还活着，他的追随者就会战至死，以示对斯夸老大的忠诚。

斯夸老大知道的事：

如果英雄能让斯夸老大开口，他能提供有用信息。

危险

他知道 A1 到 A10 区域内的所有危险、@UUID[.IdPksxjraU1gfumW]{Area A14}里的巨蝎，以及生活在 @UUID[.D4ufIAvRT4oTGO07]{Ruined Boathouse}下方的“沼泽龙”。他也知道要塞里的“鬼怪”，并警告英雄注意 @UUID[.ER1vxyKvCoRrV2KZ]{Dining Room}中的恶灵，以及 @UUID[.yk1knQyHc25ZSAfE]{Nhimbaloth's Shrine}里那些发光的“幽灵（特征）”。

神秘陌生人

他从未去过西北方岛上的外屋，但提到一周前有一条满载人群的船（他形容为“又大又鬼祟的样子”）前去拜访。访客趁沼泽龙外出时进入了沼泽龙的洞穴，但不久后沼泽龙就回来了；斯夸老大认为那些人被吃掉了。

关于凄凉灯塔

若被问及凄凉灯塔那诡异的发光，斯夸老大会瞪大双眼，摇着头警告英雄：那道光是所有闹鬼现象里最瘆人的。他确认每晚那道光都会发光，并担心上面可能有个大幽灵（特征）。

下层

斯夸老大确认，舔泥佬过去住在凄凉灯塔要塞下方的某个地城等级里，但许多夜晚之前，一群“蘑菇眼的人”（摩洛克，尽管螨精并不知道他们的名字）把他们赶到了这里。

方向

如果英雄能成功向他提出请求或以胁迫让他帮忙，并提供让他能写地图的工具，斯夸老大就能提供第一层的一张粗略地图，以及第二层的一张不完整地图。至少 2 gp 的贿赂会自动让斯夸老大愿意帮忙提供这些地图。他的第一层地图会遗漏 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yGP5XjaIq9ix9ac7]{A12} 到 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}、@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.hX0cKXoIDJT0AIRB]{A19} 到 @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{A23}、@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}，以及所有暗门。他的第二层地图显然更不完整；只标出舔泥佬曾居住过的区域：@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B8} 到 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14}，以及 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.eAD9hbPpzj5aLBZY]{B16} 到 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19}（不过他会警告英雄，一条巨大的沼泽龙住在 B19 区域的洞穴里）。

支线任务：

斯夸老大憎恨那些“蘑菇眼的人”，并向英雄承诺：如果他们下楼把对方全杀光并击败他们的国王，他就会给英雄一大堆闪亮的宝石。他形容那国王是“会魔法的祭司蘑菇眼家伙，只要看你一眼就能伤你的脑子”。斯夸老大其实并没有任何闪亮宝石；若英雄完成任务并带着证据回来，他会意识到英雄比摩洛克更难对付，而且他承诺了自己根本没有的宝藏，犯下了可怕的错误。于是他转而恳求他们饶命，并同意永远放弃针对奥塔里的阴谋。

Splintered framing in the ceiling and floor hint that thin wooden walls once divided this stone building’s interior. With those walls demolished, only a single, large chamber remains. Rubble, swamp vegetation, and mud pile in heaps like foul nests, while a larger stack of rubble, sticks, and bones looks almost, but not quite, like a throne. A flattened mound of sand with a few dozen bits of wood and stone stuck into it covers the floor before the throne.

The mitflits chose these old barracks for their commander, Boss Skrawng, to use as a throne hall. Boss Skrawng's fragile throne requires constant upkeep, a task two mitflits perform when they aren’t sleeping in the filthy nests here.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Any hero looking at the sand mound in front of the throne can attempt a @Check[type:society|dc:10]{Society} check to realize it represents a crude map of Otari. On a critical success, the hero notes several arrows that indicate plans of attack from the direction of Fogfen.

Boss Skrawng is always here, splitting his time between berating other Mudlickers within earshot, playing with his pet giant solifugid Bite Bite, sleeping on his throne, or planning attacks on Otari in his sand pile. If Boss Skrawng knows about the heroes in the vicinity, he sits on his throne at attention with Bite Bite at his side, ready to address them.

Boss Skrawng knew that it was just a matter of time before heroes from Otari challenged him in his domain, but he seems surprised that it happened before he actually did anything to the town. Unlike the other mitflits, Boss Skrawng speaks Common, and he imperiously demands to know why the heroes have come to bother him before he attacked Otari. If he realizes the heroes didn’t come to confront him, he pathetically backpedals, insisting that he has no plans to attack and that he’s harmless and friendly. He punctuates this reversal by using his trident to scatter the map of Otari at his feet. Canny heroes who can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to Boss Skrawng about their reasons for being here can talk to him and perhaps find out some of what he knows about Gauntlight Keep, but it doesn’t take long before Boss Skrawng’s negligible bravery and greater impatience prompt him to begin his assault on Otari by attacking the heroes.

Encounter

Severe 1

@Actor[xAfkUwJYq5JLmSrW]{Boss Skrawng} @Actor[C7LvY2Xxzm2xRL1M]{Bite Bite} @Actor[E0LCMHVp4sxAbQYa]{Mitflits (2)}

120 XP

If combat breaks out, Boss Skrawng orders his minions into melee, but he hangs back to use his blowgun from behind the cover of his throne. At the end of each of Boss Skrawng’s turns, the throne shakes and shudders dangerously. It doesn’t collapse unless a hero damages it (the throne has AC 10, Hardness 2, and 3 HP). If the throne collapses, Boss Skrawng becomes flustered. He immediately falls prone and must spend at least 1 action during each of his next 3 turns sputtering and cursing in Undercommon. Boss Skrawng gives up and begs for mercy if he’s reduced to 5 or fewer Hit Points, but his followers fight to the death to demonstrate their devotion to Boss Skrawng while he lives.

What Boss Skrawng Knows:

If the heroes can get Boss Skrawng to talk, he has useful information.

Dangers

He knows about all the dangers in areas A1 to A10, the giant scorpion in @UUID[.IdPksxjraU1gfumW]{Area A14}, and the “swamp dragon” that lives under the @UUID[.D4ufIAvRT4oTGO07]{Ruined Boathouse}. He also knows about the “bogeys” in the keep, warning the heroes about the haunts in the @UUID[.ER1vxyKvCoRrV2KZ]{Dining Room} and the glowing “ghosts” in @UUID[.yk1knQyHc25ZSAfE]{Nhimbaloth's Shrine}.

Mysterious Strangers

He never visited the outbuilding on the island to the northwest, but mentions that a boat full of people (whom he can describe as “big and sneaky-looking”) came to visit it a week ago. The visitors went into the swamp dragon’s cave while the dragon was out, but the dragon returned soon thereafter; Boss Skrawng assumes the people got eaten.

On Gauntlight

If asked about Gauntlight’s eerie glow, Boss Skrawng’s eyes get big, and he shakes his head, warning the heroes that the light is the creepiest haunting of them all. He confirms that every night, the light glows, and he worries that there might be a big ghost up there.

The Lower Floors

Boss Skrawng confirms that the Mudlickers used to live in a dungeon level beneath Gauntlight Keep, but that a bunch of “mushroom-eyed people” (morlocks, although the mitflits don’t know them by that name) chased them up here many nights ago.

Directions

Boss Skrawng can provide a crude map of the first level and a partial map of the second if the heroes can successfully Request or Coerce the favor from him and supply him with the means to write out a map. A bribe of at least 2 gp automatically gets Boss Skrawng feeling helpful enough to provide these maps. His map of the first level omits areas @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.yGP5XjaIq9ix9ac7]{A12} to @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}, areas @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.hX0cKXoIDJT0AIRB]{A19} to @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{A23}, area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}, and all of the secret doors. His map of the second level is obviously much less complete. It only shows the areas once dwelt in by the Mudlickers: areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.CLm67CNpT0gNtor0]{B8} to @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14} and areas @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.eAD9hbPpzj5aLBZY]{B16} to @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} (although he warns the heroes that a big swamp dragon lives in the cave at area B19).

Side Quest:

Boss Skrawng hates the "mushroom-eyed people" and promises the heroes a big pile of shiny gems if they go downstairs, kill them all, and defeat their king. He describes the king as a "magic priest mushroom-eyed guy who can hurt your brain just by looking at you." Boss Skrawng doesn't actually have any shiny gems, and if the heroes do his quest and return with proof, he realizes that the heroes are tougher than the morlocks and that he made a terrible mistake in promising them treasure he doesn't have. He instead throws himself at their mercy and agrees to abandon his plots against Otari forever.

A11. Gauntlight Base.name: A11. 凄凉灯塔基座 A11. Gauntlight Base
A11. Gauntlight Base.text:
英雄们发现该房间南侧的门卡住了，但角色可以尝试一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定来 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}。一旦打开，门便碎裂成湿透的碎片。西侧的门有一扇1英尺见方、装有铁条的窗户，并且可以正常开启。

这间圆形房间的光滑墙壁被涂成浅灰色，看不出石块之间的接缝。一段铁制楼梯沿着弧形墙壁盘旋向上，直到在近百英尺高的天花板处止于一扇活板门。房间中央的地面上有一滩红色血迹闪着光泽，仿佛有一只人形大小的生物就在不久前在此失血而亡，尽管视野中看不到任何尸体。

玫瑰团在近五个世纪前终于在此房间击败了贝科拉。她死去之时，贝科拉的灵魂经由凄凉灯塔被拖入憎恨魔窟的深处，但她留在地板上的血迹仍如她死去那天一般新鲜。

在白昼时分，新鲜的血液偶尔会泛起涟漪；其湿滑的红色表面看起来像深水池的水面，但尽管这诡异的移动令人不安，它并无害处。到了夜晚，这滩血迹便会如以下所述的危害一般发挥作用。

铁制楼梯吱呀作响并令人不安地摇晃，但结构相当稳固。作为凄凉灯塔结构的一部分，只要贝科拉的幽灵（特征）仍处于活跃状态，楼梯就无法承受任何伤害。楼梯盘旋向上90英尺，通向一扇上锁的青铜活板门，后者通往 @UUID[.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{Gauntlight Cupola}。英雄可以 @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock}并以四次成功的 @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{巧手}检定打开活板门，或使用藏在区域 @UUID[.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13} 的钥匙。

闹鬼

中等 1

@Actor[XLTPZ592Z9MXXBlA]{贝科拉之血}

80 XP

此闹鬼仅能在夜间启动。曾在憎恨魔窟的其他地方见过贝科拉形象描绘的英雄可以认出该闹鬼的外观；否则，一次成功的 @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社交}检定可确认她的身份。

The heroes find the southern door to this room stuck, but a character can attempt a @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force it Open}. Once opened, it falls to sodden pieces. The western door has a 1-foot-square window set with iron bars, and it opens normally.

The smooth walls of this circular room are painted a light gray with no indication of seams between blocks of stone. A set of iron stairs winds upward along the curved walls before terminating at a trap door in the ceiling nearly a hundred feet above. A red bloodstain glistens on the floor at the room’s center, as though a human-sized creature bled to death on the floor very recently, despite there being no body in sight.

The Roseguard finally defeated Belcorra in this room nearly five centuries ago. As she died, Belcorra’s spirit was drawn down into the depths of the Abomination Vaults through Gauntlight, but the bloodstain she left on the floor remains as fresh as the day she died.

During daylight hours, the fresh blood ripples occasionally; its slick, red surface appears like the top of a deep pool, but it’s harmless despite this eerie movement. At night, the bloodstain acts as the hazard described below.

The iron stairs creak and sway alarmingly but are quite sound. As part of Gauntlight’s structure, the stairs can’t take damage as long as Belcorra’s ghost remains active. The stairs wind up 90 feet to a locked bronze trap door leading to the @UUID[.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{Gauntlight Cupola}. A hero can @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} and open the trap door with four successful @Check[type:thievery|dc:25|traits:action:pick-a-lock]{Thievery} check or can use the key hidden in area @UUID[.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}.

Haunt

Moderate 1

@Actor[XLTPZ592Z9MXXBlA]{Blood of Belcorra}

80 XP

This haunt can activate only at night. A hero who has seen a depiction of Belcorra elsewhere in the Abomination Vaults can recognize the haunt’s appearance; otherwise, a successful @Check[type:society|dc:20|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check confirms her identity.

A12. Belcorra’s Office.name: A12. 贝科拉的办公室 A12. Belcorra’s Office
A12. Belcorra’s Office.text:
这间房间的西南角天花板已经坍塌。墙上有数个书架，但曾存放在此的书籍与纸张早已因暴露在风雨中而腐烂成渣；东北侧壁龛内的木制书桌与椅子也同样如此。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

秘密门

一名在此房间进行搜索的英雄若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，便会定位到东墙上的秘密门：一处可旋转的书架充当了门把手。在其后方，一段楼梯向下通往区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06}。

宝藏

@Actor[sAPpmNqvn6SxYS2y]{贝科拉的书桌}

一名搜索书桌的英雄会自动注意到一个半开着的暗格抽屉，里面露出几瓶仍具效力的炼金灵药，这是贝科拉藏在此处的：次等理解力灵药、下等生命灵药，以及次等怀疑者灵药。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

@Actor[sAPpmNqvn6SxYS2y]{Belcorra's Desk}

The ceiling has collapsed in the southwest corner of this room. The walls bear several shelves, but the books and papers once kept here have rotted to ruin long ago due to exposure to the elements, as have the wooden desk and chair in an alcove to the northeast.

Exploration

@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.MY61uS4Lk2va9xoZ]{B06}

Secret Door

A hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:20|traits:action:search]{Perception} check locates the secret door in the east wall, where a rotating shelf functions as the door’s handle. Beyond, a flight of stairs leads down to area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

Treasure

@Actor[sAPpmNqvn6SxYS2y]{Belcorra's Desk}

A hero Searching the desk automatically notes a hidden drawer that has fallen partially open, revealing a few still-potent alchemical elixirs Belcorra stashed here: a lesser comprehension elixir, a minor elixir of life, and a lesser skeptic's elixir.

A13. Belcorra’s Sanctum.name: A13. 贝科拉的圣所 A13. Belcorra’s Sanctum
A13. Belcorra’s Sanctum.text:
这间三角形的房间曾经可能显得舒适，但在多年雨水侵蚀以及西北墙上两处箭狭缝让风雨侵入后，房间里的长沙发、衣橱与挂毯都已陷入衰败。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

被遗忘的钥匙圈

一串@Item[jDszN0s4ucrnNhc9]{生锈的钥匙圈}放在长沙发下，任何在此房间进行搜索的英雄都会找到它。锈蚀毁掉了其中六把铁钥匙，但仍有两把铜钥匙可用：一把饰有灯塔图案，能打开通往凄凉灯塔穹顶（区域 @UUID[.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25})的活板门；另一把饰有书本图案，能打开通往贝科拉私人阅览室（区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.OJNJc6Fo510Heygw]{C27}）的门。

暗门

贝科拉维持这间私人房间用于放松，并建造了一条通往神龛的秘密入口以便轻松出入。过去有一幅挂毯遮住那扇门，但它早已腐烂坠落，因此这扇门稍微更容易被发现。一名在此房间进行搜索并在一次@Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{察觉}检定中成功的英雄，会定位到通往一处与神龛相连的小区域的暗门。角色显然能在这片空间内发现第二扇半掩着的暗门，如区域 @UUID[.yk1knQyHc25ZSAfE]{A15} 所述。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

This triangular room might have once seemed comfortable, but after years of rain and exposure to the elements through the two arrow slits in the northwestern wall, the room’s divan, armoire, and tapestries have fallen to decay.

Exploration

@UUID[.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}

Forgotten Keyring

A @Item[jDszN0s4ucrnNhc9]{Rusted Ring of Keys} sits under the divan, and any hero Searching this room finds it. Rust has ruined six of its iron keys, but two bronze keys remain usable: the one decorated with a lighthouse unlocks the trap door to Gauntlight's cupola (area @UUID[JournalEntry.KeWKr2yd8dbppeS5.JournalEntryPage.OJNJc6Fo510Heygw]{C27}), and the other decorated with a book unlocks the door to Belcorra's private reading room (area @UUID[.yk1knQyHc25ZSAfE]{A15}).

Secret Door

Belcorra maintained this private room to relax and constructed a secret entrance to the shrine to easily access it. A tapestry formerly concealed the door, but it rotted and fell long ago, so the door has become slightly easier to find. A hero Searching this room who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:16|traits:action:search]{Perception} check locates the secret door that leads into a small area that connects to the shrine. Characters can obviously spot the second, partly ajar secret door within this space, as described in area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

A14. Scorpion Kennel.name: A14. 蝎犬舍 A14. Scorpion Kennel
A14. Scorpion Kennel.text:
这个房间的天花板有两处坍塌。较小的一处坍塌摧毁了一段楼梯，那楼梯曾通往如今已成废墟的上层楼面。较大的一处坍塌将南侧的双开门大半掩埋，在屋顶留下一个洞口，部分被几根交叉的木梁挡住。北侧还有第二扇双开门，门上的石面雕刻着骷髅，骷髅上结着纠缠的苔藓。

这个房间充当舔泥佬的犬舍，用来关押它们的第一件重要收获——一只巨蝎。螨精几乎没有损失就把这只怪物引诱进来，然后在瓦砾中弄塌了几根木梁，将它圈在里面。中型或更小的生物可以攀爬穿过这团纠结的障碍，但除非被严重折磨，巨蝎不会想到要砸开木梁离开房间。

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[zJZqpx6pPW7dxEUV]{巨蝎}

80 XP

螨精让巨蝎吃得饱饱的、心情也不错，但它会立刻攻击其他生物。它能轻松地在本房间的瓦砾上疾行，不会将其视为困难地形。蝎子可以爬上南侧瓦砾并@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}出一条路来追击英雄；如有必要，它可在一次成功的@Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定后做到这一点，但除非攻击者从瓦砾另一侧不断骚扰它，否则它不太可能这么做。

对于1级角色来说，这只蝎子是个格外危险的敌人，因此如果英雄们应付得很吃力，你可以鼓励他们撤退，并让蝎子退回这个房间，而不是追逐逃跑的英雄太远。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

尽管骷髅雕刻上生长的苔藓纠结物看起来像是遍布整座遗迹的疯长植被的一部分，但它们其实属于原本的设计。这颗覆苔骷髅是外神@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.ohFJrgStEzdvGEEU]{Nhimbaloth}的宗教象征；宁布洛斯是幽灵（特征）、绝望灵光、沼泽与鬼火的外神，而贝科拉将其奉为自己的守护者。然而，关于宁布洛斯的传说既稀少又隐秘，因此英雄必须在一次@Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教}检定中成功，才能回忆知识并将这颗覆苔骷髅辨认为宁布洛斯的象征。

尽管初出茅庐的英雄们可能认不出宁布洛斯的迹象，但镇上的瓦琳·希温尼斯知晓这位阴森的外神；如果英雄们向她汇报发现，她就能为他们解惑。

The ceiling of this room has fallen in two places. A smaller collapse destroyed a flight of stairs that once led up to the now-ruined upper floor. A larger collapse mostly buried the southern double door, leaving a hole in the roof partially blocked with several crossed timbers. A second double door to the north has a stone face carved with skulls caked with tangles of moss.

This room serves as a kennel for the Mudlickers’ first significant acquisition—a giant scorpion. The mitflits lured the monster into this room with minimal loss, then collapsed several timbers in the rubble to keep it penned in. A Medium or smaller creature can clamber through this tangle, but unless it's significantly tormented, the giant scorpion won’t think to smash through the timbers to leave the room.

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[zJZqpx6pPW7dxEUV]{Giant Scorpion}

80 XP

The mitflits keep the giant scorpion well fed and content, but it attacks other creatures at once. It can skitter easily over the rubble in this room and doesn't treat it as difficult terrain. The scorpion can climb the rubble to the south and @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} a path to pursue heroes with a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:18|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check if necessary, but it’s unlikely to do so unless attackers are harrying it from the other side of the rubble.

The scorpion is a particularly dangerous foe for 1st-level characters, so you might encourage the heroes to retreat if they’re having a hard time with it and have the scorpion retreat back to this room rather than pursue fleeing heroes very far.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Although the tangles of moss growing on the skull carvings seem like part of the overgrowth prevalent throughout the ruin, they belong to the original design. The mossy skull is the religious symbol of @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.ohFJrgStEzdvGEEU]{Nhimbaloth}, the Outer God of ghosts, despair, swamps, and will-o'-wisps, whom Belcorra reveres as her patron. Nhimbaloth's lore is rare and hidden, however, so a hero must succeed at a @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge to identify the mossy skull as Nhimbaloth's symbol.

Although fledgling heroes might not recognize evidence of Nhimbaloth, Wrin Sivinxi in town knows of the sinister Outer God and can enlighten the heroes if they report their findings to her.

A15. Nhimbaloth's Shrine.name: A15. 宁布洛斯的神殿 A15. Nhimbaloth's Shrine
A15. Nhimbaloth's Shrine.text:
这座大型礼拜堂里的空气比遗迹其他地方更冷也更潮湿。墙上凝结的水珠沿着石壁流淌，穿过石头上雕刻的无数骷髅。一个腐朽的人类尸体瘫靠在墙边，他的双手卡在一道裂缝里，仿佛他死时正试图撬松一块砖。三段短阶梯通向北方更宽阔的厅室，那里有一座半圆形的高台托起一座白石祭坛。祭坛后方耸立着四扇彩绘玻璃窗，每扇高达二十英尺，描绘着四幕令人不安的场景：幽魂自杂草丛生的墓园中升起，朝向高空中一颗四角橙色星辰而去。

南侧的尸体瘫倒在通往区域 @UUID[.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13} 的秘密门旁。这名盗贼曾是人类男子，数月前为寻找一件宝藏而通过秘密门潜入神殿，却发现自己根本不是潜伏在此室中的尸火的对手。他在即将重新打开秘密门逃离它们之前便已毙命。盗贼把门留得微微半掩，开启它的旋转骷髅也仍略微转动，因此英雄们能轻易发现这道秘密门。

遭遇

严峻 1

@Actor[HBRz8BVLVN9u9Odp]{尸火 (2)}

120 XP

宁布洛斯的两名早已死去的侍祭已经腐化得只剩覆着苔藓的骷髅，横躺在北方大室的东侧边缘，最初对从南方进入者而言处于视线之外。然而它们绝非无害，因为它们体内寄宿着名为尸火的诡异生物。当英雄接近北方厅室时，尸火便会升起。它们会战斗直到被摧毁，但不会追击逃离的英雄。第一个倒下并被削弱到鬼火形态的尸火，会占据秘密门旁死去盗贼的尸体（若仍可用）——或者在更黑暗的转折中，占据一名死去的英雄！

占据尸体

由于尸火以骷髅为躯壳开始战斗，它们应以已施加的占据尸体-骷髅效果开始。随着战斗持续，它们被迫进入鬼火形态或接管新的躯体时，务必施加或移除相应的状态，以立即调整其体型、美术资源与数据！

@Item[xkt9CKO2VR32gAYf]{效果：占据尸体 - 血肉} @Item[qxNwICP84dBEsuS4]{效果：占据尸体 - 骷髅}

宝藏

两具侍祭骷髅几乎没有留下任何未腐烂或未锈蚀至无用的东西，只有两项例外：其中一具的下颚里仍嵌着一颗价值 4 gp 的 @UUID[Item.cdzzVnvc6BkPnGIO]{Gold Tooth}，而另一具侍祭在其枯骨般的脖颈上戴着一条 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.3vxoffA4slKHXtj2]{Channel Protection Amulet}。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

调查行动圣龛

贝科拉从不隐瞒她对宁布洛斯的信仰；她维持着这座规模可观的圣龛，既作为礼拜之所，也作为会见访客时用以震慑的场景。圣龛弥漫着不祥的氛围，仿佛有某个巨大而遥远的存在透过彩绘玻璃窗注视着这里。英雄可以用一次成功的 @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{宗教} 检定来回忆知识，从而辨认此处为宁布洛斯的圣龛。

搜查祭坛

进行搜查祭坛的英雄若成功通过一次 @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{察觉} 检定，会在其北侧发现一块秘密面板；面板后有一处浅凹，里面放着一张复原感官卷轴与一根 1 环1 环治疗术魔杖。

@Actor[FN5c95GBzHWDbXbP]{圣龛夹层}

宝藏

@Actor[VJ8t4Uo2LSiRSuFz]{盗贼遗骸}

盗贼的尸体上有数件有价值的物品，包括一把+1 细剑、四把匕首、一枚价值 5 gp 的银戒指、一瓶下等治疗药水，以及一瓶次等黑暗视觉灵药。

The air in this large chapel feels colder and damper than elsewhere in the ruins. Condensed beads on the walls run in rivulets across the countless skulls carved into the stone. A moldering human corpse lies slumped against a wall, his hands wedged into a crack as if he died trying to pry a brick loose. Three short flights of steps lead upward to a wider chamber to the north, where a semicircular dais supports an altar of white stone. Beyond the altar loom four stained-glass windows, each twenty feet tall and depicting four haunting scenes of ghosts rising from overgrown graveyards toward a four-pointed orange star high above.

The corpse to the south lies slumped next to the secret door leading to area @UUID[.l1967pkknJ7ifjTc]{A13}. Once a human man, this thief snuck into the temple through the secret door months ago in search of a treasure, only to find himself outclassed by the corpselights lurking in this room. He perished just before could reopen the secret door to escape from them. The thief left the door slightly ajar with the rotating skull that opens it still slightly turned, so the heroes can easily spot this secret door.

Encounter

Severe 1

@Actor[HBRz8BVLVN9u9Odp]{Corpselights (2)}

120 XP

Two long-dead acolytes of Nhimbaloth have decomposed into little more than mossy skeletons sprawled along the eastern edge of the large chamber to the north, initially out of sight of anyone entering from the south. They’re far from harmless, however, as they harbor eerie creatures called corpselights. The corpselights rise when the heroes approach the northern chamber. They fight until destroyed but don’t pursue heroes who flee. The first corpselight to fall and be reduced to its wisp form animates the corpse of the dead thief at the secret door if it’s still available—or in an even darker turn, a dead hero!

Claim Corpse

Because the Corpselights begin combat inside of skeletons, they should start with the Claim Corpse- Skeletal effect applied. As the fight continues, and they are forced into their wisp form or take control of new bodies, make sure to apply or remove the appropriate conditions to adjust their size, art, and statistics instantly!

@Item[xkt9CKO2VR32gAYf]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Flesh} @Item[qxNwICP84dBEsuS4]{Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal}

Treasure

The acolyte skeletons have little remaining that hasn't rotted or rusted away to uselessness with two exceptions: one of them has a @UUID[Item.cdzzVnvc6BkPnGIO]{Gold Tooth} worth 4 gp still in its jaw, while the other acolyte wears a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.3vxoffA4slKHXtj2]{Channel Protection Amulet} around its bony neck.

Exploration

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.EwgTZBWsc8qKaViP]{Investigate}

Investigating the Shrine

Belcorra made no secret of her faith in Nhimbaloth, and she maintained this sizable shrine to the sinister entity both as a place of worship and an intimidating setting to meet visitors. The shrine has an ominous atmosphere, as if something immense and distant watches through the stained glass windows. A hero can identify this room as a shrine to Nhimbaloth with a successful @Check[type:religion|dc:25|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Religion} check to Recall Knowledge.

Searching the Altar

A hero Searching the altar who succeeds at a @Check[type:perception|dc:18|traits:action:search]{Perception} check finds a secret panel on its northern side, which has a shallow nook that contains a scroll of restore senses and a 1st-level wand of heal.

@Actor[FN5c95GBzHWDbXbP]{Shrine Compartment}

Treasure

@Actor[VJ8t4Uo2LSiRSuFz]{Thief's Remains}

The thief's corpse has several items of value, including a +1 rapier, four daggers, a silver ring worth 5 gp, a minor healing potion, and a lesser darkvision elixir.

A16. Ruined Boathouse.name: A16. 废墟船屋 A16. Ruined Boathouse
A16. Ruined Boathouse.text:
一位英雄若仔细检查这座船屋的门，会注意到其中一扇门在过去几周内曾被破拆打开过，然后又被小心地重新关上。

这座石墙建筑的南部已经坍塌成瓦砾，暴露出船屋残余的部分，任由风雨侵蚀。里面的架子和小船都已腐朽成一堆堆腐烂物与苔藓。相对新近的一处营火残迹仍在微微冒着烟。

营火的残迹暗示着一伙来自奥塔里的盗贼曾在此出没——他们是来自 @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Crook’s Nook} 的一群人，几天前听闻有宝藏藏在岛下的洞窟里，便来到这里。他们进入下方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19}，却在被困于地城、并遭那里的幽灵女王摩洛克囚禁时，发现自己闯入了无法应付的险境。

A hero who takes a close look at the doors to this boathouse notices that one of them has been forced open and then carefully closed again within the past couple of weeks.

The southern portion of this stonewalled building has collapsed into rubble, exposing what remains of a boathouse to the elements. The shelves and boats within have decayed into heaps of rot and moss. The remains of a relatively fresh campfire smolder faintly.

The campfire’s remnants hint at the presence of a group of thieves from Otari—a band from @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.sdNti6BHkPTeO5fC]{Crook’s Nook} who came here several days ago after hearing rumors of treasure stashed in a cavern under the island. They entered area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} below only to get in over their heads when they were trapped in the dungeon and imprisoned by some of the Ghost Queen morlocks there.

A17. Ruined Pier.name: A17. 毁坏的栈桥 A17. Ruined Pier
A17. Ruined Pier.text:
这座木制码头的大部分已经坍塌进沼泽，只剩下约十英尺长的发霉、湿软木板，耷拉在古老的木桩旁。一艘系在木桩上的划艇看起来是最近才造的。

这艘划艇由骗子之角的盗贼留在此处，状况良好。英雄们可以用它在遗迹周围的水域中航行。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

正在搜索这艘划艇的英雄会发现两样东西。第一样是一小堆点心——烟熏鲑鱼包在鱼形的面团外壳里；一名在一次 @Check[type:society|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社交}检定中成功的英雄会认出这些“鱼饼”正是奥塔里骗子之角出售的那种。第二样是在船内靠近船首处装饰着的一处飞鸟雕刻。一名在一次 @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{社交}检定中成功的英雄会认出这个标记属于鱼鹰俱乐部——奥塔里的盗贼公会（大成功或大失败则确认鱼鹰俱乐部以骗子之角为总部，且公会成员会把飞鸟标记纹在身上作为纹身）。

如果英雄们在入夜后来到这里，水对岸 @UUID[.qECJHfd2gZwY8I8Y]{Old Pier}的闪火会闪动，试图引诱他们靠近。

码头下方的一个开口通向区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19}。由你决定，河流龙兽弗雷兹内尔凯什可能会离开巢穴到雾隐沼泽中狩猎，并在英雄们靠近时发现他们。对于一支由1级角色组成的队伍来说，弗雷兹内尔凯什是个难缠的敌人，因此如果英雄们难以应付她，你应让这只河流龙兽飞走，转而追逐沼泽中体型更大、也更安全的猎物。

支线任务

如果英雄们拜访骗子之角并询问这艘船的事，伊娜斯梅拉会承认她的四名“雇员”在几天前失踪了。她承诺如果英雄们能查明他们遭遇了什么并把他们带回来，她将支付50 gp作为报酬。

其中一名盗贼已经死亡，其遗骸可在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14}找到。摩洛克把另外三人作为囚犯关押在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24}。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Much of this wooden pier has collapsed into the swamp, leaving about ten feet of moldy, soggy boards slumped against ancient wood pilings. A rowboat tied to a piling looks much more recently built.

The rowboat, left here by the Crook’s Nook thieves, is in good condition. The heroes can use it to navigate the waters around the ruins.

Exploration

@UUID[.qECJHfd2gZwY8I8Y]{Old Pier}

Heroes Searching the rowboat find two things. The first is a stash of pastries—smoked salmon in a fish-shaped doughy exterior; a hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:society|dc:12|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check recognizes the “fishcakes” as those sold at the Crook’s Nook in Otari. The second is a carving of a flying bird decorating the inside of the boat near the bow. A hero who succeeds at a @Check[type:society|dc:16|traits:action:recall-knowledge]{Society} check recognizes that this mark belongs to the Osprey Club, Otari’s thieves’ guild (a critical success confirms that the Osprey Club uses Crook’s Nook as a headquarters and that guild members bear the mark of the flying bird as a tattoo).

If the heroes come here after dark, the flickerwisp at the @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.ZGby3FkCgaPte0O9]{B19} across the water flickers in an attempt to lure them closer.

An opening under the pier leads to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.xx0EOST0kN62qFg3]{B14}. At your discretion, the river drake Freznelkesh might venture out to hunt in the Fogfen and spot the heroes while they’re nearby. Freznelkesh is a difficult foe for a party of 1st-level characters, so you should have the river drake take off to pursue larger, safer prey in the swamp if the heroes are having a tough time dealing with her.

Side Quest

Should the heroes visit Crook’s Nook and ask about the boat, Yinyasmera admits that four of her “employees” went missing several days ago. She promises a 50 gp reward if the heroes can find out what happened to them and bring them back.

One thief died, and their remains can be found in area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.NyCn35Bdz6gaubNu]{B24}. The morlocks have kept the other three as prisoners in area @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}.

A18. Apprentice Island.name: A18. 学徒岛 A18. Apprentice Island
A18. Apprentice Island.text:
一座低矮的木桥横跨大岛与小岛之间的水道。一栋单层建筑坐落在小岛上茂密生长的芦苇丛中。

这座小岛上的建筑最初是贝科拉的学徒——一名名为沃鲁克·阿兹里尼的卓尔——的住所。沃鲁克已不再住在这里，但他仍在下方深处的房间里为贝科拉效力；他已超越了类人生物形态的局限，成为一名蠕虫行者（他如今居住在区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}）。

A low wooden bridge spans a watery gap between the larger island and a smaller one. A single-story building sits amid the thick reeds growing on the smaller island.

The building on this islet originally served as the home of Belcorra’s apprentice, a drow named Volluk Azrinae. Volluk no longer lives here, but he still serves Belcorra in the chambers deep below, having transcended from the limitations of his humanoid form to become a worm that walks (he now resides in area @UUID[JournalEntry.Os5bHdzCDiXgJBQ6.JournalEntryPage.NHY0hh539X658iSG]{D08}).

A19. Spookywisp.name: A19. 吓人鬼 A19. Spookywisp
A19. Spookywisp.text:
这间房间的外门卡住了，需要成功进行一次 @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:force-open]{运动}检定才能@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}。

这间书房里有几排书架、一张书桌和两把椅子。书本与物体散乱不堪，撕碎的书页胡乱地散落在房间各处。

沃鲁克曾在此继续他的研究，并在这间房里与贝科拉会面上课。

如今，一个名叫鸡窝头的淘气棕仙——一个顽皮的妖精，他同名的金发总是以毛躁凌乱的状态“常驻”在头顶——占据了这间房。尽管外表滑稽，鸡窝头却自认为是某种“吓人系”的妖精。他一注意到英雄们靠近——比如他们试图破拆房门却没能立刻成功时——便会迅速溜到书桌下面躲起来，然后用腹语术以低沉的声音喊话。他声称自己是名为“吓人鬼”的危险“微灵幽灵”。接着他施展舞光术，制造出一个他希望英雄们会相信是鬼火的光点，让光漂浮到空中，并用腹语术把自己的声音从光点处投出。

鸡窝头几天前才来到这里，但他很快就把房间里的东西翻得稀烂，却没找到任何他感兴趣的东西。随后他转向区域@UUID[.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{A23}；在那里，那副闪亮的望远镜令他入迷，但看守它的娃娃把他赶跑了。面对一只真正可怕的生物，鸡窝头退回这间房，盘算如何把那件“闪亮”据为己有。而英雄们会给他这个方法——见下方支线任务。

遭遇

微不足道 1

@Actor[SFpMOxBwiS529dJk]{鸡窝头}

如果英雄们攻击他或以暴力与他对峙，鸡窝头会因恐惧而尖叫，随后朝@UUID[.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{Lens Workshop}逃去，希望把英雄们引到那间房里，从而让他们在不经意间毁掉那只缚魂娃娃。若他们真这么做了，他会试图偷走其中的“闪亮”，然后永远逃离该区域。

XP 奖励

鸡窝头并非对队伍的真实威胁，无论他们是与他战斗还是与他达成交易，他们都获得 40 XP。

支线任务：

如果英雄们与鸡窝头交谈——无论是当面交谈，还是通过他作为吓人鬼的扮相——这位棕仙会向他们解释，他想要西南边房间里的“闪亮”。他警告英雄们，一只刻薄的鸟嘴脸娃娃会试图阻止他们拿到“闪亮”，但他保证：若英雄们把“闪亮”带给他，他就会告诉英雄们他所了解的关于该区域的三个秘密。若被要求描述“闪亮”，鸡窝头会令人恼火地说：“它就是闪的！你一看见就知道了！”若再追问，他便翻个白眼，称那是一根“会闪会发光的管子，我想要，想要，想要！”

“闪亮”指的是陈列在透镜工坊中的那副镶宝石望远镜。若英雄们取回并交给他，这位棕仙便会透露他最近从这里的书本中，以及从这里与他发现望远镜的房间之间走廊上的画作中所了解到的内容。

“第一，这栋建筑以前属于一个叫沃鲁克·阿兹里尼的人。第二，沃鲁克是另一个叫贝科拉的人的学徒；而且尽管这个沃鲁克看起来像个刻薄又危险的家伙，贝科拉似乎要糟得多！最后，那座吓人的魔法灯塔不只是能照出诡异的光；它还会发射一道塞满幽灵（特征）的光束！”

（这最后一段描述基于鸡窝头对@UUID[.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{Hall of Portraits (A22)}中灯塔画作的解读，但也与事实相去不远）。

@Actor[SFpMOxBwiS529dJk]{Tangletop}

The exterior door to this room is stuck, requiring a successful @Check[type:athletics|dc:15|traits:action:force-open]{Athletics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}.

This study features several bookshelves, a desk, and two chairs. The books and objects here lie in disarray with torn pages strewn haphazardly across the room.

Volluk once pursued his studies and met with Belcorra for lessons in this room.

Today, a mischievous brownie named Tangletop- a puckish fey whose eponymous blonde hair stays in a constant state of frizzy disarray on his head- occupies this chamber. Despite his comical appearance, Tangletop fancies himself something of a spooky sort of fey. As soon as he notices the heroes approaching, such as if they try to Force Open the door but don't succeed at doing so right away, he quickly slips into hiding under the desk before using ventriloquism to call out in a deep voice. He claims to be a dangerous "wispy-ghost" named "Spookywisp." He then uses dancing lights to create what he hopes the heroes believe is a will-o'-wisp, floating the light up in the air and using ventriloquism to cast his voice from the light.

Tangletop arrived here only a few days ago, but he made short work ripping through the room's contents before finding nothing of interest to him. He moved on toward area @UUID[.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{A23}; there, the shiny spyglass entranced him before the doll that guards it chased him off. Faced with an actually scary creature, Tangletop retreated to this room to plot methods of securing the "shiny" for himself. The heroes give him that method- see the Side Quest below.

Encounter

Trivial 1

@Actor[SFpMOxBwiS529dJk]{Tangletop}

If the heroes attack or confront him with violence, Tangletop shrieks in fear and flees toward the @UUID[.7svdEIhRQeWmtenl]{Lens Workshop}, hoping to lure the heroes into that room so that they inadvertently end up destroying the soulbound doll. If they do, he tries to steal the "shiny" therein before fleeing the area forever.

XP Award

Tangletop isn't a real threat to the party, and whether they fight him or make a deal with him, they gain 40 XP.

Side Quest:

If the heroes speak to Tangletop, either in person or via his persona as Spookywisp, the brownie explains to them that he wants the "shiny" in the room to the southwest. He warns the heroes that a mean, beak-faced doll will try to stop them from getting the "shiny" but he promises that he'll tell the heroes three secrets he has learned about the area if they bring him the "shiny". Asked to describe the "shiny", Tangletop frustratingly says, "It's shiny! You'll know it when you see it!" Pressed further, he rolls his eyes and describes it as a "sparkling glowing tube that I want, want, want!"

The "shiny" refers to the bejeweled spyglass kept on display in the Lens Workshop. If the heroes retrieve and hand it over, the brownie reveals what he recently learned from the books here as well as from reviewing the paintings in the hallway between here and the room where he spotted the spyglass.

"First, this building used to belong to someone named Volluk Azrinae. Second, Volluk was an apprentice to someone else named Belcorra, and even though this Volluk person seemed like someone who was mean and dangerous, Belcorra seemed much worse! Finally, the spooky magic lighthouse can do more than just shine an eerie light; it can also shoot a beam full of ghosts!"

(This last description is based on Tangletop's interpretation of the lighthouse painting in the @UUID[.OYCvTEvFFpv8zEql]{Hall of Portraits (A22)}, but it isn't far from the truth).

A20. Repair Storage.name: A20. 修理储藏室 A20. Repair Storage
A20. Repair Storage.text:
这个十英尺见方的房间四壁排列着摆满工具、木料和木板的架子。

这些物资用于维护凄凉灯塔要塞上层各处的运作。沃卢克曾担任首席园丁并负责管理修缮工作。由于认为这类平凡杂务有失他的技能水准，他常在需要时召唤贝科拉的其他仆从来完成这些工作。

探索

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

在此房间进行搜索的英雄会发现一把价值10 gp的@Item[zlanzgKmTDu2xKvL]{大型银钥匙}。这把钥匙可以打开下方楼层通往@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Volluk’s Workshop}的门。

@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search}

Shelves laden with tools, lumber, and planks line the walls of this ten-foot-square room.

These supplies were used for upkeep throughout the upper works of Gauntlight Keep. Volluk formerly functioned as a head groundskeeper and managed repairs. Considering such mundane tasks beneath his skills, he often called upon Belcorra's other servants as needed for these jobs.

Exploration

@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Volluk’s Workshop}

Heroes Searching this room discover a @Item[zlanzgKmTDu2xKvL]{Large Silver Key} worth 10 gp. This key unlocks the door to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} on the floor below.

A21. Stairwell.name: A21. 楼梯间 A21. Stairwell
A21. Stairwell.text:
苔藓和真菌覆盖着这些紧密盘旋的楼梯，它们通向下方的区域 @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.OmLsmbwPtNMw7csF]{B01}。从生长的状况来看，很明显已经很久没有人走过这条路了。

Moss and fungus coats these tightly spiraling stairs, which lead down to area @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.OmLsmbwPtNMw7csF]{B01}. From the state of the growth, it’s obvious that no one has gone this way for a long time.

A22. Hall of Portraits.name: A22. 肖像大厅 A22. Hall of Portraits
A22. Hall of Portraits.text:
这条走廊西北侧墙上挂着四幅画，但层层霉菌与衰败已将它们严重毁坏。

墙上的这些画在时代的侵蚀与屋顶渗漏滴下的潮湿作用下，已遭受不可逆转的损坏。

第一幅画巨大无比，接近7英尺高，几乎同样宽。这是一幅风景画，描绘了艾巴萨罗姆城陷于烈焰之中，燃烧的建筑之间，幽灵（特征）从街道上升起。画框下沿镶着一块青铜铭牌，上面写着：“愚者必将如此受苦。”

第二幅画几乎与艾巴萨罗姆那幅同样大，风格一致，但主题不同。这幅画描绘了凄凉灯塔要塞在上层楼塌毁之前的样子。灯塔高耸于庄严的要塞之上直入夜空，塔顶灯束放射出淡蓝色的光亮术，光中有幽灵般的面孔讥笑并做出狰狞表情。其青铜铭牌写着：“让光永远照耀。”

第三幅是一幅肖像画，原本描绘的是沃鲁克，但如今已被彻底撕碎。沃鲁克在成为蠕虫行者后将其毁掉。铭牌上写着：“艺术家在工作。”

第四幅也是最后一幅肖像更小，呈圆形。画中是一位身着高领红裙、带着讥诮笑容的女子——正是贝科拉本人。铭牌上写着：“光之夫人。”很久以前，沃鲁克用阿克洛文在这最后一幅画旁的石头上刻下了如下句子：“我仍为你效劳！你必将得报！”

A series of four paintings hang on the northwestern wall of this hallway, although layers of mold and decay have severely damaged them.

The paintings along the wall have sustained irrevocable damage over time and due to moisture dripping down from leaks in the roof.

The first painting is enormous, nearly 7 feet tall and almost as wide. It’s a landscape painting that depicts the city of Absalom in flames with ghosts rising from the city streets between the burning buildings. The picture’s lower frame bears a bronze plaque that reads, “So Shall the Fools Suffer.”

The second painting is nearly as large as the Absalom painting and is in the same style, though its subject is different. This second painting depicts Gauntlight Keep as it appeared before its upper floors collapsed. The lighthouse rises above the stately keep into the night sky, with its beacon emitting a pale blue light in which ghostly faces sneer and grimace. Its bronze plaque reads, “Let the Light Shine Forever.”

The third picture is a portrait that once depicted Volluk but is now totally shredded. Volluk destroyed it after becoming a worm that walks. Its plaque reads, “The Artist at Work.”

The fourth and final portrait is smaller and circular. It depicts a smirking woman dressed in a red gown with a high collar—an image of Belcorra herself. Its plaque reads, "The Lady of the Light." Long ago, Volluk scratched the following sentences, written in Aklo, into the stone next to this last painting: "I serve you still! You shall be avenged!"

A23. Lens Workshop.name: A23. 透镜工坊 A23. Lens Workshop
A23. Lens Workshop.text:
这间曾经雅致的工坊如今已成一片狼藉。潮湿的滴水苔藓从上方木制穹顶屋顶的裂缝间垂落。其下，遍地碎玻璃如地毯般铺开，闪烁着危险的光。工作台与搁架、支架与展示架——这些原本用于制作或修理灯塔巨大透镜的器具——都已化为废墟。只有一支镶宝石的望远镜，仍安然置于南侧墙边的展示架上，躲过了这场浩劫。

这场破坏大多是沃鲁克造成的。贝科拉死后，他藏身于沼泽中，等待玫瑰团离开。等他回来时，他因自己的怯懦而充满愧疚，盛怒之下砸毁了这间工坊。

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[kzX588Hjb3w4QPOj]{喙先生}

80 XP

沃鲁克制造了数个构装体，以协助他和他的女主人处理日常工作，但其中他最偏爱的，是他称作喙先生的乌鸦头、乌鸦翼的缚魂娃娃。它既非最强，也非最有用；然而喙先生体内封存着他忠心仆从的灵魂——一名名叫波波的地精——这一事实确保了这具构装体始终陪在沃鲁克身旁。如今，喙先生仍被遗弃在此，永远等待着那位转去处理其他事务、甚至换了全新身体的造物主。喙先生并未失去希望；当英雄们进入房间时，它从房间中央那堆塌陷的隆起中站起身，用颤鸣的嗓音问道：“阿兹瑞奈主人会回来吗？”无论英雄们如何回答，喙先生都会意识到他们都不是自己的造物主；随即，它拍动翅膀跃入空中，带着挫败的狂怒发动攻击，战斗至被摧毁为止。

碎玻璃

覆盖地面的碎玻璃与破裂材料形成一层不稳地面，需要进行一次@Check[type:acrobatics|dc:11|traits:action:balance]{特技}检定来@Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}。生物若在此房间内倒地，则受到 1 点穿刺伤害。

喙先生是带有笨拙翅膀的缚魂娃娃的独特变体，尽管如此他仍能用翅膀飞行。因此，他可以轻易避开房间内的不稳地面。

灵魂焦点

喙先生的灵魂焦点宝石位于他的背部，嵌在双翼之间。这颗宝石价值 5 gp，但若英雄们将其置入楼下@UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Volluk’s Workshop}中那具部分完成的缚魂娃娃里，它作为潜在信息来源可能更为珍贵。

宝藏

@Item[81IBK1HJESDCKkiG]{镶宝石望远镜}

这支望远镜是沃鲁克除凄凉灯塔的透镜之外最得意的作品。即便在自我憎恨的暴怒中，沃鲁克也下不了手砸毁这件宝藏。这支望远镜正是鸡窝头所寻找的那件“闪亮东西”。若英雄们决定留下它，望远镜价值 20 gp。

This once elegant workshop has fallen into shambles. Soggy strings of dripping moss hang through cracks in the wooden domed roof above. Below it, a carpet of broken glass glitters dangerously. Workbenches and shelves, armatures and displays—all formerly used in crafting or repairing immense lenses for a lighthouse—lie in ruins. Only a bejeweled spyglass sitting on a display rack near the southern wall has survived the devastation.

Volluk caused most of this destruction. After Belcorra’s death, he hid in the swamp while he waited for the Roseguard to leave. When he returned, he was filled with such guilt over his cowardice that he destroyed this workshop in a fit of fury.

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[kzX588Hjb3w4QPOj]{Mister Beak}

80 XP

Volluk created several constructs to aid him and his mistress in their day-to-day jobs, but the raven-headed, raven-winged soulbound doll he called Mister Beak was his favorite. Neither the most powerful nor the most helpful, Mister Beak held the soul of his devoted servant, a goblin named Borbo, a fact that ensured the construct’s place at Volluk’s side. Today, Mister Beak remains abandoned here, waiting forever for a creator who moved on to other tasks and an entirely new body. Mister Beak hasn’t lost hope, and when the heroes enter the room, he stands up from the slumped mound in the room’s center and asks in a warbling voice, “Is Master Azrinae coming back?” Regardless of the heroes’ answer, Mister Beak realizes none of them are its creator; it then leaps into the air on flapping wings to attack in a frustrated fury, fighting until destroyed.

Broken Glass

The layer of broken glass and shattered materials covering the floor makes it uneven ground with a @Check[type:acrobatics|dc:11|traits:action:balance]{Acrobatics} check to @Compendium[pf2e.actionspf2e.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. A creature who falls prone while in this room takes 1 piercing damage.

Mister Beak is a unique variant of a soulbound doll with ungainly wings that he can nevertheless use to fly. He can therefore easily avoid the uneven ground in this room.

Soul Focus

Mister Beak's soul focus gem is located on his back, nestled between his wings. The gem is worth 5 gp but might prove more valuable as a potential source of information if the heroes place it in the partially completed soulbound doll in @UUID[JournalEntry.uMZ0RiCcPSqsx1Nm.JournalEntryPage.hOMUDNapQMRjV1kQ]{Volluk’s Workshop} on the floor below.

Treasure

@Item[81IBK1HJESDCKkiG]{Bejeweled Spyglass}

The spyglass was Volluk’s finest creation apart from the lenses for Gauntlight. Even in his self-loathing rage, Volluk couldn’t bring himself to smash this treasure. The spyglass is the "shiny" that Tangletop seeks. If the heroes decide to keep it, the spyglass has a value of 20 gp.

A24. Old Pier.name: A24. 旧码头 A24. Old Pier
A24. Old Pier.text:
这座古老的木制栈桥有一部分已经塌入沼泽，而仍露出水面的部分看起来只要轻轻一接触就会步其后尘。

这座栈桥如其外观一般危险；任何人踏上去都会导致整座栈桥崩塌，坠落进其下方3尺深的水中。其下方吸附性的淤泥是高等困难地形。

世界状态

@Macro[lTRp4OBk4ueE63AE]{A24 - Pier Collapse}

如果英雄们弄塌了栈桥，点击上方的宏以切换地砖的状态——并在其在脚下碎裂时播放一个音效！

遭遇

低威胁 1

@Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{闪火}

60 XP

一只闪火栖居在这座古老栈桥腐朽残骸之间。当它注意到英雄们时，它开始发光并扭动，时而呈现为一串闪烁的萤火虫，时而呈现为一道在栈桥巨大破洞上方起伏荡漾的光亮丝带。任何踏上这段栈桥的人都有从中坠落的风险，而闪火会迅速攻击那些陷在淤泥中的受害者。闪火渴望吞食挫败与困惑术；一旦战斗开始，它绝不会撤退，即便处于劣势。

发光

闪火的发光能力意味着：尽管它是隐形的，但它会产生明亮光照。栈桥尽头放置有一个光亮术，你可以用它来引诱英雄们踏上被削弱的那一段，同时不暴露该生物的指示物——至少在它准备发动攻击之前！

一旦闪火被揭示为一个生物，只需运行这个宏来使其可见，同时隐藏场景的环境光照。

@Macro[Rjype0R8A2jawF7b]{A24 - Flickerwisp Reveal}

This old wooden pier has partially collapsed into the swamp, and the portion remaining above water looks ready to follow the rest at the slightest touch.

The pier is just as dangerous as it looks; anyone stepping onto it causes the entire pier to give way and fall into the 3 feet of water beneath it. The sucking mud beneath it is greater difficult terrain.

World State

@Macro[lTRp4OBk4ueE63AE]{A24 - Pier Collapse}

If the heroes collapse the pier, click on the above macro to toggle the state of the tile- and play a sound effect as it splinters beneath them!

Encounter

Low 1

@Actor[x3eOZvKUginj5Blh]{Flickerwisp}

60 XP

A single flickerwisp dwells amid the rotting ruins of this old pier. When it notices the heroes, it begins to glow and writhe, appearing alternately as a string of flickering fireflies or a rippling ribbon of light just above the gaping hole in the pier. Anyone who steps onto this section of the pier runs the risk of falling through, and the flickerwisp quickly attacks a victim who gets stuck in the mud. The flickerwisp is eager to sup on frustration and confusion; it doesn't retreat once a fight begins, even if it's outmatched.

Glow

The Flickerwisp's Glow ability means that, although invisible, it generates bright light. There is a light placed at the end of the pier which you can use to lure the heroes onto the weakened section without revealing the creature's token- at least until it's ready to strike!

Once the Flickerwisp is revealed to be a creature, simply run this macro to make it visible, while hiding the scene's ambient light.

@Macro[Rjype0R8A2jawF7b]{A24 - Flickerwisp Reveal}

A25. Gauntlight Cupola.name: A25. 凄凉灯塔穹顶 A25. Gauntlight Cupola
A25. Gauntlight Cupola.text:
进入穹顶

@Scene[9hB3ZY7buScJPXEy]{A - 凄凉灯塔穹顶}

当玩家从区域 @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11} 沿楼梯上到凄凉灯塔穹顶时，你需要将他们的指示物放置在活板门附近。

如果你在使用 FoundryVTT 的 VTT 就绪地图，你可以在侧边栏的场景标签中，01: 雾中的灯塔 文件夹下找到独立的穹顶地图。务必将其设为当前激活的场景，这样你的玩家就能看到它！

一排排黑色金属栅栏如同牢笼般包围着这间圆形密室。栅栏之间闪动着波光粼粼的力场，令整片区域仿佛被柔和发光的玻璃包裹。北侧地面上有一扇铁制活板门；除此之外，这房间看起来空无一物，唯有一处人形大小的玻璃与铁的包覆体在令人不安、几乎令人作呕的淡蓝色微光中闪动并发光——凄凉灯塔的灯笼！

这间房间地板上上锁的活板门向下通往 @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Gauntlight Base}。

遭遇

中等 1

@Actor[NQ6qRvpD9DIwVxt3]{吸血魔雾}

80 XP

如果英雄在下方区域 @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11} 击败了贝科拉之血的祟灵后进入此区域，那团血已蜿蜒流淌并覆上凄凉灯塔的灯笼。当英雄进入房间时，它从灯笼上滑落并转化为一团饥渴嗜血的吸血魔雾，立刻发起攻击，战至死亡。

只要英雄持续在区域 @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11} 触发并击败该祟灵，此遭遇就可能重复发生，但每晚不会出现超过一次。

Moving into the Cupola

@Scene[9hB3ZY7buScJPXEy]{A - Gauntlight Cupola}

When the players ascend the stairs to the Gauntlight Cupola from area @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11}, you'll need to place their tokens down near the trapdoor.

If you're using the VTT-ready maps from FoundryVTT, you can find the standalone Cupola map under the 01: A Light In The Fog folder in the scenes tab of your sidebar. Make sure to set it as the active scene so that your players are viewing it!

Rows of black metal bars encase this circular chamber like a cage. Shimmering waves of force flicker between the bars and gives the illusion that softly glowing glass encases this entire area. The floor to the north has an iron trapdoor; otherwise, this room appears empty save for a human-sized encasement of glass and iron that flickers and glows with an unsettling, almost nauseating pale blue shimmer—Gauntlight’s lantern!

The locked trap door in the floor of this room leads down to the @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{Gauntlight Base}.

Encounter

Moderate 1

@Actor[NQ6qRvpD9DIwVxt3]{Vampiric Mist}

80 XP

If the heroes enter this area after defeating the blood of Belcorra haunt in area @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11} below, that blood has slithered and flowed over Gauntlight’s lantern. As the heroes enter the chamber, it slides off the lantern and transforms into a ravenous blood-drinking vampiric mist which attacks at once, fighting to the death.

This encounter can repeat as often as the heroes continue to trigger and defeat the haunt in area @UUID[.JNlpc7pDiBmm5RGj]{A11}, but it doesn't occur more than once per night.

Chapter 1: A Light In The Fog.name: 第一章：雾中的灯塔 Chapter 1: A Light In The Fog
Chapter 1: A Light In The Fog.text:
章节概要

憎恨魔窟的上层——也是唯一位于地表之上的等级——是名为凄凉灯塔要塞（Gauntlight Keep）的一座巨大建筑的废墟。尽管要塞的上层已经坍塌到下层（令许多残存房间堆满瓦砾），仍有一处显眼结构留存：@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}，一座巨大的灯塔，不合时宜地矗立在名为@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.dMyS4bNbb1diRzow]{Fogfen}的大沼泽中央。在这里，英雄们可能遭遇倒霉却凶残的螨精、贝科拉时代遗留下来的危险，以及凄凉灯塔从下方某处深处汲取力量的证据。

凄凉灯塔废墟

当英雄们首次接近@Scene[3Nat4ImT49niZUdr]{凄凉灯塔要塞}的废墟时，朗读或转述以下内容。

青蛙与蚊虫的声音混杂在一起，伴随着水拍打泥泞岸边的哗啦声，全都被雾隐沼泽名副其实、无处不在的薄雾所闷住。随着雾气稍稍散开，一道幽影从令人窒闷的沼泽水汽中浮现——一片由石与木构成的庞大废墟蜷伏在湿透的沼地中一座小岛上。上层楼面大多已经坍塌，只剩地面层的石墙尚且完整。在废墟之上矗立着一座格格不入的纪念碑——一座巨大的灯塔，其涂漆的墙面与铁包的塔冠抵御住了周围沼泽的腐蚀效果。

尽管杂草丛生的小径一直通向区域@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01}，英雄们仍可通过其他入口进入废墟。沿南侧，环绕废墟的水域相对较浅；但在其他侧面，水深在10到15英尺之间，需要乘船或游泳才能通过。

特征

环境线索：

粗糙的涂鸦、先前蹲居者的痕迹、瓦砾堆、霉菌与蔓生植物的过度生长、积水水洼、乱窜的害虫、溅水声、沼泽气味。

除凄凉灯塔的灯室（cupola）@UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.6wFkYYY7f8SqcRy8]{A25}之外，凄凉灯塔要塞的上层很久以前就已坍塌，甚至在某些地方坠落到地面层。凄凉灯塔要塞地图上标注为瓦砾的区域上方直通天空，并视为困难地形。若屋顶未塌陷，天花板高度为10英尺，除非另有说明。本等级唯一的照明来自穿过常年浓雾过滤进来的些许阳光。本等级的门全都开裂腐朽，除非另有标注；以任何程度的力量去摆弄它们，都会导致它们裂开，或伴随潮湿的木屑爆裂声，直接从铰链上脱落。

凄凉灯塔受到魔法保护，免受伤害，如@UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{here}所述。这层保护也在一定程度上渗入周围废墟，使其在过去500年里放缓了通常的衰败速度。然而，时代无情，其余废墟仍在数个世纪的流逝中饱受摧残。

Chapter Synopsis

The upper level of the Abomination Vaults—and the only level aboveground—is the ruin of a large structure called Gauntlight Keep. Although the upper levels of the keep have collapsed into the lower level (filling many of the remaining rooms with rubble), one prominent structure remains: @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.efRUYLBH9Kf3CLkX]{Gauntlight}, a massive lighthouse placed incongruously in the middle of a large swamp called the @UUID[JournalEntry.67686KaEPc6XAlKJ.JournalEntryPage.dMyS4bNbb1diRzow]{Fogfen}. Here, the heroes can encounter hapless but vicious mitflits, dangers left from Belcorra’s day, and evidence that Gauntlight draws upon power from somewhere deep below.

Ruins of Gauntlight

As the heroes approach the ruins of @Scene[3Nat4ImT49niZUdr]{Gauntlight Keep} for the first time, read or paraphrase the following.

The sound of frogs and mosquitoes mixes with water sloshing against muddy shores, all muffled by the ever-present mists that linger in the aptly named Fogfen. As the mists clear, a shadow looms from the cloying swamp vapors- a sprawling ruin of stone and wood squats atop an island in the soggy marsh. The upper floors have largely collapsed, leaving only the stone walls of the ground floor intact. Above these ruins towers an out-of-place monument—a colossal lighthouse whose painted walls and iron-cased crown have resisted the corrosive effects of the surrounding swamp.

While the overgrown trail leads right to area @UUID[JournalEntry.kDJSn9wbVvjnqYEj.JournalEntryPage.tLAbtqjMjDw2qq1h]{A01}, the heroes can access the ruins through other entrances. Along the southern side, waters surrounding the ruins are relatively shallow, but on other sides, the depth ranges from 10 to 15 feet, requiring a boat or swimming to navigate.

Features

Environmental Cues:

Crude graffiti, evidence of prior squatters, mounds of rubble, overgrowth of mold and creeping plants, puddles of standing water, scuttling vermin, splashing water, swampy odors.
